title: TAPe+ML: A Compact Structured Representation for Multi-Task Computer Vision
comment: 39 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://ml.comexp.net
summary:
We present TAPe+ML v3, a compact computer vision system based on TAPe (Theory of Active Perception), a structured representation that encodes relations among perceptual elements before recognition. Instead of operating directly on pixel tensors, the system uses a shared TAPe representation and a modular recognition architecture for image classification, object detection, and instance segmentation.
  TAPe+ML v3 combines background and contour processing, local object localization, prototype-based classification, and a coordinator for specialized submodels. Across the reported experiments, it uses fewer than 100,000 parameters. On COCO object detection, it obtains 84.7 mAP50 and 65.3 mAP50-95. On COCO instance segmentation, it obtains 80.7 mask mAP50 and 58.4 mask mAP50-95. In classification experiments, it reaches 92 percent validation accuracy on Imagenette under an identical-training comparison with a raw-pixel baseline, and 89.9 percent Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-Real. We also evaluate compactness in video scene detection and adaptation under distribution shift in an industrial pilot. The results suggest that shifting part of the modeling burden from network parameters to a structured input representation can support compact multi-task vision systems with reduced data, memory, and compute requirements.

AI.tldr: 提出 TAPe+ML v3 紧凑视觉系统，基于 TAPe 结构化表示（编码感知元素间关系，先于识别阶段），用共享表示与模块化架构统一支持图像分类、目标检测与实例分割，参数量不足 10 万，在 COCO 检测/分割及 ImageNet-Real 分类等任务上取得较强性能。
AI.motivation: 传统计算机视觉直接对像素张量建模，模型容量与计算/内存开销大，且需大量数据。作者希望将部分建模负担从网络参数转移到结构化输入表示上，以降低数据、内存与算力需求，同时支持多任务。
AI.method: 构建 TAPe（Theory of Active Perception）共享结构化表示，在识别前编码感知元素间关系；系统不直接处理像素张量。TAPe+ML v3 采用模块化识别架构，包含背景与轮廓处理、局部目标定位、基于原型的分类，以及协调各专用子模型的协调器，统一用于分类、检测与分割。
AI.result: 参数量少于 100,000。COCO 目标检测：84.7 mAP50、65.3 mAP50-95；COCO 实例分割：80.7 mask mAP50、58.4 mask mAP50-95。分类：相同训练条件下 Imagenette 验证准确率 92%（对比原始像素基线），ImageNet-Real Top-1 89.9%。另在视频场景检测紧凑性与工业试点分布偏移适应中进行了评估。
AI.conclusion: 将部分建模负担由网络参数转移至结构化输入表示，可支撑紧凑的多任务视觉系统，并降低数据、内存与计算需求。

title: MemeTAG: Keyword-Driven Meme Classification through Tag Embedding Reconstruction
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures; published in the Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV), 2026
summary: The proliferation of harmful internet memes poses a significant societal threat, yet their automated classification remains a formidable algorithmic challenge due to the nuanced, multimodal nature of their content. To address this, we introduce MemeTAG, a novel dual-objective framework that pioneers a keyword-aware approach to meme classification. Our core innovation is a two-part semantic guidance mechanism: first, we leverage a pretrained Vision-Language Model to generate a set of descriptive keywords, that capture the high-level semantics. Second, we introduce the Aggregated Tag Inference Network (ATIN), an attention-based module that distills these keywords into a single, rich semantic embedding. This embedding serves as a target for a novel auxiliary reconstruction loss, which compels the model to learn deeply aligned visual and textual features. This approach, combined with an efficient three-stage training strategy, establishes a new state-of-the-art on the HarMeme, Hateful Memes Challenge (HMC), and PrideMM datasets, decisively outperforming existing state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出MemeTAG双目标框架，通过关键词感知的语义引导机制进行有害网络模因分类，在三数据集上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 有害网络模因泛滥构成社会威胁，但其内容具有细微的多模态特性，自动化分类难度大。
AI.method: 两部分语义引导机制：①用预训练视觉-语言模型生成描述性关键词以捕获高层语义；②提出基于注意力的聚合标签推理网络（ATIN），将关键词蒸馏为单一语义嵌入，并作为新型辅助重构损失的目标，促使视觉与文本特征深度对齐；配合高效三阶段训练策略。
AI.result: 在HarMeme、Hateful Memes Challenge（HMC）和PrideMM数据集上均达到新的最优性能，显著超越现有SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: 关键词感知语义引导与辅助重构损失的结合有效提升了多模态有害模因分类性能。

title: Image-Derived PM10 Estimation in Cattle Feedlot Using Machine Learning: Addressing Concentration Ranges Beyond Existing Digital Imaging Methods
summary: Affordable dust monitoring remains a pressing need for the cattle feedlot industry, yet camera-based PM estimation, despite its growing body of research in urban air quality settings, has not been evaluated under the extended concentration ranges characteristic of intensive livestock operations. This study developed an image-based approach using contrast panel features and machine learning to estimate PM10 concentrations in a commercial cattle feedlot, where hourly average PM10 ranged from 250 to 1,000 ug/m^-3 and instantaneous concentrations reached 5,000 to 20,000 ug/m^-3. Grayscale images were captured during the evening dust peak period, and features including panel contrast, black and white panel pixel values, and overall image brightness were extracted. The model also incorporated recent past values from preceding images and solar zenith angle as predictors. Among the candidate models evaluated, XGBoost achieved the highest predictive performance, with an R^2 of 0.792 and a median absolute error of 103 ug/m^-3. Feature importance analysis revealed that (a) panels positioned farthest from the camera contributed most strongly to predictions and (b) that black panel pixel values were more sensitive than white panel values to changes in PM10 concentration. Prediction accuracy during the sunset transition, which coincides with the onset of the feedlot evening dust peak, remains an area for further refinement. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of image-based PM10 estimation across PM concentration ranges substantially exceeding those reported in prior urban studies and provide practical guidelines for future deployment in feedlot environments.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一种基于对比面板图像特征与机器学习的方法，用于估算商业牛饲养场中PM10浓度，XGBoost模型取得R²=0.792、中位绝对误差103 μg/m⁻³的预测性能，验证了图像法在远超城市研究的PM浓度范围内的可行性。
AI.motivation: 牛饲养场行业对低成本粉尘监测存在迫切需求；尽管基于摄像头的PM估算在城市空气质量领域研究日益增多，但尚未在集约化畜牧作业特有的高浓度范围（小时均值250–1,000 μg/m⁻³、瞬时5,000–20,000 μg/m⁻³）下得到评估。
AI.method: 在商业牛饲养场傍晚粉尘峰值时段采集灰度图像，提取对比面板对比度、黑白面板像素值、整体图像亮度等特征，并引入前序图像的历史值与太阳天顶角作为预测因子，采用多种候选模型（含XGBoost）进行PM10估算并开展特征重要性分析。
AI.result: XGBoost预测性能最佳，R²=0.792，中位绝对误差103 μg/m⁻³；特征重要性显示距相机最远的面板贡献最大，且黑色面板像素值比白色面板对PM10变化更敏感；日落过渡期（与傍晚粉尘峰值起始重合）的预测精度仍有待改进。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了图像法PM10估算在显著超过以往城市研究的浓度范围内的可行性，并为饲养场环境的未来部署提供了实用指南，同时指出日落过渡期精度提升为后续研究方向。

title: Fragment-Aware Vision Transformers for Fresco-Fragment Style Classification
summary: Artistic style classification is usually studied on complete artworks, where models can exploit global composition, spatial organisation, and iconographic structure. In archaeological settings, however, artworks often survive only as fragmented remains, forcing recognition from incomplete, irregular, and context-limited visual evidence. We study fresco-fragment style classification using a progressive transformer-based framework. Starting from a ViT-B/16 baseline, we introduce foreground-guided masking to suppress background-only tokens, inpainting-based geometric regularisation to align irregular fragment supports with the ViT patch grid, and a supervised contrastive objective that operates on predictive distributions through a Kullback-Leibler similarity and consistently improves every branch. We combine the branches with a deliberately simple learnable logit ensemble. Experiments on CLEOPATRA and POMPAAF show that fragment-aware modelling improves over the standard ViT baseline, with the ensemble increasing accuracy from 0.604 to 0.656 and macro-F1 from 0.596 to 0.648 on CLEOPATRA, and outperforming the best single branch in four of six fragmentation settings on POMPAAF. We additionally evaluate a more complex graph-fusion variant and find that it matches the simple ensemble on POMPAAF while offering only a small, dataset-specific gain on CLEOPATRA, which does not justify its added complexity. Beyond these empirical gains, our contribution is twofold: a distribution-level contrastive objective that consistently sharpens single-branch recognition, and an interpretability analysis that verifies the models exploit genuine painted evidence, while quantifying that the inpainting-based branch draws part of its attribution from the synthesised surround.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究壁画碎片（fresco fragment）的艺术风格分类，提出渐进式 Transformer 框架：前景引导掩码、基于修复的几何正则化、基于 KL 相似度的分布级监督对比目标，并用简单可学习 logit 集成融合各分支。在 CLEOPATRA 与 POMPAAF 上超过 ViT 基线，并指出复杂图融合变体不值得其额外复杂度。
AI.motivation: 现有艺术风格分类通常针对完整艺术品，模型可利用全局构图、空间组织与图像志结构；但在考古场景中艺术品常仅以碎片形式存留，识别只能依赖不完整、不规则且缺乏上下文的视觉证据。因此需要针对碎片化证据的建模方法。
AI.method: 以 ViT-B/16 为基线，构建渐进式分支：(1) 前景引导掩码，抑制纯背景 token；(2) 基于修复（inpainting）的几何正则化，使不规则碎片支撑区域对齐 ViT patch 网格；(3) 在预测分布上通过 KL 相似度实现的监督对比目标。各分支用刻意简单的可学习 logit 集成融合；另评估更复杂的图融合变体。
AI.result: CLEOPATRA 上准确率从 0.604 提升至 0.656，macro-F1 从 0.596 提升至 0.648；POMPAAF 上在 6 种碎片设置中的 4 种优于最佳单分支。图融合变体在 POMPAAF 上与简单集成持平，在 CLEOPATRA 上仅有小幅且依赖数据集的增益。
AI.conclusion: 碎片感知建模优于标准 ViT 基线，简单 logit 集成有效。主要贡献有二：一是分布级对比目标能稳定提升单分支识别性能；二是可解释性分析验证模型确实利用真实绘画证据，同时量化出修复分支的部分归因来自合成周边区域。

title: MAGIC: Marginal-Guided Compression with Optimal Transport for Efficient Visual Document Retrieval
summary: Recent visual document retrieval (VDR) systems such as ColPali use multi-vector page embeddings, in which patch-level vectors enable fine-grained evidence matching but incur substantial index storage and MaxSim scoring overhead. Post-hoc merging offers a practical route to efficient VDR by reducing this cost without retraining the retriever, but its uniform reconstruction objectives are poorly aligned with the sparse, non-uniform patch usage induced by late-interaction retrieval. Under aggressive compression, this misalignment can preserve rarely used patches while concentrating retrieval activity on too few retained representatives. To address this misalignment, we propose Marginal-Guided Compression with Optimal Transport (MAGIC), a training-free post-hoc compressor for efficient retrieval with frozen multi-vector embeddings. MAGIC derives a MaxSim-induced compression surrogate and optimizes it through a two-marginal entropic optimal-transport formulation, where a retrieval-demand source marginal prioritizes high-use patches and a balanced target marginal regularizes retained-facet usage. Across ViDoRe benchmarks, keep ratios, and retrieval backbones, MAGIC consistently outperforms strong post-hoc compressors, with particularly large gains in the aggressive-compression regime; component ablations verify the complementary effects of its two marginals. We release the code at: https://github.com/xandery-geek/MAGIC.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的后处理压缩器 MAGIC，通过最优传输对齐补丁使用分布，缓解多向量文档检索在激进压缩下的性能退化。
AI.motivation: ColPali 等多向量视觉文档检索依赖 patch 级嵌入实现细粒度匹配，但带来巨大的索引存储和 MaxSim 打分开销。后处理合并可在不重训练检索器的前提下降低成本，但其均匀重建目标与 late-interaction 检索导致的稀疏、非均匀 patch 使用不匹配，激进压缩下会保留少用 patch 而将检索活动集中于过少的保留代表。
AI.method: MAGIC：面向冻结多向量嵌入的免训练后处理压缩器。推导 MaxSim 诱导的压缩代理目标，并用双边缘熵最优传输优化：检索需求源边缘优先高使用率 patch，平衡目标边缘正则化保留 facet 的使用。
AI.result: 在 ViDoRe 基准、不同保留率和检索骨干上，MAGIC 持续优于强后处理压缩器，激进压缩场景增益尤为显著；组件消融验证了两个边缘的互补作用。
AI.conclusion: MAGIC 以最优传输对齐检索需求，实现高效视觉文档检索的无训练压缩，代码已开源。

title: MarsFM: Shading-Regularized Flow Matching for Martian Relief Estimation
summary: We present MarsFM, an image-conditioned latent flow-matching model for local Martian relief estimation from single-band HiRISE RED orthoimagery. The method combines a pretrained generative prior with stereo-derived geometric supervision and a differentiable Lunar--Lambert shading objective. Relief, normal, gradient, curvature, and ordinal terms constrain complementary aspects of terrain structure, while a positive-affine-invariant image comparison constrains rendered appearance. An evaluation comprising 2024 gathered patch records per integration-step count yields mean affine-aligned RMSE between 0.0935 and 0.0957 in normalized signed-log relief space for one to twenty Euler steps. These scores measure agreement with VAE-reconstructed references on positive-reference support. Their narrow range supports low-step inference under this protocol. Spatial, differential, and spectral diagnostics show broad terrain correspondence alongside smoothing, amplitude compression, and boundary mismatch. MarsFM provides a framework for combining learned terrain priors with image-based constraints; establishing improved physical terrain resolution requires matched baselines and independent high-resolution reference data. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/SuperComputer/mars_hirise_dtm_processed-6aa9b66ba461e07f; code: https://github.com/Marius-Juston/MarsRecon.

AI.tldr: 提出MarsFM：一种图像条件潜空间流匹配模型，用单波段HiRISE RED正射影像估计火星局部地形起伏，结合生成先验、立体派生几何监督与可微Lunar-Lambert着色目标。
AI.motivation: 火星高分辨率地形（relief）恢复缺乏物理参考，需将学习到地形先验与影像约束结合；同时探索少步推理的可行性。
AI.method: 图像条件潜空间流匹配，融合预训练生成先验、立体派生几何监督、可微Lunar-Lambert着色目标；约束项包括relief、normal、gradient、curvature、ordinal及正仿射不变的影像比较。
AI.result: 固定训练步数下评估2024个patch记录；1至20步Euler采样在归一化signed-log relief空间获得0.0935–0.0957的仿射对齐RMSE（对VAE重建参考、正参考支撑），区间窄支持低步推理。空间/微分/谱诊断显示整体地形吻合，但存在平滑、振幅压缩与边界失配。
AI.conclusion: MarsFM为“学习地形先验+影像约束”提供框架；提升物理地形分辨率仍需匹配基线与独立高分辨率参考数据。

title: 4DGS-Fixer: Generative Sparse-View 4D Gaussian Splatting with Iterative Refinement Guided by Video Diffusion Priors
summary: This paper addresses the challenges of dynamic scene synthesis from sparse-view videos. Existing methods employ geometric priors, adaptive optimization, or density-control strategies to improve 4D Gaussian modeling under sparse observations. However, they cannot fundamentally resolve the ill-posed problem caused by insufficient observations and missing scene information. Moreover, sparse-view 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) often suffers from poor geometric initialization: with only a few input views, COLMAP typically reconstructs sparse and incomplete point clouds, leaving large scene regions without sufficient Gaussian support and making them difficult to recover through subsequent optimization. To address these limitations, we propose a novel iterative refinement framework based on a video diffusion model to improve the completeness and consistency of dynamic 4D scenes. Specifically, we first estimate multi-view depth maps and fuse them into dense point clouds to provide more complete geometric initialization for a dynamic 4DGS representation. We then employ a pretrained video restoration model to refine sequences rendered along novel camera trajectories at different time steps. The restored sequences serve as pseudo-supervision to regularize and iteratively refine the 4DGS representation. Experiments on a widely used benchmark dataset demonstrate that our method substantially outperforms existing baselines, achieving nearly a 2 dB PSNR improvement over the previous best-performing method.

AI.tldr: 提出基于视频扩散模型的迭代细化框架，通过稠密点云初始化和视频修复伪监督，显著提升稀疏视角动态4D场景重建质量。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角视频下的动态场景合成存在观测不足与场景信息缺失导致的病态问题；同时稀疏视角4DGS的几何初始化质量差，COLMAP仅能重建稀疏不完整的点云，大量区域缺乏足够高斯支持，后续优化难以恢复。现有几何先验、自适应优化或密度控制策略无法从根本上解决该问题。
AI.method: 提出基于视频扩散模型的迭代细化框架：1）先估计多视角深度图并融合为稠密点云，为动态4DGS表示提供更完整的几何初始化；2）利用预训练视频修复模型，对新视角轨迹在不同时间步渲染的序列进行细化；3）将修复后的序列作为伪监督，对4DGS表示进行正则化与迭代细化。
AI.result: 在广泛使用的基准数据集上，方法大幅超越现有基线，相较此前最佳方法取得近2 dB的PSNR提升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，结合稠密几何初始化与视频扩散/修复模型的伪监督迭代细化，可有效缓解稀疏视角4DGS的病态性与初始化缺陷，提升动态场景的完整性与一致性。

title: OnomatoBridge: Onomatopoeia Translation and Rendering Pipeline in Manga
summary: Manga is a comic drawn by black and white paints gaining popularity around the world. Onomatopoeia in Manga specifically appeals to the audience with its unique visual styles, which convey sound, motion, and emotion. Visual onomatopoeia translation requires the clean replacement of Japanese onomatopoeia with onomatopoeia in the other language while preserving their visual style. Existing approaches often produce residual artifacts or style inconsistency when removing the Japanese onomatopoeia and rendering stylized English onomatopoeia. To approach these problems, we present OnomatoBridge, a filtering pipeline for visual onomatopoeia translation. We evaluate OnomatoBridge from Japanese to English on the Manga109 onomatopoeia dataset and compare it with baseline image editing models. Experimental results show that the filtered outputs by the proposed method outperform those of conventional methods. OnomatoBridge improves English text correctness by roughly 10 to 25 points and reduces residual Japanese text by about 20 to 50% in relative terms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OnomatoBridge，一种面向漫画视觉拟声词翻译的过滤流水线，实现将日文拟声词干净替换为英文拟声词并保持视觉风格，在 Manga109 数据集上相较基线图像编辑模型提升英文文本正确性约 10–25 个点，并相对减少约 20–50% 的日文残留。
AI.motivation: 漫画中的拟声词以独特视觉风格传达声音、动作与情感，其翻译需在替换为目标语言拟声词的同时保留原有视觉风格。现有方法在去除日文拟声词与渲染风格化英文拟声词时，常产生残留伪影或风格不一致问题。
AI.method: 提出 OnomatoBridge，一种用于视觉拟声词翻译的过滤流水线（filtering pipeline），针对日文到英文的翻译任务，在 Manga109 拟声词数据集上与基线图像编辑模型进行对比评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，经 OnomatoBridge 过滤后的输出优于传统方法：英文文本正确性提升约 10–25 个点，日文残留文本相对减少约 20–50%。
AI.conclusion: OnomatoBridge 能有效缓解拟声词替换中的残留伪影与风格不一致问题，在漫画视觉拟声词翻译任务上取得优于基线的表现。

title: Hand-Aware Transition Modeling for Bimanual Procedural Anomaly Detection
summary: Procedural anomaly detection in bimanual assembly requires judging each hand action against the execution so far. A corrective action may look unusual in isolation, while a visually plausible action can violate the order of the procedure. We present HACT, a transition model over predicted per-hand events. A role-preserving history keeps the concurrent responsibilities of both hands, and a marked temporal point process assigns each observed transition a semantic and temporal surprisal. A supervised evidence head and a two-state filter convert these surprisals into per-hand anomaly posteriors. A recovery-aware protocol on predicted events and participant-disjoint folds reports the recovery false-positive rate at an operating point selected on validation participants. On two bimanual power-tool procedures HACT has the highest AUPRC and F1 among the compared methods and the fewest recovery alarms. Applied without retraining to a different assembly order of the same product, it retains the highest AUPRC and F1. The source code is available at https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/HACT.

AI.tldr: HACT：基于预测单手事件的过渡模型，用角色保持历史与带标记时序点过程计算语义/时间意外度，经监督证据头与双状态滤波输出单手异常后验，在双手电动工具流程上取得最优AUPRC/F1与最少恢复误报，并可跨装配顺序零重训迁移。
AI.motivation: 双手装配中的程序性异常检测需将每只手的动作与已执行过程对照判断：纠正性动作单独看似异常，视觉合理动作却可能违反工序顺序，因此不能仅依赖单帧外观或孤立动作。
AI.method: 提出HACT过渡模型，建模预测的单手事件序列；角色保持历史保留双手并发职责；带标记时序点过程为每次观测过渡分配语义意外度与时间意外度；监督证据头与双状态滤波器将其转换为单手异常后验；评估采用基于预测事件的恢复感知协议与参与者不相交折，并在验证参与者上选点。
AI.result: 在两个双手电动工具流程上，HACT的AUPRC与F1均高于对比方法，恢复报警最少；不重训直接应用于同一产品的不同装配顺序时，仍保持最高AUPRC与F1。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明基于预测事件过渡与双重意外度建模能有效判别程序性异常并抑制恢复动作误报，且具备跨装配顺序泛化能力；代码已开源。

title: Multi-viewpoint Geo-localization with Event Cameras
summary: Robot localization is an ongoing challenge that demands mapping and positioning systems that are tolerant to viewpoint change. Event cameras are attracting increasing interest and adoption in robotics; however, dealing with viewpoint variance is an under-investigated problem in existing event-based localizers. In addition, event-based datasets that emphasize viewpoint variance for challenging localization situations are scarce. Here, we introduce an event-based visual place recognition (VPR) system that performs robustly under viewpoint changes. We converted five large-scale geo-tagged datasets, conventionally used to train frame-based localization systems, into synthetic event streams using Image-to-Event (I2E) conversion, and used them to fine-tune a pre-trained event-based vision transformer backbone with a multi-loss function, yielding a system we call MegaEvent that learns viewpoint-robust features for place recognition. We achieved an average Recall@1 of 82% across three existing event-based localization datasets, leading the next best event-based method by 20 recall points, and frame-based VPR models applied directly to event frames by 8 to 26 recall points. We introduce a new, challenging dataset - Springfield-Event-VPR - which features a 3.7km walking route recorded in three camera orientations for a total of 11.1km, which MegaEvent outperforms the strongest baseline by 9 recall points. The code for MegaEvent is available at https://github.com/AdamDHines/megaevent.

AI.tldr: 提出MegaEvent事件相机视觉位置识别系统，通过I2E将大规模帧数据集转为合成事件流微调预训练事件ViT，实现视角鲁棒定位，并发布Springfield-Event-VPR新数据集。
AI.motivation: 机器人定位需对视角变化鲁棒，事件相机受关注但现有事件定位器对视角变化研究不足，且缺乏强调视角变化的事件数据集。
AI.method: 将5个大规模地理标注帧数据集经Image-to-Event(I2E)转为合成事件流，用多损失函数微调预训练的事件视觉Transformer骨干，得到MegaEvent，学习视角鲁棒的位置识别特征。
AI.result: 在3个现有事件定位数据集上平均Recall@1达82%，领先次优事件方法20个召回点，领先直接用于事件帧的帧式VPR模型8–26个召回点；新数据集Springfield-Event-VPR（3.7km步行路线、三种相机朝向、共11.1km）上领先最强基线9个召回点。
AI.conclusion: MegaEvent在视角变化下实现鲁棒的事件视觉位置识别，显著超越事件与帧式基线，并提供了具有视角变化挑战的新数据集，代码已开源。

title: VGGT-CAD: Reconstructing Parametric CAD 3D Model with Geometric Grounding
summary: Parametric CAD reconstruction requires recovering both precise geometry and editable modeling operations from visual observations, making it challenging under limited and ambiguous views. Existing methods mainly rely on 2D appearance cues and lack strong multi-view geometric priors. In this work, we present VGGT-CAD, a geometry-aware framework for parametric CAD reconstruction from single- and multi-view observations. We transfer pretrained 3D geometric priors into CAD reconstruction by encoding camera parameters as condition tokens and jointly modeling them with image tokens. To handle varying numbers of viewpoints, we introduce a variable-view cross-view context aggregation module that adaptively fuses multi-view features. We further develop a training-free geometry-aware view selection strategy to select complementary and reliable frames during inference. The resulting representation is decoded into CAD command sequences using a non-autoregressive decoder. We also develop VideoCAD, a large-scale multi-view video benchmark derived from existing CAD data through multi-view re-rendering. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of VGGT-CAD for visual CAD reconstruction under different observation configurations.

AI.tldr: VGGT-CAD：将预训练3D几何先验迁移至参数化CAD重建，支持单/多视角输入，并构建VideoCAD多视角视频基准。
AI.motivation: 从视觉观测恢复参数化CAD需同时获得精确几何与可编辑建模操作，在视角有限且模糊的情况下极具挑战；现有方法主要依赖2D外观线索，缺乏强多视角几何先验。
AI.method: 将预训练3D几何先验迁移至CAD重建：把相机参数编码为条件token并与图像token联合建模；提出可变视角跨视角上下文聚合模块以自适应融合多视角特征；设计免训练、几何感知的视角选择策略在推理时挑选互补可靠帧；用非自回归解码器将表示解码为CAD命令序列；并通过多视角重渲染构建大规模多视角视频基准VideoCAD。
AI.result: 大量实验证明VGGT-CAD在不同观测配置下的视觉CAD重建中均有效。
AI.conclusion: 几何感知框架结合多视角几何先验与灵活视角融合，可提升单/多视角参数化CAD重建的鲁棒性与有效性。

title: Multiclass Semantic Segmentation of Wildland Fire Images Using Context-Aware Centralized Copy-Paste Data Augmentation
summary: Producing accurate annotations for deep learning based image segmentation is both costly and labor intensive. This challenge is especially evident in wildland fire applications, where accurately labeled datasets are scarce due to the difficulty of collecting and annotating dynamic fire scenes. To address this problem, our previous work introduced the Centralized Copy-Paste Data Augmentation (CCPDA) method for semantic segmentation of wildland fire imagery, which generates artificial training samples by randomly pasting fire clusters from source images onto target images. However, random placement can produce contextually unrealistic scenes, such as fire burning on asphalt. In this paper, we present a context-aware strategy designed specifically to improve data quality and realism in small multiclass wildland fire datasets, ensuring that augmented samples remain contextually meaningful. The proposed method restricts fire placement to semantically valid target regions and selects the location whose Ash-Vegetation composition most closely matches the source context. This approach preserves existing fire regions in the target image, prevents unrealistic placements, and maintains contextual accuracy by generating images that resemble real wildland fire scenes. We evaluate the Context-Aware CCPDA strategy through numerical analysis and comparisons with other augmentation methods by a weighted sum-based multi-objective optimization (MOO) approach. The results confirm that the context-aware data augmentation strategy leads to improved segmentation performance and contextual realism, outperforming other augmentation procedures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Context-Aware CCPDA，通过语义约束与源-目标上下文匹配改进野火图像分割的数据增强，在分割性能与上下文真实性上优于其他方法。
AI.motivation: 野火图像分割的精确标注成本高、劳动力密集，且动态火场数据难以收集标注，导致标注数据集稀缺。作者前作CCPDA通过随机粘贴火簇生成样本，但随机放置会产生不符合语境的场景（如火烧在沥青上）。
AI.method: 提出上下文感知策略：将火灾粘贴限制在语义有效的目标区域，并选择Ash-Vegetation组成与源上下文最匹配的位置；同时保留目标图像中已有的火区域，避免不真实放置。通过数值分析及与其他增强方法的对比，采用加权和的多目标优化（MOO）进行评估。
AI.result: 上下文感知的数据增强策略带来更好的分割性能和上下文真实性，优于其他增强方法。
AI.conclusion: 上下文感知的CCPDA能提升小样本多类野火数据集的质量与真实感，是一种有效的增强方案。

title: SafeStyle: Calibrated Style Residual Injection for Controllable Style-Leakage Trade-off in Diffusion Stylization
summary: Reference-guided diffusion stylization aims to transfer visual style from a reference image while preserving the semantics specified by a text prompt. However, image conditioning often entangles transferable style cues with reference-specific content, leading to an inherent trade-off: stronger conditioning improves style fidelity but increases content leakage, whereas aggressive suppression reduces leakage at the cost of style expression. This challenge is further complicated by the distinct spatial organization of texture- and geometry-dominant styles. To address these issues, we propose SafeStyle, a training-free framework for calibrated style residual injection in frozen diffusion models. SafeStyle first estimates style-supported and content-associated subspaces from compact calibration sets, preserving their informative overlap while suppressing useless content variations. It then transports the purified style evidence over adaptive spatial granularity and constrains its effective influence through an explicit residual-norm budget. Experiments across texture- and geometry-dominant styles show that SafeStyle achieves a DINO style similarity of 0.432 while maintaining competitive text alignment. On a semantically disjoint leakage-stress benchmark, it further achieves a DINO style similarity of 0.474 with only 0.8\% semantic leakage, demonstrating an effective balance between style fidelity and reference-content suppression.

AI.tldr: 提出免除训练框架 SafeStyle，通过校准风格残差注入解耦风格与参考内容，实现风格保真与内容抑制的平衡。
AI.motivation: 参考图条件化易将可迁移风格线索与参考特有内容纠缠，导致风格保真与内容泄漏的固有权衡；且纹理主导与几何主导风格的空间组织差异进一步加剧该问题。
AI.method: 从紧凑校准集估计风格支持子空间与内容关联子空间，保留有用重叠并抑制无用内容变化；随后以自适应空间粒度迁移纯化后的风格证据，并通过显式残差范数预算约束其有效影响；全程在冻结扩散模型上进行、无需训练。
AI.result: 在纹理与几何主导风格上取得 0.432 的 DINO 风格相似度并保持竞争力的文本对齐；在语义不相交的泄漏压力基准上取得 0.474 的 DINO 风格相似度，语义泄漏仅 0.8%。
AI.conclusion: SafeStyle 有效平衡风格保真与参考内容抑制，为参考引导的扩散风格化提供免训练且可控的解决方案。

title: Geometry-Aware Diffusion Guidance via Curvature-Adaptive Tubular Correction
summary: Gradient-guided diffusion samplers provide flexible priors for inverse problems and conditional generation, but strong guidance can move the sampling trajectory into regions where the learned score is poorly supported. Existing tangent-projection strategies limit first-order departure from an iso-density surface, yet discard potentially useful normal motion and overlook the second-order departure induced by tangent motion on a curved surface. We introduce curvature-adaptive tubular correction (CAT), a training-free plugin that regulates both effects within a shared, noise-dependent geometric budget. CAT decomposes the guidance gradient into normal and tangent components, charges normal displacement at first order and tangent displacement according to directional curvature, and obtains their jointly optimal magnitudes from a one-dimensional dual equation. Armijo backtracking calibrates the resulting finite step against the actual guidance objective, while matrix-free directional derivatives avoid constructing the full score Jacobian. We establish local guarantees for the tubular approximation, uniqueness of the correction, and sufficient objective decrease. Across seven inverse problems on FFHQ and ImageNet, CAT improves the evaluated pixel- and latent-space host samplers, with particularly consistent gains in perceptual metrics. It also improves black hole reconstruction on InverseBench and yields the lowest FID among the compared methods at every tested classifier-free guidance scale, while maintaining stable saturation and contrast. These results support curvature-aware tubular control as a reusable mechanism for stabilizing diffusion guidance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出曲率自适应管状修正（CAT），一种免训练插件，通过噪声相关几何预算同时调控指导梯度的法向一阶位移与切向二阶（曲率诱导）位移，在七个逆问题及黑洞重建上稳定扩散指导采样并提升感知指标。
AI.motivation: 梯度引导扩散采样器为逆问题和条件生成提供灵活先验，但强引导会把采样轨迹推入学习分数支撑不足的区域。现有切空间投影策略只限制相对等密度面的一阶偏离，丢弃了可能有用的法向运动，也忽视了弯曲表面上切向运动带来的二阶偏离。
AI.method: CAT将引导梯度分解为法向与切向分量，法向位移按一阶计费、切向位移按方向曲率计费，并在共享的噪声相关几何预算内通过一维对偶方程求解二者的联合最优幅度；采用Armijo回溯校准有限步长以匹配真实引导目标，并用无矩阵方向导数避免构造完整分数雅可比。
AI.result: 在FFHQ和ImageNet的七个逆问题上，CAT改进了像素空间与隐空间宿主采样器，感知指标增益尤其稳定；在InverseBench上改善黑洞重建；在所有测试的无分类器引导尺度下取得对比方法中最低FID，并保持稳定的饱和度与对比度。
AI.conclusion: 理论上建立了管状近似的局部保证、修正的唯一性以及目标函数的充分下降；实验表明曲率感知的管状控制是一种可复用的扩散指导稳定机制。

title: Edit-VAR: Taming Visual Autoregressive Model for Precise Video Editing
summary: Text-guided video editing modifies target content while preserving the appearance and temporal coherence of unedited regions. Training-based approaches provide strong control but demand substantial data and computation. Training-free methods fall into inversion-free and inversion-based paradigms. Inversion-free approaches avoid trajectory recovery, but their source-preserving guidance can limit editing strength and leave semantic changes incomplete. Inversion-based approaches recover a latent trajectory before regeneration, where approximation errors can accumulate and cause source-content drift and temporal inconsistency. We introduce Edit-VAR, the first training-free and inversion-free framework for text-guided video editing with a pretrained visual autoregressive video model. Edit-VAR directly encodes the source video into multi-scale discrete tokens and performs probability-guided conditional token replacement for source preservation. Attention-guided token-wise and scale-aware modulation selectively relaxes source constraints over edit-relevant positions and generation stages. Scale-Decoupled Generation, implemented as late-scale constraint release, regenerates motion-consistent details and reduces texture fragmentation. Residual-guided token pruning further exploits redundancy at the final two high-resolution scales to reduce inference cost. Extensive experiments and a blind user study demonstrate that Edit-VAR outperforms existing training-free video editing methods overall in editing fidelity, source preservation, temporal coherence, and inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: Edit-VAR是首个基于预训练视觉自回归视频模型、免训练且免反演的文本引导视频编辑框架，通过概率引导的条件token替换、注意力引导的token级与尺度感知调制，以及尺度解耦生成和残差引导的token剪枝，在编辑保真度、源保持、时序一致性和推理效率上整体优于现有免训练视频编辑方法。
AI.motivation: 文本引导视频编辑需在修改目标内容的同时保持未编辑区域的外观与时序一致性。基于训练的方法控制力强但依赖大量数据和算力；免训练方法分为免反演与基于反演两类：免反演方法虽避免轨迹恢复，但其源保持引导会限制编辑强度、导致语义修改不完整；基于反演的方法需先恢复隐轨迹再生成，近似误差会累积，引发源内容漂移与时序不一致。因此需要一种既免训练、免反演，又能兼顾编辑强度与源保持的视频编辑方案。
AI.method: Edit-VAR基于预训练视觉自回归视频模型，直接将源视频编码为多尺度离散token，并执行概率引导的条件token替换以实现源保持。通过注意力引导的token级与尺度感知调制，在编辑相关位置与生成阶段选择性放松源约束。采用尺度解耦生成（以“后期尺度约束释放”实现），重生成运动一致的细节并减少纹理破碎。此外，利用残差引导的token剪枝，在最后两个高分辨率尺度上挖掘冗余以降低推理开销。
AI.result: 大量实验与盲用户研究表明，Edit-VAR在编辑保真度、源保持、时序一致性以及推理效率四个方面整体优于现有免训练视频编辑方法。
AI.conclusion: Edit-VAR首次将免训练、免反演范式引入基于自回归视频模型的文本引导视频编辑，验证了通过离散token的概率引导替换与多尺度约束调制，可在不训练、不反演的前提下同时提升编辑质量与效率，为视频编辑提供了一条兼顾性能与成本的新路径。

title: Beyond Exact Match: Task-Aware GRPO for Cross-Domain PCBA Visual Question Answering
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026)
summary: In automated Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA) inspection, standards-guided decisions require systems to jointly reason over fine-grained visual cues, component semantics, and manufacturing knowledge. Although large vision-language models (VLMs) provide a promising foundation, their deployment is hindered by the domain shift between standards-derived samples and real-world production-line imagery, together with heterogeneous output spaces spanning choice-based and numerical counting tasks. To address these challenges, we propose a multimodal reasoning framework for cross-domain PCBA visual question answering. The framework converts standards-derived, real-world, and auxiliary PCB-domain data into a unified instruction format and constructs verified reasoning traces aligned with visual evidence, question semantics, candidate options, and ground-truth answers. We further introduce Task-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which moves beyond exact-match supervision by integrating multi-component semantic rewards for choice-based questions, distance-aware rewards for counting questions, and an auxiliary format reward for valid outputs. During inference, answer-option semantic consistency correction, self-consistency voting, and multi-model arbitration are combined to improve prediction robustness. The proposed system achieves an Overall Score of 83.24 on the official PCBA Standard-to-Real Grand Challenge leaderboard, demonstrating the effectiveness of task-aware reward design and robust inference for cross-domain PCBA visual question answering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向跨域PCBA视觉问答的多模态推理框架，通过统一指令格式构建、任务感知GRPO奖励设计与鲁棒推理策略，在官方PCBA Standard-to-Real挑战赛榜单上取得83.24的总体得分。
AI.motivation: PCBA自动检测中，基于标准的决策需要系统联合推理细粒度视觉线索、元件语义与制造知识。尽管大型视觉语言模型（VLM）提供了有前景的基础，但其部署受到两方面阻碍：一是标准衍生样本与真实产线图像之间的域偏移，二是涵盖选择型与数值计数型任务的异构输出空间。因此需要一套能够跨域、兼容异构任务的方案。
AI.method: 提出跨域PCBA视觉问答的多模态推理框架。数据层面，将标准衍生数据、真实世界数据与辅助PCB领域数据转换为统一指令格式，并构建与视觉证据、问题语义、候选选项及标准答案对齐的经校验推理轨迹。训练层面，提出任务感知的组相对策略优化（GRPO），不再依赖精确匹配监督，而是整合面向选择题的多组分语义奖励、面向计数题的距距离感知奖励，以及用于保证输出有效的辅助格式奖励。推理层面，结合答案—选项语义一致性校正、自一致性投票与多模型仲裁以提升预测鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在官方PCBA Standard-to-Real Grand Challenge榜单上取得83.24的总体得分（Overall Score），验证了任务感知奖励设计与鲁棒推理对跨域PCBA视觉问答的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 任务感知奖励设计与鲁棒推理策略能够有效缓解域偏移与异构输出空间带来的困难，为跨域PCBA视觉问答提供了可行且有效的解决路径。

title: Combining Object Detection with Geometry-Aware Clustering to Distinguish Overlapping Plants in UAV Imagery
summary:
Reliable plant-level information from unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery is important for automated crop monitoring. However, in dense crop canopies, adjacent plants frequently overlap and are detected as a single object, reducing the reliability of plant-level measurements. This study presents a geometry-aware post-detection framework for resolving overlapping plant instances using standard RGB UAV imagery.
  The framework combines object detection with geometric clustering of plant components. Leaves or branches detected within each bush-level region are represented using two complementary geometric features: component centroids and radial intersection points (RIPs) derived from detected plant structures. K-means and Gaussian mixture models determine whether a detected region contains a single plant or two overlapping plants. Density filtering suppresses spurious radial intersections, and a post-pipeline ensemble combines spatial and directional geometric information.
  The framework was evaluated using UAV imagery of eggplant and tomato crops under field conditions. Centroid-based clustering achieved an F1-score of 0.89 for eggplant, while the combined centroid-RIP approach achieved the best tomato performance, with an accuracy of 0.80, precision of 1.00, and F1-score of 0.75 using K-means. Density filtering substantially improved RIP-based clustering for tomato.
  The proposed approach provides a lightweight, modular engineering solution that can be integrated with existing RGB UAV monitoring pipelines without additional depth sensors, pixel-level segmentation, three-dimensional reconstruction, or retraining of the primary bush detector. The results demonstrate that geometric reasoning applied to existing detector outputs can complement deep-learning-based object detection and improve plant-level interpretation in dense agricultural canopies.

AI.tldr: 提出一种几何感知的后检测框架，利用RGB无人机影像中植株部件的质心与径向交点（RIP）几何特征，通过K-means与高斯混合模型判断冠层区域为单株或两株重叠，实现重叠植株实例的分离。
AI.motivation: 密集作物冠层中相邻植株常发生重叠，被检测器识别为单一对象，导致植株级测量可靠性下降；而现有方法通常依赖深度传感器、像素级分割、三维重建或重新训练检测器，成本高且不易集成。
AI.method: 将目标检测与植株部件的几何聚类相结合：对每个植株级区域内的叶片或枝条，提取两类互补几何特征——部件质心与由检测到的植株结构导出的径向交点（RIP）；使用K-means和高斯混合模型判别该区域包含单株还是两株重叠植株；引入密度过滤抑制虚假径向交点，并通过后处理集成策略融合空间与方向几何信息。
AI.result: 在田间茄子与番茄的无人机影像上评估：基于质心的聚类在茄子上取得F1=0.89；质心-RIP组合方法在番茄上表现最佳，采用K-means时准确率0.80、精确率1.00、F1=0.75；密度过滤显著提升了番茄的RIP聚类效果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架是一种轻量、模块化的工程方案，无需额外深度传感器、像素级分割、三维重建或重新训练主检测器即可接入现有RGB无人机监测流程，表明几何推理可补充深度学习检测，改善密集农业冠层中的植株级解译。

title: S3VD: Semantic-Guidance Spatio-Temporal Scanning for Video Deraining
summary: Heavy rainfall severely degrades outdoor videos by corrupting high-frequency details and introducing motion blur, critically undermining the reliability of visual tasks. Recently, State Space Models (SSMs), particularly Mamba, have emerged as efficient alternatives for vision tasks with their linear complexity and ability to model long-range dependencies. However, when confronted with the poor visual representations in rainy videos, Mamba still faces difficulties in preserving the integrity of 2D spatial semantics and modeling 3D spatio-temporal correlations. To break these limitations, we introduce S3VD, a Semantic-Guidance Spatio-Temporal Scanning framework for video deraining, featuring two key innovations: Multi-Scale Semantic Fusion (MSSF) Module and Spatio-Temporal Scanning Fusion (STSF) Module. The former integrates temporal semantic priors from DINOv2 to guide precise feature representation and counteract the loss of local semantic context inherent to Mamba's 1D flatten operation, enhancing robustness against extreme degradation. The latter introduces a spatio-temporal scanning mechanism and devises a Decoupled-Gating Mamba (DG-Mamba) layer, which employs two independent gates to adaptively control preceding and subsequent contextual information within the input clip, optimizing intra-frame and inter-frame correlation modeling. Experiments on video deraining benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of S3VD, achieving state-of-the-art performance with an average 0.84 dB PSNR improvement over Mamba-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出S3VD视频去雨框架，通过多尺度语义融合与时空扫描融合两个模块，缓解Mamba在雨天视频中语义丢失与时空建模不足的问题，取得0.84 dB平均PSNR提升。
AI.motivation: 暴雨会破坏视频高频细节并引入运动模糊，严重影响下游视觉任务。Mamba等状态空间模型虽具线性复杂度与长程依赖建模优势，但其1D展平操作破坏2D空间语义，且在退化视频中难以有效建模3D时空关联。
AI.method: S3VD包含两个模块：(1) 多尺度语义融合模块（MSSF），引入DINOv2的时序语义先验指导特征表示，弥补Mamba一维展平导致的局部语义上下文丢失；(2) 时空扫描融合模块（STSF），设计时空扫描机制与解耦门控Mamba层（DG-Mamba），用两个独立门控分别自适应控制输入片段中前序与后续上下文信息，优化帧内与帧间关联建模。
AI.result: 在视频去雨基准上达到SOTA性能，相较Mamba类基线平均PSNR提升0.84 dB。
AI.conclusion: S3VD通过语义引导的时空扫描框架有效克服Mamba在退化雨天视频中的局限，验证了多尺度语义先验与解耦门控时空建模对视频去雨的有效性。

title: VeriFuse: Bounded Vision-Language Arbitration and Reason-Guided Refinement for Cooperative 3D Perception
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong scene understanding and semantic judgment across diverse tasks, but their appropriate role in cooperative perception remains unclear. Directly asking a VLM to regress 3D detections is unreliable and computationally expensive, whereas using it to select the output of a single source discards useful information from other agents. We introduce VeriFuse, a bounded arbitration framework for vehicle-infrastructure cooperative 3D detection. Each agent first produces detections independently. Around each vehicle and roadside proposal, VeriFuse generates source-conditioned geometric candidates and combines the original detections, their perturbations, and cross-source hypotheses into a unified candidate pool. A frozen VLM then chooses among three admissible actions: SELECT an adequate candidate; REFINE an existing anchor when an object is supported but all candidates are geometrically inadequate; or REJECT an unsupported infrastructure-only proposal. Experiments on the DAIR-V2X dataset show that VeriFuse achieves 0.494/0.357 cooperative 3D AP50/AP70 and limits the relative vehicle-side BEV AP50 drop under a 300 ms delay to 1.7%. Overall, VeriFuse assigns the VLM a clear and constrained role in cooperative perception: semantic reasoning resolves ambiguity among cross-agent hypotheses, while deterministic constraints determine the final 3D geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VeriFuse，一个面向车路协同 3D 检测的受限仲裁框架：将 VLM 的语义判断限定在候选池内部的选择/精修/拒绝三动作中，最终 3D 几何由确定性约束决定。
AI.motivation: VLM 在场景理解与语义判断上能力强，但在协同感知中的恰当角色尚不清晰。直接让 VLM 回归 3D 检测不可靠且计算昂贵；而仅用其选择单一来源的输出又会丢弃其他智能体的有用信息。因此需要一个既利用 VLM 语义能力、又不让其承担几何回归的框架。
AI.method: 各智能体（车辆与路侧）先独立产生检测。围绕每个车辆与路侧 proposal，生成源条件式的几何候选，将原始检测、其扰动以及跨源假设统一汇入候选池。冻结的 VLM 仅在三种可行动作中选择：SELECT（选取足够好的候选）、REFINE（目标有支撑但所有候选几何上不足时精修已有 anchor）、REJECT（拒绝无支撑的仅源自路侧的 proposal）。
AI.result: 在 DAIR-V2X 数据集上，VeriFuse 达到 0.494/0.357 的协同 3D AP50/AP70，并在 300 ms 延迟下将车辆侧 BEV AP50 的相对下降限制在 1.7%。
AI.conclusion: VeriFuse 为 VLM 在协同感知中赋予清晰且受限的角色：由语义推理解决跨智能体假设间的歧义，而最终 3D 几何由确定性约束确定，兼顾了性能与鲁棒性。

title: Cube-Splat: High-Fidelity 360° Gaussian Splatting SLAM via Cubemap Factorization and Adjoint-Consistent Optimization
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Source code : https://github.com/guoxf304/CubeSplat
summary: Recent progress in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has enabled dense visual SLAM with pinhole cameras, yet most pipelines are not designed for panoramic imagery. We present Cube-Splat, the first panoramic GS-SLAM framework that factorizes each 360° frame into a cubemap of four fixed-orientation virtual pinhole views sharing a single optical center. By designating the front face as the primary pose state, we accumulate gradients from all faces via an adjoint mapping, thereby enabling multi-face observations to coherently update a single state while strictly preserving cross-view geometric consistency. Concurrently, our mapping module densifies and optimizes anisotropic Gaussians using aggregated cubemap rays for high-fidelity, dense reconstruction. Furthermore, to rigorously evaluate panoramic SLAM under diverse and challenging conditions, we introduce SynPano, a highly scalable, photorealistic synthetic dataset featuring parameterized complex trajectories and multi-modal ground truth. Extensive evaluations on two public benchmarks (PALVIO and OmniBlender) and our SynPano dataset, collectively encompassing both indoor and outdoor scenes, demonstrate that Cube-Splat achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in tracking accuracy and reconstruction fidelity. Both the source code and the SynPano dataset are available at https://github.com/guoxf304/CubeSplat.

AI.tldr: Cube-Splat是首个全景GS-SLAM框架，将360°帧分解为四虚拟针孔视图的立方体贴图，通过伴随映射实现多面观测协同更新单一位姿状态，并提出SynPano数据集，在两公开基准与新数据集上取得SOTA跟踪精度与重建保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS SLAM多面向针孔相机，缺乏针对全景影像的管线设计；同时全景SLAM缺乏多样且具挑战性条件的严格评测基准。
AI.method: 将每帧360°影像因子化为四个固定朝向、共享单一光心的虚拟针孔视图立方体贴图；以前面为主位姿状态，用伴随映射聚合所有面的梯度，使多面观测协同更新单一状态并保持跨视图几何一致性；建图模块利用聚合的立方体射线加密并优化各向异性高斯以稠密重建；同时提出SynPano合成数据集，含参数化复杂轨迹与多模态真值。
AI.result: 在PALVIO、OmniBlender两公开基准及SynPano（覆盖室内外场景）上，跟踪精度与重建保真度均达SOTA。
AI.conclusion: Cube-Splat为全景GS-SLAM提供了统一几何一致的多面协同框架，并配套可扩展评测数据集，代码与数据已开源。

title: PrismAlign: Prior-Steered Multi-View VLM Alignment for Hallucination-Robust Table OCR
summary: Table extraction suffers from frequent structural errors and semantic hallucinations. We propose PrismAlign, a multi-VLM framework aligning diverse visual perspectives to resolve ambiguity. It integrates priors of table logic to assess output plausibility, decoupling structural alignment from cell content alignment. A Bayesian decision strategy maximizes alignment accuracy by exploiting the correlation between extraction errors and computable rule violations. Evaluated on open-source and custom VLMs, PrismAlign reduces hallucinations and achieves state-of-the-art performance on OmniDocBench 1.5, as well as on the table category of CC-OCR and PureDocBench.

AI.tldr: 提出多VLM框架PrismAlign，通过整合多样化视觉视角并对齐表格逻辑先验来缓解表格抽取中的结构错误与语义幻觉，在多个基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 表格抽取任务普遍存在结构性错误与语义幻觉问题，现有方法难以消解歧义、缺乏对输出合理性的评估机制。
AI.method: PrismAlign：一个多VLM框架，对齐多样化的视觉视角以消解歧义；整合表格逻辑先验以评估输出合理性，将结构对齐与单元格内容对齐解耦；采用贝叶斯决策策略，利用抽取错误与可计算规则违规之间的相关性来最大化对齐准确率。
AI.result: 在开源与自研VLM上进行评估，PrismAlign降低了幻觉，并在OmniDocBench 1.5以及CC-OCR、PureDocBench的表格类别上达到最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于规则违规与错误的统计关联进行贝叶斯决策对齐，可有效提升多VLM表格抽取的准确性与可靠性。

title: Field Tracking of Insects Using a Stereoscopic Event-Based Camera Setup
summary: High-speed tracking of small, fast-moving organisms in their natural environments is important to better understand their behavior and ecology. Traditional frame-based imaging suffers from motion blur due to low temporal resolution, and data storage limitations, propelling a search for more adaptive solutions. Event cameras, which capture changes in brightness at pixel level instead of entire frames, have emerged as a promising solution by increasing temporal resolution and data efficiency. Here, we demonstrate the use of event-based imaging with standard video-based processing methods by converting the asynchronous events into conventional video formats, allowing us to leverage the event camera's enhanced temporal detail to capture intricate insect flight movements and apply established image analysis techniques. Coupling this conversion process with a stereoscopic configuration provides continuous, low-latency, three-dimensional tracking of fast-moving subjects in field conditions. As a result, we substantially mitigate motion artifacts and achieve more accurate representations of animal movements. By making event-based imaging more readily applicable in natural field settings, our method support broader applications across animal behavior and ecological research, agricultural management, and other fields requiring high-fidelity object tracking in the wild.

AI.tldr: 提出将异步事件流转换为常规视频格式，结合立体配置，实现对野外小型快速移动生物的三维连续低延迟跟踪。
AI.motivation: 传统帧式成像在追踪小型、快速移动生物时受低时间分辨率导致运动模糊及存储受限的制约，亟需更具适应性的成像方案。
AI.method: 利用事件相机在像素级捕捉亮度变化，将异步事件转换为常规视频格式，从而复用成熟的图像分析流程；并将该转换与立体（双目）配置耦合。
AI.result: 在野外条件下实现对快速移动目标的连续、低延迟三维跟踪，显著抑制运动伪影，更准确地表征动物运动。
AI.conclusion: 该方法使事件成像更易应用于自然野外场景，可支撑动物行为与生态研究、农业管理及其他需高保真野外目标跟踪的领域。

title: Hiding in Plain Sight: A Diffusion-based Mitigation of Geolocation Privacy Leakage in Vision-Language Models
summary: Multimodal large reasoning models (MLRMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in complex visual understanding. However, this very power introduces a critical yet underexplored privacy threat: adversaries can exploit MLRMs to precisely infer users' geographic locations from casually shared photographs, by performing structured reasoning over subtle visual cues such as architectural styles, vegetation, and lighting conditions. In this work, we present a systematic study of MLRM-driven geolocation privacy leakage. We first reveal that refusal-based safeguards are critically insufficient, as carefully crafted jailbreak prompts can raise model response rates to 100%. We further identify that existing defenses, which inject imperceptible perturbations into shared images, suffer from structural limitations intrinsic to their pixel-space optimization, resulting in degraded black-box transferability and pronounced visual artifacts. Motivated by these findings, we propose a diffusion-based framework that provides targeted, proactive defense against geolocation privacy leakage. By injecting perturbations into the latent space of a diffusion model during reverse sampling, our method operates directly on high-level semantic representations, thereby resolving the effectiveness-utility bottlenecks by construction. We further ground our optimization with GeoCLIP, a model explicitly aligned with GPS coordinates, as a surrogate to pinpoint and disrupt the geographic signals that MLRMs exploit for location inference. This targeted semantic disruption yields significantly stronger black-box transferability while preserving perceptual image quality, offering a seamless integration on social media platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了多模态大推理模型（MLRM）的地理定位隐私泄露问题，并提出一种基于扩散模型的主动防御框架。
AI.motivation: MLRM能通过建筑风格、植被、光照等细微视觉线索对随意分享的照片进行结构化推理，精确推断用户地理位置，构成严重且尚未充分探讨的隐私威胁；现有基于拒绝的防护可被精心设计的越狱提示绕过（响应率达100%），而像素空间优化的扰动防御存在黑盒迁移性差和视觉伪影等结构性缺陷。
AI.method: 提出基于扩散模型的主动防御框架：在反向采样过程中将扰动注入扩散模型的潜在空间，直接作用于高层语义表示；并以与GPS坐标显式对齐的GeoCLIP作为代理模型来定位和破坏MLRM所利用的地理信号。
AI.result: 越狱提示可使拒绝式防护的响应率升至100%；所提方法在保持感知图像质量的同时，显著提升了黑盒迁移性，克服了效果—效用瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 基于潜在空间语义破坏的扩散防御框架可有效抵御MLRM驱动的地理定位隐私泄露，且质量损失小，便于在社交媒体平台上无缝集成。

title: RobotEQ-Video: A Video-Centric Benchmark for Social Proactive Intelligence with World-State Taxonomy
summary: Social Proactive Intelligence (SPI) extends proactive assistance beyond task completeness to consider social appropriateness in diverse embodied scenarios. However, prior SPI research faces two key limitations. First, existing work focuses on static images, whereas dynamic videos provide crucial cues for inferring human states and needs, offering richer information than isolated images. Second, prior work often relies on free-form data collection pipelines, which fail to guarantee comprehensive coverage of diverse scenarios. To address these gaps, we introduce RobotEQ-Video, shifting the focus from image-centric to video-centric analysis. To ensure comprehensive video coverage, we construct a hierarchical world-state taxonomy organized into a four-level coarse-to-fine structure, comprising 6 domains, 20 dimensions, 142 level-1 attributes, and 816 level-2 attributes. The resulting benchmark comprises 2K+ videos with 100K+ human annotations and 16K+ labels for assessing behavior properness. Benchmark evaluation reveals that current systems remain unreliable and fall short of human performance. We further explore how world models can help tackle this task. This work advances SPI research from static images to dynamic videos and ensures more comprehensive scenario coverage during benchmarking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RobotEQ-Video，将社交主动智能（SPI）研究从静态图像推进到动态视频，并基于层级化世界状态分类体系构建了大规模视频基准。
AI.motivation: 现有 SPI 研究存在两大局限：一是仅关注静态图像，无法利用视频中推断人类状态与需求的关键动态线索；二是依赖自由形式的数据采集流程，难以保证场景覆盖的全面性。
AI.method: 构建层级化世界状态分类体系，采用四级由粗到细结构，包含 6 个领域、20 个维度、142 个一级属性和 816 个二级属性；据此采集视频并标注，形成 2K+ 视频、100K+ 人工标注及 16K+ 行为恰当性标签的基准，并探索世界模型在该任务中的作用。
AI.result: 基准评测显示，现有系统表现不可靠，且低于人类水平。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将 SPI 研究从静态图像拓展至动态视频，并在基准测试中实现了更全面的场景覆盖。

title: JEPA Guided Diffusion: Predictive Vision-Language Conditioning for Generative Traffic Forecasting
comment: ECCV Workshop 2026, AI City Challenge 2026 Track 5
summary: Accurate traffic forecasting requires both understanding scene dynamics and synthesizing realistic future observations. Recent diffusion-based video generation models produce visually plausible predictions but require expensive end-to-end training and often entangle scene understanding with image synthesis. In this work, we propose a decoupled forecasting framework that separates future representation learning from video generation. A frozen V-JEPA encoder first extracts predictive latent representations from the observed traffic videos, capturing the underlying scene dynamics in a semantic latent space. A lightweight latent alignment module then projects these representations into the conditioning space of a frozen Cosmos diffusion module, enabling future video synthesis without retraining the large generative model. By freezing all foundation models and training only the lightweight alignment module, the proposed framework substantially reduces optimization complexity while preserving forecasting capability. Experimental results on the AI City Challenge 2026 Track 5 benchmark demonstrate that the proposed method achieved a score of 75.1297, ranking third in the competition. These results suggest that predictive world representations learned by V-JEPA can effectively guide downstream video generation, providing a practical and efficient alternative to end-to-end diffusion-based forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出解耦式交通预测框架，冻结V-JEPA与Cosmos，仅训练轻量对齐模块，在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 5获75.1297分、排名第三。
AI.motivation: 准确交通预测需兼顾场景动态理解与真实未来观测合成。现有扩散视频生成方法虽能生成视觉合理的预测，但端到端训练代价高昂，且将场景理解与图像合成纠缠在一起，效率与可扩展性受限。
AI.method: 将未来表征学习与视频生成解耦：先用冻结的V-JEPA编码器从观测交通视频中提取预测性潜在表征，在语义潜空间中捕捉场景动态；再用轻量潜空间对齐模块将这些表征投影到冻结的Cosmos扩散模块的条件空间，实现未来视频合成而无需重训大生成模型。整个框架冻结全部基础模型，只训练轻量对齐模块。
AI.result: 在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 5基准上取得75.1297分，竞赛排名第三。表明V-JEPA学到的预测性世界表征能有效引导下游视频生成。
AI.conclusion: 该框架大幅降低优化复杂度，同时保持预测能力，为端到端扩散预测提供了一种实用且高效的替代方案。

title: AgentVidBench: A Multi-Hop Video Question Answering Benchmark for Evaluating MLLM Agents
summary: Comprehensive video understanding is crucial for advancing artificial intelligence toward the intricate dynamics of the physical world. While recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in video understanding, existing benchmarks remain confined to simple scene-level queries or global summaries that require only single-step inference. Real-world video understanding involves more challenging tasks that require multi-hop multimodal reasoning, and there is a critical absence of video benchmarks equipped to rigorously evaluate these agentic capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce AgentVidBench, a multi-hop video question answering benchmark focused on evaluating the spatial, temporal, and causal reasoning capabilities of MLLM agents. Beyond standard question-answer pairs, AgentVidBench provides step-by-step solution traces to support trajectory evaluation that assesses whether agents explicitly acquire the evidence needed to justify their answers. Experiments with 12 proprietary and open-source MLLMs show that single-turn performance remains limited on AgentVidBench, while integrating these models into state-of-the-art agentic workflows generally improves performance with respect to both accuracy and trajectory scores. We further present a simple yet effective agentic strategy that serves as a competitive baseline on AgentVidBench, establishing our benchmark as a holistic testbed for future research on agentic video understanding. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/krafton-ai/agentvidbench and https://huggingface.co/datasets/agentvidbench/agentvidbench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AgentVidBench，一个面向多跳视频问答的基准，用于评估 MLLM 智能体在空间、时间与因果推理方面的能力，并提供逐步解题轨迹以支持过程评估。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解基准多局限于简单场景级查询或全局摘要，仅需单步推理；真实世界视频理解需要多跳多模态推理，但缺乏能严格评估此类智能体能力的视频基准。
AI.method: 构建 AgentVidBench 多跳视频问答基准，除标准问答对外还提供逐步解题轨迹以进行“轨迹评估”，判断智能体是否显式获取了支撑答案所需的证据；对 12 个专有与开源 MLLM 进行实验，并将其接入先进智能体工作流；同时提出一种简单有效的智能体策略作为基线。
AI.result: 单轮（single-turn）性能在 AgentVidBench 上仍有限；将模型集成到先进智能体工作流后，准确率与轨迹分数通常均有提升。
AI.conclusion: AgentVidBench 可作为智能体视频理解研究的整体性测试平台，所提简单策略构成有竞争力的基线，推动未来研究。

title: A Scene Language Model for Open-Vocabulary Scene Mapping
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D scene mapping aims to build a persistent representation of the objects in an environment. Existing systems typically rely on engineered mapping pipelines to associate observations, merge information across views, and maintain a consistent scene representation over time. Many additionally store feature-rich object representations, such as embeddings or image crops, increasing the size and complexity of the persistent memory. We introduce SceneLM, a Scene-Language Model that directly maintains a textual scene map. The full scene is represented as a structured text list of objects, which serves as the model's only persistent memory. For each input image, the model reads the current scene state and updates the map by adding, editing, and removing objects. To learn this behavior, we introduce supervision tasks for iterative scene map maintenance together with an automatic annotation pipeline that generates training data from images without human labels. We evaluate SceneLM on both a language-grounded retrieval benchmark and a localization benchmark. Across both benchmarks, the model produces a scene map that achieves competitive performance with complete mapping systems built from dedicated perception and geometric modules while producing a scene representation that is 6-12x more compact. We further show that SceneLM can be run online on an edge device through experiments on a quadruped. These results show that a persistent open-vocabulary 3D scene map can be maintained directly by a single vision-language model using only a lightweight text representation. Training and inference code is available on https://goldengait.github.io/scenelm/.

AI.tldr: 提出 SceneLM，用单一视觉语言模型直接以结构化文本列表维护开放词汇 3D 场景地图，作为唯一持久记忆，无需传统感知/几何模块流水线。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇 3D 场景建图依赖人工设计的建图流水线进行观测关联、跨视角信息融合与一致性维护，并常存储嵌入或图像裁剪等特征表示，导致持久内存庞大且系统复杂。
AI.method: 将整个场景表示为结构化文本对象列表，作为模型唯一持久记忆；对每张输入图像，模型读取当前场景状态并通过添加、编辑、删除对象来更新地图；设计迭代式场景地图维护的监督任务，并提出无需人工标注、直接从图像生成训练数据的自动标注流水线。
AI.result: 在语言引导检索基准和定位基准上，SceneLM 生成的场景地图性能与由专用感知和几何模块构建的完整建图系统相当，而场景表示紧凑 6-12 倍；四足机器人实验表明模型可在边缘设备上在线运行。
AI.conclusion: 持续性的开放词汇 3D 场景地图可由单一视觉语言模型仅使用轻量文本表示直接维护。

title: SIRA: Reasoning-Aware Surgical Instrument Segmentation via Query-Anchored Alignment
summary: Surgical instrument segmentation (SIS) plays a critical role in robotic assistance and surgical workflow analysis. However, most existing SIS methods formulate segmentation as a category-driven localization problem, limiting their ability to capture procedural context and task-dependent semantics in surgical workflows. We introduce Reasoning-Aware Surgical Instrument Segmentation (RA-SIS), a task formulation that frames segmentation as query-conditioned inference under surgical context. To benchmark this setting, we construct SurgRS, a surgical reasoning segmentation dataset consisting of 41,000 image-text pairs, which aligns instance-level masks with structured query-answer supervision to enable semantic grounding at the pixel level. Based on SurgRS, we propose Surgical Instrument Reasoning and Segmentation Assistant (SIRA), a multimodal framework that disentangles target-level and query-level semantics and integrates them with visual features through query-anchored dual alignment. By aligning query semantics with spatial features and segmentation prompts, SIRA enhances semantic-visual consistency in mask prediction. Extensive experiments on SurgRS demonstrate improvements over existing reasoning-aware baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/linxir226/SIRA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出推理感知的手术器械分割任务RA-SIS，并构建SurgRS数据集与SIRA多模态框架，实现查询条件下的像素级语义定位。
AI.motivation: 现有手术器械分割方法多将分割视为类别驱动的定位问题，难以捕捉手术流程中的过程上下文与任务相关语义，缺乏推理能力。
AI.method: 提出RA-SIS任务形式，将分割建模为手术上下文下的查询条件推理；构建含41,000图像-文本对的SurgRS数据集，对齐实例级掩码与结构化问答监督；提出SIRA多模态框架，解耦目标级与查询级语义，通过查询锚定双对齐融合视觉特征，对齐查询语义与空间特征及分割提示。
AI.result: 在SurgRS数据集上的大量实验表明，SIRA优于现有推理感知基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 将手术器械分割重构为查询条件推理任务，配合专用数据集与多模态对齐框架，可有效增强语义-视觉一致性，推动推理感知分割研究。

title: Quantization-Aware Kalman Estimation for Diffusion Sampling
summary: Quantization offers a practical path to deploying diffusion models with reduced memory and computation, but aggressive compression can cause quantized outputs to deviate substantially from their full-precision counterparts. Sampling-stage correction methods seek to compensate for such deviations during sampling, but existing approaches rely primarily on local information and underexploit trajectory history, limiting their ability to correct errors that propagate across timesteps. In this work, we formulate sampling with a quantized denoiser as an online estimation problem, using the history of quantized denoiser outputs to recover the underlying full-precision outputs required by the sampler. We propose QuAKE, a Quantization-Aware Kalman Estimator that combines a smooth trajectory prior with a conditional Gaussian observation model. At each sampling step, QuAKE recursively updates the posterior over the output window in closed form and feeds its posterior mean to the sampler. QuAKE is a lightweight plug-and-play corrector that requires no modification to the quantized network and naturally supports arbitrary high-order multistep ODE samplers. Experiments across W4A4-quantized text-to-image diffusion models show that QuAKE consistently outperforms existing methods in reducing the distributional discrepancy from full-precision sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文将量化去噪器的采样过程建模为在线估计问题，提出量化感知卡尔曼估计器QuAKE，利用量化去噪器输出历史以闭式递归方式恢复全精度输出，从而在多步ODE采样中补偿量化误差，在W4A4文本到图像扩散模型上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 量化可降低扩散模型的显存与计算开销，但激进压缩（如W4A4）会使量化输出严重偏离全精度结果。现有采样阶段校正方法主要依赖局部信息，未充分利用轨迹历史，难以纠正跨时间步传播的误差。
AI.method: 将量化去噪器采样形式化为在线估计问题：以量化去噪器输出历史为观测，恢复采样器所需的全精度输出。提出QuAKE（Quantization-Aware Kalman Estimator），结合平滑轨迹先验与条件高斯观测模型；每个采样步对输出窗口的后验进行闭式递归更新，并将其后验均值输入采样器。方法是轻量级即插即用校正器，无需修改量化网络，且天然支持任意高阶多步ODE采样器。
AI.result: 在W4A4量化的文本到图像扩散模型上，QuAKE在降低与全精度采样的分布差异方面持续优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: QuAKE通过卡尔曼式递归利用采样轨迹历史，有效补偿量化去噪器的跨步误差传播，是一种通用、轻量且与高阶ODE采样器兼容的采样阶段校正方案。

title: When Online Adaptation Hurts: Parameter-Frozen Test-Time Ensembling for Continual Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Medical image segmenters often get worse when sites, scanner vendors, or protocols change. Continual test-time adaptation (CTTA) addresses this problem without target labels, but it can be impossible to update a model on a non-stationary stream and can lead to a lot of errors. We examine a more reasonable and meaningful alternative: parameter-frozen inference enhancement(PIE). We use a source-trained segmenter that learns about anatomy-preserving scale and flip views, maps their predictions back to the native location, and averages the probabilities. We do not modify the weights of the model or the normalization statistics. On a cardiac MRI stream from M\&Ms, which is trained on vendor A and evaluated sequentially on vendors B, C, and D, PIE has 0.7786 mean Dice, compared to 0.7680 for source-only inference and 0.7388--0.7416 for five other online-adaptation baselines. The controlled ablations show that performance saturates at 28 views, and confidence weighting, class-prior correction, connected-component filtering, morphological refinement, and inter-slice smoothing have no effect or cause negative transfer. Qualitative results on cardiac MRI and fundus images are also consistent with the frozen ensemble keeping thinner and nested anatomical structures. These results provide a strong, stable baseline for medical CTTA and expose an important failure mode: adaptation and handcrafted refinement can be less reliable than carefully designed inference.

AI.tldr: 论文提出参数冻结的推理增强（PIE）替代持续测试时适应（CTTA）：用源训练分割器对解剖保持的尺度与翻转视图做预测、反映射到原位置并做概率平均，不更新权重与归一化统计。在M&Ms心脏MRI跨厂商序列流上，PIE平均Dice为0.7786，优于仅源推理（0.7680）与五种在线适应基线（0.7388–0.7416）。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割器在站点、扫描仪厂商或协议变化时性能下降。现有持续测试时适应（CTTA）无需目标标签，但在非平稳数据流上难以更新模型，且易引入大量错误，因此需要更合理、更有意义的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出参数冻结推理增强（PIE）：使用源域训练的分割器，构造解剖保持的尺度与翻转视图，将各视图预测映射回原始位置，并对其概率进行平均。全过程不修改模型权重，也不修改归一化统计量。并通过受控消融实验分析视图数量与多种后处理/加权策略的影响。
AI.result: 在M&Ms心脏MRI流（厂商A训练，依次在B、C、D评估）上：PIE平均Dice 0.7786，仅源推理为0.7680，五种在线适应基线为0.7388–0.7416。消融显示性能在28个视图时饱和；置信度加权、类别先验校正、连通域过滤、形态学细化与层间平滑无效果甚至导致负迁移。心脏MRI与眼底图像的定性结果一致，表明冻结集成能更好保留细薄与嵌套解剖结构。
AI.conclusion: 结果为医学CTTA提供了强而稳定的基线，并揭示一个重要失效模式：自适应与手工细化可能不如精心设计的推理可靠。

title: P$^3$-SAM: SAM with Perceptual Parallel Prompt for Few-Shot Strip Steel Surface Defect Segmentation
comment: Accepted by ICME 2026, 6 pages, 3 figures. Corresponding authors: Anpeng Wang and Runmin Cong
summary: Few-shot semantic segmentation (FSS) of strip steel surface defects (S$^3$D) has posed significant challenges distinct from natural scenes. Unlike natural images, S$^3$D task exhibits unique characteristics including low local contrast, uneven illumination, and complex fine-grained texture patterns. Although recent methods based on Segment Anything Model (SAM) have shown promise in FSS on natural images by leveraging SAM's powerful pre-trained representations, these unique industrial characteristics of S$^3$D images lead to performance drop when directly applying SAM to industrial defect scenarios. In this paper, we propose a novel Perceptual Parallel Prompt (P$^3$) framework that empowers SAM, creating the P$^3$-SAM model to address these challenges through two core strategies. First, we develop a Perceptual-Optimized Encoding (POE) strategy that enhances local contrast and preserves critical texture details for S$^3$D segmentation. Second, we introduce the Parallel Prompt Generator (PPG) strategy that simultaneously generates both semantic and spatial prompts, enabling comprehensive guidance for SAM's decoder across varying images. Extensive experiments on three few-shot S$^3$D benchmarks demonstrate that P$^3$-SAM achieves state-of-the-art performance, with particularly notable improvements of 12.00% in mIoU on Surface Defects-4i dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出P³-SAM框架，通过感知优化编码与并行提示生成两大策略赋能SAM，解决带钢表面缺陷小样本分割中的低对比度、光照不均与细粒度纹理难题，在三个基准上取得SOTA，Surface Defects-4i数据集mIoU提升12.00%。
AI.motivation: 带钢表面缺陷小样本分割（S³D）不同于自然场景：存在局部对比度低、光照不均、复杂细粒度纹理等工业特性。基于SAM的方法在自然图像FSS上表现良好，但直接迁移到工业缺陷场景时性能下降，因此需要针对工业特性改造SAM。
AI.method: 提出Perceptual Parallel Prompt（P³）框架，构建P³-SAM模型，包含两个核心策略：（1）Perceptual-Optimized Encoding（POE），增强局部对比度并保留关键纹理细节；（2）Parallel Prompt Generator（PPG），同时生成语义提示与空间提示，为SAM解码器提供跨图像的综合引导。
AI.result: 在三个小样本S³D基准上取得state-of-the-art性能，其中Surface Defects-4i数据集mIoU提升12.00%。
AI.conclusion: 针对工业缺陷图像特性对SAM进行感知优化与提示增强，可有效提升带钢表面缺陷小样本分割性能，验证了双策略框架的有效性。

title: Think Locally, Refine Globally for Memory-Efficient 3D Reconstruction
summary: We propose LoG-VGGT, a memory-efficient framework for long-sequence 3D reconstruction that balances local temporal modeling with global camera consistency. Instead of relying on full global attention, our method introduces cross-window attention at a small subset of transformer blocks, enabling effective information propagation across adjacent temporal windows while keeping memory usage bounded. To mitigate long-term pose drift, we further design a global camera consistency refinement module, where camera tokens interact with compact register tokens via cross-attention to enforce scene-level constraints across the entire sequence. This design enables joint optimization of camera representations and significantly improves long-horizon pose stability without incurring the high cost of sequence-wide attention. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LoG-VGGT achieves improved depth accuracy and robust camera pose estimation across multiple long-sequence benchmarks, while delivering competitive streaming reconstruction performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LoG-VGGT，一种面向长序列三维重建的内存高效框架，通过局部时间建模与全局相机一致性相结合，在受限内存下实现跨窗口信息传播并缓解长期位姿漂移。
AI.motivation: 长序列三维重建中，全局注意力虽能保证相机一致性，但内存开销随序列长度急剧增长；而仅依赖局部建模又会导致长期位姿漂移。因此需要一种兼顾局部时间建模与全局相机一致性且内存可控的方法。
AI.method: 方法包含两部分：(1) 在少量 transformer 块中引入跨窗口注意力，实现相邻时间窗口间的信息传播，同时保持内存占用有界；(2) 设计全局相机一致性精化模块，令相机 token 与紧凑的 register token 通过交叉注意力交互，在整个序列范围内施加场景级约束，从而联合优化相机表示。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，LoG-VGGT 在多个长序列基准上提升了深度精度和相机位姿估计的鲁棒性，同时具备有竞争力的流式重建性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过在少量块中进行跨窗口注意力并结合全局相机一致性精化，可在不承担全序列注意力高昂代价的前提下提升长时程位姿稳定性与重建质量，为内存高效的长序列三维重建提供有效方案。

title: ME-Dex 1.0: Bringing Heterogeneous Tactile Sensing into World Action Modeling
summary: World Action Models bring the predictive capabilities of video models into robot action generation, providing a rich foundation for modeling future visual states. Tactile sensing complements this foundation with direct measurements of physical interaction. Some existing methods use tactile features as conditioning inputs without jointly predicting future tactile states, visual observations, and actions. Our key insight is that tactile signals, like video, provide observations of the evolving world state and should be modeled as future observations alongside video. We present ME-Dex-1.0 (MachEmbodied-Dex-1.0), a unified World Action Tactile Model for joint visual, tactile, and action learning. ME-Dex-1.0 adopts a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture comprising a Video Expert, a Tactile Expert, and an Action Expert, all trained with flow matching. We use shared attention connects the experts in intermediate layers, allowing action generation to draw on learned representations of visual and tactile dynamics during joint denoising. To support multi-source heterogeneous tactile inputs, a Canonical Hand Model and a Unified Tactile Autoencoder map tactile observations from different embodiments and sensing layouts into shared spatial and latent spaces. To address the limited availability of paired visual, tactile, and action data, we develop the Agentic Tactile Data Engine, an agent-based data production platform. It supplements RoboTwin and DexJoCo with tactile data recorded directly from force sensors during trajectory replay in simulation. Experiments on the RoboTwin, DexJoCo, and ManiFeel simulation platforms, together with real robot evaluations, demonstrate improved manipulation performance using both grippers and dexterous hands equipped with tactile sensing.

AI.tldr: ME-Dex-1.0：统一视觉-触觉-动作的世界动作触觉模型，将触觉作为未来观测与视频联合建模，采用Mixture-of-Transformers三专家流匹配架构，并配套Agentic触觉数据引擎。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型将视频模型的预测能力引入机器人动作生成，为未来视觉状态建模提供了基础；触觉感知可直接测量物理交互，是对该基础的有力补充。但现有方法多仅将触觉特征作为条件输入，未对未来触觉状态、视觉观测与动作进行联合预测。核心洞察是：触觉信号与视频一样，提供了世界状态演化的观测，应作为未来观测与视频一并建模。
AI.method: 提出ME-Dex-1.0（MachEmbodied-Dex-1.0），一个面向视觉、触觉与动作联合学习的统一世界动作触觉模型。架构采用Mixture-of-Transformers，包含Video Expert、Tactile Expert与Action Expert三个专家，统一以flow matching训练；通过中间层的共享注意力连接各专家，使动作生成在联合去噪过程中利用视觉与触觉动力学的表征。为支持多源异构触觉输入，设计Canonical Hand Model与Unified Tactile Autoencoder，将不同本体与传感布局的触觉观测映射到共享空间与隐空间。针对配对视觉-触觉-动作数据稀缺问题，开发Agentic Tactile Data Engine（基于智能体的数据生产平台），在仿真轨迹回放中直接由力传感器采集触觉数据，补充RoboTwin与DexJoCo数据集。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin、DexJoCo与ManiFeel仿真平台及真机评测上，配备触觉感知的夹爪与灵巧手均取得更优的操作性能。
AI.conclusion: 将触觉视作未来观测并与视频、动作联合建模，配合多专家流匹配架构与统一触觉表征，可有效提升含触觉的机器人操作性能；同时智能体数据引擎缓解了多模态配对数据不足的问题，验证了世界动作触觉模型范式的可行性。

title: CompAdapt: Adaptable Composite Motion Modeling for Physics-Consistent Text-to-Video Generation
comment: 23 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Project page: https://makapic.github.io/CompAdapt/
summary: While diffusion-based text-to-video (T2V) models have demonstrated impressive capability in generating realistic and temporally coherent videos, they often fail to respect fundamental physical dynamics. Although recent physics-constrained methods incorporate explicit dynamics priors to improve physical plausibility, they remain limited to simple single-type motions, depend on manually specified parameters, and struggle to generalize to unseen physical laws. In this work, we propose CompAdapt, a physics-consistent T2V framework for adaptable generation across complex real-world scenarios. It extends neural dynamics modeling beyond single-type motions to encompass composite physical behaviors, including coupled motions, multi-stage transitions, and multi-object collisions. Furthermore, CompAdapt translates natural language prompts into structured physical semantics, enabling end-to-end specification of motion types, temporal relations, and initial physical parameters. To generalize to novel physical environments, CompAdapt introduces dynamics-aware prior matching, achieving one-shot adaptation without retraining the core dynamics module. In addition, a physics-aware latent feature fusion module improves visual fidelity under fast and complex motion. Experiments on physics-focused T2V benchmarks demonstrate that CompAdapt improves physical consistency over both general T2V models and physics-constrained baselines, while preserving high visual quality and adaptability to unseen dynamics. The project page is available at https://makapic.github.io/CompAdapt/ .

AI.tldr: 提出CompAdapt，一个物理一致的文本到视频框架，通过神经动力学建模扩展至复合物理行为，支持语言驱动的物理语义解析与少样本自适应，提升物理一致性同时保持视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式T2V模型虽能生成真实且时序连贯的视频，但常违背基本物理动力学。已有的物理约束方法仅支持单一类型运动、依赖人工指定参数，且难以泛化到未见物理规律。
AI.method: 1) 将神经动力学建模从单类型运动扩展到复合物理行为，涵盖耦合运动、多阶段过渡与多物体碰撞；2) 将自然语言提示转化为结构化物理语义，端到端指定运动类型、时序关系和初始物理参数；3) 引入动力学感知先验匹配，实现无需重训练核心动力学模块的一次性（one-shot）自适应；4) 设计物理感知隐特征融合模块，提升快速复杂运动下的视觉保真度。
AI.result: 在面向物理的T2V基准上，CompAdapt相较通用T2V模型和物理约束基线提升了物理一致性，同时保持高视觉质量和对未见动力学的适应能力。
AI.conclusion: CompAdapt通过复合动力学建模、语言到物理语义的结构化映射及少样本先验匹配，实现了复杂真实场景下物理一致的T2V生成，并具备对未见物理规律的泛化能力。

title: PSEE: Progressive Sensor Event Expansion for Point-Supervised Temporal Action Localization
summary: Temporal action localization (TAL) in wearable sensor streams identifies action classes and temporal boundaries, enabling finer-grained activity understanding than conventional action recognition. However, training typically requires costly start--end annotations for every action instance. To reduce this burden, we study point-supervised TAL, where each instance is labeled with only one timestamp and its class. We propose Progressive Sensor Event Expansion (PSEE), which combines semantic activations, sensor-specific transition evidence, and adaptive temporal ownership to recover point-supervised pseudo segments. These segments supervise standard TAL detectors without modifying their inference procedures. Cross-subject experiments on four inertial-sensing benchmarks demonstrate improved pseudo-boundary quality over adapted point-supervised baselines, compatibility with different TAL detectors, and robustness to point sampling. Code is available at https://github.com/joeeeeyin/PSEE.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究点监督下的可穿戴传感器时序动作定位（TAL），提出渐进式传感器事件扩展（PSEE）方法，从单时间戳标注恢复伪片段以训练标准TAL检测器。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴传感器流中的时序动作定位需要动作类别与起止边界，但逐实例的起止标注成本高昂，因此希望用每实例仅一个时间戳及类别的点监督来降低标注负担。
AI.method: 提出PSEE，融合语义激活、传感器特有的过渡证据与自适应时间归属，从点监督中恢复伪片段；这些伪片段用于监督标准TAL检测器，且不改变其推理流程。
AI.result: 在四个惯性传感基准上的跨受试者实验表明，PSEE相较适配后的点监督基线提升了伪边界质量，兼容不同TAL检测器，并对点采样方式具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: PSEE能有效缓解点监督TAL的边界标注缺失问题，生成高质量伪边界，具备检测器通用性与采样鲁棒性，代码已开源。

title: SkillIR: Evolving Scene-Aware Skills for Agentic Image Restoration
summary: This paper studies agentic image restoration, in which multimodal agents coordinate specialized restoration tools to recover images affected by complex degradations. Existing restoration agents often derive complete tool-use plans from the original degraded image or retrieve previously successful trajectories, providing limited support for adapting individual actions to evolving intermediate restoration states. We find that accepted tool executions can change the residual degradation state and, consequently, the applicability of subsequent tools. To address this issue, we propose SkillIR, a skill-guided framework that represents restoration experience as degradation-centered action evidence rather than complete tool-use trajectories. SkillIR consolidates context-dependent action outcomes into scene-aware restoration skills that characterize applicable conditions, expected effects, and attributable failure cases. Instead of prescribing a complete restoration plan, the retrieved skills guide one bounded action at a time within a verified residual-state loop: each tool output is treated as a candidate, committed only after transition verification, and followed by reassessment of the active residual degradations. After each rollout, the resulting evidence is used to create, refine, or patch dynamic skills, enabling accumulated restoration experience to improve decision-making for subsequent inputs. Experiments on synthetic and real-world multi-degradation datasets demonstrate that SkillIR improves restoration quality and enables more reliable and effective tool use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkillIR，一种以“退化为中心的动作证据”表示修复经验、在残余状态循环中逐步引导工具调用的技能引导框架，用于多模态智能体图像修复，提升修复质量与工具使用可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有修复智能体多从原始退化图像直接生成完整工具使用计划，或检索以往成功轨迹，难以为适应中间修复状态提供支持。作者发现已被采纳的工具执行会改变残余退化状态，从而影响后续工具的适用性，因此需要一种能随残余状态动态调整决策的方法。
AI.method: 提出SkillIR：将修复经验表示为以退化为中心的动作证据而非完整轨迹；把上下文相关的动作结果整合为场景感知的修复技能，刻画适用条件、预期效果与可归因失败案例。检索到的技能不规定完整计划，而是在经验证的残余状态循环中一次引导一个有界动作：每个工具输出先作为候选，经转移验证后才提交，随后重新评估当前残余退化。每次 rollout 后的证据用于创建、精炼或修补动态技能，使积累的修复经验改善后续输入的决策。
AI.result: 在合成与真实世界多退化数据集上的实验表明，SkillIR 提升了修复质量，并实现了更可靠、更有效的工具使用。
AI.conclusion: 以技能（退化为中心的动作证据）替代完整工具轨迹、采用有界动作与转移验证的残余状态循环，是提升智能体图像修复适应性与可靠性的有效途径。

title: MT-WAM: Reorienting the One-Pass Predictive Representation Toward Action Generation
summary: Fast-WAM shows that video-action co-training improves control without generating future video at inference, making the representation from a single video diffusion Transformer forward central to action generation. However, future-observation prediction does not explicitly prioritize the future dynamics and visual structure needed for control. We present MT-WAM, which retains the original training objectives and adds complementary supervision for future two-dimensional point trajectories and visual features. A lightweight dual-stream branch copied from the video backbone's final blocks provides target-specific processing, while a structured attention mask prevents cross-stream attention. Motion-stream tokens supply additional dynamics conditions to the action expert. Future visual-feature prediction provides supervision in a feature space that captures object and spatial structure. This supervision trains the video backbone to provide more informative visual context for action generation under changing visual conditions, without adding visual-feature-stream tokens to action conditioning. At inference, MT-WAM uses video and motion caches computed once per replan and skips future-video prediction. Without additional embodied policy pretraining, MT-WAM achieves 98.2% success on LIBERO and 73.7% on LIBERO-Plus, exceeding Fast-WAM by 23.8 percentage points on the latter. On RoboTwin 2.0 Clean2Rand, Random success increases from 6.30% to 19.40%; across four real-world tasks, average success increases from 67.0% to 77.8%.

AI.tldr: MT-WAM在Fast-WAM基础上增加未来二维点轨迹与视觉特征的辅助监督，用轻量双流分支和结构化注意力掩码实现，推理时跳过未来视频预测，在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0及真实任务上显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: Fast-WAM证明视频-动作协同训练可提升控制性能，且推理时无需生成未来视频，单次视频扩散Transformer前向的表征对动作生成至关重要。但仅用未来观测预测并未显式优先学习控制所需的未来动态与视觉结构，因此需要引入更有针对性的监督信号。
AI.method: 保留原始训练目标，增加未来二维点轨迹和视觉特征的互补监督。从视频骨干网络最后若干层复制出轻量双流分支，进行目标特定处理；采用结构化注意力掩码阻止跨流注意力。运动流token为动作专家提供额外动态条件；未来视觉特征预测在捕捉物体与空间结构的特征空间中提供监督，从而训练视频骨干在视觉条件变化下为动作生成提供更有信息的视觉上下文，且不将视觉特征流token加入动作条件。推理时使用每次重规划计算一次的视频与运动缓存，并跳过未来视频预测。
AI.result: 无需额外具身策略预训练：LIBERO成功率98.2%，LIBERO-Plus 73.7%，后者较Fast-WAM提升23.8个百分点；RoboTwin 2.0 Clean2Rand上Random成功率由6.30%升至19.40%；四个真实世界任务平均成功率由67.0%升至77.8%。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入未来运动轨迹与视觉特征监督，可在不增加推理时未来视频生成开销的前提下，有效提升视频表征对动作生成的支持能力，在仿真与真实任务上均取得一致且显著的性能增益。

title: OpenSAL360: Open-Source Crowdsourcing Platform for Omnidirectional Video Saliency Collection
summary: Omnidirectional video saliency prediction plays an important role in many immersive multimedia applications, including viewport-adaptive streaming and compression, foveated rendering, mesh simplification, perceptual quality assessment. Yet progress in this area remains constrained by the cost and complexity of collecting eye-tracking data with VR headsets, which makes large-scale dataset creation difficult to extend. We present OpenSAL360, the first open-source platform for scalable, low-cost 360° video saliency collection. Unlike conventional VR-based protocols, it requires only a standard screen, mouse, and internet connection, enabling parallel saliency data collection from common crowdsourcing assessors without specialized hardware. We validate our collection protocol against seven well-established VR eye-tracking datasets and conduct ablation studies on key interface, pre-, and post-processing parameters. To demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of the proposed methodology, we collect and publicly release a saliency dataset covering 500 omnidirectional videos annotated by 2,000+ crowdsourcing assessors, making it, to the best of our knowledge, the largest dataset in this field. We make OpenSAL360 publicly available at https://github.com/msu-video-group/OpenSAL360.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OpenSAL360，首个开源、可扩展、低成本的360°视频显著性采集平台。它仅需普通屏幕、鼠标和网络，无需VR头显，即可通过众包并行采集数据。作者用7个VR眼动数据集验证了协议，并做了参数消融实验，最终公开了一个含500个全景视频、2000+标注者的最大规模显著性数据集。
AI.motivation: 全向视频显著性预测对视口自适应流、压缩、注视点渲染、网格简化、感知质量评估等沉浸式应用很重要，但VR头显采集眼动数据成本高、流程复杂，导致大规模数据集难以扩展。
AI.method: 提出OpenSAL360开源平台：不依赖VR头显，仅需标准屏幕、鼠标和互联网连接，支持从普通众包评估者处并行采集显著性数据；并针对关键界面、预处理和后处理参数进行消融实验，同时与7个成熟的VR眼动数据集进行协议验证。
AI.result: 验证了采集协议的有效性，并完成关键参数消融；基于该平台采集并公开了一个包含500个全向视频、由2000+众包评估者标注的显著性数据集，据称是该领域目前最大的数据集。
AI.conclusion: OpenSAL360提供了一种低成本、可扩展的360°视频显著性采集方案，无需专用硬件即可实现大规模众包标注，并已开源发布平台与数据集，为全向视频显著性研究提供了重要数据基础。

title: VoxelTTO: Voxel-Aligned Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Test-Time Optimization
