summary: Recent feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods typically regress pixel-aligned Gaussian primitives, often causing excessive overlap and artifacts, while inaccuracies in predicted camera poses can lead to misalignment in novel-view synthesis (NVS). We present VoxelTTO, a feed-forward framework for reconstructing geometrically accurate 3DGS scenes from an arbitrary number of images and optional camera parameters. VoxelTTO aggregates dense image features into a global voxel representation and decodes Gaussians from voxel features, breaking the pixel-to-Gaussian correspondence. To exploit known camera parameters while keeping the pretrained visual foundation model (VFM) parameters frozen, we introduce test-time optimization (TTO) that adapts lightweight LoRA modules using pose supervision. We further replace vanilla 3DGS rasterization with stochastic solid volume rendering during training and inference, improving geometric fidelity. Training updates only the voxel-aligned Gaussian reconstruction modules, requiring 80 GPU hours. Experiments on Replica, Tanks and Temples, and DTU demonstrate improved RGB-D NVS and camera-pose estimation relative to prior methods.

AI.tldr: VoxelTTO 提出一种前馈式 3DGS 框架，将图像特征聚合到全局体素表示并从中解码高斯，摆脱像素-高斯对应关系，并结合冻结 VFM 的 LoRA 测试时优化与随机实体体积渲染，提升几何保真度与位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈 3DGS 方法通常回归像素对齐的高斯原语，导致高斯过度重叠与伪影；同时预测相机位姿不准确会在新视角合成中引起错位。因此需要一种摆脱像素对齐、并能利用已知相机参数提升几何精度与位姿估计的框架。
AI.method: 1) 将密集图像特征聚合为全局体素表示，并从体素特征解码高斯，打破像素到高斯的对应关系；2) 在冻结预训练视觉基础模型（VFM）参数的前提下，引入测试时优化（TTO），利用位姿监督自适应调整轻量 LoRA 模块；3) 训练与推理阶段用随机实体体积渲染替代原始 3DGS 光栅化；4) 训练仅更新体素对齐的高斯重建模块。
AI.result: 训练耗时 80 GPU 小时。在 Replica、Tanks and Temples 和 DTU 数据集上，相比先前方法在 RGB-D 新视角合成与相机位姿估计上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: VoxelTTO 通过体素化解码、LoRA 测试时优化与实体体积渲染，从任意数量图像及可选相机参数中重建几何精确的 3DGS 场景，验证了该框架在 NVS 与位姿估计任务上的有效性。

title: Adaptive World Memory 3D Foundation Model for Scalable 3D Mapping, Localization, and Rendering
summary: Recent 3D foundation models enable generalizable geometric reasoning from RGB images but remain limited in persistent memory, scalability, and renderable scene modeling. We present a memory-centric 3D foundation model for scalable robotic localization, reconstruction, and Gaussian rendering. Its core is an adaptive world memory mechanism that combines transformer-based gated updates with test-time temporal-spatial regulation. Learned gates control recurrent memory propagation, while temporal state evolution and spatial observation-state consistency regulate token-wise updates and forgetting over long image sequences. To support large-scale mapping, we organize memory into local submaps and integrate progressive mapping and tracking, loop closure, and SL(4)-based global refinement to maintain local accuracy and global consistency. A Gaussian reconstruction head decodes memory-enhanced features into renderable primitives, unifying camera pose estimation, dense point-cloud reconstruction, and photorealistic rendering within a single model. Experiments on public benchmarks and self-collected datasets from diverse robotic platforms demonstrate improved trajectory accuracy, reconstruction completeness, and rendering quality over existing 3D foundation reconstruction and SLAM baselines. These results support adaptive memory as a foundation for persistent robotic world modeling. The dataset and code will be made publicly available at \href{https://github.com/dtc111111/AWM-3DFM}{https://github.com/dtc111111/AWM-3DFM}.

AI.tldr: 提出以记忆为核心的3D基础模型，通过自适应世界记忆机制统一机器人定位、稠密重建与高斯渲染。
AI.motivation: 现有3D基础模型虽能从RGB图像进行可泛化的几何推理，但在持久记忆、可扩展性以及可渲染场景建模方面仍受限，难以支撑机器人在长序列、大场景中的持续世界建模。
AI.method: 核心为自适应世界记忆机制：结合基于Transformer的门控更新与测试时时空调节，通过学习门控控制循环记忆传播，并利用时序状态演化与空间观测-状态一致性调节长序列上token级的更新与遗忘；将记忆组织为局部子图以支持大尺度建图，融合渐进式建图与跟踪、回环检测以及基于SL(4)的全局优化以兼顾局部精度与全局一致性；并以高斯重建头将记忆增强特征解码为可渲染图元，在单一模型内统一相机位姿估计、稠密点云重建与逼真渲染。
AI.result: 在公开基准与多种机器人平台自采数据集上，轨迹精度、重建完整性和渲染质量均优于现有3D基础重建与SLAM基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明自适应记忆可作为持久机器人世界建模的基础；数据集与代码将开源。

title: 2D GauSS-MI: Efficient Active Scene Reconstruction with Balanced Visual and Geometric Quality
summary: Active reconstruction requires efficient active view selection to achieve high-quality reconstruction within limited onboard computational resources. Existing methods face challenges in adequately balancing visual and geometric quality with the computational efficiency required for real-time operation. In this work, we present an active reconstruction framework based on 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS). We develop an efficient online 2DGS mapping pipeline for incremental RGB-D observations and introduce a probabilistic reliability model that characterizes the view-dependent reconstruction quality of individual 2D Gaussian splats. Building on this model, we formulate 2D Gaussian Splatting Shannon Mutual Information (2D GauSS-MI), a mutual-information-based metric that exploits the explicit surface orientation of 2DGS to evaluate the expected information gain of candidate views. The proposed metric enables active view selection to account for both visual and geometric reconstruction quality. We evaluate the proposed system against three state-of-the-art baselines on eight Replica scenes. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves a favorable balance between visual and geometric reconstruction quality with substantially lower computational cost and competitive model storage.

AI.tldr: 提出基于2D高斯泼溅的主动重建框架，用概率可靠性模型与香农互信息度量（2D GauSS-MI）实现兼顾视觉与几何质量的高效主动视角选择。
AI.motivation: 主动重建需在有限机载算力下高效选择视角以获得高质量重建。现有方法难以兼顾视觉与几何质量同实时计算效率之间的平衡。
AI.method: 基于2DGS构建增量RGB-D观测的在线建图流水线；提出刻画单个2D高斯泼溅视角相关重建质量的概率可靠性模型；在其上定义2D GauSS-MI——利用2DGS显式表面朝向的互信息度量，评估候选视角的期望信息增益，使视角选择同时考虑视觉与几何质量。
AI.result: 在8个Replica场景上与三种先进基线对比，方法在视觉与几何重建质量间取得良好平衡，计算开销显著降低，模型存储具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 以2DGS为表示、以互信息为准则的主动视角选择可在低算力条件下实现高质量主动重建，兼具质量与效率优势。

title: VidOmni-Bench: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Video Understanding via Spatio-Temporal Event Verification across Complexity and Duration
summary: While Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have recently demonstrated strong performance, reliably evaluating their fine-grained video understanding remains challenging. Existing benchmarks often rely on question answering or ground-truth caption matching, where models may succeed through superficial cues and incomplete annotations. To this end, we introduce VidOmni-Bench, a benchmark that requires models to verify whether each event in dense video captions is supported by the video. VidOmni-Bench consists of 500 videos spanning five complexity types and diverse durations from 4 seconds to 90 minutes. After collecting videos along these axes, we use diverse Video-LLMs to generate dense captions and obtain human-verified sentence-level labels, where sentences containing incorrect events serve as hard negatives for evaluation. Our experiments on VidOmni-Bench reveal three key findings: (i) Video-LLMs frequently generate hallucinated descriptions in dense video captioning; (ii) they also struggle as verifiers, failing to reliably detect plausible but incorrect event descriptions; and (iii) model weaknesses vary across video complexity and duration, revealing diverse, model-specific bottlenecks in current Video-LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 VidOmni-Bench，一个通过让模型验证密集视频字幕中每个事件是否被视频支持来评估 Video-LLM 细粒度视频理解的基准，包含 500 个多复杂度、多时长视频，并揭示模型在字幕幻觉与事实验证上的薄弱环节。
AI.motivation: 现有 Video-LLM 评估基准多依赖问答或与参考字幕匹配，模型可能借助表面线索通过测试，且标注不完整，难以可靠衡量细粒度视频理解能力。
AI.method: 构建 VidOmni-Bench：收集覆盖五种复杂度类型、时长 4 秒至 90 分钟的 500 个视频；用多种 Video-LLM 生成密集字幕，并经人工核验得到句子级标签，其中含错误事件的句子作为硬负样本用于评估。
AI.result: 实验得到三点发现：(i) Video-LLM 在密集视频字幕中频繁产生幻觉描述；(ii) 作为验证器时也难以可靠识别看似合理但错误的事件描述；(iii) 模型弱点随视频复杂度与时长变化，暴露出多样且模型特定的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: VidOmni-Bench 提供了更具挑战性的细粒度视频理解评测范式，表明当前 Video-LLM 在字幕生成与验证两方面均存在显著缺陷，且瓶颈因模型和视频特性而异。

title: Refine Then Fusion: Training-Free 3D Point Cloud Adaptation with Priority Refinement and Multi-Modal Knowledge Fusion
summary: Recent pre-trained foundation models provide rich multi-modal priors for downstream 3D vision tasks. However, the effectiveness of these representations in few-shot scenarios is limited by two fundamental challenges: High-dimensional features often contain substantial channel redundancy and task-irrelevant noise, while the reliability of different modalities varies across samples. Consequently, direct aggregation of heterogeneous representations overlooks sample-dependent modality reliability and may obscure the discriminative cues essential. To address these limitations, we propose Refine Then Fusion(RTF), a training-free framework for few-shot 3D recognition. RTF first identifies discriminative feature channels by jointly modeling inter-class similarity and intra-class stability, thereby decoupling domain-specific knowledge refinement from the cached representations of pre-trained models. It then introduces a reliability-aware fusion mechanism that estimates sample-wise modality reliability from the distribution shifts induced by feature refinement, enabling adaptive aggregation of multi-modal representations. Furthermore, RTF constructs a memory cache that integrates instance-level support features with class-level prototypes to infer query labels. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks demonstrate that RTF consistently outperforms single-modal baselines, partial-fusion variants, and existing lightweight adaptation methods, achieving state-of-the-art few-shot 3D recognition performance without gradient optimization, additional training data, auxiliary training, or parameter updates.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架RTF，通过通道级特征精炼与可靠性感知的多模态融合，提升小样本3D识别性能。
AI.motivation: 预训练基础模型为3D视觉任务提供丰富多模态先验，但在小样本场景下效果受限：高维特征存在通道冗余与任务无关噪声，且不同模态的可靠性随样本变化；直接聚合异质表征会忽视样本级模态可靠性，掩盖判别性线索。
AI.method: RTF为免训练框架：1）联合建模类间相似性与类内稳定性，识别判别性特征通道，从预训练模型缓存表征中解耦领域知识精炼；2）引入可靠性感知融合机制，由特征精炼引起的分布偏移估计样本级模态可靠性，实现多模态自适应聚合；3）构建整合实例级支持特征与类级原型的记忆缓存以推断查询标签。
AI.result: 在五个基准上，RTF持续优于单模态基线、部分融合变体及现有轻量适配方法，取得SOTA小样本3D识别性能，且无需梯度优化、额外训练数据、辅助训练或参数更新。
AI.conclusion: RTF以免训练方式有效解决小样本3D识别中的特征冗余与模态可靠性问题，验证了通道精炼与可靠性感知融合的有效性。

title: Purification and Regulation: Comorbidity-Aware Multi-Label Few-Shot Learning for Medical Image Classification
summary: Multi-label few-shot learning (MLFSL) remains a significant challenge in medical image analysis (MIA). Current metric-based meta-learning methods face two critical limitations in MIA. First, conventional prototype generation often entangles irrelevant disease information, leading to contaminated prototypes and degraded performance. Second, prior studies typically enforce inter-class separability in embedding space, largely neglecting the inherent correlations among diseases. To overcome these challenges, we propose Prototype Purification and Regulation (PPR), a novel MLFSL framework for MIA. PPR first performs prototype purification by leveraging sample-level comorbidity scores to emphasize disease-specific features, producing purified prototypes that better characterize each disease. Building upon these purified prototypes, PPR further addresses the underexplored problem of inter-class prototype distance in MIA by incorporating disease-level comorbidity statistics to adaptively regulate inter-class similarity, forming a comorbidity-aware embedding space. Overall, PPR sequentially enables the model to capture pure disease features and inter-class relationships for reliable MLFSL in MIA. Extensive experiments across four chest X-ray benchmark datasets, including cross-domain evaluation, show that PPR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, significantly improving disease detection while demonstrating robust generalization and clinical applicability.

AI.tldr: 提出PPR框架，通过原型纯化与调控解决医学图像多标签小样本学习中原型污染与类间相关性被忽视的问题。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分析中的多标签小样本学习（MLFSL）尚存两大局限：其一，传统原型生成易混杂无关疾病信息，导致原型被污染、性能下降；其二，已有研究多在嵌入空间强制类间可分，却忽视疾病间的内在相关性。
AI.method: PPR先进行原型纯化：利用样本级共病评分突出疾病特异特征，生成更纯净的疾病原型；再在此基础上，引入疾病级共病统计自适应调控类间相似度，构建共病感知嵌入空间，从而依次捕获纯疾病特征与类间关系。
AI.result: 在四个胸部X光基准数据集（含跨域评估）上，PPR一致优于现有最优方法，显著提升疾病检测性能，并展现良好泛化性与临床适用性。
AI.conclusion: PPR通过原型纯化与共病感知的类间关系调控，为医学图像可靠的多标签小样本学习提供了有效方案。

title: From Retrieval to Recognition:How Vision--Language Models Become OCR Specialists
summary: Does a general vision--language model acquire specialized OCR ability by developing a new reading circuit or by reusing an existing mechanism? We address this question in the setting of full-sequence OCR, rather than local-answer retrieval. Using an evidence-grounded protocol with held-out causal interventions, we identify sparse and stable OCR-head sets in GLM-OCR, MinerU2.5, and PaddleOCR-VL-1.6. We then investigate the mechanistic origin of these OCR heads by comparing them with independently identified textual retrieval/copy heads in general VLMs. Across two general VLMs, visual OCR heads strongly overlap independently identified textual retrieval/copy heads, yielding untuned top-20 intersections of 73.3% and all-head Spearman correlations of 0.677-0.886. The overlap and causal interventions suggest that full-sequence OCR operates as dense sequential multimodal copy-and-paste, repeatedly retrieving visual evidence and routing it to the current output position. Finally, we examine how this shared circuit changes as a general VLM becomes an OCR specialist. Matched base-to-specialized comparisons show that OCR specialization largely preserves head identity, retaining 17-20 of the top 20 heads per task with all-head rank correlations of 0.874-0.942, while redistributing their functional and causal strengths.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究通用视觉-语言模型（VLM）获得OCR能力时，是发展新阅读回路还是复用已有机制。作者以全序列OCR为设定，通过证据支撑的保留因果干预协议，在GLM-OCR、MinerU2.5、PaddleOCR-VL-1.6中识别出稀疏稳定的OCR头集合，并发现其与通用VLM中独立识别的文本检索/复制头高度重叠且因果相关。结果表明全序列OCR本质上是密集顺序多模态复制粘贴机制；当通用VLM专门化为OCR专家时，头部身份基本保留，仅重新分配功能与因果强度。
AI.motivation: 回答通用视觉-语言模型获得专门OCR能力时，究竟是形成新的阅读回路，还是复用已有机制这一核心问题，并区分全序列OCR与局部答案检索两种不同设定。
AI.method: 采用证据支撑的协议与留出因果干预，在GLM-OCR、MinerU2.5、PaddleOCR-VL-1.6中识别稀疏、稳定的OCR头集合；将其与两个通用VLM中独立识别的文本检索/复制头进行对比，计算未调优的top-20交集比例和全头Spearman相关性；并通过匹配的基座—专门化模型对比，考察OCR专门化过程中头身份与功能/因果强度的变化。
AI.result: 两个通用VLM中，视觉OCR头与独立识别的文本检索/复制头高度重叠，未调优top-20交集达73.3%，全头Spearman相关为0.677–0.886；因果干预进一步支持该重叠。基座到专门化的匹配对比显示，OCR专门化基本保持头身份，每任务top-20中保留17–20个头，全头秩相关为0.874–0.942，但功能与因果强度发生重新分配。
AI.conclusion: 全序列OCR并非发展出全新的阅读回路，而是复用并改造通用的文本检索/复制回路，表现为密集顺序的多模态复制粘贴；OCR专门化主要在保留原有头身份的基础上重新分配功能与因果强度。

title: GestureFAR: Streaming Co-Speech Gesture Generation with Flow Autoregression
summary: Generating natural co-speech gestures from streaming speech is essential for embodied conversational agents, where motion must be produced while a user is still speaking. Recent streaming gesture systems make online generation possible by autoregressing over discrete motion tokens, but this design compresses high-dimensional continuous motion into finite codebooks and can limit the realism and diversity of generated gestures. To preserve both causality and continuous expressiveness, we propose \textbf{GestureFAR}, a flow-autoregressive framework for streaming co-speech gesture generation. First, GestureFAR autoregresses over causal continuous motion latents, using a transformer to model streaming audio-motion context and a per-token flow-matching head to sample the next latent from a continuous distribution. Second, we introduce a head-only flow distillation strategy that freezes the causal backbone and distills the multi-step per-token flow head into a single network evaluation using consistency and distribution-matching objectives. This keeps the model token-causal while removing the main latency bottleneck for live interaction. Experiments on BEAT2 show that GestureFAR significantly improves the quality--latency trade-off among streaming-capable methods, preserving strong gesture quality while enabling real-time token-causal generation. Project Page: https://andypinxinliu.github.io/GestureFAR

AI.tldr: GestureFAR：基于流匹配自回归的流式语音共语手势生成框架，用连续隐变量替代离散码本，并通过头部流蒸馏实现实时token因果生成。
AI.motivation: 具身对话智能体需要在用户尚未说完时即生成手势，因此流式（在线）共语手势生成至关重要。现有流式系统虽通过离散运动token自回归实现在线生成，但将高维连续运动压缩进有限码本，限制了生成手势的真实性与多样性。核心矛盾在于：既要保持因果性（causality，不依赖未来语音），又要保持连续表达力（continuous expressiveness）。
AI.method: 提出GestureFAR，一个flow-autoregressive流式共语手势生成框架，包含两部分：1）在因果连续运动隐变量（causal continuous motion latents）上自回归，用Transformer建模流式音频-运动上下文，并用逐token的flow-matching头从连续分布中采样下一个隐变量，从而避免离散化；2）头部流蒸馏（head-only flow distillation）：冻结因果主干，将多步逐token流头通过一致性（consistency）与分布匹配（distribution-matching）目标蒸馏为单次网络评估，在保持token因果性的同时消除实时交互的主要延迟瓶颈。
AI.result: 在BEAT2数据集上的实验表明，GestureFAR在具备流式能力的方法中显著改善了质量-延迟权衡（quality–latency trade-off），在保持较强手势质量的同时实现实时的token因果生成。
AI.conclusion: 以连续隐变量的流匹配自回归结合头部流蒸馏，可在不牺牲手势质量的前提下兼顾因果性与低延迟，为实时流式共语手势生成提供了有效方案。项目主页：https://andypinxinliu.github.io/GestureFAR

title: A benchmark dataset and baseline methods for four-dimensional STEM diffraction patterns
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures. Data and trained model weights: https://doi.org/10.57760/sciencedb.nbsdc.00281. Code: https://github.com/Gaiya69-rgb/4D-ImageNet
summary: Four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) records a two-dimensional diffraction pattern at each electron-probe position, yielding spatially resolved reciprocal-space information but large, heterogeneous data volumes. Here we describe 4D-ImageNet, a collection of 174,000 diffraction patterns comprising 145,000 experimental patterns selected from 29 acquisitions and 29,000 multislice simulations. The experimental data cover acquisition-level labels for Ag, Au, mixed Au-Ag, CoO, Pd and ZnO specimens across multiple fields of view, scan dimensions, camera lengths and exposure times. Each acquisition contributes 5,000 quality-ranked patterns with source scan coordinates and acquisition metadata. A set-prediction detector provides model-derived pseudo-labels for the direct-beam position and Bragg-disk centres, with a confidence score for each disk. The simulation data cover 13 crystal structures and include Euler rotations, reciprocal-space sampling and approximate low-index beam directions. A grouped mixed-domain masked-reconstruction benchmark is provided to assess leakage-resistant loading and evaluation across experimental and simulated data. The dataset is intended for representation learning, disk detection, diffraction-pattern retrieval, orientation analysis and simulation-to-experiment studies.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了4D-ImageNet，一个包含174,000个衍射图谱的4D-STEM数据集，涵盖145,000个实验数据与29,000个多切片模拟数据，并提供伪标签与基准测试。
AI.motivation: 4D-STEM在每个探针位置记录二维衍射图谱，产生大规模、异构且空间分辨的倒空间数据，但缺乏标准化数据集阻碍了表示学习、盘检测与模拟-实验对照等研究。
AI.method: 构建数据集：实验部分从29次采集（Ag、Au、Au-Ag混合、CoO、Pd、ZnO，多视场、扫描尺寸、相机长度与曝光时间）中筛选145,000个衍射图，每次采集贡献5,000个按质量排序的图谱并附扫描坐标与元数据；模拟部分含13种晶体结构、29,000个多切片模拟，包含欧拉旋转、倒空间采样及低指数束方向；采用集合预测检测器生成直接束与布拉格盘中心的模型伪标签及置信度，并提供分组混合域掩码重建基准以评估防泄漏加载与评价。
AI.result: 得到174,000个衍射图谱（145,000实验+29,000模拟），带采集级标签、质量排序、扫描坐标、采集元数据以及带置信度的束/盘中心伪标签，并具备防泄漏的分组混合域基准。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集适用于表示学习、盘检测、衍射图谱检索、取向分析及模拟到实验的研究。

title: HAT: Hypothesis-Anchored Tracking for Video Monocular Spacecraft Pose Estimation
summary: Monocular 6-DoF pose estimation of non-cooperative targets is important for on-orbit servicing and debris removal. A single-image estimator can confuse near-symmetric spacecraft orientations, and tracking can preserve an incorrect pose. We present Hypothesis-Anchored Tracking (HAT), a causal framework that uses inter-frame motion to select among competing CAD-based pose hypotheses before alignment and fusion. Rather than independently choosing the highest-scoring hypothesis in each image, HAT retains competing orientation histories and selects a pose to anchor the relative trajectory estimated by monocular SLAM. Sparse anchors and pose fusion provide per-frame estimates after initialization without revising past outputs. The method requires only a calibrated RGB sequence, a metric CAD model, and target image regions, which can be supplied by detection or segmentation. The pretrained pose and SLAM networks require no target-specific training or fine-tuning. We evaluate two versions, Mega-HAT and Pico-HAT, using MegaPose and PicoPose, on SPARK-2024, SwissCube and SHIRT, with YCB-Video assessing performance outside the space domain. Using one temporal configuration per method, the arithmetic means of the four dataset-wise comparisons show 9.4% lower mean pose error and 3.76 times the sustained input FPS for Mega-HAT relative to independent MegaPose, and 23.9% lower mean pose error and 2.42 times the FPS for Pico-HAT relative to independent PicoPose. Mega-HAT ablations on SPARK and an offline reference examine component contributions and the effect of revising past estimates.

AI.tldr: HAT 是一个利用帧间运动在配准与融合前对 CAD 位姿假设进行选择的因果式单目 6-DoF 位姿估计框架，包含 Mega-HAT 与 Pico-HAT 两个版本。
AI.motivation: 非合作目标的单目 6-DoF 位姿估计对在轨服务与碎片清除很重要，但单帧估计器会混淆近对称航天器朝向，跟踪方法又可能锁定错误位姿。
AI.method: HAT 保留多个竞争朝向历史，利用帧间运动在配准与融合前选择假设，并以此锚定单目 SLAM 估计的相对轨迹；通过稀疏锚点与位姿融合在初始化后给出每帧估计，且不修改历史输出。方法仅需标定 RGB 序列、度量 CAD 模型与目标图像区域，预训练位姿与 SLAM 网络无需目标特定训练或微调。
AI.result: 在 SPARK-2024、SwissCube、SHIRT 及 YCB-Video 上评估：相对独立 MegaPose，Mega-HAT 平均位姿误差降低 9.4%、持续输入 FPS 提升 3.76 倍；相对独立 PicoPose，Pico-HAT 平均位姿误差降低 23.9%、FPS 提升 2.42 倍。Mega-HAT 在 SPARK 上的消融实验分析了各组件贡献及修改历史估计的影响。
AI.conclusion: 通过帧间运动驱动的假设锚定跟踪，HAT 在无需目标特定训练的前提下提升了精度与效率，并保持因果性，适用于空间域及域外场景。

title: Learned Parametric Emotion Editing: Real-Time Affective Filtering for On-Device Social Media Video
summary: Problematic internet use affects a growing share of the population, yet common interventions, e.g., time limits, blocking, forced breaks, are coercive and easily circumvented. We explore a less restrictive alternative: adapting the emotional intensity of visual content. Prior work has shown that optimization can steer an image's affective content, but its per-image optimization cost makes it impractical for real-time deployment. We instead learn a model that predicts this transformation in a single forward pass: a MobileNetV4 backbone with FiLM-based emotion conditioning outputs parameters for differentiable global transformations. This replaces prior iterative optimization (80 s per image) with a single 3.7 ms forward pass. In a user study (N = 54), the model reduced viewer-reported arousal relative to unedited images, comparably to the grayscale well-being filter, while being rated higher in perceived quality. We integrate the model into an Android app that adapts Instagram video in real time, sustaining 60 fps on a Samsung Galaxy S23.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种轻量级情感调节模型（MobileNetV4+FiLM），单次前向传播（3.7 ms）即可预测图像情感强度的全局变换参数，替代此前每图80 s的迭代优化，并在用户研究（N=54）中降低了唤醒度且质量评分优于灰度滤镜，已集成至Android应用实现Instagram视频60 fps实时调节。
AI.motivation: 问题性网络使用影响日益扩大，而现有干预（时间限制、屏蔽、强制休息）具有强制性且易被规避；调整视觉内容的情感强度是一种更温和的替代方案，但先前基于优化的情感调控方法需对每张图像迭代优化（约80 s），无法满足实时部署需求。
AI.method: 以MobileNetV4为骨干网络，结合FiLM机制进行情感条件化，输出可微全局变换的参数；用单次前向传播直接预测该情感变换，取代此前的迭代优化。随后开展用户研究（N=54）评估唤醒度与感知质量，并将模型集成进Android应用，对Instagram视频进行实时处理。
AI.result: 单张处理时间由约80 s的迭代优化降至3.7 ms的单次前向传播；用户研究中，模型相对未编辑图像显著降低观看者自报唤醒度，效果与灰度健康滤镜相当，但感知质量评分更高；Android应用在三星Galaxy S23上处理Instagram视频可稳定维持60 fps。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习式单次前向预测替代逐图优化，可在保证情感调节效果的同时实现实时、低侵入的视觉内容情感强度自适应，为问题性网络使用提供了一种非强制性的干预途径，且具备移动端实时部署的可行性。

title: Detection is solved, delineation is not: what governs tooth segmentation on panoramic radiographs
summary:
Automatic tooth segmentation and FDI numbering on panoramic radiographs underpins computer-assisted dental diagnosis, yet which factors govern performance remains unclear. We assemble a corpus of 1,422 panoramic radiographs containing 42,142 expert-delineated tooth polygons across the 32-class FDI taxonomy, annotated by 30 dental practitioners and independently reviewed by two others, and use it to isolate input resolution, architecture and anatomical priors under a single evaluation protocol.
  First, resolution dominates: across a controlled 640/1024/1280 ablation, mask mAP50-95 rises 0.656 -> 0.710 -> 0.717 while mAP50 stays flat at ~0.982. Both gains are significant under a paired bootstrap over images (p < 0.001, p = 0.024); neither mAP50 change is distinguishable from zero. Added resolution buys boundary precision, not detection. Second, architecture is nearly irrelevant in-domain: a query-based transformer with 2.1x the parameters is statistically equivalent to a one-stage detector (95% CI [-0.0064, +0.0064]), only marginally better under domain shift, 5.5x slower on CPU and not executable under standard ONNX runtimes. Third, three targeted interventions fail: a LoRA-adapted self-supervised encoder underperforms, a promptable foundation segmenter degrades masks by 39%, and globally optimal anatomical label assignment yields +0.0007 despite correcting a constraint violated in 40% of out-of-domain predictions.
  Zero-shot transfer to an independent multi-centre cohort, verified overlap-free, costs 62% of mask mAP50-95 but only 18% of mAP50, reproducing the dissociation. Decomposing masks along the tooth axis localises the residual error to the apical third. Boundary precision is therefore the binding constraint, and effort is better directed at resolution and acquisition diversity than at architectural novelty.

AI.tldr: 在1422张全景片、42142个专家标注牙多边形上系统隔离输入分辨率、架构与解剖先验三大因素：分辨率主导（掩膜mAP50-95显著提升），架构在域内几乎无关，三项先验/表征干预均无效；边界精度而非检测是瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 自动牙齿分割与FDI编号是计算机辅助牙科诊断的基础，但何种因素决定其性能尚不明确。现有研究多聚焦架构创新，缺乏在统一评估协议下对各影响因素的受控对比，导致难以判断性能提升的真正来源。
AI.method: 构建含1422张全景片、42142个专家勾画牙多边形（32类FDI分类体系）的语料，由30名牙科从业者标注、另2名独立复核。在单一评估协议下开展三类实验：(1) 640/1024/1280输入分辨率消融，并以图像级配对bootstrap检验显著性；(2) 对比查询式Transformer（参数量为单阶段检测器的2.1倍）与单阶段检测器的域内、域外表现及CPU推理速度、ONNX可执行性；(3) 三项针对性干预：LoRA适配的自监督编码器、可提示基础分割模型、全局最优解剖标签分配。另进行零样本迁移至独立多中心队列，并按牙轴分解掩膜误差。
AI.result: 分辨率主导：mAP50-95由0.656升至0.710、0.717（p<0.001，p=0.024），mAP50稳定在约0.982且变化不显著，说明分辨率提升带来的是边界精度而非检测能力。域内架构近乎无关（95% CI [-0.0064, +0.0064]），查询式Transformer仅域外略优，CPU推理慢5.5倍且无法在标准ONNX运行时执行。三项干预均失败：LoRA自监督编码器性能下降，可提示基础分割模型掩膜退化39%，全局最优标签分配仅+0.0007（尽管纠正了域外预测中40%违反的约束）。零样本迁移损失62%的mAP50-95但仅损失18%的mAP50，复现该解离；按牙轴分解将残差定位至根尖三分之一。
AI.conclusion: 边界精度是约束性能的瓶颈。提升应优先投向输入分辨率与采集多样性，而非架构新颖性；解剖先验与表征干预在本任务中收益有限。

title: Extending Decoupled Attention to Dense Prediction and Masked Training for Multi-Channel Images
summary: Multi-Channel imaging (MCI) data differs fundamentally from natural images, as each channel records a semantically distinct signal rather than a colour band. To adapt vision encoders to MCI data, Multi-Channel Vision Transformers (MC-ViTs) tokenize each channel independently and concatenate the resulting tokens into one sequence, and the channel count is no longer fixed by the architecture. Self-attention is then computed across all channel-patch tokens with no restriction on which channels attend to which, which dilutes the features of individual channels. The Decoupled Vision Transformer (DC-ViT) regulates this by separating updates computed within a channel from updates computed across channels, and by forming a representation per channel before the channels are combined. Its formulation, however, pairs tokens by spatial position, and thus requires the same visible tokens in every channel. Correspondence under independent per-channel masking is recovered by solving a linear assignment between the retained patches of each channel, which allows decoupled attention to be combined with current masked multi-channel training in its standard configuration rather than a restricted one. Across three classification and three segmentation benchmarks spanning fluorescence microscopy, imaging mass cytometry and satellite imaging, including dense prediction at high channel counts, the resulting formulation outperforms the strongest MC-ViT baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出通过线性分配恢复通道间patch对应关系的解耦注意力，使DC-ViT可结合标准掩码多通道训练，在六个基准上超越最强MC-ViT基线。
AI.motivation: 多通道成像各通道语义不同，MC-ViT将各通道token拼接后全局自注意力无约束，导致单通道特征被稀释；DC-ViT虽分离通道内与跨通道更新，但其公式按空间位置配对token，要求各通道可见token一致，无法直接用于独立逐通道掩码。
AI.method: 在DC-ViT中引入基于线性分配（linear assignment）的通道间patch对应求解：对各通道保留patch进行匹配，从而在独立逐通道掩码下恢复对应关系，使解耦注意力可与标准配置的掩码多通道训练结合，而非受限配置。
AI.result: 在荧光显微、成像质谱流式和卫星成像三类模态、三个分类与三个分割基准（含高通道数密集预测）上，该公式优于最强MC-ViT基线。
AI.conclusion: 线性分配匹配可有效桥接解耦注意力与独立逐通道掩码，扩展DC-ViT适用性并提升多通道成像任务的性能。

title: Configurable Multi-Stage Vision Pipeline for Crop Disease and Pest Diagnosis
summary:
Farmer.Chat is Digital Green's farm advisory service for smallholder farmers. When something looks wrong with a crop, the farmer takes a photograph and sends it, and that photograph is the whole question: no symptom described, no crop named, often no text at all. The service has to determine whether the picture can be used, what crop it shows, and what is wrong with it, from images taken on cheap phones in a field, in poor light and with a moving camera. The system doing this today cannot be adjusted. It has no adjustable thresholds for photograph rejection, crops and problems cannot be added, and there is no confidence cut-off to set.
  We study about 1.16 million photographs sent to Farmer.Chat from Ethiopia, India, Kenya and Nigeria. The production quality gate rejected 46.8% of the images it judged, over a quarter of those reaching diagnosis returned no crop name, and 35.8% of the labelled problems filed under "disease" are pests, identifiable without the crop. We therefore split the work into three stages: a quality gate (M0), a crop detector (M1), and a disease or pest detector (M2). Route A fills all three with one fine-tuned vision-language model (Qwen3-VL-4B) answering in a single call. Route B fills each with a small specialist model (DaViT, YOLO26).
  We replace our production GPT-4o quality gate with a small MobileNetV3 gate at 86.9% F1 in 12 ms. On one test set scored the same way for every system, a hierarchical DaViT-Base achieves 95.41% crop accuracy against 91.46% for the production baseline. It also leads on diagnosis and never declines to answer, while every language model in the comparison leaves a large share of rows with no diagnosis. The fine-tuned model retains two capabilities the specialists do not have: one call for all three stages, and a request for a better photograph when the image cannot support an answer.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究 Digital Green 面向小农户的农业咨询服务 Farmer.Chat，基于约116万张来自埃塞俄比亚、印度、肯尼亚和尼日利亚的田间照片，将任务拆分为质量门控（M0）、作物检测（M1）和病害/虫害检测（M2）三阶段，并比较单模型统一路线（微调Qwen3-VL-4B）与专用小模型路线（DaViT、YOLO26）。
AI.motivation: Farmer.Chat 的真实使用场景中，农民仅上传一张照片，不描述症状、不提供作物名称，照片多由低端手机在弱光、移动条件下拍摄。现有生产系统不可调整：缺乏照片拒绝阈值、无法新增作物与问题类别、没有置信度截断。同时生产质量门控拒绝了46.8%的图像，超过四分之一进入诊断的图像未返回作物名称，标注为"disease"的问题中35.8%实为可在未知作物情况下识别的虫害。这些缺陷促使作者重新设计可配置的多阶段系统。
AI.method: 研究分析约1.16百万张 Farmer.Chat 照片，将流程拆为三阶段：质量门控M0、作物检测M1、病害或虫害检测M2。设置两条路线：Route A 使用单一微调视觉语言模型 Qwen3-VL-4B，一次调用完成三阶段；Route B 每阶段使用小型专用模型（DaViT、YOLO26）。生产质量门控由 GPT-4o 替换为 MobileNetV3。并在同一测试集上以统一评分方式比较各系统，评估作物准确率、诊断表现与拒答行为。
AI.result: 小型 MobileNetV3 质量门控达到86.9% F1，推理耗时12 ms，替代生产环境 GPT-4o 门控。在同一评分测试集上，分层 DaViT-Base 作物准确率为95.41%，高于生产基线91.46%。该模型在诊断任务上也领先，且从不拒绝作答；相比之下，所有语言模型对比系统均留下大量无诊断行。微调 Qwen3-VL-4B 保留了专用模型不具备的两项能力：一次调用完成三阶段，以及在图像不足以支持回答时主动请求更好的照片。
AI.conclusion: 针对小农户单图咨询场景，专用小模型路线在质量门控效率、作物识别与诊断覆盖率上优于生产基线；统一微调视觉语言模型则在流程集成度与主动澄清（请求重拍）方面具有独特优势。三阶段拆分与可配置设计解决了原生产系统不可调整、无法拒绝低质图像以及作物与问题类别难以扩展的问题。

title: DRT: Dense Reasoning Trace for Efficient and Grounded Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Despite the remarkable progress in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), prevailing Chain-of-Thought (CoT) paradigms remain confined to the natural-language expression space. Consequently, they inherently incur excessive linguistic overhead, leading to information dilution and weak visual grounding. To address this challenge, we propose Dense Reasoning Trace (DRT), a paradigm that departs from natural-language-centered CoT by expressing reasoning as compact structured traces, which include concise intermediate states with symbolic connectors and disentangle visual observations from logical deductions. First, we introduce the Dense Trace Initialization to internalize the DRT reasoning mode into the model, substantially improving token efficiency while preserving visual evidence. To further enable the model to faithfully capture the logical relations within traces, we propose the Trace-Grounded Reinforcement Learning framework, which builds reference traces through a tri-perspective verification pipeline and employs Trace-Grounded GRPO with structured rewards, encouraging the model to generate concise DRT-style traces with reduced hallucination and stronger logical grounding. Extensive experiments on challenging reasoning benchmarks show that DRT achieves 5.5$\times$ token efficiency improvement while improving 1.3 accuracy points over the Qwen3-VL baseline. These findings suggest that complex multimodal reasoning may not require verbose natural-language traces, opening a more efficient path for next-generation MLLMs. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/HIT-leaderone/DRT

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Dense Reasoning Trace (DRT) 范式，用紧凑的结构化推理轨迹替代自然语言 CoT，实现 5.5 倍 token 效率提升并带来 1.3 个百分点的准确率增益。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型（MLLMs）的思维链（CoT）范式局限于自然语言表达空间，导致过度的语言冗余，进而引发信息稀释与视觉基础（visual grounding）薄弱的问题。
AI.method: 1）Dense Trace Initialization：将 DRT 推理模式内化到模型中，在保留视觉证据的同时显著提升 token 效率；2）Trace-Grounded Reinforcement Learning 框架：通过三视角验证流程构建参考轨迹，并采用带结构化奖励的 Trace-Grounded GRPO，促使模型生成简洁的 DRT 式轨迹，降低幻觉、增强逻辑基础。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的推理基准上，DRT 相比 Qwen3-VL 基线实现了 5.5 倍 token 效率提升，同时准确率提高 1.3 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 复杂的多模态推理可能并不需要冗长的自然语言轨迹，这为下一代 MLLMs 开辟了更高效的路径。代码与数据已开源。

title: Diffusion-Based Tumor Inpainting for Renal Segmentation under Clinical Data Scarcity
summary: Deep learning segmentation of renal tumors requires large annotated datasets, yet clinical deployments typically offer only a handful of tumor-positive cases from the target site. We propose a diffusion-based inpainting framework that synthesizes anatomically plausible renal tumors within healthy CT scans, requiring no additional annotation, and provide the first systematic comparison of 2D, 2.5D, and full 3D (MAISI) synthesis strategies for this task. Training the diffusion model on public data (KiTS23, KIRC) and evaluating nnU-Net segmentation on a internal cohort across three low-data regimes, we find that 2.5D and 3D augmentation substantially reduce false positives (from $\sim$18--20\% to $\sim$3--6\%) while maintaining Dice, whereas 2D provides no consistent benefit. Crucially, the proposed 2.5D method matches full 3D synthesis on every metric at substantially lower computational cost, indicating that local volumetric consistency alone is sufficient for effective augmentation in data- and resource-scarce clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 提出基于扩散修复的肾脏肿瘤合成框架，无需额外标注，首次系统比较2D、2.5D与全3D（MAISI）合成策略；在低数据场景下，2.5D与3D增强将假阳性从约18–20%降至约3–6%，且2.5D在各项指标上匹配3D且计算成本显著更低。
AI.motivation: 深度学习肾脏肿瘤分割依赖大规模标注数据，但临床部署中目标部位通常仅有少量肿瘤阳性病例，数据稀缺且标注成本高，亟需无需额外标注的数据增强手段。
AI.method: 构建基于扩散模型的图像修复（inpainting）框架，在健康CT扫描中合成解剖上合理的肾脏肿瘤；在公开数据（KiTS23、KIRC）上训练扩散模型，在内部队列上以三种低数据设置评估nnU-Net分割；并首次系统对比2D、2.5D与全3D（MAISI）三种合成策略。
AI.result: 2.5D与3D增强显著降低假阳性（从约18–20%降至约3–6%），同时维持Dice；2D方法无一致收益；所提出的2.5D方法在所有指标上与全3D合成相当，但计算成本显著更低。
AI.conclusion: 仅需局部体积一致性即可实现有效的数据增强，2.5D扩散合成是数据与资源受限临床场景下高效、实用的肿瘤分割增强方案。

title: SignGPT: Toward LLM-Mediated Sign Language Interaction through Gloss-Free Translation and Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) provide limited support for sign language interaction. Unifying sign language translation (SLT) and generation (SLG) to enable sign language as both input and output can reduce switching between separate models during sign-text interaction. We present SignGPT, a unified, pose-based framework for gloss-free SLT and SLG. SignGPT integrates part-aware hierarchical representations of body, hand, and facial motion into a shared language model and employs asymmetric multi-token prediction and progressive training for bidirectional modeling. We evaluate SignGPT on How2Sign (ASL) and Phoenix-2014T (DGS) through benchmark comparisons, qualitative analyses, and component ablations. An exploratory study with 12 Deaf ASL signers assesses an LLM-mediated sign-to-sign response pipeline, highlighting the potential of unified modeling to support sign language conversation (SLC).

AI.tldr: 提出统一的、基于姿态的无注释手语翻译与生成框架SignGPT，将身体、手部、面部动作的分部位层级表示集成进共享语言模型，实现手语作为输入与输出的双向建模，并在两个数据集上验证，探索手语对话应用潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型对手语交互的支持有限；手语翻译（SLT）与手语生成（SLG）通常由分离的模型承担，在sign-text交互中需要频繁切换模型，缺乏统一框架。作者希望将SLT与SLG统一，使手语既能作为输入也能作为输出，从而支持手语对话。
AI.method: 提出SignGPT：一个统一的、基于姿态（pose-based）且无需gloss标注的SLT与SLG框架。技术上，将身体、手部、面部动作的分部位层级表示（part-aware hierarchical representations）集成到共享语言模型中，并采用非对称多token预测（asymmetric multi-token prediction）与渐进式训练（progressive training）进行双向建模。
AI.result: 在How2Sign（ASL）与Phoenix-2014T（DGS）两个数据集上，通过基准对比、定性分析与组件消融实验对SignGPT进行了评估。此外，一项由12名聋人ASL手语者参与的探索性研究评估了基于LLM中介的手语到手语响应流程（sign-to-sign response pipeline）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明统一建模在支持手语对话（SLC）方面具有潜力。

title: ZYT-World: A Real-Time Controllable World Model for Closed-Loop Autonomous-Driving Simulation
comment: Technical Report. Videos and additional results are available at zyt-aim.github.io/ZYT-World
summary: Generative world models offer controllable and repeatable closed-loop simulation for end-to-end and vision-language-action driving policies, but production deployment exposes three unresolved requirements: faithfully reproducing a mixed fisheye-pinhole rig at native resolutions; reconciling causal, per-timestep interaction with long-horizon stability and low latency; and preserving scene identity when a location is revisited. We present ZYT-World, a single architecture that natively generates four fisheye views with field of view > 180° and three pinhole views. Projection-specific Plucker adapters encode camera geometry, ego-motion adaptive layer normalization provides global motion control, and a lightweight pixel-aligned layout conditions traffic participants and signals through instance-level boxes, headings and colors. Heterogeneous training combines full-rig geometric coverage with high-resolution detail. Teacher forcing, causal consistency distillation, self-rollout distribution matching distillation, and RigCritic transform a 40-step bidirectional teacher into a one-step, per-latent streaming generator, with RigCritic evaluating the seven-view rig jointly. A 19M-parameter variational autoencoder decoder (TinyVAE), W8A8 quantization, and our inference engine reduce decoding, backbone, and incremental-execution costs, respectively. Finally, cross-trajectory pairs derived from real captures train a plug-in implicit-memory module that preserves place-specific evidence. On the internal multi-view test set, the one-step model retains more than 90% of the teacher's PSNR and SSIM, while FID, FVD, and LPIPS stay within 11% of the teacher. Under the generator-only timing in Figure 2, it is 107.7 times faster than the 40-step bidirectional teacher. TinyVAE decodes 59.8 times faster than Wan. 30s rollouts and cross-trajectory revisits show the intended long-horizon and memory behavior.

AI.tldr: ZYT-World：单一架构原生生成7路（4鱼眼+3针孔）驾驶世界模型，通过投影特定Plucker适配器、因果一致性蒸馏、RigCritic与隐式记忆模块，将40步双向教师蒸馏为一步流式生成器，速度提升107.7倍，同时保留>90%的PSNR/SSIM。
AI.motivation: 生成式世界模型虽能为端到端及VLA驾驶策略提供可控、可重复的闭环仿真，但实际部署面临三项未解需求：1）在原生分辨率下忠实复现鱼眼-针孔混合相机rig；2）在因果逐时间步交互与长时程稳定性、低延迟之间取得平衡；3）当同一地点被重访时保持场景身份一致性。
AI.method: 提出统一架构ZYT-World：原生生成4个FOV>180°的鱼眼视图与3个针孔视图；采用投影特定的Plucker适配器编码相机几何，ego-motion自适应层归一化实现全局运动控制，轻量像素对齐布局以实例级框、朝向与颜色条件化交通参与者与信号；异构训练结合全rig几何覆盖与高分辨率细节；通过teacher forcing、因果一致性蒸馏、自rollout分布匹配蒸馏及RigCritic将40步双向教师转为一步逐潜变量流式生成器；配合19M参数TinyVAE解码器、W8A8量化与推理引擎降低各环节开销；最后用真实采集的跨轨迹对训练即插即用隐式记忆模块以保留地点特定证据。
AI.result: 在内部多视图测试集上，一步模型保留教师模型>90%的PSNR与SSIM，FID、FVD、LPIPS均在教师模型11%以内；按图2仅生成器计时，比40步双向教师快107.7倍；TinyVAE解码比Wan快59.8倍；30秒rollout与跨轨迹重访实验验证了预期的长时程与记忆行为。
AI.conclusion: ZYT-World以单一架构统一解决了混合相机rig原生生成、因果流式低延迟与地点重访记忆保持三项部署需求，在显著加速的同时保持了接近教师模型的生成质量，并展现出长时程稳定与隐式记忆能力。

title: Balanced Prompt Adaptation against Entropy-Induced Collapse for Test-Time Binary Segmentation
summary: Entropy minimization is a standard objective for test-time adaptation (TTA), but it can fail in imbalanced binary segmentation. Unlike image classification, dense segmentation aggregates thousands of pixel predictions, allowing the larger predicted class to dominate the update, pull minority predictions toward itself, and produce a degenerate mask as predictions saturate and their entropy gradients vanish. We theoretically establish this collapse in a shared-shift model. This analysis motivates Balanced-Anchor Prompt Adaptation (BAPA), which combines two complementary modules. The Class-Balanced Anchors (CBA) module selects high-confidence anchors separately from each predicted class and gives foreground and background equal total loss weight, preventing the larger region from dominating the update. Dynamic Prompt Adaptation (DPA) refreshes these anchors after each prediction update and optimizes only text-side prompt residuals while keeping the vision-language encoders frozen. This prompt-only update refines the foreground-background decision boundary without altering the pretrained dense visual representation. Across experiments from four domains, BAPA achieves the highest mean Dice among the evaluated methods. Factorized ablations further validate the complementary roles of CBA and DPA, supporting balanced prompt adaptation as an effective alternative to entropy minimization for test-time binary segmentation.

AI.tldr: 针对不平衡二分类分割中熵最小化易崩溃的问题，提出平衡锚点提示适配（BAPA），含类平衡锚点（CBA）与动态提示适配（DPA），在四领域实验中取得最高平均Dice。
AI.motivation: 熵最小化是测试时适配（TTA）的标准目标，但在不平衡二分类分割中会失效。与图像分类不同，稠密分割会聚合数千个像素预测，导致占多数的预测类主导更新，把少数类预测拉向自身；随着预测饱和、其熵梯度消失，最终产生退化的分割掩码。
AI.method: 作者在共享偏移（shared-shift）模型下从理论上证明了上述崩溃现象。据此提出 BAPA，包含两个互补模块：类平衡锚点（CBA）分别从每个预测类中挑选高置信度锚点，并使前景与背景获得相等的总损失权重，避免较大区域主导更新；动态提示适配（DPA）在每次预测更新后刷新这些锚点，并仅优化文本侧提示残差，冻结视觉-语言编码器。该仅提示更新在不改变预训练稠密视觉表示的前提下细化前景-背景决策边界。
AI.result: 在来自四个领域的实验中，BAPA 在所评估方法中取得最高平均 Dice；因子化消融进一步验证了 CBA 与 DPA 的互补作用。
AI.conclusion: 平衡的提示适配可作为熵最小化的有效替代方案，用于测试时二分类分割。

title: SFVO: Decoupled Confidence-Guided Stereo-Flow Visual Odometry with Bidirectional PnP
summary: Deep learning-based visual odometry (VO) has achieved significant progress, yet most existing methods focus on a monocular approach, which suffers from scale ambiguity. Stereo VO provides real metric by its nature, but remains less studied in deep learning VO due to its high computational cost and modeling complexity. Recent advances in stereo matching and optical flow estimation have made dense visual correspondence increasingly accurate and reliable, but their complementary geometric information has not been fully exploited for VO. In this paper, we present SFVO, a correspondence-driven stereo VO framework that directly builds upon pretrained stereo matching and optical flow models. SFVO exploits pretrained stereo matching and optical flow models to estimate stereo and temporal correspondences. Instead of learning pose directly from images, SFVO maps learned correspondences into geometric constraints and predicts which points are trustworthy. To improve the reliability of visual correspondence-based geometric constraints, we introduce decoupled confidence maps for rotation and translation. This design better aligns the characteristics of visual correspondence and 6-DoF transformations. Extensive experiments on outdoor and indoor datasets demonstrate that SFVO achieves robust and accurate pose estimation with strong generalization capability. The code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SFVO，一个对应关系驱动的双目视觉里程计框架，直接基于预训练的双目匹配和光流模型，将学习到的对应关系映射为几何约束并预测可信点，通过解耦的旋转/平移置信度图提升约束可靠性，实现鲁棒精确的位姿估计。
AI.motivation:
1. 现有深度学习VO多集中于单目方法，存在尺度模糊问题；
2. 双目VO天然提供真实度量尺度，但因计算成本高、建模复杂而研究不足；
3. 双目匹配与光流估计的进展使稠密视觉对应日益精确，但其互补的几何信息在VO中尚未被充分利用。
AI.method:
1. 提出SFVO——对应关系驱动的双目VO框架，直接构建于预训练的双目匹配与光流模型之上；
2. 利用预训练模型估计双目对应（立体匹配）与时间对应（光流）；
3. 不直接从图像学习位姿，而是将学习到的对应关系映射为几何约束，并预测哪些点值得信赖；
4. 引入针对旋转与平移的解耦置信度图（decoupled confidence maps），以更好匹配视觉对应与6自由度变换的特性，提升几何约束可靠性。
AI.result: 在室外与室内数据集上的大量实验表明，SFVO实现了鲁棒且精确的位姿估计，并具备强泛化能力。代码将开源。
AI.conclusion: SFVO证明，充分利用预训练匹配/光流模型提供的稠密对应关系，并以解耦置信度建模其可靠性，是构建高精度、高泛化双目VO的有效途径，弥补了深度学习双目VO研究的不足。

title: Beyond Benchmark Scores: Auditing Medical Vision-Language Models for Chest X-Ray Tuberculosis Screening
comment: 27 pages, 7 figures, and 21 tables; includes extended methods, statistical analyses, and robustness evaluations
summary: A medical model's benchmark score does not establish that the same conclusion holds under a different evaluation. This study tests whether claims about model ranking, score reliability and screening performance survive changes in cohort, prompt, negative spectrum, specified prevalence and operating threshold. We audit three medical vision-language models (BioMedCLIP, CheXficient, and MedSigLIP) and a general-domain OpenCLIP comparator on 12,200 chest radiograph records from four datasets (Montgomery, Shenzhen, TBX11K, and VinDr-CXR). Five fixed prompt families yield 244,000 model--image--prompt scores. No model leads every cohort and reliability criterion. Prompt-family changes alter AUROC in 21 of 48 multiplicity-controlled comparisons. Replacing healthy controls with sick non-tuberculosis controls reduces AUROC by 0.075--0.306 across all four models. On VinDr-CXR, the three medical models distinguish tuberculosis from no-finding controls substantially better than from pneumonia or lung tumor; their AUROC point estimates for both named diseases fall below 0.5. CheXficient has documented VinDr-CXR pretraining exposure, which limits the interpretation of its results. Thresholds chosen for 95\% sensitivity on TBX11K training retain that constraint by point estimate in only four of sixteen target evaluations. A five-seed supervised source model reaches 0.999 AUROC on TBX11K validation but 0.629 on each of two external cohorts. Conservative exclusion of perceptual-overlap candidates narrows this gap without closing it. These retrospective, single-task results show that discrimination, score reliability and threshold retention support different portability claims. Evidence for chest X-ray tuberculosis screening should identify the complete evaluation specification rather than attribute clinical portability to a checkpoint alone.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过在4个数据集、12200份胸片记录上对3个医学视觉语言模型和1个通用模型进行多维度评估，发现模型排名、分数可靠性与筛查性能均无法在队列、提示词、负样本谱、患病率与阈值变化下稳健保持。
AI.motivation: 医学模型基准分数不能证明同一结论在其他评估设定下仍然成立；作者希望检验关于模型排名、分数可靠性与筛查性能的论断能否在队列、提示词、负样本谱、指定患病率与操作阈值变化下保持稳定。
AI.method: 审计BioMedCLIP、CheXficient、MedSigLIP三个医学视觉语言模型及通用域对照OpenCLIP，使用Montgomery、Shenzhen、TBX11K、VinDr-CXR四个数据集的12200份胸片记录；构建5个固定提示词族，生成244000个模型-图像-提示词分数；进行多重性控制的AUROC比较、替换负样本对照、阈值迁移测试，并以五种子监督源模型验证外部泛化。
AI.result: 无模型在所有队列与可靠性标准上领先；提示词族变化在48个多重性控制比较中有21个改变AUROC；将健康对照替换为患病非结核对照使四模型AUROC下降0.075–0.306；VinDr-CXR上三个医学模型对结核与无异常对照的区分显著优于对肺炎或肺肿瘤，对两种指定疾病的AUROC点估计均低于0.5；TBX11K训练集上按95%灵敏度选取的阈值在16个目标评估中仅4个按点估计保持该约束；监督源模型TBX11K验证AUROC为0.999，而两个外部队列均为0.629，保守剔除感知重叠候选可缩小但未消除差距。
AI.conclusion: 这些回顾性、单任务结果表明，判别能力、分数可靠性与阈值保持支持不同的可移植性论断；胸片结核筛查的证据应明确完整的评估规范，而非仅凭checkpoint归因临床可移植性。

title: XCalib Depth-Guided Geometric Optimization for Dense Thermal-Visible Video Registration
summary: Image registration is a vital preprocessing step in multimodal perception tasks, including image fusion, object detection, and semantic segmentation. In Advanced Driver- Assistance Systems (ADAS), spatial misalignment between visible (RGB) and infrared (IR) cameras -caused by non-coincident optical axes and field-of-view differences- introduces non-uniform parallax and visual ghosting. Classical keypoint-based methods are restricted to global homographies that fail under dynamic depth, while unconstrained dense flow algorithms lack structural regularization and suffer from temporal instability. In this paper, we propose XCalib, an unsupervised dense thermal-visible registration framework that bridges this gap. Rather than serving as an absolute metric calibration tool, XCalib leverages virtual pinhole camera parameterization strictly as a geometric constraint space. By optimizing effective relative pose and intrinsics alongside predicted monocular metric depth, XCalib restricts the search space of spatial displacements to physically valid projection geometries. Our key contributions are: (1) a novel registration paradigm that uses camera parameterization as an implicit regularizer for dense cross-modal warping; (2) Normalized Edges Correlation (NEC), a robust structural similarity metric tailored to cross- spectral alignment; and (3) extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations across public ADAS datasets, demonstrating superior temporal stability and alignment accuracy over unconstrained dense flow baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 XCalib——一种无监督的稠密热红外-可见光配准框架，将虚拟针孔相机参数化作为几何约束空间，结合单目度量深度优化相对位姿与内参，并引入归一化边缘相关性（NEC）度量，实现优于无约束稠密光流的对齐精度与时间稳定性。
AI.motivation: 在多模态感知任务（图像融合、目标检测、语义分割）中，图像配准是关键预处理步骤。ADAS 场景下可见光（RGB）与红外（IR）相机因光轴不重合、视场差异导致空间错位，产生非均匀视差与视觉重影。传统关键点方法受限于全局单应假设，在动态深度下失效；无约束稠密光流缺乏结构正则化，存在时间不稳定问题。因此需要一种兼具几何约束与稠密跨模态对齐能力的配准方法。
AI.method: 提出 XCalib 无监督稠密热红外-可见光配准框架。其核心是将虚拟针孔相机参数化严格作为几何约束空间而非绝对度量标定工具：通过优化有效相对位姿与相机内参，并结合预测的单目度量深度，将空间位移的搜索空间限制在物理有效的投影几何范围内，从而以相机参数化作为稠密跨模态形变的隐式正则化。同时提出归一化边缘相关性（NEC），一种面向跨光谱对齐的鲁棒结构相似性度量。
AI.result: 在多个公开 ADAS 数据集上进行了广泛的定量与定性评估，结果表明 XCalib 在时间稳定性与对齐精度上均优于无约束稠密光流基线方法。
AI.conclusion: XCalib 通过将相机参数化用作稠密跨模态形变的隐式正则化，弥合了全局单应方法与无约束稠密光流之间的鸿沟，配合 NEC 度量，为 ADAS 热红外-可见光配准提供了更稳定、更精确的无监督解决方案。

title: PointLAM: Local Attentive Mamba for Efficient Point-based 3D Object Detection
summary: 3D object detection from LiDAR point clouds faces a fundamental dilemma: voxel-based methods achieve efficiency at the cost of geometric quantization, while point-based methods preserve fidelity but suffer from prohibitive computational bottlenecks. Specifically, point-based architectures are crippled by slow downsampling strategies (e.g., FPS) and expensive dynamic neighbor queries (e.g., k-NN) coupled with costly continuous interactions. To tackle these systemic inefficiencies, we propose PointLAM, a highly efficient and powerful point-based architecture driven by two synergistic innovations. First, to resolve the downsampling bottleneck, we develop the Laplacian Point Sampler (LPS). LPS employs an implicit discrete Laplacian high-pass filter and Doubly Sorted Sampling to achieve fast, structure-aware foreground preservation. Second, to overcome local modeling latency, we design the Local Hadamard Aggregator (LHA). LHA decouples spatial indexing from feature representation using transient grids, and replaces complex continuous interactions with a Hadamard Gating mechanism for topology-aware, attentive modulation. By coupling this local gating with Bi-Directional Mamba (BDM) layers for global sequence modeling, we formulate the Local Attentive Mamba (LAM) block. Powered by this architecture, PointLAM achieves competitive performance on nuScenes and Waymo for point-based detectors. It rivals highly optimized voxel competitors while requiring a fraction of the computational footprint, demonstrating marked superiority in detecting small instances and handling extreme sparsity. Project page: https://pointlam.github.io/.

AI.tldr: PointLAM 是一种高效的纯点云 3D 检测架构，通过 Laplacian Point Sampler (LPS) 和 Local Hadamard Aggregator (LHA) 两项创新，分别解决下采样瓶颈与局部建模延迟，结合双向 Mamba 构成 Local Attentive Mamba (LAM) 模块，在 nuScenes 与 Waymo 上以极低计算代价取得与体素方法竞争的性能。
AI.motivation: LiDAR 3D 检测存在根本性两难：体素方法效率高但牺牲几何量化精度，点云方法保真度高却受限于计算瓶颈。点云架构具体受制于缓慢的下采样策略（如 FPS）和高代价的动态近邻查询（如 k-NN）以及昂贵的连续交互，亟需系统性解决这些低效问题。
AI.method: 提出 PointLAM 架构，包含两项协同创新：1) Laplacian Point Sampler (LPS)，利用隐式离散拉普拉斯高通滤波与双排序采样 (Doubly Sorted Sampling)，实现快速、结构感知的前景保留；2) Local Hadamard Aggregator (LHA)，用瞬态网格将空间索引与特征表示解耦，并以 Hadamard Gating 机制替代复杂连续交互，实现拓扑感知的注意力调制。将局部门控与双向 Mamba (BDM) 层耦合进行全局序列建模，构成 Local Attentive Mamba (LAM) 模块。
AI.result: 在 nuScenes 和 Waymo 数据集上，PointLAM 在纯点云检测器中达到有竞争力的性能，可与高度优化的体素方法相媲美，同时仅需其一小部分计算量，并在小目标检测和极端稀疏场景下表现出明显优势。
AI.conclusion: PointLAM 通过 LPS 与 LHA 两项创新有效缓解了点云方法的下采样与局部建模瓶颈，结合 BDM 全局建模，验证了高效纯点云架构的可行性，在精度与效率间取得良好平衡，尤其擅长小实例检测与稀疏场景。

title: A Principled Approach to Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
summary: Traditional unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) methods are designed to flag or localise deviations from a normative distribution, ignoring the underlying generative mechanisms of the anomalies. Yet the nature of an anomaly is often as important as its presence. We reformulate UAD as a Bayesian inverse problem, in which the objective is to infer the most probable corruption responsible for each observation. Our framework yields a probabilistic anomaly score as the energy of the inferred corruption parameters, and serves as a principled recipe for developing new UAD algorithms. We derive several existing methods as instances of the general framework, each corresponding to the same energy score under different modelling choices. Experimentally, we study the framework's components in a controlled setting, and improve object-class AUROC on the MVTec AD dataset by 2.3% by adapting the underlying corruption model. Finally, we validate the framework on a brain MRI benchmark, achieving strong detection performance while producing estimates of pathology intensity, bias, and geometry. Code is available at https://github.com/jgmyles/inverse-uad.

AI.tldr: 本文将无监督异常检测(UAD)重构为贝叶斯逆问题,推断导致观测的最可能损坏,并以推断出的损坏参数能量作为概率性异常分数,统一了若干现有方法,并在MVTec AD与脑MRI基准上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 传统UAD方法只关注偏离正常分布的标志或定位,忽略了异常本身的生成机制;而异常的性质与其存在同样重要。
AI.method: 将UAD建模为贝叶斯逆问题,推断每次观测对应的最可能损坏(corruption);以所推断损坏参数的能量作为概率性异常分数,并作为开发新UAD算法的通用范式。通过不同建模选择,可导出多种现有方法为同一能量分数下的实例。
AI.result: 在受控环境下研究框架各组件;通过调整底层损坏模型,在MVTec AD数据集上目标类别AUROC提升2.3%;在脑MRI基准上取得较强检测性能,同时给出病理强度、偏置和几何的估计。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯逆问题框架为UAD提供了原则性范式,既能给出异常分数,又能刻画异常的生成机制,统一既有方法并具备实际改进与可迁移性。

title: VideoReloc: Long-Term Indoor Video Relocalization against a Kilobyte-Scale Semantic Scene Graph
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://videoreloc.github.io
summary: Given a compact semantic scene graph, long-term indoor video relocalization estimates a map-frame trajectory after lighting and furniture changes. Visual methods rely on appearance and become unreliable under these changes; localizing one frame at a time from object classes and geometry instead leaves sparse, ambiguous evidence. We introduce VideoReloc, whose adaptive clips use odometry to gather spatial evidence until object and motion criteria are met, adapting query length to the observed scene. Its run-level decision rechecks conflicting placements using evidence accumulated across connected clips, stabilizing the trajectory beyond adjacent-clip tracking. Hypothesis-first registration proposes poses from object triplets and verifies each using clip-wide object centers and box surfaces. Orientation-aware refinement uses box faces, gravity and wall directions to resolve ambiguity in camera orientation and refine the full pose. This reframes sparse-map relocalization as verification of spatially extended video queries, moving discriminative support from stored appearance to temporal context and permitting a 100 kB map of class-labelled boxes. On RIO10 and ReplicaCAD, the all-frame localization success rate at 1 m/10$^\circ$ is 73.5% and 61.1% under causal evaluation, rising to 90.6% and 74.8% with clip closure. The evaluated per-frame scene coordinate regressors reach up to 47.6% and 49.8%, respectively, with maps of 12.6-42 MB. Project page: https://videoreloc.github.io

AI.tldr: VideoReloc 将长期室内视频重定位重新表述为对空间扩展视频查询的验证，通过对齐里程计生成自适应片段并提出假设优先的配准，仅需 100 kB 的类别标注框地图，在 RIO10 与 ReplicaCAD 上取得 73.5%/61.1% 的因果评估成功率。
AI.motivation: 长期室内场景中存在光照与家具变化，基于外观的视觉定位方法不可靠；而逐帧依靠物体类别与几何进行定位又导致证据稀疏、存在歧义。作者希望将判别依据从存储的外观转移到时间上下文中，从而支持极轻量级的语义地图。
AI.method: VideoReloc 包含三部分：(1) 自适应片段，利用里程计累积空间证据，直到满足物体与运动判据，使查询长度随场景自适应；(2) 片段级决策，在相连片段间累积证据，对冲突位姿进行复检，稳定轨迹；(3) 假设优先配准，由物体三元组提出候选位姿，并用片段范围的物体中心和框表面逐一验证；(4) 方向感知细化，利用框面、重力与墙面方向消解相机朝向歧义并精化完整位姿。
AI.result: 在 RIO10 和 ReplicaCAD 上，1 m/10° 的全帧定位成功率在因果评估下分别为 73.5% 和 61.1%，加入片段闭合后提升至 90.6% 和 74.8%。对比的逐帧场景坐标回归器仅达 47.6% 和 49.8%，且地图大小为 12.6–42 MB。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将稀疏地图重定位转化为对空间扩展视频查询的验证，用时间上下文替代存储外观作为判别支撑，在仅 100 kB 的类别标注框地图下显著优于逐帧场景坐标回归方法。

title: Object Detection Benchmarks are Incomplete: The Role of Label Errors and Annotation Uncertainty
summary: While object detection has advanced through improved architectures and open-vocabulary models, we provide strong evidence that benchmark quality is limited by annotation incompleteness. Across four widely used datasets (COCO, Pascal VOC, Cityscapes, KITTI), re-annotation reveals substantial increases in annotated objects (e.g., up to +60% on KITTI and +40% on COCO), driven primarily by previously unlabeled small, occluded, or densely packed instances. While some differences arise from dataset-specific annotation conventions, we consistently find that missing annotations are the main source of label errors across all datasets. To achieve high data quality, we introduce a scalable annotation pipeline that emphasizes high recall and captures ambiguity through soft labels aggregated from at least 11 annotators per object. The resulting annotations improve coverage and align well with human calibration. We show that benchmark performance is highly sensitive to annotation quality, although model rankings remain largely stable. We introduce two large-scale benchmarks: (i) an uncertainty-aware object detection benchmark, and (ii) a label error detection benchmark grounded in real label errors. We show that current detectors are strongly depended on annotation quality and are misaligned with human perception. Current label error detection methods, which have been shown to perform well on synthetic noise, struggle to achieve high recall and precision on real label errors. Our results highlight the need for future object detection benchmarks to move beyond deterministic annotations toward high-recall, uncertainty-aware evaluation that maximizes valid instances and better reflects real-world ambiguity.

AI.tldr: 论文指出目标检测基准的质量瓶颈在于标注不完整而非架构，重新标注四大数据集发现漏标显著，提出高召回+软标签的标注流程，并构建两个大规模基准，表明现有检测器与标签错误检测方法在真实标注误差下表现受限。
AI.motivation: 目标检测虽在架构与开放词汇模型上取得进展，但基准质量受标注不完整制约；现有标注多为确定性且遗漏大量小目标、遮挡与密集实例，导致评估与人类感知不一致。
AI.method: 对 COCO、Pascal VOC、Cityscapes、KITTI 四个常用数据集进行重新标注，量化漏标与标签错误来源；提出可扩展标注流程，强调高召回，并通过每目标至少 11 名标注者聚合的软标签刻画歧义；据此构建两个大规模基准：不确定性感知目标检测基准与基于真实标签错误的错误检测基准。
AI.result: 重新标注使标注目标数量显著增加（KITTI 最高 +60%，COCO +40%），主要来自此前未标注的小、遮挡或密集实例；缺失标注是所有数据集中标签错误的主要来源。基准性能对标注质量高度敏感，但模型排名大体稳定；当前检测器高度依赖标注质量且与人类感知不一致；现有标签错误检测方法虽在合成噪声上表现良好，但在真实标签错误上召回率与精确率较低。
AI.conclusion: 未来目标检测基准应超越确定性标注，转向高召回、不确定性感知的评估方式，以最大化有效实例并更好地反映真实世界的歧义性。

title: Morphology-Aware Ambiguity Learning for Wafer Defect Decision Support
summary: Wafer map defect recognition is commonly formulated as a fixed-taxonomy classification problem that assigns each wafer to a single defect class. However, some wafers exhibit morphologies near class boundaries, for which forcing a single prediction may be less informative than providing plausible diagnostic alternatives. This paper proposes a morphology-aware ambiguity learning framework that supports three diagnostic actions: automatic single-class diagnosis, assisted diagnosis with two plausible defect classes, and full review. Using the radial, angular, and geometric characteristics of training wafer maps, the framework constructs a class-level ambiguity matrix representing defect-class pairs with similar morphology and plausible diagnostic alternatives. It guides the model to learn plausible alternative classes rather than treating all incorrect classes equally. During inference, the matrix determines whether an uncertain prediction can be represented by a meaningful two-class diagnostic set or should be escalated for full review. Experiments on WM-811K show that the proposed framework outperforms conventional approaches in defect recognition and diagnostic decision support, providing meaningful two-class alternatives while reserving full review for cases with unresolved ambiguity. Illustrative cost analyses further show the potential cost advantage of the proposed routing strategy. The diagnostic behavior of the framework remains consistent across different backbone architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出形态学感知的模糊性学习框架，将晶圆图缺陷识别从固定分类转为支持单类诊断、双类辅助诊断与全复核三种动作。
AI.motivation: 传统晶圆图缺陷识别把每片晶圆强制归为单一缺陷类别，但部分晶圆形态处于类别边界附近，单一预测信息量不足，需要提供合理的替代诊断选项。
AI.method: 利用训练晶圆图的径向、角度与几何特征构建类别级模糊矩阵，表示形态相似、可作为替代诊断的缺陷类别对；据此引导模型学习合理的替代类而非等价看待所有错误类；推理时由该矩阵判断不确定预测能否用有意义的两类诊断集合表示，否则升级为全复核。
AI.result: 在WM-811K上，该框架在缺陷识别与诊断决策支持方面优于常规方法，能给出有意义的两类替代方案，并将全复核保留给模糊性未解决的样本；示例性成本分析显示该路由策略具有潜在成本优势；诊断行为在不同骨干网络上保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 形态学感知的模糊性学习框架可有效支持分级诊断决策，兼顾识别性能与成本，且不依赖特定骨干架构。

title: Chronosphere: Space-Time Tessellation of Local Climate Experts
summary: We introduce Chronosphere, a spatio-temporal neural field that learns representations of climate. A central challenge in geographic representation learning is modeling environmental processes whose spatial and temporal complexity varies widely. Yet existing location encoders typically fix a single level of detail everywhere. Global bases such as spherical harmonics spread capacity uniformly across space and time. Localized bases resolve only predefined regions. Learned tessellations adapt, but are inefficient at representing higher frequencies. Chronosphere unifies these approaches, pairing an adaptive tessellation of learnable sites on the spacetime torus $S^2\times S^1$ with a shared bank of local basis functions. Both where capacity is placed and how much detail each region carries adapt to the data, across space and time. Trained to reconstruct climatology, Chronosphere matches or leads state-of-the-art location encoders across spatial and temporal tasks, with the largest gains under spatial and temporal transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Chronosphere，一种在时空环面 S^2×S^1 上自适应部署可学习站点并共享局部基函数的时空神经场，用于气候表征学习，在空间/时间任务及迁移场景下达到或超越现有位置编码器。
AI.motivation: 地理表征学习的核心难点在于环境过程的时空复杂度差异极大，而现有位置编码器普遍在所有位置固定单一细节层级：全球基（如球谐函数）在时空上均匀分配容量，局部基只能覆盖预定义区域，学习型镶嵌虽能自适应但对高频表征效率低。
AI.method: Chronosphere 统一上述思路，将时空环面 S^2×S^1 上的可学习站点自适应镶嵌与共享的局部基函数库相结合，使容量放置位置与各区域细节量均随数据在空间和时间上自适应调整，并以重建气候态为训练目标。
AI.result: 在空间与时间任务上，Chronosphere 达到或领先当前最先进的位置编码器，且在空间与时间迁移场景下增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 自适应时空镶嵌配合共享局部基函数能够有效解决固定细节层级编码器的容量分配问题，提升气候表征的精度与泛化能力。

title: Benchmarking the Explanatory Quality of Open-Weight Vision-Language Models in Face Recognition
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have recently been proposed as promising tools for face recognition, as they can produce natural language explanations alongside similarity scores. This capability is considered appealing for face comparisons in forensic contexts, which require decisions to be transparent and auditable. However, existing evaluations of VLMs for that use case focus mostly on recognition accuracy, while the validity of generated explanations remains unquantified. In this work, we introduce a benchmarking framework for VLM-based face recognition that treats explanation quality as a core evaluation axis. We propose two criteria that explanations should satisfy: relevance, i.e., reliance on identity-stable facial features; and faithfulness, i.e., alignment with the visible image content without hallucinated features. We jointly develop a methodology enabling the quantification of relevance and faithfulness of evaluated models, based on constraining model outputs to a structured explanation format that supports automated querying and auditing. Using this framework, we benchmark several families of open-weight VLMs, jointly evaluating face verification accuracy and explanation quality. Our results highlight remaining shortcomings of produced explanations, and emphasize the need for such explanation quality metrics to get a complete picture of model performance. The proposed benchmark and open-source evaluation harness provide a foundation for proper benchmarking and future fine-tuning of explainable face recognition systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向VLM人脸识别的基准框架，将"解释质量"作为核心评估维度，定义相关性（依赖身份稳定的面部特征）与忠实性（与可见图像内容一致、无幻觉特征）两项标准，并通过结构化解释格式实现自动化量化。对多个开放权重VLM家族同时评估人脸验证准确率与解释质量，揭示现有解释的不足。
AI.motivation: VLM可同时输出相似度分数与自然语言解释，被视为司法等取证场景人脸比对的有力工具，因为此类场景要求决策透明、可审计。但现有评估多聚焦识别准确率，对生成解释的有效性缺乏量化，无法判断解释是否真正支撑可审计性。
AI.method: 构建VLM人脸识别的基准测试框架，把解释质量作为核心评估轴。提出解释应满足的两项准则：相关性（依赖身份稳定的面部特征）与忠实性（与可见图像内容对齐、不含幻觉特征）。设计量化方法，通过将模型输出约束为结构化解释格式，支持自动化查询与审计。据此对多个开放权重VLM家族进行基准测试，联合评估人脸验证准确率与解释质量。
AI.result: 联合评估人脸验证准确率与解释质量后，结果暴露出所生成解释仍存在明显缺陷，说明仅看准确率无法完整刻画模型性能，解释质量指标具有必要性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基准与开源评估工具为可解释人脸识别系统的规范化基准测试及后续微调奠定了基础。

title: Catena: A Comprehensive Software Suite for Large-Scale Connectomics
summary: The gold standard datasets for mapping connectomes are electron microscopy volumes of densely labeled neural tissue at nanometer resolution. Yet reconstructing and proofreading neuronal arbors and annotating all synapses requires pipelining multiple software tools that are often fragmented, inconsistently maintained, or proprietary, hindering reproducibility and automation. Here, we introduce Catena, an open-source, comprehensive, developer-centric software suite for connectomics that integrates modules for 3D neuron and organelle segmentation, synapse detection, microtubule tracking, and neurotransmitter inference. Catena organizes its modules in composable, chunk-wise processing pipelines in a completely documented, extensible, and adaptable design. We further reduce compute and ground-truth data requirements with pretrained machine learning models, facilitating fine-tuning. Catena ships fully containerized modules that encapsulate evolving dependencies for consistent execution across workstations and clusters. By consolidating open components, shareable models, and containerized runtimes, Catena delivers a reproducible and scalable approach to mapping cellular connectomes from electron microscopy volumes. Code and documentation: https://github.com/Mohinta2892/catena.git

AI.tldr: Catena是一个面向连接组学的开源、开发者中心型软件套件，通过集成分割、突触检测、微管追踪与神经递质推断等模块，并采用可组合的分块流水线与容器化部署，实现电子显微镜体数据的可复现、可扩展连接组重建。
AI.motivation: 电子显微镜密集标注神经组织的体数据是连接组映射的金标准，但神经元树突/轴突重建、校对及突触标注依赖多个软件工具，这些工具往往碎片化、维护不一致或为专有软件，阻碍了可复现性与自动化。作者意在整合这些分散组件，提供统一的开源解决方案。
AI.method: 提出Catena软件套件，包含3D神经元与细胞器分割、突触检测、微管追踪、神经递质推断等模块；模块组织为可组合的分块（chunk-wise）处理流水线，设计完全文档化、可扩展、可适配；通过预训练机器学习模型降低计算与标注数据需求并支持微调；模块完全容器化以封装依赖，保证跨工作站与集群的一致执行。
AI.result: Catena整合了开放组件、可共享模型与容器化运行环境，提供从电子显微镜体数据映射细胞连接组的可复现且可扩展的方法；代码与文档见 https://github.com/Mohinta2892/catena.git。
AI.conclusion: Catena以开源、模块化、容器化和预训练模型为核心，弥补了现有连接组学工具碎片化、难复现的缺陷，为电子显微镜连接组重建提供了可复现、可扩展的统一软件框架。

title: The Role of Radiometric Features in Cross-Site Leaf-Wood Segmentation of LiDAR Point Clouds
comment: 5 pages, 6 figures. Accepted for presentation at IGARSS 2026 (IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium)
summary: Leaf-wood segmentation of individual trees from LiDAR point clouds is essential for quantitative structure models (QSMs) used in non-destructive biomass estimation. Existing segmentation methods typically exclude radiometric features (e.g., intensity, return number) to maximize cross-sensor compatibility. We challenge this design choice by evaluating cross-site and cross-platform generalization: training on the public Heidelberg dataset (terrestrial TLS, 1550nm) and testing on a novel dataset from Ontario, Canada (RPA-LS, 905nm). Results show that geometry-only methods - including state-of-the-art deep learning models trained on high-density LiDAR datasets - fail to generalize to the sparse, top-down geometry of aerial scans, achieving F1 scores <= 0.56. Incorporating radiometric features (intensity, return number, number of returns) improves F1 to 0.61, but more critically, increases wood recall by 119% from 0.16 to 0.35. Furthermore, geometry-only approaches often result in fragmented stem and branch components. We find that leveraging radiometric features preserves greater structural connectivity, resulting in more coherent architectures that are better suited for QSM reconstruction. We demonstrate that while geometric patterns are view-dependent and prone to overfitting scan patterns, radiometric features encode physical material properties that generalize across disparate sensors and environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了现有单木枝叶分割方法为跨传感器兼容性而舍弃辐射特征的做法。通过在Heidelberg（TLS, 1550nm）训练、在加拿大安大略新数据集（RPA-LS, 905nm）测试的跨站点、跨平台实验证明：仅依赖几何特征（包括高密度LiDAR训练的SOTA深度学习模型）在稀疏、俯视的航空扫描几何下泛化失败（F1≤0.56）；引入辐射特征（强度、回波次数、回波数量）将F1提升至0.61，并将木质召回率从0.16提高到0.35（提升119%），同时保持更强的结构连通性，更适合QSM重建。
AI.motivation: 单木枝叶分割是定量结构模型（QSM）与非破坏性生物量估算的关键步骤。现有方法普遍剔除辐射特征（强度、回波数等）以追求跨传感器兼容性。本文质疑这一设计选择，旨在验证辐射特征在跨站点、跨平台泛化中的实际价值，以及几何特征因视角依赖而易过拟合扫描模式的局限性。
AI.method: 采用跨站点、跨平台泛化评估：在公开Heidelberg数据集（地基TLS，1550nm，高密度）上训练，在一份来自加拿大安大略省的新数据集（RPA-LS，905nm，稀疏、俯视的航空扫描几何）上测试。对比仅几何特征方法与引入辐射特征（intensity、return number、number of returns）的方法，并分析分割结果的结构连通性与碎片化程度。
AI.result: 仅几何特征方法（含高密度LiDAR训练的SOTA深度学习模型）无法泛化到稀疏、俯视的航空扫描几何，F1≤0.56；加入辐射特征后F1提升至0.61；更关键的是木质召回率由0.16提升至0.35，增幅119%。此外，仅几何方法常导致茎干与枝条组件破碎，而辐射特征能保持更强的结构连通性，得到更连贯的架构，更利于QSM重建。
AI.conclusion: 几何模式具有视角依赖性，易过拟合扫描模式；而辐射特征编码了物理材质属性，能够在不同传感器与环境间泛化。因此，在单木枝叶分割及QSM重建中应重新纳入辐射特征，而非为跨传感器兼容性而舍弃它们。

title: Info3R: Information-Adaptive Test-Time Training for 3D Reconstruction
summary: Transformer-based models have recently achieved strong performance on 3D reconstruction from images, and recent works extend them to process video streams in an online manner for real-world deployment. However, existing methods overlook two key signals when handling long image streams: the importance of each incoming frame and the information saturation of the model's internal state. In this paper, we propose Info3R, a novel information-adaptive test-time training method for the online 3D reconstruction. We introduce an information-aware state update that modulates the state update strength based on the redundancy and informativeness of each incoming frame. To restore the state's plasticity -- its capacity to incorporate new observations -- we propose a dynamic state reset, triggered by the cumulative magnitude of state updates and the model's prediction confidence and accompanied by an anchor-to-world alignment. Our method achieves consistent improvements on camera pose estimation, video depth estimation, and 3D reconstruction, while substantially mitigating the performance degradation in the long sequence evaluation. Notably, on KITTI Odometry, our method achieves on average 1.68x lower ATE than LongStream, demonstrating its robustness on extended outdoor sequences.

AI.tldr: 提出 Info3R，一种信息自适应的在线 3D 重建测试时训练方法，通过信息感知状态更新与动态状态重置缓解长序列性能退化。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 Transformer 的在线 3D 重建方法在处理长图像流时忽略两个关键信号：每个输入帧的重要性，以及模型内部状态的信息饱和问题，导致长序列性能退化。
AI.method: 引入信息感知状态更新，依据输入帧的冗余度与信息量调节状态更新强度；提出动态状态重置，由状态更新的累积幅度与模型预测置信度触发，并配合锚点到世界坐标的对齐。
AI.result: 在相机位姿估计、视频深度估计和 3D 重建上取得一致提升，显著缓解长序列评估中的性能退化；在 KITTI Odometry 上，ATE 平均比 LongStream 低 1.68 倍。
AI.conclusion: Info3R 通过信息自适应测试时训练有效提升在线 3D 重建在长序列上的鲁棒性，尤其适用于扩展的户外序列场景。

title: PRIME: Perception Feedback with Situational Memory Embeddings in VLA Models
summary: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving operate primarily through feedforward inference across the perception--reasoning--planning hierarchy. While modern architectures maintain temporal recurrence within the perceptual module, early perception remains blind to downstream reasoning and navigation goals, processing visual inputs agnostically without prioritizing cues informed by prior decisions. To bridge this gap, this paper introduces PRIME, a learned feedback mechanism that conditions the VLA perceptual queries on a novel Situational Memory. By aggregating latent representations of past perception, reasoning, navigation goals, and predicted behaviors across an L-step window via cross-attention, PRIME enables intent-driven perceptual attention at minimal computational cost, adding only a maximum of 29.7M parameters (0.41% of the 7.3B-parameter base model). Evaluated on the Bench2Drive closed-loop benchmark, PRIME achieves a state-of-the-art Driving Score of 82.47 (+4.73 over ORION) and a Success Rate of 60.00% (+5.38 percentage points), the highest reported Driving Score among published VLAs trained on Think2Drive demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PRIME，一种学习式反馈机制，通过情境记忆将导航目标与推理信息注入感知查询，实现意图驱动的感知注意力，参数增量极小（0.41%），在Bench2Drive闭环基准上取得SOTA驾驶得分82.47与60.00%成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶VLA模型主要采用感知—推理—规划的前馈推理范式。虽然现代架构在感知模块内保留时序递归，但早期感知对下游推理与导航目标"视而不见"，处理视觉输入时缺乏目标导向，无法优先关注由先前决策所提示的关键线索，形成感知与决策目标之间的割裂。
AI.method: 提出PRIME——一种学习式反馈机制。构建"情境记忆"（Situational Memory），通过交叉注意力聚合过去L步窗口内感知、推理、导航目标与预测行为的潜在表示，并以此条件化VLA的感知查询，从而以极小计算开销实现意图驱动的感知注意力。额外参数最多29.7M，仅占7.3B基础模型的0.41%。
AI.result: 在Bench2Drive闭环基准上，驾驶得分（Driving Score）达82.47，较ORION提升4.73；成功率（Success Rate）达60.00%，提升5.38个百分点。该得分为已发表、基于Think2Drive示范训练的VLA中最高。
AI.conclusion: PRIME通过情境记忆将下游推理与导航意图反馈至早期感知，有效弥合前馈VLA中感知与决策目标间的鸿沟，以极低的参数与计算代价显著提升闭环驾驶性能，验证了意图驱动感知注意力的有效性与高效性。

title: Traffic Sign Recognition for Autonomous Driving Using Branched YOLOv2 and Geometric Features
summary: Traffic sign recognition (TSR) is an important perception task for autonomous driving and advanced driver-assistance systems, where a system must both localize traffic signs and determine their semantic classes efficiently. This work presents a TSR system based on YOLOv2 for simultaneous detection and classification. Two complementary modifications are studied. First, YOLOv2 is extended with intermediate prediction layers, forming a branched architecture that can terminate inference early for easy cases and reduce computation time. Both whole-image and cell-wise branching strategies are investigated. Second, geometric information is introduced to reduce classification errors between visually similar signs. An unsupervised Bayesian image-segmentation method produces binary representations that are compared with class-specific geometric templates inside YOLOv2 bounding boxes. This information is used either during inference or as an additional signal during training. A dedicated dataset is constructed by combining GTSDB and GTSRB samples using seamless cloning and controlled image transformations. Experiments cover ten traffic-sign classes, with 3,000 training and 300 test samples. The selected branched architecture reports 0.647 s runtime and 0.680 mAP, compared with 0.6607 s and 0.680 mAP for baseline YOLOv2. Geometric verification during inference increases mAP to 0.713, while the geometric-feature training variant achieves 0.697 mAP with a reported runtime of 0.6608 s.

AI.tldr: 基于YOLOv2的交通标志检测与分类系统，通过分支预测层实现早期退出以降低计算量，并引入无监督贝叶斯分割得到的几何信息以减少相似标志的分类错误。
AI.motivation: 交通标志识别需同时完成标志定位与语义分类，且要求高效；现有方法在易样本上计算冗余，且视觉相似标志易被误分类。
AI.method: 以YOLOv2为基干，做两类改进：(1) 增加中间预测层构成分支架构，支持整图与按单元格分支策略，易例可提前终止推理；(2) 用无监督贝叶斯图像分割生成二值表示，在YOLOv2边界框内与类别几何模板比对，可在推理阶段使用或作为训练附加信号。数据由GTSDB与GTSRB经无缝克隆与受控图像变换合成。
AI.result: 10类交通标志、3000训练/300测试样本。选定分支架构运行时0.647 s、mAP 0.680；基线YOLOv2为0.6607 s、mAP 0.680。推理阶段几何验证将mAP提升至0.713；几何特征训练变体mAP 0.697，运行时0.6608 s。
AI.conclusion: 分支架构可在不损失精度下缩短推理时间，几何信息（尤其推理阶段验证）能显著提升mAP，但训练变体收益较小且略增开销。

title: OmniVBench: A Benchmark and Large-Scale Dataset for Omni Reference-to-Video Generation
summary: Reference-to-video (R2V) generation is evolving toward increasingly general and versatile reference control, giving rise to the emerging paradigm of omni R2V generation. However, existing benchmarks fall short of these emerging capabilities: their test cases cover limited reference types and compositions, and their evaluation protocols largely assess holistic reference consistency, overlooking whether reference factors are properly preserved, disentangled, and routed. Meanwhile, the high cost of constructing omni R2V training data makes suitable training resources scarce. To address these gaps, we introduce OmniVBench and the Omni-R2V Dataset for evaluating and training omni R2V models. OmniVBench expands R2V evaluation across broader reference types, fine-grained control tasks, and richer reference compositions, covering 7 task families and 18 fine-grained tasks spanning content, motion, style, structure, narrative, and multi-reference settings. We introduce factor-grounded evaluation with 12,172 case-specific checklist items, assessing whether intended reference factors are faithfully preserved, correctly disentangled and bound to their targets, and properly realized according to the instruction. We further introduce the Omni-R2V Dataset, bringing industrial-grade training resources for diverse R2V tasks to the broader research community. Drawing primarily on a large-scale corpus of professional video footage, it comprises 340K processed training samples spanning diverse reference types and multi-reference compositions. We develop task-specific pipelines for reference-target pair construction, offering a practical and scalable recipe for omni R2V data construction. Extensive evaluation of advanced open- and closed-source R2V models reveals clear performance gaps across task families and evaluation dimensions on OmniVBench, highlighting remaining limitations of current R2V models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OmniVBench基准与Omni-R2V数据集，以评估和训练全能参考到视频（omni R2V）生成模型。
AI.motivation: 现有R2V基准测试的参考类型与组合有限，评估协议多针对整体参考一致性，忽视了参考因子是否被正确保留、解耦与路由；同时全能R2V训练数据构建成本高、资源稀缺。
AI.method: 构建OmniVBench，覆盖7个任务族、18个细粒度任务，涵盖内容、运动、风格、结构、叙事与多参考设置，并引入基于因子的评估，含12,172条案例特定清单项；同时构建Omni-R2V数据集，基于大规模专业视频语料，含340K处理后的训练样本，并提供任务特定的参考-目标配对构建流程。
AI.result: 对先进开源与闭源R2V模型的广泛评估显示，各任务族与评估维度上存在明显性能差距，揭示当前模型的局限。
AI.conclusion: OmniVBench与Omni-R2V数据集为全能R2V生成提供了更全面的评估与可扩展的训练资源，推动该领域发展。

title: MintAct: A Unified Visual Agent for Digital Environments
summary: We present MintAct, a family of vision-language models that unifies UI grounding, multi-step navigation across mobile, desktop, and web, and visual tool use, trained at 2B, 4B, and 8B scales. Through careful design of our environments, data, and training recipes, MintAct models match the performance of per-domain specialists across all of these capabilities. To enable this, we develop a scalable environment and reinforcement learning (RL) infrastructure. On the environment side, we host hundreds of concurrent instances across heterogeneous per-domain backends, serving both trajectory data collection and online RL. To enable efficient and scalable RL training, an asynchronous framework keeps explicit control over the cross-domain training distribution and remains stable under noisy environment feedback and off-policy drift. Experimental results show that MintAct achieves state-of-the-art performance (48.9 on OSWorld-Verified) across a wide range of benchmarks at comparable model sizes.

AI.tldr: MintAct 是一系列 2B/4B/8B 规模的视觉-语言模型，统一了 UI grounding、跨移动/桌面/Web 的多步导航与视觉工具使用，性能匹敌各领域专用模型，并在 OSWorld-Verified 上取得 48.9 的 SOTA 成绩。
AI.motivation: 现有 UI 智能体能力通常由各领域专用模型分别实现，缺乏统一的跨移动、桌面、Web 的多能力模型；同时训练此类模型需要可扩展的环境与 RL 基础设施来支撑大规模轨迹采集与在线训练。
AI.method: 统一训练 UI grounding、多步导航、视觉工具使用三类能力，覆盖 2B/4B/8B 规模；精心设计环境、数据与训练配方；构建可扩展的环境与 RL 基础设施：托管跨异构领域后端的数百个并发实例，用于轨迹采集和在线 RL；采用异步 RL 框架，显式控制跨域训练数据分布，并在噪声环境反馈与 off-policy 漂移下保持稳定。
AI.result: MintAct 在可比模型规模下于广泛基准测试中达到 SOTA，其中 OSWorld-Verified 得分为 48.9，且在各能力上匹配领域专用模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一的环境、数据与训练配方以及可扩展的异步 RL 基础设施，单一模型家族可同时胜任 UI grounding、跨平台多步导航与视觉工具使用，无需为每个领域单独训练专用模型。

title: TALON: A Temporally Aware Longitudinal Framework for Radiology Report Generation
summary: Current radiology report generation (RRG) models usually produce descriptive reports based on a single examination or only the most recent prior examination, limiting their ability to perform accurate and meaningful longitudinal comparisons and detect subtle interval changes. Although recent approaches have begun to incorporate multiple prior examinations, they usually aggregate a fixed-length history without explicitly modeling the role-dependent relevance of each prior examination before fusion. To address this, we propose TALON, a Temporally Aware LONgitudinal RRG framework that adaptively integrates variable-length patient histories. The underlying Dual-Channel Temporal Fusion Module (DCTFM) compares the current examination with each prior examination through complementary similarity and change channels to capture persistent findings and interval changes, respectively. The specially designed channel-specific attention estimates the relevance of each prior examination, while a learned prior-specific gate adaptively integrates informative longitudinal evidence and suppresses redundancy. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR show that TALON outperforms the current state-of-the-art method on various clinical efficacy and graph-based metrics.
