When more prior examinations become available, TALON's performance on these metrics improves even further, emphasizing the strength of TALON's DCTFM in modeling longitudinal RRG across longer and more complex patient histories than existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出TALON框架，通过双通道时序融合模块自适应整合变长病史，提升纵向放射报告生成性能。
AI.motivation: 现有放射报告生成模型通常仅基于单次检查或最近一次既往检查，难以进行有效的纵向对比和细微间隔变化检测；已有尝试虽引入多次既往检查，但多采用固定长度历史聚合，未在融合前显式建模各既往检查的角色依赖相关性。
AI.method: TALON（Temporally Aware LONgitudinal RRG）框架，其核心为双通道时序融合模块（DCTFM）：通过互补的相似性通道与变化通道，将当前检查与每个既往检查进行对比，分别捕捉持续征象与间隔变化；并设计通道特定注意力估计各既往检查的相关性，配合可学习的既往特异性门控，自适应整合有信息的纵向证据并抑制冗余。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-CXR数据集上，TALON在多项临床效能指标与基于图的指标上优于当前最先进方法；当可用既往检查增多时，其性能进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: TALON的DCTFM在建模纵向RRG时能有效处理比现有方法更长、更复杂的患者病史，验证了自适应变长历史融合的优越性。

title: Curriculum-Based Noise Adaptation for Phoneme-to-Text Reconstruction in Visual Speech Recognition
comment: Submitted for journal publication and currently under consideration
summary: Phoneme-centric visual speech recognition reconstructs sentences from intermediate phoneme predictions, making overall recognition performance highly dependent on the robustness of the phoneme-to-text reconstruction model. Existing reconstruction approaches are commonly trained on clean phoneme sequences or synthetically corrupted inputs, leading to a mismatch between training conditions and the realistic phoneme prediction errors encountered during inference. To address this limitation, this paper proposes progressive error curriculum training (PECT). This curriculum learning framework progressively adapts a No Language Left Behind (NLLB)-based phoneme-to-text reconstruction model using synthetic phoneme perturbations, multi-domain pseudo-labels, and target-domain pseudo-labels generated by a visual speech recognizer. By gradually exposing the reconstruction model to increasingly realistic phoneme prediction errors, the proposed framework improves robustness while preserving sentence-reconstruction accuracy. Experiments on the LRS2 and LRS3 benchmarks demonstrate that PECT consistently improves reconstruction performance across multiple phoneme-based visual speech recognition frontends, including visual automatic speech recognition (V-ASR), point visual automatic speech recognition (PV-ASR), and head-pose-aware visual speech recognition (HP-VSR) variants. In particular, PECT reduces the word error rate (WER) of HP-VSR-FiLMFuse (L4) from 23.3% to 22.2% on LRS2 and reduces the WER of HP-VSR-ResFiLM from 30.3% to 29.7% on LRS3. Comprehensive ablation studies and qualitative analyses further demonstrate the effectiveness of progressively adapting the reconstruction model to realistic phoneme prediction errors. These results show that PECT provides an effective and generalizable curriculum learning strategy for phoneme-to-text reconstruction in phoneme-centric visual speech recognition.

AI.tldr: 提出渐进式错误课程训练（PECT），通过逐步引入愈发真实的音素预测错误来增强音素到文本重建模型的鲁棒性，从而提升音素中心视觉语音识别性能。
AI.motivation: 音素中心视觉语音识别的整体性能高度依赖音素到文本重建模型的鲁棒性。现有重建方法多基于干净音素序列或人工合成噪声训练，导致训练条件与推理时真实音素预测错误之间存在失配。
AI.method: 提出渐进式错误课程训练（PECT）课程学习框架，基于NLLB构建音素到文本重建模型，依次使用合成音素扰动、多域伪标签以及由视觉语音识别器生成的目标域伪标签，渐进式地让重建模型接触越来越真实的音素预测错误。
AI.result: 在LRS2与LRS3基准上，PECT对多种音素前端（V-ASR、PV-ASR、HP-VSR）均带来一致的性能提升：HP-VSR-FiLMFuse（L4）在LRS2上WER由23.3%降至22.2%；HP-VSR-ResFiLM在LRS3上WER由30.3%降至29.7%。消融实验与定性分析进一步验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PECT为音素中心视觉语音识别中的音素到文本重建提供了一种有效且可泛化的课程学习策略，通过渐进适应真实音素预测错误，在保持句子重建精度的同时提升鲁棒性。

title: MME-Safety: A Fine-grained Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of MLLMs
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show remarkable advancements, their cross-modal capabilities introduce complex vulnerabilities that easily bypass unimodal filters. Existing benchmarks lack fine-grained intent-related annotations and rely on unidimensional metrics, hindering comprehensive robustness evaluation. To address this, we propose MME-Safety, a rigorously verified benchmark featuring a unique four-dimensional annotation schema that categorizes risk scenarios, harm severity, and modality-specific stealth levels. Furthermore, we introduce a hierarchical evaluation framework to assess fundamental response reliability, actual risk exposure, and the structural integrity of defensive behaviors. Extensive zero-shot evaluations across 17 state-of-the-art MLLMs provide a comprehensive safety profile of current multimodal systems. Our analysis systematically investigates cross-modal input configurations and uncovers safety implications associated with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. These multifaceted findings underscore the urgent need for robust, reasoning-aware safety alignment in the multimodal landscape.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MME-Safety，一个具有四维标注体系（风险场景、危害严重度、模态特定隐蔽性等）的多模态大模型安全基准，并配套分层评估框架，对17个先进MLLM进行零样本评测，揭示跨模态输入配置与思维链推理的安全影响。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型的跨模态能力带来易绕过单模态过滤器的复合脆弱性；现有基准缺乏细粒度的意图相关标注，且依赖单一维度指标，难以全面评估鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出 MME-Safety 基准，包含经严格验证的四维标注范式，对风险场景、危害严重度及模态特定隐蔽水平进行分类；同时提出分层评估框架，从基础响应可靠性、实际风险暴露和防御行为结构性完整性三个层面进行评价。
AI.result: 对17个当前最先进 MLLM 进行广泛零样本评测，得到多模态系统安全画像；系统分析跨模态输入配置，并揭示与思维链（CoT）推理相关的安全影响。
AI.conclusion: 多维发现表明多模态场景亟需具备推理感知能力的安全对齐机制。

title: WM-VS: Progress-Aligned World Models for Closed-Loop Visual Servoing
summary: Closed-loop visual servoing requires predictions that indicate whether an action reduces task error, not only whether the action is plausible. We call this gap the prediction-control mismatch and introduce WM-VS, a target-centric progress-aligned world-model framework for closed-loop visual servoing. Offline target-region DINOv2 correspondences define a signed four-dimensional servo coordinate for translation, scale, and in-plane rotation. Stage 1 aligns action-conditioned latent transitions with this coordinate; Stage 2 freezes the world model and trains a reactive joint-velocity policy with action imitation, consequence supervision, and short imagined rollouts that favor error contraction. Deployment is RGB-only and reactive, without online trajectory optimization. On a real 7-DoF eye-to-hand system, WM-VS reaches a corner RMSE no larger than 10 percent of its initial value in 30/30 trials and retains this criterion at the final valid frame in 25/30 (83.33 percent). Removing future-error alignment reduces retention to 26.67 percent. The learned progress signal agrees with an external AprilTag corner error not used for training or control (mean Spearman rho = 0.8778). Without retraining, two unseen 3D targets achieve translation-error reductions of 86.48 percent and 90.27 percent and rotation-error reductions of 70.01 percent and 65.70 percent. These results link progress-aligned action consequences to repeated closed-loop correction and transfer. Code and data will be released as open source.

AI.tldr: 提出 WM-VS，面向闭环视觉伺服的目标中心、进度对齐世界模型框架，解决“预测-控制失配”问题。
AI.motivation: 闭环视觉伺服中，仅判断动作是否“合理”不足以保证任务误差收缩，需要预测动作是否真正减小任务误差；作者将此缺口称为预测-控制失配。
AI.method: 利用离线目标区域 DINOv2 对应关系定义平移、尺度和平面内旋转的四维带符号伺服坐标。第一阶段让动作条件潜变量转移与该坐标对齐；第二阶段冻结世界模型，训练反应式联合速度策略，结合动作模仿、后果监督和偏向误差收缩的短想象 rollout。部署仅用 RGB、反应式执行，无需在线轨迹优化。
AI.result: 真实 7-DoF 眼在手系统上，30/30 次试验角点 RMSE 达到不超过初值 10%，最终有效帧保留该标准 25/30（83.33%）；移除未来误差对齐后保留率降至 26.67%。学习到的进度信号与未用于训练/控制的 AprilTag 角点误差一致（Spearman rho 均值 0.8778）。不重训练时，两个未见 3D 目标平移误差分别降低 86.48% 和 90.27%，旋转误差降低 70.01% 和 65.70%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明显式对齐动作后果中的进度信号可支撑闭环反复修正与迁移；代码与数据将开源。

title: Do Spinning Radar Doppler Velocity Measurements Improve Vehicle Detection and Tracking?
summary: Spinning frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radars have been gaining popularity in autonomous vehicle perception on account of their robustness to adverse weather conditions and 360° field of view. Recently, scanning radars have also been shown capable of generating per-azimuth Doppler velocity. In this paper, we investigate whether these Doppler velocity measurements improve spinning radar vehicle detection and tracking performance. For detection, we estimate the ego motion and use it to undo the Doppler range distortion of the radar image before passing it to a network. For tracking, we propose a new way to estimate a per-vehicle velocity and use it as a prior for the tracker's motion model. Since Doppler-enabled spinning radar data is not available in any dataset with ground-truth dynamic object labels, our first contribution is an automatic labelling pipeline that uses an ensemble of fine-tuned off-the-shelf lidar detectors to label all 643 km of the Boreas Road Trip dataset. We then transfer detections to radar, and use over 250 km of vehicle-dense sequences as ground-truth training data. By training and evaluating two state-of-the-art detectors, we show that Doppler undistortion can improve detection accuracy by up to $2.37$ points on mean average precision. Furthermore, we show that the Doppler velocity prior can improve tracking accuracy by $13.68$ points on multi-object tracking accuracy (MOTA) versus the zero-velocity initialization baseline, while achieving $99.7\%$ of the MOTA obtained using ground-truth velocities as the prior.

AI.tldr: 本文研究旋转式FMCW雷达的多普勒速度测量能否提升车载检测与跟踪性能，通过自动标注管线构建数据，验证了多普勒去畸变可提升检测精度，多普勒速度先验可显著提升跟踪精度。
AI.motivation: 旋转式FMCW雷达因对恶劣天气鲁棒且具备360°视场，在自动驾驶感知中日益流行，且扫描雷达可生成逐方位多普勒速度。但现有带真值动态目标标签的数据集缺乏多普勒旋转雷达数据，因此作者希望探究这些多普勒速度测量是否能改善旋转雷达的车辆检测与跟踪性能。
AI.method: 检测方面：估计自车运动，用于消除雷达图像的多普勒距离畸变后再输入网络。跟踪方面：提出估计每辆车速度的新方法，并将其作为跟踪器运动模型的先验。为获得训练数据，作者提出自动标注管线，用集成微调的现成激光雷达检测器标注Boreas Road Trip数据集的全部643 km数据，再将检测结果迁移到雷达，使用超过250 km车辆密集序列作为真值训练数据，并训练评估两个SOTA检测器。
AI.result: 多普勒去畸变可将检测精度提升最多2.37个点的平均精度均值（mAP）；多普勒速度先验相比零速度初始化基线可将多目标跟踪精度（MOTA）提升13.68个点，同时达到使用真值速度作为先验所获MOTA的99.7%。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，旋转雷达的多普勒速度测量能有效提升车辆检测与跟踪性能：去畸变改善检测，速度先验显著改善跟踪，且接近使用真值速度的上限效果。

title: Robust Structureless Monocular Visual Inertial Initialization Exploiting Line Features and Vanishing Points
summary: Accurate initialization is essential for reliable visual-inertial odometry (VIO), but it is often ill-conditioned under degenerate motions. Existing methods typically require restrictive excitation motions to ensure sufficient observability or rely on computationally expensive 3D structure reconstruction, limiting efficient and practical deployment. To address these limitations, we propose SLIM-init, a structureless monocular VIO initializer that directly exploits geometric constraints from tracked 2D line features without explicit 3D landmark reconstruction. Specifically, SLIM-init leverages line-derived vanishing points (VPs) as translation-invariant orientation cues to provide robust rotation-only constraints under degenerate scenarios such as low-parallax or translation-dominant motions. It further incorporates a line epipolar residual to constrain translation and a line-normal projection residual to improve the conditioning of linear alignment, enhancing the accuracy and robustness of initial state estimation. Extensive experiments on a public benchmark and challenging custom degenerate-motion sequences demonstrate improved accuracy and robustness over state-of-the-art initialization methods. The source code is available at: https://github.com/cjunwan/SLIM-init.

AI.tldr: 提出SLIM-init，一种无结构单目VIO初始化器，直接利用2D线特征的几何约束（消失点、线对极残差、线法向投影残差），在退化运动下实现鲁棒的旋转与平移初始估计。
AI.motivation: VIO初始化对精度至关重要，但在退化运动下常呈病态。现有方法或要求严格的激励运动以保证可观性，或依赖计算昂贵的3D结构重建，难以高效实用部署。
AI.method: SLIM-init为无结构（structureless）单目VIO初始化器，无需显式3D路标重建：1）利用线导出的消失点（VP）作为平移不变的方向线索，在低视差或平移主导等退化场景下提供仅旋转约束；2）引入线对极残差约束平移；3）引入线法向投影残差改善线性对齐的条件数。
AI.result: 在公开基准及自建的挑战性退化运动序列上进行大量实验，相比当前最先进的初始化方法，精度与鲁棒性均有提升。代码开源：https://github.com/cjunwan/SLIM-init。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接利用2D线特征的几何约束而非3D结构重建，SLIM-init在退化运动下实现了高效、鲁棒且精确的单目VIO初始化。

title: FOCAL-VLA: Subtask-Guided Geometry Distillation and Implicit World Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models built on pretrained vision-language models have demonstrated strong performance across diverse robotic manipulation tasks. However, VLA models that directly map current 2D observations to actions often lack sufficient spatial and temporal understanding, limiting their performance in precise and long-horizon manipulation. Recent methods enhance VLA models through geometric supervision and future-state prediction across the entire scene. However, these methods can suffer from redundant scene information, distracting the model from learning the geometry and dynamics relevant to the current interaction. To address this issue, we propose FOCAL-VLA, a framework that combines subtask-guided geometry distillation with implicit world modeling to learn representations of current spatial structure and future interaction dynamics. To focus geometric learning on the current subtask, we transfer geometric knowledge from VGGT to the VLA model by aligning geometry latents with features from subtask-relevant image regions. To capture the future 3D evolution of the current interaction, we incorporate implicit world modeling using Track4World features from current and future demonstration frames. The two complementary representations jointly guide action generation without running VGGT or Track4World at inference time. Experiments show that FOCAL-VLA outperforms baselines on both simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks. Project website: https://zhiyuan-gao.github.io/FOCAL-VLA/.

AI.tldr: FOCAL-VLA：通过子任务引导的几何蒸馏与隐式世界建模，为 VLA 模型注入任务相关的空间结构与未来交互动力学表征，在仿真与真实操作任务上超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型直接将当前 2D 观测映射为动作，缺乏充分的空间与时间理解，难以应对精细和长时序操作。已有的几何监督与未来状态预测方法覆盖整个场景，引入冗余信息，反而干扰模型学习与当前交互相关的几何和动力学。
AI.method: 提出 FOCAL-VLA 框架，融合两项互补表征：(1) 子任务引导的几何蒸馏——将 VGGT 的几何知识迁移到 VLA 模型，通过将几何隐变量与子任务相关图像区域的特征对齐，使几何学习聚焦当前子任务；(2) 隐式世界建模——利用当前与未来演示帧的 Track4World 特征，捕捉当前交互的未来 3D 演化。两种表征联合引导动作生成，且推理阶段无需运行 VGGT 或 Track4World。
AI.result: 在仿真基准和真实世界操作任务上，FOCAL-VLA 均优于基线方法。项目网站：https://zhiyuan-gao.github.io/FOCAL-VLA/。
AI.conclusion: 通过聚焦子任务相关几何并隐式建模未来 3D 动力学，可在不增加推理开销的前提下有效提升 VLA 模型在精细与长时序操作中的表现。

title: VLA-Scope: Shift-Aware Failure Prediction for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models map visual observations and natural-language instructions to robotic actions, but distribution shifts can compromise their reliability. Because these models may still succeed under out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions, detecting OOD inputs alone is insufficient to predict execution failure. In this paper, we introduce VLA-Scope, a two-stage framework that combines input-shift characterization with execution history to predict failure during OOD rollouts. The first stage uses pooled image and language representations to detect OOD inputs and classify their shift categories. For inputs flagged as OOD, the second stage combines the predicted category, action-prefix features, and execution progress features. A logistic regression model shared across shift categories updates failure risk as execution proceeds. We evaluate the framework with OpenVLA on ten LIBERO-Spatial tasks using leave-one-group-out cross-validation. OOD detection achieves a ROC-AUC of 0.9454, and shift classification achieves 91% accuracy. Evaluated independently of the OOD gate on all 1,400 OOD rollouts, the failure predictor achieves a ROC-AUC of 0.8497 after 60 executed actions, compared with 0.7906 without execution progress features. It also achieves a higher ROC-AUC than the evaluated ActProbe and SAFE-MLP baselines. These results suggest that combining action features with temporally aggregated execution step representations improves failure prediction under input shifts.

AI.tldr: 提出VLA-Scope两阶段框架，结合输入偏移特征与执行历史，在OOD场景下预测VLA模型执行失败。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将视觉观测与自然语言指令映射为机器人动作，但分布偏移会损害其可靠性。由于模型在OOD条件下仍可能成功执行，仅检测OOD输入不足以预测执行失败，需进一步预测失败风险。
AI.method: VLA-Scope为两阶段框架：第一阶段利用池化的图像与语言表征检测OOD输入并分类其偏移类别；第二阶段针对被标记为OOD的输入，融合预测类别、动作前缀特征与执行进度特征，采用跨偏移类别共享的逻辑回归模型，随执行推进更新失败风险。
AI.result: 在OpenVLA与十个LIBERO-Spatial任务上采用留一组交叉验证：OOD检测ROC-AUC为0.9454，偏移分类准确率91%；在全部1400条OOD轨迹上（独立于OOD门控评估），执行60步后失败预测ROC-AUC为0.8497，无执行进度特征时为0.7906；且优于ActProbe与SAFE-MLP基线。
AI.conclusion: 将动作特征与时间聚合的执行步表征相结合，可提升输入偏移条件下的失败预测性能。

title: ProTracer: Proprioception-Guided Failure Diagnosis in Robot Manipulation
summary: This paper presents a comprehensive framework for robot manipulation failure analysis that includes binary failure detection, failure categorization, explanation generation, and the additional capability of failure onset localization, which aims to identify the earliest moment at which a robot execution deviates from a valid task-completion trajectory and is ultimately followed by task failure. To address these tasks, we propose ProTracer, a training-free framework that leverages existing Vision-Language Models (VLMs) together with proprioceptive signals for failure analysis. Our method uses proprioceptive dynamics to identify temporally informative action boundaries and converts richer robot-state signals into structured natural-language descriptions that can be jointly analyzed together with visual observations by the VLM. This design combines the temporal precision of proprioceptive signals with the multimodal reasoning capabilities of modern VLMs without requiring additional model training. We further introduce FailTime, a benchmark with synchronized visual and proprioceptive observations for evaluating conventional failure diagnosis tasks as well as failure onset localization. Experiments demonstrate that ProTracer achieves strong performance across both conventional failure diagnosis tasks and the newly introduced failure onset localization task, highlighting the importance of proprioceptive reasoning for fine-grained temporal failure analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ProTracer——一个免训练框架，结合本体感知信号与视觉语言模型（VLM），实现机器人操作失败的二分类检测、失败分类、解释生成及失败起点定位，并构建 FailTime 基准进行评测。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作失败分析通常只做失败检测或分类，缺乏对失败发生时刻的细粒度定位，且现有方法多依赖额外模型训练，难以兼顾时间精度与多模态推理能力。
AI.method: ProTracer 无需训练：利用本体感知动力学识别具有时间信息的动作边界，并将机器人状态信号转化为结构化自然语言描述，与视觉观测一并交由现有 VLM 联合分析，从而融合本体感知的时间精度与 VLM 的多模态推理能力。同时构建 FailTime 基准，提供视觉与本体感知同步观测，用于评测传统失败诊断任务与失败起点定位。
AI.result: 实验表明，ProTracer 在传统失败诊断任务和新增的失败起点定位任务上均取得较强性能，凸显本体感知推理对细粒度时间失败分析的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，将本体感知信号与 VLM 结合可在免训练条件下完成多层级失败分析，尤其是失败起点定位，本体感知推理是实现细粒度时序失败分析的关键。

title: Omni Demand Understanding: A Benchmark for Contextual User-Intent Inference in Multimodal Interaction
summary: Natural audio-visual interaction is emerging as an important interface for AI assistants, allowing users to communicate through speech and vision rather than carefully composed text prompts. However, existing benchmarks of interactive capabilities still focus primarily on response quality, leaving a more fundamental question underexplored: can a model correctly infer the user's underlying demand from complex multimodal interaction? Real-world user demands are often underspecified in speech and must be inferred from multimodal cues and dialogue history. This inference is further complicated by ambiguous or disfluent expression and noisy acoustic environments. Conversely, request-like speech may not constitute a demand to the assistant, leading to false triggers. We establish Omni Demand Understanding (ODU) as a distinct multimodal contextual inference problem: given an interaction stream, a model must detect whether a user demand is present and infer intent from multimodal and conversational context. ODU evaluates this capability along five dimensions, covering both single-turn and multi-turn interactions. We construct ODU-Bench using a challenge-driven taxonomy, taxonomy-guided agentic video generation, and human-recorded interactions, followed by media-grounded annotation and human verification. We evaluate 14 native MLLMs. Even the strongest, Gemini 3.1 Pro, recovers only 44.7% of key information that must be inferred from visual, acoustic, or conversational context. Moreover, 11 of the 14 models exhibit false-trigger rates above 50% on non-demand scenarios. These results reveal a systematic capability gap in current MLLMs' ability to infer contextual user demands. We hope ODU can establish the evaluation of a previously underexplored yet essential capability in multimodal interaction: correctly understanding user demands before generating an appropriate response.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Omni Demand Understanding (ODU) 这一多模态上下文推理任务，并构建 ODU-Bench 基准，从五个维度评估模型能否从语音、视觉与对话历史中推断用户潜在需求及判断需求是否存在。评测 14 个原生 MLLM 显示存在系统性能力缺口。
AI.motivation: 现有交互能力基准主要关注回答质量，忽视了更根本的问题：模型能否从复杂的多模态交互中正确推断用户潜在需求。真实需求常在语音中表述不完整，需借助多模态线索与对话历史推断，并受表达歧义、不流畅及噪声环境影响；同时请求式语音未必构成真实需求，易导致误触发。该能力此前未被系统评估。
AI.method: 将 ODU 定义为独立的多模态上下文推理问题：给定交互流，模型需检测是否存在用户需求，并从多模态与对话上下文推断意图。从五个维度进行评估，覆盖单轮与多轮交互。通过挑战驱动的分类法、分类法引导的智能体视频生成及真人录制交互构建 ODU-Bench，并进行媒体对齐标注与人工验证。评测 14 个原生 MLLM。
AI.result: 最强模型 Gemini 3.1 Pro 仅能恢复 44.7% 需从视觉、声学或对话上下文推断的关键信息；14 个模型中有 11 个在非需求场景下的误触发率超过 50%。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示当前 MLLM 在推断上下文用户需求方面存在系统性能力缺口。作者希望 ODU 能建立对这一多模态交互中此前未被充分探索却至关重要的能力的评估，即在生成恰当回复之前先正确理解用户需求。

title: 2nd Place Solution to the HANDS 2026 Workshop Challenge-Dexterous Grasp Motion Track: Single-Shot Trajectory Warping for Grasp Motion Generation
summary: This report describes our 2nd place solution to the HANDS 2026 workshop challenge (Dexterous Grasp Motion track) in conjunction with ECCV 2026. In this challenge, we address grasp motion generation for the 12-DoF LinkerHand O6, aiming to produce physically plausible reach-and-lift trajectories for unseen objects from randomized initial hand poses in simulation. This task is particularly challenging because each grasp requires a per-step policy to make approximately $70$ twelve-dimensional decisions, with errors accumulating over time, while test objects and physical dynamics may differ from those encountered during training. To address these challenges, we propose editing a single successful GraspM3 demonstration instead of generating the motion step by step: a policy observes the object once and outputs a 12-D warp of the demonstration, which is then replayed open-loop. Moreover, we train the warp policy with one-step PPO over all $4{,}824$ training objects in parallel. As a result, our method achieved success rates of $94.61\%$ on the easy track, the highest of all submissions, and $57.18\%$ on the hard track of the private test set.

AI.tldr: 面向12自由度LinkerHand O6的抓取动作生成，提出"编辑单条成功演示"而非逐步生成的方法：策略观测一次物体后输出12维形变参数，开环回放演示轨迹，并用单步PPO在全部4824个训练物体上并行训练。私有测试集上简单赛道成功率94.61%（所有提交中最高），困难赛道57.18%，获HANDS 2026@ECCV挑战赛灵巧抓取动作赛道第二名。
AI.motivation: 任务难点在于：（1）每次抓取需逐步策略做出约70步、每步12维的决策（约70×12维），误差随时间累积；（2）测试物体与物理动力学可能与训练分布不同。逐步生成的开环/闭环策略易受累积误差与域偏移影响，因此需要一种对分布偏移更鲁棒的范式。
AI.method: 不在仿真中逐步生成动作，而是对单条成功的GraspM3演示进行编辑：策略仅观测一次物体，输出一个12维的warp（形变/变形）参数，将演示轨迹整体变形后以开环方式回放。训练上采用单步PPO，在全部4824个训练物体上并行优化该warp策略。
AI.result: 在私有测试集上：简单赛道成功率94.61%，为所有提交中最高；困难赛道成功率57.18%。总成绩为HANDS 2026（与ECCV 2026同期举办）灵巧抓取动作赛道第二名。
AI.conclusion: 以"一次性物体观测+单条演示形变+开环回放"替代逐步动作生成，可有效规避多步决策的误差累积并提升对未见物体和动力学差异的鲁棒性；单步PPO配合大规模并行训练（4824物体）是该方案高效可行的关键。该方法在挑战赛中取得第二名的成绩，验证了演示编辑范式在灵巧抓取动作生成上的有效性。

title: Evaluating In-Context Learning and Retrieval Strategies for Devanagari Post-OCR Correction
summary: In-context learning using Large Language Models (LLMs) offers a compelling path to training-free post-OCR correction, yet its effectiveness for Devanagari script remains entirely unexplored. We present the first systematic evaluation of LLMs (3B-32B) for post-OCR correction in Hindi and Marathi, comparing three in-context example retrieval strategies: domain-random selection, dense semantic retrieval, and our proposed CharBM25, which retrieves examples by character n-gram BM25 similarity over OCR inputs to target shared error patterns with the test sentence. Across a 20,000-sentence benchmark spanning five news domains, retrieval strategy is the decisive factor in correction quality: CharBM25 outperforms domain-random selection by 2.8-4.0pp absolute WER on Hindi and 2.9-3.8pp on Marathi, using character trigrams, which consistently outperform bigrams and unigrams. Scale dominates performance: Gemma-3-27B achieves WER reductions of 55.0% for Hindi and 33.3% for Marathi under CharBM25-5. Few-shot gains are capacity-gated: models below 8B do not reliably improve over the OCR baseline, and on Marathi the smallest models (3B) degrade more sentences than they improve. Marathi is persistently harder to correct than Hindi across all scales, reflecting its greater morphological complexity. These findings establish CharBM25 as an effective, GPU-free retrieval strategy that matches or exceeds dense retrieval at negligible computational cost, and show that combining it with a general-purpose LLM of 12B+ parameters delivers reliable, training-free Devanagari post-OCR correction without task-specific fine-tuning. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/AbhishekBhandari/Devanagari-OCR-ICL-Benchmark

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估了3B-32B规模LLM在印地语和马拉地语（天城文）上的免训练OCR后校正，提出基于字符n-gram BM25相似度的CharBM25示例检索策略，在2万句基准上验证其显著优于域随机与稠密检索。
AI.motivation: 利用LLM的上下文学习实现免训练OCR后校正颇具前景，但其在天城文（Devanagari）上的有效性尚未被探索；同时，少样本示例的检索策略对校正质量的影响缺乏系统研究，且缺乏相应基准。
AI.method: 构建覆盖5个新闻领域的2万句基准；对3B-32B的多个LLM在印地语和马拉地语上评测；对比三种上下文示例检索策略：域随机选择、稠密语义检索，以及提出的CharBM25（在OCR输入上以字符n-gram BM25相似度检索示例，以匹配与测试句共享的错误模式）；并比较不同n-gram阶数（1/2/3）。
AI.result: 检索策略是校正质量的决定性因素：CharBM25以字符三元组（优于二元、一元）相对域随机选择在印地语上绝对WER降低2.8-4.0pp、马拉地语上2.9-3.8pp；模型规模主导性能，Gemma-3-27B在CharBM25-5下WER相对下降印地语55.0%、马拉地语33.3%；少样本增益受容量门控，小于8B的模型无法可靠优于OCR基线，马拉地语上最小的3B模型使更多句子变差；马拉地语因形态复杂度更高而始终比印地语更难校正。
AI.conclusion: CharBM25是一种有效且无需GPU的检索策略，以可忽略的计算成本达到或超过稠密检索；与12B+参数的通用LLM结合，可在无需任务特定微调的情况下实现可靠的天城文免训练OCR后校正。数据集已公开。

title: Listen Before You Speak: Response Planning from Listener Facial Reactions for Conversational Speech Generation
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 2026 ECCV Workshop (11th ABAW) Best Student Paper Award
summary: Conversational speech depends on dialogue context and the listener's immediately preceding behavior. We propose ReACT-TTS, a two-stage framework that uses a one-second pre-response listener facial sequence to plan the next utterance's emotion and prosody before speech realization. On a strict dyadic MELD protocol, Temporal conditioning yields higher mean macro-F1 and VAD concordance than Text-only across ten seeds, while accuracy remains essentially unchanged. Ablations show that temporal modeling performs best among the visual variants and that an explicit early-to-late difference is unnecessary; correct listener reactions also outperform cyclic mismatches on average. In a contextual-appropriateness study with 20 speech researchers, 76% of judgments prefer Temporal, 9% Text-only, and 15% report no preference. We further connect the predicted response style to a Grad-TTS backbone for end-to-end speech realization. Overall, the results support pre-response listener dynamics as complementary cues for conversational response planning. The source code is available at https://github.com/CYJ1/ReACT-TTS_public.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReACT-TTS 两阶段框架，利用听者一秒反应前面部序列预测下一话语的情感和韵律，再驱动 Grad-TTS 合成语音；在 MELD 双方对话协议与主观评测中优于纯文本条件。
AI.motivation: 对话语音依赖对话上下文以及听者紧邻前一刻的行为，而现有多数 TTS 仅以文本（或文本加说话人自身历史）为条件，忽略了听者在回应前的即时面部动态这一互补线索。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段以一秒反应前听者面部序列作为时间条件，预测下一话语的情感与韵律（VAD）风格；在严格的双方 MELD 协议下与纯文本条件对比，并进行视觉变体消融（含显式早—晚差分）与循环错配对照；第二阶段将预测的回应风格接入 Grad-TTS 主干实现端到端语音合成。
AI.result: 十个随机种子下，Temporal 条件的平均 macro-F1 与 VAD 一致性高于 Text-only，而准确率基本持平；消融显示时间建模在视觉变体中表现最佳、显式早—晚差分并无必要，正确听者反应平均优于循环错配；20 位语音研究者的语境恰当性评测中，76% 偏好 Temporal，9% 偏好 Text-only，15% 无偏好。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明反应前听者动态可作为对话回应规划的互补线索；框架可接入 Grad-TTS 完成端到端语音实现，代码已开源。

title: MIST: Multimodal Survival Prediction with Genomic-Guided Histology Attention
comment: Accepted at the COMPAYL 2026 Workshop on Computational Pathology and Multimodal Data at MICCAI 2026. 11 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables
summary: Multimodal survival models can combine complementary prognostic information from whole-slide images and genomic profiles, but effective fusion remains challenging amid external cohort shift and computational complexity. To address these challenges, we propose MIST, multimodal survival prediction with genomic-guided histology attention. MIST represents genomic features as tokens and allows them to query compact foundation-model-derived histology context tokens before survival prediction. This design enriches molecular information with histology context rather than merging separately encoded modalities only at the final stage. Training combines discrete-time survival prediction with genomic feature masking, WSI dropout, and paired WSI-genomics contrastive alignment. Across four external evaluations in colon, renal, lung, and glioblastoma cohorts, MIST improves external C-index over standard fusion baselines in the primary comparisons. These results support genomic-guided histology attention as a compact and effective strategy for multimodal oncology outcome prediction. Our code is available at https://github.com/samiyavuuz/MIST .

AI.tldr: 提出MIST，用基因组特征作为查询token去检索紧凑的病理基础模型上下文token，实现基因组引导的组织学注意力融合，在四个外部队列上提升生存预测C-index。
AI.motivation: 多模态生存模型可整合全切片图像（WSI）与基因组信息的互补预后价值，但面临外部队列分布偏移与计算复杂度高的挑战，且晚期简单融合效果有限。
AI.method: 将基因组特征表示为token，作为查询去关注由基础模型导出的紧凑组织学上下文token，从而在预测前用组织学上下文丰富分子信息，而非仅在最终阶段合并各自独立编码的模态。训练结合离散时间生存预测、基因组特征掩码、WSI dropout，以及配对的WSI-基因组对比对齐。
AI.result: 在结肠、肾、肺与胶质母细胞瘤四个外部评估队列中，MIST在主要比较上相较标准融合基线的外部C-index均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 基因组引导的组织学注意力是一种紧凑且有效的多模态肿瘤结局预测策略，代码已开源。

title: How Many Posterior Samples? Calibrated Stopping for Adaptive Sensing
summary: In classification-oriented adaptive sensing, posterior samples characterize uncertainty at the current measurement state and can serve two roles: they may guide the next sensing direction, while their class labels provide votes for the candidate classes and determine whether sensing should continue. We focus on the stopping layer that turns these votes into a declaration, without modifying the posterior sampler or sensing directions. A natural plug-in rule declares when the observed vote share exceeds a threshold. We show that this threshold is not itself a confidence guarantee: when the underlying vote mass equals the threshold, the plug-in rule declares about half the time. As alternatives, we calibrate a fixed-sample rule and a finite-horizon sequential rule to a prescribed false-declaration probability, and study exact curtailment, which stops a fixed-pool rule once its final verdict is forced. We then derive how one-round declaration probabilities determine posterior-sample cost and classification accuracy along a sensing path. On MNIST with DDRM and a fixed PCA-guided probe sequence, curtailment saves up to 62% of posterior samples. Among the evaluated rules at matched operating points, sequential stopping reduces the cost the most. At a high accuracy, that same sequential rule can trade more posterior samples for fewer measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文研究分类导向自适应感知中的"停止层"：在不修改后验采样器与感知方向的前提下，将后验样本的类别投票转化为类别声明。作者指出直观的插件式阈值规则（投票份额超过阈值即声明）并不构成置信保证——当真实投票质量恰好等于阈值时，插件规则约有一半概率误声明。为此，作者将固定样本规则与有限时域序贯规则校准到预设的误声明概率，并研究"精确截断"（一旦最终判决被确定即停止）。随后推导一轮声明概率如何决定沿感知路径的后验样本开销与分类精度。在 MNIST 上使用 DDRM 和固定 PCA 引导探测序列，截断最多节省 62% 的后验样本；在匹配工作点上序贯停止开销最低；在高精度下序贯规则可用更多后验样本换取更少测量。
AI.motivation: 分类导向自适应感知中，后验样本既用于指导下一步感知方向，又通过类别投票决定是否继续感知。然而，将投票份额与阈值直接比较的插件式停止规则看似自然，却缺乏置信度语义：当真实投票质量等于阈值时，该规则约有 50% 的概率做出声明。因此需要一个显式的"停止层"，把投票转化为具有可校准误声明概率的判决，同时不改变后验采样器和感知方向。
AI.method: 1) 形式化停止层问题：仅将后验样本的类别投票映射为声明，保持采样器与感知方向不变。2) 分析插件式阈值规则的缺陷，证明其在投票质量等于阈值时声明概率约为 1/2。3) 提出并校准两类具有误声明概率保证的规则：固定样本规则与有限时域序贯规则。4) 研究精确截断（exact curtailment）：当固定池规则的最终判决已被确定时提前停止。5) 推导一轮声明概率与后验样本开销、分类精度沿感知路径的关系。6) 在 MNIST 上用 DDRM 与固定 PCA 引导探测序列进行实验验证。
AI.result: 理论上：插件式阈值并非置信保证，在投票质量等于阈值时误声明概率约 0.5；固定样本与有限时域序贯规则可校准至预设误声明概率；给出声明概率与样本开销、精度的路径级关系。实验上（MNIST + DDRM + 固定 PCA 引导探测序列）：精确截断最多节省 62% 的后验样本；在匹配工作点下，序贯停止的成本最低；在高精度区，序贯规则可用更多后验样本换取更少的测量次数。
AI.conclusion: 停止层应被显式校准，而非依赖直观的插件式阈值，因为后者不提供置信保证。可校准的固定样本规则、有限时域序贯规则及精确截断能够以可控的误声明概率显著降低后验采样成本；其中序贯停止在匹配工作点下最省成本，并能在高精度情形下以后验样本换取测量次数，为分类导向自适应感知提供了实用的停止准则。

title: The Weight Is Over - Interactive Diffusion on Consumer GPUs
summary: On-device inference is booming, but the momentum is almost all in language models. Diffusion pipelines are memory hungry, latency-sensitive, and require orchestrating an embedder, a transformer, a decoder, and often further postprocessing that is not as standardized as LLM inference loops are. We navigate the trade-off between performance, quality, and model footprint to reach as many client devices in the wild as possible. We make three contributions: an embedding translator that maps a small text encoder into a large encoder space to cut weight and latency; a reproducible sweep recipe for navigating the speed/quality/memory triangle in diffusion pipelines; and an interactive on-device image generation editor achieving sub-second TTFI on recent GPUs.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨扩散模型在端侧推理中的性能、质量与模型体积权衡，提出三项贡献：用嵌入翻译器将小文本编码器映射到大编码器空间以降低权重与延迟；给出可复现的扫描配方以导航速度/质量/内存三角；并实现交互式端侧图像生成编辑器，在近期GPU上达到亚秒级TTFI。
AI.motivation: 端侧推理发展迅速但主要集中在语言模型；扩散流水线内存需求大、对延迟敏感，且需编排嵌入器、Transformer、解码器及后处理，流程标准化程度不及LLM推理循环。目标是覆盖尽可能多的客户端设备，需在性能、质量与模型体积间权衡。
AI.method: 提出嵌入翻译器（embedding translator），将小型文本编码器映射至大型编码器空间以减少权重和延迟；设计可复现的扫描配方（sweep recipe），用于在扩散流水线中导航速度/质量/内存三角；构建交互式端侧图像生成编辑器。
AI.result: 在近期GPU上实现亚秒级TTFI（time-to-first-image），并可在速度、质量与内存之间进行可复现的权衡探索。
AI.conclusion: 通过嵌入翻译与系统化扫描方法，可在端侧扩散流水线中有效平衡速度、质量与内存，实现面向广泛客户端设备的低延迟交互式图像生成。

title: GALA: Geometry-Aware Latent Action Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Model Pretraining across Embodiments
summary: Learning large-scale vision-language-action (VLA) models from multi-embodiment datasets remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces across end effectors. Although latent action models (LAMs) can learn embodiment-agnostic action representations from diverse video data, existing image-based LAMs often fail to capture fine-grained end-effector articulation, particularly finger-level geometric changes in human and dexterous robot hands. To address this limitation, we propose GALA, a Geometry-Aware Latent-Action modeling framework that augments image-based latent actions with 3D end-effector geometric motion. However, naively incorporating point clouds yields fine-grained action representations with limited shared semantics, hindering cross-embodiment pretraining. To address this issue, we introduce the Unified End-effector Motion Representation (UEMR), which preserves fine-grained motion information while improving the cross-embodiment generalizability of latent actions. Building upon UEMR, GALA combines visual latent actions that capture scene-level dynamics with geometric latent actions that capture shared fine-grained end-effector articulation, providing effective supervision for VLA pretraining from multi-embodiment data, including action-free ego-centric human videos. Experiments on fine-grained motion probing, cross-embodiment retrieval, and downstream VLA evaluation demonstrate GALA's effectiveness in modeling generalizable fine-grained motions across embodiments, achieving 68.3% RoboCasa-GR1 success rate and 75.5% real-world success rate. Code, appendix, and demos are available at https://puzhenyuan.github.io/GALA-website/.

AI.tldr: GALA（Geometry-Aware Latent-Action）框架通过将3D末端执行器几何运动融入图像潜动作建模，并引入统一末端执行器运动表示（UEMR），实现跨本体细粒度动作的通用表征学习，用于多本体VLA预训练，在RoboCasa-GR1达68.3%成功率、真实世界达75.5%。
AI.motivation: 从多本体数据集学习大规模VLA模型面临挑战：不同末端执行器的动作空间异质。现有图像型潜动作模型（LAM）虽能从多样视频中学习本体无关的动作表示，但难以捕捉细粒度末端执行器关节运动，尤其是人手与灵巧机械手的指级几何变化。因此需要引入几何信息以增强细粒度动作建模能力。
AI.method: 提出GALA几何感知潜动作建模框架：在图像型潜动作基础上增强3D末端执行器几何运动。针对直接使用点云会得到细粒度但共享语义有限的动作表示、阻碍跨本体预训练的问题，提出统一末端执行器运动表示（UEMR），在保留细粒度运动信息的同时提升潜动作的跨本体泛化性。基于UEMR，GALA融合捕捉场景级动态的视觉潜动作与捕捉共享细粒度末端执行器关节运动的几何潜动作，为多本体数据（含无动作的自中心人类视频）的VLA预训练提供有效监督。
AI.result: 在细粒度运动探测、跨本体检索与下游VLA评估实验中，GALA展现出跨本体建模通用细粒度运动的有效性，在RoboCasa-GR1上取得68.3%成功率，真实世界任务取得75.5%成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通过在图像型潜动作中引入几何感知的UEMR表示，GALA有效解决了现有LAM细粒度末端执行器建模不足的问题，提升了跨本体动作表示的通用性与VLA下游性能，验证了几何信息对多本体VLA预训练的价值，代码、附录与演示已开源。

title: Designer-RSI: Evolving Procedural Memory from User Traffic for Agentic Graphic Design
summary: Professional graphic design is a long-horizon agentic task in which structured, editable artifacts emerge from many interdependent actions, yet outcomes admit no reliable programmatic oracle. We introduce a continual adaptation framework in which a frozen frontier model operates professional design software through more than 230 tools, while an external procedural memory of natural-language skills accumulates and refines reusable design procedures from experience. The memory widens by acquiring procedures for recurring uncovered subtasks and deepens by revising existing procedures against their own successful and failed executions, while a matched replay gate admits only changes that repair failures without regressing observed successes. Five rounds over 1,406 real user briefs and 1,869 automatically graded trajectories, with no weight updates and no human labels, grow the bank from 76 documentation-derived skills to 139 and raise GenEval2 execution success on Claude-Sonnet-4 from 72.7% to 99.3% (+11.99 points in generation quality), with 61.8% and 67.6% win rates against the no-skill agent across four specialized design benchmarks on Claude-Sonnet-4 and Claude-Opus-4.6. We further show the two mechanisms are effective in combination: on 200 held-out briefs from user-traffic benchmark, widening or deepening alone reaches a 49.4% / 48.6% win rate over the no-skill agent, while their combination reaches 58.5% (p = 0.025). Procedural memory offers a practical route to continual adaptation of agents under noisy, unverifiable feedback.

AI.tldr: 提出"程序性记忆"外部框架：冻结前沿模型操作专业设计软件230+工具，通过技能"拓宽"（新增子任务程序）与"深化"（据成功/失败修订）持续积累自然语言设计技能，配合匹配回放门控防止退化；5轮迭代将技能库从76增至139，GenEval2成功率72.7%→99.3%，并在多基准上优于无技能智能体。
AI.motivation: 专业平面设计是长时程智能体任务，需经多步相互依赖动作生成结构化可编辑产物，但结果缺乏可靠的程序化评判标准（无oracle）；同时无法依赖权重更新或人工标注实现持续适应，因此需要一种在噪声、不可验证反馈下仍能持续改进的外部机制。
AI.method: 冻结前沿模型通过230+工具操作专业设计软件；构建外部自然语言技能的程序性记忆，包含两种机制：拓宽（为反复出现的未覆盖子任务获取新程序）与深化（依据自身成功/失败执行修订既有程序）；引入匹配回放门控，仅接受能修复失败且不使已观测成功退化的变更。全程无权重更新、无人工标签，在1,406份真实用户需求与1,869条自动评分轨迹上迭代5轮。
AI.result: 技能库由76个文档衍生技能扩展至139个；GenEval2执行成功率在Claude-Sonnet-4上从72.7%提升至99.3%，生成质量提升11.99分；在四个专业设计基准上对无技能智能体的胜率分别为61.8%（Claude-Sonnet-4）和67.6%（Claude-Opus-4.6）。在用户流量基准的200份留出需求上，单独拓宽或深化胜率为49.4%/48.6%，二者结合达58.5%（p=0.025），验证机制组合有效性。
AI.conclusion: 程序性记忆为在噪声且不可验证反馈条件下实现智能体的持续适应提供了一条可行路径；拓宽与深化两种机制结合使用效果显著优于单独使用。

title: Emergent Intelligence: Resonant Oscillators Produce Proactive Adaptive Behavior
comment: 22 pages, 9 figures, 14 tables. Code: https://github.com/FoundAItion-ai/Its/tree/v1.1.7/PY/VisualCube . Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19264202
summary: Most artificial neural systems are built to map given inputs to outputs. Adaptive agents face a prior problem: they must act without enough evidence, seek encounters with the world, and revise behavior when evidence appears. We propose another starting point for intelligent neural networks: proactive search without signals, curiosity at its most basic. We ask whether it can come from a minimal untrained circuit. The spiking unit studied here inverts its response to input: with no signal in its window it fires faster; once signals arrive it switches to a slower, inverted regime. Search needs three or more such oscillators in counter-phase, each reading the same input in a different time window. With no training, supervision, parameter tuning, or controller, the composite switches on its own between exploratory spiral search and exploitative tracking, finding both first-degree symmetry and second-degree groups. The switch comes from temporal disagreement between its fast and slow readings of the same signal. We view the circuit as evolutionarily trained: its abilities come from structure, not experience. Ablation over 63 configurations and 63,000 trials shows the switch needs both temporal staggering and counter-phase opposition, neither enough alone: the behavior is emergent, not programmed. The spiral persists at zero rotational diffusion, so it is structural, and degrades gently under perturbation. More oscillators improve spiral regularity but cut resource capture, so the smallest sufficient circuit wins. We propose that this principle underlies search in simple organisms, navigation and decisions in complex ones, and, being so simple and common, goes unnoticed unless you strip the logic bare. Eventually, networks of such proactive primitives may offer another foundation for AI architectures that explore our world rather than merely predict the next symbol in a sequence.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种无需训练、监督或参数调整的极简脉冲神经回路，通过三个以上反相且时间窗错开的振荡单元，自发在探索性螺旋搜索与利用性追踪之间切换，实现一级对称与二级群组发现。
AI.motivation: 现有人工神经网络多被设计为将给定输入映射到输出，而适应性智能体面临更前置的问题：必须在证据不足时行动、主动寻求与世界的接触，并在证据出现时修正行为。作者希望探索智能神经网络的另一出发点——无信号下的主动搜索，即最基础的"好奇心"，并追问这种能力能否来自一个最小的、未经训练的回路。
AI.method: 研究一种对输入响应反转的脉冲单元：窗口内无信号时放电更快，信号到来后切换为更慢的反转模式。搜索需要三个或更多此类振荡器处于反相，并各自在不同时间窗读取同一输入。系统不进行训练、监督、参数调优，也不设控制器。通过63种配置、63,000次试验的消融实验，检验时间错开与反相这两种要素的作用，并考察旋转扩散与扰动下的稳健性，以及振荡器数量对搜索行为的影响。
AI.result: 该复合回路无需训练即可自发在探索性螺旋搜索与利用性追踪之间切换，并能发现一级对称与二级群组。切换机制源于其对同一信号的快、慢读法之间的时间不一致。消融实验显示该切换同时需要时间错开与反相，二者单独均不足，表明行为是涌现的而非被编程的。螺旋在零旋转扩散下仍持续，说明其是结构性的，并在扰动下平缓退化。振荡器增多可提升螺旋规则性，但会降低资源获取，因此最小充分回路最优。
AI.conclusion: 作者将该回路视为"进化训练"的结果：其能力源于结构而非经验。他们提出这一原理可能支撑简单生物的搜索，以及复杂生物的导航与决策，并因过于简单普遍而常被忽视。最终，这类主动原语构成的网络或可为AI架构提供另一种基础，使其探索世界而非仅仅预测序列中的下一个符号。

title: A Confidence-Driven Evolutionary Algorithm for Noisy Optimization with Joint Chance Constraints
summary: Many real-world optimization problems involve noisy objective evaluations and probabilistic constraints, particularly in the form of joint chance constraints, which are computationally expensive to evaluate. In this work, we propose CR-EA-C, a confidence-driven evolutionary algorithm for solving noisy black-box optimization problems under joint chance constraints. CR-EA-C introduces three key components: (1) analytical feasibility estimation for joint chance constraints, (2) a pairwise statistical ranking mechanism for robust comparison under noise, and (3) a modified infeasibility-driven survival strategy to accelerate convergence. These components enable statistically reliable decision-making while improving the efficiency of function evaluations. The proposed method is evaluated against four recent metaheuristic algorithms under various uncertainty distributions. Furthermore, its practical effectiveness is also assessed on two additional real-world optimization problems and compared with conventional static sampling methods. Experimental results show that CR-EA-C consistently satisfies the prescribed joint chance constraints while achieving competitive objective values overall. This demonstrates that CR-EA-C is an effective general-purpose approach for noisy optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出置信度驱动的进化算法CR-EA-C，用于求解带联合机会约束的噪声黑盒优化问题，通过解析可行性估计、成对统计排序与改进的不可行度驱动生存策略，在保证约束满足的同时提升评估效率与目标性能。
AI.motivation: 现实优化问题常含噪声目标评估与概率约束（尤其是联合机会约束），此类约束评估代价高昂，传统方法难以在统计可靠性与计算效率间取得平衡。
AI.method: CR-EA-C包含三个核心组件：(1) 针对联合机会约束的解析可行性估计；(2) 用于噪声下稳健比较的成对统计排序机制；(3) 改进的不可行度驱动生存策略以加速收敛。这些组件共同实现统计可靠的决策并减少函数评估开销。
AI.result: 在多种不确定性分布下与四种近期元启发式算法对比；并在两个额外真实优化问题上与传统静态采样方法比较。结果显示CR-EA-C能持续满足规定的联合机会约束，同时整体取得有竞争力的目标值。
AI.conclusion: CR-EA-C是被证明有效的通用噪声优化方法，兼具约束满足性与目标性能优势。

title: Predictive Suppression Layers for Communication-Efficient Spiking Neural Networks
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the 1st Neuromorphic Physical Layer Signal Processing for Wireless Systems Workshop (NeuroPHY 2026), co-located with EWSN 2026
summary: Feedforward Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) typically propagate every generated spike indiscriminately, disregarding whether the information is redundant from an information-theoretic perspective. This lack of selectivity induces high redundancy in inter-layer communication, creating an expensive overhead, e.g., in scenarios involving many-core neuromorphic hardware or communication-dominated Internet-of-Things (IoT) where features are transmitted wirelessly. To address this challenge, we trade localized processing for leaner network channels by introducing a minimal predictive coding framework for SNNs. We propose two layer variants sharing a predictor block: error units, which transmit signed spiking residuals, and predictive suppression, which uses residual magnitude to dynamically gate and forward only unpredictable, "surprising" activity. Evaluated on the N-MNIST and Spiking Heidelberg Digits (SHD) datasets using diagnostic metrics that decouple local processing from cross-layer communication, our new predictive coding layers achieve significant communication savings. Numerical results reveal a three-fold reduction in communicated activity, while increasing the task accuracy for both datasets. The latter finding is notable, and suggests that predictive coding layers not only minimize communication overhead, but also produce output feature vectors with a higher representation power.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于脉冲神经网络（SNN）的最小预测编码框架，通过引入误差单元与预测抑制两种层变体，减少层间通信冗余，在N-MNIST和SHD数据集上实现约三倍通信量降低并提升任务精度。
AI.motivation: 前馈SNN不加区分地传播每一个生成的脉冲，未从信息论角度判断信息是否冗余，导致层间通信存在高冗余，在多核神经形态硬件或通信主导的IoT无线传输场景中带来昂贵开销。
AI.method: 以牺牲局部处理换取更精简的网络通道，提出SNN的最小预测编码框架。两种层变体共享一个预测器模块：误差单元（error units）传输带符号的脉冲残差；预测抑制（predictive suppression）利用残差幅度动态门控，仅转发不可预测的"意外"活动。
AI.result: 在N-MNIST和SHD数据集上，采用将局部处理与跨层通信解耦的诊断指标评估，通信活动减少约三倍，同时两个数据集的任务精度均得到提升。
AI.conclusion: 预测编码层不仅能最小化通信开销，还能产生具有更高表示能力的输出特征向量，说明精度提升源于表征能力的增强。

title: The Internet Archive Music Dataset
summary: We introduce the Internet Archive Music Dataset (IAMD), a large-scale collection of captioned music segments derived from the Internet Archive. To the best of our knowledge, IAMD constitutes the largest publicly available music-caption dataset to date with over 34,000 hours of audio, providing a valuable benchmark for training and evaluating music understanding and generative models. The dataset is built from content declared to be distributed under Creative Commons licenses, and cross-referencing with MusicBrainz is done to improve license information reliability. To annotate IAMD, we present an automatic captioning pipeline that augments base captions produced by an audio-language model (ALM) with textual metadata sourced from the Internet Archive and imputed metadata obtained using audio classification models. Caption quality is assessed objectively and subjectively, and results indicate that the annotation pipeline is reliable and does not degrade caption quality with scaling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出互联网档案馆音乐数据集（IAMD），这是目前公开可用的最大音乐-文本描述数据集，包含超过34,000小时音频及标题描述，并提供自动化描述生成流程。
AI.motivation: 现有公开音乐-文本描述数据集规模有限，难以支撑音乐理解与生成模型的训练和评估，因此需要一个大规模、可靠标注的音乐描述基准数据集。
AI.method: 从互联网档案馆中选取声明为Creative Commons许可的内容构建数据集，并与MusicBrainz交叉验证以提升许可信息可靠性。提出自动描述生成流程：以音频-语言模型（ALM）生成的基础描述为核心，融合互联网档案馆的文本元数据以及通过音频分类模型推测的填补元数据。
AI.result: 构建了包含超过34,000小时音频的IAMD数据集，规模为当前公开音乐描述数据集之最。通过客观与主观评估验证了描述质量，结果表明标注流程可靠，且随规模扩展描述质量不下降。
AI.conclusion: IAMD为音乐理解与生成模型提供了大规模、可信的公开基准；其自动描述流程具备可扩展性与可靠性，可支持后续研究。

title: Composer2Vec: A Continuous Embedding Space of Composer Style Learned from Symbolic Melody Generation
summary: We analyze the composer embeddings learned by a composer-conditioned Transformer as a continuous latent space of compositional style, rather than merely as an internal representation for generation. A model that recursively predicts melody continuations was trained on melodic sequences extracted from MIDI data, conditioned on composer identity (124 composers). Principal component analysis of the learned composer embedding matrix (124x128) shows that the first principal component correlates strongly with composer birth year (r = -0.884, p < 0.001, n = 123), a stronger correlation than we obtain by applying the same PC1-birth-year analysis to existing general-purpose audio-text embeddings (CLAP, MuQ-MuLan) trained on unrelated audio-text corpora, not on symbolic melody generation. A shuffle test (2,000 permutations) confirms that the Silhouette score for stylistic-period labels is statistically significant (0.0110, p < 0.001). We further show that vector arithmetic in the embedding space captures meaningful stylistic relationships between composers. These results suggest that composer embeddings, learned without supervision beyond composer identity, form an interpretable latent space that captures musical-historical structure.

AI.tldr: 作曲家条件Transformer学习的作曲家嵌入可视为可解释的作曲风格连续隐空间，其主成分与作曲家出生年份高度相关，并显著编码风格时期结构。
AI.motivation: 以往作曲家嵌入多被视为生成任务的内部表示，而未被当作可分析的风格隐空间；作者希望检验这种无额外监督的嵌入是否能捕捉音乐史结构。
AI.method: 在MIDI旋律序列上训练递归预测旋律续写的作曲家条件Transformer（124位作曲家）；对124x128的作曲家嵌入矩阵做PCA；将PC1与出生年份相关分析，并与CLAP、MuQ-MuLan等通用音频-文本嵌入对比；用2,000次置换检验评估风格时期标签的Silhouette分数显著性；并做嵌入空间向量算术。
AI.result: 第一主成分与作曲家出生年份强相关（r=-0.884, p<0.001, n=123），强于对CLAP、MuQ-MuLan等嵌入做同样分析的结果；风格时期标签的Silhouette分数为0.0110且置换检验显著（p<0.001）；向量算术能捕捉作曲家间有意义的风格关系。
AI.conclusion: 仅以作曲家身份为监督学习到的作曲家嵌入形成可解释的隐空间，能够反映音乐历史结构，说明生成模型内部表示可作为音乐学分析对象。

title: Voice-Light: A Full-Duplex Cascaded Voice Agent with Causal Turn-Taking and Speculative Generation
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Code, datasets, and model artifacts: https://github.com/BertilBraun/Voice-Light ; live demo: https://voice.bertil-braun.de
summary: Natural spoken interaction requires more than streaming ASR, language generation, and speech synthesis: a system must react to overlap without canceling on every acknowledgment, prepare a response before a turn is certain, and ensure canceled audio cannot enter conversation history. We present Voice-Light, a full-duplex cascaded voice agent that combines immediate acoustic onset, a causal adapter sharing a streaming ASR encoder, reversible playback control, and private speculative response generation. Structured tool calls execute concurrently with audible bridge speech, while browser acknowledgments make rendered audio authoritative for durable history. Locked evaluation on 1,673 real-conversation silence candidates found that an earlier learned completion checkpoint preserved a 2.70% false-cutoff rate but reached only 12.53% end-of-turn recall, compared with 95.60% for a Silero timing policy. The deployed system therefore retains a hybrid controller rather than claiming a learned-policy replacement. Across three unscripted operator-run microphone sessions, 36 measured response turns had a 758 ms median from final VAD endpoint to first server audio; 21 turns were below 800 ms. These sessions are an instrumented case study, not a controlled user evaluation. We release the synthetic data, model artifacts, evaluation code and summaries, source code, and deployment configuration supporting the result.

AI.tldr: 提出全双工级联语音代理 Voice-Light，融合声学起音、因果适配器、可逆播放控制与私密推测生成；沉默候选评测中外推学习式完成模型 EOT 召回率仅 12.53%，故保留混合控制器，实测 36 轮响应中位延迟 758 ms。
AI.motivation: 自然口语交互不能仅靠流式 ASR、语言生成与语音合成的简单串联：系统需在重叠说话时做出反应而不因每个确认词被取消，需在轮次尚未确定时就预备回复，并保证已取消音频不进入对话历史。
AI.method: 构建 Voice-Light 全双工级联语音代理，包含即时声学起音、与流式 ASR 编码器共享的因果适配器、可逆播放控制、私密推测式回复生成；结构化工具调用与可听桥接语音并发执行，浏览器确认使已渲染音频成为权威历史；在 1,673 个真实对话沉默候选上锁定评测学习式完成检查点与 Silero 计时策略。
AI.result: 学习式完成检查点保持 2.70% 误截断率，但端轮召回仅 12.53%，Silero 计时策略达 95.60%；三次无脚本操作员麦克风会话中 36 个响应轮从最终 VAD 端点到首段服务器音频中位 758 ms，21 轮低于 800 ms。
AI.conclusion: 系统因此保留混合控制器，而非宣称以学习策略替代计时策略；会话属仪表化案例研究而非受控用户评测，并公开合成数据、模型产物、评测代码与摘要、源码及部署配置。

title: Online Algorithms for Independent Low-Rank Matrix Analysis and Rank-Constrained Spatial Covariance Matrix Estimation Based on Maximum Weighted Likelihood Estimation
summary: Real-time multichannel speech extraction (MSE) under diffuse noise conditions is an important task with a wide range of applications, such as speech recognition and hearing aids. In this paper, we propose online algorithms for independent low-rank matrix analysis (ILRMA) and rank-constrained spatial covariance matrix estimation (RCSCME). Previously, we proposed a real-time extension of the RCSCME-based method: an MSE method based on ILRMA and RCSCME using the blockwise batch algorithm. However, it assumes that the spatial characteristics are stationary within a single batch, and thus, in dynamic situations where the target speaker moves, its performance may degrade. To address this problem, we derive the online algorithms for ILRMA and RCSCME in the following three steps. First, we formulate framewise cost functions for ILRMA and RCSCME on the basis of maximum weighted likelihood estimation. Second, we derive the update rules for the framewise cost functions on the basis of auxiliary-function techniques. These naive update rules are computationally costly for real-time execution on a practical machine. Thus, we finally derive the online algorithms by approximating some intermediate parameters with their estimates. Furthermore, we propose stabilization and further acceleration techniques for these online algorithms. In experiments, we simulate situations where a target speaker is stationary or moves and show that the proposed method achieves superior speech extraction performance compared with conventional methods. In addition, using real-world recorded signals, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in practical scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ILRMA与RCSCME的在线算法，用于扩散噪声下的实时多通道语音提取，并通过近似中间参数、稳定化与加速技术实现实时运行，在仿真与实录信号上均优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 扩散噪声下的实时多通道语音提取在语音识别、助听器等场景应用广泛。作者此前提出的基于ILRMA与RCSCME的分块批处理实时方法假设单批内空间特性平稳，当目标说话人移动时性能下降。
AI.method: 分三步推导在线算法：首先基于最大加权似然估计构建ILRMA与RCSCME的逐帧代价函数；其次基于辅助函数技术推导逐帧更新规则；鉴于原始更新规则计算代价高，最后通过用估计值近似部分中间参数得到在线算法，并提出稳定化与进一步加速技术。
AI.result: 在目标说话人静止与移动的仿真场景中，所提方法语音提取性能优于传统方法；使用真实录制信号进一步验证了其在实际场景中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提在线ILRMA与RCSCME算法在动态条件下兼具实时性与提取性能，适用于实际语音提取应用。

title: I'll Keep an Ear Out: Teaching AudioLLMs Proactive Audio Assistance
summary: Audio large language models (AudioLLMs) operate reactively, responding only when queried. We introduce proactive audio assistance, where an AudioLLM monitors an audio stream and autonomously decides when to alert the user from a single natural-language intent, motivated by wearable applications for Deaf and Hard of Hearing users. We propose Interrupt and Silent Modeling (ISM), a model-agnostic paradigm that embeds proactive decisions into LLM decoding via two special tokens: \texttt{<interrupt>} and \texttt{<silent>}, capturing four states: onset detection, sustained-relevance triggering, irrelevance suppression, and de-duplication. Applied to Qwen2-Audio-7B, ISM achieves 99.6\% interrupt F1 and perfect de-duplication recall on ESC-50. On noisy Epic-Sounds kitchen audio, ISM achieves the highest interrupt F1 without domain-specific training, the only method maintaining strong onset detection without over-triggering or over-suppression. Streaming evaluation confirms real-time viability with 3.5-second average latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"主动音频助手"任务，并设计了模型无关的ISM范式，通过在LLM解码中引入<interrupt>和<silent>两个特殊token嵌入主动决策，在Qwen2-Audio-7B上实现高中断F1与去重召回，并验证了实时可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有AudioLLM是被动响应式的，仅在用户查询时才作出反应。针对听障（Deaf and Hard of Hearing）用户的佩戴式应用场景，需要模型能够主动监听音频流，并依据单条自然语言意图自主判断何时提醒用户。
AI.method: 提出Interrupt and Silent Modeling（ISM）范式，模型无关，通过<interrupt>和<silent>两个特殊token将主动决策嵌入LLM解码过程，覆盖四种状态：起始（onset）检测、持续相关性触发、无关性抑制、去重。
AI.result: 在Qwen2-Audio-7B上，ESC-50上达到99.6%中断F1与完美的去重召回；在含噪的Epic-Sounds厨房音频上，无需领域特定训练即取得最高中断F1，是唯一在保持强起始检测能力的同时不过度触发、不过度抑制的方法；流式评估显示平均延迟3.5秒，具备实时可行性。
AI.conclusion: ISM为AudioLLM提供了通用、可嵌入解码的主动辅助能力，兼顾检测灵敏度与抑制/去重表现，并支持实时流式场景，适用于听障辅助等佩戴式应用。

title: GenTraceBench: A Benchmark for Tracing Audio Deepfakes Across Pre- and Post-training Stages
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to the 15th International Symposium on Chinese Spoken Language Processing (ISCSLP 2026)
summary: Modern text-to-speech (TTS) systems are rarely deployed as unchanged pre-trained models. They are often adapted through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or preference optimization such as DPO and GRPO. This raises a practical question for audio deepfake forensics: do fingerprints learned from a foundation generator remain valid after adaptation? We present GenTraceBench, a controlled benchmark spanning five TTS architectures, 16 pre-/post-training variants, and 49,728 utterances generated with fixed texts and speaker prompts. Under a train-on-foundation, test-on-adapted protocol, we evaluate binary detection, closed-set attribution, and open-set verification. DPO and GRPO generally preserve fingerprints, whereas some SFT and pre-training-data changes cause substantial drift; effect sizes vary across three forensic backbones. Repeated training runs confirm the largest W2V-BERT attribution drop, while a data-mixture control with comparable speech quality shows that composition change need not cause drift. In W2V-BERT verification, multi-shot enrollment reduces EER for the SFT condition from 44.4% to 11.0%, whereas the SingNet-only condition remains at or above 45% EER.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GenTraceBench 基准，系统评估 TTS 基础生成器指纹在监督微调（SFT）与偏好优化（DPO/GRPO）等适配后的有效性，发现 DPO/GRPO 基本保留指纹，而部分 SFT 与预训练数据变化导致显著漂移。
AI.motivation: 现代 TTS 系统通常不会以原始预训练模型直接部署，而是经过 SFT 或 DPO、GRPO 等偏好优化适配。这引出一个音频深度伪造取证的实际问题：从基础生成器学到的指纹在适配后是否仍然有效。现有研究缺乏在受控条件下对该问题的系统评测。
AI.method: 构建 GenTraceBench 受控基准，覆盖 5 种 TTS 架构、16 个训练前/后变体、49,728 条固定文本与说话人提示生成的语音。采用"基础模型训练、适配模型测试"协议，评估二分类检测、闭集归因和开集验证三类任务，并在三种取证骨干网络上比较效应量，同时进行重复训练与数据混合对照实验。
AI.result: DPO 与 GRPO 总体上能保留生成器指纹；部分 SFT 与预训练数据变化则导致明显指纹漂移，且效应量在不同取证骨干间存在差异。重复训练验证了 W2V-BERT 归因性能的最大下降；语音质量相当的数据混合对照表明，数据组成变化本身未必引起漂移。在 W2V-BERT 验证中，多片段注册将 SFT 条件的 EER 从 44.4% 降至 11.0%，而仅用 SingNet 的条件 EER 仍保持在 45% 及以上。
AI.conclusion: TTS 生成器指纹对适配策略的鲁棒性具有条件依赖性：偏好优化较安全，SFT 与数据变化风险较高，且取证结论受骨干模型与注册方式影响。GenTraceBench 为音频深度伪造取证的指纹稳定性研究提供了可复现的受控评测平台。

title: Training Music Sample Identification Models on Real Sample Pairs
summary: Sample identification (SI) is the task of matching pairs of tracks, where one track is created by musically transforming an element of the other. In the absence of sample annotations at scale, the dominant training paradigm has depended on artificially creating sample pairs. Although a recently released dataset provides annotations of real sample pairs at scale, an effective training recipe is missing. In this work, we present SI Embeddings (SIE), an SI model that achieves state-of-the-art results on three benchmarks, including a large-scale test set. We show that the previous state of the art trained on artificial pairs generalizes only partially to real pairs, and that its training data limits its performance. We also show that real pairs do not fully account for SIE's performance: its architecture and training recipe contribute substantially. We provide the first fully supervised training recipe for real-world SI, establishing a strong foundation for future research in the field.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SI Embeddings (SIE) 模型，通过首个全监督训练方案，在三个基准（含大规模测试集）上取得样本识别任务的最优性能，并验证真实样本对并非性能的全部来源。
AI.motivation: 样本识别（SI）需要匹配经音乐变换得到的音轨对，但缺乏大规模的真实样本标注，主流做法依赖人工合成的样本对训练。虽有新数据集提供大规模真实样本对标注，却缺少有效的训练方法。
AI.method: 提出 SI Embeddings (SIE) 模型，设计首个针对真实世界样本识别的全监督训练配方，并分析模型架构与训练策略对性能的贡献，同时与在人工样本对上训练的先前最优方法进行对比。
AI.result: SIE 在三个基准（包括一个大规模测试集）上取得最优结果；先前基于人工样本对训练的最优方法在真实样本对上仅部分泛化，且其训练数据限制了性能；真实样本对并不能完全解释 SIE 的表现。
AI.conclusion: SIE 的架构与训练配方对性能具有实质性贡献。本文提供了首个面向真实场景样本识别的全监督训练方案，为该领域后续研究奠定了坚实基础。

title: Investigating the Performance and Energy Costs of Replicating Band-Split RNN for Music Source Separation
summary: Band-split recurrent neural network (BSRNN) is a popular music source separation model that yields close to state-of-the-art results using reasonable computational resources and public datasets. It is therefore interesting from a reproducible research perspective, but achieving its performance is not straightforward since its full code is not available. In this paper, we conduct a replication of BSRNN via implementing the full pipeline. We extend the original paper's analysis by experimentally studying various design choices about data preprocessing, the optimization protocol, and architectural parameters. We report and discuss this project's energy cost, and we underline how its footprint could have been substantial lower upon availability of the full pipeline, which advocates for more reproducible research practices. To comply with this objective, we publicly release our code and pre-trained models.

AI.tldr: 本文复现了音乐源分离模型BSRNN，实现完整流程，并通过实验研究数据预处理、优化协议和架构参数等设计选择，同时报告能耗成本并公开代码与预训练模型。
AI.motivation: BSRNN在合理计算资源和公开数据集下接近SOTA，具有可复现研究价值，但完整代码不可用导致复现困难；作者希望通过复现推动更可复现的研究实践。
AI.method: 通过实现完整流程复现BSRNN，并扩展原论文分析，实验研究数据预处理、优化协议及架构参数等设计选择。
AI.result: 成功复现BSRNN，并得出关于数据预处理、优化协议和架构参数等设计选择的实验结论；报告了项目能耗成本。
AI.conclusion: 若完整流程可得，能耗足迹本可大幅降低，倡导更可复现的研究实践；公开代码和预训练模型。

title: Spherical Harmonic Sliced Wasserstein Displacement Interpolation for Acoustic Source and Reflection Density Modeling
summary: Spatial room impulse responses (SRIRs) capture directional distributions of acoustic sound-sources and their reflections. However, collecting SRIRs of moving sound-sources remains a challenge, requiring complex interpolations across measurements that account for multi-path spatial-temporal dynamics. This paper investigates the Wasserstein metric and displacement for evaluating interpolated SRIR echo densities in the spherical harmonic domain. We present novel sum-of-magnitude square expansions for efficiently fitting probability density functions, maximizing likelihood, inverse sampling, and computing spherical sliced Wasserstein interpolations. Experiments compare the Wasserstein displacements and metric to linear and geometric interpolations of SRIR image-source densities on a line-path, and demonstrate model-order reduction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在球谐域中利用Wasserstein度量与位移来评估插值的SRIR回声密度，并通过新的幅度平方和展开实现高效概率密度拟合、最大似然、逆采样及球面切片Wasserstein插值，实验验证了模型降阶与插值效果。
AI.motivation: 移动声源的空间房间脉冲响应（SRIR）采集困难，需要在多次测量间进行复杂插值以刻画多路径时空动态，因此需要更合适的度量与插值方法来评估和处理SRIR回声密度。
AI.method: 提出新颖的幅度平方和（sum-of-magnitude-square）展开，用于高效拟合概率密度函数、最大化似然、逆采样以及计算球面切片Wasserstein插值；并将Wasserstein度量与位移用于球谐域中插值SRIR回声密度的评估。
AI.result: 实验在直线路径上对SRIR图像源密度的线性插值与几何插值进行比较，计算Wasserstein位移与度量，并展示了模型降阶效果。
AI.conclusion: Wasserstein度量与位移为球谐域中SRIR回声密度的插值评估提供了有效工具，所提幅度平方和展开支持高效计算，并实现模型降阶。

title: Enhancing Audio Reasoning via Semantic Summary Prediction
summary: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) perform well on complex question answering but often show a reasoning gap, where explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reduces accuracy compared to direct answers. We hypothesize that long reasoning sequences shift attention away from the audio input. To address this, we propose SPARE (Semantic Prediction for Audio REasoning), which introduces a register token aligned with the final conclusion using a cosine similarity loss with a Sentence-BERT embedding. This conditions the model's latent space with the target semantic goal before reasoning begins. Experiments on MMAU and MMAR with SALMONN show improved zero-shot reasoning and stronger early attention to audio without additional inference cost.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SPARE方法，通过一个与结论对齐的register token在推理前为模型注入目标语义，缓解大型音频语言模型在显式CoT下推理性能下降的问题。
AI.motivation: 大型音频语言模型虽在复杂问答上表现良好，但存在推理缺口：显式思维链（CoT）反而比直接作答准确率更低。作者假设原因是长推理序列使得注意力偏离音频输入。
AI.method: 提出SPARE（Semantic Prediction for Audio REasoning）。引入一个register token，用Sentence-BERT嵌入配合余弦相似度损失，使其与最终结论对齐，从而在推理开始前就条件化模型的潜在空间，注入目标语义。
AI.result: 在MMAU与MMAR基准上，使用SALMONN模型进行实验，零样本推理性能提升，且对音频的早期注意力更强，同时不增加额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过对齐结论的register token预先引导语义目标，可有效改善音频语言模型在CoT下的推理表现与音频关注度，且无额外推理成本。

title: Per-Aetiology Contrastive Severity Embeddings with Phonological Pseudo-Labelling for Multilingual Dysarthric Speech
comment: Accepted at IEEE SLT 2026, 13-16 December 2026, Palermo, Sicily
summary: Most multilingual dysarthria-severity systems either train on a single aetiology-language pair or pool heterogeneous aetiologies into one label space. We test that pooling assumption with four matched HuBERT-base contrastive embedding models under a shared backbone, training recipe, corpus registry and held-out evaluation: one mixed-aetiology baseline and three aetiology-specific models for cerebral palsy (CP), Parkinson's disease (PD) and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Training combines clinically labelled speech with ordinal pseudo-labels from a training-free phonological profiling method [1], [2]. On speaker-disjoint, leakage-filtered held-out subsets, the per-aetiology models outperform the mixed baseline across all three target aetiologies: CP (macro F1 0.829 vs 0.676, +22.6 % relative), PD (0.715 vs 0.511, +40.0 %) and ALS (0.788 vs 0.596, +32.3 %). On CP, adding 144 SAP and 44 CDSD pseudo-labelled speakers lifts macro F1 from 0.786 to 0.829 over a clinical-only CP model (+4.3 percentage points). Training data span three to seven languages per aetiology. We position this as a controlled comparison of label-space design choices and discuss pseudo-label calibration, split hygiene, and confidence-thresholded deployment as important limitations for future work.

AI.tldr: 该研究用四个匹配的HuBERT-base对比嵌入模型进行受控比较，发现按病因分别建模优于混合病因基线，且伪标签数据可进一步提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多语言构音障碍严重度系统要么仅在单一"病因-语言"对上训练，要么将异质病因合并到一个标签空间。作者通过受控实验检验"合并病因"这一假设是否成立。
AI.method: 在共享骨干、训练配方、语料注册表和留出评估下，训练四个匹配的HuBERT-base对比嵌入模型：一个混合病因基线，及脑瘫（CP）、帕金森病（PD）、肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）三个病因专属模型。训练结合临床标注语音与来自免训练音系画像方法的序数伪标签。
AI.result: 在说话人不相交、去泄漏的留出子集上，各病因专属模型全面优于混合基线：CP（宏F1 0.829 vs 0.676，相对+22.6%）、PD（0.715 vs 0.511，+40.0%）、ALS（0.788 vs 0.596，+32.3%）。CP上加入144名SAP与44名CDSD伪标签说话人后，宏F1由0.786升至0.829（+4.3个百分点）。各病因训练数据覆盖三至七种语言。
AI.conclusion: 本研究将结果定位为对标签空间设计选择的受控比较，并指出伪标签校准、划分卫生（split hygiene）和基于置信度阈值的部署是未来工作的重要局限。

title: Verify, Don't Trust: Agentic Model Development for Video Discovery Retrieval at Scale
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 8 tables. ACM sigconf format; submitted to the KDD 2027 Applied Data Science Track
summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents can propose, implement, and evaluate model changes. Autoresearch loops demonstrate this capability through minutes-scale iterations on a self-contained program. Online autoresearch instead spans asynchronous systems, hours-long variants, and weeks-long campaigns that can influence a product. A completed run can still support an invalid conclusion when a code change is a no-op, data windows leak, evaluator semantics drift, or the two arms traverse different serving funnels. We present EvoPilot, a human-gated method for long-horizon online autoresearch. Role-specific agents execute each round through a versioned domain skill and typed adapter. Durable records preserve experiments and failures; deterministic checks enforce recorded lessons.
  We study a 37-day campaign for the retrieval system that powers Video Deep Dive (VDD), an online experience for discovering follow-on videos after a user opens a seed video. The campaign covered seven directions and used an hourly refreshed index of hundreds of millions of videos. Earlier manual experiments had not established a benefit from an interaction head. A primitive autoresearch attempt revisited the direction but incorrectly attributed an offline hit-rate decline of 22 percentage points to the head. We then introduced EvoPilot. Its human-gated verification traced the drop to a pre-existing evaluation defect that produced output depths of 3,000 and 600. After repair, a matched comparison measured an offline improvement of 3.20 percentage points. Post-study replay and mutation tests rejected invalid comparisons while admitting valid counterparts. Durable state recovered an interrupted round, and artifact reuse avoided approximately five GPU-hours. Separately, a seven-day randomized online evaluation estimated a 0.66% relative increase in the VDD slice of Good Search Result Rate for Retention (GSRR).

AI.tldr: 本文提出EvoPilot——一种人类把关的长周期在线自动研究方法，通过角色化智能体、版本化领域技能、类型化适配器、持久记录与确定性检查保障实验有效性，并在37天VDD检索系统研究中修正评测缺陷、取得离线+3.20pp与在线GSRR相对提升0.66%的结果。
AI.motivation: 现有autoresearch多局限于分钟级、自包含程序的短周期迭代；而真实在线自动研究涉及异步系统、数小时至数周的长周期实验，且成品运行仍可能因空操作代码变更、数据窗口泄漏、评测语义漂移或两组实验经由不同服务漏斗而产生无效结论。因此需要一个面向长周期在线场景、以人类把关与有效性校验为核心的自动研究方法。
AI.method: EvoPilot采用人类把关（human-gated）的长周期在线autoresearch流程：每轮由角色专用智能体通过版本化的领域技能（domain skill）和类型化适配器（typed adapter）执行；持久化记录保存实验与失败；确定性检查（deterministic checks）强制落实已记录的教训。方法上还包括人类把关的验证、匹配对比（matched comparison）、研究后重放与变异测试，以及持久状态恢复与工件复用。
AI.result: 在37天、覆盖七个方向、基于数亿视频小时级刷新索引的VDD检索系统研究中：早期人工实验未证明交互头有收益，一次原始autoresearch尝试将离线命中率下降22个百分点错误归因于该交互头；引入EvoPilot后，人类把关验证定位到该下降源于既有评测缺陷（输出深度为3,000与600），修复后匹配对比测得离线提升3.20个百分点。重放与变异测试拒绝了无效对比、接纳了有效对比；持久状态恢复了一个被中断的轮次；工件复用节省约5个GPU小时；另经7天随机在线评估，VDD切片上GSRR相对提升0.66%。
AI.conclusion: EvoPilot证明在长周期在线自动研究中，人类把关、持久状态、确定性检查与工件复用可有效防止无效归因与评测缺陷导致的错误结论，同时支持有效优化：在VDD检索系统中实现离线+3.20pp与在线GSRR相对+0.66%的可信收益，并降低算力开销。

title: Hybrid GPU-CPU Retrieval for Personalized Search at Ultra-Large Scale
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. ACM sigconf format; submitted to the KDD 2027 Applied Data Science Track
summary:
Embedding-based retrieval on user-generated content at the trillion-document scale exposes a sharp conflict between two production demands: deep, expressive personalization for queries with rich user intent, and broad coverage of a massive inventory under fixed latency and resource budgets. We characterize this as the personalization-scale paradox: hosting the full serving inventory in GPU memory is too resource intensive, while CPU compute cannot execute the same interaction-heavy model on the latency-critical path.
  We present a hybrid GPU-CPU co-serving system that resolves the paradox through orchestration rather than a new model class. A high-depth GPU pathway fuses retrieval and interaction pre-ranking over a curated online pool on the order of a billion documents, while a high-breadth CPU pathway searches an independently selected online inventory roughly twenty times larger with lightweight personalized scoring. Either or both pathways can run per request; candidates are deduplicated before shared downstream ranking.
  The system is deployed in production. A full-system A/B test against the legacy CPU-only configuration improves model-scored relevance and substantive engagement, while separate pathway experiments show positive value at their own deployment scopes. Retrieval logs show that the pathways contribute structurally distinct candidates, production serving measurements characterize their latency, and a matched capacity plan quantifies the economic rationale for assigning modeling depth to GPUs and inventory breadth to CPUs. Together, these results validate a practical, independently evolvable depth-breadth architecture for ultra-large-scale personalized search.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种GPU-CPU混合协同服务架构，通过编排而非新模型来解决超大规模个性化检索中"深度与广度"冲突的悖论，并在生产环境验证其有效性与经济性。
AI.motivation: 在万亿级用户生成内容上的嵌入检索面临"个性化-规模悖论"：深度表达性个性化与大规模库存覆盖在固定延迟与资源预算下相互冲突。将全部服务库存放入GPU显存资源开销过大，而CPU无法在延迟关键的路径上运行同样交互密集的模型。
AI.method: 提出混合GPU-CPU协同服务系统，通过编排解决悖论：GPU高深度路径在约十亿文档的精选在线池上融合检索与交互式预排序；CPU高广度路径以轻量个性化打分搜索约二十倍规模的独立在线库存。每条请求可运行一条或两条路径，候选在共享下游排序前去重。
AI.result: 系统已部署生产。与仅用CPU的旧配置进行全系统A/B测试，模型打分相关性与实质性互动均有提升；分路径实验在各自部署范围内也显示正向价值。检索日志表明两条路径贡献结构上不同的候选；生产服务测量刻画了其延迟；匹配容量规划量化了"GPU负责建模深度、CPU负责库存广度"的经济性依据。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果验证了一种实用、可独立演进的"深度-广度"架构，适用于超大规模个性化搜索。

title: Auto-Bidding with Disentangled Advertiser Profiles and Train-Free Adaptation
summary: Auto-bidding is a key component of modern advertising systems that provides a personalized bidding strategy for each advertiser. By characterizing each individual, profile-based methods achieve personalization and have proven effective in domains such as recommendation. However, despite the diverse bidding behavior of advertisers, their application to auto-bidding remains limited. A primary reason is that constructing and leveraging advertiser profiles face several challenges: extracting pure profiles is non-trivial, modeling common and private information simultaneously is difficult, and profile updating and cold-start adaptation remain challenging. To tackle these issues, we propose \textbf{ADAPT}, an \underline{\textbf{A}}uto-bidding framework with \underline{\textbf{D}}isentangled \underline{\textbf{A}}dvertiser \underline{\textbf{P}}rofiles and \underline{\textbf{T}}raining-free adaptation. ADAPT introduces a two-stage training paradigm and supports training-free adaptation. Specifically, (i) the stage 1 extracts pure static and dynamic profiles via contrastive learning over the advertiser memory bank; (ii) the stage 2 disentangles the dynamic profile into a common profile and a private profile, and combines them with the static profile to jointly condition the bidding strategy; (iii) once trained, ADAPT constructs profiles for new advertisers and updates profiles of existing advertisers without retraining. Our experiments on a large-scale auto-bidding benchmark demonstrate that ADAPT consistently achieves superior performance, and ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of each module. The source code will be released at https://github.com/YuzunoKawori/ADAPT.

AI.tldr: 提出 ADAPT 自动出价框架，通过解耦广告主画像与免训练自适应，提升个性化出价效果。
AI.motivation: 基于画像的个性化方法在推荐等领域有效，但在自动出价中应用有限。主要挑战在于：难以提取纯净画像、难以同时建模共性与私有信息、画像更新与冷启动自适应困难。
AI.method: ADAPT 采用两阶段训练范式并支持免训练自适应：(i) 阶段一通过广告主记忆库上的对比学习提取纯净的静态与动态画像；(ii) 阶段二将动态画像解耦为共性画像与私有画像，并与静态画像结合以联合条件化出价策略；(iii) 训练完成后，无需重新训练即可为新广告主构建画像、为既有广告主更新画像。
AI.result: 在大规模自动出价基准上，ADAPT 持续取得更优性能，消融实验进一步验证了各模块的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ADAPT 通过画像解耦与免训练自适应，有效应对自动出价中的画像构建、建模与更新难题，代码将开源。

title: Adaptive Preference Modeling via Explicit Indirect Relational Learning for Personalized Fashion Matching
summary: Personalized fashion complementary recommendation requires jointly modeling user preferences and item compatibility under sparse and multimodal data conditions. Existing approaches often capture higher-order relational signals implicitly through graph propagation or rely on direct interaction data, limiting their ability to explicitly model indirect preference and compatibility relationships. To address this limitation, we propose an Adaptive Preference with Contrastive Learning framework (APCL) that explicitly models both direct and indirect relational signals within a unified recommendation architecture. Specifically, APCL constructs indirect user-item and item-item relationships through a correlation-guided adaptive aggregation mechanism and represents them as dedicated personalization and compatibility views. To improve representation learning, we further introduce a functional view contrastive learning strategy that aligns direct and indirect preference representations and direct and indirect compatibility representations, encouraging consistency across relational contexts. By integrating multimodal visual and textual information with explicit indirect relational modeling, APCL captures richer semantic characteristics while improving robustness in sparse-interaction settings. Experiments on two benchmark fashion recommendation datasets demonstrate that APCL consistently outperforms representative baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出APCL框架，通过相关性引导的自适应聚合显式建模直接与间接的用户-物品和物品-物品关系，并引入功能视图对比学习对齐直接与间接偏好/兼容性表示，结合多模态信息提升稀疏交互下的时尚互补推荐性能。
AI.motivation: 个性化时尚互补推荐需要在稀疏且多模态的数据条件下同时建模用户偏好与物品兼容性。现有方法多通过图传播隐式捕获高阶关系信号，或依赖直接交互数据，难以显式建模间接的偏好与兼容性关系，从而限制了表达能力。
AI.method: 提出APCL（Adaptive Preference with Contrastive Learning）框架：1）通过相关性引导的自适应聚合机制构建间接的用户-物品与物品-物品关系，并将其表示为个性化视图和兼容性视图；2）引入功能视图对比学习策略，对齐直接与间接的偏好表示、直接与间接的兼容性表示，以增强跨关系上下文的一致性；3）融合多模态视觉与文本信息与显式间接关系建模。
AI.result: 在两个基准时尚推荐数据集上的实验表明，APCL持续优于代表性基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模间接关系并结合对比学习与多模态信息，可捕获更丰富的语义特征，并在稀疏交互场景下提升鲁棒性与推荐性能。

title: Predictable Failure in Multi-Hop Retrieval: Score-Distributional Confidence Scoring and Abstention
summary: Multi-hop retrieval failures are not uniformly distributed across queries: they cluster in structurally predictable subpopulations. We prove two results formalizing this structure. First (CWAR Reducibility): confident-failure reduction is achievable if and only if retrieval features carry mutual information about success, a condition satisfied by LLM-judge pipelines but substantially weaker in dense-only settings, explaining the AUC-AC gap between regimes. Second (Feature Regime Complementarity): no single ANN score feature achieves best predictive performance across all failure regimes; the dominant feature differs between datasets (query length on MuSiQue, hop-1 concentration on HoVer), and a constructive witness pair shows each is necessary in one regime and non-contributory in the other. We instantiate these principles in RegimeAbstain, which computes a Retrieval Confidence Score (RCS), a logistic function of up to nine query-ANN structural features, all available without any additional LLM call, and uses it to implement a calibrated abstention policy. We define the Confident-Wrong-Answer Rate (CWAR) metric and evaluate across three multi-hop benchmarks (MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA, HoVer) and two retrieval architectures (LLM-judge and dense-only), covering five failure regimes with CWAR from 14.5% to 62.1%. RCS achieves best or co-best AUC-AC in all five conditions against eight confidence baselines. On MuSiQue (LLM-judge), RCS reduces CWAR from 39.5% to 20.6% at 50% coverage (47.8% relative reduction), with ECE=0.035. A model trained on MuSiQue transfers to 2WikiMultiHopQA with only -0.5pp AUC loss, confirming the domain-agnostic structure of regime features.

AI.tldr: 论文提出多跳检索失败具有结构性分布规律，并通过CWAR可归约性与特征机制互补性两个定理加以形式化，实例化为RegimeAbstain方法，显著降低置信错误率并具跨数据集迁移性。
AI.motivation: 多跳检索的失败并非在查询间均匀分布，而是聚集于结构上可预测的子群体；现有置信度方法与仅依赖稠密检索的设置难以有效抑制"置信但错误"的失败。
AI.method: 证明两个定理：CWAR可归约性（当且仅当检索特征携带关于成功的互信息时，置信失败可归约）与特征机制互补性（无单一ANN分数特征在所有失败机制下最优）。据此提出RegimeAbstain，计算由最多九个查询-ANN结构特征构成的检索置信分数RCS（逻辑函数形式，无需额外LLM调用），并实现校准弃答策略，定义CWAR指标。
AI.result: 在三个多跳基准（MuSiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA、HoVer）与两种检索架构（LLM-judge、dense-only）的五个失败机制（CWAR 14.5%–62.1%）上，RCS在AUC-AC上对标八个置信基线取得最优或并列最优。MuSiQue（LLM-judge）上50%覆盖率时将CWAR从39.5%降至20.6%（相对下降47.8%），ECE=0.035；MuSiQue训练的模型迁移至2WikiMultiHopQA仅损失0.5个百分点AUC。
AI.conclusion: 多跳检索失败具备机制相关的可预测结构，RCS与校准弃答可有效降低置信错误且具域无关性，验证了机制特征的跨数据集可迁移性。

title: AutoRecLab: Describe the Experiment, Get the Code!
comment: Accepted at the 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys '26), Demo Track. 4 pages, 2 figures
summary: Empirical evaluation is central to recommender-systems (RecSys) research, but turning experimental designs into executable code remains a manual and error-prone task. We present AutoRecLab, a Python-based autonomous RecSys lab that automates RecSys experiments from natural-language prompts. Given a research idea, AutoRecLab derives explicit experiment requirements, builds and validates a prototype, and iteratively expands it into the requested full experiment. The workflow combines retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for documentation lookup, static type verification, and execution-steered tree search. In our demonstration, AutoRecLab autonomously implements an explicit-to-implicit feedback conversion study. In a baseline comparison across six algorithms and three datasets, 8 of 9 runs succeed at an average cost of approx- imately $1 per run with GPT-5.4-mini.

AI.tldr: 提出 AutoRecLab：一个基于 Python 的自主推荐系统实验框架，可将自然语言研究想法自动转化为可执行实验代码并完成端到端评估。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统（RecSys）研究中经验评估至关重要，但从实验设计到可执行代码的转化过程高度依赖人工、容易出错，缺乏自动化手段。
AI.method: AutoRecLab 接收自然语言提示，先推导出显式实验需求，构建并验证原型，再迭代扩展为完整实验。工作流融合了面向文档检索的检索增强生成（RAG）、静态类型验证以及执行引导的树搜索（execution-steered tree search）。
AI.result: 在演示中，AutoRecLab 自主实现了一项显式反馈到隐式反馈转换的研究。在覆盖 6 种算法、3 个数据集的基线对比中，9 次运行有 8 次成功，使用 GPT-5.4-mini 时平均每次运行成本约 1 美元。
AI.conclusion: AutoRecLab 展示了以低成本自动化推荐系统实验流程的可行性，能够以自然语言驱动实现从需求推导到完整实验执行的全流程。

title: RBS-Attention: Radius-Bounded Sparse Prefill for Long-Context Large Language Models
summary: Long-context large language model inference is increasingly limited by prefill, where dense self-attention processes the entire prompt before generation begins. Sparse block selection can reduce this cost, but a block centroid may hide a highly relevant token among many irrelevant ones. We call this failure mode mean dilution and propose RBS-Attention, a training-free sparse-prefill method with two complementary selection branches. A centroid base branch captures average relevance, while a rescue branch uses the maximum key-block radius and its prompt-, layer-, and head-dependent distribution to identify blocks at risk of underestimation. Independently thresholding the two branches and combining their masks controls the contribution of rescue blocks while preserving regular block-sparse FlashAttention execution. On H100 GPUs, RBS-Attention achieves 20.65$\times$ standalone prefill-attention speedup, 11.92$\times$ vLLM prefill-attention speedup, and 5.97$\times$ end-to-end time-to-first-token speedup at 128K on Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-FP8. On the dense Qwen3-32B model, it obtains 88.65 overall RULER accuracy versus 89.52 for dense attention; LongBench-v2, InfiniteBench, and Video-MME provide additional quality evaluation.
