Supporting experiments measure actual retention, compare selectors at matched density, and characterize block-size, threshold, and memory behavior. Together, these results support radius-adaptive dual-branch selection as an effective approach to long-context prefill.

AI.tldr: 提出 RBS-Attention，一种免训练的稀疏预填充方法，通过质心基分支与救援分支双路选择，缓解"均值稀释"问题，在保持精度的同时大幅加速长上下文推理。
AI.motivation: 长上下文 LLM 推理瓶颈在预填充阶段，密集自注意力需处理整个提示。稀疏块选择可降低成本，但块质心可能掩盖块内少数高度相关的 token（即"均值稀释"失效模式），导致重要块被低估。
AI.method: RBS-Attention 为免训练稀疏预填充方法，含两条互补选择分支：质心基分支捕捉平均相关性；救援分支利用最大 key 块半径及其依赖 prompt、层、头的分布，识别有被低估风险的块。两分支独立阈值化并合并掩码，以控制救援块贡献，同时保留常规块稀疏 FlashAttention 执行。
AI.result: H100 上，Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-FP8、128K 时：独立预填充注意力加速 20.65×，vLLM 预填充注意力加速 11.92×，端到端首 token 时间加速 5.97×。密集 Qwen3-32B 上 RULER 总分 88.65，对比密集注意力 89.52；另在 LongBench-v2、InfiniteBench、Video-MME 上评测质量。辅助实验测量实际保留率、同密度下比较选择器，并刻画块大小、阈值与内存行为。
AI.conclusion: 半径自适应双分支选择是长上下文预填充的有效方案，兼顾显著加速与近乎无损的精度。

title: Attention-Aware Routing: Coupling Routing and Attention in MoEs
summary: In Mixture-of-Experts language models, the router typically selects and weights experts based on the token's hidden state, utilizing limited contextual information. We propose Attention-Aware Routing (AAR), which augments the router with temporal and spectral features extracted from a sliding window of attention weights that represent a summary of the model's contextual state, disentangled from the hidden state. Keeping the base transformer entirely frozen, we train only the routing parameters, isolating routing as the sole variable. AAR improves GSM8K by +3.37 pp over a routing-only SFT baseline on OLMoE. Beyond performance, we show that routing and attention form a coupled circuit: routing changes at layer l propagate through the residual stream to amplify attention sinks at layer l+1, reshaping attention without any direct update to the attention mechanism itself. Further, AAR reduces long diverging generation, with incorrect answers getting shorter, while correct answers remain unchanged in length. Finally, AAR is strongly depth-sensitive: applying it indiscriminately across layers can degrade factual retrieval, whereas mathematical reasoning gains persist when it is introduced deeper in the network. This sensitivity exposes a retrieval--reasoning tension across depth and makes layer-selective AAR a controlled probe of the routing-relevant information carried by attention at different layers.

AI.tldr: 提出注意力感知路由(AAR)，用注意力权重滑窗特征增强路由器，冻结主干仅训练路由参数，提升推理能力并揭示路由-注意力耦合机制。
AI.motivation: MoE路由器仅依赖当前token隐状态，上下文信息有限；作者希望在不改动主干模型的前提下，为路由引入更丰富的上下文表征，并借此隔离路由这一单一变量来研究其作用。
AI.method: 提出AAR：从注意力权重滑动窗口中提取时序与频域特征，作为路由器输入，这些特征被视为模型上下文状态的摘要，且与隐状态解耦。保持基础Transformer完全冻结，只训练路由参数。
AI.result: 在OLMoE上，AAR相对仅路由SFT基线在GSM8K上提升+3.37个百分点；路由与注意力构成耦合回路：第l层路由变化经残差流传播，放大第l+1层注意力汇，重塑注意力；减少长发散生成，错误答案变短而正确答案长度不变；AAR呈强深度敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 路由与注意力存在耦合回路，且不同深度承载的信息不同；跨层盲目应用AAR会损害事实检索，而数学推理收益在更深层引入时仍保持，揭示深度上的检索-推理张力，使层选择性AAR成为探测各层注意力所携带路由相关信息的受控手段。

title: CaLR: Causal Latent Revision for Robust Diffusion Reasoning
summary: Autoregressive (AR) models suffer from local greediness, while diffusion language models (DLMs) often lack the strict causal structure required for reasoning. To combine the advantages and overcome the drawbacks of the dual, we propose Causal Latent Revision (CaLR), a framework that reformulates reasoning as constrained latent optimization. By adopting a causal topology matrix (CTM) from an expert model and implicit differentiation, CaLR performs gradient-guided ``thought revision" to enforce logical consistency, enabling dynamic self-correction of intermediate steps during parallel generation. Empirically, CaLR achieves SOTA DLM performance on complex benchmarks, surpassing strong AR baselines and demonstrating superior robustness in constrained tasks like Sudoku.

AI.tldr: 提出Causal Latent Revision (CaLR)框架，将推理重新表述为受约束的隐空间优化，融合自回归模型与扩散语言模型优势，通过因果拓扑矩阵与隐式微分实现梯度引导的"思维修正"。
AI.motivation: 自回归(AR)模型存在局部贪心问题，而扩散语言模型(DLM)往往缺乏推理所需的严格因果结构。为兼具两者优势并克服各自缺陷，需一种统一方法。
AI.method: CaLR采用来自专家模型的因果拓扑矩阵(CTM)与隐式微分，执行梯度引导的"思维修正"以强制逻辑一致性，从而在并行生成过程中对中间步骤进行动态自我纠正。
AI.result: 在复杂基准上，CaLR取得DLM的SOTA性能，超越强AR基线，并在数独等受约束任务上展现出更优的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CaLR通过受约束隐空间优化有效结合AR与DLM优势，实现并行生成中的动态自纠错，验证了因果结构约束对推理任务的增益。

title: LoRA Enhanced Contrastive Learning with SAS Vision Transformers
summary: Automatic target recognition (ATR) with synthetic aperture sonar (SAS) supports advanced naval capabilities, but deep learning is constrained by scarce target imagery, background clutter, and human-in-the-loop assessment. We adapt DINOv3 Vision Transformer (ViT) models to underwater SAS ATR using a three-stage parameter-efficient framework. Stage 1 uses Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) while freezing the ViT backbone, bridging the gap between natural-image pretraining and underwater acoustic propagation. Stage 2 uses hard-negative mining to strengthen the decision boundary against acoustic mimics, including rocks and sediment formations resembling man-made targets. Stage 3 uses Supervised Contrastive Learning (SupCon) to separate target and clutter representations. We evaluate at-sea SAS data using a mission-level geographic split, compare all arms at 85 percent test recall, and repeat each comparison over three random seeds. LoRA accounts for the primary effect, increasing area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) from 0.300 to 0.679 +/- 0.027 using the same frozen backbone. Rank 4 achieves this result while training only 0.26 percent of weights. Neither refinement stage exceeds its matched control: hard-negative mining changes AUPRC by -0.0045 +/- 0.0119 versus an equal-size random curriculum, and SupCon changes AUPRC by +0.0002 +/- 0.0096 versus the preceding stage. These null results indicate that mining occurred on data the encoder had already fit and that supervised stages had already imposed most target-clutter geometry. One efficient adaptation stage is sufficient; stacked refinement is not.

AI.tldr: 将DINOv3 ViT经LoRA参数高效适配到水下合成孔径声呐ATR，LoRA带来主要增益（AUPRC 0.300→0.679），而后续的难负样本挖掘与SupCon精炼阶段均未超过对照，表明单一适配阶段已足够。
AI.motivation: 合成孔径声呐自动目标识别对海军能力有重要价值，但深度学习受限于目标图像稀缺、背景杂波强以及依赖人工在环评估，因此需要参数高效的适配方案，弥合自然图像预训练与水下声传播之间的域差异。
AI.method: 采用三阶段参数高效框架适配DINOv3 ViT：阶段1冻结ViT主干，仅用LoRA（秩4，仅训练0.26%权重）；阶段2用难负样本挖掘强化对声学仿似物（岩石、沉积物等）的决策边界；阶段3用监督对比学习分离目标与杂波表示。基于海上SAS实拍数据、按任务级地理划分评估，统一在85%测试召回率下比较，并对每个对比重复3个随机种子。
AI.result: LoRA为主要的效应来源，在同一冻结主干下将AUPRC从0.300提升至0.679±0.027，秩4即达到该结果。两个精炼阶段均未超过匹配对照：难负样本挖掘相对等规模随机课程使AUPRC变化-0.0045±0.0119；SupCon相对前一阶段变化+0.0002±0.0096，二者均为零结果。
AI.conclusion: 零结果表明难负样本挖掘作用在编码器已经拟合的数据上，且监督阶段已施加了大部分目标—杂波几何结构。因此一个高效的适配阶段即已足够，堆叠式多阶段精炼并非必要。

title: Detecting Hallucination in LLMs: Tracing the Topological Signatures of Impaired Context Sharing
summary: In this work, we examine the topology of information flow patterns within attention graphs to effectively distinguish hallucinated from non-hallucinated responses. We analyze the Forman-Ricci curvature to identify structural patterns indicating information bottlenecks in attention graphs. We then introduce a method that captures both semi-local and global information-flow characteristics of attention heads associated with hallucinated responses. We evaluate our approach extensively across several LLMs and established benchmarks. Empirical results demonstrate that our proposed single-pass approach provides consistent improvements over existing attention-based and multi-response baselines across two hallucination-detection benchmarks, while achieving competitive performance across diverse LLM architectures. Further analysis reveals that impaired context sharing among tokens during causal generation is strongly associated with hallucination occurrences in LLMs. In particular, hallucinated responses are consistently characterized by an over-reliance on self-attention, diffused context retrieval from earlier tokens, or information over-squashing, especially in the final transformer layer.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析注意力图的拓扑结构与Forman-Ricci曲率，捕捉注意力头的信息流特征，提出一种单次前向传播的幻觉检测方法，在多个LLM与基准上优于现有注意力类和多响应基线。
AI.motivation: 幻觉检测对LLM可靠性至关重要。现有方法多依赖多响应采样或仅利用注意力权重，缺乏对注意力图内部信息流动结构（如信息瓶颈）的刻画，难以有效区分幻觉与非幻觉响应。
AI.method: 将注意力图视为信息流网络，利用Forman-Ricci曲率识别表征信息瓶颈的结构模式；提出同时捕捉与幻觉响应相关注意力头的半局部与全局信息流特征的方法，实现单次前向传播的检测。
AI.result: 在多个LLM和两个幻觉检测基准上，该单次传播方法相较现有基于注意力和多响应的基线取得一致的性能提升，并在多种LLM架构上保持有竞争力的表现。
AI.conclusion: 幻觉响应与因果生成过程中token间上下文共享受损密切相关，典型表现为过度依赖自注意力、对早期token的上下文检索分散，以及信息过度压缩（over-squashing），尤其在最后一个transformer层中尤为明显。

title: Decoupling Internal Representational Changes and Causal Importance in Fine-Tuned Large Language Models
summary: Fine-tuning has emerged as a widely adopted approach for adapting LLMs to a variety of downstream tasks. However, how it reshapes their internal mechanisms remains poorly understood. To address this, we investigate how fine-tuning alters internal representations in LLMs, including attention patterns and layer-wise activations, and examine whether these changes are linked to task-relevant components identified by EAP (e.g., attention heads and logit-level activations) that drive task performance. We find that EAP-identified components are concentrated within specific layers, indicating a degree of functional localisation in how models internalise task-specific behavior. Notably, the distribution of these components across layers is largely uncorrelated with the layers undergoing the most substantial representational changes during fine-tuning. Furthermore, we observe that overlap in EAP-identified components across tasks does not translate into cross-task performance transfer if the tasks are different in nature (e.g. classification vs. generative tasks). More specifically, fine-tuning on one task can lead to a degradation of performance on another when the two tasks exhibit a high degree of overlap in their EAP-identified components.

AI.tldr: 本文研究微调如何重塑LLM内部表征，发现EAP识别的任务关键组件集中于特定层，但其分布与微调中表征变化最大的层基本不相关；跨任务的EAP组件重叠在任务性质不同时不带来性能迁移，反而可能导致性能下降。
AI.motivation: 微调已成为适配LLM下游任务的常用方法，但其如何改变模型内部机制仍缺乏理解。作者希望探究微调对内部表征（注意力模式、逐层激活）的影响，并检验这些变化是否与EAP识别的任务关键组件（注意力头、logit级激活）相关联。
AI.method: 分析微调前后LLM的内部表征，包括注意力模式和逐层激活；使用EAP（基于激活的路径/组件识别方法）定位驱动任务表现的组件（注意力头与logit级激活）；比较EAP组件分布与表征变化最大的层，并考察跨任务EAP组件重叠与性能迁移的关系。
AI.result: EAP识别的组件集中在特定层，表明模型内部化任务特定行为存在一定程度的功能局部化；这些组件的层分布与微调中发生显著表征变化的层基本不相关；跨任务的EAP组件重叠在任务性质不同（如分类与生成）时并不转化为跨任务性能迁移；具体而言，当一个任务的微调与另一任务在EAP组件上高度重叠时，前者可能导致后者性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 微调引起的表征变化与EAP识别的任务关键组件在层级上并不对应，说明功能局部化与表征漂移是相对独立的现象；EAP组件的跨任务重叠不能简单预测正向迁移，任务性质差异下甚至预示负迁移，这对理解微调机制与任务适配策略具有启示。

title: TinyCeNN-LM: Quality-Gated Conversion of Pretrained Attention with CeNN-Inspired Cellular-Recurrent Layers
summary: Replacing attention in a pretrained language model is a compatibility problem: a plausible substitute may alter representations expected by later layers. TinyCeNN-LM introduces a \emph{quality-gated post-training conversion} framework using CeNN-inspired cellular-recurrent layers with bounded local processing, compact recurrent memory, routing, fusion, and accept-or-rollback validation. Three implementations are studied: Integrated Memory, MemoryFusion, and PDelta3-GDN2-CLVR+Local32. Strict PDelta3 conversion accepts a layer only when representation and NLL criteria pass fixed thresholds. On SmolLM2-135M, layers 0-2 are accepted with cumulative $Δ\mathrm{NLL}=+0.01209$, while layer 3 is rejected despite acceptable NLL because representation fidelity fails. On Qwen3.5-0.8B, full-attention layers 3, 7, and 11 are accepted with final $Δ\mathrm{NLL}=+0.02073$. Integrated Memory keeps perplexity within $-0.07\%$ to $+0.93\%$ while reducing total cache by up to $6.01\%$. A sampled 200-item downstream sanity check gives $28.5\%$--$32.0\%$ overall accuracy for converted Qwen releases. The results support conservative, quality-gated structural conversion rather than universal attention replacement or speedup.

AI.tldr: TinyCeNN-LM 提出"质量门控后训练转换"框架，用类 CeNN 的细胞循环层替换预训练语言模型中的注意力层，仅在表示保真度与 NLL 双阈值同时通过时接受替换，否则回滚。在 SmolLM2-135M 与 Qwen3.5-0.8B 上验证了保守转换的可行性。
AI.motivation: 直接替换预训练语言模型中的注意力机制存在兼容性问题：看似合理的替代层可能改变后续层所依赖的表示。因此需要一个带质量门控、可回滚的保守转换流程，而非追求普适的注意力替换或加速。
AI.method: 提出质量门控后训练转换框架（quality-gated post-training conversion），采用受 CeNN 启发的细胞循环层，具备有界局部处理、紧凑循环记忆、路由、融合以及"接受或回滚"验证机制。研究三种实现：Integrated Memory、MemoryFusion、PDelta3-GDN2-CLVR+Local32。严格 PDelta3 转换仅当表示与 NLL 指标均通过固定阈值时才接受该层。
AI.result: SmolLM2-135M 上，第 0-2 层被接受，累计 ΔNLL=+0.01209；第 3 层虽 NLL 可接受但因表示保真度不达标被拒绝。Qwen3.5-0.8B 上，全注意力层 3、7、11 被接受，最终 ΔNLL=+0.02073。Integrated Memory 将困惑度变化控制在 -0.07%~+0.93%，总缓存最多减少 6.01%。对转换后 Qwen 版本抽样 200 项下游检查，总体准确率为 28.5%~32.0%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持采用保守的、质量门控的结构转换策略，而非通用的注意力替换或加速方案；转换的可行性与收益受表示保真度约束。

title: Clinician-Grounded Quality Assurance for AI-Assisted Psychiatric Intake
summary: Before patients can use AI-assisted psychiatric intake systems, health systems need practical ways to routinely evaluate these tools against their clinical standards for quality assurance. Because clinicians may use different intake styles, evaluation for this task must (1) support comparison across interviewing approaches, (2) minimize clinician burden, and (3) measure clinically relevant performance for health systems deploying these technologies. We present a clinician-grounded evaluation platform built around a memory-augmented patient simulator for open-ended AI interviewing, InterviewPlayground. We created interactive patients using InterviewPlayground with our expert-authored vignettes, constructed a simulated intake platform for the interviews, and designed evaluation modalities relevant to intake. In a pilot of 6 clinicians in a 25-minute assessment compared to a GPT-based LLM intake interviewer, the LLM recovered more of the clinically relevant items embedded in the patient vignettes (88.0% vs. 38.9%), but made more clinical inferences not based on the interview (56.8% vs. 27.8%), and characterized identified safety concerns less often (33.3% vs. 66.7%), setting the stage for deployed quality assurance for this task.

AI.tldr: 提出临床医生导向的评估平台InterviewPlayground，用记忆增强患者模拟器支持开放式AI问诊的对比评估，并在6名临床医生试点中验证其可行性与临床相关性。
AI.motivation: AI辅助精神科问诊系统在部署前需要常规化、可操作的质量评估手段。由于临床医生的问诊风格各异，评估须满足三点：支持不同问诊方式的横向比较、降低临床医生负担、测量对部署机构有临床意义的性能。
AI.method: 构建以记忆增强患者模拟器为核心的临床医生导向评估平台InterviewPlayground；将专家撰写的病例脚本转化为可交互患者；搭建模拟问诊平台；设计面向问诊任务的评估模态；开展6名临床医生的25分钟试点评估，并与基于GPT的LLM问诊者进行对比。
AI.result: LLM问诊者从病例脚本中提取临床相关条目更多（88.0% vs. 38.9%），但产生更多无问诊依据的临床推断（56.8% vs. 27.8%），且对已识别安全问题的特征描述更少（33.3% vs. 66.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 该平台为AI辅助精神科问诊任务的部署质量保证提供了可行基础，并揭示了LLM在信息采集覆盖度与临床推断可靠性、安全风险评估方面的权衡。

title: Can Agents Design Better Chips with a Higher Level Abstraction?
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly being explored for chip design, but most existing approaches operate directly at RTL. We ask whether agents can design better chips by leveraging higher-level abstractions. We compare Direct RTL Design, Agent-based HLS Design, Post-Compiler HLS Refinement, and Post-HLS RTL Refinement, and combine Agent-based HLS Design with Post-HLS RTL Refinement as Agent-based HLS with RTL Refinement (AHRR). We use FPGAs as a practical, easy-to-deploy platform for end-to-end evaluation, but note that the design-flow tradeoffs we study are largely independent of the target technology. Across a diverse 11-tasks benchmark suite, AHRR achieves a 2.6$\times$ geometric-mean speedup over Direct RTL Design across our benchmark suite. Case studies show that HLS distills design knowledge into abstractions that agents can leverage, while RTL refinement recovers lower-level optimization opportunities. Together, these results make AHRR a promising workflow for agentic chip design. The code and evaluation artifacts are available at https://github.com/ZijD/AHRR.

AI.tldr: 该论文比较了四种LLM智能体芯片设计流程，提出将智能体HLS设计与HLS后RTL精炼结合的AHRR方法，在11项FPGA基准测试中实现相对直接RTL设计2.6倍的几何平均加速。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体芯片设计方法大多直接在RTL层面操作，未能充分利用更高层次抽象来提升设计质量。作者试图探究：智能体能否借助更高层次抽象设计出更好的芯片。
AI.method: 对比四种设计流程：直接RTL设计、智能体HLS设计、编译器后HLS精炼、HLS后RTL精炼，并将智能体HLS设计与HLS后RTL精炼组合为AHRR。以FPGA作为便于部署的端到端评估平台，在11项多样化任务基准上评测。
AI.result: AHRR在11项任务基准上相比直接RTL设计取得2.6倍几何平均加速。案例研究表明，HLS将设计知识蒸馏为智能体可利用的抽象，而RTL精炼则恢复底层优化机会。
AI.conclusion: 结合高层次HLS抽象与低层次RTL精炼的AHRR是面向智能体芯片设计的有前景工作流，且所研究的设计流权衡在很大程度上与目标工艺无关。

title: SpecOpt: Contact-Diff Reasoning for Agentic Molecule Optimization Toward Binding Specificity
summary: Off-target protein binding is a major source of adverse effects for small-molecule drugs, yet most structure-based molecular design methods focus on generating selective compounds de novo rather than improving the selectivity of existing, well- characterized drugs. We introduce specificity optimization (SpecOpt), a molecular design task that seeks constrained structural modifications to an existing compound that increase its binding preference for an intended target over known off-targets while preserving its structural identity and drug-like properties. To enable systematic evaluation, we construct a ChEMBL-derived benchmark from compound-target interaction data, identifying intended targets through curated drug-mechanism annotations and off- targets through measured activities. We then develop an agentic framework that docks each compound against its intended target and off-targets, compares the resulting poses through residue-aware atom-protein contacts, and provides these differential interactions to a large language model to propose targeted structural modifications. Candidates are retained only if they satisfy molecular similarity, ADMET, and target-off-target docking selectivity criteria. On 915 compounds, the agent improves the target- off-target binding gap for 84.8% of compounds, shifting the mean gap from -0.72 to +0.47 kcal/mol while maintaining a mean Tanimoto similarity of 0.72 to the starting compounds. Ablation studies identify residue-specific contact information as the critical optimization signal: replacing residue identities with binary contact indicators eliminates improvement on all 29 ablation compounds. These results establish SpecOpt as a distinct molecular design problem and demonstrate residue-aware differential interactions as an effective signal for improving the specificity of existing compounds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"特异性优化"(SpecOpt)任务及智能体框架,通过对已有药物进行受约束的结构修饰,提升其对目标靶点相对已知脱靶靶点的结合偏好。
AI.motivation: 脱靶蛋白结合是小分子药物产生不良反应的主要来源,但现有基于结构的分子设计方法多关注从头生成选择性化合物,而非改善已有、表征充分的药物的选择性。
AI.method: 1) 定义SpecOpt任务:在保持结构同一性和成药性的约束下,对现有化合物做结构修饰以增强其对目标靶点相对脱靶靶点的结合偏好。2) 基于ChEMBL化合物-靶点相互作用数据构建基准数据集,通过药物机制注释确定目标靶点,通过实测活性确定脱靶靶点。3) 开发智能体框架:将化合物分别对接至目标靶点和脱靶靶点,通过残基感知的原子-蛋白接触比较对接构象,将差异性相互作用输入大语言模型以生成针对性的结构修饰;候选分子需通过分子相似性、ADMET及靶点-脱靶靶点对接选择性筛选。
AI.result: 在915个化合物上,该智能体使84.8%的化合物目标-脱靶结合差距得到改善,平均差距从-0.72 kcal/mol提升至+0.47 kcal/mol,同时与起始化合物的平均Tanimoto相似度为0.72。消融实验表明残基特异性的接触信息是关键优化信号:将残基身份替换为二值接触指示符后,29个消融化合物上均无改善。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了SpecOpt作为一个独立的分子设计问题,并证明残基感知的差异性相互作用是提升现有化合物特异性的有效信号。

title: Implicit Rule Induction with Test-Time Task Embeddings in ARC-like Tasks
summary: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus and related benchmarks evaluate whether AI models can solve novel reasoning tasks, but often leave unclear whether success reflects inference of the intended underlying rule or reliance on shortcuts. We address this gap by studying test-time task embeddings in Vision ARC (VARC), a model in which a pre-trained backbone is complemented by a trainable embedding representing the transformation rule. In the original VARC, test-time training (TTT) is jointly applied to the backbone and task embedding. Here we introduce a novel two-step TTT protocol: first finetune only the task embedding (Embed-TTT), then freeze it and finetune the backbone. Across ARC-AGI-1, ConceptARC, and two controlled datasets with known rules, Embed-TTT consistently yields improved task embeddings, ones that align better with underlying task rules, improve embedding-based retrieval, and enable accurate linear probing of known rules. Qualitatively, Embed-TTT identifies more semantically meaningful relations between test and train tasks on ARC-AGI-1. We also show that optimizing only task embeddings (less than 0.01% of model parameters) already solves a non-trivial fraction of ARC-AGI-1, ConceptARC, and Mini-ARC tasks, while the full two-step pipeline improves final performance. Finally, we show that Embed-TTT recovers the underlying geometric structure of parametric rules and learns compositional capabilities that enable rule-wise interpolation, but not extrapolation. These findings support a clearer separation between rule induction and rule execution in ARC-like evaluations, motivating benchmarks that better distinguish in-distribution from out-of-distribution rules.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两步式测试时训练协议（先微调任务嵌入 Embed-TTT，再冻结嵌入微调主干），证明该方法能获得与底层规则更一致的任务嵌入，并更清晰地区分 ARC 类任务中的规则归纳与规则执行。
AI.motivation: 现有 ARC 及类似基准虽用于评估模型求解新颖推理任务的能力，但往往无法判断其成功究竟源于推断出预期规则，还是依赖捷径。作者希望厘清这一点，为此研究 VARC 中的测试时任务嵌入。
AI.method: 在 VARC（预训练主干 + 可训练任务嵌入）基础上提出新颖的两步测试时训练协议：第一步仅微调任务嵌入（Embed-TTT），第二步冻结该嵌入并微调主干。评估覆盖 ARC-AGI-1、ConceptARC 及两个具有已知规则的受控数据集，并借助嵌入检索、线性探针、定性分析与几何结构分析进行检验。
AI.result: Embed-TTT 持续产生更优的任务嵌入，与底层任务规则对齐更好，提升基于嵌入的检索效果，并支持对已知规则做准确的线性探针；在 ARC-AGI-1 上能识别出更具语义意义的测试—训练任务关系。仅优化任务嵌入（不到模型参数的 0.01%）即可解决相当一部分 ARC-AGI-1、ConceptARC 和 Mini-ARC 任务，完整两步流程进一步提升了最终性能。Embed-TTT 还能恢复参数化规则的底层几何结构，学到支持规则级插值但不支持外推的组合能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持在 ARC 类评估中更清晰地区分规则归纳与规则执行，并推动设计能更好区分分布内与分布外规则的基准。

title: AI-GRACE: A Use-Case Operationalization Framework for Agentic AI: From Organizational Objectives and Obligations to Deployment Capabilities and Architecture
summary: Organizations deploying agentic artificial intelligence must determine more than whether a model is trustworthy; they must establish what to validate, control, and observe for a use case to deliver its intended outcome while meeting applicable obligations. This paper proposes AI-GRACE (Agentic Intelligence-Governance, Risk, Assurance, Controls, and Evidence) as a use-case operationalization framework connecting organizational governance with technical implementation. The proposal draws on professional observations and a purposive synthesis of standards and literature, using design science to frame the method contribution and situational method engineering to guide contextual tailoring and reuse. The framework establishes objectives and obligations and then assesses risks in seven proposed domains, including mission and value realization. It derives requirements for assurance before deployment, runtime controls, and evidence, which guide capability qualification, gap assessment, and a logical architecture. An Agent Operating Envelope specifies permitted actions and escalation conditions, while Risk-Aligned Independence Levels (RAIL) summarize the authorized independence. A fictional retail banking application illustrates the method. The contribution is a traceable basis for deciding what an organization must implement, what it already supports, and what remains unresolved. Empirical evaluation must establish whether it improves deployment decisions, efficiency, and reuse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI-GRACE框架（智能体AI的治理、风险、保证、控制与证据），通过用例操作化将组织治理与技术实现相连接，为智能体AI的部署提供可追溯的决策依据。
AI.motivation: 部署智能体AI的组织不能仅判断模型是否可信，还需明确用例需验证什么、控制什么、观测什么，以达成预期结果并满足合规义务。现有治理与技术实现之间缺乏衔接。
AI.method: 基于专业观察与标准及文献的目的性综合，采用设计科学框定方法贡献，并用情境化方法工程指导情境裁剪与复用。框架先确定目标与义务，再在七个风险域（含任务与价值实现）评估风险，导出部署前保证、运行时控制与证据需求，进而指导能力资格认定、差距评估与逻辑架构设计；以“智能体运行包络”（Agent Operating Envelope）规定允许动作与升级条件，以“风险对齐独立性等级”（RAIL）概括授权独立性。并以虚构的零售银行场景进行示例说明。
AI.result: 框架输出了一个可追溯的基础，用以判断组织必须实现什么、已支持什么以及尚存哪些未解决问题；虚构零售银行用例对该方法进行了演示。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于为智能体AI用例的治理与落地提供可追溯的决策基础；其是否改善部署决策、效率与复用仍需实证评估。

title: Information-Gain Rewards over Diversity-Pruned Tests: GT-Anchored Verifier Co-Training for Reliable Code Generation
summary: Self-play methods that co-train a single language model as both coder and test author promise to move code-generation RL beyond fixed test suites, but they suffer from two coupled pathologies: permissiveness collapse, where pass-rate rewards are maximised by trivial, non-discriminative tests, and concentration bias, where i.i.d. sampled tests cluster on modal inputs and inflate estimator variance. We introduce CoVer (Co-trained Coder and Verifier), a single-policy GRPO framework that addresses both failure modes. First, an information-gain (IG) reward scores each self-generated test by the mutual information between its pass/fail vector and a graded, ground-truth-anchored correctness signal y [0, 1] m, gated by the sign of their covariance so that only positively discriminative tests receive reward. Second, a three-stage diversity-aware selection step prunes a candidate pool to a behaviourally non-redundant suite (invalidity, input-string, execution-profile filtering), raising the effective sample size of the IG estimator at fixed execution budget. On five benchmarks (LiveBench, MBPP, LiveCodeBench, CodeContests, Code-Forces), CoVer raises one-shot pass@1 by +5.8 points at 7B and +7.1 points at 14B over the Qwen2.5-Instruct backbone, and achieves the highest macro-average among all compared methods at both scales. As a drop-in backbone inside the CodeT ranking pipeline, CoVer-7B adds +3.5 points, demonstrating the dual benefit of co-training for both generation and selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CoVer，一个单策略 GRPO 框架，通过信息增益奖励与多样性感知筛选，同时缓解自博弈代码生成中的"宽容崩塌"与"集中偏差"两大问题。
AI.motivation: 自博弈方法让单一语言模型同时充当编码器与测试作者，有望摆脱固定测试集的限制，但存在两个耦合缺陷：1）宽容崩塌——通过率奖励可被平凡、无区分度的测试最大化；2）集中偏差——独立同分布采样的测试聚集在众数输入上，抬高估计器方差。
AI.method: 提出 CoVer（协同训练的编码器与验证器），单策略 GRPO 框架。其一，采用信息增益（IG）奖励，以自生成测试的通过/失败向量与锚定真值的分级正确性信号 y∈[0,1]^m 之间的互信息打分，并由协方差符号门控，仅让正区分性测试获得奖励；其二，设计三阶段多样性感知选择步骤（无效性过滤、输入字符串过滤、执行轮廓过滤），将候选池剪枝为行为上非冗余的测试套件，在固定执行预算下提高 IG 估计器的有效样本量。
AI.result: 在 LiveBench、MBPP、LiveCodeBench、CodeContests、CodeForces 五个基准上，CoVer 相较 Qwen2.5-Instruct 主干将 one-shot pass@1 在 7B 上提升 +5.8 分、14B 上提升 +7.1 分，并在两种规模下取得所有对比方法中最高的宏平均。作为 CodeT 排序流水线的即插即用主干，CoVer-7B 额外提升 +3.5 分。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明协同训练对生成与选择均具双重收益，验证了 IG 奖励与多样性感知筛选在缓解宽容崩塌和集中偏差方面的有效性。

title: Ability-Residual Decoupled Modeling for Affective Cognitive Diagnosis
summary: Cognitive diagnosis infers students' concept mastery from response logs. However, students' responses are not determined by mastery alone: non-cognitive factors such as emotion, engagement, and fatigue can also affect performance. Affective cognitive diagnosis therefore extends conventional cognitive diagnosis by incorporating affective states. Existing methods often assume that the cognitive diagnosis backbone has already explained ability, item, and concept effects, so the remaining errors can be attributed mainly to affect. We argue that this assumption can be insufficient in real educational data: item calibration bias, systematic concept bias, personalized student-concept deviations, and latent student-item matching can form stable cognitive residuals. Without an explicit modeling pathway, these residuals may leak into affective representations, producing affect contamination. To address this problem, we propose an ability-residual decoupled framework for affective cognitive diagnosis. The model first captures unmodeled cognitive residuals through student, item, concept, student-concept, and low-rank student-item components, and then uses an affective module to modulate guess/slip effects. A Q-matrix-constrained concept residual attention mechanism adaptively aggregates only item-relevant concept residuals. Experiments on ASSIST2017, ASSIST2012, ASSIST2009, and Junyi with six cognitive diagnosis backbones show response-prediction gains across the reported comparisons and generally improved affect alignment when affect labels are available. Ablation studies, leakage probes, principal component analysis visualization, long-tail analysis, and case studies further indicate that ability residuals absorb stable cognitive bias, reduce cognitive contamination in the affective branch, and enhance the robustness and predictive accuracy of cognitive diagnosis models.

AI.tldr: 提出能力-残差解耦框架用于情感认知诊断，显式建模认知残差以避免情感污染。
AI.motivation: 现有情感认知诊断方法假设骨干模型已充分解释能力、题目和概念效应，剩余误差主要归因于情感。但真实教育数据中，题目校准偏差、系统性概念偏差、个性化学生-概念偏差及潜在学生-题目匹配会形成稳定的认知残差。若缺乏显式建模路径，这些残差会泄漏进情感表征，造成情感污染。
AI.method: 提出能力-残差解耦框架。首先通过学生、题目、概念、学生-概念及低秩学生-题目组件捕获未建模的认知残差；随后用情感模块调制猜测/失误效应；并引入Q矩阵约束的概念残差注意力机制，仅自适应聚合与题目相关的概念残差。
AI.result: 在ASSIST2017、ASSIST2012、ASSIST2009及Junyi四个数据集上，结合六种认知诊断骨干模型，响应预测性能在报道的对比中均有提升；在情感标签可用时情感对齐总体改善。消融、泄漏探测、主成分分析可视化、长尾分析及案例研究进一步验证其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 能力残差可吸收稳定认知偏差，减少情感分支中的认知污染，提升认知诊断模型的鲁棒性与预测精度。

title: A Fully Differentiable Neuro-Soft-Symbolic Framework for Perceptual Task Planning
summary: Perceptual planning tasks require two key capabilities: accurately perceiving uncertain scenes and planning valid action sequences following logical rules. Conventional methods convert perception into discrete symbolic facts and then plan, discarding perceptual uncertainty and severing task-level feedback to perception. We introduce a generic, fully differentiable neuro-soft-symbolic framework that connects visual perception and task planning within a single computational graph. The framework maintains a continuous soft symbolic state, lifts domain rules into a differentiable soft-$T_P$ transition operator, and optimizes action logits over a short planning horizon. Gradients from the planning objective can also update the perception parameters, allowing task-relevant perceptual representations to be refined during planning. On Blocksworld, our method solves 40/40 LatPlan-40 tasks and 596/600 PlanBench-600 tasks, compared with 33/40 for LatPlan and 587/600 for the reasoning-model baseline, while requiring substantially less computation and time. In the perceptual-uncertainty ablation, our method improves the success rate from 59\% with frozen perception to 83\%. We further conduct task-and-motion simulations on Blocksworld scenes, providing an execution-level validation of the compatibility between decoded task plans and downstream robotic motion execution.

AI.tldr: 提出一种全可微的神经-软符号框架，将视觉感知与任务规划统一在单一计算图中，通过软符号状态与可微 soft-T_P 转移算子实现端到端规划，并在 Blocksworld 任务上超越 LatPlan 与推理模型基线。
AI.motivation: 感知规划任务需同时具备对不确定场景的准确感知与遵循逻辑规则的有效动作序列规划能力。传统方法将感知转为离散符号事实后再规划，丢弃了感知不确定性，并切断任务级反馈对感知的反向作用。
AI.method: 构建通用的全可微神经-软符号框架，在单一计算图中连接视觉感知与任务规划：维护连续软符号状态，将领域规则提升为可微 soft-T_P 转移算子，在短规划视野上优化动作 logits；规划目标的梯度可回传更新感知参数，从而在规划过程中精炼任务相关的感知表示。
AI.result: 在 Blocksworld 上，方法在 LatPlan-40 上求解 40/40，在 PlanBench-600 上求解 596/600，而 LatPlan 为 33/40、推理模型基线为 587/600，且计算量与时间显著更少；感知不确定性消融中，成功率由冻结感知的 59% 提升至 83%。进一步在 Blocksworld 场景开展任务与运动仿真，验证了解码任务计划与下游机器人运动执行的兼容性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过可微软符号表示与任务级梯度回传，弥合了感知与规划之间的割裂，在保持低计算开销的同时提升规划成功率，并具备向机器人运动执行层延伸的可行性。

title: CogGym: Towards Large-Scale Comparative Evaluation of Human and Machine Cognition
summary: Understanding and modeling human intelligence are parallel goals shared by artificial intelligence (AI) and cognitive science. As AI systems grow increasingly capable, in what ways do model responses resemble human responses, and where do they systematically diverge? The sheer breadth and diversity of the tasks humans can perform and think about pose a challenge for scalable and rigorous comparison between humans and models. We introduce CogGym, a scalable, unified framework grounded in cognitive science for systematically comparing model and human behavior on matched experimental trials. CogGym uses a semi-automated, human-in-the-loop pipeline to standardize diverse experimental paradigms into a task-agnostic Experiment Markup Language (EML), enabling reproducible and faithful comparison at scale. For initial release, we curate and standardize 258 cognitive experiments from 100 papers that focuses on human commonsense reasoning, and evaluate 50 large language models against human responses. We find a clear scaling trend where larger and more recent AI models better reproduce human judgments. Yet AI models' improvement on such common reasoning tasks is considerably slower than the gains observed on formal-reasoning benchmarks like math and coding, and model--human fit remains well below human splithalf reliability ($R^2 = 0.93$ on text, $0.95$ on image, and $0.92$ on video) with the best models achieving $R^2 = 0.59$ on text, $0.58$ on image, and $0.43$ on video experiments. We intend for CogGym to provide a living evaluation framework that continually incorporates new cognitive science experiments to characterize where model behavior resembles human behavior, where it systematically diverges, and how those patterns change as models and experiments evolve.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CogGym——一个基于认知科学的可扩展统一框架，用于在匹配实验试次上系统比较模型与人类行为，并初步标准化258个常识推理实验，评测50个大模型，发现模型规模越大越接近人类判断，但拟合度仍远低于人类信度。
AI.motivation: 理解与建模人类智能是AI与认知科学的共同目标。随着AI能力增强，需要明确模型回应在哪些方面类似人类、又在哪些方面系统性偏离。但人类任务种类繁多，缺乏可扩展且严谨的人机比较方法。
AI.method: 提出CogGym框架，采用半自动化、人在回路的流水线，将多样实验范式标准化为任务无关的Experiment Markup Language (EML)，实现大规模可复现的忠实比较。初始版本标准化了100篇论文中的258个认知实验，聚焦人类常识推理，并评测50个大语言模型与人类反应。
AI.result: 存在清晰的扩展趋势：更大、更新的模型更好地复现人类判断。但AI在常识推理任务上的提升明显慢于数学、编程等形式推理基准；模型—人类拟合度远低于人类分半信度（文本R²=0.93、图像0.95、视频0.92），最佳模型仅为文本R²=0.59、图像0.58、视频0.43。
AI.conclusion: CogGym旨在成为一个持续演进的评估框架，不断纳入新的认知科学实验，用于刻画模型行为在何处类似人类、在何处系统性偏离，以及这些模式如何随模型和实验演进而变化。

title: PlaceReasoner-Beta: Reasoning-Driven Macro Placement and Benchmarking
summary: Automated macro placement remains a fundamental challenge in VLSI physical design. Despite decades of research, existing approaches predominantly optimize hand-crafted proxy objectives, such as estimated wirelength, and typically produce placements through one-shot numerical optimization, limiting their ability to incorporate visual layout context, codified design expertise, and downstream physical-design feedback in a unified loop. We present PlaceReasoner-Beta, a verifier-guided multi-agent framework that reformulates macro placement as a closed-loop reasoning problem rather than black-box optimization. A vision-language model (VLM) planner generates candidate placements from the floorplan image, macro specifications, and connectivity structure; a geometric verifier enforces physical legality and expert placement principles; a physical verifier refines candidates using early implementation feedback; and a post-route optimizer further improves promising layouts using final PPA. To enable reproducible evaluation, we introduce PlaceReasoner-Bench, a fully open end-to-end benchmark built from open RTL designs, EDA tools, and technology libraries. It comprises 8 designs at two aspect ratios, yielding 16 tasks with fixed floorplans and I/O assignments, so methods differ only in macro positions and orientations and are evaluated using routed PPA and DRC rather than pre-route proxies. Across the benchmark, PlaceReasoner-Beta achieves the best timing among DRC-clean methods on all square tasks, reducing post-route TNS by 61.2% at 1:1 and 53.0% at 2:1 relative to the classical baseline field. It also shortens routed wirelength on most designs despite never explicitly optimizing it, demonstrating that reasoning over spatial structure under physical-design feedback can improve end-to-end layout quality beyond proxy-objective optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出验证器引导的多智能体框架 PlaceReasoner-Beta，将宏单元布局重构为闭环推理问题，并发布开源端到端基准 PlaceReasoner-Bench；在DRC-clean条件下取得最佳时序，后布线TNS相对经典基线降低61.2%（1:1）与53.0%（2:1）。
AI.motivation: 自动宏单元布局是VLSI物理设计的核心难题。现有方法多优化手工代理目标（如估计线长），且采用一次性数值优化，难以统一融入视觉布局上下文、可编码的设计专家经验以及下游物理设计反馈。
AI.method: 提出 PlaceReasoner-Beta，一个验证器引导的多智能体闭环推理框架：VLM规划器基于版图图像、宏单元规格与连接结构生成候选布局；几何验证器保证物理合法性与专家布局准则；物理验证器利用早期实现反馈精修候选；后布线优化器基于最终PPA进一步改进有潜力的布局。同时构建 PlaceReasoner-Bench：基于开源RTL、EDA工具与工艺库的全开源端到端基准，含8个设计×2种宽高比共16个任务，固定floorplan与I/O分配，方法仅在宏单元位置和朝向上不同。
AI.result: 评测采用后布线PPA与DRC而非布线前代理指标。在所有方形任务上，PlaceReasoner-Beta 在DRC-clean方法中取得最佳时序，后布线TNS相对经典基线分别降低61.2%（1:1）和53.0%（2:1）；在多数设计上还缩短了布线线长，尽管从未显式优化线长。
AI.conclusion: 在物理设计反馈下对空间结构进行推理，可超越代理目标优化，提升端到端布局质量；闭环、验证器引导的推理范式为宏单元布局提供了新路径。

title: Efficient Benchmarking in Production: A Study of an Evolving LLM Agent
comment: A study of efficient recurring evaluation of a production LLM agent based on real-world historical data
summary: Production LLM agents are evaluated repeatedly as they evolve, but full agent benchmarks are costly to rerun. We study efficient recurring evaluation for a production analytics agent serving tens of thousands of monthly active users and report first-hand deployment experience. Using 574 historical runs of the production benchmark, split chronologically into calibration and held-out periods, we compare random sampling, historical caching, fixed representative subsets, and IRT-based adaptive testing. The results show that multidimensional 2PL adaptive testing achieves the best overall score fidelity: executing 200 questions, 38.5% of a full run, yields 1.03 pp of MAE. We nevertheless deployed difficulty-stratified fixed subsets because of their operational simplicity, and show they transfer without recalibration to five other agent families and remain stable across calibration windows as short as one day. Drawing on this deployment experience, we report practical recommendations for recurring production-agent evaluation.

AI.tldr: 针对生产环境分析型LLM智能体的重复评估，基于574次历史基准运行比较四种采样策略：多维2PL自适应测试保真度最佳（200题、38.5%题量，MAE 1.03pp），但实际部署选择难度分层固定子集，因其运维简单且可跨智能体族与短标定窗口迁移。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中的LLM智能体在迭代演进时需反复评估，但完整基准测试重跑成本高昂，因此需要研究高效的低成本重复评估方法，并获取一线部署经验。
AI.method: 使用生产基准的574次历史运行数据，按时间顺序划分为标定期与留出期；对比随机采样、历史缓存、固定代表性子集与基于IRT的自适应测试四种策略；并检验固定子集在五个其他智能体族上的迁移性及不同标定窗口（最短一天）下的稳定性。
AI.result: 多维2PL自适应测试在总体分数保真度上最优：执行200题（占完整运行的38.5%）时MAE为1.03个百分点。但最终部署的是难度分层固定子集，因其运维简单，且无需重新标定即可迁移到五个其他智能体族，并在短至一天的标定窗口下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 在准确性与运维成本之间存在权衡，自适应测试虽精度最佳但固定分层子集更适于生产落地；据此总结出面向生产智能体重复评估的实践建议。

title: GameASG-Bench: Benchmarking Autonomous Software Generation for Game Development
summary: Autonomous software generation (ASG) aims to turn human requirements into executable applications, but delivering these applications does not necessarily establish that their interacting components satisfy the specified behavioral requirements. We introduce GameASG-Bench, a benchmark that makes behavioral testability part of the generation task for game development. Our design declares an evaluation interface specification before generation, fixing legal starting scenarios, player-level actions, stable snapshots, rejection behavior, and invariants while leaving private implementations open. Concretely, we include: (i) static L1 checks that assess source-level compliance; and (ii) browser-executed L2 checks that combine semantic observations with real input and runtime evidence. We implement this protocol as 47 browser-native game-generation tasks spanning 12 primary genres and both 2D and 3D interaction, each with executable checks and an independently verified reference implementation. Our experiments answer four key questions about end-to-end agent performance, tool access and nominal turn budget, reasoning effort, and harness choice. Across nine agent stacks, the highest observed mean L2 check pass rate is 93.2%, yet the highest observed strict task success rate, requiring all L1 and applicable L2 prerequisite and core requirement checks, is only 55.3% (26/47 tasks). For DeepSeek-V4-Flash, full tool access and larger nominal turn budgets yield more strict task successes, while the strict task success rate is not monotonic in reasoning effort. Both tested harnesses achieve 18 strict task successes, but only ten tasks succeed under both. These results expose task-level compliance gaps that high average check pass rates actually obscure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GameASG-Bench，将行为可测试性纳入游戏开发生成任务：先声明评估接口规范，再做静态 L1 与浏览器执行 L2 双层检查，覆盖 47 个浏览器原生游戏任务。九种智能体栈中最高平均 L2 通过率为 93.2%，但最严格任务成功率仅 55.3%（26/47），揭示高平均通过率掩盖的任务级合规缺口。
AI.motivation: 自主软件生成（ASG）虽能把人类需求转化为可执行应用，但交付应用并不等于其交互组件满足既定的行为需求。现有基准缺乏对生成结果行为可测试性的系统性评估，因此需要在生成任务中内嵌行为验证。
AI.method: 提出 GameASG-Bench 基准。生成前先声明评估接口规范，固定合法起始场景、玩家级动作、稳定快照、拒绝行为与不变量，同时保留私有实现开放。检查分两层：(i) 静态 L1 检查，评估源码级合规；(ii) 浏览器执行的 L2 检查，结合语义观察、真实输入与运行时证据。协议实现为 47 个浏览器原生游戏生成任务，覆盖 12 个主要类型及 2D/3D 交互，每个任务均配可执行检查与独立验证的参考实现。
AI.result: 实验回答四个关键问题：端到端智能体性能、工具访问与名义回合预算、推理努力程度、测试框架选择。九种智能体栈中，最高平均 L2 检查通过率为 93.2%，但要求全部 L1 及适用 L2 前置与核心需求检查的严格任务成功率最高仅 55.3%（26/47）。对 DeepSeek-V4-Flash，完整工具访问与更大名义回合预算带来更多严格任务成功，而严格任务成功率对推理努力程度并非单调。两种测试框架均取得 18 个严格任务成功，但仅 10 个任务在两者下都成功。
AI.conclusion: 高平均检查通过率掩盖了任务级合规缺口。GameASG-Bench 表明，将行为可测试性前置到生成任务中，能够暴露平均指标无法反映的严格合规问题，为自主软件生成的行为验证提供更严格的评估范式。

title: LEGIT: Credentialing Protocol for Trustworthy AI Agent Marketplaces
summary: Agentic marketplaces are emerging where AI agents with varying capabilities autonomously complete specialized tasks for buyers. A major challenge of such marketplaces is that buyers cannot easily determine which agent will perform best on their tasks. Reported benchmark scores may be difficult to verify or compare across tasks, software, and budgets. We introduce LEGIT, a credentialing protocol connecting certification, reputation, and proposed marketplace allocation. Certification binds measured quality and cost per solved task to an agent configuration, task domain, evaluation budget, and evidence through a signed record. Reputation links records of past task outcomes to the same identity, subject to the reliability of the reported feedback. Buyers and agents can verify credential records and inspect optional visual profiles. Evaluations reveal cost differences between agent configurations with similar observed task success, and show that comparisons depend on the evaluation budget. These results support binding performance measurements to the tested configuration and resource limits. A complementary analysis quantifies the deposits and fees required for reputation manipulation under a stated Sybil attack model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LEGIT——一个连接认证、声誉与市场分配的凭证协议，用于解决智能体市场中买家难以判断哪个AI智能体在自身任务上表现最佳的问题。认证将测得的质量与成本绑定到具体智能体配置、任务领域、评估预算及证据上，形成签名记录；声誉则将历史任务结果记录与同一身份关联，并考虑反馈可靠性。实验表明，配置相近的智能体在任务成功率相似时成本差异显著，且比较结论依赖于评估预算，验证了将性能测量绑定到被测配置和资源限制的必要性。此外，分析量化了在给定女巫攻击模型下操纵声誉所需的押金与费用。
AI.motivation: 智能体市场正在兴起，具备不同能力的AI智能体自主为买家完成专业任务。然而买家难以判断哪个智能体在自身任务上表现最佳，所报告的基准分数在不同任务、软件和预算之间难以验证或比较，缺乏可信的凭证机制来支撑市场分配决策。
AI.method: 提出LEGIT凭证协议，整合认证、声誉与市场分配三个环节。认证通过签名记录，将测得的每任务解决质量与成本绑定到智能体配置、任务领域、评估预算和证据上；声誉将过往任务结果记录与同一身份关联，并受所报告反馈可靠性的约束。买家与智能体可验证凭证记录并查看可选的可视化画像。此外，在给定的女巫攻击模型下，量化了操纵声誉所需押金与费用。
AI.result: 评估揭示：在观测任务成功率相近的智能体配置之间存在显著成本差异；同时，智能体之间的比较结论取决于评估预算的大小。这些结果表明有必要将性能测量绑定到实际被测配置与资源限制上。补充分析量化了在特定女巫攻击模型下操纵声誉所需的押金与费用门槛。
AI.conclusion: LEGIT通过将认证、声誉与市场分配相连接的凭证协议，提升了智能体市场中性能与成本信息的可验证性与可比性。结果支持将性能测量绑定到被测配置与资源限制，并为抵御声誉操纵提供了基于押金与费用的经济分析支撑。

title: Offline Multimodal Large Language Models for Decision Support in Air Operations
summary: Air operations rely on complex rules, established procedures, and time-critical analysis under limited connectivity and strict security constraints. In such environments, analysts must combine written doctrine with images, often without access to external computing resources. This paper studies offline large language models as decision support tools, deployed in isolated and restricted environments to give analysts access to doctrinal knowledge that remains traceable to its original sources through natural language interaction. We describe a modular retrieval-augmented architecture suitable for operation without Internet connectivity, supporting both text and image input from technical manuals. As a first step toward evaluating this architecture, we report a pilot study with four image analysts of the Brazilian Air Force, combining (i) a doctrinal knowledge assessment based on their electronic-target identification doctrine, comparing human and proposed system performance on the same test, and (ii) a measurement of the cognitive workload involved in manually producing a reconnaissance target report (Relatório de Missão de Reconhecimento - REMIR) without AI assistance. The results show a demanding manual task, especially in terms of mental demand (6.0/7) and effort (5.0/7), while the proposed system matches the human score (8/10) and completes the assessment in 7.1 minutes (compared to a human average of 26.5 minutes), establishing a baseline for future AI-assisted evaluation. Finally, we describe a future evaluation protocol to systematically compare manual and AI-assisted workflows.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在无网络、受限安全环境下的离线大语言模型作为决策支持工具，提出模块化检索增强架构，并通过巴西空军四名图像分析员的试点研究，验证系统在教义知识评估中达到与人类相同分数(8/10)且速度大幅提升。
AI.motivation: 空中作战依赖复杂规则、既定程序，并需要在有限连接和严格安全约束下进行时间关键的分析；分析员须结合书面条令与图像，且常无法访问外部算力资源。为此需要能在隔离受限环境中部署、可追溯至原始来源的离线知识支持工具。
AI.method: 提出一种适用于无互联网连接的模块化检索增强(RAG)架构，支持来自技术手册的文本和图像输入；并开展含四名巴西空军图像分析员的试点研究，包括：(i)基于其电子目标识别条令的知识评估，比较人类与系统在同一测试上的表现；(ii)测量无AI辅助下人工编制侦察目标报告(REMIR)的认知负荷。
AI.result: 人工任务要求苛刻，心理需求(6.0/7)和努力程度(5.0/7)较高；所提系统得分与人类持平(8/10)，评估耗时7.1分钟，而人类平均为26.5分钟，从而建立了未来AI辅助评估的基线。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了离线检索增强系统在受限环境下作为教义知识决策支持的可行性基线，并提出了未来系统比较人工流程与AI辅助工作流的评估协议。

title: DENSE: Distilling Agent Trajectories into Evidence-Grounded Shortcut Trees for Self-Refinement
summary: Online agent deployments produce abundant execution traces, while task-specific verification and expert annotation are costly to scale. We study how to distill these traces into reusable feedback without post-hoc outcome labels, drawing on their evidence of local progress, recovery, and unfinished requirements. We introduce DENSE (Distilling Evidence from Nested Subtask Executions), which organizes this evidence into evidence-grounded nested shortcut trees. DENSE compresses redundant attempts, reconciles issues across levels using recovery evidence, and summarizes completed branches while expanding unresolved ones, linking reusable progress to remaining obligations. We introduce REFIT, a source-paired protocol comparing feedback from shared initial trajectories under post-hoc outcome blindness, with environments and model contexts reset for fresh attempts at the same tasks. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, DENSE achieves the highest strict pass rate among tested non-privileged feedback methods across four recipient models. Relative to initial executions, strict pass rate improves by 7.12-15.64 pp, with 19.0-43.6% fewer observed recipient tokens in reruns. GPT-5.5 ablations support combining nested subtask analysis with shortcut construction and issue reconciliation. These findings point toward agent self-refinement through evidence-grounded trajectory reuse with less reliance on external supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出 DENSE，一种从嵌套子任务执行轨迹中蒸馏证据、构建可复用反馈的方法，无需事后结果标签；配套 REFIT 评测协议，在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上严格通过率提升 7.12–15.64 个百分点，重跑 token 减少 19.0–43.6%。
AI.motivation: 在线智能体部署产生大量执行轨迹，但任务特定的验证与专家标注难以规模化。作者希望利用轨迹中蕴含的局部进展、恢复过程与未完成需求等证据，在无事后结果标签的条件下，将轨迹蒸馏为可复用的反馈。
AI.method: 提出 DENSE（Distilling Evidence from Nested Subtask Executions）：将证据组织为“证据锚定的嵌套捷径树”（nested shortcut trees），压缩冗余尝试，利用恢复证据跨层级协调问题，总结已完成分支并展开未解决分支，把可复用进展与剩余义务关联。提出 REFIT 协议：源配对的评测方案，在事后结果盲（outcome blindness）条件下比较来自相同初始轨迹的反馈，并重置环境与模型上下文以进行同一任务的全新尝试。
AI.result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，DENSE 在四个接收模型中取得所测试的非特权反馈方法中最高严格通过率；相对初始执行，严格通过率提升 7.12–15.64 个百分点，重跑中观测到的接收方 token 减少 19.0–43.6%。GPT-5.5 消融实验支持将嵌套子任务分析与捷径构建、问题协调相结合。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，智能体可借助证据锚定的轨迹复用实现自我改进，减少对外部监督的依赖。

title: GVPO++: Group Variance Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training and On-Policy Distillation
comment: Extended version of the NeurIPS 2025 paper "GVPO: Group Variance Policy Optimization for Large Language Model Post-Training"
summary:
Post-training plays a pivotal role in enhancing the reasoning capabilities and task-specific expertise of large language models (LLMs). Despite recent advances in post-training methods, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), their practical deployment remains impeded by training instability arising from the reliance on importance sampling.
  We introduce Group Variance Policy Optimization (GVPO), a novel post-training method that integrates the analytical solution of KL-constrained reward maximization into its gradient weighting scheme. This formulation provides an intuitive interpretation: GVPO's gradient corresponds to the mean squared error between the central distance of implicit rewards and that of actual rewards. GVPO offers two key advantages: (1) it guarantees a unique optimal solution, exactly to the KL-constrained reward maximization objective, and (2) it enables flexible sampling distributions without requiring importance sampling.
  Beyond general post-training, we show that GVPO naturally extends to on-policy distillation (OPD). Furthermore, GVPO enables the optimization of a broad family of extended OPD objectives, providing a principled foundation for diverse objective design. By unifying theoretical guarantees with practical adaptability, GVPO establishes a new paradigm for reliable and versatile LLM post-training and on-policy distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GVPO，一种将KL约束奖励最大化的解析解融入梯度加权的后训练方法，避免依赖重要性采样，从而缓解训练不稳定，并自然扩展到在线策略蒸馏（OPD）及其扩展目标族。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练方法（如GRPO）依赖重要性采样，导致实际部署中训练不稳定，限制了其应用。
AI.method: GVPO将KL约束奖励最大化的解析解整合进梯度加权方案，其梯度对应隐式奖励中心距离与实际奖励中心距离之间的均方误差；方法不依赖重要性采样，允许灵活的采样分布，并可扩展到在线策略蒸馏及其扩展目标。
AI.result: GVPO保证唯一最优解，且恰好对应KL约束奖励最大化目标；同时支持灵活采样分布而无需重要性采样，并可优化更广泛的扩展OPD目标。
AI.conclusion: GVPO统一了理论保证与实际适应性，为可靠且通用的LLM后训练与在线策略蒸馏建立了新范式。

title: Risk-Aware Occupancy for Safety-Oriented End-to-End Autonomous Driving
comment: The first version of this research was completed in early 2025
summary: Sparse representation formulates the environment perception for the end-to-end driving system as a set of discrete elements like objects and lane lines. This formulation meets safety risks in crowded, occluded scenes dealing with unstructured obstacles, uncertain regions, and intricate interactions. In this paper, we propose a dense representation, risk-aware occupancy, to characterize planning-relevant risks in an explicit and uniform manner. It jointly encodes global scene occupancy, map-derived traffic constraints, and future dynamic agent occupancy into a unified BEV map. The unified BEV map captures the risk evidence for trajectory planning in both spatial and temporal dimensions. We design an E2E network, ROIDrive, to realize risk-aware occupancy. It predicts risk-aware occupancy with an independent branch and injects it into planning queries for safety-oriented trajectory generation. In addition, to quantify the safety problem, we introduce RiskOcc4D-nuScenes built upon nuscenes and occ3d-nuscenes. Our risk-aware occupancy yields relative open-loop collision reductions of 52.9% under the UniAD metric and 35.0% under the ST-P3 metric on nuScenes.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"风险感知占据"（risk-aware occupancy）这一稠密表示，将全局场景占据、地图交通约束和未来动态智能体占据统一编码进BEV地图，并设计端到端网络ROIDrive，在nuScenes上实现显著碰撞率下降。
AI.motivation: 稀疏表示将环境感知建模为对象、车道线等离散元素，在拥挤、遮挡、非结构化障碍物、不确定区域和复杂交互场景中存在安全风险，因此需要更明确、统一地表征与规划相关的风险。
AI.method: 提出风险感知占据表示，将全局场景占据、地图衍生的交通约束、未来动态智能体占据联合编码为统一BEV地图，在空间和时间维度上捕捉轨迹规划的风险证据；设计端到端网络ROIDrive，通过独立分支预测风险感知占据，并将其注入规划查询以生成面向安全的轨迹；同时构建RiskOcc4D-nuScenes数据集（基于nuScenes和Occ3D-nuScenes）以量化安全问题。
AI.result: 风险感知占据在nuScenes上实现相对开环碰撞降低：UniAD指标下降低52.9%，ST-P3指标下降低35.0%。
AI.conclusion: 用稠密、显式、统一的风险感知占据替代稀疏表示，可有效提升端到端驾驶系统的规划安全性，并通过新数据集RiskOcc4D-nuScenes量化验证。

title: Driving on Registers, Reasoning on Risk: Risk-Aware Occupancy for Register-Based End-to-End Autonomous Driving
comment: This version of this research was completed in early 2026
summary: Multimodal trajectory prediction improves behavioral coverage in end-to-end autonomous driving, but existing methods remain limited by sparse scene representations. Incomplete evidence leads to low-quality candidate generation and unreliable ranking among geometrically similar trajectories. On a register-based baseline, bad and poor candidates constitute 19.74% of the candidate set, while the oracle-best candidate ranks only 33.9th on average. We propose RRDrive, which introduces risk-aware occupancy as a dense, temporally aligned, and trajectory-queryable representation. Its global structure guides high-quality multimodal generation, while candidate-conditioned risk queries support fine-grained selection. We further construct RiskOcc4D-NAVSIM with automatic risk annotations. RRDrive achieves a selected-trajectory PDMS of 0.951, representing a 1.5% relative improvement over the baseline (0.937), and improves the average candidate PDMS by 7.7%. In challenging scenes, it improves candidate PDMS by 30.2% and increases the Spearman correlation among good candidates by 0.41, from 0.26 to 0.67. To move beyond this oracle setting, we further develop an external RiskOcc predictor, a perception module that estimates risk-aware occupancy directly from sensor inputs. The competitive performance validates the representation's feasibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RRDrive，引入风险感知占据（risk-aware occupancy）作为稠密、时间对齐且可被轨迹查询的表示，用于多模态轨迹预测，并结合RiskOcc4D-NAVSIM数据集与外部RiskOcc预测器，显著提升候选生成质量与排序可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态轨迹预测受限于稀疏场景表示，证据不完整导致候选轨迹生成质量低，且几何相似轨迹间排序不可靠。在register-based基线上，差与较差候选占19.74%，oracle最优候选平均仅排第33.9位。
AI.method: 提出RRDrive：利用risk-aware occupancy作为稠密、时间对齐、可被轨迹查询的表示；其全局结构引导高质量多模态生成，候选条件风险查询支持细粒度选择。构建带自动风险标注的RiskOcc4D-NAVSIM。进一步开发外部RiskOcc预测器，直接从传感器输入估计风险感知占据。
AI.result: RRDrive取得选中轨迹PDMS 0.951，较基线0.937相对提升1.5%；平均候选PDMS提升7.7%；在困难场景中候选PDMS提升30.2%，好候选间Spearman相关从0.26提升至0.67（+0.41）。外部RiskOcc预测器性能具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 风险感知占据表示能有效提升多模态轨迹生成的覆盖度与排序质量，并可通过感知模块从传感器输入直接估计，验证了该表示的可行性与实用价值。

title: LogicTrack: Auditing Reasoning Trajectories of Large Language Models with Formal Logic Solvers
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has been shown to improve the performance of large language models (LLMs), yet existing optimization methods largely rely on outcome-based feedback, leaving the logical validity of intermediate reasoning steps largely unverified. To address the gap whereby LLMs arrive at correct final answers through logically flawed intermediate reasoning chains, we propose LogicTrack, a neuro-symbolic framework that audits reasoning trajectories by auto-formalizing each reasoning step into symbolic representations and verifying it with automated theorem provers. LogicTrack introduces Solver-Based Backtracking Reward (SBR), a step-wise scoring mechanism that quantifies logical soundness and guides backtracking tree search at inference time. We further extend LogicTrack to construct supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data with backtracking traces from its trajectories, enabling fine-tuned models to internalize step-wise auditing as an intrinsic capability. Extensive experiments across 8 reasoning benchmarks and 7 LLMs demonstrate that LogicTrack effectively improves both the verifiability of reasoning chains and final answer pass rate, thereby enhancing overall CoT quality and trustworthiness in high-stakes domains.

AI.tldr: LogicTrack是一个神经符号框架，通过自动形式化推理步骤并用定理证明器验证，配合基于求解器的回溯奖励（SBR）进行逐步评分与推理时回溯搜索，并生成带回溯轨迹的SFT数据，从而提升大模型思维链的逻辑可靠性与答案正确率。
AI.motivation: 现有CoT优化方法多依赖结果导向的反馈，缺乏对中间推理步逻辑有效性的验证，导致模型可能通过逻辑有缺陷的推理链得出正确最终答案。
AI.method: 提出LogicTrack神经符号框架：将每个推理步骤自动形式化为符号表示，并用自动定理证明器验证；引入Solver-Based Backtracking Reward（SBR），一种逐步评分机制，量化逻辑合理性并指导推理时的回溯树搜索；进一步利用其轨迹中的回溯痕迹构建监督微调（SFT）数据，使微调模型内化逐步审计能力。
AI.result: 在8个推理基准和7个大语言模型上的大量实验表明，LogicTrack有效提升了推理链的可验证性与最终答案通过率。
AI.conclusion: LogicTrack通过神经符号逐步验证与回溯奖励机制提升了思维链质量与可信度，适用于高风险领域的推理应用。

title: PolyBridgeBench: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Physics-Grounded Bridge Design
summary: Multimodal large language models, or MLLMs, perform well at visual understanding and structured generation, yet these capabilities do not establish whether an engineering design will work when executed. Existing benchmarks assess spatial reasoning, structural validity, or physics-grounded construction, but they do not determine whether MLLMs can synthesize complete load-bearing structures and repair them after simulator execution exposes a failure. We introduce PolyBridgeBench, an executable benchmark for multimodal bridge design. A model receives a visual scene and structured engineering constraints and generates a complete node--member--material topology. Deterministic legality checks gate execution in a native dynamic physics simulation. Following an execution failure, the benchmark returns temporal visual evidence from the failed rollout and evaluates repair under a fixed interaction budget. Separate measurements of deterministic validity, dynamic functional success, and post-failure recovery identify the stage at which design fails. Experiments with six representative MLLMs across 189 levels expose a substantial gap between deterministic validity and dynamic success, pronounced sensitivity to material budgets, and limited post-failure recovery under the primary strict-budget setting.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 PolyBridgeBench，一个可执行的桥梁设计多模态基准，用于检验 MLLM 能否生成完整承重结构并在仿真失败后进行修复。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多评估空间推理、结构合法性或物理构建，但无法判断 MLLM 是否能综合出完整承重结构，并在仿真执行暴露失败后进行修复。视觉理解与结构化生成能力并不等于工程设计可执行。
AI.method: 模型接收视觉场景与结构化工程约束，生成完整的节点—构件—材料拓扑；确定性合法性检查作为原生动态物理仿真的执行门控。执行失败后，基准返回失败推演的时间序列视觉证据，并在固定交互预算下评估修复。分别测量确定性有效性、动态功能成功与失败后恢复。
AI.result: 六个代表性 MLLM 在 189 个关卡上的实验显示：确定性有效性与动态成功之间存在显著差距，对材料预算高度敏感，且在主要严格预算设置下失败后恢复能力有限。
AI.conclusion: PolyBridgeBench 通过分阶段测量定位设计失败的环节，揭示了 MLLM 在可执行工程设计中的能力缺口，尤其是动态承重成功与失败后修复方面。

title: The Communication Bottleneck: A Round-Trip Study of Tree-Structured Expression Serialization in Language Models
summary: When language models reason in chain-of-thought or exchange free-text intermediates, they serialize structured information into natural language. How much tree-structured compositional content survives this bottleneck? We propose a round-trip protocol that answers this question empirically for tree-structured expressions. A generator converts a procedurally generated arithmetic expression into a word problem, a separate extractor recovers the expression from the word problem alone, and symbolic equivalence provides an exact oracle. Evaluating all pairwise combinations of sixteen models yields a communication matrix whose marginals separate generation quality from extraction quality. Three main findings emerge. First, the channel is lossy and asymmetric: swapping which model generates and which extracts shifts accuracy by up to 60.4 points, and the best pair reaches 92.9% by combining different models on each end rather than the same model on both. Second, at least 73.6% of round-trip failures originate at generation, and difficulty is driven by tree structure (operator count, depth, right-branching) rather than model family. Third, the channel is trainable: ~3600 fine-tuning examples that share the evaluation's operators and tree shapes lift every open-weight model above untrained Gemini-3.1-Pro, an upper bound under matched semantics. A disjoint-domain regime with new operators and vocabulary also raises every open-weight model, confirming the gain is not an artifact of matched semantics, though a gap to the frontier remains. Together these results identify tree-structured expression serialization as a primary limiting factor when models communicate hierarchical structure through natural language.

AI.tldr: 提出"往返协议"实证测量语言模型在自然语言序列化中保留树结构组合信息的能力，发现该信道有损且不对称、失败多源于生成端且受树结构驱动、并可通过少量微调提升。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在进行思维链推理或交换自由文本中间结果时，会将结构化信息序列化为自然语言。作者希望量化这一"瓶颈"中究竟有多少树结构组合内容能够存活。
AI.method: 设计往返协议：生成器将程序化生成的算术表达式转化为文字应用题，独立的提取器仅从文字应用题还原表达式，并以符号等价作为精确评测基准。对16个模型的所有两两组合进行评测，得到通信矩阵，其边际分布可分离生成质量与提取质量。另进行共享语义的约3600条微调实验，以及引入新算子与新词表的非同分布域实验。
AI.result: 信道有损且不对称：交换生成与提取角色可使准确率变化达60.4个百分点，最佳组合在两端使用不同模型而非同一模型，达92.9%。至少73.6%的往返失败源自生成端，难度由树结构（算子数量、深度、右分支）而非模型家族驱动。约3600条与评测共享算子与树形的微调样本可将所有开放权重模型提升至未训练Gemini-3.1-Pro之上；非同分布域实验同样提升所有开放权重模型，证明增益并非语义匹配的假象，但与前沿模型仍有差距。
AI.conclusion: 树结构表达式的序列化是模型通过自然语言传递层次结构时的主要限制因素，信道具有可训练性，生成端是主要瓶颈。

title: Learning-to-Optimize as the Missing Architectural Layer of AI-Native Networks
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is becoming a fundamental design principle of future AI-native communication networks, enabling autonomous resource management, adaptive control, and zero-touch network operation. While current AI-native architectures increasingly embed intelligence across network functions, they provide little guidance on how optimisation knowledge should be systematically generated, transferred, and exploited by AI models. This paper argues that the Learning-to-Optimize (L2O) represents the missing architectural layer between optimisation and AI-native intelligence. Rather than viewing optimisation merely as an online decision engine, the proposed paradigm redefines optimisation algorithms as offline knowledge generators that produce high-quality supervisory information for neural surrogate models. The resulting models inherit optimisation expertise while enabling low-latency runtime inference suitable for dynamic network environments. A generic four-stage L2O workflow is introduced, comprising optimisation, knowledge generation, surrogate learning, and runtime inference. Unlike existing Learning-to-Optimize approaches, which primarily focus on algorithm acceleration, the proposed framework establishes L2O as an architectural abstraction applicable across heterogeneous communication and computing systems. The proposed paradigm is illustrated by an NR-V2X relay-selection problem, in which optimisation-generated solutions from a Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) solver are used to train a Graph Neural Network that can reproduce near-optimal decisions in real time. The presented perspective positions Learning-to-Optimize as a key architectural enabler for future AI-native networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将Learning-to-Optimize (L2O)视为连接优化算法与AI原生智能的缺失架构层，通过四阶段工作流把优化算法转化为离线知识生成器，训练神经代理模型实现低时延在线推理，并以NR-V2X中继选择问题（MILP求解器生成解训练GNN）进行验证。
AI.motivation: 未来AI原生通信网络正把AI作为基本设计原则，以支持自主资源管理、自适应控制与零接触运维。然而现有AI原生架构虽在各网元中嵌入智能，却缺乏对"优化知识应如何被系统化生成、迁移与利用"的指导，即缺少一个在优化与AI原生智能之间的架构抽象层。
AI.method: 提出以L2O作为该缺失架构层的新范式，将优化算法重新定义为离线知识生成器，而非仅作为在线决策引擎，从而为神经代理模型产生高质量监督信息。给出通用四阶段L2O工作流：优化求解、知识生成、代理学习与运行时推理；其代理模型继承优化专长，同时支持动态网络环境所需的低时延推理。与聚焦算法加速的现有L2O方法不同，该框架将L2O确立为可跨异构通信与计算系统应用的架构抽象。
AI.result: 以NR-V2X中继选择问题作为示例验证，使用混合整数线性规划（MILP）求解器生成的优化解训练图神经网络（GNN），该GNN能够在实时条件下复现近最优决策。
AI.conclusion: 该观点将Learning-to-Optimize定位为未来AI原生网络的关键架构使能者，为优化知识与AI原生智能之间的衔接提供了系统化抽象与可操作工作流。

title: Dual-Interest Sequential Product Recommendation With Multi-Granular SSM
summary: Sequential recommendation aims to predict the next item a user will interact with based on their historical behavior. Advances in Transformers have significantly improved sequential recommendation but are still limited by cost efficiency. Although State Space Models (SSMs) have recently enabled efficient long-range modeling, most existing methods encode each item with a single static contextual role, overlooking the phenomenon of item polysemy. In fact, the same item often plays different semantic roles depending on user context, and existing methods are limited in capturing dynamic behavior across different temporal granularities. In this work, we propose DSRec, a novel dual-interest cross-SSM model that explicitly disentangles item roles across long-term and short-term semantic context. Sequential items are encoded into long-term interest embeddings that capture stable preferences via historical aggregation, and a short-term interest branch that emphasizes local session intent modulated by inter-click time intervals. These interest embeddings are processed through distinct SSM encoders: a full-sequence Mamba for long-term modeling, and a time-modulated SSM that dynamically adjusts state evolution based on temporal gaps. To enable effective cross-granularity alignment, we adopt a residual cross-fusion mechanism that exchanges contextual information between the two branches while preserving semantic independence. Experiments on public benchmarks demonstrate that DSRec outperforms other state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出DSRec，一种双兴趣跨SSM模型，通过显式解耦长短期语义上下文中的物品角色，并结合Mamba与时序调制SSM及残差交叉融合，提升序列推荐效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的序列推荐虽性能优异但成本高；SSM方法虽实现高效长程建模，却多以单一静态上下文角色编码物品，忽视物品多义性，也难以捕捉不同时间粒度下的动态行为。
AI.method: 将序列物品编码为长期兴趣嵌入（历史聚合捕获稳定偏好）与短期兴趣分支（以点击时间间隔调制局部会话意图）；分别用全序列Mamba与时间调制SSM编码；采用残差交叉融合机制在两个分支间交换上下文信息，同时保持语义独立性。
AI.result: 在公开基准数据集上的实验表明，DSRec优于其他最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: DSRec通过双兴趣解耦与跨粒度对齐有效建模物品多义性与动态行为，验证了SSM双分支架构在序列推荐中的有效性。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Centroid-Guided Contrastive Loss for Structured Fraudulent Job Posting Detection
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Submitted to IEEE Open Journal of the Computer Society. Code: https://github.com/ali-ahmed925/CGCL_code
summary: Fraudulent job posting detection aims to identify job advertisements that are corrupted either through fake content, misleading information, or negative intent, disrupting the online eco-system of job-seekers and employers. Existing studies in this domain lack effective methods to simultaneously achieve high accuracy and meaningful structure of latent-space representations that capture subtleties among fake posts. To this end, we propose Centroid-Guided Contrastive Loss (CGCL), a loss function which unifies classification with densely formulated clustering to consistently reshape latent-space through a centroid-driven top-$k$ push-and-pull mechanism. The complementary nature of CGCL enables the model to enforce accurate decision boundaries and maintain high clustering compactness, effectively capturing both class separability and latent structure. Extensive experiments demonstrate the state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance of our method on EMSCAD, a public benchmark dataset. The code associated with this work is available at: https://github.com/ali-ahmed925/CGCL_code

AI.tldr: 本文提出Centroid-Guided Contrastive Loss（CGCL），将分类与密集聚类统一，通过质心驱动的top-k推拉机制重塑潜在空间，用于欺诈招聘帖检测。
AI.motivation: 现有欺诈招聘帖检测方法难以同时实现高准确率和具有意义的潜在空间结构表示，无法捕捉虚假帖子间的细微差异。
AI.method: 提出CGCL损失函数，统一分类与密集聚类，通过质心驱动的top-k推拉机制一致地重塑潜在空间，兼顾类间可分性与类内紧凑性。
AI.result: 在公开基准数据集EMSCAD上，实验表明该方法达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: CGCL能够同时实现准确决策边界与高聚类紧凑度，有效捕捉类可分性和潜在结构；代码已开源。

title: Reducing Barriers to Academic Support: Evaluating a Course-Specific RAG System for Addressing Help-Seeking Disparities in Higher Education
summary: Access to academic support is a key determinant of student success, yet students experience it unequally: some readily seek help from lecturers or tutors, while others hesitate due to anxiety, fear of judgement, uncertainty about expectations, or low confidence in their understanding. This may be especially evident in computing education, where programming tasks are cumulative and cognitively demanding. Although students increasingly turn to general-purpose generative AI tools, these can produce responses that are inaccurate, insufficiently contextualised, or misaligned with module expectations. This study presents and evaluates Beacon, a course-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system providing private, immediate, module-aligned academic support. Grounding responses in approved teaching materials, Beacon was designed to lower barriers to help-seeking while encouraging independent learning. Using a design-based research approach, Beacon was developed iteratively and evaluated via mixed methods, combining questionnaires and semi-structured interviews with students and staff at a Higher Education institution. Students described Beacon's responses as closely aligned with module content and more trustworthy than unrestricted generative AI tools, valuing its use of pseudocode and scaffolded explanations over direct solutions. Although participants remained cautious about trusting AI-generated responses without verification, they viewed the system as a valuable first point of support before consulting lecturers or official resources. The findings suggest that carefully designed course-specific AI systems may reduce barriers to academic support by occupying an intermediary space between independent study and formal support. Rather than replacing educators, educational AI may be most valuable when it broadens access to guidance while preserving the pedagogical role of lecturers.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出并评估了Beacon——一个面向特定课程的RAG学术支持系统，通过将回答锚定于经批准的课程材料，降低学生求助门槛，同时促进自主学习。
AI.motivation: 学术支持的可及性是学生成功的关键决定因素，但学生获得支持并不平等：部分学生因焦虑、害怕被评判、对期望不确定或缺乏自信而犹豫求助。这一问题在编程等累积性强、认知负荷高的计算教育中尤为突出。通用生成式AI工具虽被广泛使用，却可能产生不准确、缺乏情境化或与课程期望不符的回答。
AI.method: 采用设计型研究方法，迭代开发课程专属的检索增强生成系统Beacon，并以混合方法进行评估，结合问卷与半结构化访谈，研究对象为某高等教育机构的学生与教职工。
AI.result: 学生认为Beacon的回答与课程内容高度契合，比不受限的生成式AI工具更可信；他们尤其看重其使用伪代码与支架式解释而非直接给出答案。参与者对未经核实即信任AI生成内容仍持谨慎态度，但将系统视为在咨询讲师或查阅官方资源之前的有价值的第一支持点。
AI.conclusion: 精心设计的课程专属AI系统可通过占据自主学习与正式支持之间的中介空间来降低学术支持障碍。教育AI并非取代教师，其最大价值在于拓宽获取指导的渠道，同时保留讲师的教学角色。

title: Calibrating Teacher--Student Discrepancy for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves reasoning models by learning the token-level discrepancy between a stronger teacher and an on-policy student. However, this discrepancy does not purely reflect the capability gap between the teacher and the student: it also contains deviations arising from the teacher itself, which are consequently mixed into the observed teacher--student discrepancy and indiscriminately learned by standard OPD during training. This issue is further exacerbated by privileged OPD, where privileged information induces larger teacher-side likelihood shifts, thereby encouraging the student to learn more of the teacher's own deviation. We introduce \textbf{Calibrated On-Policy Distillation (Cal-OPD)}, which estimates the teacher's self-deviation region through positive and negative privileged interventions and calibrates the original teacher--student discrepancy by retaining only the component that lies beyond this region. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that, while retaining only about 52--65\% of the original teacher--student discrepancy as the optimization signal, Cal-OPD consistently outperforms standard OPD and its variants across model scales.

AI.tldr: Cal-OPD通过正负特权干预估计教师自身的自偏差区域，并据此校准师生差异信号，在仅保留约52–65%原始优化信号的情况下，在数学推理基准上稳定优于标准OPD及其变体。
AI.motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过让学生模型学习更强的教师模型与其自身在token级别的差异来提升推理能力，但该差异并不纯粹反映师生能力差距，还混入了教师自身产生的偏差，被标准OPD不加区分地学习。特权OPD会进一步放大这一问题：特权信息诱发更大的教师侧似然偏移，使学生学到更多教师自身的偏差。
AI.method: 提出Calibrated On-Policy Distillation（Cal-OPD）。该方法通过正向与负向特权干预来估计教师的自偏差区域，并利用该区域对原始师生差异进行校准，仅保留位于该区域之外的分量作为优化信号。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准上，Cal-OPD在仅保留约52–65%原始师生差异作为优化信号的前提下，在不同模型规模上均持续优于标准OPD及其变体。
AI.conclusion: 师生差异中混入的教师自身偏差会对在线策略蒸馏产生负面影响，通过特权干预识别并剔除该自偏差区域、仅保留真正的能力差距信号，可在更少优化信号的条件下获得更优的推理性能。

title: One Prompt Does Not Fit All: Self-Meta-Evolve for Personalized Information Extraction
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for enterprise information extraction (IE), where the same document must be reorganized differently for each user. Existing prompt optimization methods, however, rely on a single prompt optimized against a global objective, which is misaligned with the inherent user heterogeneity of real workplaces. We formulate enterprise IE as per-user prompt adaptation under interaction feedback and propose Self-Meta-Evolve, a hierarchical framework that maintains a dedicated prompt for each user and continuously refines it through a dual-loop process: an inner loop that edits structured prompts based on persona-conditioned feedback, and an outer loop that evolves the meta-prompt itself by distilling successful editing patterns. To enable scalable training and evaluation, we release a persona-driven IE benchmark of 292 simulated enterprise users, paired with a reproducible persona-generation pipeline grounded in O*NET occupational taxonomies. On this benchmark, Self-Meta-Evolve achieves a 74.58% success rate, outperforming the strongest prompt-optimization baseline by 13.56 absolute points, and reaches 52.54\% within only two iterations. A double-blind human study with twenty real professionals further confirms that prompts adapted by our framework win against static baselines in 71% of pairwise comparisons.

AI.tldr: 论文将企业信息抽取建模为面向单用户的提示自适应问题，提出双层进化框架Self-Meta-Evolve，并发布292个模拟企业用户的人格驱动基准，成功率74.58%，较最强基线提升13.56个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有提示优化方法依赖单一提示并针对全局目标优化，与企业真实工作场景中同一文档需按不同用户需求重新组织的用户异质性本质相冲突，因此需要面向单用户、基于交互反馈的提示自适应方法。
AI.method: 提出Self-Meta-Evolve分层框架：为每个用户维护专属提示，通过双循环持续精炼——内循环依据人格条件化反馈编辑结构化提示，外循环通过蒸馏成功编辑模式来进化元提示本身；同时基于O*NET职业分类体系构建可复现的人格生成流水线，发布含292个模拟企业用户的人格驱动IE基准。
AI.result: 在该基准上成功率达74.58%，比最强提示优化基线高出13.56个绝对百分点；仅需两次迭代即达到52.54%。与20位真实从业者的双盲人工研究进一步表明，本框架适配的提示在71%的成对比较中优于静态基线。
AI.conclusion: 面向单用户的提示自适应是企业IE的有效建模范式，双层元提示进化能在有限迭代内显著超越全局优化基线，并在真实专业人员评审中获得多数偏好，验证了用户异质性建模的必要性与实用价值。

title: Accelerating Dense LLMs via L0-regularized Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance but suffer from slow and costly inference. Existing acceleration methods often lead to noticeable performance degradation, while Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models require extensive computational resources. In this paper, we propose L0-MoE, a lightweight MoE approach using L0-regularization to accelerate dense LLMs nearly without performance loss. Our method introduces a cluster confusion matrix for domain-aware dataset curation and applies dynamic batching for efficient training. Experiments show that L0-MoE achieves up to 2.5x speedup over dense models while maintaining competitive performance, outperforming existing LLM acceleration baselines.

AI.tldr: L0-MoE：用L0正则化的轻量级MoE加速稠密LLM，最高2.5倍加速且性能几乎无损。
AI.motivation: LLM推理慢、成本高；现有加速方法常带来明显性能损失，而常规MoE需大量计算资源。
AI.method: 提出轻量级MoE方法L0-MoE，采用L0正则化加速稠密LLM；引入聚类混淆矩阵进行领域感知的数据集构建，并用动态批处理实现高效训练。
AI.result: 相较稠密模型最高2.5倍加速，同时保持有竞争力的性能，优于现有LLM加速基线。
AI.conclusion: L0-MoE可在近乎不损失性能的前提下有效加速稠密LLM，是一种有前景的加速方案。

title: GUARD: Natural Forgetting in Large Reasoning Models via Guided Answer-Reasoning Distillation
summary: Recent advances in large reasoning models (LRMs) have made machine unlearning more challenging, as protected facts or unsafe rationales may surface in intermediate chain-of-thought (CoT) traces before the final answer is produced. Existing unlearning objectives typically suppress the target content or redirect internal representations, but they never specify how the post-forgetting trajectory should continue, which can lead to hallucinated substitutes, malformed boundaries, or repetitive outputs. We argue that LRM unlearning should instead learn a natural forgetting trajectory: a coherent non-disclosing CoT followed by a stable refusal-style answer that replace the original disclosure. To this end, we propose Guided Answer-Reasoning Distillation (GUARD), which converts model-generated unsafe disclosures into safe-exit trajectories, aligns a frozen LRM via guidance tokens, and distills the guided behavior into model parameters.To address the lack of metrics for replacement quality beyond leakage, we further introduce Natural Forgetting Reasoning Score (NFRS), which captures structural stability, fluency, and unsupported substitutes in forgotten outputs. Extensive experiments on R-TOFU and a STAR-1-derived harmful-intent setting show that GUARD substantially reduces unsafe and privacy disclosures across two widely adopted distilled LRMs while preserving reasoning utility. Codes are available at https://github.com/zeyu-Yan/GUARD

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GUARD（Guided Answer-Reasoning Distillation），通过将模型生成的不安全披露转化为"安全退出轨迹"，用引导 token 对齐冻结的大推理模型并将该行为蒸馏进参数，实现"自然遗忘"；同时提出 NFRS 指标评估替换质量，在 R-TOFU 与 STAR-1 衍生场景上显著降低泄露且保持推理能力。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型（LRM）的中间思维链（CoT）会在最终答案前暴露受保护事实或不安全推理，而现有 unlearning 方法只抑制目标内容或重定向内部表示，未规定遗忘后的轨迹应如何延续，导致幻觉替代、边界错乱或重复输出。
AI.method: 提出 Guided Answer-Reasoning Distillation (GUARD)：将模型自身生成的不安全披露改写成"连贯的非披露 CoT + 稳定拒绝式回答"的安全退出轨迹；通过 guidance tokens 对齐一个冻结的 LRM；再将这种引导行为蒸馏到模型参数中。同时提出 NFRS 指标，从结构稳定性、流畅性、无支撑替代内容三方面衡量替换质量。
AI.result: 在 R-TOFU 和一个由 STAR-1 派生的有害意图设定上，针对两种广泛使用的蒸馏式 LRM 进行大量实验，GUARD 在显著减少不安全与隐私披露的同时保持了推理效用。
AI.conclusion: LRM 遗忘应学习"自然遗忘轨迹"而非单纯抑制；GUARD 结合轨迹蒸馏与 NFRS 评估，为兼顾安全性与推理效用的遗忘提供了有效框架，代码已开源。

title: World Modeling in Transformers
summary: Behavioral failures can make a transformer appear to lack a world model even when it has learned faithful representations of its environment. We demonstrate this in TaxiGPT, a transformer trained on random walks through Manhattan whose failures have been interpreted as evidence of an incoherent internal map. Through mechanistic analysis and causal interventions, we show that the model represents intersections and streets, tracks its position, and uses a goal compass to navigate. We trace its failures to interference between superposed intersection features, which disrupts localization within the internal map. Affordance packing, which groups representations of intersections with the same legal moves, helps limit the consequences of these errors. Finally, we propose mechanistic indicators that we use to compare models and show that world-modeling capacities emerge at different stages of training. Our findings motivate a shift from asking whether a model has a world model to mechanistically studying its world modeling: the interacting capacities through which it represents its environment and uses those representations to guide behavior.

AI.tldr: 通过机制分析与因果干预，作者证明TaxiGPT的行为失败并非缺乏世界模型，而是叠加路口特征之间的干扰破坏了内部定位。
AI.motivation: 先前研究将transformer在导航任务中的行为失败解读为其内部世界地图不一致或缺失世界模型的证据，作者认为这种推断可能错误：模型或许具有忠实的环境表征，但行为失败来源于表征使用层面的问题，因此需要从机制上重新审视世界模型的有无。
AI.method: 以在曼哈顿随机游走数据上训练的transformer（TaxiGPT）为对象，采用机制分析与因果干预方法，识别模型中表征路口、街道、自身位置及目标方位（goal compass）的具体组件，定位失败来源；并提出“affordance packing”策略，将具有相同合法动作的路口表征归组；同时构造机制性指标用于跨模型比较，并追踪训练不同阶段世界建模能力的出现过程。
AI.result: 模型确实表征了路口与街道、能够追踪自身位置并利用目标方位进行导航；其失败可归因于叠加（superposed）路口特征之间的干扰，导致内部地图中的定位被破坏。Affordance packing能够限制此类错误的后果。机制性指标显示世界建模能力在训练的不同阶段逐步涌现，且各模型之间存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 应把研究问题从“模型是否具有世界模型”转向对世界建模的机制性研究，即考察模型表征环境并据此引导行为的多个相互作用能力。行为失败不足以判定世界模型缺失。

title: ECG Mirage: Revealing and Mitigating the Underutilisation of ECGs in Vision-Language Models for Clinical Prediction
summary: Emergency department (ED) decision-making relies on heterogeneous clinical information, including patient history, vital signs, laboratory results, and electrocardiograms (ECGs). Vision--language models (VLMs) can jointly process these modalities, but strong predictive performance does not necessarily imply meaningful use of the correct patient's ECG. We term this failure mode ECG Mirage: apparent multimodal capability without useful dependence on patient-specific ECG information. We distinguish two forms: ECG neglect, where ECGs provide little predictive benefit, and ECG confusion, where matched ECGs outperform no-image inputs but not mismatched ECGs. To evaluate these behaviours, we compare predictions obtained with matched ECGs, outcome-discordant mismatched ECGs, and no-image inputs while holding the clinical text and prediction targets fixed. Across four VLMs on MDS-ED, matched ECGs provide no consistent advantage for either ICU admission or clinical deterioration prediction. We then train four restricted visual prompts using supervised learning followed by conditional direct preference optimisation, while keeping the VLM backbone frozen. The resulting models achieve balanced accuracies of 70.6% for ICU admission and 67.5% for deterioration and increase the matched-versus-mismatched performance gap to approximately 16.5 and 5.5 percentage points, respectively. Overall, our study identifies ECG Mirage in multimodal clinical prediction and introduces visual prompt tuning as an efficient mitigation strategy.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并定义"ECG Mirage"现象，即视觉语言模型(VLM)在急诊多模态预测中表面具备多模态能力，实则未有效利用患者特异性ECG信息，并通过对比实验验证该问题并提出视觉提示微调缓解策略。
AI.motivation: 急诊决策依赖病史、生命体征、化验和心电图等异构信息，VLM虽可联合处理这些模态，但强预测性能未必意味着真正利用了正确的患者ECG。作者关注这种"假性多模态能力"的失效模式，旨在揭示并量化模型对患者特异性ECG信息缺乏有效依赖的问题。
AI.method: 定义ECG Mirage的两种形式：ECG忽视(ECG几乎不带来预测增益)与ECG混淆(匹配ECG优于无图像输入但不优于错配ECG)。实验在MDS-ED数据上，固定临床文本与预测目标，对比匹配ECG、结局不一致的错配ECG和无图像输入三种条件下的预测。随后在冻结VLM主干的前提下，用监督学习加条件直接偏好优化(conditional DPO)训练四个受限视觉提示。
AI.result: 在四种VLM上，匹配ECG对ICU入住或临床恶化预测均无一致优势，证实ECG Mirage存在。经视觉提示训练后的模型在ICU入住预测上达70.6%平衡准确率，恶化预测达67.5%，并将匹配-错配性能差距分别提升至约16.5和5.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别了多模态临床预测中的ECG Mirage现象，表明VLM的强性能可能掩盖其对患者特异性ECG的无用依赖；视觉提示微调是一种高效缓解策略，能显著增强模型对匹配ECG的依赖并提升预测表现。

title: LLM-Generated Feature Pools for Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: We study how far a simple statistical pipeline can go on univariate time series anomaly detection under a strict selection protocol. The method extracts a small pool of statistics over sliding windows, scores each window with a transductive robust (MAD) model, and selects a feature subset per domain on a held-out tuning split. On TSB-AD-U it reaches $0.529$ per-series VUS-PR, above the best neural ($0.45$) and statistical ($0.44$) entries on the public leaderboard and within $0.06$ of the strongest pretrained foundation model, several of which use more supervision than ours.
