Ablations locate the cause: across three selection strategies and a hindsight oracle the score moves by $0.031$, and across the aggregation grid by $0.096$, while changing the candidate pool moves it by $0.226$. The candidate pool sets the ceiling; the search over it is second-order. We therefore generate a pool per domain by prompting a multimodal LLM with in-context example windows from that domain. The generated pools match the hand-crafted one under matched selection, and the two cover different domains: selecting over their union improves on the generated pool in all twelve generator-seed pairs and lifts the pipeline to $0.588$, matching the performance of the best entry on the leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 在严格选择协议下，一个提取滑窗统计量、用MAD转导鲁棒模型打分并按域选择特征子集的简单流程，在TSB-AD-U上达到0.529 VUS-PR，超过最强神经(0.45)与统计(0.44)方法，逼近最强预训练基础模型。消融表明候选池决定性能上限，选择与聚合搜索仅为二阶因素。故用多模态LLM以内嵌示例窗口按域生成候选池，其与手工池在匹配选择下相当且覆盖互补域，二者并集选择在全部12个生成器-种子组合上提升，将流程提升至0.588，与排行榜最佳条目持平。
AI.motivation: 探究在严格选择协议下，简单统计流水线在单变量时间序列异常检测中能达到何种水平，并厘清决定性能的关键因素（候选池、选择策略、聚合方式）的相对重要性。
AI.method: 方法为：在滑动窗口上提取小型统计量池，用转导鲁棒（MAD）模型对窗口打分，并在留出调优集上按域选择特征子集；进一步通过提示多模态LLM、提供该域的内嵌示例窗口来生成候选池，并在手工池与生成池的并集上进行选择。
AI.result: 在TSB-AD-U上达到0.529 per-series VUS-PR，高于公开排行榜上最强神经（0.45）与统计（0.44）条目，距最强预训练基础模型差0.06。消融显示：三种选择策略及事后oracle使分数变动0.031，聚合网格变动0.096，而更换候选池变动0.226。生成池在匹配选择下与手工池相当，域覆盖互补；并集选择在全部12个生成器-种子对中均提升，分数升至0.588，与排行榜最佳条目持平。
AI.conclusion: 候选池设定性能上限，而对其搜索仅为二阶因素。利用多模态LLM按域生成候选池并与手工池联合选择，可显著提升简单统计流水线，达到与排行榜最优条目相当的水平，表明该任务的瓶颈在于候选统计量的覆盖而非模型或搜索复杂度。

title: EnterpriseVal: Quantifying the Efficacy, Reliability and Value of Generative AI in the Enterprise
summary: Frontier language models now produce professional deliverables that expert graders judge to match human work on a substantial share of economically valuable tasks, yet most enterprise GenAI initiatives fail to show a measurable business effect and a large fraction of agentic projects are expected to be cancelled. We argue that this is substantially a measurement problem: public benchmarks answer "what can the model do?", whereas a deployment decision requires "is this workflow fit, reliable, safe and worth scaling - here, on our data, under our controls?". We present EnterpriseVal, a use-case-level evaluation system that closes this gap. It comprises (i) a formal specification of the use case and of the frozen socio-technical configuration under test, model, prompts, retrieval, tools, guardrails and human oversight, with an autonomy level and consequence tier that jointly set the required evaluation intensity; (ii) a metric catalogue spanning fidelity, utility, efficiency, reliability, assurance and oversight; (iii) a grading protocol that scales blinded expert judgement with calibrated LLM-as-judge scoring through prediction-powered inference; (iv) a two-tier threshold gate, stated as an executable algorithm, that maps metric vectors with confidence bounds to REJECT/CONDITIONAL/SCALE decisions; and (v) a value-and-risk model in which the reviewer catch rate is a measured parameter. We report a pilot across three workflows in a global bank. In credit-memo drafting, human-graded citation precision reached 88% and hallucination rate 1.6% for the best model against gates of 70% and 5%; in procedure transformation, analyst refinement effort fell from an estimated 27.4 to 2.9 hours per document. We separate established results, documented pilot evidence, the proposed system and open hypotheses, and specify the experiments required for full validation

AI.tldr: 论文指出企业GenAI落地失败的核心是"测量问题"，提出EnterpriseVal——一套用例级评估系统，将模型能力基准转化为部署决策依据，并在某全球银行三个工作流中试点验证。
AI.motivation: 前沿语言模型已能在大量经济价值任务上产出与人类专家相当的专业交付物，但多数企业GenAI项目未能体现可测量的业务收益，且相当比例的智能体项目预计将被取消。作者认为这主要是测量问题：公开基准回答的是"模型能做什么"，而部署决策需要回答"该工作流在此处、基于我们的数据与管控条件下，是否适配、可靠、安全且值得规模化"。
AI.method: EnterpriseVal由五部分构成：(i) 用例及冻结的社会技术配置的形式化规范，涵盖模型、提示、检索、工具、护栏与人工监督，并以自主性等级与后果层级共同确定评估强度；(ii) 覆盖保真度、效用、效率、可靠性、保障与监督的指标目录；(iii) 通过预测驱动推断（prediction-powered inference）以校准的LLM-as-judge评分扩展盲审专家判断的评分协议；(iv) 以可执行算法表述的两级阈值门，将带置信界的指标向量映射为拒绝/有条件/规模化决策；(v) 将审查者捕获率作为实测参数的价值-风险模型。
AI.result: 在某全球银行三个工作流的试点中：信贷备忘录撰写任务里，最优模型的人工评分引用精确率达88%、幻觉率1.6%，对应门槛为70%与5%；流程改造任务中，分析师精修工作量从估计的每份文档27.4小时降至2.9小时。作者区分了已确立结果、有记录的试点证据、所提出系统与开放假设，并列出完整验证所需的实验。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将企业GenAI的部署决策重新定义为可度量的用例级评估问题，提供了从形式化规范、指标体系、评分协议、阈值门到价值-风险模型的完整框架，并以银行试点给出初步证据；但作者明确其系统部分与开放假设尚需专门设计的实验才能完成全面验证。

title: What Should We Ask Next? Retrieval-Aware Question Learning under Partial Evidence
summary: Interactive retrieval under partial evidence is a sequential information-acquisition problem: an agent must decide which question will create the most useful evidence for the next retrieval update. Existing systems train this decision by imitating an offline ordering of candidate QA pairs, although question value is determined by the response it elicits and its downstream effect on retrieval. We establish that candidate discriminativeness and perceived usefulness provide weak supervision for this objective, then introduce RAVEL, a retrieval-aware online reinforcement learning framework for interactive person re-identification. RAVEL initializes from supervised question generation, observes the current Top-4 candidates directly, and optimizes the question policy with rank feedback from the full question-answer-retrieval loop. Experiments on Interactive-PEDES show that RAVEL delivers progressively stronger retrieval performance across five interaction rounds. Further analysis shows that RAVEL reallocates the questioning budget toward localized open-ended attributes, which provide more useful retrieval evidence and yield the largest gains on initially difficult queries.

AI.tldr: 本文研究部分证据下的交互式检索问题，提出 RAVEL——一个面向交互式行人重识别的检索感知在线强化学习框架，直接优化问题策略以最大化检索收益。
AI.motivation: 现有系统通过模仿候选问答对的离线排序来训练提问决策，但问题价值实际上取决于其引出的回答以及对检索的下游影响；候选区分度与主观有用性只能提供弱监督，无法对齐真实检索目标。
AI.method: RAVEL 从监督式问题生成模型初始化，直接观测当前 Top-4 候选，并利用完整"提问—回答—检索"闭环中的排序反馈，通过在线强化学习优化提问策略。
AI.result: 在 Interactive-PEDES 数据集上，RAVEL 在五轮交互中实现逐步增强的检索性能；分析显示其将提问预算重新分配给局部化开放式属性，这类问题提供更有用的检索证据，并在初始困难查询上取得最大提升。
AI.conclusion: 以检索结果为终局反馈的在线强化学习优于离线模仿排序范式，能够有效分配提问预算并显著提升交互式检索，尤其是困难查询场景。

title: AutoViewMem: Self-Configuring Orthogonal Views for Conversational Long-Term Memory
summary: Long-term memory is essential for large language model (LLM) agents to maintain consistency and personalization over extended interactions. Existing memory systems typically rely on fixed granularities or static schemas, but these designs struggle when heterogeneous information, such as preferences, events, constraints, and temporal updates, is embedded in a single mixed representation. The resulting semantic interference makes top-K retrieval sensitive to noise and often leaves relevant evidence poorly ranked. We present AutoViewMem, a data-driven framework that organizes long-term conversational memory into self-configuring, low-overlap semantic views before indexing. AutoViewMem discovers candidate views from interaction traces, selects a compact complementary view set, and uses these views to guide write-time structured extraction of provenance-grounded memories. This representation-first design moves semantic disentanglement from retrieval time to write time, allowing standard top-K similarity search to retrieve focused evidence without explicit routing or iterative retrieval. We further apply offline consolidation to improve memory compactness and consistency. Experiments on the LoCoMo and PersonaMem benchmarks, under both Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B backbones, show that AutoViewMem improves long-horizon question answering and personalization over strong memory baselines while preserving a simple inference pipeline.

AI.tldr: AutoViewMem 通过“数据结构化优先”的思路，将长时记忆在写入阶段组织为自配置、低重叠的语义视图，从而在标准 top-K 检索下提升长程问答与个性化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体记忆系统多采用固定粒度或静态 schema，难以处理单条混合表示中同时包含偏好、事件、约束和时间更新等异构信息的问题；由此产生的语义干扰使 top-K 检索对噪声敏感，相关证据排序不佳。
AI.method: 提出 AutoViewMem 数据驱动框架：在索引前将长期对话记忆组织为自配置、低重叠的语义视图。具体包括从交互轨迹中发现候选视图、选择紧凑的互补视图集合，并以此指导写入阶段的结构化抽取，生成带溯源依据的记忆；同时引入离线整合以提升记忆紧凑性与一致性。
AI.result: 在 LoCoMo 与 PersonaMem 基准上，基于 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-14B 骨干模型的实验表明，AutoViewMem 在长程问答与个性化任务上优于强记忆基线，同时保持简单推理流程。
AI.conclusion: 将语义解耦从检索阶段前移至写入阶段，可有效缓解混合表示带来的语义干扰，使标准 top-K 相似度检索无需显式路由或迭代检索即可获取聚焦证据，为长时记忆提供了一种可扩展且推理简便的解决方案。

title: Learning Cardiac Features: ECG Biometrics Across Time and~Exercise
summary: Electrocardiograms (ECGs) carry subject-specific patterns enabling reliable individual discrimination, forming the basis of ECG biometrics. Beyond authentication, this paradigm holds significant potential to secure sensitive cardiac data and to serve as a pretext task in self-supervised learning. Yet, most studies remain confined to singlesession, resting data, leaving robustness to temporal and physiological variations largely untested. We address this gap by evaluating ECG biometrics under realistic conditions involving exercise-induced stress and cross-session variability. A Siamese ResNet with late multi-lead fusion strategy is trained on a large ECG dataset extracted from cardiopulmonary exercise tests and evaluated with a exercise-and time-aware protocol, as well as on public benchmarks. This first extensive assessment of ECG biometrics under combined physiological and temporal variability achieves an intra-session rest-to-peak EER of 1.7% and stateof-the-art 3.9% on the CYBHi dataset. Findings support the presence of an intrinsic cardiac signature resilient to physiological and temporal drift.

AI.tldr: 该研究在运动诱发应激与跨会话条件下评估心电生物识别，采用Siamese ResNet与晚期多导联融合，在运动-时间感知协议下取得1.7%的会话内静息至峰值EER，并在CYBHi数据集上达到最优的3.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有心电生物识别研究多局限于单会话静息数据，对时间与生理变化（如运动应激）的鲁棒性缺乏验证，而这对其在敏感心脏数据保护及自监督预训练任务中的应用至关重要。
AI.method: 构建Siamese ResNet模型并采用晚期多导联融合策略，基于心肺运动试验提取的大规模心电数据集训练，使用运动-时间感知协议评估，并在公开基准（如CYBHi）上进行测试。
AI.result: 在生理与时间双重变化下，会话内静息至峰值EER为1.7%，在CYBHi数据集上取得3.9%的最新最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明存在一种对生理与时间漂移具有鲁棒性的内在心脏特征签名，支持心电生物识别在现实变异性条件下的可行性。

title: A Lie Detector Test for Language Models: Reading Knowledge a Model Won't Reveal
summary: Large language models can hold knowledge they do not report. A model may sandbag on a capability evaluation, or answer against what it internally knows, and its outputs alone cannot tell whether it is hiding an answer or simply does not have one. We borrow the Concealed Information Test, a forensic method that identifies guilty knowledge by presenting a suspect with the true detail among plausible decoys and measuring a stronger response to the item they recognize. Our method, Probe of Internal Recognition (PIR), does the same inside a model. It presents a question with its candidate answers and reads, from the model's internal states, which candidate the model recognizes as correct. PIR is reference-free, needing no honest reference model and no labeled truth corpus. Across eight models from five families (Gemma, Qwen, Llama, Mistral, and Phi), PIR recovers the recognized answer at 0.70 to 0.87 balanced accuracy, well above the 0.28 to 0.40 unknown-item baseline and the 0.25 chance rate. It stays readable across every form of concealment we test, from prompted deception and trained sandbagging to external password-locked and circuit-broken checkpoints, with recognition between 0.85 and 0.93. When the model hides a known answer, recognition stays high. When unlearning removes the knowledge, recognition drops to the level of a question the model never knew. PIR therefore separates a model that will not answer from one that cannot, which supports sandbagging audits and unlearning verification. The signal is causal, adds information beyond black-box behavioral cues, and extends from multiple-choice questions to free-form generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PIR（Probe of Internal Recognition），借鉴测谎中的隐藏信息测试范式，通过读取模型内部状态判断它是否"识别"出正确答案，从而区分模型"不愿回答"与"不能回答"。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可能掌握知识却不报告，例如在能力评估中故意放水（sandbagging）或违背内部已知答案作答。仅凭输出无法判断模型是隐藏了答案还是根本没有该知识，这对模型审计与评估构成障碍。
AI.method: PIR将一个问题连同候选答案一同呈现，从模型内部状态中读取其"识别"为正确的候选答案，类似法医隐藏信息测试中通过真实细节与干扰项的比较识别"有罪知识"。该方法是无需参考的（reference-free），不需要诚实参考模型，也不需要标注真值语料。
AI.result: 在来自五个家族（Gemma、Qwen、Llama、Mistral、Phi）的八个模型上，PIR以0.70–0.87的平衡准确率恢复出被识别的答案，显著高于未知项的0.28–0.40基线和0.25的随机水平。在所有测试的隐藏形式（提示欺骗、训练sandbagging、外部密码锁定、circuit-broken检查点）下保持可读性，识别率0.85–0.93。模型隐藏已知答案时识别率仍高；当遗忘（unlearning）真正移除知识时，识别率降至模型从未知晓该问题的水平。
AI.conclusion: PIR能区分"不愿回答"与"不能回答"的模型，支持sandbagging审计和遗忘验证。该信号具有因果性，提供了超越黑箱行为线索的额外信息，并可从多项选择题扩展到自由生成任务。

title: CodeMidas: Scaling Agentic Coding RL Environments from Code Itself
summary: Training capable coding agents via reinforcement learning (RL) requires diverse tasks with reliable verifiers. Open-source codebases offer a rich source of such tasks, while existing methods typically rely on development artifacts such as issues and commits, limiting the range of tasks that can be extracted. To better scale RL environments, we present CodeMidas, an agentic pipeline that turns implemented functionality in existing codebases into executable RL environments using source code as its only task-specific input. CodeMidas allocates agentic compute to every stage of environment construction: agents explore implemented functionality to formulate behavioral specifications, construct tests grounded in execution of the original code, and validate and filter candidate tasks through execution checks and repeated solution rollouts. The resulting dataset has 5,545 training tasks from 3,185 open-source codebases spanning 23 programming languages and 15 technical domains. Training MiMo-V2.5 on these tasks with GRPO improves performance on all five diverse benchmarks, covering issue repair (DeepSWE + 11.7%), whole-program construction (ProgramBench +17%), and terminal work (Terminal-Bench v2.1 +8.5%). Ablations show that increasing the number of high-quality training tasks improves performance. Trajectory analysis shows the RL-trained agent demonstrates better behaviors like increasing codebase exploration and more diverse self-verification. These results establish source code as a scalable foundation for constructing RL environments that improve coding agents across diverse software tasks.

AI.tldr: CodeMidas将开源代码库中已实现的功能转化为可执行RL环境，仅以源码为任务特定输入，构建了覆盖23种语言、15个领域的5,545个训练任务，训练MiMo-V2.5后在五类基准上全面提升。
AI.motivation: 训练具备编码能力的智能体需要通过强化学习获得多样化且具备可靠验证器的任务。开源代码库蕴含丰富任务来源，但现有方法多依赖issue、commit等开发过程产物，限制了可提取任务的范围，难以规模化构建RL环境。
AI.method: CodeMidas是一条智能体化流水线，将代码库中已实现的功能转换为可执行RL环境。它把智能体算力分配到环境构建的每个阶段：智能体探索已实现功能以形成行为规范；基于原始代码的实际执行构建测试；通过执行检查与多次解轨迹采样对候选任务进行验证和过滤。
AI.result: 构建的数据集包含来自3,185个开源代码库的5,545个训练任务，覆盖23种编程语言与15个技术领域。用GRPO训练MiMo-V2.5后在五个基准上均获提升：issue修复（DeepSWE +11.7%）、整程序构建（ProgramBench +17%）、终端任务（Terminal-Bench v2.1 +8.5%）。消融实验表明增加高质量训练任务数量可提升性能；轨迹分析显示RL训练后的智能体表现出更多代码库探索与更多样化的自验证行为。
AI.conclusion: 以源代码作为构造RL环境的可扩展基础是可行的，能够提升编码智能体在多样软件任务上的表现。仅依赖源码作为任务特定输入即可大规模生成高质量可验证任务，任务规模与质量对性能具有正向作用。

title: ResNLS: An Improved Model for Stock Price Forecasting
summary: Stock prices forecasting has always been a challenging task. Although many research projects try to address the problem, few of them pay attention to the varying degrees of dependencies between stock prices. In this paper, we introduce a hybrid model that improves the prediction of stock prices by emphasizing the dependencies between adjacent stock prices. The proposed model, ResNLS, is mainly composed of two neural architectures, ResNet and LSTM. ResNet serves as a feature extractor to identify dependencies between stock prices, while LSTM analyzes the initial time series data with the combination of dependencies, which are considered as residuals. Our experiment reveals that when the closing price data for the previous 5 consecutive trading days is used as input, the performance of the model (ResNLS-5) is optimal compared to those with other inputs. Furthermore, ResNLS-5 demonstrates at least a 20% improvement over current state-of-the-art baselines. To verify whether ResNLS-5 can help clients effectively avoid risks and earn profits in the stock market, we construct a quantitative trading framework for back testing. The result shows that the trading strategy based on ResNLS-5 predictions can successfully mitigate losses during declining stock prices and generate profits in periods of rising stock prices.

AI.tldr: 提出ResNLS混合模型，用ResNet提取相邻股价依赖作为残差、LSTM处理原始时序，取前5个交易日收盘价为输入的ResNLS-5表现最优，较SOTA基线至少提升20%，并经量化回测验证可在跌势中减亏、涨势中获利。
AI.motivation: 股价预测长期是难题，已有研究多忽视股价之间不同程度依赖关系的重要性，本文旨在通过强调相邻股价间的依赖来提升预测精度。
AI.method: ResNLS由ResNet与LSTM两种神经架构组成：ResNet作为特征提取器识别股价间依赖关系，该依赖以残差形式与原始时间序列数据结合，再由LSTM进行建模分析；同时构建量化交易框架用于策略回测。
AI.result: 以连续5个交易日收盘价为输入时（ResNLS-5）性能最优；ResNLS-5较当前最先进基线至少提升20%；回测显示基于其预测的交易策略能在股价下跌阶段成功减少损失，并在上涨阶段产生收益。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模相邻股价依赖的ResNLS-5在预测精度与实盘策略收益两方面均优于现有基线，可为投资者规避风险与获取利润提供支持。

title: A Hybrid Computational Intelligence Framework for scRNA-seq Imputation: Integrating scRecover and Random Forests
summary: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables transcriptomic profiling at cellular resolution but suffers from pervasive dropout events that obscure biological signals. We present SCR-MF, a modular two-stage workflow that combines principled dropout detection using scRecover with robust non-parametric imputation via missForest. Across public and simulated datasets, SCR-MF achieves robust and interpretable performance comparable to or exceeding existing imputation methods in most cases, while preserving biological fidelity and transparency. Runtime analysis demonstrates that SCR-MF provides a competitive balance between accuracy and computational efficiency, making it suitable for mid-scale single-cell datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出SCR-MF——一个两阶段模块化工作流，先用scRecover进行有原则的dropout检测，再用missForest进行稳健的非参数插补，在多数情况下性能可比或优于现有方法，并在精度与效率间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: scRNA-seq可实现细胞分辨率的转录组分析，但普遍存在dropout事件，掩盖了真实生物学信号。现有插补方法在准确性、可解释性、生物保真度与计算效率之间难以兼顾。
AI.method: SCR-MF采用两阶段模块化流程：第一阶段用scRecover进行dropout检测（识别真正需要插补的零值），第二阶段对检测到的dropout用missForest进行稳健的非参数插补。
AI.result: 在公开数据集与模拟数据集上，SCR-MF在多数情况下取得稳健且可解释的性能，可比或超过现有插补方法；同时保持生物学保真度与流程透明性。运行时间分析表明其在精度与计算效率间具有竞争力的平衡，适用于中等规模单细胞数据集。
AI.conclusion: SCR-MF通过“检测+插补”的两阶段设计，提供了稳健、可解释、保真且高效的单细胞dropout插补方案，适合中等规模scRNA-seq数据的下游分析。

title: Making Latent Evolution Explicit: Operator-Structured Transitions for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) augment robot policies by predicting how task-relevant scene states may evolve under interaction. Recent WAMs increasingly perform such prediction in latent representation spaces, avoiding full appearance-level generation while preserving control-relevant information. Yet latent transitions are commonly realized with Transformer-based predictors whose inductive structure is centered on token interaction rather than temporal evolution. We study transition realization as an architectural choice distinct from predictive representation and prediction-policy coupling. We introduce the Latent Evolution Operator Network (LEON), which models latent evolution in a learned observable space through context-modulated operator-based propagation and additive forcing. Grounded in the controlled Koopman generator view of evolution, LEON organizes context-dependent transition variation around a shared evolution-operator structure while retaining a complementary path for additive change. Controlled dynamical systems verify the resulting evolution-specific inductive bias and the complementary roles of operator propagation and forcing. Across two WAM formulations that integrate latent prediction into the policy differently, LEON improves closed-loop performance and robustness while remaining effective under full transition replacement. These results establish transition realization as a consequential architectural choice in latent WAMs.

AI.tldr: 本文将潜空间世界动作模型中的"潜状态转移实现方式"视为独立于预测表征与预测-策略耦合的架构选择，提出基于算子的潜演化网络LEON，用上下文调制的算子传播加可加驱动力建模潜演化，在受控动力学系统与两种WAM框架上验证了该演化归纳偏置的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）日益在潜表征空间预测任务相关场景状态的演化，以避免全外观生成并保留控制相关信息。但潜转移普遍由Transformer预测器实现，其归纳结构以token交互为中心，而非时间演化本身。作者认为"转移实现方式"是与预测表征、预测-策略耦合相区分的独立架构选择，且缺乏专门针对演化结构的归纳偏置。
AI.method: 提出潜演化算子网络LEON。以受控Koopman生成元视角为理论基础，在学习到的可观空间中对潜演化建模：采用上下文调制的算子式传播刻画围绕共享演化算子结构的上下文相关转移变化，并保留一条用于可加变化的互补路径（additive forcing）。
AI.result: 在受控动力学系统上验证了LEON所具有的演化专用归纳偏置，以及算子传播与驱动力二者的互补作用；在两种以不同方式将潜预测接入策略的WAM形式下，LEON提升了闭环性能与鲁棒性，且在完全替换转移模块时仍然有效。
AI.conclusion: 转移实现方式（transition realization）是潜空间世界动作模型中一个具有实质影响的架构选择，值得作为与表征学习、策略耦合并列的独立设计维度加以研究。

title: BI-Agent and BI-Bench: Towards Automating End-to-End Business Intelligence
comment: code and data are available at \url{https://github.com/Hu-Chuxuan/bi-agent}
summary:
Business intelligence (BI) is a cornerstone of enterprise decision-making and is widely used by enterprise users in software such as Power BI and Tableau. In traditional BI workflows, users need to prepare data by (1) identifying relevant tables, (2) performing data transformations, and (3) building join relationships, before they can (4) answer their business questions. These steps can be complex and time-consuming, making BI challenging.
  Given the strong capabilities of large language models (LLMs) in working with data, we study their ability to answer BI questions end-to-end, without requiring users to manually perform the tedious preparation steps. To do this, we harvest a large collection of real-world BI projects from public sources, and manually extract pairs of (questions, ground-truth answers) from real user dashboards. The resulting benchmark, BI-Bench, is the first benchmark to systematically study LLMs' ability on end-to-end BI.
  We find that even frontier LLMs perform poorly on BI-Bench, with less than 50% accuracy. To address their limitations, we design a tool-augmented BI-Agent that decomposes BI workflows into subtasks on structured data, such as search, join, and transform, and orchestrates specialized data management methods across BI stages. Furthermore, we develop a post-training framework that synthesizes training trajectories from real BI projects, enabling BI-Agent to be further post-trained using both supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). BI-Agent achieves substantial accuracy gains of up to 40 percentage points with vanilla LLMs, and post-trained BI-Agent yields gains of up to 30 points. Our results highlight the importance of combining tool-augmented reasoning with domain-specific post-training in complex BI workflows, and point to promising directions for future research.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了首个端到端商业智能（BI）基准BI-Bench，发现前沿LLM准确率不足50%；提出工具增强的BI-Agent及后训练框架，实现显著准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 传统BI工作流需用户手动完成识别相关表、数据变换、构建连接关系等繁琐准备步骤，耗时且复杂。鉴于LLM在数据处理上的强能力，作者希望研究其能否端到端回答BI问题，从而免去手动准备环节。
AI.method: 1) 从公开来源采集大量真实BI项目，并从真实用户仪表盘中人工抽取（问题，真值答案）对，构建BI-Bench基准；2) 设计工具增强的BI-Agent，将BI工作流分解为结构化数据上的子任务（搜索、连接、变换），并编排各BI阶段的数据管理方法；3) 开发后训练框架，从真实BI项目合成训练轨迹，采用监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）对BI-Agent进行后训练。
AI.result: 前沿LLM在BI-Bench上表现不佳，准确率低于50%；BI-Agent相较原始LLM最高提升40个百分点；经后训练的BI-Agent进一步提升最高30个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在复杂BI工作流中，将工具增强推理与领域特定后训练相结合至关重要，并为未来研究指明了有前景的方向。

title: Bio-MF: Low-Latency and High-Fidelity EEG-to-fNIRS Cross-Modal Generation for Hybrid Motor-Imagery Brain--Computer Interfaces
summary: Hybrid motor-imagery brain-computer interfaces (MI-BCIs) combining EEG and fNIRS can outperform EEG-only systems by exploiting complementary electrophysiological and hemodynamic information. To obtain such hybrid information when paired EEG-fNIRS acquisition is unavailable or inconvenient, recent studies have focused on EEG-to-fNIRS cross-modal generation. However, existing methods still suffer from slow generation and often require pretraining, limiting their use in real-time MI-BCI scenarios. Although one-step generative models offer an attractive route to low-latency synthesis, removing the iterative refinement process can reduce generation fidelity and introduce non-physiological artifacts. To address these problems, this paper proposes Bio-MF, a latent-free one-step MeanFlow framework for EEG-conditioned fNIRS generation. Bio-MF performs direct signal-space x-prediction, converts this signal-space output into MeanFlow velocity supervision, and completes inference with one network evaluation. To preserve task-relevant hemodynamic structure under heterogeneous sensor layouts, Bio-MF integrates Spatial-Temporal Interactive 4D Encoding, cross-modal classifier-free guidance, and noise-level-gated FFT regularization. On Dataset 1, EEG + synthetic fNIRS improves ACC over EEG-only by 3.37 and 4.15 percentage points for HbR and HbO, respectively. On Dataset 2, the corresponding gains remain 2.98 and 2.50 percentage points under the unseen 64-channel EEG montage. On an RTX PRO 6000 GPU, Bio-MF generates one fNIRS trial in 7.0 ms, corresponding to an 857x speedup over the 1000-step SCDM latency. These results show that Bio-MF enables fast EEG-to-fNIRS synthesis while preserving task-relevant generation quality for downstream hybrid MI decoding. Our code is available at https://github.com/psychosiwa/Bio-MF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Bio-MF，一种无潜空间、单步 MeanFlow 框架，用于 EEG 条件生成 fNIRS 信号，兼顾低延迟生成与任务相关血流动力学保真度，在混合运动想象 BCI 解码中显著优于纯 EEG 基线。
AI.motivation: 混合 MI-BCI 结合 EEG 与 fNIRS 可优于纯 EEG 系统，但配对采集不便。现有 EEG-to-fNIRS 跨模态生成方法生成慢且常需预训练，难以满足实时 MI-BCI 需求；一步生成模型虽低延迟，却缺乏迭代细化，易降低保真度并引入非生理伪影。
AI.method: 提出 Bio-MF：无潜空间单步 MeanFlow 框架，直接进行信号空间 x-prediction，并将其转化为 MeanFlow 速度监督，推理仅需一次网络评估。为在异构传感器布局下保留任务相关血流动力学结构，集成时空交互 4D 编码、跨模态无分类器引导及噪声级门控 FFT 正则化。
AI.result: Dataset 1 上 EEG+合成 fNIRS 相比纯 EEG，HbR 与 HbO 的 ACC 分别提升 3.37 与 4.15 个百分点；Dataset 2 在未见过的 64 通道 EEG 蒙太奇下提升 2.98 与 2.50 个百分点。RTX PRO 6000 GPU 上单试次生成 7.0 ms，相比 1000 步 SCDM 延迟实现 857 倍加速。
AI.conclusion: Bio-MF 实现了快速 EEG-to-fNIRS 合成，同时保持面向下游混合 MI 解码的任务相关生成质量，验证了单步 MeanFlow 在跨模态生理信号生成中的有效性。

title: Scaling Discovery through Test-Time Communication
summary: Science advances not in isolation but through collaboration, yet existing agentic systems capture little of this. Whether communicating agents help remains an open question with mixed prior results. We show that test-time communication can substantially outperform independent parallel attempts on challenging tasks, where sharing a breakthrough can push the whole group forward. We first study the effect of scaling multi-agent test-time communication, where agents have no predefined roles and communicate via a shared directory, on ARC-AGI-3, a benchmark requiring novel problem solving. We find that a team of $k$ communicating agents, team@$k$, matches the success rate of $4k$ independent agents, and this advantage grows with $k$, suggesting gains compound with scale. The effect is not merely efficiency: a task that no single agent can solve, a team of agents can solve reliably. Furthermore, these gains transfer to research-oriented tasks, given sufficient compute. On polyomino packing, communicating agents outperform best@$k$ and exceed the prior best-known score. On MNIST classifier compression, communication surpasses the best-known human solution. A team of four agents produced a 1,957-byte classifier submission achieving 99.4% test accuracy, smaller than both the best-known human solution and the best single-agent result. These gains are not unconditional. Independent agents may outperform communication when compute is limited or when a clear measure of progress is absent. However, under sufficient compute and clear feedback, multi-agent communication consistently yields stronger results.

AI.tldr: 测试时通信的多智能体团队显著优于独立并行尝试，优势随规模增长并可迁移至研究型任务，但需充足算力与清晰反馈。
AI.motivation: 科学进步依赖协作，但现有智能体系统鲜有体现；通信智能体是否有益此前结论不一，尚属开放问题。
AI.method: 研究无预设角色、通过共享目录通信的k个智能体团队（team@k）在ARC-AGI-3上的测试时通信扩展效应；并迁移至polyomino packing与MNIST分类器压缩等研究型任务。
AI.result: team@k匹配4k个独立智能体的成功率且优势随k增长；单智能体无法解决的任务团队可稳定解决。polyomino packing超过best@k及此前最优分数；MNIST压缩中四人团队以1,957字节达到99.4%测试精度，优于已知人类最优与最佳单智能体结果。算力受限或无清晰进展度量时独立智能体可能更优。
AI.conclusion: 测试时通信可带来复合增益且能迁移到研究型任务，但收益非无条件：需充足算力与清晰反馈时，多智能体通信才稳定取得更强结果。

title: PlantShade: Predicting Plant Shadows for Lighting-Aware Robotic Agricultural Operation
comment: This paper has been accepted by the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Plant growth and agricultural production form the foundation of a country's sustainable development and directly impact human livelihoods. Recent advances in frontier artificial intelligence have enabled scientific agriculture with strong potential to improve crop productivity. In this paper, we identify the importance and inherent complexity of plant shade simulation, as shading is a critical factor influencing plant growth. To advance this field and promote broader societal benefits, we focus on two main contributions. First, we introduce a comprehensive plant growth and shade dataset covering four plant species, including soybean, tomato, sugarbeet, and strawberry. The dataset includes top-down viewpoints with a supplementary light along a circular trajectory, casting dynamic shadows across multiple growth stages and diverse observation complexities. Second, we propose generative shade simulation based on diffusion models, enabling realistic shade generation for unseen plants and supporting downstream robotic tasks such as perception, lighting control, and view planning. The model incorporates temporal conditioning to facilitate flexible shade simulation across different time stages. We conduct both quantitative and qualitative evaluations to assess model performance. This work provides a foundational study for plant-aware shade modeling and has meaningful implications for broader agricultural and robotic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了涵盖大豆、番茄、甜菜、草莓四种作物、多生长阶段与循环光照的植物生长与阴影数据集，并提出融入时间条件的扩散生成模型以实现逼真阴影模拟，支持机器人感知、光照控制与视角规划等下游任务。
AI.motivation: 植物生长与农业生产是国家可持续发展与民生的重要基础，前沿AI推动了科学农业的发展。阴影是影响植物生长的关键因素，但植物阴影模拟本身具有重要性与内在复杂性，现有工作缺乏系统性研究，因此本文旨在推进该领域以产生更广泛的社会效益。
AI.method: 工作包含两部分：（1）构建综合的植物生长与阴影数据集，覆盖大豆、番茄、甜菜、草莓四种植物，采用俯视视角并辅以沿圆周轨迹运动的补充光源，在多个生长阶段产生动态阴影，涵盖多样的观测复杂度；（2）提出基于扩散模型的生成式阴影模拟方法，通过引入时间条件（temporal conditioning）实现不同时间阶段的灵活阴影生成，可为未见植物生成逼真阴影。
AI.result: 通过定量与定性评估验证了模型性能，模型能够为未见植物生成逼真阴影，并支持机器人感知、光照控制与视角规划等下游任务。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为植物感知的阴影建模提供了基础性工作，对更广泛的农业与机器人应用具有意义。

title: Aligning with Lived Experience: Heterogeneous Benefits of Fine Tuning in Mental Health Support Generation
summary: As access to professional mental healthcare remains limited, many individuals turn to online platforms such as Reddit to seek peer support situated within human lived experience. However, a significant portion of such queries go unanswered, presenting an opportunity for using Large Language Models (LLMs) to fill this gap. While LLMs have demonstrated strong performance on clinical benchmarks, their ability to generate lived-experience informed and community-aligned peer support is underexplored. Addressing this gap, we introduce the COmmunity-centered Peer Engaged Support (COPES) dataset and a three-axis evaluation framework to assess LLM alignment with community perspectives to mental health support seeking queries. Evaluating zero-shot and post-trained (SFT and DPO) models, we show that post-training on COPES significantly improves Strategy Alignment (>50% for general-purpose models) and alignment in Emotion & Tone. However, we also observe that such improvements are heterogeneous and alignment improvements vary significantly across subreddits and requested coping strategies. Furthermore, post-training induces distributional shifts, heavily favoring problem-focused recommendations while suppressing emotion-focused strategies. Together, this work shows that while curating community-driven data improves the alignment of LLM responses, model performance remains disparate across distinct sub-communities and specific mental health needs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出COPES数据集与三轴评估框架，评估LLM在心理健康同伴支持中与社区视角的对齐程度，发现后训练（SFT、DPO）能显著提升策略与情感语调和情绪对齐，但改进异构且引发策略分布偏移。
AI.motivation: 专业心理医疗资源有限，许多人转向Reddit等在线平台寻求基于真实生活经验的同伴支持，但大量求助帖无人回应。LLM虽有潜力填补这一空白，其在临床基准上表现良好，却缺乏对"基于生活经验、契合社区规范"的同伴支持生成能力的探索。
AI.method: 构建COmmunity-centered Peer Engaged Support（COPES）数据集，并提出三轴评估框架，用以衡量LLM在面对心理健康求助时与社区视角的对齐程度。评估对象包括零样本模型以及经SFT和DPO后训练的模型。
AI.result: 在COPES上后训练可使通用模型策略对齐提升50%以上，并改善情感与语调对齐；但改进呈异构性，不同子版块（subreddit）与不同应对策略上的对齐提升差异显著。此外，后训练引入分布偏移，过度偏向问题导向型建议而抑制情绪导向型策略。
AI.conclusion: 基于社区数据精选可提升LLM响应的对齐性，但模型表现在不同子社区与具体心理健康需求间仍不均衡，未来需针对多元社区与需求进一步优化。

title: Geometry of Values: Task Vector Composition for Ethical Preference Alignment in Language Models
comment: Accepted at the Pluralistic Alignment Workshop @ ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea. https://icml.cc/virtual/2026/75692
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in applications that must weigh clashing moral values, yet even strong models exhibit hidden biases and brittle instruction-following across languages. We introduce a 12,000-instance dataset of two-option dilemmas covering pairwise three value conflicts: Honesty vs. Justice, Justice vs. Autonomy, and Autonomy vs. Honesty, along with their translations into Hindi, Arabic, Spanish, and Chinese, to probe cross-lingual behavior. Benchmarking on GPT-5-mini reveals that it consistently favors Honesty over Autonomy across all five languages when no policy is given. The Llama-3.2-1/3B models exhibit strong first-option bias; however, both plain fine-tuning and Direct Preference Optimization fine-tuning effectively remove this bias, increasing accuracy to greater than 98%. In order to decouple the effect of learning correlations in the dataset from abstract values, we propose a task vector transfer based experiment where after computing the task vectors for a direction of value preference we orthogonalize it with respect to the general instruction following vector. Our experiment shows that this method is effective in isolating the direction of the specific value preference that can successfully be used to conduct task arithmetic to obtain a model with the opposite stance.

AI.tldr: 构建12000条双选项道德困境数据集（含印、阿、西、中四种翻译），评测LLM跨语言价值偏好，并借助任务向量正交化方法分离特定价值偏好方向。
AI.motivation: LLM在价值冲突场景中表现出隐性偏见与跨语言指令遵循脆弱性，需要可探测其价值观取向及跨语言一致性的基准与方法。
AI.method: 构建覆盖三组两两价值冲突（诚实vs公正、公正vs自主、自主vs诚实）的12000条双选项困境数据集，并翻译为印地语、阿拉伯语、西班牙语、中文；在GPT-5-mini与Llama-3.2-1/3B上基准测试；对Llama采用普通微调与DPO微调；提出任务向量迁移实验，将价值偏好方向的任务向量对通用指令遵循向量做正交化处理。
AI.result: GPT-5-mini在五种语言下无策略给定均一致偏好诚实高于自主；Llama-3.2-1/3B存在明显首选项偏见，普通微调与DPO微调均可消除该偏见，准确率提升至98%以上；正交化方法能有效分离出特定价值偏好方向，并可通过任务算术得到立场相反的模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了跨语言道德困境基准，揭示模型价值偏好的一致性偏见，并证明任务向量正交化可解耦数据相关性与抽象价值，实现价值取向的可控编辑。

title: From Task Success to Productive Success: Evaluating Human-AI Collaboration by Quality and Cost
summary: AI productivity is often measured by task completion time, economic value, or improvements in outcome quality. However, these measures usually treat collaboration as a black box where they capture what output was produced, but not the interaction cost required to produce it. Motivated by economics literature, we introduce a productivity-oriented framework for evaluating human-AI collaboration as outcome quality relative to interaction cost. Across two datasets spanning four tasks, we show that: (1) sessions with identical quality ratings can differ by up to 70 times in interaction cost; (2) quality-cost relationships vary by task, with some tasks rewarding extended interaction and others favoring fast convergence; (3) subjective user ratings are not reliable substitutes for productivity; and (4) productive sessions are characterized by agents probing earlier and users spending less effort repairing the interaction. By distinguishing productive success from costly success, our framework makes interactional cost visible and shows how dialogue analysis can inform the evaluation and design of AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以"产出质量/交互成本"为核心的人机协作生产力评估框架，发现同等质量会话的交互成本可相差70倍，且质量—成本关系因任务而异，主观评分无法替代生产力度量。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生产力度量（任务完成时间、经济价值、结果质量提升）将协作视为黑箱，只关注产出什么，而忽略了产出过程中的交互成本，导致"高成本的成功"与"高生产力的成功"被混为一谈。
AI.method: 借鉴经济学文献，构建以结果质量相对于交互成本的生产力导向框架；在两个数据集、四项任务上对会话进行质量与交互成本联合分析，并对成功与失败会话的对话行为（如智能体探询时机、用户修复投入）进行对比。
AI.result: （1）质量评分相同的会话，交互成本差异可达70倍；（2）质量—成本关系随任务变化，部分任务受益于延长交互，部分任务偏好快速收敛；（3）主观用户评分不能可靠替代生产力指标；（4）高生产力会话中智能体更早进行探询，用户耗费更少精力修复交互。
AI.conclusion: 通过区分"高生产力的成功"与"高成本的成功"，该框架使交互成本可见，并表明对话分析可为AI系统的评估与设计提供依据。

title: EnSol: an environment-aware graph neural network for molecular solubility prediction
summary: Molecular solubility directly affects key aspects of molecular development such as reaction feasibility, formulation performance, separation efficiency, and solvent selection. However, experimental measurement across solutes, solvents, and temperatures remains costly and sparsely sampled. Existing computational models often rely on fixed-solvent assumptions, deterministic formulations, or simplified representations of solute-solvent interactions, limiting their ability to capture complex molecular interactions, continuous temperature effects, and experimental uncertainty. Here, we introduce EnSol, an environment-aware probabilistic framework for molecular solubility prediction. EnSol represents the solute and solvent as molecular graphs and learns separate representations for each before bringing them together through cross-attention to capture solute-solvent interactions. Temperature is incorporated directly into the solvent environment through feature-wise modulation, and a mixture density network predicts full solubility distributions to capture both temperature-dependent behavior and experimental uncertainty. On the independent SolProp and Leeds benchmark datasets, EnSol achieved Spearman correlations of 0.876 and 0.601, respectively, outperforming state-of-the-art solubility prediction models across both benchmarks. Beyond computational benchmarking, experimental validation across chemically diverse solute-solvent pairs showed that EnSol maintained strong predictive performance and supported reliable solvent ranking, achieving a Spearman correlation of 0.715. These results show that EnSol can support reliable solubility prediction and solvent selection across diverse chemical systems while accounting for predictive uncertainty.

AI.tldr: EnSol：一种环境感知的概率框架，用分子图+交叉注意力建模溶质-溶剂相互作用，并通过特征调制注入温度、用混合密度网络预测完整溶解度分布；在SolProp和Leeds上Spearman相关分别为0.876和0.601，实验验证为0.715。
AI.motivation: 分子溶解度影响反应可行性、制剂性能、分离效率与溶剂选择等关键环节，但实验测量成本高、覆盖稀疏。现有计算模型多依赖固定溶剂假设、确定性建模或简化的溶质-溶剂相互作用表示，难以刻画复杂分子相互作用、连续温度效应及实验不确定性。
AI.method: 提出EnSol——环境感知的概率框架。将溶质与溶剂分别表示为分子图并学习各自独立表示，再通过交叉注意力融合以捕捉溶质-溶剂相互作用；温度经特征级调制直接注入溶剂环境表示；采用混合密度网络预测完整溶解度分布，以同时建模温度依赖行为与实验不确定性。
AI.result: 在独立的SolProp与Leeds基准上，EnSol的Spearman相关系数分别为0.876与0.601，在两个基准上均优于当前最先进的溶解度预测模型；在化学多样性溶质-溶剂对的实验验证中保持较强预测性能并支持可靠溶剂排序，Spearman相关系数为0.715。
AI.conclusion: EnSol可在多种化学体系中实现可靠的溶解度预测与溶剂选择，并能给出预测不确定性，为环境感知的概率化溶解度建模提供了有效方案。

title: SWE-Proof: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World Issues with Machine-Checked Proofs?
summary: Ensuring the correctness of LLM-generated code is a core challenge for modern software engineering. Benchmarks for agentic code generation check correctness with held-out test suites, which are inherently incomplete and increasingly susceptible to memorization. Formal verification avoids both problems, but existing work covers only standalone tasks whose specifications are given as input, not real issues, which touch large repositories and state intent in vague natural language. We present Benchproofer, a pipeline that turns a coding task with a known correct patch into a formally verified one: it writes a specification for the new code, summarizes the existing functions that code calls with axioms, and admits an instance only after mechanical and adversarial gates agree. Applying it to SWE-bench Verified yields SWE-Proof, 500 real issues whose correctness is formally verified rather than tested, and it extends to SWE-bench Pro. Across two frontier models, verification catches what tests miss: a quarter to a half of test-passing patches admit counterexamples, which a structured natural-language specification does not fix, while a correct formal one lifts resolution from 85% to 95% for Opus 4.8. Writing that specification is the hard part: models that must write their own gain nothing over an unaided baseline, and only 62% of their specifications pass our audit. The usual failure is faithfulness, a specification that constrains part of the required behavior and leaves the rest free. Specification quality still tracks the outcome, failing on 89% of unresolved instances against 47% of resolved ones, making faithful specification synthesis a concrete open problem.

AI.tldr: 提出 Benchproofer 流水线，将带正确补丁的编码任务转为形式化验证任务，构建 SWE-Proof（500 个真实 issue），揭示测试通过的补丁中大量存在反例，并把"忠实规格合成"定为核心开放问题。
AI.motivation: 现有 agentic 代码生成基准依赖留出测试集判断正确性，测试集本身不完整且易被记忆；形式化验证虽能规避这两个问题，但已有工作只覆盖规格作为输入给定的独立任务，无法处理涉及大型仓库、意图由模糊自然语言表述的真实 issue。
AI.method: Benchproofer 流水线：对已知正确补丁的编码任务，(1) 为新代码编写形式化规格；(2) 用公理概括被调用既有函数的行为；(3) 仅在机械门与对抗门一致同意后接纳该实例。据此将 SWE-bench Verified 转为 SWE-Proof，并扩展至 SWE-bench Pro。
AI.result: 在两种前沿模型上，验证捕获了测试遗漏的错误：25%–50% 通过测试的补丁存在反例；结构化自然语言规格无法解决该问题，而正确形式化规格将 Opus 4.8 的解决率从 85% 提升到 95%。自写规格的模型相对无辅助基线无增益，仅 62% 的规格通过审计；主要失败模式是忠实性不足（规格只约束部分必需行为）。规格质量与结果相关：未解决实例中 89% 规格失败，已解决实例中为 47%。
AI.conclusion: 测试通过不等于正确，形式化验证可暴露测试遗漏的反例并显著提升解决率；瓶颈在于模型自主编写忠实规格的能力，忠实规格合成仍是具体且迫切的开放问题。

title: Visual Navigation Transformer with Pose Attention
summary: Learned navigation policies typically consume observations as a temporally ordered history, with positional encodings tying each observation to when it was seen, making it difficult to reuse experience from earlier traversals of an environment. Systems that do reuse such experience usually construct an explicit representation, such as a map or a topological graph, and plan on it. We propose VNT-PA (Visual Navigation Transformer with Pose Attention), a transformer planner whose context is a set of depth keyframes indexed by camera pose. With camera poses as positional encoding, attention depends on the pose differences between keyframes rather than on their temporal order. VNT-PA is trained to imitate a shortest-path planner operating on the ground-truth scene mesh, predicting actions by querying the spatial context with only its current pose and the goal position. On point-goal navigation in HM3D validation scenes, VNT-PA reaches 93.3% success and 90.4% success weighted by path length (SPL), outperforming baselines that encode the same context as a temporal sequence or treat pose as an input feature, in both navigation performance and training efficiency. Because the spatial context is a pose-indexed set, frames from different trajectories can be fused at test time. The planner also degrades more gracefully under localization noise than a conventional baseline which plans on explicit maps. These results show that pose-stamped experience can serve directly as the environment representation for a learned planner, and that making attention depend on pose differences, rather than on temporal order, speeds up training and improves long-horizon navigation.

AI.tldr: 提出VNT-PA，一种以位姿索引的深度关键帧集合为上下文的Transformer导航规划器，注意力依赖位姿差而非时间顺序，在HM3D点目标导航中达到93.3%成功率和90.4% SPL。
AI.motivation: 现有学习式导航策略将观测作为时序历史消费，位置编码把每个观测绑定到其被看到的时间，导致难以复用早前遍历同一环境的经验。复用经验的系统通常需构建显式表征（地图或拓扑图）并在其上规划，存在局限。
AI.method: VNT-PA以相机位姿索引的深度关键帧集合作为上下文，用位姿作为位置编码，使注意力取决于关键帧间的位姿差而非时间顺序。模型通过模仿在真值场景网格上运行的最短路径规划器进行训练，仅凭当前位姿和目标位置查询空间上下文来预测动作。
AI.result: 在HM3D验证场景的点目标导航中，VNT-PA达到93.3%成功率与90.4% SPL，在导航性能和训练效率上均优于将相同上下文编码为时序序列或把位姿作为输入特征的基线；由于空间上下文是位姿索引集合，测试时可融合不同轨迹的帧；在定位噪声下比基于显式地图规划的传统基线退化更平缓。
AI.conclusion: 带位姿标记的经验可直接作为学习式规划器的环境表征；让注意力依赖位姿差而非时间顺序，能加速训练并改善长时程导航。

title: Fewer Steps, Better Actions: Rethinking Flow-Matching Inference for VLA Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies based on flow matching generate action chunks through repeated evaluations of an action expert. Increasing the number of integration steps raises inference cost, but does not necessarily improve closed-loop success. We propose Coda, which reallocates part of this integration budget to a single learned endpoint correction. A frozen policy first completes a few-step noise-to-action trajectory; a lightweight Transformer then predicts a demonstration-supervised residual using the candidate action, source noise, and shared observation-prefix cache. Only the corrector is trained. On 50 RoboTwin Easy tasks, five-step Coda improves success from 71.64% to 74.68% over the matched five-step baseline, while reducing forward latency by 30.2% relative to the default ten-step policy. A two-step configuration achieves 71.88% success with a 2.12$\times$ speedup. An independent 13-task control shows a 5.69-percentage-point gain at nearly equal latency, supporting correction as an effective alternative to additional integration. The same design also improves frozen official SmolVLA, raising two-step success from 60.8% to 69.4%. These results show that endpoint correction improves the quality-latency trade-off of frozen flow-matching policies.

AI.tldr: 提出 Coda，将流匹配 VLA 策略的部分积分预算重新分配给单一学习式端点校正，在不增加推理成本的前提下提升闭环成功率。
AI.motivation: 基于流匹配的 VLA 策略通过反复评估动作专家生成动作块。增加积分步数会提高推理成本，却不一定提升闭环成功率，即积分步数与任务成功率之间存在明显的质量-延迟失衡问题。
AI.method: 冻结原策略，先以少步数完成从噪声到动作的轨迹；再引入轻量级 Transformer 校正器，利用候选动作、源噪声与共享观测前缀缓存预测演示监督的残差；训练时仅更新校正器。该设计将部分积分预算转为一次端点校正。
AI.result: 在 50 个 RoboTwin Easy 任务上，五步 Coda 将成功率从 71.64% 提升至 74.68%，相比默认十步策略前向延迟降低 30.2%；两步配置达 71.88% 成功率，加速 2.12 倍。独立 13 任务对照在近乎相同延迟下取得 5.69 个百分点提升。将该设计用于冻结的官方 SmolVLA，两步成功率由 60.8% 提升至 69.4%。
AI.conclusion: 端点校正可有效替代额外的积分步数，改善冻结流匹配策略的质量-延迟权衡，是一种通用且低成本的性能增强方案。

title: Hallucination-R1: Robustness-Oriented Paraphrase Generation for Factual Consistency
summary: Factual hallucination is commonly defined by incorrect factual outputs. We study a paraphrase-induced hallucination setting, where a model answers a factual question correctly in its original form but generates an incorrect answer under a semantically equivalent paraphrase. Such inconsistencies expose latent factual instability under semantic invariance. However, general-purpose paraphrases are often insufficient as robustness-oriented supervision: near-copy paraphrases provide weak signals, while overly diverse paraphrases may break semantic equivalence. In this paper, we propose HALLUCINATION-R1, a robustness-oriented paraphrase generation framework that learns to produce semantically faithful yet robustness-challenging paraphrases for factual consistency. Through two-stage optimization, it first stabilizes meaning-preserving and diverse paraphrasing, then rewards paraphrases that reveal factual consistency degradation in downstream QA models. Experiments on SimpleQuestions, PopQA, and TruthfulQA show that HALLUCINATION-R1 achieves a strong consistency--diversity trade-off and exposes robustness failures across multiple model families and datasets. Further analyses indicate that these failures are not reducible to surface-level artifacts or semantic drift, but reveal non-trivial factual instability under meaning-preserving variation. A lightweight fine-tuning study also shows that HALLUCINATION-R1-generated data improves robust accuracy under paraphrase variations, suggesting its utility for robustness-oriented training. Our code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/yuwenhan07/Hallucination-R1.

AI.tldr: 提出HALLUCINATION-R1框架，通过生成语义保真但能暴露模型事实不稳定的改写句，研究改写诱导的幻觉问题，并在多个数据集上验证其一致性与多样性权衡及鲁棒性训练价值。
AI.motivation: 模型对同一事实问题在原句下回答正确，但语义等价的改写句下却回答错误，这种不一致揭示了语义不变条件下的潜在事实不稳定。而通用改写句作为鲁棒性监督信号不足：近似抄袭的改写信号弱，过度多样的改写又可能破坏语义等价。
AI.method: 提出HALLUCINATION-R1，一个面向鲁棒性的改写生成框架。采用两阶段优化：首先稳定语义保真且多样的改写生成，然后奖励那些能在下游问答模型中暴露事实一致性退化的改写句。
AI.result: 在SimpleQuestions、PopQA和TruthfulQA上，HALLUCINATION-R1实现了一致性与多样性之间的良好权衡，并在多种模型家族和数据集上暴露出鲁棒性失败。分析表明这些失败并非表层伪影或语义漂移所致，而是语义保持变化下的事实不稳定。轻量微调研究显示，其生成数据能在改写变化下提升鲁棒准确率。
AI.conclusion: HALLUCINATION-R1生成的改写句能有效暴露并缓解模型在语义等价变化下的事实不稳定，对鲁棒性导向训练具有实用价值，代码与模型已公开。

title: KnowDemo: Knowledge-Guided Robot Demonstration Generation from Human Videos
summary: Learning robot manipulation policies typically requires substantial demonstration data, which are costly to collect on real robots. Recent methods generate robot demonstrations from human videos by adapting recovered motion and validating the resulting trajectories in simulation. However, methods centered on motion-reference adaptation can limit behavioral diversity by retaining the demonstrated contact strategies and subtask orders, while insufficient understanding of task requirements and scene relations can reduce demonstration generation efficiency by generating invalid candidates. To address these limitations, we propose KnowDemo, a framework that uses structured manipulation knowledge from human videos to generate diverse robot demonstrations for a target workspace. To distinguish task requirements from demonstration-specific choices, we develop a knowledge extraction and reasoning module based on a vision-language model (VLM) that associates object and action descriptions with inferred task conditions, demonstration references, and permissible execution variations. To translate this knowledge into executable demonstrations, we resolve the descriptions against target-scene entities and geometry to guide candidate generation and screening before motion planning and simulation. The resulting demonstrations exhibit multimodal behavior through alternative contact strategies and valid subtask orders, with structured execution labels. Experiments demonstrate additional verified execution modes beyond a reference-only configuration and improved candidate planning success through task-guided grasp sampling. To validate the generated data for policy learning, we fine-tune the pretrained $π_{0.5}$ model on simulation data, achieving sim-to-real transfer across three tasks. Project page: https://zhiyuan-gao.github.io/knowdemo/

AI.tldr: 提出KnowDemo框架，利用人视频中的结构化操作知识生成多样化的机器人演示数据，以缓解真实机器人演示数据采集成本高的问题。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作策略学习通常依赖大量演示数据，而在真实机器人上采集成本高昂。现有方法通过适配人视频中恢复的运动并在仿真中验证来生成演示，但以运动参考适配为中心会因保留原演示的接触策略与子任务顺序而限制行为多样性；同时对任务需求与场景关系理解不足会导致生成无效候选，降低演示生成效率。
AI.method: 构建基于VLM的知识抽取与推理模块，将物体与动作描述同推断出的任务条件、演示参考及可允许的执行变化关联起来，从而区分任务需求与演示特有条件；再将知识描述与目标场景中的实体和几何进行解析对齐，用于引导候选生成与筛选，最后经运动规划与仿真验证生成带结构化执行标签的演示。
AI.result: 生成的演示通过替代接触策略和有效子任务顺序展现出多模态行为，并带有结构化执行标签；相比仅基于参考的配置，可获得更多经过验证的执行模式；借助任务引导的抓取采样，提升了候选规划成功率；在仿真数据上微调预训练的π_{0.5}模型，实现了三个任务的sim-to-real迁移。
AI.conclusion: 以结构化操作知识为核心可有效突破运动参考适配带来的多样性与效率瓶颈，生成多样化且带标签的机器人演示数据，并支撑策略的仿真到真实迁移。

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning with Buffered Quantile Objectives
summary: Quantile-based reinforcement learning provides an interpretable approach to risk-sensitive decision-making by optimizing a prescribed quantile of the cumulative-return distribution. Despite this appeal, learning under a point quantile objective is challenging: quantiles can change abruptly under small perturbations of the return distribution, and exact quantile-sensitive planning requires computationally demanding distributional optimization. Lower-buffered quantiles alleviate the former difficulty by averaging neighboring quantiles immediately below the target level, providing a smoother surrogate while preserving the underlying point-quantile objective. Existing methods based on this principle, however, remain model-based and rely on explicit return-law planning, limiting their applicability beyond small tabular problems. We develop Deep-BQRL, a model-free distributional reinforcement-learning framework that extends buffered-quantile learning to neural function approximation. The method learns conditional return quantiles directly from sampled transitions, constructs buffered action scores from the relevant region of the learned quantile function, and uses ensemble disagreement to guide exploration. An augmented input representation allows the learned policy to respond to trajectory information without explicitly reproducing the quantile-state recursion required by exact planning. Experiments on an asset-selling optimal-stopping problem and slippery FrozenLake compare Deep-BQRL with model-based UCB-BQRL and tabular PPO and TRPO implementations. In asset selling, Deep-BQRL attains smaller mean cumulative point-quantile policy gaps than PPO and TRPO at the reported target levels, while UCB-BQRL retains the smallest gaps. The learned stopping decisions also vary with the target quantile, providing an interpretable illustration of the method's risk-sensitive behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出无模型分布式强化学习框架Deep-BQRL，将缓冲分位数学习扩展到神经函数逼近，直接由采样转移学习条件回报分位数并构建缓冲动作分数。
AI.motivation: 基于分位数的强化学习可优化累积回报分布的指定分位点，实现可解释的风险敏感决策，但点分位数目标存在两大难题：回报分布的微小扰动会导致分位数骤变；精确的分位数敏感规划需要计算开销大的分布式优化。下缓冲分位数通过对目标水平下方相邻分位数取平均缓解了前者，但现有方法仍为基于模型、依赖显式回报分布规划，难以扩展到小型表格问题之外。
AI.method: 提出Deep-BQRL，一种无模型分布式强化学习框架，将缓冲分位数学习推广到神经函数逼近。方法直接从采样转移中学习条件回报分位数，基于所学分位数函数的相关区域构造缓冲动作分数，并利用集成不一致性引导探索；同时采用增广输入表示，使所学策略能够响应轨迹信息，而无需显式复现精确规划所需的分位数-状态递归。
AI.result: 在资产出售最优停止问题和打滑FrozenLake上进行实验，与基于模型的UCB-BQRL以及表格型PPO、TRPO比较。在资产出售任务中，Deep-BQRL在报告的目标水平上取得比PPO和TRPO更小的平均累积点分位数策略差距，而UCB-BQRL的差距最小；所学停止决策随目标分位数变化，体现了方法的可解释风险敏感行为。
AI.conclusion: Deep-BQRL将缓冲分位数学习成功扩展到无模型神经函数逼近，在保持风险敏感可解释性的同时缓解了点分位数目标的非光滑性与计算难题；实验验证其在最优停止问题上的有效性，但相较基于模型的UCB-BQRL在策略差距上仍有差距。

title: From Memory to Behavior: A Behavior-Aware Role-Playing Framework for Social Media Influencers
summary: Large language models have shown strong potential as role-playing agents for real individuals, yet faithful impersonating remains challenging. Existing in-context learning-based methods fail to capture how individuals react under different situations. In addition, LLM-based evaluation is difficult for obscure individuals. To address these challenges, we propose Situation--Internal state--Behavior Persona method to incorporate situation-dependent behavioral strategies. We further design an evaluation protocol that provides LLM evaluators with references about the impersonated individual. We evaluate our approach on a newly constructed dataset for the task of generating replies on social media. Experimental results show that our proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art ICL-based baselines, while our evaluation protocol achieves moderate correlation with human judgment. Besides, experiments on fictional-character benchmarks demonstrate that our proposed method is applicable beyond the social media setting. These findings suggest that incorporating behavioral information broadly improves the fidelity of role-playing for real individuals on social media or fictional characters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"情境-内部状态-行为（SIB）人格"方法，将情境依赖的行为策略纳入角色扮演，并设计配套评测协议，在真实个体社媒回复生成任务与虚构角色基准上均优于现有ICL基线。
AI.motivation: LLM作为真实个体的角色扮演代理潜力巨大，但忠实模仿仍具挑战：现有基于上下文学习（ICL）的方法无法刻画个体在不同情境下的反应差异；同时针对冷门/不知名个体的LLM自动评测也缺乏可靠依据。
AI.method: 提出情境-内部状态-行为人格（Situation–Internal state–Behavior Persona）方法，显式建模情境依赖的行为策略；并设计评测协议，为LLM评测者提供关于被模仿个体的参考信息；同时构建了面向社交媒体回复生成任务的新数据集。
AI.result: 在新建数据集上，所提方法优于当前最先进的ICL基线；评测协议与人工判断达到中等程度相关性；在虚构角色基准上的实验表明该方法可迁移至社交媒体之外的场景。
AI.conclusion: 引入行为信息能广泛提升真实个体（社交媒体场景）及虚构角色角色扮演的保真度。

title: Knowledge-Graph-Augmented Chronos-2 for HEC-RAS Surrogate Forecasting
summary: We investigate whether coupling a time-series foundation model to hydraulic project knowledge improves surrogate forecasting of HEC-RAS water-surface elevation (WSE). We present KG-Chronos-2, which combines a frozen Chronos-2 predictor with exact-state residual decoding, graph-conditioned historical retrieval, and input-aligned correction. We compare the method with persistence, a residual LSTM, project-conditioned recurrent GeoFNO, a hydraulic DCRNN-style model, and frozen Chronos-2. Task-specific fitting uses the 2008 simulation. Evaluation covers 64 fixed 24-hour windows from the 2011 and 2002 simulations at 4,675 cross sections in 71 reaches on a shared geometry. KG-Chronos-2 achieves event-balanced root-mean-square error 0.246970 in native WSE units. It reduces RMSE by 14.13% relative to frozen Chronos-2, 29.38% relative to the hydraulic DCRNN-style model, and 39.54% relative to recurrent GeoFNO. The 95% hierarchical-bootstrap interval for its event-balanced RMSE difference from frozen Chronos-2 is [-0.075177, -0.016317]. KG-Chronos-2 also achieves the lowest active-window and final-lead RMSE among the six completed systems. These results support coupling a frozen temporal predictor to project knowledge for warm-start HEC-RAS forecasting on the fixed benchmark.

AI.tldr: 将冻结的时序基础模型与工程知识耦合，构建 KG-Chronos-2 代理模型，用于 HEC-RAS 水面高程预测，在固定基准上取得最低误差。
AI.motivation: 探究将时序基础模型与水利工程知识耦合，能否提升 HEC-RAS 水面高程（WSE）代理预报的精度。
AI.method: KG-Chronos-2 = 冻结的 Chronos-2 预测器 + 精确状态残差解码 + 图条件历史检索 + 输入对齐校正；对比对象包括持续性基线、残差 LSTM、项目条件循环 GeoFNO、DCRNN 类水力模型与冻结 Chronos-2。用 2008 模拟进行任务拟合；评估使用 2011 与 2002 模拟中 64 个固定 24 小时窗口，覆盖共享几何上 71 个河段的 4,675 个断面。
AI.result: 事件均衡 RMSE 为 0.246970（原生 WSE 单位）；较冻结 Chronos-2 降低 14.13%，较 DCRNN 类模型降低 29.38%，较循环 GeoFNO 降低 39.54%。与冻结 Chronos-2 的 RMSE 差 95% 层次自举区间为 [-0.075177, -0.016317]。同时取得六个完整系统中最低的活跃窗口与末端提前期 RMSE。
AI.conclusion: 在固定基准上，将冻结时序预测器与项目知识耦合，可有效支持 HEC-RAS 热启动预报。

title: Consistent Relexicalization of Clinical Documents using Graph-Based Approach
comment: Accepted for presentation at the Sixth International Conference on AI ML Systems (AIMLSystems 2026), Lake Como, Italy, October 6-9, 2026
summary: Relexicalization is a pivotal technique in clinical NLP, as it facilitates robust masking of sensitive information while synthesizing datasets that retain high-fidelity, real-world characteristics. However, preserving structural integrity, relational coherence, and temporal consistency during transformation remains a significant challenge. Existing approaches frequently rely on independent entity replacement, which results in clinical inconsistencies across longitudinal records. This reduces the value of such relexicalized datasets for downstream scientific analysis. To address these limitations, we introduce G-RELIC (Graph Based Contextual Relexicalization with Improved Consistency) which combines the power of LLMs with graphs. G-RELIC implements a graph-based mapping mechanism which optimizes for one-to-one correspondence between original and surrogate entities. It also introduces a deterministic temporal repositioning algorithm to preserve temporal consistency. Empirical evaluations on diverse, real-world clinical datasets validate that G-RELIC significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. G-RELIC yields a 30.4 percentage point improvement in relational integrity (62.1% to 92.5%) and 45.9 percentage point improvement in temporal coherence (46% to 91.9%) without compromising on the recognized privacy benchmarks for clinical datasets. This maximizes the analytical utility of relexicalized datasets while minimizing re-identification risk.

AI.tldr: G-RELIC 结合大语言模型与图结构，通过图映射机制保证实体一一对应、并用确定性时间重定位算法维持时间一致性，显著提升临床文本重词化数据的关系完整性与时间连贯性。
AI.motivation: 临床 NLP 中重词化（relexicalization）可对敏感信息进行掩蔽并合成高保真数据集，但现有方法多采用独立实体替换，导致纵向病历中出现临床不一致，破坏结构完整性、关系连贯性与时间一致性，降低数据下游分析价值。
AI.method: 提出 G-RELIC（Graph Based Contextual Relexicalization with Improved Consistency），将 LLM 与图结构结合：(1) 基于图的映射机制，优化原始实体与替代实体之间的一一对应关系；(2) 确定性时间重定位算法，保持时间一致性。
AI.result: 在多样化真实临床数据集上显著优于现有最优基线：关系完整性提升 30.4 个百分点（62.1%→92.5%），时间连贯性提升 45.9 个百分点（46%→91.9%），且未损害临床数据集的隐私基准。
AI.conclusion: G-RELIC 在保持隐私保护水平的同时最大化重词化数据集的分析效用，兼顾再识别风险的最小化，为临床 NLP 数据合成提供更可靠的方案。

title: Talking Past the Machine: Morality, Politeness, and Alignment in Human-AI Dialogue
comment: Accepted at the 60th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS-60)
summary: Conversational AI systems produce fluent, socially appropriate responses, yet whether they participate in cooperative communication or merely simulate its surface forms remains unclear - a question central to how these systems are evaluated, trusted, and designed. This study investigates how morality, politeness, and alignment - three dimensions central to cooperative dialogue - function in human-AI interaction compared to human-human conversation. We analyze 15,881 human-ChatGPT and 10,784 human-human multi-turn dialogues, using mixed-effects models to identify which features predict turn-to-turn alignment. We observe a consistent dissociation: AI produces the surface features of cooperative communication without the underlying social architecture. Moral output appears preconfigured rather than negotiated; warmth is generated without face sensitivity; linguistic convergence declines persistently. Most strikingly, the cooperative mechanisms themselves reverse direction: hedging and softening associated with greater accommodation between humans are associated with reduced alignment when produced by AI, and purity framing associated with human divergence coincides with users converging toward the AI. Agency - giving users room to shape the exchange - is the most consistent predictor of alignment across both interaction types, while lower moral assertiveness in more recent models is not accompanied by better cooperation. Together these patterns suggest that AI reproduces the surface of cooperation without the mutual adaptation that grounds it between humans - and, more surprisingly, that mechanisms sustaining human accommodation can run in reverse with AI, suggesting a turn-level view may be insufficient for interaction-level success.

AI.tldr: 该研究对比15,881段人-ChatGPT与10,784段人人多轮对话，发现AI只复制了合作性交流的表层特征，却缺乏支撑人际适应的社会架构，且部分合作机制在AI情境下发生方向逆转。
AI.motivation: 对话式AI能生成流畅、社交得体的回应，但其究竟是在进行真正的合作性交流，还是仅模拟其表层形式尚不明确；这一问题直接关系到此类系统如何被评估、信任与设计。
AI.method: 基于15,881段人-ChatGPT与10,784段人人多轮对话，聚焦道德、礼貌与对齐三个合作性对话核心维度，采用混合效应模型识别预测逐轮对齐（turn-to-turn alignment）的特征。
AI.result: 观察到一致性的分离：AI产出合作交流的表层特征却缺少底层社会架构；道德输出似为预配置而非协商生成；温暖感在缺乏面子敏感性的情况下被生成；语言趋同持续下降。合作机制本身发生方向逆转：人际间促进顺从的模糊限制与软化措辞，在AI产出时反而与对齐降低相关；人际间导致分歧的纯洁性框架，在AI情境下却伴随用户向AI趋同。能动性（给予用户塑造交流的空间）是两类互动中对齐最稳定的预测因子；较新模型道德断言性降低并未带来更好的合作。
AI.conclusion: AI复制了合作的表层，却缺少支撑人际合作的相互适应；更令人意外的是，维系人际顺从的机制在AI情境下可能反向运行，说明仅从逐轮视角可能不足以判断互动层面的成功。

title: AtomEgo: Exploring Ego-Robot Integration for Embodied Foundation Model Pretraining
summary: Embodied foundation models are constrained by the limited scale and diversity of robot demonstrations, motivating the use of large-scale egocentric human interaction data. However, how to effectively incorporate such data into embodied-model pre-training remains unclear because of substantial embodiment and action-space gaps between humans and robots. We present AtomEgo, a systematic study of ego--robot co-training supported by a curated corpus of approximately 2,659 hours and a scalable data processing pipeline. Across vision--language--action and world--action model architectures, we investigate three representative paradigms: joint co-training with domain-specific action heads, progressive ego-to-robot transfer through embodiment alignment, and joint video--action modeling. We evaluate these paradigms through multi-task real-robot experiments and language-conditioned cross-embodiment representation analysis. Our results reveal a simple principle: Data Scale * Alignment Quality --> Capability Gain; egocentric data can improve generalization, but their value depends on how effectively they are aligned and utilized. This principle can provide practical guidance for scalable ego--robot pre-training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AtomEgo，基于约 2659 小时第一人称人类交互数据与可扩展处理管线，系统研究 ego-robot 协同预训练。在 VLA 与世界-动作两类架构上比较三种范式：带域特定动作头的联合协同训练、通过具身对齐的渐进式 ego-to-robot 迁移、以及联合视频-动作建模。真机多任务实验与语言条件跨具身表征分析表明：数据规模 × 对齐质量 → 能力增益。
AI.motivation: 具身基础模型受限于机器人演示数据的规模与多样性，因此需要引入大规模第一人称人类交互数据；但人与机器人之间存在显著的具身差异与动作空间鸿沟，如何将此类数据有效纳入具身模型预训练尚不清晰。
AI.method: 构建约 2659 小时的第一人称人类交互语料及可扩展数据处理管线；覆盖视觉-语言-动作（VLA）与世界-动作两类模型架构；系统研究三种代表性预训练范式：1）带域特定动作头的联合协同训练；2）通过具身对齐实现渐进式 ego-to-robot 迁移；3）联合视频-动作建模。通过多任务真机实验与语言条件跨具身表征分析进行评估。
AI.result: 第一人称数据能够提升泛化能力，但其价值取决于对齐与利用的有效程度；不同范式在真机多任务与跨具身表征上表现出差异，最终归纳出“数据规模 × 对齐质量 → 能力增益”的简单原则。
AI.conclusion: 第一人称人类数据对具身预训练具有可观价值，但并非规模越大越好；关键在于具身与动作空间的对齐质量及使用方式。该原则为可扩展的 ego-robot 预训练提供了实践指导。

title: OneBid: A Unified Auto-Bidding Foundation Model for Diverse oCPX Advertising Scenarios
summary: Auto-bidding is central to computational advertising, where strategies must maximize advertisers' conversion value under economic constraints. It has evolved from rule-based controllers to reinforcement learning and generative methods such as Decision Transformer (DT). Yet these methods increasingly mismatch the prevailing optimized cost-per-X (oCPX) paradigm, which spans heterogeneous scenarios (e.g., registration, purchase), each served by a separate model, leading to fragmented pipelines and underexploring cross-scenario modeling. Inspired by foundation models like LLMs, unifying these oCPX scenarios into one model raises three challenges: multi-objective control, scalable capacity under strict latency, and safe offline policy improvement. We present OneBid, a unified auto-bidding foundation model that learns a reusable backbone from heterogeneous oCPX logs and adapts it to scenario-specific deployments via offline post-training. Building on DT, OneBid extends single Return-to-Go conditioning to two atomic signals, Return-to-Go for conversion value and Cost-to-Go for cost ratio, plus value-aware regularization on next-action prediction. To absorb distributional heterogeneity, we design a sequence-level Mixture-of-Experts architecture, where shared experts encode cross-scenario knowledge and sparsely-routed experts capture scenario-specific patterns at low latency, yielding consistent scaling with model size and data. During post-training, we align the backbone with scenario preferences via Critic-guided Relative Offline Policy optimization (CROP): a learned critic scores candidate actions group-relatively, avoiding the unsafe online exploration of GRPO-style fine-tuning while constraining policy shift to reduce OOD risk. Validated via online A/B tests and fully deployed at Kuaishou, OneBid delivers an overall +2.2% ADVV gain on oCPX Ads, peaking at +13.1% in the ROAS scenario.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OneBid，一种统一的自动出价基础模型，从异构oCPX日志中学习可复用骨干，并通过离线后训练适配各场景，在快手全量部署后实现oCPX广告整体+2.2% ADVV提升，ROAS场景峰值+13.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有自动出价方法（规则控制器、强化学习、Decision Transformer等）与主流oCPX范式日益不匹配：oCPX涵盖注册、购买等异构场景，且每场景单独建模，导致流水线碎片化、跨场景建模探索不足。受LLM等基础模型启发，作者希望将多个oCPX场景统一到一个模型中，但面临三大挑战：多目标控制、严格时延下的可扩展容量、安全离线策略改进。
AI.method: OneBid基于Decision Transformer，将单一Return-to-Go条件扩展为两个原子信号——衡量转化价值的Return-to-Go与衡量成本比的Cost-to-Go，并加入价值感知的下一动作预测正则。为吸收分布异构性，设计序列级Mixture-of-Experts架构：共享专家编码跨场景知识，稀疏路由专家以低时延捕获场景特有模式，实现模型规模与数据的一致扩展。后训练阶段采用Critic引导的相对离线策略优化（CROP）：学习到的critic对候选动作进行组内相对打分，避免GRPO式微调的在线探索风险，同时约束策略偏移以降低OOD风险。
AI.result: 通过在线A/B测试验证并在快手全量部署，OneBid在oCPX广告上实现整体+2.2%的ADVV提升，在ROAS场景中峰值达+13.1%。
AI.conclusion: OneBid验证了以基础模型范式统一异构oCPX自动出价场景的可行性：双信号条件、序列级MoE与安全离线策略优化三者结合，可同时满足多目标控制、低时延可扩展与安全离线改进，并在大规模真实系统中取得显著业务收益。

title: On Repulsive and Attractive Teachers: Separating Correctness from Behavior in Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation provides dense, token-level supervision by conditioning a model on privileged information and distilling the resulting teacher distribution back into the model. However, privileged information can change not only what the teacher knows, but also how it behaves, entangling correctness-relevant learning signals with unintended behavioral shifts. We study this effect in reasoning tasks by contrasting attractive self-distillation, which moves the model toward a privileged teacher, with repulsive self-distillation, which moves it away from a privileged teacher. We find that both objectives can induce strong and opposing behavioral shifts: attraction suppresses exploratory reasoning and promotes shorter, more confident responses, whereas repulsion increases response length, can trigger unintended switches into a model's latent thinking mode, and ultimately becomes unstable. Motivated by these observations, we study contrastive self-distillation, which combines attraction toward a correct-solution-conditioned teacher with repulsion from an incorrect-solution-conditioned teacher. In contrast to prior work that combines such distillation signals with a GRPO objective, we isolate the self-distillation objective and study its behavior on its own. We find that the shared behavioral shifts of the two teachers largely cancel, leaving a token-level signal that more directly reflects correctness. Across non-thinking, instruct-only, and already-thinking models, this contrastive objective improves reasoning performance while maintaining stable response lengths.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究on-policy自蒸馏中特权信息引发的行为偏移问题，发现吸引式与排斥式自蒸馏会产生相反的行为变化，提出对比式自蒸馏（同时吸引正确教师、排斥错误教师）可使行为偏移相互抵消，从而保留更纯粹的token级正确性信号，在多种模型上提升推理性能并保持响应长度稳定。
AI.motivation: on-policy自蒸馏通过特权信息提供密集的token级监督，但特权信息不仅改变教师"知道什么"，还改变其"行为方式"，将正确性学习信号与意外的行为偏移纠缠在一起，导致学习信号不纯。
AI.method: 在推理任务中对比两种目标：吸引式自蒸馏（向特权教师靠近）与排斥式自蒸馏（远离特权教师）；进而研究对比式自蒸馏，即结合向正确解条件教师的吸引与向错误解条件教师的排斥，并剥离GRPO目标、单独隔离研究该自蒸馏目标本身的行为。
AI.result: 两种目标均引发强烈且相反的行为偏移：吸引抑制探索性推理、促使回答更短更自信；排斥增加响应长度、可能触发模型潜在思考模式的意外切换、最终变得不稳定。对比式蒸馏中两位教师共享的行为偏移大部分相互抵消，留下更直接反映正确性的token级信号；在非思考、仅指令、已思考三类模型上均提升推理性能，且响应长度保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 对比式自蒸馏通过正确教师吸引与错误教师排斥的组合，使行为偏移相互抵消，从而获得更纯粹的正确性信号，可在不引入GRPO目标的情况下单独提升推理性能并维持稳定的响应长度。

title: Potential-Field Action Representation for Reinforcement Learning in Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Model-free reinforcement learning can acquire contact-rich robotic manipulation skills through trial-and-error interaction, but it often requires the policy to learn both task strategy and low-level motion generation. In this setting, the action representation is critical because it determines how policy outputs are converted into robot motion, shaping both exploration and physical execution. Direct Cartesian command interfaces require the policy to generate motion at every decision step, coupling task-level adaptation with continuous low-level control and increasing the learning burden. We propose PA-RL, a reinforcement-learning framework that uses artificial potential fields as the action representation. Instead of commanding motion directly, the policy adapts the parameters of an energy-like potential field, which generates a state-dependent guidance direction executed through a Cartesian impedance controller. We evaluate PA-RL on peg-in-hole insertion, a representative contact-rich task with nonlinear dynamics and discontinuous contact transitions. In simulation, PA-RL is compared with Cartesian velocity, Cartesian pose, and variable-impedance action spaces using the same RL algorithm. PA-RL is the only method to reach a 100% evaluation success rate within the allotted training time, while the best baseline reaches 92.6%. It also reduces joint-torque variation by 55.4% and Cartesian acceleration variation by 70.8% relative to the best baseline, without explicit motion-quality penalties in the reward. The simulation-trained policy further completes 9/9 real-robot insertions without fine-tuning, demonstrating the deployment feasibility of the learned potential-field interface.

AI.tldr: 提出PA-RL框架，用人工势场作为强化学习的动作表示，策略调节势场参数而非直接输出运动，在轴孔装配任务中取得100%仿真成功率并实现零微调真机迁移。
AI.motivation: 无模型强化学习可习得接触丰富的操作技能，但策略需同时学习任务策略与底层运动生成，学习负担重。直接笛卡尔指令接口要求策略在每个决策步生成运动，将任务级适应与连续底层控制耦合。因此动作表示的设计成为关键问题，需要一种能解耦任务决策与运动生成的表示方式。
AI.method: 提出PA-RL：以人工势场作为动作表示。策略不直接指令运动，而是调节类能量势场的参数，由该势场产生状态相关的引导方向，并通过笛卡尔阻抗控制器执行。在轴孔插入这一代表性接触丰富任务上，与笛卡尔速度、笛卡尔位姿、可变阻抗三种动作空间在相同RL算法下对比。
AI.result: PA-RL是唯一在给定训练时间内达到100%评估成功率的方方法，最优基线为92.6%。相较最优基线，关节力矩变化降低55.4%，笛卡尔加速度变化降低70.8%，且奖励中未显式加入运动质量惩罚项。仿真训练的策略无需微调即完成9/9真机插入。
AI.conclusion: 人工势场动作表示能有效解耦任务级适应与底层运动生成，提升学习效率与运动质量，并具备良好的仿真到现实部署可行性。

title: Steering LLMs Responses Towards Moral Foundations on the Norwegian MFQ-30
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Awarded best Paper Award at WNNLP 2026 (University of Oslo). Proceedings: https://www.uio.no/studier/emner/matnat/ifi/IN5550/v26/final-exam/wnnlp2026_proceedings.pdf
summary: Recent work applies human psychometric questionnaires to large language models to elicit moral and value profiles, but it is not clear whether these instruments measure anything stable in models or whether the resulting profiles can be moved toward a target human population. We administer the Norwegian Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ-30) to six open-weight LLMs and compare their foundation profiles to a sample of N = 1,282 Norwegian respondents. We test two steering interventions, prompt-level persona steering and activation-level ActAdd. Half the models engage with the questionnaire under our attention check. The other half default to flat or central-tendency outputs that look near-human on average without tracking item content. A neutral Nordic-respondent persona, written without any distributional information from the human sample, brings the engaging models 44-77% closer to the Norwegian mean in Mahalanobis $d^2$. One-pair ActAdd at a fixed mid-layer flattens the foundation profile rather than steering individual foundations. For at least one model the same persona that shifts the profile also induces engagement that was absent at baseline, a concrete instance of the cognitive phantoms that Peereboom et al. (2025) warn about.

AI.tldr: 将挪威语MFQ-30施测于6个开源LLM并与1282名挪威人比较：半数模型真正参与作答，半数输出趋中而无项目敏感性；无分布信息的中性北欧人设使参与模型向人类均值靠近44-77%（Mahalanobis d²），单对ActAdd仅压平剖面，且人设可同时诱发原本缺失的作答参与。
AI.motivation: 近期研究用人类心理测量问卷为LLM elicits道德与价值画像，但尚不清楚这些工具是否测量模型中任何稳定的东西，也不清楚所得画像能否被推向目标人类群体分布；本文旨在检验其测量稳定性与可引导性。
AI.method: 对6个open-weight LLM施测挪威语版MFQ-30，与N=1282挪威受访者样本对比基础画像；设置attention check判定模型是否真正参与；实施两类steering干预：prompt层面的persona steering与activation层面的ActAdd（固定中层、单对向量）。
AI.result: 半数模型通过attention check并参与问卷，另半数默认输出flat/central-tendency结果，均值上近似人类但不追踪item内容；不含任何人类样本分布信息的中性Nordic-respondent persona使参与型模型在Mahalanobis d²上向挪威均值靠近44-77%；固定中层单对ActAdd并未steering单个foundation，而是flatten整体foundation profile；至少一个模型中同一persona在推移画像的同时诱发了基线时缺失的engagement。
AI.conclusion: LLM的心理测量画像部分依赖于伪作答与分布拟合，而非稳定特质；persona steering可在无分布信息下有效对齐群体均值，但也会同时诱发engagement变化，构成Peereboom et al. (2025)所警示的cognitive phantoms的具体实例，提示此类问卷在模型上并非纯粹的特质测量工具。

title: Chinese Competitive Debating Dataset and Benchmark
summary: Debate adjudication requires tracking how arguments develop through interaction, yet existing datasets rarely combine fine-grained debate transcripts with professional judgments collected during real competitions under a shared rubric. We introduce a dataset and benchmark for evaluating large language models' understanding of competitive Chinese-language debate at the match, stage, and speaker levels. We organized 182 matches and recruited 120 professional judges, with each match independently adjudicated by three judges using a predefined rubric. After excluding matches with incomplete records, the dataset contains 148 matches, 2,698 stages, and 20,542 exchange units, with manually verified transcripts and segmentation. It preserves original stage scores, match votes, best-debater ballots, and adjudication rationales. We define three tasks: winner-tendency prediction, stage-score prediction, and best-debater prediction. Zero-shot evaluation of multiple large language models yields a highest winner-prediction accuracy of 66.2%, a highest Pearson correlation of 0.250 between model stage scores and mean human ratings, and a highest best-debater prediction accuracy of 56.8%. The dataset and benchmark provide a testbed for studying large language models' understanding of interactive argumentation and their agreement with professional judges.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个中文竞技辩论数据集与基准，涵盖比赛、阶段、辩手三个层级，用于评估大语言模型对互动式论证的理解能力。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集很少将细粒度辩论转写文本与真实比赛中在统一评分量表下收集的专业评判相结合，而辩论裁决需要对论证在互动中如何发展进行追踪。
AI.method: 组织182场比赛并招募120名专业评委，每场比赛由三名评委依据预设量表独立裁决；剔除记录不完整比赛后，数据集包含148场比赛、2698个阶段和20542个交流单元，并保留人工核验的转写与切分、原始阶段分数、比赛投票、最佳辩手票及裁决理由；定义胜方倾向预测、阶段分数预测和最佳辩手预测三项任务，并对多个大语言模型进行零样本评估。
AI.result: 零样本评估中，最高胜方预测准确率为66.2%，模型阶段分数与人类平均评分的最高皮尔逊相关系数为0.250，最佳辩手预测最高准确率为56.8%。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集与基准为研究大语言模型对互动式论证的理解及其与专业评委的一致性提供了测试平台。

title: SynthDemo-RL: Breaking the Zero-Reward Barrier in VLA Adaptation with LLM-Guided Synthetic Demonstrations
summary: Fine-tuning Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models commonly relies on human teleoperation demonstrations, while reinforcement learning (RL) with sparse binary rewards faces an exploration challenge when successful trajectories are rarely sampled. We propose SynthDemo-RL, a teacher-student framework in which an automated teacher converts simulator-privileged state into successful manipulation trajectories, a VLA student is distilled from them by supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and PPO with binary task-success rewards refines the student. We study reward coverage, the fraction of tasks for which at least one success is observed under the fixed evaluation protocol, as a complement to the average success rate. On LIBERO-PRO, a public benchmark of perturbed LIBERO tasks for which no demonstrations exist, 27 of 57 scored tasks are at exactly 0% success for a pi_0.5 policy fine-tuned on the original LIBERO tasks. Direct PPO from this policy, under the same PPO recipe and the same RL compute as SynthDemo-RL's refinement stage, rescues 10 of these 27 tasks and leaves 17 at 0%. SynthDemo-RL, with 50 synthesized trajectories per task and no new human demonstrations, rescues all 27 and reaches average success rates of 97.8% and 97.1% on the Position and Task axes of LIBERO-PRO, respectively. On standard LIBERO, the same pipeline reaches 96.0% with no human demonstrations, within 1.7 points of pi_0.5 trained on 50 human demonstrations per task. We further validate the pipeline on RoboTwin 2.0 and verify that trajectories from a policy trained in a MuJoCo twin execute open-loop on a physical robot.

AI.tldr: 提出 SynthDemo-RL 教师-学生框架：自动教师在仿真中用特权状态合成成功轨迹，经 SFT 蒸馏到 VLA 学生模型，再用稀疏二值奖励的 PPO 精调，从而在无人演示的情况下解决稀疏奖励探索难题。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型微调依赖人类遥操作演示，成本高；而稀疏二值奖励的强化学习在成功轨迹罕有采样时面临严重的探索难题。
AI.method: 教师-学生框架：1) 自动教师将仿真器特权状态（privileged state）转换为成功操作轨迹；2) 学生 VLA 通过监督微调（SFT）从合成轨迹中蒸馏；3) 使用二值任务成功奖励的 PPO 进一步精炼学生策略。每任务合成 50 条轨迹，不使用新的人类演示。提出"奖励覆盖度"（至少观测到一次成功的任务比例）作为平均成功率的补充指标。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-PRO（57 个计分任务）上，基于原始 LIBERO 微调的 pi_0.5 策略有 27 个任务成功率为 0%；同等 PPO 配方与算力从该策略直接做 PPO 仅挽救 10 个，仍留 17 个为 0%；SynthDemo-RL 挽救全部 27 个，Position 与 Task 轴平均成功率分别达 97.8% 与 97.1%。标准 LIBERO 上达到 96.0%，与使用每任务 50 条人类演示训练的 pi_0.5 相差 1.7 个百分点。并在 RoboTwin 2.0 上验证，且在 MuJoCo 孪生中训练的策略轨迹可在物理机器人上开环执行。
AI.conclusion: 自动合成的教师轨迹加稀疏奖励 RL 精炼，可在零人类演示条件下显著提升 VLA 模型的成功率与奖励覆盖度，优于直接用 PPO 的方案，并具备跨仿真平台与真机开环执行的可行性。

title: Outcome-Conditioned End-Effector Geometry Across Vision-Language-Action Policies
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables, 23 references. Submitted to ICRA 2027
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies solve the same manipulation task through different action interfaces, but task success alone does not establish whether their physical executions agree. We study cross-policy end-effector geometry in 15,000 closed-loop LIBERO rollouts from four policies. The primary clean-condition analysis forms 3,600 configuration-matched, and therefore dependent, policy pairs. Both-success pairs have a median normalized dynamic time warping distance of 0.0120 m versus 0.0380 m when exactly one policy succeeds. This ordering holds in every task, every policy pair, and nine sampling and band-limited representations; however, the ratio varies severalfold across representations, so we report the direction rather than a fixed multiple. Both-failure pairs are more separated again but rest on thin, uneven support, so we report them as exploratory. Within successful executions, partner replacements separate more across tasks than across initial states. A matched baseline still reveals measurable, heterogeneous residual policy differences, so a low cross-policy distance does not imply interchangeability. Successful executions sit about as far from same-task demonstrations as those demonstrations sit from each other, compatible with task-associated geometry without separating training-data overlap from task constraints. A common 72-action window preserves the ordering but reduces its magnitude; endpoint and duration adjustment likewise leaves a positive mixed-outcome coefficient relative to both-success pairs, though its magnitude is specification-dependent. Under composite visual stress, policy rankings and pair composition change together.

AI.tldr: 论文研究跨策略末端执行器几何一致性，发现双双成功配对的DTW距离显著小于单侧成功配对，但低距离不意味着策略可互换。
AI.motivation: 仅凭任务成功率无法判断不同VLA策略在同一操作任务中的物理执行是否一致，需要研究跨策略末端执行器轨迹几何。
AI.method: 基于四个策略在LIBERO上的15,000次闭环回放，构造3,600个配置匹配（因而相互依赖）的策略配对，采用归一化DTW距离度量，并在九种采样与带限表示下检验；另用同任务示教作基线，并施加复合视觉扰动。
AI.result: 双双成功配对的中位归一化DTW距离为0.0120 m，单侧成功为0.0380 m，该排序在所有任务、策略配对及九种表示中稳定，但比值随表示变化数倍；双失败配对分离更大但支撑样本单薄，仅作探索性报告。成功执行中，更换合作策略造成的分离大于更换初始状态；匹配基线仍显示可测且异质的残余策略差异。成功执行与同任务示教的距离约等于示教之间的距离。72动作窗口保留排序但幅度下降；端点与时长调整后混合结果系数仍为正，幅度依赖设定。复合视觉压力下策略排名与配对构成同时变化。
