AI.conclusion: 跨策略成功执行存在与任务相关的几何一致性，显著高于混合/失败配对，但低跨策略距离不等于策略可互换；结论应报告方向而非固定倍数，并注意表示与视觉条件的敏感性。

title: When Steering Fails in Latent Reasoning: A Latent-to-Language Transition Gap
summary: Activation steering has become a widely used approach for controlling language models during explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, motivating its extension to latent CoT. However, we find that steering continuous thoughts produces substantially weaker effects on subsequent language generation than steering explicit CoT, even when the hidden representations are moved by comparable amounts. We first show that task information remains identifiable in continuous thoughts. Hence, we hypothesize a \textbf{latent-to-language transition gap}, in which an intervention effect in latent space fails to transfer to language generation. Two further results support this hypothesis: the output distribution changes abruptly at the transition boundary, and task-related directions exert much weaker bidirectional control in latent CoT than in explicit CoT. These findings identify the transition interface as a central target for evaluating and designing future latent-steering methods.

AI.tldr: 激活引导在显式CoT有效，但对潜空间连续思维（latent CoT）效果显著更弱，即使表征位移量相当；作者提出"潜空间到语言转换鸿沟"假说并给出两项证据。
AI.motivation: 激活引导已成为控制语言模型显式链式推理（CoT）的常用手段，研究者希望将其扩展到潜空间CoT。然而作者发现，对连续思维进行引导时，其对后续语言生成的影响远弱于对显式CoT的引导，这一现象需要解释。
AI.method: 首先验证任务信息在连续思维中依然可被识别；据此提出"latent-to-language transition gap"假说，即潜空间中的干预效果无法传递到语言生成。随后通过两项分析检验该假说：(1) 在转换边界处输出分布发生突变；(2) 任务相关方向在latent CoT中的双向控制能力远弱于显式CoT。
AI.result: 任务信息在连续思维中仍可识别；输出分布在潜空间到语言的转换边界处呈现突跃变化；任务相关方向对latent CoT的双向控制效力明显低于显式CoT，即便隐表征位移幅度相当。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果支持"潜空间到语言转换鸿沟"假说，表明转换界面是评估与设计未来潜空间引导方法的核心目标。

title: CIBuzzBench: A Benchmark for Cross-Lingual Understanding of Chinese Internet Buzzwords
summary: Chinese social media has generated a vast and continually evolving lexicon of internet buzzwords whose meanings are often non-literal and deeply rooted in local cultural and pragmatic contexts. Existing research has primarily focused on interpreting these buzzwords within Chinese, leaving largely unexplored whether LLMs can transfer such culturally grounded knowledge across languages and accurately convey the intended meanings in English. This cross-lingual capability is also critical for safety, as harmful expressions may obscure their offensive content through culture-specific homophony, euphemism, irony, or coded language. In this paper, we investigate the ability of advanced LLMs to understand Chinese internet buzzwords across languages. To this end, we introduce CIBuzzBench, the first benchmark for cross-lingual Chinese-to-English understanding of Chinese internet buzzwords. CIBuzzBench comprises 3,001 Chinese internet buzzwords annotated with English meaning explanations, English equivalents, category labels, and harmfulness labels. Based on these annotations, we design three evaluation tasks: Meaning Explanation, Cross-lingual Equivalent Matching, and Culturally Grounded Harmfulness Detection. We evaluate representative state-of-the-art proprietary and Chinese LLMs under both English- and Chinese-prompting settings. Our results show that LLMs continue to struggle with the cross-lingual understanding of Chinese internet buzzwords, particularly in fine-grained non-literal interpretation, robust equivalent matching under option perturbations, and calibrated harmfulness detection. These findings highlight the persistent challenges posed by culturally grounded language phenomena for multilingual LLMs and safety-oriented evaluation. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/SuperYFan/CIBuzzBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个中英跨语言中文网络流行语理解基准CIBuzzBench（3,001条，含英文释义、英文对应词、类别与有害性标注），设计三个评测任务，发现现有LLM在跨语言理解上仍存在明显困难。
AI.motivation: 中文社交媒体网络流行语含义多非字面，且深植于本土文化与语用语境。既有研究多局限于中文语境下的解读，LLM能否将这类文化负载知识跨语言迁移并准确以英文传达其本意尚不清楚；该跨语言能力对安全也至关重要，因为有害表达可能借助谐音、委婉、反讽或编码语言掩盖其攻击性。
AI.method: 构建CIBuzzBench基准，包含3,001条中文网络流行语，标注英文释义、英文对应词、类别标签与有害性标签；基于标注设计三个任务：含义解释、跨语言对应词匹配、文化根植的有害性检测；在英文与中文两种提示设置下评测代表性先进闭源LLM与中文LLM。
AI.result: LLM在中文网络流行语的跨语言理解上仍普遍表现不佳，尤其体现在细粒度非字面释义、选项扰动下对应词匹配的稳健性，以及有害性检测的校准性方面。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了文化根植语言现象对多语言LLM及安全导向评测的持续挑战。数据集与代码已开源于 https://github.com/SuperYFan/CIBuzzBench。

title: ForceTwin: Physics-informed Digital Twins for Robotic Manipulation from Instrumented Human Interaction
summary: Manipulating objects requires understanding not only their motion, but also the physical properties that determine it. For articulated objects, these include inertia, friction, and mechanisms such as springs or door closers, whose effects can vary with configuration and velocity. Such properties are not directly observable from appearance: visually identical doors may require very different effort to manipulate. Existing digital-twin pipelines recover primarily kinematics or assign static physical parameters from visual and language priors, which can yield physically implausible estimates. As a result, state-dependent mechanism dynamics remain unidentified and are not represented in standard asset formats. We present ForceTwin, a system for identifying physics-informed digital twins of articulated objects from instrumented human interaction. A person probes an object using a handheld force-sensing gripper, providing synchronized poses and interaction forces from which we estimate the articulation, parametric dynamics including inertia, Coulomb friction, viscous damping, and a structured neural residual capturing state-dependent mechanism forces. ForceTwin nearly halves the inertial-parameter error of a VLM prior. As a feedforward dynamics model for impedance control on a Spot and a Franka FR3, ForceTwin achieves 87% goal completion across nine object-embodiment pairs, compared with 60% using VLM-prior and 57% using kinematics-only twins, with the largest gains on objects whose strong mechanisms cause both baselines to stall. We further use the identified twins to train whole-body door-traversal policies and deploy them in the real world. Project Page: https://timengelbracht.github.io/forcetwin-website/

AI.tldr: ForceTwin：通过带力传感手柄的人机交互，辨识铰接物体的物理信息数字孪生，涵盖惯性、库仑摩擦、粘性阻尼及状态依赖机构力的神经残差建模，实现高精度动力学预测与机器人操作策略。
AI.motivation: 铰接物体的操作不仅依赖运动学，还取决于惯性、摩擦以及弹簧、闭门器等机构特性，这些物理属性随构型与速度变化且无法从外观直接观测（外表相同的门操作难度可能差异巨大）。现有数字孪生流程多仅恢复运动学，或依据视觉与语言先验赋予静态物理参数，导致估计物理上不合理，状态依赖的机构动力学无法被辨识，也无法在标准资产格式中表达。
AI.method: 提出ForceTwin系统：由人手持带力感知的夹爪对物体进行探测交互，获取同步的位姿与交互力数据；在此基础上估计铰接运动学，并辨识参数化动力学模型，包含惯性、库仑摩擦、粘性阻尼，以及一个结构化神经残差项用于捕获状态依赖的机构力。
AI.result: 惯性参数误差相比VLM先验降低近一半；作为阻抗控制的前馈动力学模型，在Spot与Franka FR3、九组物体-本体配对上达到87%目标完成率，而VLM先验为60%、仅运动学孪生为57%；在强机构导致两种基线停滞的物体上提升最大。所辨识孪生还被用于训练全身开门通行策略并在真实世界部署。
AI.conclusion: 通过仪器化人类交互可辨识包含状态依赖机构力的物理信息数字孪生，显著优于视觉语言先验与纯运动学方法，并可直接支撑真实机器人的阻抗控制与全身操作策略训练。

title: Matrix AdaGrad: Row-wise and Column-wise Adaptive Subgradient Methods
summary: Adaptive optimization methods such as AdaGrad and Adam are widely used in modern neural-network training, but their adaptive scaling is primarily designed for vector-valued parameters and does not explicitly exploit matrix structure. Recent matrix-aware optimizers demonstrate the benefits of structured optimization, yet a general theoretical framework for deriving matrix-aware adaptivity comparable to that of AdaGrad remains lacking. In this work, we develop a general Online Mirror Descent framework with adaptive proximal functions for matrix-valued parameters, providing a principled approach to deriving matrix-aware adaptive optimization through online regret minimization. By introducing row-wise and column-wise matrix proximal functions and analyzing the resulting regret trade-off, we derive Row-wise Matrix AdaGrad (Row-AdaGrad) and Column-wise Matrix AdaGrad (Column-AdaGrad), with adaptive scaling determined by the accumulated row-wise or column-wise gradient norms. We establish regret guarantees and show that these matrix-aware bounds can be strictly tighter than those of entry-wise AdaGrad under structured gradients. Experiments on matrix factorization and deep neural-network training further demonstrate the benefits of aligning adaptive scaling with matrix structure, including improved optimization stability and trainability at larger learning rates and greater network depths.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向矩阵参数的在线镜像下降（OMD）框架，通过行/列矩阵近端函数推导出Row-AdaGrad与Column-AdaGrad，理论证明其遗憾界在结构化梯度下优于逐元素AdaGrad，并在矩阵分解和深度网络训练中验证了优势。
AI.motivation: 现有AdaGrad、Adam等自适应优化方法主要针对向量参数设计，未显式利用矩阵结构；近期矩阵感知优化器虽展现结构化优化的好处，但缺乏类似AdaGrad那样可用于推导矩阵感知自适应的通用理论框架。
AI.method: 构建带自适应近端函数的矩阵参数在线镜像下降（OMD）通用框架，通过在线遗憾最小化推导矩阵感知自适应优化。引入行向与列向矩阵近端函数，分析由此产生的遗憾权衡，据此导出Row-wise Matrix AdaGrad和Column-wise Matrix AdaGrad，其自适应缩放由累积的行向或列向梯度范数决定。
AI.result: 建立了遗憾保证，证明在结构化梯度下矩阵感知遗憾界可严格紧于逐元素AdaGrad；在矩阵分解与深度神经网络训练实验中，将自适应缩放与矩阵结构对齐带来更优的优化稳定性，并能在更大学习率和更深网络下保持可训练性。
AI.conclusion: 矩阵感知的自适应缩放对应矩阵结构可带来理论更紧的遗憾界与实证更优的稳定性及可训练性，为矩阵参数优化提供了与AdaGrad对等的通用理论框架。

title: Federated Deep Clustering Networks for High-Dimensional and Heterogeneous Data
comment: Accepted to the 4th International Conference on Federated Learning Technologies and Applications (FLTA 2026)
summary: Clustering high-dimensional data is a fundamental task in unsupervised machine learning with applications to a variety of domains. In the centralized data scenario, this task is commonly solved using deep clustering methods that utilize deep neural network architectures to learn clustering-friendly latent space representations. In Federated Learning, where data is distributed between clients and is private, deep clustering methods are less explored. In particular, recently introduced federated deep clustering methods, despite showing very promising performance, still fall short in reliably providing good performance if data across clients are non-identically-independently distributed. In this work, we introduce a generalization of Deep Clustering Networks to the federated scenario, named FedDCN, that simultaneously optimizes a reconstruction loss and a clustering loss. To ensure robustness and latent space alignment in non-identically-independently distributed data scenarios, FedDCN generates synthetic data augmentations, and its learning objective includes a geometric regularization for latent space alignment. Through experimental evaluation, the effectiveness of the approach under IID and non-IID assumptions is demonstrated, and future research directions are identified.

AI.tldr: 提出FedDCN，将深度聚类网络推广到联邦场景，同时优化重构损失与聚类损失，并通过合成数据增强和几何正则化实现非IID数据下的潜空间对齐。
AI.motivation: 高维数据聚类是无监督学习的核心任务，集中式场景下深度聚类方法已较成熟，但联邦学习中数据分布在客户端且涉及隐私，深度聚类研究较少。已有联邦深度聚类方法在客户端数据非独立同分布（non-IID）时性能不够可靠。
AI.method: 将Deep Clustering Networks推广至联邦场景，提出FedDCN：联合优化重构损失与聚类损失；生成合成数据增强；在学习目标中引入几何正则化以对齐潜空间。
AI.result: 实验评估表明，在IID与非IID假设下该方法均表现出有效性，并据此指出了未来研究方向。
AI.conclusion: FedDCN为联邦非IID场景下的深度聚类提供了兼顾重构与聚类的方案，通过数据增强与几何正则化提升鲁棒性和潜空间对齐，但具体性能细节与未来方向需参考原文。

title: Do Personality-Tuned LLMs Make Better Social Agents?
summary: LLMs are increasingly used in social simulations for socially interactive agents and robots, offering more flexibility than rule-based systems. However, even though they mimic human behaviour very well, there is a persistent alienness to them. This work investigates whether personality-aware fine-tuning can reduce this gap by improving the consistency and controllability of personality-conditioned dialogue generation compared with instruction prompting alone. We fine-tune two small open-weight LLMs, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Ministral-8B-Instruct, using a corpus that combines personality-labelled social media posts and dialogues to create a personality-based dialogue engine for social simulation. The resulting models are evaluated across multiple social interaction scenarios using three independent LLM judges, which assess personality fidelity and provide evidence-based behavioral interpretations. We additionally quantify inter-rater agreement and lexical characteristics of the generated dialogue. Results indicate that fine-tuned models are not better at role-playing different personalities than their respective baseline models. However, low inter-rater agreement limits the confidence with which these results can be interpreted. Concerning the quality of generated texts, fine-tuned models are mostly comparable to the baselines, with fine-tuning improving the linguistic diversity of the Qwen models. While the results appear generally usable and the baseline models offer the best overall performance, future studies should place greater emphasis on the quality and domain alignment of training data for accurate personality role-playing.

AI.tldr: 该研究探究人格感知微调能否缩小LLM在社交仿真中与人类的"异质感"，结果发现微调模型在人格角色扮演上并不优于基线模型。
AI.motivation: LLM在社交仿真中虽能模仿人类行为，但仍存在持续的"异质感"。作者希望通过人格感知微调提升人格条件化对话生成的一致性与可控性，从而缩小这一差距，并与仅使用指令提示的方法进行对比。
AI.method: 基于融合人格标注社交媒体帖子与对话的语料，对两个小型开放权重LLM（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct与Ministral-8B-Instruct）进行微调，构建面向社交仿真的人格化对话引擎。在多个人际互动场景中，使用三个独立LLM评审评估人格保真度并提供基于证据的行为解读，同时量化评审者间一致性与生成对话的词汇特征。
AI.result: 微调模型在扮演不同人格方面并不优于各自的基线模型；但评审者间一致度较低，限制了结论的可信度。在生成文本质量上，微调模型与基线大体相当，微调仅提升了Qwen模型的语言多样性。基线模型整体表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 结果整体可用，基线模型表现最优。未来研究应更加重视训练数据的质量与领域对齐，以实现准确的人格角色扮演。

title: Neural Cellular Automata Learn General Features in their Hidden Channels
summary: Modern deep learning models achieve impressive generalization through over-parameterization, but this paradigm often struggles with overfitting and memorization in few-shot regimes. Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs) offer a highly parameter-efficient alternative, yet research has focused primarily on their output, leaving the role of their internal hidden channels largely unexplored. In this paper, we investigate the internal dynamics of NCA hidden channels and introduce a novel transfer-learning mechanism that injects a pretrained teacher's hidden states into a student model to guide early optimization. Evaluated on few-shot and scale-variant MNIST benchmarks, NCAs outperform comparable recurrent and feed-forward architectures, demonstrating superior generalization with a minimal parameter budget (~9,800 parameters). Mechanistic analysis reveals that the hidden channels decouple feature extraction from uniform classification consensus by absorbing morphological complexity and converging to mutually orthogonal states. Furthermore, we demonstrate that these hidden channels capture general, scale-invariant topological primitives rather than class-specific templates. This allows a student model to achieve strong few-shot performance on unseen classes using features transferred from a teacher trained only on a subset of digits (0-5). Our results highlight the potential of utilizing hidden-state dynamics as a robust, decentralized computational substrate for parameter-efficient transfer learning

AI.tldr: 本文研究神经细胞自动机（NCA）的隐藏通道内部动力学，提出将教师模型隐藏状态注入学生模型的迁移学习机制，在少样本MNIST上以约9800参数实现优越泛化。
AI.motivation: 深度模型依赖过参数化带来泛化，但在少样本场景下易过拟合与记忆。NCA虽参数高效，但研究多聚焦输出而忽视其内部隐藏通道的作用。
AI.method: 探究NCA隐藏通道的内部动力学，设计迁移学习机制，将预训练教师模型的隐藏状态注入学生模型以引导其早期优化；在少样本与尺度变化的MNIST基准上，与同规模循环及前馈架构进行比较，并进行机制性分析。
AI.result: NCA在约9800参数的极小预算下优于可比的循环与前馈架构，泛化更强。隐藏通道将特征提取与统一分类共识解耦，通过吸收形态复杂度并收敛到相互正交状态实现；其捕获的是通用的尺度不变拓扑基元而非类别特定模板，使学生模型可借助仅在数字0-5上训练的教师特征，在未见类别上取得强少样本性能。
AI.conclusion: 隐藏状态动力学可作为稳健、去中心化的计算基底，用于参数高效的迁移学习，凸显NCA内部动力学在少样本泛化中的价值。

title: Detecting Pretraining Data in Large Language Models from a Free-Energy Perspective
summary: Detecting pretraining data in large language models is challenging because high likelihood can reflect either training exposure or strong generalization. In the joint space of prediction loss and predictive entropy, a likelihood-only detector uses a horizontal boundary and can mistake predictable non-members for members. Motivated by this, we introduce an inclined boundary that evaluates prediction loss relative to predictive entropy. Our analysis shows that entropy correction can preserve the expected membership signal while reducing its variance, thereby improving standardized member--non-member separation. We further extend the mean--variance analysis to the more general setting with a nonzero mean entropy gap. Interestingly, this entropy-adjusted score admits a Helmholtz free-energy interpretation, leading to Energy Transfer Detection (ETD), which views pretraining data detection from a macroscopic residual free-energy transfer perspective. Extensive experiments show that ETD achieves the best average detection performance, improving average AUROC by up to 3.5\% and TPR@5\%FPR by up to 5.1\%, while remaining robust across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出能量转移检测（ETD），通过在预测损失与预测熵的联合空间中引入倾斜边界（熵校正分数），从宏观残余自由能转移视角实现更优的预训练数据检测。
AI.motivation: 在大语言模型中检测预训练数据存在困难：高似然既可能源于训练曝光（成员），也可能源于强泛化（非成员）。仅基于似然的检测器在损失-熵联合空间中使用水平边界，容易将可预测的非成员误判为成员。
AI.method: 引入相对预测熵评估预测损失的倾斜边界，并进行均值-方差分析：证明熵校正可保留期望成员信号同时降低其方差，从而提升标准化的成员-非成员可分性；进一步将该分析推广到具有非零均值熵差的更一般情形。该熵调整分数具有Helmholtz自由能解释，据此提出ETD，从宏观残余自由能转移角度刻画预训练数据检测。
AI.result: 大量实验表明ETD取得最佳平均检测性能，平均AUROC最高提升3.5%，TPR@5%FPR最高提升5.1%，并在多种设置下保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 相对熵的倾斜边界优于水平边界，熵校正能在保持成员信号期望的同时降低方差；ETD以自由能转移视角统一解释该检测问题，并在实验中取得领先且鲁棒的检测效果。

title: When Should a Failing Robot Ask? Initiating Corrective Human-Robot Dialogue from Audited Sensor Evidence
comment: Accepted at the IROS 2026 Workshop on Human-Robot Dialogue
summary: A robot that fails at a task faces the first decision in corrective dialogue: act on its own diagnosis, consult another onboard sensor, or interrupt a person. Choosing well requires knowing how much the robot's sensors reveal about the cause and how reliable the robot's own diagnosis is. We build a simulated benchmark in which every failure's true cause is known, because we injected it, and measure what each sensor reveals, with explicit checks against data leakage. Some failures are diagnosable from camera images; others only from the robot's force data (0.99 from force data, no image method above 0.55). We then test six open vision-language models. Their behavior tracks the surface of the prompt, not the evidence: moving the refusal option from last to first in the answer list collapses refusal rates from 78-100% to 0-6% in three of the six swept model-and-family pairs. Accuracy from frames stays at or below a majority-class baseline under every prompt variant, with or without worked examples, and stated confidence carries no information about correctness. Handing the same models the force data as ten lines of text produces the first above-baseline diagnoses, in four of the six models: much of the failure reflects missing sensor data, not missing ability. We pose the choice as a three-action decision problem, act, consult your own sensors, or ask a human, whose optimal policy follows from measured accuracy. The models do not follow it, and their ask rates ignore a fourfold change in question cost. One question to a human still lifts them from that baseline to roughly the answerer's own reliability (0.70-0.81 when they ask). The decision to ask should be tied to measured accuracy and stated costs, not to the model's confidence.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个注入式故障诊断基准，测度不同传感器对故障原因的信息量，并测试六个开源视觉-语言模型在"自主行动/查阅自身传感器/询问人类"三动作决策中的表现，发现模型决策跟随提示表面形式而非证据，询问率不随成本变化。
AI.motivation: 机器人在任务失败后面临纠正对话中的首要决策：依据自身诊断行动、查阅其他机载传感器，还是打断人类求助。要做出合理选择，需要知道传感器对故障原因揭示了多少信息，以及机器人自身诊断的可靠性如何。现有模型是否具备这种基于证据的元认知决策能力尚不清楚，且缺乏真值已知、可严格检验数据泄漏的评测环境。
AI.method: 构建仿真基准，通过人为注入故障使每个失败的真实原因已知，并显式检查数据泄漏，量化各传感器（相机图像、力数据）对故障原因的可诊断性。随后测试六个开源视觉-语言模型在不同提示变体（选项顺序、示例有无）下的诊断准确率、拒绝率与置信度校准。将决策形式化为三动作问题（自主行动、查阅自身传感器、询问人类），并考察模型策略是否遵循由实测准确率推导出的最优策略，包括改变提问成本后的询问率响应。
AI.result: 部分故障只能由力数据诊断（力数据达0.99，无图像方法超过0.55）。模型行为跟随提示表面而非证据：将拒绝选项从末位移到首位，使六个模型-家族对中三对的拒绝率从78–100%骤降至0–6%。在所有提示变体（含/不含示例）下，基于帧的准确率均不高于多数类基线，且声明置信度与正确性无关。将力数据以十行文本形式提供后，六个模型中有四个首次出现高于基线的诊断，说明失败多源于传感器数据缺失而非能力缺失。模型不遵循最优策略，其询问率对四倍的提问成本变化不敏感。向人类提一个问题可将其从基线提升至回答者自身可靠性水平（提问时0.70–0.81）。
AI.conclusion: 是否提问的决策应基于实测准确率与明示成本，而非模型自身置信度。模型当前缺乏基于证据的元认知决策能力，其求助行为易受提示形式操纵且对成本不敏感；补齐传感器数据可显著改善诊断表现。

title: NemotronLabs VoiceChat: An Open Full-duplex Speech-to-Speech Model with Tool Calling Capabilities
summary: We introduce NemotronLabs VoiceChat, an open full-duplex speech-to-speech model with native tool-calling capabilities. NemotronLabs VoiceChat combines a streaming speech encoder and decoder-only language model with parallel specialized output streams for agent text and structured function calls, an auxiliary RNN-T branch for incremental user transcription, and a streaming TTS decoder. This design enables the model to listen, transcribe, reason, invoke tools, and speak within a unified streaming architecture while preserving the temporal behavior required for natural conversation. On Full-Duplex-Bench 1.0, NemotronLabs VoiceChat achieves the lowest pause-handling takeover rates among evaluated open-weight systems, 100\% takeover following user interruptions, and a 4.33/5 post-interruption response-quality score. On Full-Duplex-Bench 1.5, it resumes its response after user backchannels in 93\% of cases. NemotronLabs VoiceChat obtains a 55.1 normalized average on VoiceBench and, on Full-Duplex-Bench 3.0 (FDB 3.0), achieves 82.5\% tool-selection F1, while argument accuracy and end-to-end tool execution remain areas for improvement. These results demonstrate that full-duplex interaction, speech recognition and generation, general language capabilities, and external tool use can be integrated in a single open speech-to-speech model without sacrificing real-time conversational behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出开源全双工语音到语音模型 NemotronLabs VoiceChat，原生支持工具调用，在多项全双工对话与工具选择基准上取得领先结果。
AI.motivation: 现有语音对话系统难以在统一架构中同时实现全双工交互、语音识别与生成、通用语言能力及外部工具调用，且往往牺牲实时对话所需的时序行为。
AI.method: 将流式语音编码器与仅解码器语言模型结合，配置面向智能体文本与结构化函数调用的并行专用输出流、用于增量用户转写的辅助 RNN-T 分支，以及流式 TTS 解码器，形成统一的流式架构。
AI.result: 在 Full-Duplex-Bench 1.0 上取得所评估开源权重系统中最低的暂停处理接管率、用户打断后 100% 接管率及 4.33/5 的打断后回复质量分；在 Full-Duplex-Bench 1.5 上用户反馈后 93% 恢复应答；VoiceBench 归一化平均分 55.1；FDB 3.0 工具选择 F1 达 82.5%，但参数准确率与端到端工具执行仍有提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 全双工交互、语音识别与生成、通用语言能力和外部工具使用可集成于单一开源语音到语音模型中，且不牺牲实时对话行为。

title: DiaVLo: Diagnosing Behaviours of Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) rely on storing and transferring appropriate information across their sub-components. Verifying that the VLMs exhibit desired behaviours, while avoiding harmful ones, is central to their reliable deployment. Yet, methods that identify VLM behaviours remain scarce. We present DiaVLo, a diagnostic framework that leverages human curation and VLMs' generation capabilities to construct specifications of desired and observed VLM behaviours, surfacing potential misalignments. Beyond this, DiaVLo also provides causal estimates to identify the most influential concepts steering VLM behaviours. We evaluate DiaVLo on several open-source VLMs under both classification and generation conditions. Our experiments show that DiaVLo produces behaviour labels that correlate with model performance and provide context for measured performance. DiaVLo surfaced behaviours that are clearly aligned and misaligned, alongside patterns in how VLMs perceive, organise, and prioritise concepts.

AI.tldr: DiaVLo是一个诊断框架，利用人工策划与VLM生成能力构建期望与观察行为规范，并因果估计影响VLM行为的关键概念。
AI.motivation: VLM依赖子组件间存储与传递信息，验证其表现期望行为并避免有害行为对可靠部署至关重要，但识别VLM行为的方法仍很稀缺。
AI.method: DiaVLo结合人工策划与VLM生成能力，构建期望与观察到的VLM行为规范以揭示潜在错位，并提供因果估计识别最具影响力、驱动VLM行为的概念。
AI.result: 在多个开源VLM上于分类和生成条件下评估，DiaVLo生成的行为标签与模型性能相关并为性能提供背景；揭示了对齐与错位行为，以及VLM感知、组织和优先处理概念的模式。
AI.conclusion: DiaVLo能够有效诊断VLM行为，识别对齐与错位现象及概念组织模式，为VLM可靠部署提供行为层面的可解释依据。

title: Extreme classification: beating chance with one training example from each class
summary: We study a minimal classification problem: Given independent labeled observations $X\sim P$ and $Z\sim Q$ from two unknown distributions $P,Q$, and given an independent target $Y$ drawn with equal probability from $P$ or $Q$, can one classify $Y$ strictly better than chance whenever $P\neq Q$? The one-nearest-neighbor rule succeeds for every pair of multivariate Gaussian distributions with distinct means and a common positive-definite covariance matrix but can perform strictly worse than chance even for smooth densities on the real line. We construct a fixed randomized kernel rule whose expected accuracy is exactly $1/2+\operatorname{MMD}_k^2(P,Q)/4$, and obtain characteristic kernels on countably generated measurable spaces from countable families of measurable binary questions. We also prove that a deterministic order rule on $\mathbb R$ beats chance for every pair of distinct Borel probability measures. A measurable encoding then gives a deterministic distribution-free rule which beats chance on every countably generated measurable space, in particular every separable metric space. Finally, we show that no rule works for every distinct pair of distributions and every unknown unbalanced class prior; under adaptive target-class selection, every rule other than a fair coin is strictly worse than chance for some finitely supported pair.

AI.tldr: 研究二分类最小问题：能否构造规则使对任意P≠Q的分类准确率严格优于随机猜测；给出核方法、序方法与可测编码的构造，并刻画先验不平衡与自适应选择下的不可能性。
AI.motivation: 探讨最弱假设下的二分类可学习性：仅知两分布不同(P≠Q)、无样本量、无先验信息，且目标Y以等概率来自P或Q，是否存在普遍优于随机的规则，并厘清其边界条件（如不平衡先验、自适应类别选择）。
AI.method: 1) 反例：光滑密度下一近邻可劣于随机，而共同正定协方差的高斯下最近邻有效；2) 构造固定随机化核规则，期望准确率为1/2+MMD_k²(P,Q)/4，并由可数族可测二值问题得到可数生成空间上的特征核；3) R上确定性序规则对任意不同Borel概率测度优于随机；4) 通过可测编码推广到可数生成可测空间（含可分度量空间）；5) 分析未知不平衡类先验与自适应目标类选择下的不可能性。
AI.result: 存在随机化核规则统一优于随机且准确率由MMD²显式刻画；R上确定性序规则普遍有效并可编码到可数生成空间；但若类先验未知且不平衡，或允许目标类自适应选择，则任何规则（或除公平硬币外）对某有限支撑分布对严格劣于随机。
AI.conclusion: 在等概率目标先验下，普遍优于随机是可行的，且可通过核MMD与序/可测编码实现分布无关的确定性规则；其根本限制来自不平衡先验与自适应类别选择，此时不存在普遍有效规则。

title: Complex Problem Solving in Large Language Models: A Statistical Control Survey and Diagnostic Framework
comment: 82 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to Artificial Intelligence Review
summary: Complex problem solving (CPS) with large language models (LLMs) is often framed as a matter of stronger reasoning or longer generation. Yet early-step error amplification, prompt brittleness, and failures to revise incorrect commitments are difficult to explain by missing knowledge or expressive capacity alone. This survey interprets CPS as a sequential estimation-and-decision problem over a latent solution state. A controller maintains a belief about an unobserved solution trajectory, updates it as noisy intermediate evidence arrives, and decides whether to commit, verify, branch, roll back, or abstain to minimize expected loss. Reasoning supplies candidate transitions and interpretations, whereas process control shapes and evaluates those proposals and regulates subsequent transitions and observations. Within this framework, we organize existing methods around five components: explicit state representation, transition structuring, validation and constraint enforcement, search and rollback, and uncertainty management. We also interpret evaluation metrics according to the statistical quantities they estimate. The framework further yields a diagnostic hypothesis: interventions should be most effective when they target the error or uncertainty component implicated by an observed failure. We distinguish systematic, stochastic, and irreducible error together with epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty, and call this alignment problem-control fit and its failure control mismatch. For example, additional sampling may reduce sampling variability while leaving a shared systematic error unchanged. This perspective clarifies what current methods estimate and control, what remains uncontrolled, and why reliable validation, targeted recovery, calibrated uncertainty, and matched-budget evaluation are central open problems.

AI.tldr: 该综述将大语言模型的复杂问题求解(CPS)重新建模为对潜在解状态的序贯估计-决策问题，以"过程控制"区分于"推理"为组织主线，提出五组件分类框架与"控制匹配"诊断假说，指出可靠验证、针对性恢复、不确定性校准与匹配预算评估是核心开放问题。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常把LLM复杂问题求解归因于"推理更强"或"生成更长"，但早期步骤误差放大、提示脆弱性、无法修正错误承诺等现象，仅靠知识缺失或表达容量不足难以解释。因此需要一个能解释这些失败机制并统一组织现有方法的理论视角。
AI.method: 将CPS形式化为潜在解状态上的序贯估计与决策问题：控制器维护关于未观测解轨迹的信念，随噪声中间证据到达而更新，并决定提交、验证、分支、回滚或弃答以最小化期望损失。区分"推理"(提供候选转移与解释)与"过程控制"(塑造与评估提案、调节后续转移与观测)。据此把现有方法归纳为五个组件——显式状态表示、转移结构化、验证与约束执行、搜索与回滚、不确定性管理；并按所估计的统计量重新解读评估指标。进一步区分系统性/随机性/不可约误差与认知/偶然不确定性，提出"问题-控制匹配"及失配的诊断假说。
AI.result: 构建了一个统一的估计-决策框架与五组件方法分类体系；建立了评估指标与所估计统计量之间的对应；给出可检验的诊断假说：干预应在针对观测失败所牵涉的误差或不确定性成分时最有效，例如额外采样可降低采样方差却无法改变共同的系统性误差。
AI.conclusion: 该视角厘清了当前方法实际估计与控制了什么、哪些部分仍不受控，并说明为何可靠验证、针对性恢复、校准不确定性及匹配预算的评估是关键开放问题。

title: A Smoothed Discrepancy Principle for Random Feature Methods and Neural Networks
summary: We study data-driven early stopping for spectral regularisation methods in the classical non-parametric regression setting. Building on the discrepancy principle, we propose a multi-scale stopping rule that applies to general kernel estimators and show that, unlike previous approaches, it achieves full adaptivity over all smoothness levels in the well-specified case. A key contribution of our work is an extension based on random feature approximations, which reduces computational cost on large datasets while preserving minimax-optimal statistical guarantees. Our procedure not only selects an optimal stopping time but also provides a fully data-driven choice of the number of random features needed to achieve optimal rates. Through the established connection between random features and neural networks in the neural tangent kernel regime, our method further yields a principled, data-driven recommendation for the network width. We prove that the resulting simultaneously chosen width and stopping time allow neural networks to attain minimax-optimal learning rates without prior knowledge of smoothness or capacity parameters.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究非参数回归中谱正则化方法的数据驱动早停策略，提出多尺度停止规则，并结合随机特征近似，实现全平滑度自适应与随机特征数、神经网络宽度的数据驱动选择。
AI.motivation: 现有谱正则化早停方法难以在所有平滑度水平上实现完全自适应，且在大数据集上计算成本高；同时随机特征与神经网络宽度等容量参数通常需要先验知识。
AI.method: 基于差异原则（discrepancy principle）提出适用于一般核估计器的多尺度停止规则，并扩展到随机特征近似；通过随机特征与神经正切核（NTK）区域神经网络的联系，将该规则用于选择网络宽度与停止时间。
AI.result: 在正确设定情形下实现对所有平滑度水平的完全自适应；随机特征扩展在降低大数据计算成本的同时保持极小极大最优统计保证；可同时数据驱动地选择最优停止时间与所需随机特征数。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为随机特征数与神经网络宽度提供有原则的数据驱动建议，使神经网络在无需平滑度或容量参数先验知识的情况下达到极小极大最优学习率。

title: Triply-Scalable Equivariant Gaussian Process Modeling
summary:
Gaussian processes (GPs) provide principled probabilistic predictions while encoding prior knowledge, including equivariances. Yet, their use in large-scale scientific problems is limited by computational cost. Equivariant neural networks are common but typically lack the uncertainty quantification offered by GPs, which is valuable in applications such as molecular research. High-dimensional inputs and large symmetry groups further demand scalability. We establish results pertaining to the interplay of GP equivariance and conditioning and leverage them to obtain equivariant sparse GPs through suitable mean functions and covariance kernels. We instantiate this framework with a flexible class of integration-free equivariant kernels, yielding scalable and data-efficient GP inference. In particular, we introduce triply scalable equivariant Gaussian processes.
  We employ equivariant sparse variational Gaussian processes for $\mathrm{SO}(2)$-equivariant vector fields and molecular property prediction. Alongside the SVGP, we develop a matrix-free equivariant full-GP implementation that combines an exact Kronecker reduction with preconditioned conjugate-gradient solves, enabling fast and scalable evaluation of the full joint predictive density. We further compare different approaches for selecting inducing points in the equivariant sparse GP models. Our test cases include synthetic $\mathrm{SO}(2)$-equivariant fields as well as the prediction of electric dipole moments of N-methylformamide based on quantum chemistry simulations, achieving accurate, uncertainty-aware predictions at a fraction of the computational cost of classical GP inference.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究等变高斯过程的可扩展性问题，通过均值函数与协方差核实现等变稀疏GP，并给出免积分等变核，构建近乎三重可扩展的等变GP，用于SO(2)等变矢量场与分子性质预测。
AI.motivation: 高斯过程具备概率预测与先验（含等变性）编码能力，但在大规模科学问题中受计算成本限制；等变神经网络常用却缺乏GP式的不确定性量化，而分子研究等应用高度需要该量化。高维输入与大对称群进一步要求可扩展性。
AI.method: 建立GP等变性与条件化相互作用的结果，借此通过合适的均值函数与协方差核获得等变稀疏GP；实例化为免积分等变核的灵活类，实现可扩展且数据高效的推断；采用SO(2)等变稀疏变分GP（SVGP）；并开发免矩阵等变全GP实现，结合精确Kronecker约简与预处理共轭梯度求解，以评估完整联合预测密度；同时比较等变稀疏GP中诱导点选择的不同方法。
AI.result: 在合成SO(2)等变场以及基于量子化学模拟的N-甲基甲酰胺电偶极矩预测任务上，实现准确且具不确定性感知的预测，计算成本仅为经典GP推断的一小部分。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的三重可扩展等变高斯过程框架兼具等变性、稀疏可扩展性与不确定性量化，可高效处理高维与大对称群的科学建模任务，在分子性质预测等场景中表现有效。

title: Diagonalized Attention for Individualized Regression: Latent-Row Localization and Prediction
summary: Modern text and image representations are often matrix-valued, with rows corresponding to tokens, patches, or other local feature vectors. Predictive information is often sparse but sample-specific, making classical sparse regression methods with a common support poorly suited to this heterogeneity. This paper formalizes an individualized sparse regression framework for matrix-valued covariates in which each observation has its own rows of interest, while the associated regression effects are shared across the population. To estimate this model, we introduce a diagonalized attention mechanism that uses query--key scores to localize sample-specific signal rows and a value matrix for downstream regression. The proposed method has a parameter dimension independent of sample size and can identify rows of interest for new observations without their responses. We establish existence theorems showing that, under suitable score-separation and concentration conditions, single-head and multi-head diagonalized attention models recover the latent rows with high probability, yielding prediction risk bounds. Our theory therefore provides a statistical explanation of how attention-based scoring localizes sample-specific signals in heterogeneous matrix-valued data. Simulations demonstrate strong prediction and localization in regression and misspecified classification across varying sample sizes, dimensions, and signal cardinalities. Real sentiment analyses show improved classification accuracy and interpretable token selection.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出面向矩阵值协变量的个体化稀疏回归框架，并引入对角化注意力机制，用query-key分数定位每个样本专属的信号行、用value矩阵做回归，理论上证明了单头/多头模型可高概率恢复潜在行并给出预测风险界。
AI.motivation: 矩阵值表示（行对应token、patch等局部特征）中，预测信息往往稀疏但样本特异，传统共享支撑集的稀疏回归难以适应这种异质性。
AI.method: 提出个体化稀疏回归框架：每个观测有自身关注的行，但回归效应在全人群共享；引入对角化注意力机制，用query-key分数定位样本特异信号行，用value矩阵进行下游回归。参数维度与样本量无关，且可在无响应的情况下为新样本识别关注行。
AI.result: 在适当的分数分离与集中条件下，建立存在性定理，证明单头与多头对角化注意力模型能以高概率恢复潜在行，并给出预测风险界；模拟实验在回归和误设定分类中随样本量、维度和信号基数变化均表现出强预测与定位能力；真实情感分析显示分类精度提升且token选择可解释。
AI.conclusion: 该理论为注意力打分如何在异质矩阵值数据中定位样本特异信号提供了统计学解释。

title: Sparse Identification for Automatic Large-Scale Screening: A Constraint-Aware Framework with Ultra Fast Decoding Algorithm
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: In the early stages of a pandemic, identification of a small number of infected individuals through large-scale screening is critical for pandemic control, yet remains challenging under limited reagents and testing capacity. Existing group testing methods suffer from either high computational complexity or low identification accuracy. Even worse, no available methods provide theoretically rigorous analysis for sparse identification with hard constraints caused by the sample usage constraint and the dilution effect existing ubiquitously in practical applications. In this article, we propose the Logic Screening method (LoSc), an ultra fast, accurate, and theoretically grounded framework for large-scale screening. LoSc introduces a novel decoding algorithm with a very simple selection strategy, achieving identification of all positives with only O(klogn) pooled tests. The decoding relies only on logical operations, enabling direct hardware implementation and yielding ultra fast computational implementation. Moreover, LoSc explicitly incorporates dilution and sample usage constraints into pooling designs, and establishes theoretical guarantees to guide optimal pooling configurations. Extensive simulations confirm the superior effectiveness, efficiency, and scalability. We believe LoSc offers a fast and reliable solution for automatic large-scale screening.

AI.tldr: LoSc：一种超快速、准确且具理论支撑的大规模筛查框架，通过仅含逻辑运算的解码算法实现 O(klogn) 混合检测识别所有阳性样本。
AI.motivation: 疫情早期需通过大规模筛查识别少数感染者，但受限于试剂与检测能力。现有分组检测方法或计算复杂度高、或识别准确率低，且缺乏对样本使用约束与稀释效应等硬约束下稀疏识别的严格理论分析。
AI.method: 提出逻辑筛查方法 LoSc，引入采用极简选择策略的新型解码算法，解码仅依赖逻辑运算，支持直接硬件实现；在池化设计中显式纳入稀释效应与样本使用约束，并建立理论保证以指导最优池化配置。
AI.result: LoSc 仅需 O(klogn) 次混合检测即可识别所有阳性样本，实现超快速计算；大量仿真验证了其在有效性、效率和可扩展性方面的优越性。
AI.conclusion: LoSc 为自动大规模筛查提供了一种快速可靠的解决方案，兼具超快速度、高准确性与理论严谨性。

title: Brownian Heads for Deep ReLU Representations: Activation Mass and the Cost of Same-Sample Selection
summary: Deep representation learning often selects hidden features and fits the final predictor on the same sample, so fixed-feature analysis performed after selection can omit selection cost. We study the conditional empirical Rademacher complexity of deep ReLU representations followed by bounded-norm predictors in additive or Lévy-Brownian RKHSs, termed Brownian heads. For a fixed representation, we derive an exact dual identity and sharp bounds in terms of activation mass, the average norm of the observed hidden vectors. Under same-sample selection, the representation supremum induces a quadratic Rademacher process. Brownian layer-cake and Gaussian-projection identities reduce it to coordinatewise or signed projected threshold traces, separating realized scale from selection complexity. For samples with pairwise-distinct inputs, explicit scalar ReLU families match the finite-trace and VC rates up to universal constants at the realized trace-and-envelope level. Induced-norm contraction also yields architecture-level bounds for rectangular, rank-deficient ReLU networks. Experiments verify the sharp bounds and rates, exhibit a selection gap at fixed activation mass, and assess the predictive feasibility of Brownian heads.

AI.tldr: 本文研究深度ReLU表示后接有界范数预测器（Brownian heads）的条件经验Rademacher复杂度，针对同一样本上进行特征选择与预测器拟合导致的"选择成本遗漏"问题，给出了精确对偶恒等式、锐利界以及coordinated/符号投影阈值迹的形式。
AI.motivation: 深度表示学习常在同一批样本上同时进行隐藏特征选择与最终预测器拟合。此后再做固定特征的分析会忽略"选择成本"，从而低估复杂度。作者希望刻画"同一样本选择"下的条件经验Rademacher复杂度，把已实现的尺度与选择复杂度分离开来。
AI.method: 研究对象为Deep ReLU表示后接加性RKHS或Lévy-Brownian RKHS中的有界范数预测器（Brownian head）。对固定表示，推导精确对偶恒等式，并用激活质量（激活值平均范数）给出锐利界。在同一样本选择下，表示上确界诱导出二次Rademacher过程；利用Brownian layer-cake与Gaussian projection恒等式将其约化为逐坐标或带符号的投影阈值迹，从而分离已实现尺度与选择复杂度。对输入两两不同的样本，构造显式标量ReLU族，使其在已实现迹与包络层面以通用常数匹配有限迹率和VC率。通过诱导范数收缩，将结果推广到矩形、秩亏ReLU网络的架构级界。
AI.result: 得到了固定表示下的精确对偶恒等式与基于激活质量的锐利界；将二次Rademacher过程约化为阈值迹形式；显式标量ReLU族在实现迹-包络层面匹配有限迹与VC率（至通用常数）；给出了矩形、秩亏ReLU网络的架构级复杂度界。实验验证了锐利界与率，展示了固定激活质量下的"选择间隙"，并评估了Brownian heads的预测可行性。
AI.conclusion: 同一样本特征选择带来的选择成本不可忽略，需在复杂度分析中显式建模。通过二次Rademacher过程与阈值迹分解，可将已实现尺度与选择复杂度分离，并为深层ReLU网络（含秩亏情形）提供架构级泛化界；实验支持理论界与选择间隙的存在。

title: Improving the Predictive Performance of Bootstrap Aggregating by Dirichlet Resampling
comment: 29 pages (10 main text, 19 pages appendix), 21 tables, 3 algorithms. No figures
summary: We revisit Breiman's observation that reducing inter-tree correlation without weakening individual trees can improve random forests. Building on this principle, we introduce two variants: Dirichlet-Multinomial Bagging Random Forest (DM) and Dirichlet-Weighted Random Forest (DW). Both modulate sample reweighting via a concentration parameter $α>0$. We provide a simple theoretical criterion that clarifies when these variants behave indistinguishably from standard random forests, and we use it to guide a lightweight tuning strategy. In a controlled evaluation on public classification benchmarks, DM and DW are consistently competitive and often stronger than other random-forest (RF) baselines, with negligible additional runtime.

AI.tldr: 该论文基于Breiman关于"在不削弱单棵树的前提下降低树间相关性可提升随机森林"的观察，提出Dirichlet-Multinomial Bagging Random Forest (DM) 与 Dirichlet-Weighted Random Forest (DW) 两种变体，通过浓度参数α调节样本重加权，并给出判定其与标准随机森林行为一致的简化理论准则，据此设计轻量调参策略。
AI.motivation: Breiman曾观察到，若能降低树间相关性而不削弱单棵树的强度，则可提升随机森林性能。论文以此原理为出发点，试图通过样本重加权机制进一步控制树间相关性，从而在保持单树能力的同时提升集成效果。
AI.method: 提出两种随机森林变体：(1) Dirichlet-Multinomial Bagging Random Forest (DM)；(2) Dirichlet-Weighted Random Forest (DW)。二者均通过浓度参数 α>0 对样本重加权进行调制。此外，论文给出一个简洁的理论准则，用于刻画在何种条件下这两种变体与标准随机森林的行为无法区分（即退化为标准RF），并以此准则指导一种轻量级的超参数调优策略。
AI.result: 在公开分类基准上的受控实验中，DM与DW表现稳定且具有竞争力，往往优于其他随机森林基线方法，且额外运行时间开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 通过Dirichlet基的样本重加权机制调节树间相关性，可在几乎不增加计算成本的前提下提升随机森林性能；所提供的理论准则明确了变体与标准RF等价的条件，并为轻量调参提供了依据。

title: Riemannian Simultaneous Inference for Tangent Vector Field Regression
summary: We consider nonparametric tangent vector field regression on a Riemannian manifold without boundary. Because responses at different points lie in different tangent spaces, the proposed kernel estimator first parallel transports nearby responses to the target tangent space and then forms a volume-corrected local average. We first derive its uniform second-order bias, finite-bandwidth covariance, and stochastic rate. For simultaneous inference, the tangent norm is written as a supremum over the unit tangent bundle. Exact covariance whitening gives a unit-variance Gaussian field whose correlation length is of order $h$ along the base manifold and of order one along the fibre. Its local covariance geometry leads to a Gumbel limit with an explicit intrinsic constant. Combining this limit with Gaussian approximation and cross-fitted covariance estimation yields a feasible simultaneous confidence tube for the regression field. We further discuss improved finite-sample inference with bandwidth selection and high-order bias corrections. Simulations on various manifolds support the proposed inference procedure. A randomized reconstruction of global wind data illustrates how the tube's cross-sections describe spatially varying uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 提出黎曼流形上切向量场回归的非参数核估计方法，通过平行移动与体积校正实现均匀偏差、协方差与随机率分析，并构造可行的同时置信管。
AI.motivation: 不同点处的响应位于不同切空间，无法直接做局部平均，因此需要一种能跨切空间比较和聚合响应的非参数回归框架，并进一步解决同时推断（置信管）问题。
AI.method: 先通过平行移动将邻近响应传输到目标切空间，再做体积校正的局部平均形成核估计；推导均匀二阶偏差、有限带宽协方差与随机率；将切向范数写成单位切丛上的上确界，经精确协方差白化得到单位方差高斯场，分析其局部协方差几何并导出显式内在常数的Gumbel极限，结合高斯逼近与交叉拟合协方差估计构造同时置信管，并讨论带宽选择与高阶偏差修正。
AI.result: 得到核估计的均匀二阶偏差、有限带宽协方差和随机率；白化后相关长度在基流形方向为O(h)、纤维方向为O(1)；获得带显式内在常数的Gumbel极限，并据此给出可行的同时置信管；模拟验证推断流程，全球风数据重构展示置信管截面刻画空间变化的不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为黎曼流形上的切向量场回归提供了完整的非参数估计与同时推断理论，兼顾有限样本改进与实际数据应用。

title: Training-Adaptive Convolutional Sparse Coding via Information Bottleneck for Robust Visual Representation
summary: Visual signals require compact yet sufficient representations for robust downstream prediction. Convolutional sparse coding (CSC) provides an explicit mechanism for suppressing redundant components while preserving signal content, but its sparsity coefficient is typically fixed and manually selected. We propose a training-adaptive convolutional sparse coding framework for robust visual signal representation. Specifically, we unfold the CSC optimization with the Fast Iterative Shrinkage-Thresholding Algorithm (FISTA) and treat the sparsity coefficient as a differentiable variable jointly learned with the network parameters. From the information bottleneck perspective, this coefficient controls the trade-off between information retention and compression: the sparsity term promotes compact representations, while the reconstruction term together with task loss preserves task-relevant signal content. We further introduce a label-free post-training strategy that adjusts the compression strength for corrupted inputs with the main network parameters fixed. Experiments on CIFAR and ImageNet demonstrate competitive clean-data recognition and greatly improved robustness under different input perturbations.

AI.tldr: 提出训练自适应的卷积稀疏编码框架，用FISTA展开并将稀疏系数作为可微变量联合学习，从信息瓶颈视角平衡信息保留与压缩，并引入无标签后训练策略，在CIFAR与ImageNet上实现竞争性干净精度与显著提升的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 视觉信号需要紧凑但充分的表示以支撑鲁棒的下游预测。卷积稀疏编码（CSC）能显式抑制冗余并保留信号内容，但其稀疏系数通常固定且需人工设定，限制了自适应性与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 用快速迭代收缩阈值算法（FISTA）展开CSC优化；将稀疏系数视为可微变量，与网络参数联合学习。从信息瓶颈视角，该系数控制信息保留与压缩的权衡：稀疏项促进紧凑表示，重构项与任务损失共同保留任务相关信息。此外引入无标签后训练策略，在固定主网络参数的情况下，针对受扰输入调整压缩强度。
AI.result: 在CIFAR和ImageNet数据集上的实验表明，该方法在干净数据识别上具有竞争性表现，并在不同输入扰动下大幅提升鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将稀疏系数纳入可学习框架并结合信息瓶颈与无标签后训练，实现了训练自适应的卷积稀疏编码，兼顾紧凑表示与任务相关性，在精度与鲁棒性之间取得良好平衡。

title: Layerwise Decoupling for Stable Structured Sparsification of Fully Connected Layers
summary: We propose a decoupled, layerwise method for structurally sparsifying the fully connected layers of pretrained neural networks. Rather than penalizing all layers jointly, our approach extracts shallow two-layer subnetworks, normalizes the inner weights, and applies a structured group penalty to the outer weight matrix of each block, processing layers sequentially to prune neurons and reduce the width of each layer. We prove that the constrained decoupled objective is equivalent at optimality to a specific joint penalty on the inner and outer weights, for any positively homogeneous activation, and thus admits a clean projected and proximal formulation. Our central finding is that this decoupled reformulation is more robust than coupled methods. In numerical experiments it provides a wider usable range of the regularization strength and a lower rate of catastrophic over-pruning than the tested joint baseline while maintaining comparable accuracy. We establish these properties in controlled classification and sparse-recovery studies, and examine their scope in a high-dimensional PINN stress test and in the feed-forward layers of OPT-1.3B.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种解耦、逐层（layerwise）的结构化稀疏化方法，用于对预训练神经网络全连接层进行剪枝，并证明其与特定联合惩罚在最优性上等价，实验表明该方法比联合（coupled）基线更稳健。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常对所有层联合施加惩罚（joint penalty），在剪枝时会同时影响全部层，导致正则化强度可用范围窄，且容易出现灾难性过度剪枝（catastrophic over-pruning）。作者希望找到一种更稳健的结构化稀疏化方式，以拓宽可用的正则化范围并降低过度剪枝风险。
AI.method: 提出解耦的逐层方法：从预训练网络中抽取浅层两层子网络（two-layer subnetwork），对内部权重进行归一化，并对每个块的外层权重矩阵施加结构化组惩罚（structured group penalty）；按顺序逐层处理以剪除神经元、缩减每层宽度。理论上证明，对于任意正齐次激活函数（positively homogeneous activation），约束解耦目标在最优处等价于对内外权重的特定联合惩罚，因而可得到简洁的投影与近端（projected and proximal）形式。
AI.result: 解耦重述比耦合方法更稳健：数值实验中提供了更宽的正则化强度可用范围，且灾难性过度剪枝率低于所测试的联合基线，同时保持可比的准确率。在受控的分类与稀疏恢复研究中验证了这些性质，并在高维 PINN 压力测试和 OPT-1.3B 的前馈层中考察了其适用范围。
AI.conclusion: 解耦、逐层的结构化稀疏化框架在理论上与联合惩罚等价，在实践中比耦合方法更稳健，兼具更宽的可用正则化范围与更低的过度剪枝率，且准确率相当，具有在多种网络与任务上的适用潜力。

title: Multi-Domain Clustering via Measure Quantization
summary: Clustering is a fundamental task in data analysis, typically addressed through centroid-based methods such as K-means. In this work, we present a general framework for multi-domain clustering via measure quantization: given samples from multiple domains, we learn a shared set of cluster prototypes by minimizing a probability metric, such as the Sinkhorn divergence or the Maximum Mean Discrepancy, between each domain's probability measure and the measure of prototypes. Data points are then assigned to clusters either via nearest centroid, or via optimal transport, a collaborative strategy that couples all samples within a domain. A mini-batch optimization strategy makes both fitting and assignment scalable, reducing memory and computational cost while preserving clustering performance. Experimental results on 5 multi-domain benchmarks spanning image, audio and sensor data show that our Sinkhorn-based method consistently outperforms classical and multi-domain clustering baselines, and that this advantage persists when scaling to hundreds of thousands of samples.

AI.tldr: 提出基于测度量化的多域聚类通用框架：用Sinkhorn散度或MMD匹配各域概率测度与原型测度学习共享聚类原型，支持最近质心或最优传输分配，并用小批量优化实现可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 聚类是数据分析的基础任务，通常以K-means等质心方法解决。但多域场景下，来自多个域的数据需要共享的聚类结构，传统方法难以在概率测度层面统一建模并兼顾可扩展性。
AI.method: 给定多个域的样本，学习一组共享的聚类原型，通过最小化每域概率测度与原型测度之间的概率度量（如Sinkhorn散度或最大均值差异MMD）来拟合。数据点分配采用两种方式：最近质心，或最优传输——后者在同域内耦合所有样本的协作式策略。引入小批量优化策略，使拟合与分配均可扩展，降低内存与计算开销。
AI.result: 在覆盖图像、音频和传感器数据的5个多域基准上，基于Sinkhorn的方法一致优于经典聚类与多域聚类基线；规模扩展到数十万样本时该优势依然保持。
AI.conclusion: 测度量化提供了一个统一、可扩展的多域聚类框架，Sinkhorn散度作为目标度量表现最佳，最优传输分配提供协作式聚类能力，小批量优化在保持性能的同时显著提升可扩展性。

title: Geometric Mean Pooling for Equal-Weight Multiplicative Coarse-Graining
summary: As an alternative to the additive and extremal biases of average and max pooling, we introduce Geometric Mean Pooling (GMP), a signed pooling operator that combines the product of feature signs with the geometric mean of feature magnitudes. Motivated by local-to-global composition in quantum many-body physics, GMP retains both joint sign information and a characteristic multiplicative scale without introducing learnable pooling parameters. We show that non-overlapping hierarchical GMP preserves the corresponding global multiplicative statistic and evaluate it on synthetic sequence tasks, iterative coarse-graining, image classification, and molecular lipophilicity regression. On the synthetic tasks, GMP recovers product-based signals more accurately than average and max pooling and maintains predictive performance under the tested levels of multiplicative input noise. On image and molecular data, however, its effectiveness depends on the representation, target parameterization, and placement of local and global pooling. These results position GMP as a complementary, regime-dependent inductive bias for tasks in which equal-weight multiplicative composition is plausible, rather than as a universal replacement for standard pooling operators.

AI.tldr: 论文提出几何平均池化（GMP），一种带符号池化算子，将特征符号乘积与特征幅值的几何平均结合，在合成任务上优于平均池化和最大池化，但在图像与分子任务上效果依赖具体设置，定位为特定情形下的补充性归纳偏置。
AI.motivation: 平均池化具有可加性偏置，最大池化具有极值偏置，二者均无法刻画特征间的乘性合成关系；受量子多体物理中局部到全局组合的启发，作者希望设计一种能同时保留联合符号信息与乘性尺度的池化算子。
AI.method: 提出几何平均池化（GMP）：将特征符号的乘积与特征幅值的几何平均相结合，构成带符号的池化算子；该算子不引入可学习参数，并采用非重叠的层级式GMP以保持全局乘性统计量。在合成序列任务、迭代粗粒化、图像分类与分子亲脂性回归上进行评估。
AI.result: 在合成任务上，GMP比平均池化和最大池化更准确地恢复基于乘积的信号，并在所测试的乘性输入噪声水平下保持预测性能；在图像与分子数据上，其有效性取决于表示方式、目标参数化以及局部与全局池化的位置安排。
AI.conclusion: GMP是一种互补的、依赖具体情形的归纳偏置，适用于等权乘性组合合理的任务，而非对标准池化算子的通用替代方案。

title: Moral Entropy: Auditing Bias and Uncertainty in Moral Judgment
summary:
Most work in computational ethics treats annotator disagreement on moral content as noise to be voted away, collapsed into majority vote or the more permissive any-annotator rule the moment a single annotator flags an item. We argue this uncertainty should instead be modeled and learned from.
  We introduce Moral Entropy, a Bayesian framework that keeps a full posterior over the true label and decomposes its entropy into aleatoric uncertainty (irreducible disagreement about the moral content) and epistemic uncertainty (from insufficient or noisy annotation) -- and lets any heuristic consensus rule be audited against a calibrated ground truth via entropy methods such as cross-entropy/KL, Brier score, and expected calibration error.
  Across three corpora and fifteen discourse domains, auditing the standard aggregation rules against this posterior reveals bias that no current pipeline reports: the any-annotator rule disagrees with the calibrated posterior on roughly 30% of items -- pooled, almost entirely false positives, though the errors invert at the foundation level (19.9%/38.9% mean FPR/FNR on MFTC) -- while the stricter majority and two-vote rules miss 63-83% of true positives.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Moral Entropy贝叶斯框架，将道德标注分歧建模为可学习的不确定性，并分解为偶然与认识两类不确定性，用于审计常见聚合规则的偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有计算伦理研究通常把标注者对道德内容的分歧视作噪声，通过多数投票或任一标注者标记的宽松规则直接消除，忽略了其中蕴含的不确定性信息。
AI.method: 构建Moral Entropy:在真实标签上保留完整后验分布，将熵分解为偶然不确定性(道德内容本身的不可约分歧)与认识不确定性(标注不足或噪声导致);并借助交叉熵/KL、Brier分数和期望校准误差等熵方法，将任意启发式共识规则与校准后的真实标签进行对比审计。
AI.result: 在三个语料库、十五个话语领域上审计标准聚合规则:任一标注者规则与校准后验在约30%条目上不一致，合并后几乎全为假阳性，但在基础层面错误发生反转(MFTC上平均FPR/FNR为19.9%/38.9%);更严格的多数投票与两票规则则漏掉63-83%的真阳性。
AI.conclusion: 现有聚合规则存在当前流程未报告的偏差，将道德标注分歧建模为不确定性并加以学习，可为共识规则提供校准的审计基准，优于简单投票消除分歧的做法。

title: Sparse Priors for Efficient Distribution Learning
summary: Despite the widespread use and success of generative AI techniques today, theoretical guarantees on learning a distribution supported in $d$ dimensions from $n$ samples degrade as $O(n^{-1/Θ(d)})$, though shown to be minimax optimal. We hypothesize that present bounds are too pessimistic because smoothness assumptions are not enough to capture the structure of distributions that often appear in real applications. Consequently, we introduce the class of sparse priors and define the "Sparse Dimension" as a measure of sparsity of a prior over the space of all distributions. We show that distribution learning under a $k$-sparse prior achieves a Bayesian risk lower bound of $Ω(\sqrt{k/n})$ under common distance metrics, and show a matching (up to logarithmic terms asymptotically in $n,k$) upper bound for the TV distance under mild additional assumptions. We show the statistical equivalence of distribution learning and learning to sample in the Bayesian setting so that our results apply to learning to sample as well. While $k$ can still depend on the dimension $d$, or a notion of intrinsic dimension, our results show that learning under an appropriate prior overcomes the curse of dimensionality with respect to the dependence on $n$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"稀疏先验"类别与"稀疏维度"概念，证明在k-稀疏先验下分布学习的贝叶斯风险下界为Ω(√(k/n))，并在TV距离上给出匹配上界，从而在依赖n的层面克服维度灾难，同时表明该结果同样适用于"学习采样"。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式AI方法虽广泛应用且成功，但从n个样本学习d维支撑分布的理论保证退化为O(n^{-1/Θ(d)})，即使已是极小极大最优，仍被认为过于悲观。作者假设：仅靠光滑性假设不足以刻画真实应用中分布的固有结构，因此需要引入能反映分布结构的先验类以获得更紧的界。
AI.method: 1) 引入"稀疏先验"类（sparse priors）；2) 定义"稀疏维度"（Sparse Dimension）作为所有分布空间上先验稀疏性的度量；3) 在k-稀疏先验下分析分布学习的贝叶斯风险，推导下界；4) 在温和附加假设下针对TV距离证明匹配上界；5) 在贝叶斯框架下证明"分布学习"与"学习采样"的统计等价性。
AI.result: 在k-稀疏先验下，常见距离度量上的贝叶斯风险下界为Ω(√(k/n))；在温和附加假设下，TV距离上获得匹配上界（渐近于n,k，至多相差对数项）。由于分布学习与学习采样的统计等价性，这些结果同样适用于学习采样。k仍可依赖维度d或本质维度。
AI.conclusion: 在合适的先验（即k-稀疏先验）下进行学习，可在关于n的依赖上克服维度灾难，即使k仍可能依赖d或本质维度。这表明现有基于光滑性的悲观界源于未充分利用分布结构，稀疏先验提供了更精确的理论保证，并统一了分布学习与学习采样两类任务。

title: Elastic Threshold Attention: Learned Contextual Sparsity for Long-Context Decoding
summary: Massive KV caches can cause severe memory-bandwidth bottlenecks during long-context decoding. Sparse attention methods mitigate this via selective loading, but that comes at a cost: rigid heuristics drop necessary context, leading to quality degradation. We introduce \textbf{Elastic Threshold Attention (ETA)}, an end-to-end trainable architecture that achieves hardware-accelerated decoding speed without sacrificing dense model quality. ETA predicts dynamic, contextual thresholds directly from query representations, allowing the model to allocate dense-like context to difficult retrieval or reasoning steps while pruning routine tokens. To learn this policy from scratch without representation collapse, ETA \emph{multiplicatively suppresses} sub-threshold logits toward zero during training rather than deleting them. Training against this smooth uniform attention floor provides a distributed probability reservoir that \textbf{causes localized attention sinks on initial tokens to disappear}. It also enables the model to hard-prune uninformative KV blocks at inference time and absorb incidental tokens co-admitted by coarse GPU block selection. As a result, a 1.45B pretrained ETA model rivals dense attention across language modeling, commonsense reasoning, and long-context needle retrieval at $\approx 85\%$ training sparsity and $\approx 38\%$ active decode density. At inference time, we implement a custom decode kernel in Triton that screens KV blocks in $O(1)$ time using cached geometric-probabilistic bounds, delivering up to $2.5\times$ wall-clock decode speedups over FlashAttention-2 on sequences up to 512K tokens. Finally, we introduce an offline calibration algorithm for domain-specific deployments that freezes per-head constant thresholds to eliminate predictor overhead, cutting attention compute by an additional $27\%$.

AI.tldr: 提出弹性阈值注意力（ETA），一种端到端可训练稀疏注意力架构：由查询表示动态预测上下文阈值，训练时对低于阈值的logits做乘法抑制而非删除，形成平滑注意力下限；推理时以Triton核在O(1)时间筛选KV块，实现长上下文解码加速且保持稠密模型质量。
AI.motivation: 长上下文解码时海量KV缓存造成严重显存带宽瓶颈。现有稀疏注意力依赖刚性启发式选择性加载，会丢弃必要上下文，导致质量下降。作者希望在不牺牲稠密模型质量的前提下获得硬件加速的解码速度。
AI.method: ETA从查询表示直接预测动态、上下文相关的阈值，对困难检索或推理步骤分配类稠密上下文、对常规token剪枝。训练时对低于阈值的logits做乘法抑制趋向零（而非删除），形成平滑均匀的注意力下限与分布式概率蓄水池；推理时硬剪枝无信息KV块，并吸收GPU粗粒度块选择附带选入的token；同时实现基于缓存几何-概率界的Triton解码核，O(1)时间筛选KV块；另提供离线校准算法，冻结每头常数阈值以消除预测器开销。
AI.result: 1.45B预训练ETA在语言建模、常识推理与长上下文针检索上媲美稠密注意力，训练稀疏度约85%、活跃解码密度约38%。平滑注意力下限使初始token上的局部注意力汇消失。自定义Triton解码核在最长512K token序列上相较FlashAttention-2实现最高2.5倍墙钟解码加速。离线校准进一步削减注意力计算27%。
AI.conclusion: ETA通过可学习的动态阈值与乘法式软抑制训练策略，兼顾稀疏效率与稠密质量；结合定制GPU内核与离线校准，可在长上下文场景实现显著解码加速，并适用于领域特定部署。

title: Continuous Delayed-Memory Stochastic Gradient Descent and Continuous-Time Reinforcement Learning from History of Astrophysical Time Series Studies
comment: Keywords: Stochastic process, Stochastic gradient descent, Continuous-Delayed-Memory Stochastic Gradient Descent, Stochastic Delay Differential Equation, Reinforcement Learning, Adjoint method
summary: Quasars are luminous objects in the universe that exhibit stochastic brightness variations encoding information about the supermassive black holes powering them, and modeling these variations from ground-based survey data time series, known as light curves, is a statistical challenge. This paper reviews how stochastic differential equations (SDEs) have been adapted with neural network parameterizations to overcome this challenge in history. We create the Continuous-Delayed-Memory Stochastic Gradient Descent which depend on the past state of the discrete iteration process. We performed the simulation on some 2-dimensional landscape and observed some wider-exploration and more precise convergent behavior compared to Vanilla SGD by adjusting hyperparameters. Besides, we proposed a reinforcement learning structure with continuous time policy gradients for exploratory policies without solving HJB PDE, and we show that its optimality conditions recover the Gibbs policy of previous works.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了将随机微分方程（SDE）与神经网络参数化结合用于类星体光变曲线建模的历史，并提出一种依赖离散迭代过程历史状态的连续延迟记忆随机梯度下降（Continuous-Delayed-Memory SGD），在二维景观仿真中相较Vanilla SGD展现出更广的探索与更精确的收敛；同时提出一种无需求解HJB偏微分方程的连续时间策略梯度强化学习结构，并证明其最优性条件可恢复已有工作中的Gibbs策略。
AI.motivation: 类星体亮度呈随机变化，承载着其背后超大质量黑洞的信息；从地基巡天观测得到的光变曲线时间序列中建模这些随机变化是一个统计难题，需要借助SDE与神经网络参数化等手段加以解决。
AI.method: 1）回顾SDE结合神经网络参数化用于类星体光变曲线建模的发展历程；2）提出Continuous-Delayed-Memory SGD，其更新依赖于离散迭代过程的过去状态；3）在若干二维景观上进行仿真，并通过调节超参数与Vanilla SGD对比；4）提出一种采用连续时间策略梯度的强化学习结构，用于探索性策略且无需求解HJB偏微分方程，并分析其最优性条件。
AI.result: 在二维景观仿真中，通过调整超参数，Continuous-Delayed-Memory SGD相比Vanilla SGD表现出更广泛的探索行为和更精确的收敛性能；所提出的连续时间策略梯度强化学习结构的最优性条件可恢复前人工作得到的Gibbs策略。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，将SDE与神经网络参数化结合是应对类星体光变曲线统计建模挑战的有效途径，且带延迟记忆的SGD与连续时间策略梯度方法在优化与强化学习层面具有理论联系与实用价值。

title: Do Quantum Models Scale Like LLMs?
summary: In this work, we study the neural scaling laws of RydbergGPT, an autoregressive transformer model trained on qubit projective measurement data gathered from interacting Rydberg atom arrays. The quantum system is known to exhibit a finite-size remnant of a critical point as the laser detuning parameter is varied. We find that near the critical point the transformer loss as a function of training dataset size is well described by a power-law with a loss floor correction. However, away from criticality the quality of the power-law description is substantially reduced. We then compare the statistical structure of both Rydberg measurements and natural-language corpora using an entropy-normalised, finite sample corrected mutual information "two-point" function. We find that near-critical statistics of the two point functions are closest to those observed in natural-language, whilst other qubit configurations far from the critical point have two-point functions that decay more rapidly. This supports the hypothesis that multi-scale dependence contributes to stable neural scaling, and that scaling behaviour should be viewed as a property of the model-data pair.

AI.tldr: 本文研究RydbergGPT（基于Rydberg原子阵列量子比特投影测量数据训练的自回归Transformer）的神经标度律，发现标度行为依赖于模型-数据对：临界点附近损失与数据集规模呈带损失下限修正的幂律，远离临界点时幂律描述显著变差。
AI.motivation: 神经标度律通常被视为模型的固有属性，但标度行为是否依赖于训练数据本身的统计结构尚不清楚。作者希望借助具有可调控临界性的量子多体系统，检验数据统计特性（尤其是多尺度依赖性）对稳定神经标度的贡献。
AI.method: 以交互Rydberg原子阵列的量子比特投影测量数据训练自回归Transformer（RydbergGPT），通过改变激光失谐参数使系统处于临界点附近或远离临界点；测量不同数据集规模下的测试损失并拟合幂律（含损失下限修正）；同时使用熵归一化、有限采样校正的互信息"两点"函数，比较Rydberg测量数据与自然语言语料的统计结构。
AI.result: 临界点附近，损失随训练集规模呈带损失下限修正的幂律；远离临界点时幂律拟合质量大幅下降。两点函数分析显示，临界附近的两点函数衰减特征与自然语言最为接近，而远离临界点的量子比特构型其两点函数衰减更快。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度依赖性有助于稳定的神经标度行为，神经标度律应被视为模型-数据对的联合属性，而非仅由模型决定的性质。

title: When AI Reviews Train AI Reviewers: Scientific-Judgment Collapse and Mitigation
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) increasingly participate in scientific evaluation, both as automated reviewers and as assistants to human reviewers. As model-generated reviews enter public data and future training corpora, AI peer review can become recursive: later reviewers learn from judgments produced by earlier models. We study one step of this feedback loop in a controlled setting. Starting from Llama 3.1 8B, we first fine-tune a reviewer on official ICLR reviews from 2018--2023 and then train four successor models on ICLR 2024 data with systematically varied mixtures of official and model-generated reviews. Our study shows that introducing synthetic reviews compresses rating distributions and reduces both same-paper and corpus-level semantic diversity. We call this pattern $\textbf{scientific-judgment collapse}$.
  To mitigate this failure mode, we introduce $\textbf{TrustReviewer}$, an open-source LLM-based system for generating peer reviews of AI and machine learning papers. TrustReviewer intervenes at two complementary stages. For training-time prevention, we train the core reviewer in a single stage on a curated corpus designed to reduce low-quality and semantically degenerate supervision. For test-time correction, paired activation steering aims to further mitigate residual tendencies toward collapsed judgments without further training or additional expert annotation. Together, these results characterize a concrete risk of recursive reviewer training and provide practical interventions for preserving judgment diversity and improving recommendation alignment in AI-assisted scientific evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该研究识别出LLM参与同行评审时的"科学判断坍塌"现象，并提出TrustReviewer系统加以缓解。
AI.motivation: LLM日益参与科学评审，模型生成的评审意见会进入公开数据与未来训练语料，导致AI评审可能形成递归反馈循环——后续评审者会学习先前模型产生的判断。作者希望研究这一反馈环路中的单步效应及其风险。
AI.method: 受控实验：以Llama 3.1 8B为起点，先在2018–2023年ICLR官方评审上微调出评审模型，再用ICLR 2024数据训练四个后继模型，并系统变化官方评审与模型生成评审的混合比例。缓解方案TrustReviewer采用两阶段干预：训练期在精选语料上单阶段训练核心评审模型以减少低质量与语义退化监督；测试期使用配对激活引导（paired activation steering）抑制残余的坍塌倾向，无需再训练或额外专家标注。
AI.result: 引入合成评审会压缩评分分布，并降低同篇论文内与语料库级别的语义多样性，作者称之为"科学判断坍塌"（scientific-judgment collapse）。
AI.conclusion: 递归评审训练存在具体风险；TrustReviewer的训练期预防与测试期纠正能在无需额外训练或标注的情况下，帮助保持判断多样性并改善推荐对齐。

title: Efficient Bayes-Adaptive Reinforcement Learning with Temporal Logic Specifications
comment: ©~2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media, including reprinting/republishing this material for advertising or promotional purposes, creating new collective works, for resale or redistribution to servers or lists, or reuse of any copyrighted component of this work in other works
summary: We present a novel end-to-end model-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithm for efficient policy synthesis under given Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) specifications (e.g., safety or reachability) in unknown environments. To do so, a Limit-Deterministic B{ü}chi Automaton (LDBA) representation of the LTL task is synchronised with a Bayes-Adaptive Markov Decision Process (BAMDP) representation of the environment, which allows us to leverage an enhanced exploration-exploitation trade-off that is achieved via Bayesian RL, as opposed to traditional non-Bayesian approaches. We further propose a novel Bayes-Adaptive Monte-Carlo Planning (BAMCP) algorithm to allow for approximate Bayes-optimal strategy synthesis in the synchronised BAMDP construct. A range of finite- and infinite-horizon task experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in terms of both property satisfaction and sample efficiency, when compared to traditional model-free approaches. Additional ablation studies also successfully highlight the value of the novel BAMCP algorithm in comparison to classical BAMCP for LTL task satisfaction. Finally, we also showcase a successful application of our approach for \textit{cautious} RL, namely to reduce the number of task violations incurred during policy training.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于模型的端到端强化学习算法，将LTL任务转化为LDBA并与BAMDP环境表示同步，配合新型BAMCP算法实现未知环境中高效策略合成。
AI.motivation: 在未知环境中，针对给定LTL规范（如安全性或可达性）进行策略合成时，传统非贝叶斯方法探索-利用权衡不佳，且无模型方法样本效率低、易产生任务违规，亟需更高效的端到端方案。
AI.method: 将LTL任务的LDBA表示与环境的BAMDP表示进行同步，借助贝叶斯RL获得更优的探索-利用权衡；并进一步提出一种新型贝叶斯自适应蒙特卡洛规划（BAMCP）算法，在同步后的BAMDP结构上进行近似贝叶斯最优策略合成。
AI.result: 在多种有限与无限时域任务实验中，方法在性质满足度和样本效率上均优于传统无模型方法；消融研究验证了新型BAMCP相较经典BAMCP对LTL任务满足的优势；并成功应用于“谨慎”RL以减少训练中的任务违规次数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，通过LDBA与BAMDP同步并结合定制化的贝叶斯自适应蒙特卡洛规划，可在未知环境中实现高效、样本友好的LTL策略合成，并可用于减少任务违规。

title: From Switching to Dynamic Regret: A Simple Reduction via Unbiased Random Sequences
summary: In non-stationary online learning, dynamic regret has attracted increasing attention as a measure of how well an online learner performs against a time-varying comparator sequence. Despite considerable advances, attaining optimal bounds for strongly convex and exp-concave losses often involves intricate analysis. In this paper, we present a \textit{simple} framework that reduces dynamic regret minimization to switching regret minimization. As a result, we can derive dynamic regret bounds by using off-the-shelf algorithms with switching regret guarantees. The key idea of our reduction is to construct, for \textit{any} comparator sequence, an auxiliary random sequence that is unbiased at each round, with the controlled variance and a manageable number of switches. Combining this construction with suitable surrogate losses, we can decompose dynamic regret into the expected switching regret against the random sequence and its controlled variance. Theoretically, for strongly convex and exp-concave losses, we establish the $\widetilde{O}(T^{1/3}P_T^{2/3})$ dynamic regret bounds, where $T$ denotes the time horizon and $P_T$ denotes the path-length of the comparator sequence. Moreover, for general convex losses, the same reduction also recovers the $O(\sqrt{T(1+P_T)})$ dynamic regret bound. Notably, all our findings match the minimax optimal results for these three types of losses, highlighting the versatility of our proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个将动态遗憾最小化归约为切换遗憾最小化的简单框架，通过构造无偏辅助随机序列，统一导出强凸、指数凹及一般凸损失下的最优动态遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 在非平稳在线学习中，动态遗憾是衡量学习器相对时变比较器序列表现的重要指标。针对强凸与指数凹损失，现有达到最优界的分析往往复杂繁琐，缺乏简洁统一的处理方式。
AI.method: 作者提出一个归约框架：对任意比较器序列构造一个每轮无偏、方差受控且切换次数可控的辅助随机序列；结合合适的替代损失，将动态遗憾分解为对该随机序列的期望切换遗憾与其受控方差两部分，从而可利用现成的具有切换遗憾保证的算法推导动态遗憾界。
AI.result: 对强凸和指数凹损失，得到 $\widetilde{O}(T^{1/3}P_T^{2/3})$ 的动态遗憾界；对一般凸损失，同一归约恢复 $O(\sqrt{T(1+P_T)})$ 的动态遗憾界。上述结果均与相应三类损失的极小极大最优结果相匹配。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明动态遗憾最小化可简洁地归约到切换遗憾最小化，利用现成算法即可获得最优界，凸显了所提框架的通用性与简洁性。

title: Generative inversion for early ranking of competing geologic interpretations
summary: High-consequence subsurface decisions are often made under severe data scarcity. Experts may arrive at competing interpretations of the same subsurface system, yet early in a project there is rarely a practical way to determine which one is most realistic. This uncertainty can persist until several wells are drilled, often costing millions of dollars. Existing approaches for evaluating geologic interpretations rely either on subjective judgment or on dense data that are rarely available in early-stage investigations. We present a workflow that addresses this challenge by translating competing geologic interpretations into alternative spatial priors and ranking them according to their consistency with hydraulic-head observations. For each interpretation, a text-to-image foundation model generates an ensemble of 1600 geologic images, and a separately trained variational autoencoder provides an interpretation-specific latent representation. A supervised inverse network maps the head observations into this latent space, and the frozen decoder produces an image that is mapped to a log-conductivity field. Steady-state flow simulation then provides predicted heads, and the resulting mismatch is converted into a Gaussian-form compatibility score. We evaluate the framework using a synthetic benchmark based on the Johansen Formation and three interpretations of decreasing consistency with the reference representation. Across 925 test cases, the mean head RMSE increases from 0.197 for the Precise \& Accurate interpretation to 0.227 for the Accurate interpretation and 0.280 for the Mismatched interpretation. We subsequently apply the workflow to two published conceptual models of the Culebra Dolomite Member at the Waste Isolation Pilot Plant. The revised model receives a compatibility weight of 0.991, compared with 0.009 for the original model, consistent with the independent evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出将竞争性地质解释转化为空间先验，并用水头观测一致性进行排序的工作流，结合文本到图像基础模型、变分自编码器与反演网络，在合成基准与真实场址概念模型上实现定量判别。
AI.motivation: 高后果地下决策常在严重数据稀缺条件下做出，专家对同一地下系统可能给出相互竞争的解释，而项目早期缺乏实用手段判断哪种解释最接近真实。此类不确定性往往要等到钻进多口井后才能消解，代价常达数百万美元。现有评估地质解释的方法要么依赖主观判断，要么依赖早期调查中罕见的密集数据。
AI.method: 1) 将竞争性地质解释翻译为不同的空间先验；2) 对每种解释，用文本到图像基础模型生成1600张地质图像集成，并单独训练一个变分自编码器提供该解释专属的潜表示；3) 用监督反演网络将水头观测映射到该潜空间，由冻结解码器输出图像并映射为对数导水系数场；4) 进行稳态流动模拟得到预测水头，将失配转换为高斯型相容性得分，据此对解释排序。
AI.result: 在基于Johansen组、包含三种一致性递减解释的合成基准上，925个测试案例的平均水头RMSE从"Precise & Accurate"解释的0.197升至"Accurate"的0.227，再到"Mismatched"的0.280。随后应用于WIPP场址Culebra白云岩段两个已发表概念模型，修订模型相容性权重为0.991，原模型为0.009，与独立证据一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作流能在数据稀缺的早期阶段将竞争性地质解释转化为可定量比较的空间先验，并通过水头观测的一致性实现客观排序，为高后果地下决策提供实用判别依据，且在合成与真实场址案例中均得到验证。

title: ASGARD: Action-Space Guard for UAV Resilience via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) controllers have been recently adopted for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) navigation and control. However, they are susceptible to action-space attacks that overwrite the action commands after the policy generates them and before the actuators execute them. While most existing defenses target attacks on the policy's inputs, those addressing action-space attacks retrain the policy at training time and are not resilient to corrupted actions at runtime. We propose ASGARD, a two-phase teacher-student pipeline for making RL-based UAV control resilient to action-space attacks. In the teacher phase, an encoder combines the UAV's physical state with action-attack-related privileged information to produce an action-attack-aware latent that trains the RL control policy and a monitor that outputs corrected action commands to the actuators. In the student phase, both the encoder and the monitor are trained via supervised learning from their teacher counterparts to run on-board using only the UAV's physical state history. We evaluate ASGARD across attack scenarios targeting different action commands on UAV. We find that ASGARD is resilient to action-space attacks and completes the missions despite the attack. We further find that ASGARD generalizes to unseen attacks and remains resilient against stealthy attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出 ASGARD 两阶段“教师-学生”框架，使基于强化学习的无人机控制在运行时能抵御动作空间攻击，保证任务完成。
AI.motivation: 强化学习控制器已用于无人机导航与控制，但易受动作空间攻击——攻击者在策略生成动作之后、执行器执行之前篡改动作指令。现有防御多针对策略输入攻击，而针对动作空间攻击的方法需在训练时重训策略，无法在运行时应对被篡改的动作。
AI.method: ASGARD 采用教师-学生两阶段流水线。教师阶段：编码器将无人机物理状态与动作攻击相关特权信息融合，生成“动作攻击感知”的隐表示，用于训练强化学习控制策略以及一个向执行器输出修正动作指令的监控器。学生阶段：编码器与监控器通过监督学习从教师模型蒸馏，仅依赖无人机物理状态历史即可在机载运行。
AI.result: 在针对无人机不同动作指令的多类攻击场景下评估：ASGARD 对动作空间攻击具有韧性，在攻击存在时仍能完成任务；且能泛化到未见攻击类型，并对隐蔽性攻击保持韧性。
AI.conclusion: ASGARD 通过特权信息蒸馏与运行时监控修正，弥补了现有动作空间防御需训练时重训、无法运行时防护的不足，实现无人机强化学习控制的运行时动作攻击韧性，并具备泛化性与隐蔽攻击防御能力。

title: From Stress to Affect: Multimodal Deep Learning for Physiological Emotion Recognition Across Wearable Sensor Modalities
summary: Physiological emotion recognition using wearable sensors has important applications in mental health monitoring, affective computing, and human-computer interaction. However, existing studies typically evaluate a single model, sensing configuration, or dataset, limiting our understanding of how these factors influence recognition performance. We present a comparative study of temporal deep learning architectures for physiological emotion recognition using two multimodal wearable datasets: WESAD and EmoWear. Bidirectional long short-term memory (LSTM), temporal convolutional network (TCN), and Transformer models are evaluated under wrist-only, chest-only, and multimodal sensing configurations using participant-independent leave-one-subject-out cross-validation (LOSO-CV). We also investigate soft-voting ensembles, sensor ablation, sampling frequency, and gradient-based saliency. The Transformer achieved the highest multimodal accuracy on WESAD (99.02% +/- 0.51%), whereas the LSTM achieved the best multimodal accuracy on EmoWear for both arousal (91.80% +/- 1.06%) and valence (89.96% +/- 0.36%). These results show that relative architecture performance depends on dataset characteristics rather than one architecture being uniformly superior. Multimodal sensing consistently outperformed wrist-only and chest-only configurations across both datasets. Sampling-frequency analysis showed that 4 Hz provides a practical operating point, with performance comparable to higher frequencies at substantially lower training cost. These findings provide guidance for selecting architectures, sensing modalities, and sampling frequencies for wearable physiological emotion recognition.

AI.tldr: 比较研究：在WESAD与EmoWear双模态可穿戴数据集上评估Bi-LSTM、TCN与Transformer，发现架构优劣依赖数据集特性，多模态传感优于单部位，4 Hz为实用采样频率。
AI.motivation: 现有生理情感识别研究通常只评估单一模型、传感配置或数据集，难以理解这些因素如何影响识别性能，缺少系统性的横向对比。
AI.method: 在WESAD与EmoWear两个多模态可穿戴数据集上，对双向LSTM、时序卷积网络（TCN）和Transformer进行对比；在仅手腕、仅胸部与多模态三种传感配置下，采用被试独立留一被试交叉验证（LOSO-CV）评估；并考察软投票集成、传感器消融、采样频率与基于梯度的显著性分析。
AI.result: Transformer在WESAD多模态上取得最高准确率（99.02% ± 0.51%）；LSTM在EmoWear上取得最佳多模态表现，唤醒度91.80% ± 1.06%、效价89.96% ± 0.36%。架构相对性能取决于数据集特性，不存在普遍最优架构。多模态传感在两个数据集上均稳定优于仅手腕和仅胸部配置。采样频率分析表明4 Hz是实用工作点，性能与更高频率相当但训练成本显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 可穿戴生理情感识别中架构选择应结合数据集特性，优先采用多模态传感，并在精度与成本间折中时选择约4 Hz采样频率，为模型、模态与采样率的选择提供实践指导。

title: MOSAIC-SR: Transformer-Guided Symbolic Regression for Scientific Equation Recovery
summary: Symbolic regression aims to recover closed-form equations from observations, providing interpretable models for scientific discovery. Existing approaches struggle to combine flexible structural search with efficient inference. Search-based methods can refine expression structure but often rely on costly combinatorial optimization with random initialization. Pretrained neural models generate formulas almost instantly, but their predictions often contain symbolic errors. We introduce MOSAIC-SR, which uses a pretrained Transformer to propose multiple initial sketches. These sketches initialize searches in several promising regions, avoiding random starts in the vast expression space. Each search jointly recovers structure and constants through scale-aware constant optimization and local symbolic repair. We evaluate MOSAIC-SR on the SRSD-Feynman dataset with and without dummy variables and on six additional benchmarks. MOSAIC-SR obtains the highest symbolic solution rate on every dataset while ranking among the top two methods in predictive accuracy. This advantage persists in the presence of irrelevant dummy inputs. The results show that learned priors can focus search on promising equation structures, and that numerical optimization and symbolic repair are important for recovery.

AI.tldr: MOSAIC-SR结合预训练Transformer生成多个初始表达式草图来初始化搜索，并通过尺度感知常数优化与局部符号修复联合恢复结构，在多数据集上取得最高符号解率。
AI.motivation: 符号回归需从观测中恢复闭式方程以获得可解释模型。现有方法难以兼顾灵活的结构搜索与高效推理：基于搜索的方法结构可调但依赖昂贵组合优化与随机初始化；预训练神经模型生成快但常含符号错误。
AI.method: 用预训练Transformer提出多个初始草图，在若干有前景区域初始化搜索以规避广阔表达式空间中的随机起点；每个搜索通过尺度感知常数优化与局部符号修复联合恢复结构与常数。
AI.result: 在含/不含虚拟变量的SRSD-Feynman数据集及六个额外基准上评估，MOSAIC-SR在每个数据集上符号解率最高，预测精度位列前二；存在无关虚拟输入时优势依然保持。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的先验可将搜索聚焦于有前景的方程结构，数值优化与符号修复对恢复至关重要。

title: On the Limits of Maximal Coding Rate Reduction for Out-of-Distribution Generalisation
summary: Substantial efforts have been devoted to making deep learning objectives, representations, and architectures interpretable, with the goal of improving the safety, robustness, and generalisation of learning systems in diverse real-world applications. The recently proposed maximal coding rate reduction ($\mathrm{MCR}^{2}$) offers a promising information-theoretic framework for learning structured, discriminative representations of class-wise submanifolds and has inspired interpretable white-box architectures. However, we observe that $\mathrm{MCR}^{2}$ can completely fail under distribution shift, motivating our study of its out-of-distribution (OOD) generalisation limits. We establish two limitations of $\mathrm{MCR}^{2}$ for OOD generalisation. First, the $\mathrm{MCR}^{2}$ objective alone can admit complete prediction failure: a representation based entirely on unstable environmental features can achieve the global coding optimum yet fail completely after correlation reversal, despite an available perfectly stable feature. This exact-optimum example includes test inputs that cannot occur during training. Even when every possible test input can also occur during training, coding quality can be arbitrarily close to optimal while prediction error is arbitrarily close to 100%. Second, directly incorporating the invariance principle underlying widely successful invariant risk minimisation (IRM) and risk extrapolation (REx) does not eliminate this failure. The failing representation admits the same optimal coding operator across training environments, showing that shared coding optimality does not ensure stable prediction. Reliable OOD guarantees for $\mathrm{MCR}^{2}$ therefore require additional new assumptions or learning principles that establish stable predictive relationships across environments.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了最大编码率约简（MCR²）目标在分布偏移下可能完全失效，证明其编码最优并不保证稳定的预测关系。
AI.motivation: MCR²作为信息论框架，被认为能学习结构化、判别性的表征并支持可解释白盒架构，但作者观察到它在分布偏移下会彻底失败，因此需要研究其分布外泛化的根本局限。
AI.method: 通过构造极端反例并进行理论分析：一是构造仅依赖不稳定环境特征即可达到全局编码最优、却在相关性反转后预测完全失败的精确最优解；二是分析在训练中所有测试输入均可出现的条件下编码质量任意接近最优而错误率接近100%的情形；三是检验引入IRM与REx所依据的不变性原理能否消除该失败。
AI.result: MCR²存在两个OOD泛化局限：第一，仅用MCR²目标可容许完全预测失败，失败表征在所有训练环境中共享相同最优编码算子；第二，直接融入IRM和REx的不变性原理无法消除该失败，说明共享编码最优性不蕴含稳定预测。
AI.conclusion: MCR²要实现可靠的OOD保证，需要引入能跨环境建立稳定预测关系的新假设或学习原则，单纯依赖编码最优性或现成不变性原理并不充分。

title: Stiefel-AdamW: Geometry-Aware AdamW for Linear Factorization Blocks
summary: A pervasive structural pattern in modern deep learning is the linear factorization block: a submodule of the form $W = BA$ in which two parameter matrices are multiplied directly, with no intervening nonlinearity. Such blocks appear in LoRA adapters, low-rank compressed layers, query-key products of self-attention, and share a common pathology: the factorization is non-unique, which can destabilize training and limit usable learning rates. Despite this, factorization blocks are typically optimized with standard Euclidean methods that ignore the underlying geometry. We introduce Stiefel-AdamW, a near drop-in replacement for AdamW for use wherever such blocks appear. By constraining one factor on the Stiefel manifold while leaving the other Euclidean, Stiefel-AdamW relaxes the full $\mathrm{GL}(\mathbb{R}^r)$ gauge symmetry to a compact orthogonal symmetry, ruling out factor blow-up while retaining the coordinate-wise diagonal preconditioning that gives AdamW its practical strength. Moment estimation is performed in the ambient Euclidean space, with geometry entering only through a tangent-space projection and a manifold retraction. The implementation overhead over AdamW is minimal, and we show that the resulting optimizer inherits both the stability benefits of Riemannian methods and standard convergence guarantees. We validate Stiefel-AdamW on LoRA-style fine-tuning of GPT2, ViT, and Mistral 7B and on full pretraining of GPT2 on OpenWebText, showing consistent improvements over strong baselines at essentially no additional cost over AdamW.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Stiefel-AdamW：在含线性分解块 W=BA 的模块上，将其中一个因子约束到 Stiefel 流形，把 GL(r) 规范对称性约化为紧正交对称性，从而在保留 AdamW 逐坐标对角预条件的同时消除因子膨胀。
AI.motivation: 现代深度学习中的线性分解块（如 LoRA、低秩压缩层、自注意力中的 query-key 乘积）普遍存在分解非唯一性，即 GL(r) 规范对称性，可能导致训练不稳定并限制可用学习率。然而此类模块通常仍使用忽略底层几何结构的欧氏优化方法（如 AdamW），存在方法错配。
