AI.method: 提出 Stiefel-AdamW，作为 AdamW 的近似即插即用替代：对一个因子施加 Stiefel 流形约束，另一个因子保持欧氏。矩估计仍在环境欧氏空间中进行，几何仅通过切空间投影与流形回缩进入；由此将 GL(r) 规范对称性松弛为紧正交对称性，同时保留 AdamW 的逐坐标对角预条件。实现开销极小。
AI.result: 理论上证明该优化器兼具 Riemannian 方法的稳定性优势与标准收敛保证。实验上在 GPT2、ViT、Mistral 7B 的 LoRA 式微调，以及 GPT2 在 OpenWebText 上的完整预训练中，相比强基线取得一致提升，且相比 AdamW 几乎无额外成本。
AI.conclusion: Stiefel-AdamW 是一种在含线性分解块场景中几乎零额外开销、可直接替换 AdamW 的优化器，通过流形几何约束有效消除因子膨胀、提升训练稳定性，并在多任务上验证了一致收益。

title: A Lightweight Plug-in Gate for Transformer-Based Time-Series Forecasters
summary: Covariate-rich time-series forecasting requires deciding how external variables enter the target forecasting path. Existing Transformer-based forecasters usually build a covariate representation and pass it to the encoder without an explicit admission stage. This paper studies pre-encoder covariate admission as an input-side interface that regulates that representation immediately before encoder processing. We implement the interface with a lightweight representation-level pre-encoder gate that assigns sigmoid scores to representation units, and we also study a usage-regularized variant that penalizes average admission. The interface is evaluated as a plug-in module for TimeXer, Inverted Transformer (iTransformer), and Patch Time Series Transformer (PatchTST) under a zero-extra-tuning protocol, where each gated model inherits the corresponding baseline configuration. Experiments on the Electricity Transformer Temperature minute-level (ETTm1 and ETTm2) datasets, Traffic, Energy, and influenza-like illness (ILI) include paired forecasting comparisons, gate-placement ablation, initialization ablation, controlled covariate-admission analysis, and a variance inflation factor (VIF)-informed permutation feature importance (PFI) diagnostic case study. In the tested settings, the gate is competitive with the corresponding baselines, and the usage penalty reduces average admission scores while keeping forecasting errors close to the unpenalized TimeXer setting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"编码器前协变量准入"作为输入端接口，用轻量级表示级门控（sigmoid评分）调节协变量表示后再送入编码器，并作为插件模块在TimeXer、iTransformer、PatchTST上以零额外调参协议评估。
AI.motivation: 协变量丰富的时间序列预测中，外部变量如何进入目标预测路径是关键问题；现有Transformer类预测器通常直接构建协变量表示并送入编码器，缺少显式的"准入"阶段。
AI.method: 在编码器前实现表示级轻量门控接口，对表示单元分配sigmoid分数，并研究对平均准入施加惩罚的使用正则化变体；以插件形式接入TimeXer、iTransformer、PatchTST，采用零额外调参协议继承各自基线配置。
AI.result: 在ETTm1、ETTm2、Traffic、Energy和ILI数据集上开展配对预测对比、门控位置消融、初始化消融、受控协变量准入分析及VIF-informed PFI诊断案例研究；在测试设置下门控与对应基线具有竞争力，使用惩罚降低了平均准入分数且预测误差接近未惩罚的TimeXer设置。
AI.conclusion: 编码器前协变量准入可作为有效且易插拔的输入端接口，在几乎不损失预测精度的情况下实现对协变量表示的显式调控，并可通过使用正则化压缩不必要的准入。

title: FedeRage: Provably Convergent Agnostic Federated Learning under General Client Drift
summary: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without sharing raw data, but its performance degrades under non-IID data and stochastic client participation. Remedies built on classical Federated Averaging (FedAvg) typically presuppose that client participation probabilities are known to the server, which is rarely the case in deployed systems. We first discuss and then characterize the optimization problem that \emph{distributionally agnostic} FedAvg actually solves when participation is entirely unknown, possibly highly skewed, and of variable size across rounds: uniform aggregation is shown to minimize a well-defined stochastic objective, weighted by the participation-induced marginal, at a standard $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ rate for convex and possibly nonsmooth losses. Building on this characterization, we propose \emph{Federated Risk-Averse Averaging} (\textsc{FedeRage}), a risk-averse extension of FedAvg that embeds the \emph{Conditional Value-at-Risk} (CVaR) into the local objective within a natural distributionally robust optimization (DRO) framework. \textsc{FedeRage} implicitly upweights high-loss and infrequently participating clients while adding only a \emph{single scalar per-client}, and admits an $\mathcal{O}(κ/\sqrt{T})$ rate in which the factor $κ$ is the upper bound on the ``price" of risk aversion. In contrast with aggregation-alignment schemes based on optimal transport, which require the availability distribution as an input, \textsc{FedeRage} remains agnostic to it. Several experiments on three heterogeneous benchmarks indicate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods in accuracy, fairness, and convergence speed.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画了在客户端参与概率完全未知时FedAvg实际求解的优化问题，并提出将CVaR嵌入本地目标的联邦风险规避平均算法FedeRage，仅需每客户端一个标量即可提升精度、公平性与收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在非独立同分布数据和随机客户端参与下性能下降。现有基于FedAvg的补救方法通常假设服务器已知客户端参与概率，而这在实际部署中很少成立。
AI.method: 首先刻画"分布不可知"FedAvg在参与未知、可能高度偏斜且各轮规模可变时实际求解的优化问题，证明均匀聚合最小化一个由参与诱导边际加权的随机目标，凸且可能非光滑时达O(1/√T)速率。基于该刻画提出FedeRage，在自然DRO框架下将CVaR嵌入本地目标，隐式提升高损失与低参与频率客户端的权重，仅增加每客户端单个标量。
AI.result: FedeRage具有O(κ/√T)速率，κ为风险规避"代价"的上界；与需要可用性分布作为输入的最优传输聚合对齐方案不同，FedeRage对分布保持不可知。在三个异构基准上，精度、公平性和收敛速度一致优于最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: FedeRage在无需知晓参与分布的前提下实现了风险规避的联邦聚合，理论速率与实验表现均具优势。

title: Toward individual-level calibration in affect recognition with perceptual adjustment queries
comment: 14 pages, 13 figures. Accepted as a poster at IEEE ACII 2026
summary: Behavioral tasks measuring facial affect perception assume that identical stimuli impose equivalent perceptual difficulty across participants. However, this assumption is systematically violated by individual differences in perceptual sensitivity. Using an affective perception task as our testbed, we propose a framework to normalize for perceptual difficulty that directly estimates each participant's Just Noticeable Difference (JND) along the facial affect spectrum via cognitively lightweight perceptual adjustment queries (PAQs). We use these PAQ-inferred JNDs to re-express stimulus distances, constructing difficulty-equated tasks in perceptual space. We validate the framework in a Two-Alternative Forced-Choice (2AFC) task using two complementary behavioral measures: binary metacognitive difficulty judgments and response time variance decomposition. We find that PAQ calibration significantly equalizes perceived task difficulty at an individual level when compared to both the non-calibrated baseline and population-level Weibull calibration, while also reducing mean response time and between-subject variance in response time. These results establish PAQ as a principled and practical instrument for individualized perceptual calibration in facial affect recognition.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出用轻量级知觉调整查询（PAQ）估计个体JND，将刺激距离重表达到知觉空间以构建难度等化的面部情感任务，并在2AFC中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 行为任务通常假设相同刺激对所有被试具有相同知觉难度，但个体知觉敏感性差异会系统性破坏该假设，导致任务难度不等化。
AI.method: 以情感知觉任务为测试平台，通过认知轻量的知觉调整查询（PAQ）直接估计每位被试在面部情感谱上的最小可觉差（JND），并用推断的JND重表达刺激距离，在知觉空间中构建难度等化任务；在二选一强迫选择（2AFC）任务中，以二元元认知难度判断和反应时方差分解两种互补行为指标进行验证。
AI.result: 与非校准基线和群体级Weibull校准相比，PAQ校准在个体水平显著等化知觉任务难度，同时降低平均反应时和反应时的被试间方差。
AI.conclusion: PAQ可作为面部情感识别中个体化知觉校准的原则性且实用的工具。

title: REFINEPPO: Learning Continuous Control Policies by Iterative Action Refinement
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has achieved strong performance across a wide range of continuous-control problems. These continuous-control policies, however, are often defined as direct mappings from an observed state to an action or action distribution, requiring a single feed-forward network to construct an optimal control decision in one pass. While effective, this formulation leaves little opportunity for the policy to reconsider or progressively improve an action once an initial prediction has been formed. In this work, we explore an alternative approach: rather than learning only to directly predict an action, can a policy learn to iteratively improve one, and can this iterative process provide advantages during policy learning? We introduce Iterative Action Refinement (IAR), an iterative action-construction method that constructs control actions through a sequence of learned residual corrections. Starting from an initial proposal, a shared refinement network repeatedly conditions on the observed state and the current action proposal, allowing each refinement step to revise the action constructed by preceding steps. The final refined proposal is then used to determine the action executed by the agent. We integrate this iterative action-construction mechanism with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), yielding REFINEPPO. We evaluate REFINEPPO across 14 benchmark control tasks, complemented by controlled ablations of refinement depth and update schedules and analyses aimed at understanding why iterative refinement is effective. Across these environments, REFINEPPO matches or exceeds the performance of standard PPO while demonstrating faster convergence on several tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出迭代动作精化（IAR）方法，通过共享精化网络对初始动作提案进行多步残差修正，并与PPO结合形成REFINEPPO，在14个连续控制基准上匹配或超越标准PPO，且在多个任务上收敛更快。
AI.motivation: 主流深度强化学习（DRL）连续控制策略通常将策略建模为从状态到动作（或动作分布）的直接映射，需由单次前馈网络一次性构造最优控制决策。这种一次性预测的范式缺乏对动作进行重新考虑或逐步改进的机会，可能限制策略的表达与优化空间。作者因此希望探索：策略能否学习迭代地改进动作，以及这种迭代过程能否在策略学习阶段带来优势。
AI.method: 提出迭代动作精化（IAR）：从初始动作提案出发，使用一个共享的精化网络反复以观测状态与当前动作提案为条件进行残差修正，每一步都可在前序步骤构造的动作基础上进行修订，最终精化提案决定智能体实际执行的动作。将该迭代动作构造机制与近端策略优化（PPO）集成，得到REFINEPPO。实验在14个基准控制任务上评估，并进行了精化深度与更新调度（update schedules）的受控消融，以及旨在解释迭代精化有效性的分析。
AI.result: 在14个基准控制任务上，REFINEPPO的性能与标准PPO相当或更优，并在若干任务上展现出更快的收敛速度。消融实验考察了精化深度和更新调度的影响，并提供了对迭代精化为何有效的分析。
AI.conclusion: 迭代动作构造（而非仅直接预测动作）是一种可行且有效的连续控制策略范式：通过共享精化网络的逐步残差修正，REFINEPPO在不牺牲（甚至提升）性能的同时加快了部分任务的收敛，表明迭代精化能为策略学习带来实质优势。

title: Talk to Me, Jarvis: An Open-Source Edge-Deployable Voice Assistant Framework for Autonomous Racecars
summary: Recent advances in large language models have improved their effectiveness as back-end components for voice assistants, particularly in intent understanding and context-aware input classification. However, online-hosted models introduce network dependency and variable inference latency, limiting their suitability for time-critical autonomous driving applications. In this work, we address these issues by developing Jarvis, an offline voice assistant for high-level behavioral commands of autonomous vehicles. Its architecture integrates speech recognition and synthesis with natural language command classification into a lightweight, local framework. Jarvis core component is a text-to-command classifier, built using a domain-specific fine-tuning of the Mistral 7B model, demonstrating low-latency inference. Our experimental evaluation demonstrates that our solution outperforms larger online-hosted models, achieving 97.63 % intent recognition accuracy with an average processing latency of 1.39 s, making it well-suited for operations requiring quick response times. To support further research and fine-tuning, we provide an open-source implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Jarvis——一个面向自动驾驶车辆高级行为指令的离线语音助手，其核心是基于Mistral 7B领域微调的文转指令分类器，在保证低延迟的同时实现了97.63%的意图识别准确率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型作为语音助手后端组件效果显著，但在线托管模型存在网络依赖和推理延迟波动问题，难以满足自动驾驶等时间关键场景的需求，因此需要一种离线、低延迟的语音助手方案。
AI.method: 构建Jarvis离线语音助手架构，将语音识别、语音合成与自然语言指令分类集成到轻量级本地框架中；核心组件为文转指令分类器，通过对Mistral 7B模型进行领域特定的微调实现低延迟推理。
AI.result: 实验评估表明，该方案优于更大的在线托管模型，意图识别准确率达97.63%，平均处理延迟为1.39秒，适合对响应速度要求较高的操作场景。
AI.conclusion: Jarvis验证了基于小规模本地微调模型构建离线语音助手的可行性，兼顾了准确率与低延迟，并开源实现以支持后续研究与微调。

title: Signal-Centric Remote Sensing via Alternative Preprocessing and Acoustic Processing for ML-Driven Applications
comment: 7 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables. Published in Proc. IEEE SoutheastCon 2025, pp. 1078-1084, doi: 10.1109/SoutheastCon56624.2025.10971547
summary: The dominant method of processing sonar data is using image-based representations, requiring the preprocessing of image data on autonomous systems. We propose an alternative data processing method for remote sensing applications via the use of data in Comma-Seperated Value format. Experimentation on our alternative approach shows a reduction of processing time by 91.18%, an improvement in accurate object detection by Machine Learning, and an increase in SNR (Signal-to-noise ratio), PSNR (Peak signal-to-noise ratio), and other evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用CSV格式数据替代图像化表示来处理声呐数据，实验显示处理时间减少91.18%，机器学习目标检测精度提升，且SNR、PSNR等指标均改善。
AI.motivation: 主流声呐数据处理依赖图像化表示，需要在自主系统上对图像数据进行预处理，计算开销大、效率低，因此作者寻求一种替代性的遥感数据处理方法。
AI.method: 提出一种基于逗号分隔值（CSV）格式数据的数据处理方法，替代传统的图像化表示方式，用于遥感（声呐）应用。摘要未给出更具体的算法、网络结构或实验设置的细节。
AI.result: 实验表明：处理时间减少91.18%；机器学习的目标检测准确率有所提升；信噪比（SNR）、峰值信噪比（PSNR）以及其他评价指标均有提高。
AI.conclusion: 以CSV格式数据直接处理声呐数据是图像化表示方法的有效替代方案，在效率与多项信号质量及检测指标上均表现更优。摘要信息较为简略，方法细节与实验条件有待正文补充。

title: HMB-GAN: Hybrid Multi-Bézier GAN for Vector Shape Synthesis
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Published in the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Quantum Software (QSW)
summary: We explore the use of hybrid quantum-classical generative adversarial networks for synthesising CAD-ready vector geometries. Unlike prior work that operates in rasterised or single-Bézier domains, we introduce HMB-GAN (Hybrid Multi-Bézier GAN), an end-to-end differentiable generative framework that constructs closed shapes through stitched multi-segment Bézier representations with geometric continuity enforced by construction. We compare a quantum-enhanced generator with a classical generator within this architecture and evaluate them across point cloud distribution metrics and geometric shape statistics. Results show that despite faster convergence, a reduction in model parameter count, and slightly improved performance on point cloud metrics, the quantum generator suffers from excessive simulator overhead and thus classically-simulated evaluation suffers from hardware constraints. These results demonstrate the feasibility of modelling structured geometries through hybrid quantum architectures whilst highlighting contemporary hardware limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HMB-GAN，一个端到端可微的混合量子-经典GAN框架，通过拼接多段Bézier表示生成闭合的CAD矢量几何图形，并对比量子增强生成器与经典生成器的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有生成工作多局限于栅格化或单一Bézier域，无法直接生成CAD可用的矢量几何；同时需要探索混合量子-经典架构在结构化几何建模中的可行性。
AI.method: 提出HMB-GAN（Hybrid Multi-Bézier GAN），通过拼接多段Bézier表示构建闭合形状，并由构造过程强制保证几何连续性，形成端到端可微的生成框架；在同一架构下分别实现量子增强生成器与经典生成器进行对比。
AI.result: 量子生成器收敛更快、模型参数量更少，在点云分布度量上略有提升；但模拟器开销过大，导致经典模拟评估受限于硬件约束。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了通过混合量子架构建模结构化几何的可行性，同时凸显了当前硬件条件的局限。

title: M2G-LLM: Enhancing Clinical Prediction via Multimodal Graph Reasoning and LLM Context Injection
summary: Integrating diverse data modalities --- such as clinical notes, laboratory results, and medical imaging --- is essential for advancing clinical decision-making. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable performance in processing unstructured clinical text, their limited capacity to incorporate non-text modalities hinders their broader utility in healthcare applications. Here, we introduce M2G-LLM (Multimodal MedGraph-LLM), a novel framework that enhances LLMs with multimodal integration and alignment via Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). Our approach models temporal relationships between patient visits, propagates information across clinically similar patients, and aligns heterogeneous data sources to construct enriched multimodal context vectors. These vectors are injected into the intermediate layers of the LLM, enabling joint reasoning over textual and non-textual modalities. We evaluate M2G-LLM on the MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-CXR datasets, demonstrating improvements in clinical prediction tasks over strong baseline models. Our results highlight the promise of combining the language understanding of LLMs with the relational reasoning capabilities of GNNs for comprehensive, multimodal healthcare analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出M2G-LLM框架，用图神经网络增强大语言模型，实现多模态医疗数据融合与对齐，并在MIMIC-IV与MIMIC-CXR上取得临床预测性能提升。
AI.motivation: 临床决策需要整合临床笔记、检验结果、医学影像等多种数据模态，而现有大语言模型虽擅长处理非结构化临床文本，却难以纳入非文本模态，限制了其在医疗场景中的应用。
AI.method: M2G-LLM通过图神经网络（GNN）建模患者多次就诊之间的时序关系，在临床相似患者间传播信息，并对异质数据源进行对齐，构建富含信息的多模态上下文向量；这些向量被注入LLM的中间层，从而支持文本与非文本模态的联合推理。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV和MIMIC-CXR数据集上的评估表明，M2G-LLM在临床预测任务上优于强基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM的语言理解能力与GNN的关系推理能力相结合，为全面、多模态的医疗分析提供了有前景的路径。

title: TierKV: Long-Context On-Device LLMs via Predictive Multi-Tier KV Caching
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are moving onto mobile devices for increasingly diverse workloads over text, images, video, and audio. These applications often require long contexts, making the Key-Value (KV) cache a dominant memory bottleneck because it grows linearly with sequence length and is accessed at every decoding step. Prior work reduces KV-cache footprint through low-rank compression, token eviction, or flash offloading, but the resulting reconstruction overhead, irreversible token loss, or I/O stalls can offset the benefit of saving memory. We present TierKV, a mobile LLM inference framework built on Predictive Multi-Tier Cache Optimization (PMCO). Before decoding starts, PMCO predicts future cache demand from prefill hidden states and jointly assigns tokens to exact, low-rank, and flash-offloaded tiers under the device memory and accuracy budgets. This formulation retains access to the full context, removes the circular dependency of reactive eviction, and admits a closed-form solver that selects tier boundaries and per-layer ranks at runtime. Across eight text, vision, and audio models on three mobile SoCs, TierKV improves prefill throughput by up to 17.6x over existing mobile LLM frameworks, reduces RAM-resident KV cache by 12.5-34%, thereby enabling substantially longer contexts under the same memory budget, while incurring only minor accuracy degradation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TierKV 移动端 LLM 推理框架，基于 Predictive Multi-Tier Cache Optimization（PMCO），在解码前预测未来缓存需求并将 token 联合分配到精确、低秩和闪存卸载三层，缓解 KV 缓存内存瓶颈。
AI.motivation: LLM 部署到移动设备后需处理文本、图像、视频、音频等多样负载，且常需长上下文。KV 缓存随序列长度线性增长并在每个解码步被访问，成为主要内存瓶颈。已有方法（低秩压缩、token 驱逐、闪存卸载）分别带来重建开销、不可逆 token 损失或 I/O 停顿，抵消了省内存收益。
AI.method: 提出 Predictive Multi-Tier Cache Optimization（PMCO）：在解码开始前，从 prefill 隐状态预测未来缓存需求，在设备内存和精度预算下将 token 联合分配到精确层、低秩层和闪存卸载层。该建模保留完整上下文访问，消除反应式驱逐的循环依赖，并可用闭式求解器在运行时确定层级边界与每层秩。
AI.result: 在三种移动 SoC 上的八种文本、视觉和音频模型上，TierKV 相比现有移动 LLM 框架将 prefill 吞吐提升最高 17.6 倍，将驻留内存的 KV 缓存减少 12.5–34%，从而在相同内存预算下支持显著更长的上下文，且仅带来轻微精度下降。
AI.conclusion: TierKV 通过预测式多层缓存优化，在可接受的精度损失下显著降低移动端 KV 缓存内存占用并提升 prefill 吞吐，使移动设备在相同内存约束下能处理更长上下文。

title: Reliability-Centered Evaluation of Sparse Longitudinal CT Lesion-Size Forecasting with Conformal Interval Calibration and Gompertz-Inspired Regularization
summary: Sparse longitudinal CT follow-up limits lesion-size forecasting when only a few prior observations are available. We constructed a five-visit DLT-derived same-lesion trajectory benchmark from DeepLesion and Deep Lesion Tracker (DLT), yielding 205 trajectories from 129 patients. We compared an exploratory conventional sparse-to-final analysis with a primary fixed visit-index horizon design predicting the common log change from T3 to T4 while progressively adding earlier observations, evaluating predictive accuracy, uncertainty reliability, post-hoc conformal interval calibration, subgroup performance, and Gompertz-inspired trajectory regularization. The evaluated methods showed partially overlapping point-prediction accuracy but distinct uncertainty behavior. Mean held-out RMSE across ten training seeds was 0.4726, 0.4305, 0.4499, and 0.4513 for m = 1, 2, 3, 4, indicating the lowest mean RMSE at m = 2; additional history did not improve RMSE. At m = 4, raw Cohort-Level Feature GP coverage was near the 95% nominal level, whereas MC Dropout, Deep Ensemble, and residual-scale intervals were conservative. Patient-level conformal calibration generally produced near-nominal or conservative coverage at the cost of wider intervals. Patient-grouped development cross-validation selected lambda* = 0 for the Gompertz-inspired term. A global population reference frequently opposed lesion-level change directions, and prediction difficulty varied across anatomical subgroups. Overall, additional historical observations provided limited predictive benefit once the prediction horizon was controlled, while predictive accuracy, uncertainty reliability, and trajectory consistency did not necessarily improve together, and should be evaluated jointly in sparse longitudinal imaging.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于DeepLesion与DLT构建五访视同病灶轨迹基准（129例患者、205条轨迹），在固定预测时域（T3→T4）下逐步加入早期观测，评估点预测精度、不确定性可靠性、保形校准、亚组表现与Gompertz轨迹正则化。结果显示RMSE在m=2最低，增加历史观测未提升精度；不同方法不确定性行为差异明显，轨迹一致性与精度、可靠性并不协同提升。
AI.motivation: 稀疏纵向CT随访中仅有少量先验观测，使病灶尺寸预测困难；同时现有研究往往孤立评估预测精度与不确定性，缺乏在固定预测时域下对精度、不确定性可靠性、轨迹一致性的联合评估，且缺少标准化的同病灶多访视轨迹基准。
AI.method: 构建五访视DLT衍生同病灶轨迹基准（DeepLesion + Deep Lesion Tracker，205条轨迹/129例患者）。采用固定访视索引时域设计作为主分析，预测T3→T4的常见对数变化，并逐步增加更早观测（m=1,2,3,4）；另做稀疏至终点的探索性分析。评估点预测精度（10个训练种子的留出RMSE）、不确定性可靠性（Cohort-Level Feature GP、MC Dropout、Deep Ensemble、残差尺度区间）、患者级事后保形区间校准、解剖亚组表现，以及Gompertz启发的轨迹正则化（患者分组交叉验证选λ*）。
AI.result: 10个种子平均留出RMSE：m=1为0.4726，m=2为0.4305，m=3为0.4499，m=4为0.4513，m=2最低，增加历史观测未改善RMSE。m=4时原始Cohort-Level Feature GP覆盖接近95%名义水平，而MC Dropout、Deep Ensemble与残差尺度区间偏保守；患者级保形校准总体达到近名义或保守覆盖，但区间更宽。患者分组交叉验证选择Gompertz项λ*=0。全局人群参考常与病灶级变化方向相反，且预测难度随解剖亚组变化。
AI.conclusion: 在控制预测时域后，额外历史观测带来的预测收益有限；预测精度、不确定性可靠性与轨迹一致性未必协同改善，因此在稀疏纵向影像分析中应对三者进行联合评估，而非单独依赖某一指标或单一不确定性方法。

title: MIRCID: Inferred Hub-miRNAs Drive Cross-Task Improvements in Drug Mechanistic Modeling
summary: Drug mechanism-of-action (MoA) modeling commonly relies on perturbational transcriptomes, but matched microRNA (miRNA) measurements are often unavailable. Inferred regulatory features offer a scalable way to reuse these data. Here, we present MIRCID, a framework comparing gene expression with inferred transcription factor (TF) activity and miRNA expression across pathway classification and similarity-based MoA retrieval. HubmiRNet infers 414 pan-cancer hub miRNAs (HubmiRs) from 977 L1000 landmark genes, achieving a Pearson correlation coefficient of 87.72\%; its 1,298-output variant also outperformed SiCmiR on the full-miRNA task (71.21\% versus 67.30\%). In the evaluated comparisons, miRNA augmentation provided more consistent gains than TF activity. Generic embedding controls showed model-dependent utility, while complementarity analyses identified a distinct, partially linearly recoverable representation that retained gene-derived structure. Illustrative rescue cases linked improved classification to biologically plausible miRNA patterns in samples with weak transcriptional signatures. These findings support inferred HubmiRs as a biologically informed recoding of transcriptomic data for perturbational drug modeling, while leaving recovery of measured perturbational miRNA responses to further validation.

AI.tldr: 提出MIRCID框架，利用推断的枢纽miRNA（HubmiR）与TF活性辅助基因表达进行药物机制（MoA）建模。
AI.motivation: 药物MoA建模依赖扰动转录组，但配对的miRNA测量常缺失，需要可扩展的推断性调控特征来复用现有数据。
AI.method: 构建MIRCID框架，在通路分类与基于相似度的MoA检索任务中，对比基因表达、推断的TF活性与推断miRNA表达；HubmiRNet从977个L1000 landmark基因推断414个泛癌枢纽miRNA，并有1,298输出的变体；引入通用嵌入对照与互补性分析。
AI.result: HubmiRNet达到87.72%的Pearson相关系数；1,298输出变体在全miRNA任务上以71.21%优于SiCmiR的67.30%；miRNA增强带来的增益比TF活性更一致；通用嵌入对照的效用依赖模型；识别出保留基因来源结构、可部分线性恢复的独立表征；示例性rescue案例显示弱转录信号样本的分类改善与合理的miRNA模式相关。
AI.conclusion: 推断的HubmiR可作为生物学启发的转录组重编码用于扰动药物建模，但实测扰动miRNA响应的恢复仍需进一步验证。

title: Multi-Subject Pretraining Enables Short-Calibration Personalization for Closed-Corpus Surface EMG Speech Decoding
summary: Surface electromyography (sEMG)-based silent speech interfaces are limited by cross-user variability and calibration burden. We study a limited-data setting in which each of 27 speech-typical participants contributed less than 0.5 h of data (21.3 min on average) across Aloud and Mimed speech. Within a closed 50-sentence corpus, we used leave-one-subject-out evaluation, initializing from a released single-subject checkpoint, pretraining on non-held-out participants, and fine-tuning on the target participant. This pipeline achieved 21.7% character error rate (CER) and 31.9% word error rate (WER), compared with 49.3% CER without target-subject calibration and 68.0% CER for direct checkpoint fine-tuning. Multi-subject pretraining from random initialization followed by fine-tuning reached 44.9% CER and did not converge under the fixed schedule in 5 of 27 folds, indicating substantial optimization and accuracy benefits from checkpoint initialization. Macro-averaged CER declined from 74.4% with one pretraining participant to 21.7% with 26. Three minutes of target-subject calibration achieved 20.5% CER and 31.7% WER, with no statistically significant difference from the full approximately 13-min pool (21.7% CER and 31.9% WER). A subject-specific adapter provided no detectable benefit. Excluding the five evaluation sentences from all sEMG model-training data increased CER and WER to 78.6% and 99.9%. These results support short-calibration personalization in a standardized-montage, closed-corpus setting.

AI.tldr: 在27名受试者、人均约21分钟sEMG数据的少数据设定下，采用单受试者检查点初始化＋多受试者预训练＋目标受试者微调，闭集50句任务的CER降至21.7%、WER降至31.9%；3分钟校准即可媲美约13分钟数据。
AI.motivation: sEMG默读语音接口受跨用户差异与校准负担制约，需探究在极少量数据下能否实现低成本个性化。
AI.method: 27名语音正常受试者在Aloud与Mimed两种模式下人均贡献<0.5 h（均值21.3 min）数据；闭集50句语料，采用留一受试者评估；流程为从公开单受试者检查点初始化→在非留出受试者上预训练→目标受试者微调；并做消融：无目标校准、直接检查点微调、随机初始化多受试者预训练、预训练受试者数量、3分钟vs约13分钟校准池、受试者专属适配器。
AI.result: 主流程CER 21.7%、WER 31.9%；无目标校准CER 49.3%；直接检查点微调CER 68.0%；随机初始化预训练后微调CER 44.9%且在27折中5折固定调度下不收敛；宏观平均CER随预训练受试者数由1人的74.4%降至26人的21.7%；3分钟校准CER 20.5%、WER 31.7%，与约13分钟池无显著差异；受试者适配器无显著收益；若训练数据排除5句评估句，CER/WER升至78.6%/99.9%。
AI.conclusion: 在标准化电极布置、闭集语料条件下，短时校准的个性化可行；检查点初始化对优化稳定性和精度均关键。

title: FairLMs: A Turnkey Library for Fairness in Language Models
summary: Fairness research on language models involves measuring bias, applying mitigation methods, and examining the evidence on which an evaluation rests. Existing tools offer complementary functionality through different interfaces, so combining them requires reconciling model interfaces, evidence formats, access constraints, and result types before applicability can be checked or methods compared. We introduce \textbf{FairLMs}, a Python library that connects these activities through explicit declarations of model capabilities and input requirements. It provides 33 intrinsic and extrinsic metrics, 14 mitigation components spanning four intervention categories, 14 dataset and scoring-instrument diagnostics, adapters for the three Transformer architectures and supported hosted completion APIs, and benchmark loaders. Declarations are checked before execution and results carry the configuration under which they were obtained, so that compatible components can be combined, methods compared under a common protocol, and workflows extended to new models and datasets. The source code is available at: https://github.com/FairLMs/FairLMs.

AI.tldr: FairLMs 是一个 Python 库，通过显式声明模型能力与输入需求，整合语言模型公平性研究中的偏见测量、缓解与证据检验，实现组件兼容组合与统一协议下的方法比较。
AI.motivation: 语言模型公平性研究涵盖偏见测量、缓解方法应用以及评估所依赖证据的检验。现有工具通过不同接口提供互补功能，但在组合使用时，需要先协调模型接口、证据格式、访问约束和结果类型，才能判断适用性或比较方法，导致整合成本高。
AI.method: 提出 FairLMs Python 库，以模型能力与输入需求的显式声明连接上述活动。库内提供 33 个内在与外在指标、14 个缓解组件（覆盖四类干预）、14 个数据集与评分工具诊断、适配三种 Transformer 架构及受支持的托管补全 API 的适配器，以及基准加载器。声明在执行前被检查，结果携带获得时的配置信息。
AI.result: 可实现兼容组件的组合、在统一协议下比较方法，并将工作流扩展到新模型和数据集。源码见 https://github.com/FairLMs/FairLMs。
AI.conclusion: FairLMs 通过声明式设计统一了公平性测量、缓解与诊断流程，降低了工具整合与协议不一致带来的障碍，提升了方法的可比性与工作流的可扩展性。

title: Fast And Accurate Text Content File Type Identification
comment: To appear in The 13th IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Advanced Analytics (DSAA 2026)
summary: A common requirement across organizations is to have a tool that can identify file types based on their contents, particularly in the cybersecurity domain where magic numbers and file extensions can not be trusted. While existing tools work well in practice, there is plenty of room for improvement either in terms of computational load and time for detection in the case of model based tools like Magika or in terms of accuracy of detection in the case of file parsing tools that use programming language constructs. In this study, we propose a neural network model for identification of types of text content files, especially source code, that is more accurate and faster than other available tools. Our experiments on open-source files indicate that it is not only more accurate on average for text-content file-type identification, but also approximately four times faster than Magika, while being 28% smaller in size.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于文本内容文件（尤其是源代码）类型识别的神经网络模型，在开源文件上实验表明，其识别准确率更高，速度约为Magika的4倍，模型体积小28%。
AI.motivation: 组织普遍需要基于内容而非扩展名或magic number识别文件类型，尤其在网络安全领域。现有工具存在不足：基于模型的方法（如Magika）在计算负载和检测时间上有改进空间，基于编程语言构造的文件解析工具则在准确率上存在不足。
AI.method: 提出一种神经网络模型，用于文本内容文件类型的识别，重点针对源代码文件。
AI.result: 在开源文件上的实验表明，该模型在文本内容文件类型识别上平均准确率更高，速度约为Magika的4倍，同时模型体积小28%。
AI.conclusion: 该神经网络模型在准确率、检测速度和模型体积方面均优于现有工具，是文本内容文件类型识别的一种更优方案。

title: An Introduction to Compression-Based Machine Learning
comment: To appear in The 13th IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Advanced Analytics (DSAA 2026)
summary: Any lossless compression algorithm (like gzip) may be converted into a machine learning method, via either Normalized Compression Distance or the Minimum Description Length principle. Any auto-regressive model may be converted into a lossless compression method via entropy coding. This seemingly circular dependence has unrealized potential in modern artificial intelligence and machine learning, and we survey and formalize the various strategies that have been used to leverage compression for machine learning. We introduce and empirically validate a design framework for compression-based ML, finding compression-based methods competitive with conventional baselines and decisively stronger on malware. We find that varying these design choices yields accuracy gains of up to 0.62.

AI.tldr: 该论文综述并形式化了利用压缩进行机器学习的多种策略，提出并实证验证了一个基于压缩的机器学习设计框架，发现该类方法可与传统基线竞争，在恶意软件任务上明显更强，设计选择变化可带来最高0.62的精度提升。
AI.motivation: 无损压缩算法可通过归一化压缩距离或最小描述长度原则转化为机器学习方法，自回归模型也可通过熵编码转化为无损压缩方法，这种看似循环的依赖关系在现代人工智能与机器学习中具有尚未实现的潜力，因此需要系统梳理并形式化相关策略。
AI.method: 论文对利用压缩服务机器学习（compression-based ML）的各种策略进行综述与形式化，提出一个用于压缩驱动机器学习的设计框架，并通过实证实验验证该框架，同时考察不同设计选择对精度的影响，并与常规基线进行对比。
AI.result: 实验表明，基于压缩的方法可与传统基线竞争，并在恶意软件任务上具有决定性优势；调整设计选择可带来最高0.62的精度增益。
AI.conclusion: 压缩与机器学习之间存在双向可转化的紧密联系，系统化的设计框架能够有效指导压缩驱动的机器学习方法，并在特定任务上展现显著优势，值得在人工智能与机器学习领域进一步挖掘其潜力。

title: Routine Blood Tests Outperform CRP for Distinguishing Bacterial From Viral Infection in Children
summary: Acute infectious diseases are among the leading causes of medical consultations and hospitalizations in children worldwide. These infections are predominantly caused by viruses or bacteria, yet differentiating between the two remains a common clinical challenge. As a result, pediatricians often default to the safer option of prescribing antibiotics contributing to the growing problem of antimicrobial resistance. The objective is to assess the additional predictive value of CBC towards determining the current infection. This retrospective study used data from 906 pediatric patients aged between 2 and 14 years who were tested positive either for viral or bacterial infection between 2022 and 2026. Inclusion criteria further required availability of CBC results and CRP level measurements. These laboratory parameters as well as age were used as input features for several supervised classification models. Model performance was evaluated using AUC, sensitivity and specificity. The best performing model is XGBoost, which included all features, achieving out of-sample performance of AUC of 81.7% and sensitivity of 70.8%, specificity of 79.2%. All trained models outperform a CRP-based only decision-rule model in terms of AUC. We suggest that the decision to prescribe antibiotics should be based on a number of factors, including but not limited to CBC, some of which are not currently incorporated into routine practice.

AI.tldr: 该回顾性研究基于906名2–14岁儿童的CBC、CRP及年龄数据，采用多种监督分类模型区分病毒与细菌感染，XGBoost表现最佳（AUC 81.7%、敏感度70.8%、特异度79.2%），所有模型均优于仅基于CRP的决策规则。
AI.motivation: 急性感染是儿童就诊和住院的主要原因，但病毒与细菌感染的临床鉴别困难，导致儿科医生倾向经验性使用抗生素，加剧抗菌药物耐药问题。研究旨在评估全血细胞计数（CBC）在判断当前感染类型方面的附加预测价值。
AI.method: 回顾性研究，纳入2022–2026年间906例2–14岁、经检测确诊为病毒或细菌感染的儿科患者，要求具备CBC结果和CRP测量值。以CBC参数、CRP水平及年龄作为输入特征，训练多种监督分类模型，采用AUC、敏感度和特异度评估模型性能。
AI.result: 表现最佳的模型为XGBoost，纳入全部特征，样本外性能为AUC 81.7%、敏感度70.8%、特异度79.2%。所有训练模型在AUC上均优于仅基于CRP的决策规则模型。
AI.conclusion: 抗生素处方决策应基于多种因素，包括但不限于CBC，其中部分因素目前尚未纳入常规临床实践。

title: IntBMoE: Integrating Block-Level Conditioning into Expert Composition for Full-Participation Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) scales capacity, but existing designs cannot set three quantities independently. For a single token, participation is how many experts contribute knowledge to its output, execution is how many are actually computed (compute cost), and materialization is how many expert-sized parameter sets must be built and stored (memory cost). Sparse routing keeps execution and materialization low, but shrinks participation: for each token, only a few experts contribute. Dense output-mixing restores full participation, but its execution grows with the number of experts. Parameter-merging keeps execution at one expert, but its materialization grows with the number of routing decisions. We propose IntBMoE, a block-conditioned MoE that decouples all three by pairing dense expert composition with sparse block execution. Its blocks come from a small learned codebook, one per entry. At each internal layer, a lightweight hypernetwork merges all expert bases in that layer's pool into one composed expert. Participation is full, because every composed expert draws on the entire pool. Execution stays sparse, because a router sends each token to only a few blocks. Materialization is bounded, because the codebook, not the input, fixes how many blocks exist. Dual-Path Residual Gating (DPRG) further couples two independently composed paths through multiplicative gating. Experiments on image classification show consistent gains over representative sparse and dense MoE baselines. Additional experiments on language modeling and sequential recommendation validate its generalization beyond vision. IntBMoE is fully deployed in AMap's generative recommendation system, serving hundreds of millions of users under a 60ms latency budget, with a 2.4% relative UVCTR gain in online A/B testing. Our code is available at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/DreamX-Rec/.

AI.tldr: 提出 IntBMoE，一种块条件 MoE，通过"稠密专家组合 + 稀疏块执行"将参与度、执行量、物化量三者解耦；在图像分类、语言建模、序列推荐上均优于代表性 MoE 基线，并已在工业推荐系统上线。
AI.motivation: 现有 MoE 设计无法独立设定三个量：参与度（每个 token 有多少专家贡献知识）、执行量（实际计算多少专家，即计算成本）、物化量（需构建与存储多少专家规模参数集，即内存成本）。稀疏路由执行与物化低但参与度小；稠密输出混合恢复全参与度但执行量随专家数增长；参数合并执行量恒为一个专家但物化量随路由决策数增长。三者相互牵制，缺乏独立可调的机制。
AI.method: IntBMoE 采用块条件 MoE：块来自一个小型可学习码本（每个条目对应一个块），数量由码本而非输入决定。每一内部层中，轻量超网络将该层专家池中所有专家基合并为一个组合专家，因此组合专家可汲取整个专家池，参与度满额；路由器仅将每个 token 送到少量块，执行保持稀疏；物化量因块数由码本固定而有界。此外引入双路径残差门控（DPRG），通过乘性门控耦合两条独立组合路径。
AI.result: 图像分类实验相比代表性稀疏与稠密 MoE 基线取得一致提升；语言建模与序列推荐实验验证了其在视觉之外的泛化能力。IntBMoE 已完整部署于 AMap 生成式推荐系统，在 60ms 延迟预算下服务数亿用户，在线 A/B 测试取得 2.4% 的相对 UVCTR 提升。
AI.conclusion: IntBMoE 通过块条件组合与稀疏块执行，实现了参与度、执行量、物化量的解耦，兼顾表达能力与效率，并在大规模工业推荐场景中验证了有效性与可部署性。

title: Probabilistic Forecasting of Business Process Executions with Neural Temporal Point Processes
summary: Operators of service-based systems act on forecasts of how a running execution will continue, and such a forecast is actionable only if its reliability is known. Mainstream deep-learning models for this task are discriminative and deterministic: they emit a single next activity and a single remaining-time estimate, without a distribution to reason over. We instead cast the problem as generative sequence modelling with marked temporal point processes, which define a joint density over the next mark and its inter-event time and therefore deliver predictive distributions by construction. Real event logs violate the simple-point-process assumption these models rest on, since consecutive events frequently carry identical timestamps; we handle such ties explicitly and combine a transformer encoder with a mixture decoder over inter-event times, trained by exact log-likelihood. On ten public logs, the resulting model matches discriminative baselines on point accuracy, dominates them on the calibration and sharpness of remaining-time distributions, and is the cheapest at inference, since a full predictive distribution is obtained in a single forward pass without sampling.

AI.tldr: 该论文将预测性业务流程监控建模为标记时序点过程，用Transformer编码器加混合解码器输出联合预测分布，在十个公开日志上精度持平判别式基线、剩余时间分布校准与锐度更优，且推理最廉价。
AI.motivation: 服务型系统的运维者依赖对运行中执行将如何延续的预测，而这种预测只有在可靠性已知时才可操作。主流深度学习模型是判别式且确定性的：只输出单个下一活动与单个剩余时间估计，没有可供推理的分布。同时真实事件日志违反简单点过程假设（连续事件常携带相同时间戳），需要显式处理这种并列（ties）。
AI.method: 把问题转化为使用标记时序点过程的生成式序列建模，该过程对下一标记及其事件间时间定义联合密度，从而在结构上自然给出预测分布。针对相同时间戳的并列问题显式处理，并将Transformer编码器与事件间时间上的混合解码器相结合，用精确对数似然进行训练。
AI.result: 在十个公开日志上，所得模型在点精度上与判别式基线持平，在剩余时间分布的校准与锐度上超过它们，并且推理成本最低，因为完整预测分布可在一次前向传播中获得而无需采样。
AI.conclusion: 生成式标记时序点过程建模为预测性流程监控提供了可校准且锐利的预测分布，同时保持点精度并降低推理成本，是判别式确定性基线的有力替代方案。

title: Tracing the Evidence Behind Zero-Shot Time-Series Forecasting: A Source-First Taxonomy and Audit Framework
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to ACM AI Summit 2026 (Visionary Papers)
summary: Zero-shot time-series forecasting (TSF) is often described as forecasting without target-specific parameter updates, but that training-status condition does not specify what evidence the system may use. A frozen language model prompted with serialized values, a time-series model pretrained on broad forecasting corpora, and a retrieval-augmented forecaster may all satisfy the no-update condition while drawing on different transferable evidence. This paper argues that zero-shot TSF should therefore be governed as an evidence-access claim. We propose a source-first taxonomy that separates three primary evidence sources---frozen LLM prior reuse, parametric time-series pretraining, and retrieval-augmented external memory---from the architectures that implement them. After the source is identified, four additional audit questions remain: task interface, forecast object and scoring, prediction-time context, and resource budget. The resulting agenda is to make zero-shot leaderboards auditable by reporting evidence boundaries and interface assumptions alongside scores, so that benchmark progress reflects transferable forecasting capability rather than undisclosed changes in context, memory, or budget.

AI.tldr: 本文主张"零样本"时间序列预测的定义应转向"证据可及性"声明，并提出以证据来源为先的分类法，配合四项审计问题，使零样本预测榜单可被审计。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本TSF定义仅以"是否进行目标特定参数更新"为标准，属于训练状态条件，无法说明系统可以使用哪些证据。冻结LLM提示、大规模语料预训练的时间序列模型、检索增强预测器都可能满足"不更新"条件，却依赖不同的可迁移证据，导致基准比较含义不清、进展不可解释。
AI.method: 提出"证据来源优先"（source-first）的分类法：首先区分三类主要证据来源——冻结LLM先验复用、参数化时间序列预训练、检索增强的外部记忆——并与其实现架构分离；在确定来源后，再通过四个审计问题刻画系统：任务接口、预测对象与评分方式、预测时可用上下文、资源预算。
AI.result: 形成一套审计框架与议程：将"零样本"从训练状态标签重构为证据可及性声明，并明确来源识别在先、四项审计问题在后的核查流程，从而可以系统性地判别不同方法之间可比与不可比的边界。
AI.conclusion: 零样本预测榜单应在报告分数的同时报告证据边界与接口假设，使基准进展真正反映可迁移的预测能力，而非未披露的上下文、记忆或预算变化。

title: Decision-Focused Learning for Mean-Variance Portfolio Optimization via KKT-Based Reformulation
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted at PRICAI 2026 (Pacific Rim International Conference on Artificial Intelligence)
summary: Mean-variance portfolio optimization (MVO) is a central framework in data-driven asset management. A widely adopted approach is a two-stage framework that first predicts expected returns and then solves the optimization problem based on these predictions, with the predictive models trained by minimizing prediction errors. However, this objective of prediction is not aligned with the quality of the downstream portfolio decision. Decision-focused learning (DFL), which directly minimizes the downstream decision loss within the learning process, has thus emerged as a promising direction. However, existing DFL approaches to MVO rely on surrogate losses or constraint relaxations for tractability, creating a structural mismatch between predictive model training and the constrained MVO solved at evaluation. We propose a single-level optimization formulation that incorporates the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) optimality conditions of the lower-level MVO into the upper-level learning problem. This formulation explicitly preserves the budget and short-sale constraints while remaining tractable for standard nonlinear optimization solvers. Rolling-window experiments on real-world ETF (Exchange Traded Funds) data across two asset universes with different correlation structures show that our method achieved the best performance on multiple investment metrics and also demonstrated performance improvement due to the proposed regularization.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对均值-方差投资组合优化（MVO）中"预测-优化"两阶段框架目标不一致的问题，提出将下层MVO的KKT最优性条件嵌入上层学习问题的单层优化公式，在保留预算约束与卖空约束的同时保持可解性，并在真实ETF数据上取得多项投资指标的最优表现。
AI.motivation: 传统两阶段方法先预测期望收益、再求解优化，预测模型以最小化预测误差为目标，但该目标与下游投资组合决策质量并不一致，存在目标错配。决策聚焦学习（DFL）虽直接最小化下游决策损失，但现有面向MVO的DFL方法为保证可解性依赖代理损失或约束松弛，导致训练阶段的预测模型与评估阶段求解的带约束MVO之间存在结构性不匹配。
AI.method: 提出单层优化（single-level optimization）公式：将下层MVO问题的KKT最优性条件作为约束纳入上层学习问题，从而在训练中显式保留预算约束与卖空约束，同时保持对标准非线性优化求解器的可解性；并引入正则化项以提升性能。
AI.result: 在两个具有不同相关结构资产池的真实ETF数据上进行滚动窗口实验，所提方法在多项投资指标上均取得最佳表现，并验证了所提正则化带来的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过KKT条件将带约束的MVO嵌入决策聚焦学习框架，可在不依赖代理损失或约束松弛的前提下消除训练与评估之间的结构错配，为约束型投资组合优化提供了有效且可解的端到端学习方案。

title: Optimal Randomized Proper Online Learning
summary: We prove that the optimal expected mistake bound of online learning a function class $\mathcal{H}$ by a randomized proper learning algorithm is $O(\mathtt{L}(\mathcal{H}) \log T)$, where $\mathtt{L}(\mathcal{H})$ is the Littlestone dimension of $\mathcal{H}$ and $T$ is the time horizon. Our result improves upon the previously best known bound of $O(\mathtt{L}(\mathcal{H}) \log^6 T)$ given by Daskalakis and Golowich (STOC 2022), and is optimal up to a universal constant for worst-case classes.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了随机恰当在线学习算法的最优期望错误界为 O(L(H) log T)，改进了此前 O(L(H) log^6 T) 的结果，并在最坏情况下达到常数因子最优。
AI.motivation: 此前随机恰当在线学习的最优错误界仅已知为 O(L(H) log^6 T)（Daskalakis 与 Golowich, STOC 2022），与理论下界存在较大差距，因此需要缩小该差距并确定紧确的错误界。
AI.method: 针对函数类 H，研究随机恰当学习算法，结合 Littlestone 维数 L(H) 与时间视界 T 进行理论分析，构造并证明期望错误上界。
AI.result: 证明了随机恰当在线学习的最优期望错误界为 O(L(H) log T)，优于先前的 O(L(H) log^6 T)。
AI.conclusion: 该界在最坏情况函数类下达到仅差一个通用常数的意义下最优，从而确定了随机恰当在线学习的紧确期望错误界。

title: Understanding LLM Quantization through Activation-Guided Compensation and Orthogonal Residuals
summary: Post-training weight-activation quantization reduces the memory and inference costs of large language models, but aggressive W4A4 quantization remains difficult because activation outliers degrade effective quantization resolution. Although weight optimization, channel-wise scaling, and orthogonal rotation mitigate this problem, the error components they address and their relationship remain unclear. Using an exact decomposition of local weight-activation quantization error into an activation-guided weight compensation term and an orthogonal residual, we bound the residual using persistent channel-wise outlier and regular activation quantities. This decomposition clarifies which error components can be addressed by weight compensation and which require transformation design. We then use the residual bounds to derive practical guidelines for applying randomized Hadamard rotation, sign selection, and channel scaling. In particular, the analysis explains how random signs suppress constructive interference among persistent outlier channels, how sampling multiple sign patterns can improve transformation selection, and how second-moment balancing leads to an $L_2$ scaling rule while a further relaxation recovers SmoothQuant-style $L_\infty$ scaling. We evaluate these guidelines through backpropagation-free configurations across eight Llama and Mistral models, obtaining performance competitive with gradient-trained SpinQuant.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过将局部权重-激活量化误差精确分解为"激活引导的权重补偿项"与"正交残差", 用持久通道离群量和规则激活量对残差给出上界, 并据此推导出Hadamard旋转、符号选择与通道缩放的设计准则, 在8个Llama/Mistral模型上以无反向传播配置取得与梯度训练的SpinQuant相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 训练后W4A4量化可显著降低大语言模型的显存与推理开销, 但激活离群值会破坏有效量化分辨率。已有的权重优化、通道缩放与正交旋转手段虽能缓解该问题, 但它们各自修正的误差成分及其相互关系尚不清晰, 缺乏统一的理论刻画, 导致变换设计缺乏原则性指导。
AI.method: 对局部权重-激活量化误差进行精确分解, 拆为激活引导的权重补偿项与正交残差; 利用持久通道离群量(persistent channel-wise outlier)和规则激活量对残差建立上界; 基于该上界推导随机Hadamard旋转、符号选择与通道缩放的实用准则, 包括随机符号抑制持久离群通道间构造性干涉、多符号模式采样改进变换选择、二阶矩平衡导出L2缩放规则, 并进一步松弛得到SmoothQuant式L∞缩放。方法为无需反向传播的配置化流程。
AI.result: 在八个Llama与Mistral模型上以无反向传播配置进行评测, 性能与需梯度训练的SpinQuant相当。
AI.conclusion: 该误差分解厘清了哪些误差成分可由权重补偿解决、哪些需依赖变换设计, 并为旋转、符号选择与缩放提供了统一的理论依据与实践准则; 表明在无需梯度训练的情况下亦可达到与梯度方法可比的W4A4量化性能。

title: Efficient Architecture Search under Leave-One-Subject-Out Evaluation
summary: Deep neural architectures are widely used for signal processing in automated pain assessment systems. However, architecture design has remained largely a manual task despite the potential efficiency benefits of Neural Architecture Search (NAS). Embedding NAS in a Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) evaluation is computationally demanding because a fully nested implementation requires $N$ independent architecture searches and, assuming approximately linear training cost, scales as $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$. We propose a block-based, leakage-controlled approach that shares NAS runs between subjects, reducing the number of searches from $N$ to $B$, where $B \ll N$, dubbed PainNAS. On the BioVid Heat Pain dataset, PainNAS yields comparable subject-level accuracy with substantially fewer parameters and FLOPs.

AI.tldr: 提出PainNAS：一种基于块的、防泄漏的神经架构搜索方法，通过受试者间共享NAS搜索将搜索次数从N降至B（B≪N），在BioVid热痛数据集上以更少参数和FLOPs取得相当的受试者级准确率。
AI.motivation: 深度神经架构广泛用于自动化疼痛评估的信号处理，但架构设计仍主要依赖人工，NAS的潜在效率收益未被充分利用。同时，将NAS嵌入留一受试者（LOSO）评估计算代价高昂：完全嵌套实现需N次独立架构搜索，按近似线性训练成本计复杂度为O(N²)。
AI.method: 提出一种基于块（block-based）、控制泄漏（leakage-controlled）的方法，在受试者之间共享NAS搜索过程，将搜索次数从N减少到B（B≪N），命名为PainNAS。
AI.result: 在BioVid Heat Pain数据集上，PainNAS取得了与基线相当的受试者级准确率，同时参数量和FLOPs大幅减少。
AI.conclusion: 通过受试者间共享搜索的块式防泄漏NAS设计，可有效缓解LOSO评估中NAS的O(N²)计算瓶颈，在保持受试者级性能的同时显著降低模型复杂度，为自动化疼痛评估提供了更高效的架构设计范式。

title: What Must Survive? Exact Task-Information--State Frontiers for Resource-Sufficient Learning
summary:
A system may be compressed before its downstream task is fully known. We ask how much retained state is then necessary and how much can be saved by limited advance task information.
  For a finite family of linear tasks, a task message is revealed before state formation and the exact task only afterwards. For an advice alphabet of size $K$, the exact frontier is \[ p^*(K)= \min_{\substack{\Pcal\text{ partition of }\U\\|\Pcal|\le K}} \max_{C\in\Pcal}\rank(T_C), \] with the $b$-bit frontier obtained by setting $K=\min(2^b,|\U|)$. Thus advance task information reduces state through partitions whose joint task operators have low rank.
  We also give an approximate singular-value frontier, a common-core lower bound and exact direct-sum law, and strong NP-hardness of finding an optimal advice partition. The hardness persists at every fixed positive approximation tolerance.
  Three examples illustrate the result. A well-conditioned softmax attention construction gives an exact $524{,}288\to1{,}024$ coordinate frontier when nine bits resolve one of $512$ continuations. A domain-decomposed digital twin yields an interface-plus-local-state law and a weighted partition problem for heterogeneous regions.
  A hierarchical multi-task model gives a two-stage frontier in which three bits reduce the required state from $3136$ to $448$ coordinates, with further task information approaching the irreducible $328$-coordinate single-task floor.

AI.tldr: 研究在下游任务未完全已知时压缩系统所需保留状态的问题，刻画了任务信息的比特数与状态维度之间的精确前沿。
AI.motivation: 系统常在下游任务完全确定之前就被压缩，因此需要明确：此时保留多少状态是必要的，以及有限的“提前任务信息”能节省多少状态。论文为此建立理论框架并用实例说明。
AI.method: 对有限线性任务族，在状态形成前先揭示任务消息、之后才揭示确切任务。对大小为K的advice字母表，给出精确前沿 p*(K)=min_{|P|≤K} max_{C∈P} rank(T_C)，b比特前沿取K=min(2^b,|U|)。并给出近似奇异值前沿、公共核下界与精确直和律，以及最优advice划分的强NP难性（在每个固定正近似容差下均成立）。
AI.result: 三个例子：良态softmax注意力构造在9比特区分512种延续之一时给出精确的524,288→1,024坐标前沿；域分解数字孪生得到界面加局部状态律以及异构区域的加权划分问题；分层多任务模型给出两阶段前沿，3比特把所需状态从3,136降到448坐标，进一步任务信息逼近不可约的328坐标单任务下界。
AI.conclusion: 提前任务信息通过将任务划分为联合任务算子低秩的分区来减少必要状态；这一前沿可精确刻画，但寻找最优advice划分在计算上强NP难，且近似同样困难。

title: IncentRL: The Trade-Off Between Preference Guidance and Task Performance
summary: Preference-based reward shaping can guide reinforcement learning, but adding preference signals to the reward may unintentionally change the task being optimized. We address this problem with IncentRL, a framework that introduces preference guidance while explicitly characterizing its effect on external-task performance. IncentRL adds a Kullback--Leibler (KL) penalty between a specified outcome distribution and a preferred distribution. For finite discounted Markov decision processes with bounded shaping costs, we derive an external-value perturbation bound, establish a sufficient strict-action-gap condition for preserving the original optimal policy, and characterize the large-weight regime through discounted cumulative preference cost. Exact examples clarify the limits of these guarantees, including tied optima and support mismatch. We study a practical implementation using a hand-designed, distance-based outcome proxy, a fixed preference distribution, and score-weighted coefficient search. On MiniGrid DoorKey-8x8, the reported three-seed mean success rate after two million training steps reaches 98\% with coefficient 0.01, compared with 90.5\% for the reported zero-coefficient baseline, while the search progressively shifts toward smaller coefficients. Together, these results provide a principled view of the central trade-off in preference-based RL: using additional guidance to improve learning without excessively distorting the original task objective. The current experiments remain descriptive and do not yet isolate KL shaping from simpler alternatives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 IncentRL 框架，通过在结果分布与偏好分布间加入 KL 惩罚引入偏好引导，并显式刻画其对原始外部任务性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 基于偏好的奖励塑形能引导强化学习，但向奖励中加入偏好信号可能无意改变被优化的任务目标。
AI.method: IncentRL 在指定结果分布与偏好分布之间加入 KL 惩罚。针对有界塑形成本的有限折扣 MDP，推导外部价值扰动界，建立保持原最优策略的严格动作间隙充分条件，并用折扣累积偏好成本刻画大权重情形；实现上采用手工设计的距离型结果代理、固定偏好分布和分数加权系数搜索。
AI.result: 在 MiniGrid DoorKey-8x8 上，系数 0.01 时三随机种子两百万步平均成功率 98%，零系数基线为 90.5%，搜索逐渐偏向更小系数。
AI.conclusion: 结果给出了偏好型 RL 核心权衡的原则性视角：利用额外引导改善学习而不致过度扭曲原始任务目标；当前实验仍属描述性，尚未将 KL 塑形与更简单替代方案区分开。

title: OpenMAS-GCom. A Diagnostic Benchmark for Graph-enhanced Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Graph-enhanced multi-agent systems (G-MAS) coordinate large language model agents through communication graphs and role assignments, which determine how agents exchange information and divide responsibilities. However, final-score comparisons across systems combine differences in models, communication patterns, roles, and computation costs, making performance differences difficult to attribute to specific communication structures, role assignments, and information flows. To address this evaluation attribution problem, we introduce OpenMAS-GCom, a benchmark for diagnosing how these components affect G-MAS performance through controlled interventions. We represent systems through collaboration units, communication links, shared intermediate information, and execution rules. OpenMAS-GCom compares original systems with versions modified by changing one component while keeping tasks, models, prompts, and budget limits fixed. We rewire communication edges, remove specialist or critic agents, replace intermediate messages with incorrect content, and disable workers during execution. The benchmark evaluates 17 single-agent, ordinary multi-agent, and graph-enhanced configurations on 29 datasets across six domains. We add 400 G-MAS-Complex tasks requiring agents to combine information from multiple documents, resolve conflicting records, and return specified values with source identifiers. Experiments show larger mean losses after specialist removal than after critic removal, different performance degradation under incorrect messages and worker failures despite similar original scores, and different configurations achieving the highest accuracy and accuracy per token on G-MAS-Complex.

AI.tldr: 提出 OpenMAS-GCom 基准，通过受控干预诊断通信结构、角色分配与信息流对图增强多智能体系统（G-MAS）性能的具体影响。
AI.motivation: 最终分数比较混合了模型、通信模式、角色与计算成本等差异，导致性能差异难以归因到具体的通信结构、角色分配和信息流，即存在"评估归因问题"。
AI.method: 用协作单元、通信链路、共享中间信息和执行规则表示系统；在任务、模型、提示与预算固定下，每次只改变一个组件，对比原始系统与修改版本。干预方式包括：重连通信边、移除专家或批评者智能体、用错误内容替换中间消息、执行中禁用工作者。基准覆盖 17 种配置（单智能体、普通多智能体、图增强）与 6 个领域的 29 个数据集，并新增 400 个 G-MAS-Complex 任务（要求综合多文档信息、解决冲突记录并返回带来源标识的指定值）。
AI.result: 移除专家带来的平均性能损失大于移除批评者；在原始分数相近的情况下，错误消息与工作者故障导致不同程度的性能退化；在 G-MAS-Complex 上，不同配置分别在最高准确率和最高每 token 准确率上表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: OpenMAS-GCom 可实现对 G-MAS 各组件的受控诊断与归因，揭示角色、消息正确性和工作者可靠性对性能的差异化影响，并支持在准确率与计算效率间做配置取舍。

title: MACE: Memory-Agent Co-Evolution with Adaptive Memory Graphs for Multi-Agent Systems
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems generate collaboration traces that record how agents plan tasks, verify intermediate results, and repair failures. Reusing these procedures requires preserving an action's prerequisites and the outputs needed by subsequent agents. Our empirical studies show that grouping these dependencies into functional memory units improves their retention, while connecting units increases retrieval of the units and links jointly required by a task. The preferred combination of units also changes between instructions and checklists, even when each combination's content is fixed across formats. Updating choices from the outcomes of each combination and format pairing outperforms scoring combinations and formats separately. These findings motivate MACE, a memory-agent co-evolution framework that adapts memory organization and agent memory use through execution feedback. Its MemGoG structure represents functional units as subgraphs of related conditions, actions, and outputs, connecting them through support, conflict, and repair relations. MACE Loop selects task-relevant units and relations within a memory budget and provides each agent with instructions or checklists for its current operation. It records the selected units, presentation formats, agent outputs, and task outcomes to update unit scores and relations for retrieval and inform subsequent presentation choices. Across eight benchmarks, MACE outperforms ten baselines with an average score of 81.11%, compared with 78.97% for the strongest baseline, SAGE.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MACE框架，通过记忆-智能体协同演化，将协作痕迹组织为功能单元子图并自适应选择呈现格式，在八个基准上平均得分81.11%，优于最强基线SAGE的78.97%。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统产生的协作痕迹蕴含任务规划、结果验证与失败修复过程，复用这些过程需保留动作前置条件及后续智能体所需输出。然而现有方法未有效组织此类依赖关系，也未考虑呈现格式对记忆检索的影响。
AI.method: 通过实证研究发现：将依赖分组为功能记忆单元可提升保留率，连接单元能增加任务所需单元与链接的联合检索；指令与清单格式下最优单元组合不同。据此提出MACE：MemGoG将功能单元表示为条件-动作-输出子图，以支持、冲突、修复关系连接；MACE Loop在记忆预算内选择相关单元与关系，为智能体提供指令或清单，并记录选择、格式、输出与结果以更新单元分数与关系。
AI.result: 在八个基准测试中，MACE平均得分81.11%，超过十个基线方法，最强基线SAGE为78.97%。
AI.conclusion: 基于执行反馈协同演化记忆组织与智能体记忆使用，并动态选择呈现格式，能有效提升多智能体协作过程的复用效果。

title: Trading Depth for Time in Recurrent Transformers
summary: Recurrent Transformers increase computational depth through temporal recurrence, feeding each token's high-level hidden state into the computation of the next. This raises a natural question: is additional computation better spent on more temporal steps or greater physical depth? We investigate this question using Latent Recurrent Transformers (LRTs), which retain one backbone forward pass per vocabulary token during decoding and provide a controlled setting for comparing these two ways of adding computation. Specifically, we insert a latent thought token between consecutive vocabulary tokens. Each thought token passes through the same $L$ layers as a vocabulary token, sharing the backbone parameters and providing an additional stage of hidden-state refinement before predicting the next token. We compare this $L$-layer LRT against a $2L$-layer LRT without thought tokens. Both execute $2L$ Transformer blocks per vocabulary token during decoding, but the thought-token model uses fewer parameters. On 16- and 20-layer mixture-of-experts NanoChat backbones, one thought token brings the shallower model within 0.006 and 0.004 bits per byte of its double-depth counterpart, recovering 67% and 81% of the improvement with approximately 48% fewer total parameters. These results suggest that temporal thinking offers a parameter-efficient alternative to increasing physical depth in recurrent Transformers.

AI.tldr: 在循环Transformer中，将额外计算用于时间步（潜思考token）比单纯增加物理深度更参数高效：一个思考token使浅层模型以约少48%参数恢复深层模型67%–81%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer通过时间循环增加计算深度，但存在一个关键问题：额外计算应投入更多时间步还是更大物理深度？作者希望在同一受控条件下比较这两种增加计算量的方式。
AI.method: 提出Latent Recurrent Transformers（LRTs）。解码时每个词表token保留一次主干前向；在相邻词表token之间插入一个潜思考token，该token与词表token经过相同的L层、共享主干参数，从而在预测下一token前提供额外的隐藏状态精炼阶段。对比L层LRT（含思考token）与不含思考token的2L层LRT，两者每个词表token均执行2L个Transformer块，但思考token模型参数更少。
AI.result: 在16层和20层混合专家NanoChat主干上，一个思考token使浅层模型与双倍深度对应模型的差距分别缩小到0.006和0.004 bits per byte，恢复了67%和81%的改进，同时总参数减少约48%。
AI.conclusion: 在循环Transformer中，时间维度的"思考"是增加物理深度的一种参数高效替代方案。

title: Riemannian Neural Hamiltonian Flows: Geodesic Symplectic Transport and Interpretability
summary: Hamiltonian normalizing flows are attractive generative models because their phase-space maps are invertible and volume preserving, but most neural constructions are formulated in Euclidean space. We introduce Riemannian Neural Hamiltonian Flows, which combine the fixed kinetic energy of a Riemannian manifold, a learned scalar potential, and an explicit geodesic leapfrog integrator. Our analysis explains how the learned Hamiltonian can be made interpretable. Every normalizable potential defines an implicit profile, and the position marginal initially accelerates along the relative score between that profile and the base. The matched potential is the interpretable specialization for which the implicit profile is the target. In the isotropic Gaussian case, the mechanism corresponds to a phase-space rotation. A local harmonic analysis extends this result around each mode of a general target on a manifold. The gap between the learned and the matched potential is the sum of a residual memory of the base and a bias of the model, and the two potentials agree when the position base has been transferred to the momentum. This can be achieved when the former is broader than the target. Numerical experiments on Euclidean, hyperbolic, and spherical spaces show competitive sample quality and numerical cost against a Riemannian continuous normalizing flow, and confirm the interpretability of the learned potential.

AI.tldr: 本文提出黎曼神经哈密顿流（Riemannian Neural Hamiltonian Flows），将流形上的固定动能、可学习标量势与显式测地线蛙跳积分器结合，构造可逆、保体积的生成模型，并给出该学习哈密顿量的可解释性理论与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 哈密顿归一化流因相空间映射可逆且保体积而成为有吸引力的生成模型，但现有的大多数神经构造局限于欧氏空间，难以直接应用于具有曲率的黎曼流形数据分布。因此作者希望把哈密顿流推广到一般黎曼流形，并解决其学习到的势函数缺乏可解释性的问题。
AI.method: 方法上将黎曼流形上的固定动能、一个可学习的标量势函数以及显式测地线蛙跳积分器组合成黎曼神经哈密顿流。理论分析方面，指出每个可归一化势函数定义了一个隐式轮廓（implicit profile），位置边缘分布在初始时沿该轮廓与基分布之间的相对得分加速；提出匹配势（matched potential）作为可解释的特例，使隐式轮廓即为目标分布。在等温高斯情形下，该机制对应于相空间旋转；并通过局部调和分析将结论推广到一般流形目标分布的每个众数附近。学习势与匹配势之间的差距被分解为基分布的残差记忆与模型偏差，当位置基分布已转移到动量时两者一致，而这在前者比目标更宽泛时可实现。
AI.result: 在欧氏、双曲和球面空间上的数值实验表明，该方法相比黎曼连续归一化流（Riemannian continuous normalizing flow）具有竞争力的采样质量和数值开销，并验证了所学势函数的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 黎曼神经哈密顿流为流形上的生成建模提供了一种可逆、保体积且具有可解释哈密顿量的方案，理论与实验共同表明其势函数可被赋予明确的统计意义，并在多种几何空间上取得良好效果。

title: Beyond Gaussian Worlds: Latent Geometry Matters for JEPAs
summary: Recent Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) prevent representation collapse by constraining learned representations to follow a prescribed target distribution, such as an isotropic Gaussian or the uniform distribution on a hypersphere. Klindt et al. (2026) showed that, under their Euclidean assumptions, matching a Gaussian target can recover Gaussian latent variables up to a linear transformation, and that the Gaussian is the unique distribution with this guarantee. We extend their analysis to latent variables supported on embedded Riemannian manifolds and derive conditions on the latent geometry and positive-pair dynamics under which alignment and exact distribution matching guarantee linear recovery. In particular, when the latent variables are uniformly distributed on a sphere and the representations are matched to the same spherical distribution, every optimal representation recovers the latent state up to an orthogonal transformation. This shows that Gaussian uniqueness is not a universal property of distribution-matched JEPAs: non-Euclidean latent geometries can admit other linearly recoverable distributions. We further derive an approximate-recovery bound that is strictly tighter for the spherical world than for the Gaussian world. Experiments on Gaussian, spherical, and toroidal latent spaces show that geometrically compatible targets yield better linear recovery when optimization succeeds, whereas mismatched targets distort the latent structure. This advantage persists in high-dimensional Clifford-torus worlds.

AI.tldr: 本文将分布匹配式JEPA的线性可恢复性理论从欧氏情形推广到嵌入黎曼流形的潜变量，证明球面均匀分布等非欧氏几何同样可实现线性恢复，并给出更紧的近似恢复界，实验验证几何匹配目标优于失配目标。
AI.motivation: Klindt等（2026）在欧氏假设下证明：匹配高斯目标可在线性变换意义下恢复高斯潜变量，且高斯是具此保证的唯一分布。本文质疑"高斯唯一性"是否为分布匹配式JEPA的普遍性质，探究非欧氏潜几何是否也能支持线性可恢复的分布。
AI.method: 将分析推广到支撑在嵌入黎曼流形上的潜变量，推导在何种潜几何与正对（positive-pair）动力学条件下，对齐与精确分布匹配可保证线性恢复；重点分析潜变量在球面上均匀分布、表征匹配同一球面分布的情形；并推导近似恢复界，比较球面世界与高斯世界的紧致程度。实验覆盖高斯、球面、环面潜空间以及高维Clifford环面世界。
AI.result: 当潜变量在球面上均匀分布且表征匹配同一球面分布时，每个最优表征均可恢复潜状态至正交变换；球面世界的近似恢复界严格紧于高斯世界；实验表明几何兼容的目标在优化成功时带来更好的线性恢复，而失配目标会扭曲潜结构，该优势在高维Clifford环面世界中依然保持。
AI.conclusion: 高斯唯一性并非分布匹配式JEPA的普遍性质：非欧氏潜几何可容纳其他线性可恢复分布（如球面均匀分布）。目标分布与潜几何的兼容性是线性恢复的关键，为设计几何匹配的JEPA目标提供了理论与实证依据。

title: Optimization Geometry of Equivalent Brownian RKHS Representations
summary: Equivalent finite parameterizations can represent the same functions and intrinsic norm yet induce different optimization algorithms. We study this effect in a controlled finite Brownian RKHS with nodal, increment, and spectral coordinates. Classical finite-element, RKHS-interpolation, Brownian-covariance, and mixed-boundary DCT identities make the shared hypothesis class, Brownian energy, approximation operator, and coordinate maps explicit. Our main results concern the optimization geometry of this fixed model. With mapped initialization, identical scalar steps, and identical minibatches, nodal and spectral GD/SGD have exactly the same mapped trajectories. Increment GD is an explicit Euler step for the constant Brownian/Sobolev metric, with factor $1/h$. For Brownian-regularized least squares, $κ_2(\mathbf H_{\mathrm{inc}})\le1+A/ρ$, independently of grid resolution $G$ for fixed $A$, $ρ>0$, and the stated normalization. Under the stated standard-Adam convention, the universal orthogonal equivariance group is exactly the signed permutations; the block DCT-VIII transform is not one. Float64 tests over five grids numerically verify the finite identities, mapped one-layer and recursive trajectories, conditioning predictions, and theorem-matched Adam separation. Thus coordinate effects are isolated without changing the represented functions, intrinsic regularizer, or approximation space.

AI.tldr: 在受控的有限布朗RKHS中，节点、增量与谱坐标可表示同一函数与内蕴范数，却导致不同的优化几何与算法行为。理论证明映射轨迹等价性、增量GD的显式欧拉刻画、条件数上界，以及标准Adam下正交等变群恰为带符号置换，并用Float64实验验证。
AI.motivation: 有限参数化之间的可逆坐标变换不改变所表示的函数与内蕴范数，但会改变优化算法在参数空间中的更新路径与几何性质。作者希望在一个完全可解析的受控模型（有限布朗RKHS）中，分离并量化这种"坐标效应"，而不是混淆于假设类、正则项或近似空间的改变。
AI.method: 构造有限布朗RKHS，选择节点坐标、增量坐标和谱（DCT）坐标三种等价参数化，利用有限元、RKHS插值、布朗协方差和混合边界DCT恒等式，使共享假设类、布朗能量、近似算子与坐标映射显式化。分析映射初始化、相同标量步长和相同小批量下GD/SGD的映射轨迹；给出增量GD作为常布朗/Sobolev度量显式欧拉的$1/h$因子；推导正则最小二乘Hessian条件数上界；并按标准Adam约定确定正交等变群。用五组网格的Float64数值实验验证恒等式、轨迹、条件数预测与Adam分离。
AI.result: 节点与谱GD/SGD在映射初始化、相同标量步长和相同小批量下具有完全相同的映射轨迹；增量GD是常布朗/Sobolev度量的显式欧拉步，步长因子为$1/h$；对布朗正则最小二乘，$\kappa_2(\mathbf H_{\mathrm{inc}})\le 1+A/\rho$，在固定$A,\rho>0$及给定归一化下与网格分辨率$G$无关；标准Adam约定下普遍正交等变群恰为带符号置换，块DCT-VIII变换不属于该群。Float64五网格实验数值验证了上述结论。
AI.conclusion: 该受控框架在不改变所表示函数、内蕴正则化子与近似空间的前提下，成功隔离了坐标/参数化对优化几何与算法行为的影响：映射轨迹可因坐标选择而相同或不同，增量坐标带来分辨率无关的条件数上界，而Adam的等变性受坐标变换破坏。这为理解等价参数化下的优化差异提供了可解析的基准与判据。

title: SpecQuant: Speculative Decoding with Multi-Parent Quantization for Adaptive LLM Inference
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure. Published in the 2026 Fifth International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
summary: Running large language models (LLMs) locally continues to be limited by restrictions of compute and memory on consumer hardware. The popular acceleration technologies, such as quantization, speculative decoding, and adaptive inferencing, offer substantial speed boosts but usually necessitate retraining, per architecture tuning, or draft models. SpecQuant is a trainingfree framework, that combines speculative decoding with multiparent quantization to perform adaptive, efficient inference of LLMs. SpecQuant derives multiple quantized variants (INT4, FP8, FP16) from a shared base model, and dynamically routes queries based on predicted complexity; lightweight variants are used for simple or factual tasks, and full-precision models are used for complex reasoning tasks or long-context inputs. The shared-weight design of SpecQuant ensures sufficient token acceptance for speculative decoding without compatibility issues using separate draft parent models. We evaluate SpecQuant on Qwen2.5 based models on the MMLU, AlpacaEval, and GSM8K datasets, or benchmarks, demonstrating 35-43% speedups without degrading accuracy greater than 2%, substantial within the LLM community. SpecQuant enables practical on-device LLM deployment across diverse hardware without special infrastructure or expertise.

AI.tldr: SpecQuant：一种免训练框架，结合投机解码与多父量化，实现LLM自适应高效推理，在MMLU等基准上取得35–43%加速且精度损失不超过2%。
AI.motivation: 在消费级硬件上本地运行大语言模型受限于算力与内存。现有加速技术（量化、投机解码、自适应推理）虽能显著提速，但通常需要重训练、针对特定架构调优或额外草稿模型。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架SpecQuant，将投机解码与多父量化结合。由同一基座模型派生出INT4、FP8、FP16多种量化变体，基于预测的查询复杂度动态路由：简单或事实性任务使用轻量变体，复杂推理或长上下文输入使用全精度模型。共享权重设计保证投机解码有足够的token接受率，且无需独立草稿父模型，避免兼容性问题。
AI.result: 在基于Qwen2.5的模型上，于MMLU、AlpacaEval、GSM8K数据集/基准进行评测，实现35–43%的加速，且精度下降不超过2%。
AI.conclusion: SpecQuant可无需特殊基础设施或专业知识，支持跨多种硬件的实用化端侧LLM部署。

title: GEM-MPC: Balancing Exploration and Exploitation through Expert-Guided Planning
summary: Effective exploration in high-dimensional continuous control remains a central challenge in reinforcement learning. Planning-based methods address this by combining online planning with learned policies and value functions, but their components can become misaligned during training: learned sampling policies may diverge from planner behavior, while planning distributions stored in replay become stale as the model and value function evolve. Reanalysis can refresh these targets, but at substantial computational cost. We propose GEM-MPC, an MPPI-based reinforcement learning method that improves the interaction between planning and learning. GEM-MPC uses MPPI to combine a policy trained to clone the planner with a KL-regularized policy that explores around it, providing complementary exploitation and guided exploration within planning. We further introduce Gated Prior Distillation, which selectively learns from stored planning distributions only when they provide a better target than the current prior, reducing the impact of stale planning data without requiring full reanalysis. Across continuous-control benchmarks, GEM-MPC consistently outperforms existing planning-based baselines under lower computational budgets.

AI.tldr: GEM-MPC是一种基于MPPI的强化学习框架，通过融合克隆规划器的策略与KL正则化探索策略，并提出门控先验蒸馏机制，在低计算预算下提升规划与学习的一致性及连续控制性能。
AI.motivation: 高维连续控制中的高效探索仍是强化学习核心难题。基于规划的方法结合在线规划与学习到的策略和价值函数，但训练中组件易失配：采样策略偏离规划器行为，回放中的规划分布随模型与价值函数演化而过时，而重分析虽可刷新目标却计算代价高昂。
AI.method: 提出GEM-MPC：利用MPPI在规划中融合两个策略——一个克隆规划器的策略与一个围绕其进行探索的KL正则化策略，从而同时提供利用与引导探索；并引入门控先验蒸馏（Gated Prior Distillation），仅在存储的规划分布优于当前先验时选择性地从中学习，无需完整重分析即可缓解过时规划数据的影响。
AI.result: 在多个连续控制基准上，GEM-MPC在更低计算预算下持续优于现有基于规划的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过改进规划与学习之间的交互，GEM-MPC以较低计算开销实现了更优的规划一致性与探索效率。

title: GraphSkillEvo: Evolutionary Optimization of Graph-Structured Agent Skills
summary: Skills can improve the performance of Large Language Model (LLM) agents by providing task-specific procedural guidance, while skill optimization further improves their effectiveness through iterative refinement. However, existing skill optimization methods typically represent skills as unstructured natural-language instructions, creating two key challenges: 1) Unstructured skills often lack explicit workflow-level guidance and contain substantial redundancy, making them difficult for LLMs to execute; 2) the vast search space of unconstrained natural-language skills makes skill optimization ineffective. To address these challenges, we propose representing skills as graph-structured natural-language artifacts. In graph-structured skills, each node represents an execution step together with its operational guidance, while directed edges encode context-dependent transitions between steps. Compared to unstructured skills, graph-structured skills can provide clear workflow-level guidance. Moreover, the proposed graph-structured skill can also facilitate skill optimization. Building on this structured representation, we introduce GraphSkillEvo, a population-based evolutionary optimization framework with mutation and crossover operators for graph-structured skills. By maintaining multiple candidate skills and combining effective components, GraphSkillEvo enables broader and more comprehensive exploration of the structured skill space than purely LLM-based iterative self-refinement. Extensive experiments across five agent benchmarks demonstrate that GraphSkillEvo consistently outperforms the strong skill optimization baseline SkillOpt, improving average accuracy by 4.01% on GPT-5.4-nano and 1.76% on GPT-5.4. Our code is available at https://github.com/ruisun7/GraphSkillEvo.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将技能表示为图结构的自然语言产物，并构建基于种群进化的优化框架 GraphSkillEvo，在五个智能体基准上显著优于现有技能优化基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体技能优化方法将技能表示为非结构化自然语言指令，存在两大问题：一是缺乏显式的工作流级指导且冗余严重，LLM 难以执行；二是无约束的自然语言技能搜索空间过大，导致优化效率低下。
AI.method: 将技能建模为图结构的自然语言产物：节点表示执行步骤及其操作指导，有向边编码步骤间依赖上下文的转移关系。基于该结构化表示，提出 GraphSkillEvo——一种基于种群的进化优化框架，包含针对图结构技能的变异与交叉算子，通过维护多个候选技能并组合有效组件，实现比纯 LLM 迭代自精炼更广泛、更全面的结构化技能空间探索。
AI.result: 在五个智能体基准上的大量实验表明，GraphSkillEvo 持续优于强基线 SkillOpt，在 GPT-5.4-nano 上平均准确率提升 4.01%，在 GPT-5.4 上提升 1.76%。
AI.conclusion: 图结构的技能表示可提供清晰的工作流级指导并促进技能优化，结合种群进化框架能有效扩大并深化技能空间的探索，为 LLM 智能体的技能优化提供了新范式。

title: Bilevel Optimization of Topology and Hyperparameters (BOTH)
comment: Currently under submission to SMO journal
summary: Topology optimization (TO) represents a significant step towards automating the design process: given a working simulation, TO can produce a viable prototype at the press of a button by differentiating the simulation and iteratively improving the design. In practice, however, TO is riddled with ``magic numbers''---hyperparameters whose tuning significantly affects the outcome. Finding the right values typically requires not only deep problem-specific knowledge but also extensive trial-and-error. While practitioners can use surrogate-assisted hyperparameter optimization as an alternative, this approach requires strictly limiting the number of hyperparameters through careful problem formulation. Here, we propose differentiating TO itself using automatic differentiation. This yields ``hypergradients'' that allow us to tune these hyperparameters in tandem with the primary optimization. We show that evaluating just one or two steps of TO is sufficiently informative and that the method scales favorably to thousands of hyperparameters at an expense comparable to only a few standard TO runs. We demonstrate this approach on stress-constrained and compliance problems, with the latter utilizing a neural parameterization of the density field.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出对拓扑优化过程本身进行自动微分以获得"超梯度"，从而与主优化同步调优众多超参数，实验证明一两步拓扑优化即可提供充分信息，方法可扩展到数千个超参数且代价仅相当于数次标准优化运行。
AI.motivation: 拓扑优化（TO）虽能自动化设计流程，但实际应用中高度依赖"魔法数字"——超参数，其调优需要深厚的领域知识和大量试错。替代方案（代理模型辅助的超参数优化）又要求通过精心的问题表述来严格限制超参数数量。
AI.method: 利用自动微分对拓扑优化本身求导，得到"超梯度"（hypergradients），使得超参数能够与主优化过程同步调优。仅评估一两步拓扑优化即可获得足够信息，并使方法能够扩展到数千个超参数。
AI.result: 在应力约束问题和柔度问题上验证了该方法，其中柔度问题采用了密度场的神经参数化。方法可扩展到数千个超参数，计算代价与仅运行几次标准拓扑优化相当。
AI.conclusion: 对拓扑优化本身进行自动微分可有效解决超参数调优难题，突破了传统替代方法的规模限制，为拓扑优化中超参数的自动调优提供了可行且高效的途径。

title: RegKT: Interpretable and Robust Deep Knowledge Tracing With IRT-Regularizer
summary: As deep learning models continue to advance, knowledge tracing models have achieved higher accuracy. However, these gains come at the cost of reduced interpretability, which is crucial for practitioners in educational settings to adopt new methodologies. Additionally, deep learning models are prone to overfitting, particularly when dealing with the small datasets that are common in educational applications. In this paper, we propose a novel regularization technique designed to enhance the robustness of deep-learning-based knowledge tracing models, while simultaneously improving their interpretability. Our method addresses both the interpretability and overfitting challenges, making it more feasible for real-world educational applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新型正则化技术，旨在同时提升深度学习知识追踪模型的鲁棒性与可解释性，缓解小数据集上的过拟合问题。
AI.motivation: 深度学习知识追踪模型虽精度提升，但可解释性下降，且在小规模教育数据集上易过拟合，阻碍教育实践者采用。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的正则化技术，用于增强深度学习知识追踪模型的鲁棒性，并同时改善其可解释性。
AI.result: 该技术同时应对可解释性与过拟合两大挑战（摘要未给出具体量化结果）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法使深度学习知识追踪更适用于真实教育场景。

title: LLMs as Feature Engineers for Text-and-Tabular Prediction
summary: We introduce an iterative framework that automates the extraction of interpretable, schema-bound categorical features from unstructured text for tabular prediction models. To navigate the feature space, a generator LLM proposes semantic definitions, a separate extractor LLM materializes the features, and a downstream tabular model evaluates their predictive performance. We optimize this search by translating explicit model errors, such as AUC ranking inversions, into natural-language feedback, steering the LLM to resolve specific predictive failures. Evaluated across three public datasets, this error-driven loop accelerates feature discovery by up to $3\times$ compared to unguided search. Empirically, the generated features demonstrate strong multi-view complementarity, strictly outperforming any subset when combined with TF-IDF and dense embeddings. Finally, the framework guarantees instance-level interpretability: the discovered features dominate SHAP importance rankings and provide a fully transparent, semantic audit trail for every prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种迭代框架，利用生成器LLM提出语义定义、抽取器LLM物化特征，并由下游表格模型评估性能，通过将模型误差（如AUC排序倒挂）转化为自然语言反馈来引导搜索，从而从非结构化文本中自动提取可解释、schema约束的分类特征。在三份公开数据集上，误差驱动循环将特征发现速度提升最高3倍，生成特征与TF-IDF和稠密嵌入结合时严格优于任一子集，并保证实例级可解释性，SHAP重要性排名中占据主导并提供透明的语义审计轨迹。
AI.motivation: 从非结构化文本中为表格预测模型提取可解释、schema约束的分类特征通常依赖人工设计，成本高且难以保证下游性能；同时LLM自动特征生成往往缺乏针对性的搜索引导，导致发现效率低。作者希望构建一种自动化、误差驱动且可解释的特征发现机制，以提升特征搜索效率并保持预测性能与透明度。
AI.method: 提出迭代式自动特征提取框架：生成器LLM负责提出候选特征的语义定义，抽取器LLM负责将定义物化为具体的实例级特征，下游表格模型评估这些特征的预测性能。搜索过程通过将显式模型误差（例如AUC排序倒挂）翻译为自然语言反馈，引导LLM针对特定预测失败进行修正与再生成，从而优化特征空间探索。
AI.result: 在三份公开数据集上评估：误差驱动循环将特征发现速度相较无引导搜索提升最高约3倍；生成的类别特征表现出较强的多视图互补性，与TF-IDF和稠密嵌入结合后严格优于任一单独特征子集；在实例级可解释性方面，所发现特征在SHAP重要性排名中占据主导，并为每次预测提供完全透明、语义化的审计轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 误差驱动的LLM迭代框架能够高效自动化地从非结构化文本中提取可解释、schema约束的分类特征，在提升搜索效率的同时增强多视图互补性与实例级可解释性，为表格预测模型提供了一条兼顾性能、效率与透明度的特征工程路径。

title: ExpBoN: Exponential-Noise Best-of-$n$ for Efficient Test-Time LLM Alignment
summary: Best-of-$n$ (BoN) sampling is a simple yet effective inference-time alignment method, but hard maximization provides only coarse control over the trade-off between reward and distribution shift. Soft Best-of-$n$ (Verdun et al. 2025) provides smoother control and converges to the optimal distribution associated with KL-regularized reward maximization. In this paper, we introduce ExpBoN, an alternative soft BoN method based on the exponential-noise report-noisy-max mechanism. It admits an exact finite-$n$ decomposition, which yields exponentially fast convergence in total variation, expected reward, and both directions of KL divergence. We provide comprehensive theoretical analyses of its convergence and regret behavior. We further integrate ExpBoN into the guided speculative inference (GSI) framework (Geuter, Mroueh, and AlvarezMelis 2025), resulting in ExpGSI, for efficient reward-guided LLM alignment. ExpGSI yields substantial reductions in computational cost while maintaining comparable accuracy. Experiments on MATH500, MMLU-STEM, and Minerva Math with the Qwen2.5-Math and Qwen3 model families show that ExpGSI reduces estimated computation by $14\%$-$39\%$ across candidate budgets for Qwen2.5-Math and by up to $45\%$ at $n=16$ for Qwen3. Overall, our results provide a theoretical and algorithmic foundation for exponential-noise BoN and efficient test-time LLM alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ExpBoN，一种基于指数噪声 report-noisy-max 机制的软 Best-of-n 采样方法，并集成到 guided speculative inference 框架形成 ExpGSI，实现高效奖励引导的 LLM 对齐，在降低计算成本的同时保持精度。
AI.motivation: Best-of-n 采样是简单有效的推理时对齐方法，但硬最大化对奖励与分布偏移之间的权衡控制过于粗糙。Soft Best-of-n 提供更平滑的控制并收敛到 KL 正则化奖励最大化的最优分布，因此需要探索替代性的软 BoN 方法及其高效推理实现。
AI.method: 提出 ExpBoN，基于指数噪声的 report-noisy-max 机制实现软 BoN。该方法具有精确的有限 n 分解，可实现总变差、期望奖励及双向 KL 散度的指数级快速收敛。进一步将 ExpBoN 集成到 guided speculative inference（GSI）框架，得到 ExpGSI，用于高效奖励引导的 LLM 对齐。
AI.result: 提供了 ExpBoN 收敛性与遗憾行为的全面理论分析。在 MATH500、MMLU-STEM 和 Minerva Math 上，使用 Qwen2.5-Math 与 Qwen3 模型族实验表明：ExpGSI 在各候选预算下对 Qwen2.5-Math 减少约 14%-39% 的估算计算量，对 Qwen3 在 n=16 时减少最多 45%，同时保持可比精度。
AI.conclusion: 结果为指数噪声 BoN 及高效测试时 LLM 对齐提供了理论与算法基础。

title: Intervention Granularity Matters: Coherent Treatment Bundles in Counterfactual Simulation with Clinical World Models
summary: Counterfactual simulation with a clinical world model means fixing a patient's history, changing the treatment, and reading off the predicted response. Doing so requires deciding what counts as one intervention. In clinical settings, interventions are documented as bundles: a co-occurrence audit of 945,707 patient-hours from MIMIC-IV shows groups of components, such as every parameter of a dialysis circuit, that never appear apart, so an edit that changes one component on its own describes an hour that never occurs in the data. We hypothesize that the granularity at which an intervention is edited changes how a world model responds, and test this with Clin-JEPA, a latent world model of patient trajectories conditioned on hourly treatment text. At 1,019 documented onsets of invasive ventilation, we keep the patient's history and other treatments fixed and compare editing one ventilator setting with editing the complete configuration recorded for a real patient with the most similar recent trajectory. The complete bundle moves the predicted next state further than any single setting, consistently across all five settings, and the difference remains after accounting for how much each edit changes the model's input. Intervention granularity therefore materially affects the response of a clinical world model: single-component edits may understate treatment sensitivity, and bundle-aware editing may offer a better-supported basis for counterfactual treatment simulation.

AI.tldr: 在临床世界模型中，干预的编辑粒度会实质影响反事实预测结果：临床干预以"捆绑包"形式记录，单组件编辑会低估治疗敏感度，而捆绑包感知编辑更合理。
AI.motivation: 临床反事实模拟需要确定"何为一次干预"。但在真实临床中，干预以捆绑形式记录（如透析回路的每个参数从不单独出现），单独修改某一组件会描述数据中从未出现过的小时。作者假设：编辑干预的粒度会改变世界模型的响应，并对此进行验证。
AI.method: 对MIMIC-IV中945,707患者-小时进行共现审计，确认捆绑组件从不单独出现。构建Clin-JEPA——以每小时治疗文本为条件的患者轨迹潜在世界模型。在1,019个有创通气记录起点上，固定患者历史与其他治疗，比较"编辑单个呼吸机设置"与"编辑真实相似轨迹患者所记录的完整配置"两种方式。
AI.result: 完整捆绑包使预测的下一状态移动幅度大于任何单一设置，且在全部五个设置上一致；在控制编辑对模型输入改变量之后，这一差异依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 干预粒度对临床世界模型的响应有实质影响。单组件编辑可能低估治疗敏感度，捆绑包感知编辑为反事实治疗模拟提供了更有依据的基础。

title: Beyond Kinematics: Benchmarking Simulation Fidelity for Muscle-Driven Imitation Learning
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables, submitted to ICRA 2027
summary: In this work, we conduct a systematic comparison of two state-of-the-art motion-imitation reinforcement learning (MIRL) pipelines, one built on SCONE/HyFyDy and one built on MuJoCo/MyoSim. HyFyDy emphasizes physiological realism through detailed musculotendon modeling, while MuJoCo prioritizes computational efficiency and scalable policy learning. While recent work has demonstrated that both pipelines reproduce human kinematics with high fidelity, it remains unclear if they accurately capture the underlying neuromuscular behavior that produced the movement. This limitation is particularly important for robotic assistive-device design and control, where outcome measures such as muscle activation patterns and metabolic cost are often used as optimization targets.
