To conduct a systematic comparison, our work compares both pipelines using a common set of human motion-capture and electromyography (EMG) measurements. The results find that while both pipelines produce similar kinematics with relative accuracy, the muscle activations from HyFyDy are more aligned with the experimental EMG, as supported by the average pooled (RMSE, r) values for muscle activations from HyFyDy and MuJoCo: (0.164, 0.4) and (0.344, 0.11), respectively. While we conclude that the more advanced physiological realism of HyFyDy currently makes it more suitable for musculoskeletal modeling, both require further development to bring physiological realism to GPU-parallelizable simulation environments and advance robotic assistive device design.

AI.tldr: 系统对比SCONE/HyFyDy与MuJoCo/MyoSim两条运动模仿强化学习流程：两者运动学精度相近，但HyFyDy的肌电激活与实验EMG更吻合，更适合肌骨建模。
AI.motivation: 现有MIRL流程虽能高保真复现人体运动学，但是否能捕捉产生该运动的神经肌肉行为尚不明确；该问题对以肌肉激活模式和代谢代价为优化目标的机器人辅助装置设计至关重要。
AI.method: 采用同一套人体运动捕捉与肌电（EMG）测量数据，系统对比两条最先进流程：基于SCONE/HyFyDy（强调肌腱精细建模的生理真实性）与基于MuJoCo/MyoSim（强调计算效率与可扩展策略学习）。
AI.result: 两者均能相对准确地产生相似的运动学；但肌肉激活与实验EMG的对齐程度，HyFyDy明显优于MuJoCo。平均合并（RMSE, r）指标：HyFyDy为(0.164, 0.4)，MuJoCo为(0.344, 0.11)。
AI.conclusion: 更先进的生理真实性使HyFyDy当前更适合肌骨建模；但两者均需进一步发展，以在GPU可并行仿真环境中实现生理真实性，从而推进机器人辅助装置设计。

title: Kinks vs. Smoothness: Identifiability of Real Analytic nICA for Laplace-like Sources
summary: Many machine learning systems try to explain complex data - like images or financial time series - in terms of hidden, independent factors that generated them. Recovering the true underlying factors, rather than some scrambled version of them, is the central challenge of nonlinear Independent Component Analysis (nICA). We prove identifiability (exact recovery) up to trivial ambiguities for real analytic generating functions when source probability density functions have a finite number of discontinuities in the first derivative. The Laplace distribution is the most prominent example satisfying this assumption. Our proof relies on the contrast between kinks in the source distribution and the smoothness of real analytic functions. Real analytic functions comprise a broad class of generating mechanisms, and can be approximated with Normalizing Flows or Variational Autoencoders with standard activation functions (e.g., tanh, softplus, GELU), so our result applies with minimal changes to existing training pipelines. We perform experiments on real and synthetic data with both Normalizing Flows and Variational Auto-Encoders demonstrating their identifiability properties. In experiments on CelebA data we recover several interpretable latent factors controlling unique attributes across the dataset.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了在源分布概率密度函数一阶导数仅有有限个不连续点时，实解析生成函数下的非线性独立成分分析（nICA）可实现可辨识性（精确恢复至平凡歧义），并用正规化流和变分自编码器实验验证。
AI.motivation: 机器学习系统常需用隐藏的独立因子解释图像或金融时间序列等复杂数据，核心挑战是从非线性混合中恢复真实因子而非打乱版本，即非线性独立成分分析（nICA）的可辨识性问题。已有工作对生成函数和源分布假设较强，限制了适用范围。
AI.method: 假设生成函数为实解析函数，源概率密度函数具有有限个一阶导数不连续点（如拉普拉斯分布）；利用源分布中的"拐点（kinks）"与实解析函数光滑性之间的对比来构造可辨识性证明。实解析函数类范围广泛，可用标准激活函数（tanh、softplus、GELU）的正规化流或变分自编码器近似，因此结论可最小改动地应用于现有训练流程。
AI.result: 在真实与合成数据上，使用正规化流和变分自编码器进行实验，验证了其可辨识性；在CelebA数据集上恢复出若干可解释的潜在因子，分别控制数据集中独特的属性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将nICA可辨识性推广到实解析生成函数与一类含有限不连续点的源分布（如拉普拉斯分布），且与主流深度生成模型训练流程兼容，为可解释表示学习提供了理论与实证支持。

title: Joint Remaining Useful Life Prediction and Capacity Estimation of Lithium-Ion Batteries Using Partial-Charging Data
summary: Joint remaining useful life (RUL) prediction and capacity estimation require representations of both gradual degradation and recent battery behavior. This paper presents a cross-expert framework using partial-charging measurements without measured historical full-cycle capacity as an input. The RUL Expert encodes nominal 10-min segments from ten cycles sampled within a 30-cycle history using a pretrained gated recurrent unit (GRU) encoder, a two-dimensional convolutional neural network (2D-CNN), and a temporal GRU. The Capacity Expert processes statistical descriptors of nominal 40-min segments from ten consecutive cycles using a 2D-CNN and a Transformer. A feature-wise linear modulation module uses the short-term representation to condition the long-term representation for joint prediction. Training comprises supervised autoencoder pretraining, independent expert pretraining, and fusion training with frozen experts. On two public battery-aging datasets, the reference configuration achieves mean RUL root-mean-square errors of 143.69 and 161.10 cycles and capacity errors of 12.36 and 7.28mAh, respectively. On Dataset I, fusion reduces both mean errors relative to either standalone expert. The results demonstrate a trade-off between RUL and capacity accuracy: the proposed method attains the lowest reported RUL RMSE among the compared methods on both datasets, whereas several baselines yield lower capacity errors.

AI.tldr: 提出"跨专家"框架，仅用部分充电测量、无需历史满充容量，通过RUL专家与容量专家特征调制融合，实现联合RUL预测与容量估计。
AI.motivation: 联合RUL预测与容量估计需同时表征电池的长期渐进退化与近期行为；且实际中常缺乏历史满充容量测量，故需在部分充电数据下实现双任务预测。
AI.method: RUL专家：对30循环历史内采样的10个循环、标称10分钟片段，用预训练GRU编码器+2D-CNN+时序GRU编码；容量专家：对连续10循环、标称40分钟片段的统计描述子，用2D-CNN+Transformer处理；用特征级线性调制（FiLM）以短期表征调制长期表征实现联合预测；训练分三阶段：监督自编码器预训练、各专家独立预训练、冻结专家后的融合训练。
AI.result: 在两个公开电池老化数据集上，参考配置取得平均RUL RMSE为143.69与161.10循环，容量误差为12.36与7.28 mAh；在数据集I上，融合相较任一单独专家均降低两类平均误差。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了RUL与容量精度之间的权衡：所提方法在两个数据集上取得对比方法中最低的RUL RMSE，但多个基线在容量误差上更优。

title: Learning to Move Cities: Deep Meta-Models and Reinforcement Policies for Calibration and Control in Urban Networks
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures. Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 2026 IEEE 29th International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC), Naples, Italy. (c) 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted; permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses
summary: Urban transportation networks present complex optimization challenges spanning calibration of high-fidelity simulators and real-time operational control. This paper presents a shared latent-space framework that connects simulator calibration and reinforcement learning control through a common learned representation of urban traffic dynamics. First, we develop a combinatorial MLP-autoencoder architecture that learns low-dimensional manifolds linking simulator inputs (origin-destination demand, network parameters) to outputs (travel times, congestion patterns), enabling efficient Bayesian optimization for calibration. This approach demonstrates superior sample efficiency compared to traditional dimension reduction methods, achieving better fit to observational data within fixed computational budgets. Second, we implement a deep Q-learning agent with experience replay and target networks to optimize dynamic traffic assignment through scheduling and routing adjustments. In empirical evaluations on benchmark networks, our approach reduces system-wide travel times by up to 51% compared to baseline operations. The learned latent representation is not only used to reduce the dimensionality of Bayesian calibration, but is also incorporated into the reinforcement learning state representation, allowing the control policy to operate on compressed and calibrated traffic dynamics. This shared latent-space formulation provides a unified pathway from simulator calibration to adaptive operational control within intelligent transportation systems. Our results highlight the transformative potential of deep learning methods in urban mobility planning and management, particularly for large-scale networks where traditional optimization approaches face computational bottlenecks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个共享隐空间框架，通过统一的学习表征将交通仿真器校准与强化学习控制相连接，实现从校准到自适应控制的端到端优化。
AI.motivation: 城市交通网络优化面临高保真仿真器校准成本高、实时运行控制困难的双重挑战，传统方法在大规模网络上存在计算瓶颈，且校准与控制通常相互割裂。
AI.method: 1）设计组合式MLP自编码器，学习连接仿真器输入（OD需求、网络参数）与输出（行程时间、拥堵模式）的低维流形，用于高效贝叶斯优化校准；2）构建带经验回放和目标网络的深度Q学习智能体，通过调度与路径调整优化动态交通分配；3）将共享隐表征同时用于降低贝叶斯校准维度并纳入强化学习状态表示。
AI.result: 在基准网络上，相比传统降维方法，所提自编码器在固定计算预算下样本效率更高、对观测数据拟合更佳；控制策略使系统整体行程时间相比基线运营最多降低51%。
AI.conclusion: 共享隐空间表述为智能交通系统提供了从仿真器校准到自适应运行控制的统一路径，展示了深度学习方法在城市出行规划与管理中的变革潜力，尤其适用于传统优化方法面临计算瓶颈的大规模网络。

title: RACER: Role-Aligned Competence Estimation for Human-AI Routing
summary: Learning to defer asks a predictive system when to act autonomously and when to defer to a human expert. Population-adaptive deferral extends this problem to unseen experts using a small context set of expert behavior. Neural context encoders such as L2D-Pop can be query-dependent, but may learn routing shortcuts tied to absolute class coordinates. Identity-Free Deferral (IFD) removes such shortcuts through role-indexed classwise competence profiles, but its estimates are constant within each class and cannot capture instance-level expert specialization. We propose RACER---Role-Aligned Competence Estimation for Routing---a role-relative framework for estimating an unseen expert's competence from context. RACER estimates the posterior-predictive probability that the expert is correct on a query under each candidate class role, then combines these estimates with the model posterior to obtain the Bayes-relevant expert-correctness probability. Nonparametric and neural kernel-pooling estimators use candidate-role relations, shared aggregation, and symmetric summaries, excluding absolute class-identity channels. We prove coherent class-relabelling invariance, derive a Bayes-aligned deferral surrogate, and give a plug-in regret bound relating routing regret to classifier and competence-estimation error. On controlled synthetic benchmarks, including a PathMNIST histopathology context-scaling study with simulated experts, RACER benefits from additional context under hidden subtype dependence and gives the strongest aggregate performance on a separately sampled unseen-expert split in the CIFAR-100 synthetic experiments. On the radiologist and human--AI chest-radiography benchmarks (VinDr-CXR and CheXpert), the RACER family is competitive or best in budget-swept deferral, with calibration results varying across metrics and datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RACER——一种角色对齐的能力估计路由框架，通过角色相对估计未见专家在查询上的正确概率，并与模型后验结合，实现类别重标记不变且贝叶斯对齐的延迟决策。
AI.motivation: 群体自适应延迟需借助少量专家行为上下文集适配未见专家。现有神经上下文编码器（如L2D-Pop）可能依赖绝对类别坐标学习路由捷径；IFD虽通过角色索引的类别能力剖面消除捷径，但其估计在每个类别内为常数，无法刻画实例级专家专长。
AI.method: RACER在每个候选类别角色下估计专家在查询上正确的后验预测概率，再结合模型后验得到贝叶斯相关的专家正确概率。采用非参数与神经核池化估计器，利用候选—角色关系、共享聚合与对称摘要，排除绝对类别身份通道。理论层面证明类别重标记一致性不变性，推导贝叶斯对齐的延迟代理损失，并给出将路由遗憾关联于分类器与能力估计误差的插入式遗憾界。
AI.result: 在受控合成基准（含PathMNIST组织病理学上下文扩展实验与模拟专家）上，RACER在隐藏亚型依赖下能受益于更多上下文；在CIFAR-100合成实验的独立采样未见专家划分上取得最佳总体表现。在VinDr-CXR与CheXpert放射科及人机胸片基准上，RACER族在预算扫描延迟中具竞争力或最优，标定结果因指标与数据集而异。
AI.conclusion: RACER通过角色相对、类别身份无关的能力估计，兼顾贝叶斯对齐与类别重标记不变性，在合成与真实医学延迟基准上验证了有效性，为群体自适应延迟提供了一种可扩展且理论可解释的框架。

title: Time series generation with spectrally aligned latent flow matching
summary: Latent flow models have proven to be a reliable and cost-effective method for time series generation. However, the latent compression induces unwanted artefacts, such as a spectral mismatch with respect to the underlying dataset, thus hindering their use as training surrogates. In this article, we propose a spectrally-aligned latent-flow time series generator, where the latent space for flow matching is trained to preserve dynamical properties that are relevant for the suitability of synthetic samples. We find that incorporating fine-tuning losses based on canonical signal representations such as the Fourier, wavelet and signature transforms helps overcome these issues. The interpretability of these transformations allows us to ensure that the synthetic signals are aligned with the true ones in terms of relevant features, such as smoothness or targeted spectral content, as opposed to relying on pointwise reconstruction losses only. We compare the proposed aligned models against a base latent-flow model and the state of the art over real-world long-range univariate and multivariate benchmark datasets. Our quantitative results validate the superiority of the proposed method in terms of its performance on metrics reflecting signal realness and computational efficiency, while being aligned to the training set with respect to its local structure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种频谱对齐的潜变量流（latent-flow）时间序列生成器，通过在流匹配潜空间中引入基于傅里叶、小波和签名变换的微调损失，解决潜压缩导致的频谱失配问题，从而生成更真实、高效且与真实数据在局部结构上对齐的合成时间序列。
AI.motivation: 潜变量流模型是成本高效的时间序列生成方法，但潜压缩会引入不希望的伪影，尤其是与底层数据集之间的频谱失配，从而限制了其作为训练替代数据（training surrogate）的可用性。
AI.method: 提出频谱对齐的潜变量流时间序列生成器，将用于流匹配的潜空间训练为保留与合成样本适用性相关的动态特性。具体地，引入基于典型信号表示（傅里叶变换、小波变换和签名变换）的微调损失，利用这些变换的可解释性，确保合成信号在平滑度或目标频谱内容等相关特征上与真实信号对齐，而非仅依赖逐点重建损失。
AI.result: 在真实世界的长程单变量和多变量基准数据集上，将所提对齐模型与基础潜变量流模型及当前最优方法进行对比。定量结果显示，所提方法在反映信号真实性的指标及计算效率上均具优势，并在局部结构上与训练集保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 基于傅里叶、小波和签名变换的频谱对齐微调损失，可有效克服潜压缩带来的频谱失配问题，使潜变量流生成器在信号真实性、计算效率与局部结构对齐方面优于基线及现有最优方法。

title: Assessment of Machine Learning-Based Critical Heat Flux Models in the CTF Subchannel Code for Square Rod Bundle Prediction
summary:
The prediction of critical heat flux (CHF), a key safety-related quantity in nuclear thermal hydraulics, remains an important challenge due to its direct relationship with fuel performance and reactor safety. Recent studies have demonstrated that relative to traditional empirical correlations and lookup tables (LUTs), machine learning (ML) methods can substantially improve CHF prediction accuracy. Most ML-based CHF models, however, have been developed and evaluated using tube databases, leaving their applicability to reactor-relevant rod bundle geometries largely unexplored.
  This study evaluates ML-based CHF models deployed within the CTF subchannel code using the Electric Power Research Institute (EPRI) rod bundle CHF database. Both pure and hybrid residual correction models are considered in local and semilocal formulations. The tube-trained ML CHF models generally transferred favorably to rod bundle applications and outperformed traditional CHF methods across most geometries and operating conditions. The local hybrid LUT model produced the strongest overall performance, and the semilocal pure ML model remained highly competitive. Comparison against the Bowring correlation, W-3 correlation, and 2006 Groeneveld LUT demonstrated that substantial improvements in rod bundle CHF prediction are possible even when models are trained exclusively on tube data. These findings provide one of the first large-scale assessments of ML-based CHF models in square rod bundles within a production-level subchannel analysis environment and support their broader application in reactor thermal hydraulic analysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究在CTF子通道程序中，利用EPRI棒束CHF数据库评估了基于机器学习的临界热流密度（CHF）模型，涵盖纯模型与混合残差修正模型、局部与半局部形式。结果表明，管训练ML模型可较好地迁移到棒束工况，大多数情况下优于传统CHF方法，其中局部混合LUT模型整体表现最佳，半局部纯ML模型也极具竞争力，验证了ML方法在反应堆热工水力分析中的推广潜力。
AI.motivation: CHF预测是核热工水力中的关键安全量，直接关系燃料性能与反应堆安全。尽管机器学习方法相比传统经验关联式和查找表（LUT）显著提高了CHF预测精度，但现有ML模型多基于圆管数据库开发与评估，其在反应堆相关棒束几何中的适用性尚不明确，因此需要开展面向棒束的大规模评估。
AI.method: 研究将ML-based CHF模型部署于CTF子通道程序中，采用EPRI棒束CHF数据库进行评估。模型形式包括纯ML模型与混合残差修正模型，并分别考虑局部（local）与半局部（semilocal）两种建模框架。评估结果与Bowring关联式、W-3关联式以及2006 Groeneveld LUT进行对比。
AI.result: 基于圆管数据训练的ML CHF模型总体上能较好地迁移至棒束应用，并在大多数几何和运行工况下优于传统CHF方法。其中，局部混合LUT模型整体性能最强，半局部纯ML模型也保持高度竞争力。与Bowring、W-3关联式及2006 Groeneveld LUT的对比表明，即使仅使用管数据训练，也能在棒束CHF预测上取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次在生产级子通道分析环境中对方形棒束内的ML-based CHF模型进行了大规模评估，证实了ML模型跨几何迁移的可行性，并支持其在反应堆热工水力分析中的更广泛应用。

title: Abstention and Noise Filtering: Two Missing Primitives of Softmax Attention
comment: 21 pages (8 pages main text plus appendices), 5 figures, 12 tables
summary: Gating the value pathway of attention reportedly improves language model pretraining, and prior studies disagree on why. We argue and provide experimental evidence that such gates supply two different things that softmax attention lacks: abstention and noise filtering. The first is abstention, which allows an attention head to output nothing, bypassing the requirement that attention weights must sum to one. The second is noise filtering, which allows the value pathway of an attention head to suppress interference from superposed features in the residual stream. In our experiments in matched models from 10M to 350M parameters, we supply abstention through a learned per-head sink logit in the softmax and noise filtering through a gate on each value. We report three empirical findings. First, the benefit of abstention, measured as the reduction in validation loss relative to a matched baseline, declines as models grow, whereas the benefit of noise filtering increases with scale. In particular, abstention accounts for nearly all of the gain from gating at 10M and filtering for most of it at 350M. Second, the best model at every scale is the one with both primitives built in. Third, injecting controlled interference into the values a head reads confirms that the gate removes such interference, and reveals that each of the two gate forms we study has a characteristic blind spot. Supplying both primitives adds negligible parameters and remains compatible with the key-value cache.

AI.tldr: 本文认为注意力中的门控提供了softmax注意力缺失的两种能力——放弃（abstention）与噪声过滤，并通过10M–350M参数的匹配实验验证：放弃的收益随规模下降，噪声过滤的收益随规模上升，同时具备两者时各规模均最优，且额外参数极少并兼容KV缓存。
AI.motivation: 已有研究报道对注意力值通路进行门控能改善语言模型预训练，但对其原因存在分歧。作者希望厘清门控究竟带来何种能力，从而解释并统一这些相互矛盾的观察。
AI.method: 在10M至350M参数的匹配模型上进行实验。通过可学习的逐头sink logit在softmax中实现放弃，通过对每个value施加门控实现噪声过滤；比较基线、仅门控、仅sink以及两者兼备的模型，并人为向value注入受控干扰以检验门控的过滤作用。
AI.result: 三点发现：其一，放弃的收益（相对基线的验证损失下降）随模型增大而减小，噪声过滤的收益则随规模增大而增加——10M时门控收益几乎全部来自放弃，350M时主要来自过滤；其二，各规模下同时内置两种原语的最优；其三，受控干扰实验证实门控能去除干扰，并揭示两类门控各有特征性盲区。
AI.conclusion: 门控的价值可分解为放弃与噪声过滤两种互补原语，二者随规模的贡献此消彼长，需同时具备才能在各规模取得最优。该方案额外参数可忽略，且与KV缓存兼容，具备实际部署可行性。

title: COMPLEX: A Closed-Form Certified Embedding of Multiparameter Persistence Modules
summary: Every multiparameter persistence vectorization we know of carries a one-sided Lipschitz upper bound and nothing below it: without a lower gauge there is no sense in which the features are faithful, and no per-prediction guarantee can be built on them. This paper supplies the missing side. COMPLEX is a closed-form, training-free embedding of multiparameter modules -- slice the module along a fixed near-diagonal net, embed each slice barcode by the certified PLACE/PALACE landmark map, concatenate. Under a checkable witnessing-slice coherence condition, holding on 100% of audited pairs on Orbit5k, a single slice carries a closed-form lower gauge: separated modules stay separated in the embedding. With the standard upper bound this gives, to our knowledge, the first two-sided distortion bound for a multiparameter feature map, making faithfulness measurable. Measuring it, we find the floor tight within a small factor of realized distances yet operationally local: an RBF-SVM reaches 91% where 1-NN reaches 78% on the same features. Local per-prediction certification therefore fails for a structural reason common to every landmark embedding whose lower gauge is witnessed by one coordinate. With no learned embedding and no held-out calibration -- only a cross-validated SVM head -- COMPLEX sets the state of the art on both Orbit benchmarks (91.95% on Orbit5k, 92.98% on Orbit100k), level with or above Euler-characteristic surfaces and above transformers and graphcode. On graphs it exceeds GRIL on all four shared molecular benchmarks with one fixed configuration, including the only multiparameter method to clear COX2's majority baseline by more than three points. Closed-form selection -- of the landmark radius, the kernel (certificate-preserving), and the bifiltration set -- buys further accuracy; gradient-shaped adaptation buys none.

AI.tldr: 提出COMPLEX：一种无需训练、闭式的多参数持久性向量化方法，首次给出双侧失真界，使特征保真度可度量，并在多个基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有多参数持久性向量化仅具单侧Lipschitz上界，缺乏下界（下侧标尺），因此无法判断特征是否忠实，也无法给出逐预测保证。本文旨在补充缺失的下界。
AI.method: COMPLEX将多参数模沿固定近对角网切片，用经认证的PLACE/PALACE地标映射嵌入每个切片条形码，再拼接。在可检验的"见证切片一致性"条件下（在Orbit5k审计对上100%成立），单个切片即可提供闭式下侧标尺，结合标准上界得到首个双侧失真界。采用闭式选择地标半径、核函数（保证书）与双过滤集，仅用交叉验证的SVM头，无需学习嵌入与留出校准。
AI.result: 下界紧至与实现距离相差小因子，但操作上呈局部性：RBF-SVM达91%，1-NN仅78%。在Orbit基准上达91.95%（Orbit5k）与92.98%（Orbit100k），与欧拉特征曲面持平或更高，优于transformer与graphcode。在图上，以单一固定配置在四个共享分子基准上超越GRIL，且是唯一在COX2上超过多数类基线3分以上的多参数方法。
AI.conclusion: COMPLEX首次实现多参数特征图的双侧失真界，使保真度可度量。但逐预测局部认证因结构性原因失效——该原因普遍存在于下侧标尺由单一坐标见证的地标嵌入中。闭式选择带来额外精度提升，而梯度式自适应无增益。

title: $λ$-Controlled GRPO: Turning Flow-Matching Ratio Instability into a Budgeted Resource
summary: Reinforcement learning is increasingly used to align image generators with reward signals, and Flow-GRPO recently extended this paradigm to flow-matching models by treating the denoising sampler as a stochastic policy that can be optimized from reward feedback. Training in this setting is unstable in a way specific to multi-step denoising: the policy update changes systematically across denoising steps, with importance ratios drifting below one, becoming increasingly dispersed, clipping at different rates, and leaving fewer usable samples late in training. Prior work treats these effects as separate failure modes and addresses each with a hand-tuned stabilizer. We show instead that they arise from a single per-step quantity, which we call path variance. This quantity is determined exactly by the sampler's Gaussian transition kernel and can be estimated cheaply during training. This reframes instability as a resource that can be measured and budgeted rather than a collection of symptoms to repair. Our method, $λ$-Controlled GRPO, calibrates importance-ratio behavior from this predicted law rather than from noisy empirical statistics, and allocates gradient effort across denoising steps according to their predicted cost. The two scales governing the update are fixed by standard policy choices rather than introduced as free tuning parameters. On a text-to-image model under two reward settings, rendering difficult target text scored by optical character recognition and matching human preferences scored by a preference model, $λ$-Controlled GRPO improves both text accuracy and preference reward over the strongest empirical stabilizer. It also keeps late-step path variance within its intended budget, precisely where the baseline systematically overshoots. The result is a Flow-GRPO update calibrated by its own transition law rather than stabilized after instability appears.

AI.tldr: 论文提出λ-Controlled GRPO，将多步去噪强化学习中的不稳定现象统一归因于一个由高斯转移核精确决定的"路径方差"量，据此校准重要性比率并分配各去噪步的梯度预算，在文本到图像任务上优于最强经验稳定器。
AI.motivation: Flow-GRPO将去噪采样器视为可优化的随机策略，但其训练存在多步去噪特有的不稳定性：策略更新随去噪步系统变化，重要性比率持续低于1、离散度增大、裁剪率不一，训练后期可用样本减少。已有工作将这些视为彼此独立的失效模式，各自使用手工调节的稳定器修补。
AI.method: 作者证明上述现象源自同一个逐步量——路径方差（path variance），该量由采样器的高斯转移核精确确定，且可在训练中低成本估计。基于此提出λ-Controlled GRPO：依据预测的方差规律（而非噪声化的经验统计）校准重要性比率行为，并按各去噪步的预测成本分配梯度努力；控制更新的两个尺度由标准策略选择固定，而非作为自由调参引入。
AI.result: 在两个奖励设置下的文本到图像模型上——以OCR评分的困难目标文本渲染，以及以偏好模型评分的人类偏好匹配——λ-Controlled GRPO在文本准确率和偏好奖励两方面均优于最强的经验稳定器，并将后期步的路径方差保持在预期预算内，而这正是基线系统性超出的地方。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将多步去噪训练不稳定重构为可测量、可预算的资源，而非需要逐一修复的症状集合，得到由自身转移规律校准、而非在不稳定出现后再行修补的Flow-GRPO更新。

title: Available Guardrails: Certifying Selective Prediction across ML Systems
summary: A selective predictor acts as a safety gate: it returns an output only when the prediction appears sufficiently trustworthy. Deployments increasingly require this reliability to be certified at a target precision for every reporting unit of interest, such as a tool, policy label, or patient subgroup. The main difficulty is often not whether a granted certificate is valid, but whether finite calibration data can produce one at all. As the gate becomes safer or more fine-grained, some units may receive too little evidence to certify. We make this notion of availability computable through classical exact-binomial inversion and formulate reporting-partition selection, under a fixed group order, as a dynamic program that exposes the trade-off among safety, granularity, and served traffic. The resulting frontier reveals a large population opportunity that finite-sample estimation nearly erases: a truth-informed planner gains $0.157$ mean coverage over support balancing, whereas a naive estimator recovers only $0.005$, making recovery from finite data the central challenge. Constructing candidate partitions on one planning split and selecting among them on another recovers part of this gap, improving mean coverage over support balancing by $0.060$, with the direction reproduced in $59$ of $60$ model effects across three intent-routing datasets and two architectures. A complementary validity-preserving lever, reallocating the familywise error budget across reporting units, recovers additional coverage both with population quantities and noisy estimates. The same frontier recurs, with predictor-specific ceilings, across LLM tool-calling, content moderation, lesion classification, and recommendation. Certified availability is therefore a plannable deployment resource that determines when a safety gate can be certified, at what granularity, and over how much traffic.

AI.tldr: 选择性预测器需在每个报告单元上以目标精度获得认证，其核心瓶颈是有限校准数据能否产生有效证书（即可用性）。本文用精确二项反演使可用性可计算，并将固定群序下的报告划分选择建模为动态规划，揭示安全性—粒度—覆盖流量三者的前沿权衡。
AI.motivation: 部署场景要求选择性预测器对每个报告单元（如工具、政策标签、患者亚组）在目标精度上获得可靠性认证。真正的困难往往不在于已授予证书是否有效，而在于有限校准数据能否产生证书：门槛越安全或划分越细，部分单元获得的证据越少而无法认证，这一"可用性"问题此前缺乏可计算的形式化刻画。
AI.method: 以经典精确二项反演（exact-binomial inversion）将可用性形式化为可计算量；在固定群序（group order）下把报告划分选择问题建模为动态规划，刻画安全性、粒度与服务流量之间的权衡前沿；提出在规划划分上构造候选划分、在另一划分上选择的两阶段方法，并引入在报告单元间重新分配族错误率预算这一保有效性调节手段。评估覆盖三个意图路由数据集、两种架构、共60个模型效应，并延伸至LLM工具调用、内容审核、病灶分类与推荐四类任务。
AI.result: 理论前沿显示存在被有限样本估计几乎抹去的大规模总体机会：真值知情规划器相较支持平衡平均覆盖提升0.157，而朴素估计器仅恢复0.005，说明从有限数据中恢复该机会是核心挑战。两阶段构造-选择方法可恢复部分差距，平均覆盖较支持平衡提升0.060，且该方向在三个意图路由数据集、两种架构的60个模型效应中有59个复现。重新分配族错误率预算在总体量与含噪估计下均能额外回收覆盖。相同前沿在四类任务中反复出现，仅预测器特定上限不同。
AI.conclusion: 认证可用性是一种可规划的部署资源，它决定安全门能否被认证、以何种粒度认证以及覆盖多少流量。该框架将可用性从被动观测转为主动规划对象，为在安全、粒度与流量间做部署决策提供了可计算依据。

title: Particle Competition and Cooperation for Robust Graph Convolutional Network Learning Under Label Noise
comment: Submitted to Neurocomputing. Code and experimental results are publicly available at https://github.com/fbreve/PCC-GCN and https://github.com/fbreve/NoisyGL
summary: Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) are highly sensitive to label noise, since corrupted supervision can propagate through the graph and degrade learned node representations. This work proposes PCC+GCN, a hybrid framework that uses Particle Competition and Cooperation (PCC) as a graph-based label-refinement stage before GCN training. PCC identifies suspicious labeled nodes through particle domination dynamics and determines whether their labels should be preserved, removed, or reassigned before GCN training. The framework also allows the graph used by PCC to be augmented with feature-based $k$-nearest-neighbor edges, while the GCN itself is trained on the original graph structure and node features. The proposed method was evaluated on ten graph datasets from the NoisyGL benchmark under conventional Uniform, Pair, and Random label noise, as well as under instance-dependent label noise. A detailed hyperparameter analysis was also conducted on Cora, CiteSeer, and PubMed. Under conventional noise, PCC+GCN achieved the highest overall average accuracy and the best average rank among the evaluated methods, with an average gain of $1.67$ percentage points over the baseline GCN across the clean setting and all noisy scenarios. Under instance-dependent noise, PCC+GCN remained competitive with the best-performing robust methods while requiring substantially lower execution time, being the fastest robust method on eight of the ten datasets. The results indicate that PCC-based label refinement provides an effective and computationally efficient preprocessing strategy for improving GCN robustness under noisy supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PCC+GCN 框架，将粒子竞争与合作（PCC）作为图标签精炼预处理阶段，通过粒子支配动力学识别并处理可疑标签节点，从而提升 GCN 在标签噪声下的鲁棒性。在 NoisyGL 的十个图数据集上，该方法在常规噪声下取得最高平均准确率，平均提升 1.67 个百分点，且在实例依赖噪声下保持竞争力并显著降低执行时间。
AI.motivation: 图卷积网络对标签噪声高度敏感，错误的监督信号会沿图结构传播并损害节点表示学习。因此需要一种能有效识别并修正噪声标签的预处理策略，以增强 GCN 在噪声监督下的鲁棒性，同时兼顾计算效率。
AI.method: 提出 PCC+GCN 混合框架：先由粒子竞争与合作（PCC）机制基于粒子支配动力学识别可疑的已标注节点，决定其标签应当保留、移除还是重新分配；随后在精炼后的标签上训练 GCN。PCC 使用的图可加入基于特征的 k 近邻边进行增强，而 GCN 仍在原始图结构与节点特征上训练。此外进行了超参数分析。
AI.result: 在 NoisyGL 基准的十个图数据集上，针对 Uniform、Pair、Random 等常规标签噪声以及实例依赖标签噪声进行评估。常规噪声下，PCC+GCN 取得最高总体平均准确率与最佳平均排名，在干净设置及所有噪声场景下相较基线 GCN 平均提升 1.67 个百分点；实例依赖噪声下，与最佳鲁棒方法竞争力相当，且执行时间大幅降低，在十个数据集中的八个上为最快鲁棒方法。并在 Cora、CiteSeer、PubMed 上完成了详细的超参数分析。
AI.conclusion: 基于 PCC 的标签精炼是一种有效且计算高效的预处理策略，可显著提升 GCN 在噪声监督下的鲁棒性，兼具精度优势与执行效率。

title: Benchmarking World Models for Continual Learning on Compositional Tasks
summary: A desirable property of a world model is the ability to learn continually across tasks, adapting to new environments without forgetting what the agent has already learnt. In particular, the ability to retain and reuse knowledge obtained from prior experiences underpins an agent's ability to efficiently adapt to novel environments, as the dynamics of the physical world can often be described in recurring mechanisms. However, the world model's measure of adaptation entangles two abilities: the speed and capacity to learn unseen tasks, and the reuse of knowledge already acquired, since incoming tasks carry novel content alongside what recurs. In order to isolate knowledge reuse from prior experiences, we propose a compositional continual learning benchmark for world models in robot manipulation. Specifically, we design each task curriculum with compositional tasks that combine aspects of the tasks seen in the sequence. We further factorise this composition along the axes of action and perception to better understand how different input modalities bottleneck knowledge reuse. We evaluate state-of-the-art world models under canonical continual learning methods, alongside a modular world model whose dynamics backbone contains explicitly reusable components. Results show that modularity balances reuse against forgetting better than conventional methods, but none solve the problem fully, leaving clear room for continual world models built to reuse without forgetting. More details are available on our project website: https://object814.github.io/Compositional-Continual-Learning/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个面向机器人操作世界模型的组合式持续学习基准，通过在动作与感知两个维度上分解任务组合，将"知识复用"与"快速学习新任务"两种能力解耦，并评估现有世界模型及模块化模型的表现。
AI.motivation: 世界模型理想上应能跨任务持续学习，在适应新环境的同时不遗忘已学知识。由于真实世界的动力学常以重复机制出现，复用先前经验是实现高效适应的关键。然而现有世界模型的适应度指标将"学习未见任务的速度与容量"和"已有知识的复用"混为一谈，因新任务同时包含新颖内容与重复成分，导致难以单独衡量知识复用能力。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个面向机器人操作世界模型的组合式持续学习基准。具体做法是为每个任务课程设计组合式任务，使其由序列中已出现任务的若干方面组合而成；并沿动作（action）与感知（perception）两个轴对这种组合进行因子化分解，以分析不同输入模态如何成为知识复用的瓶颈。评估对象包括当前最先进的世界模型在典型持续学习方法下的表现，以及一种动力学骨干网络包含显式可复用组件的模块化世界模型。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，模块化设计在"复用"与"遗忘"之间取得了比传统方法更好的平衡，但没有任何方法能完全解决该问题。
AI.conclusion: 现有世界模型与持续学习方法均无法同时实现无遗忘的知识复用，说明构建"复用而不遗忘"的持续世界模型仍存在明确的研究空间。更多细节见项目网站 https://object814.github.io/Compositional-Continual-Learning/。

title: BrainWideBench: Benchmarking large-scale pretraining and across-animal transfer in multi-region neural recordings
summary: Advances in large-scale neural recording have made it possible to collect data across many animals and distributed brain regions, raising the question of whether this scale can be exploited to learn general-purpose neural representations transferable across diverse downstream tasks. Yet, progress toward this goal has been limited by fragmented evaluation protocols and a narrow focus on individual task domains. Here, we present BrainWideBench, a benchmark for evaluating across-animal transfer on multi-region neural recordings, built on the International Brain Laboratory Brainwide Map dataset of neural and behavioral recordings spanning 276 brain regions from 139 mice performing a sensory-guided decision-making task. The benchmark is organized around three complementary task suites that evaluate whether learned representations support downstream decoding of behavior, can predict masked or future neural activity, and can recover biologically meaningful anatomical organization. With this benchmark, we systematically evaluate pretraining methods across transfer settings, including finetuning on downstream objectives and zero-shot generalization to unseen animals. Our results confirm pretraining improves performance over matched single-session baselines, but we show current methods exhibit heterogeneity in transfer capabilities: gains depend strongly on the alignment between pretraining objectives and downstream tasks. No single approach performs uniformly well across all three suites, and most methods are designed to only address a subset of them. Together, these findings suggest that learning representations that jointly generalize across behavior, dynamics, and anatomy remains an open challenge. By providing a unified and reproducible evaluation suite, BrainWideBench establishes a framework for measuring progress toward general-purpose models of the mouse brain.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出BrainWideBench，一个基于IBL Brainwide Map数据集（139只小鼠、276个脑区）的跨动物多脑区神经记录迁移评测基准，包含行为解码、神经活动预测和解剖结构恢复三套任务，系统评估预训练方法。
AI.motivation: 大规模神经记录技术已能跨多动物、多脑区采集数据，理论上可用于学习可迁移的通用神经表征；但现有研究受限于碎片化的评测协议和单一任务域的狭隘关注，缺乏统一、可复现的评测框架来验证这一目标。
AI.method: 构建BrainWideBench基准，基于IBL Brainwide Map数据集（139只小鼠、276个脑区，执行感觉引导决策任务）；设计三套互补任务：①下游行为解码；②掩码或未来神经活动预测；③生物学解剖组织的恢复；在微调与零样本跨动物泛化两种迁移设定下系统评测多种预训练方法。
AI.result: 预训练相比匹配的单会话基线确实提升性能；但当前方法迁移能力存在异质性——增益强烈依赖预训练目标与下游任务的对齐程度；没有任何单一方法在三套任务上均表现一致优异，多数方法仅针对其中一部分任务设计。
AI.conclusion: 同时跨行为、神经动力学和解剖结构泛化的表征学习仍是开放挑战；BrainWideBench提供了统一、可复现的评测套件，为衡量小鼠大脑通用模型的进展建立框架。

title: HERMES: Contrast-Aware Knowledge Graph Reasoning from Clinical Notes for Patient Outcome Prediction
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, The 15th Conference on Information Technology and its Applications
summary: Clinical predictive models often rely on structured Electronic Health Record data, such as time-series and procedure codes. While recent approaches have begun leveraging unstructured clinical notes, they typically encode them as flat sequences, which may lose explicit relational and temporal structure present in clinical narratives. In response, we propose HERMES, a graph-based framework that operates exclusively on clinical text while preserving clinical relationships. This approach builds on two key ideas. First, personalized Knowledge Graphs (KGs) are constructed through Large-Language-Model-guided extraction from clinical notes with Contrastive Logic Modeling that explicitly captures temporal dynamics and treatment failures and changes in outcomes. Second, a Graph Attention Network synthesizes patient representations through graph-based learning over the KGs. Experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV for in-hospital mortality and 30-day readmission prediction show that HERMES consistently outperforms strong text-only baselines. Our findings demonstrate that explicit relational modeling with Contrastive Logic Modeling significantly advances predictive performance.

AI.tldr: HERMES是一个仅基于临床文本构建个性化知识图谱的图框架，通过大语言模型引导抽取与对比逻辑建模保留临床关系和时间动态，并用图注意力网络生成患者表征，在MIMIC-III/IV的院内死亡与30天再入院预测上优于强文本基线。
AI.motivation: 临床预测模型多依赖结构化电子健康记录数据（如时间序列、手术编码）。近期研究虽开始利用非结构化临床笔记，但通常将其编码为扁平序列，可能丢失临床叙述中显式的关系结构与时间结构。
AI.method: 提出HERMES图框架，仅作用于临床文本并保留临床关系。基于两个关键设计：(1) 通过大语言模型引导的抽取，从临床笔记构建个性化知识图谱，并采用对比逻辑建模显式捕捉时间动态、治疗失败及结局变化；(2) 使用图注意力网络在知识图谱上进行图学习，合成患者表征。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-III与MIMIC-IV上针对院内死亡率和30天再入院预测的实验表明，HERMES持续优于强文本-only基线。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，借助对比逻辑建模进行显式关系建模可显著提升预测性能。

title: Beyond WER: Entity and Disfluency Recall in Accented Conversational ASR
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 1 table, accepted at Interspeech 2026
summary: ASR systems optimised for Word Error Rate (WER) often miss named entities and filled pauses in accented conversational English, both critical for language-learning feedback. We present a three-stage pipeline for speakers from India, Indonesia, and Latin America: (1) heuristic SQL filters curating entity-rich training data at 2.8x the entity density of random sampling, (2) regional LoRA adapters fine-tuned on Qwen2.5-Omni-3B producing both verbatim and corrected transcripts in a single forward pass, and (3) a six-category error taxonomy validated by an LLM-based judge (83.8% agreement, 210 human-labelled samples). The pipeline achieves 80-85% entity recall (up from 53-55%), 76-86% filler recall (up from <5%), and 6-10% WER across 6k test utterances, outperforming Whisper and a commercial ASR on entity recall while matching a zero-shot 30B model with 10x fewer parameters. Paired bootstrap tests confirm that curation alone accounts for 2.8-4.2 pp of entity recall gain (p<0.0001).

AI.tldr: 面向印度、印尼与拉美口音的对话英语，提出三阶段ASR流水线，显著提升命名实体与填充词召回，同时保持低WER。
AI.motivation: 以WER为优化目标的ASR系统，在带口音的对话英语中常漏识别命名实体与填充词，而这两者对语言学习反馈至关重要。
AI.method: 三阶段流水线：(1) 启发式SQL过滤，构建实体密度为随机采样2.8倍的训练数据；(2) 区域LoRA适配器，在Qwen2.5-Omni-3B上微调，单次前向同时输出逐字与纠正转写；(3) 六类错误分类体系，由LLM评判器验证（83.8%一致率，210条人工标注样本）。
AI.result: 6千条测试语音上，实体召回从53-55%提升至80-85%，填充词召回从<5%提升至76-86%，WER为6-10%；实体召回优于Whisper与某商用ASR，并以1/10参数量匹配零样本30B模型；配对bootstrap检验显示，仅数据策展即贡献2.8-4.2个百分点的实体召回增益（p<0.0001）。
AI.conclusion: 数据策展与轻量区域适配相结合，可在低参数量下兼顾实体/填充词召回与整体识别精度，满足口音对话英语的语言学习反馈需求。

title: Recursive Language Models Generalize Out of Domain
summary: We study when limiting what a language model can see improves learning. We compare standard CoT, the more general learner that reads the full trace, with recursive language models, which restricts itself by solving each subtask in an isolated context. In-distribution, this generality comes for free: CoT can efficiently simulate the recursive rule, so the IID generalization guarantee changes only by a constant factor, and recursion does not offer much. But out of domain, CoT can fit training by relying on context outside the current subtask, i.e. a shortcut that breaks once those tokens change; recursive context isolation rules out this failure mode. Even though CoT's class still covers the recursive rule, simplicity bias picks the shortcut over the truth. Thus, to go beyond distributional accuracy and truly reason, covering the right rule is not enough; this contrasts with classical learning theory.

AI.tldr: 限制语言模型可见上下文（递归式隔离）在分布外场景下优于标准CoT，因为CoT会依赖跨子任务的捷径，而递归隔离排除了这种失败模式。
AI.motivation: 研究"限制模型可见信息"何时能提升学习效果，对比标准CoT（读取完整轨迹的通用学习器）与递归语言模型（在隔离上下文中求解每个子任务），探讨泛化与真正推理之间的关系。
AI.method: 理论分析：将标准CoT视为更通用的学习器，递归语言模型视为带上下文隔离约束的学习器，比较两者在分布内（IID）与分布外（OOD）的泛化保证，并结合简单性偏置（simplicity bias）分析假设选择行为。
AI.result: 分布内：CoT可高效模拟递归规则，IID泛化保证仅差常数因子，递归无显著优势。分布外：CoT依赖当前子任务之外的上下文作为捷径，一旦这些token变化即失效；递归上下文隔离排除了该失败模式。尽管CoT的假设类仍覆盖正确规则，简单性偏置会优先选择捷径而非真实规则。
AI.conclusion: 要超越分布精度并实现真正推理，仅"覆盖正确规则"是不够的，这挑战了经典学习理论中"假设类包含正确规则即可"的观点。

title: PhysioBench: A Unified Benchmark for Physiological Signal Question Answering
summary: Physiological signals support diverse clinical and monitoring tasks, yet existing physiological signal foundation models typically require task-specific adaptation for each task. Natural language provides a common interface for specifying different prediction objectives, but the ability of current models to follow such instructions across physiological signal modalities remains insufficiently evaluated. To address this gap, we introduce PhysioBench, a unified benchmark for physiological signal question answering. PhysioBench harmonizes annotations from 22 public datasets into 61.4 million questions across 30 tasks. Each question-answer pair is grounded in a signal segment and traceable to its source annotation. We evaluate 21 representative models, including large language models, vision-language models, time-series language models, and physiological signal foundation models under three complementary settings. The results show that none of the evaluated models achieves consistently strong performance across physiological signal modalities and tasks. The incorporation of natural language supports unified prediction across tasks, although performance remains sensitive to question formulation. Beyond these findings, PhysioBench offers an extensible platform for fine-grained analysis and future research on physiological signal understanding. Our codes are available at https://github.com/Leanna97/PhysioBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhysioBench，一个统一的生理信号问答基准，将22个公开数据集整合为3000万+任务中的6140万个问题，评测21个模型在三种设定下的表现，发现现有模型在跨模态、跨任务上均无法稳定取得强性能。
AI.motivation: 生理信号基础模型通常需要针对每项任务进行特定适配，缺乏统一性。自然语言可作为指定不同预测目标的通用接口，但现有模型在生理信号模态间遵循此类指令的能力尚未得到充分评估，故需构建统一基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建PhysioBench统一基准：将22个公开数据集的标注统一为30个任务、6140万个问题，每个问答对均基于信号片段并可溯源至原始标注；在三种互补设定下评测21个代表性模型，涵盖大语言模型、视觉语言模型、时间序列语言模型及生理信号基础模型。
AI.result: 没有任何被评测模型能在生理信号模态与任务上持续保持强性能；引入自然语言支持跨任务统一预测，但性能对问题表述方式较为敏感。
AI.conclusion: PhysioBench为生理信号理解的细粒度分析与未来研究提供了可扩展平台，代码已开源。

title: VISPATH: Visual-Intent-Guided Path Reasoning for Multimodal Knowledge Graph Question Answering
summary: Knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) enables models to answer natural-language questions through structured graph reasoning and has achieved substantial progress across many benchmarks and applications. Recently, multimodal KGQA (MM-KGQA) has attracted increasing attention because many questions require jointly using multimodal inputs and KG evidence. However, existing MM-KGQA methods typically use multimodal information only for starting entity grounding or evidence retrieval, after which multi-hop reasoning degenerates into text-only graph search. As a result, they cannot exploit multimodal cues that become important at intermediate hops. To address this limitation, we propose VISPATH, a visual-intent-guided path reasoning framework for MM-KGQA. VISPATH first identifies a reliable starting entity by combining multimodal grounding with graph-structural cues. It then performs intent-guided path discovery by recomputing hop-specific multimodal intent from the input, question, and current partial paths, so that each expansion is guided by the current reasoning state. The discovered paths are further refined through reasoning-chain pruning, which evaluates candidate paths as complete evidence chains based on their consistency with the question, reasoning sketch, and hop-specific intent. Finally, VISPATH checks whether the selected evidence is sufficient for answer generation. We further construct VISPATH-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating multimodal multi-hop reasoning over KGs, covering questions that require two to four hops over KG paths. Extensive experiments on VISPATH-Bench and three additional multimodal QA benchmarks show that VISPATH consistently outperforms strong baselines. Notably, with GPT-4o as the backbone, VISPATH surpasses GPT-5.4 on VISPATH-Bench, achieving a 10.6% relative improvement in average accuracy and a 13.1% improvement at 2-hop reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VISPATH，一个面向多模态知识图谱问答的视觉意图引导路径推理框架，通过在多跳推理的每一步重新计算多模态意图来指导路径扩展，并构建了VISPATH-Bench基准，实验证明其在多个基准上优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态KGQA方法仅将多模态信息用于起始实体锚定或证据检索，之后的多跳推理退化为纯文本图搜索，无法利用在中间跳才变得重要的多模态线索。
AI.method: VISPATH首先结合多模态锚定与图结构线索识别可靠的起始实体；然后进行意图引导的路径发现，根据输入、问题和当前部分路径重新计算各跳特定的多模态意图，使每次扩展由当前推理状态引导；再通过推理链剪枝对候选路径作为完整证据链进行评估，基于其与问题、推理草图和各跳意图的一致性进行筛选；最后检查所选证据是否足以生成答案。此外构建了VISPATH-Bench基准，涵盖需要2至4跳KG路径的问题。
AI.result: 在VISPATH-Bench及另外三个多模态问答基准上的大量实验表明，VISPATH持续优于强基线；以GPT-4o为骨干时，在VISPATH-Bench上超过GPT-5.4，平均准确率相对提升10.6%，2跳推理提升13.1%。
AI.conclusion: VISPATH通过在多跳推理中引入逐跳多模态意图引导与推理链剪枝，有效解决了现有方法中间跳多模态线索利用不足的问题，并验证了其性能优势。

title: Reading Less While Writing: A Closed-Form Bandwidth Dial for Streaming Multimodal Decoders
summary:
A decoder that turns video or audio into text conventionally consumes the entire input before emitting a word. Offline this is merely more than the task requires; live it is impossible, since a caption cannot wait for a match to end. Streaming systems bolt on a fixed rule such as wait-$k$, which waits for the same number of input tokens before every word, regardless of the input's length or pace.
  We replace the fixed offset with ZENDAYA, a schedule governed by a single continuous parameter $γ$. It makes the visible source prefix a closed-form function of generation progress, scaled by the input's own predicted length, so an ordinary offline decoder and a real-time streaming decoder become two endpoints of one family rather than separate models. The same scalar fixes, in closed form, the mean fraction of source consumed per emitted word, $\bar{E}(γ) \approx 1/(1+γ)$, making it at once a latency dial and an interpretable budget. We prove a structural dependency theorem: under any schedule fixed in advance and non-decreasing, no emitted token can depend on input that has not yet arrived. The guarantee holds for trained and untrained weights alike, and extends to unbounded streams under arbitrary asynchronous arrival.
  The empirical result is counterintuitive: seeing less can produce better text, because a flood of source dilutes attention exactly when the model has the least of its own output to anchor on. Trained from scratch across two modalities and three public corpora (Charades-STA, ActivityNet Captions, LibriHeavy), a compact 29M-parameter decoder matches or beats the fixed schedule while reading less of the source, with the sharpest gains at the lowest latencies, where a fixed offset collapses. Streaming METEOR gains are statistically significant on all three corpora.

AI.tldr: 提出 ZENDAYA 调度器，用单一连续参数 γ 将离线解码器与流式解码器统一为一个家族，通过闭式函数依输入预测长度控制可见源前缀，实现可调延迟预算。
AI.motivation: 传统解码器需读完整输入才输出文本，离线场景冗余、实时场景不可行；现有流式方案采用固定 wait-k 规则，不考虑输入长度与节奏，在低延迟下性能崩塌。
AI.method: 用 ZENDAYA 替代固定偏移：可见源前缀为生成进度与输入预测长度的闭式函数，γ 同时决定每输出词的平均源消耗比例 Ē(γ)≈1/(1+γ)。证明结构性依赖定理：任何事先固定的非递减调度下，已输出 token 不能依赖未到达的输入；该保证对已训练/未训练权重均成立，并可扩展到异步到达的无界流。
AI.result: 在两种模态、三个公开语料（Charades-STA、ActivityNet Captions、LibriHeavy）上从零训练 29M 参数解码器，性能匹配或超过固定调度，且读取更少源；最低延迟处增益最显著。三个语料上流式 METEOR 提升均具统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 固定调度被连续参数化调度取代，离线与流式成为同一家族的两个端点；少看源反而提升文本质量（源稀释注意力），γ 兼作延迟旋钮与可解释预算。

title: Rewarding Efficient Reasoning Improves Abstention on Underspecified Tasks in Reasoning Models
summary: While modern large reasoning models (LRMs) excel at providing correct answers in many tasks, we provide additional evidence for the observation that they often struggle with a critical capability: knowing when to abstain from answering. We analyze this gap by comparing LRM behavior to results from a human study, revealing that human reasoning effort on unanswerable tasks is upper-bounded by answerable tasks, whereas LRMs waste computational resources by generating longer Chains of Thought (CoTs) on unanswerable than on answerable prompts. To overcome this inefficiency, we take inspiration from a resource-rational perspective on human cognition and introduce a novel GRPO reward that encourages efficient reasoning about whether the task contains all the information needed to solve it. Fine-tuning several 4B LRMs with this reward leads to human-like abstention performance gains (+12.8% on average) while retaining answering capabilities and boosting the models' efficiency (44% shorter CoTs on average).

title: Diverse and Adaptable Arm Coordination for Octopus-Crawling via Diffusion-Based Uncertainty-Aware Optimization
summary: Octopus crawling motivates soft robots that exploit redundancy, yet discovering and organizing diverse coordination modes for adaptation remains challenging. To address this, we introduce a Diffusion-based Uncertainty-aware Optimization (DUO) algorithm that learns demonstration-free crawling controllers for a simulated, muscle-actuated CyberOctopus. This work represents the first application of diffusion-based control to soft multi-arm robots in contact-rich simulations. By embedding a variety of locomotion behaviors within a shared control distribution, this approach enables the simulated octopus to navigate dynamic physical constraints, demonstrating that learned coordination diversity inherently facilitates robust adaptation. The main contributions include: (i) a symmetry-structured policy representation that folds radially equivalent controllers into a canonical directional sector, (ii) an online black-box optimization strategy, the DUO algorithm, that discovers and retains diverse coordination modes, and (iii) a control editing technique that adapts existing controllers to novel actuator constraints without retraining. These results show how learned coordination diversity makes motor abundance a practical resource for adaptation in soft multi-arm robots.

AI.motivation: 章鱼爬行启发的软体多臂机器人存在冗余性，如何发现并组织多样的协调模式以适应动态约束仍是难点。现有方法依赖演示，泛化与适应能力不足。

title: How Many Humans Is a Judge Panel Worth?
comment: 18 pages, 10 figures, and 8 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/Chao1208/chaosnli-judge-votes
summary: How many human judgments does a panel of language models represent? The answer depends on what is matched. We audit categorical judge panels against empirical human label distributions, retaining disagreement that binary errors relative to one gold label collapse. We measure spectral residual diversity by matching the participation ratio of a normalized residual Gram matrix to conditionally independent human-reference draws, giving nu_H. We separately match distributional squared error, giving nu_MSE. Across three ChaosNLI tasks, the same 32-judge panels have nu_H=4.24--6.50 but nu_MSE=2.30--3.75. A spectral identity separates the eigenvalues, member energies, and averaging-direction weights that determine error. Realizable hard-label panels show that greater spectral diversity can accompany worse distribution recovery even with equal member energies and nonnegative correlations. In the observed panels, within-size ranking agreement varies sharply by task; some member additions produce conflicting changes that persist across two item halves. The consensus-direction share of centered residual variance is gamma_co=43.8% on MNLI-m and 33.7% on SNLI, quantifying shared variation retained by averaging. We provide aligned votes and analysis protocols for auditing these distinctions. Effective size is therefore a target-specific measurement: spectral diversity and distribution recovery should not be treated as interchangeable measures of panel quality or as general human-replacement rates.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"有效规模"（effective size）是目标依赖的测量：通过谱残差多样性（nu_H）与分布均方误差匹配（nu_MSE）两种口径审计语言模型评审团对类别人群标签分布的还原能力，发现同一32评审团在ChaosNLI三个任务上nu_H为4.24–6.50而nu_MSE仅为2.30–3.75，二者不可互换。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常把语言模型评审团视为人类判断的替代品，"有多少人类判断"这一问题的答案取决于匹配什么量。二值化相对单一金标签的错误会掩盖标注分歧，因此需要用保留分歧的分布级指标重新审计评审团质量，明确谱多样性与分布还原度是否可互换。
AI.method: 构建谱残差多样性指标nu_H：对归一化残差Gram矩阵匹配参与比（participation ratio）至条件独立的人类参考抽样；另以分布平方误差匹配得到nu_MSE。在ChaosNLI三个任务上对同一32评审团进行审计，并用谱恒等式分解决定误差的特征值、成员能量与平均方向权重；再利用可实现硬标签评审团构造对照，检验等成员能量、非负相关条件下的多样性与分布还原关系。
AI.result: 同一32评审团在三个ChaosNLI任务上nu_H=4.24–6.50，而nu_MSE仅2.30–3.75，两者显著分离。可实现硬标签评审团显示，在成员能量相等、相关性非负时，更高的谱多样性可能与更差的分布还原并存。观察到的评审团中，同规模排名一致性随任务剧烈变化，部分成员增补产生跨两个条目半集持续存在的冲突变化。中心化残差方差中共识方向占比gamma_co在MNLI-m为43.8%、SNLI为33.7%，量化了平均化保留的共享变异。
AI.conclusion: 有效规模是目标特定的量：谱多样性与分布还原度不应被视为可互换的评审团质量指标，也不应被当作通用的人类替代率。研究提供了对齐投票数据与分析协议，以支持对上述区分的审计。

title: Prediction Dynamics in Depth-Recurrent Language Models
summary: Depth-recurrent language models refine predictions through repeated latent updates. Why can intermediate answers agree with the endpoint while their scores continue to change? We derive a sharp margin characterization that decomposes the conservatism of a magnitude bound into common translation, direction relative to the winner, and the pairing of each competitor's update with its score gap. Across Huginn-3.5B and Ouro-1.4B, accounting for update direction and competitor pairing reduces the mean earliest qualifying depth by a further 22.5-34.4% of the total depth beyond translation removal under full answer-text scoring. This retrospective comparison uses completed trajectories. Substantial contributions also occur under label scoring. For shared predictive distributions, we separate common and contrast motion orthogonally and express the common component through candidate-set mass and within-set concentration. Common and contrast energies can attenuate at different rates, allowing a growing preference-change share to coexist with shrinking absolute updates. These findings explain finite-depth answer preservation through the geometry and composition of observed score changes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种紧致的margin刻画，将幅度界（magnitude bound）的保守性分解为公共平移、相对获胜者的方向以及各竞争者更新与其分数差距的配对三部分，用于解释深度循环语言模型中中间答案与终点一致但分数持续变化的现象。
AI.motivation: 深度循环语言模型通过重复的潜在更新精炼预测，但存在一个反直觉现象：中间答案与终点答案一致，其分数却持续变化。作者希望刻画这种分数变化的几何与组成结构，解释为何在有限深度下答案能够保持稳定，并厘清幅度界为何过于保守。
AI.method: 推导紧致的margin刻画，将幅度界的保守性分解为：公共平移、相对获胜者的方向、以及每个竞争者更新与其分数差距的配对。在Huginn-3.5B与Ouro-1.4B上，基于完整答案文本评分（回顾性使用已完成轨迹）与标签评分进行验证；对共享预测分布，正交分离公共运动与对比运动，并用候选集质量与集合内集中度表达公共分量。
AI.result: 在全答案文本评分下，计入更新方向与竞争者配对后，平均最早合格深度相比仅去除平移的情形进一步下降，占总深度的22.5%-34.4%；标签评分下也有显著贡献。公共与对比运动能量可以以不同速率衰减，使得偏好变化占比增长与绝对更新收缩同时存在。
AI.conclusion: 通过观察到的分数变化的几何与组成结构，可解释有限深度下的答案保持现象；幅度界的保守性主要来自平移、方向与竞争者配对三方面，公共与对比运动的差异化衰减是答案稳定而分数变化的关键机制。

title: FootQuery: Future-Touchdown-Guided Retrieval from Depth History for Perceptive Humanoid Locomotion
summary: Humanoid locomotion over complex terrain requires anticipating footholds that may no longer be visible at touchdown. Limited camera coverage and self-occlusion make it necessary to retrieve relevant terrain information from earlier observations. We present FootQuery, a perceptive locomotion framework that queries depth history using each foot's predicted next touchdown. The policy predicts touchdown locations and uncertainty from proprioception and uses these distributions, together with per-foot features, to query sparsely sampled historical depth frames. During training, realized contacts are projected into historical images to supervise retrieval at the regions where those contacts were visible. The retrieved per-foot features are fused with global visual memory to generate control actions. A progressive force-assistance curriculum supports early exploration, while event-consistent tread-midline shaping encourages coordinated stair contacts. Deployment requires only proprioception and onboard depth images. In simulation, the complete framework outperforms its component ablations on the most challenging tested stairs, gaps, and platforms. Real-world experiments on a Unitree G1 demonstrate continuous traversal with a single policy across outdoor stairs and indoor routes combining stair ascent and descent, platforms, and gaps. These results support organizing visual history around anticipated contacts for perceptive humanoid locomotion.

AI.tldr: 提出FootQuery感知运动框架：利用每只脚预测的下一落足点查询稀疏历史深度帧，结合全局视觉记忆生成控制动作，实现人形机器人在复杂地形上的连续行走。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人在复杂地形行走需预判落足点，但触地时该区域可能已被遮挡或不在相机视野内。受限于相机覆盖范围与自遮挡，必须从早期观测中检索相关地形信息。
AI.method: 以本体感觉预测各脚落足位置及其不确定性，结合逐脚特征查询稀疏采样的历史深度帧；训练时将实际接触投影到历史图像中，监督接触可见区域的检索；检索到的逐脚特征与全局视觉记忆融合生成控制动作；采用渐进式力辅助课程支持早期探索，并用事件一致的踏面中线整形鼓励协调的楼梯接触。部署仅需本体感觉与机载深度图像。
AI.result: 仿真中最具挑战性的楼梯、间隙与平台场景下，完整框架优于各组件消融版本。在Unitree G1真实实验中，单一策略可连续通过室外楼梯，以及包含上下楼梯、平台与间隙的室内路线。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，围绕预期接触点组织视觉历史，是构建感知式人形机器人运动的有效途径。

title: Adaptive Rollout Truncation Based on Epistemic Uncertainty for Efficient Offline World Model Training
comment: 8 pages, 12 figures. Accepted at the IEEE/RSJ IROS 2026 Workshop "Rethinking Uncertainty for Modern Robotics Paradigms"
summary:
Accurate neural world models are central to model-based robotics, where they enable robots to predict future states from previously observed trajectories. Multi-step autoregressive training improves long-horizon prediction, but fixed rollout horizons also increase computational cost and can amplify early training errors when the model is still inaccurate. Existing training schemes typically use the same rollout length throughout optimization, independent of the model's current predictive reliability.
  We propose an epistemic uncertainty-driven adaptive rollout strategy for offline world model training following an auto-curriculum training scheme. Instead of always unrolling to a fixed horizon, the model terminates autoregressive rollouts once epistemic uncertainty exceeds a threshold calibrated from a warm-up phase. We study two uncertainty estimators: a five-head ensemble with a shared recurrent backbone and Monte Carlo Dropout. A two-stage warm-up procedure stabilizes uncertainty estimates before we enable adaptive truncation.
  Experiments on ANYmal-D and ANT show that ensemble-based adaptive truncation matches or improves the prediction accuracy of fixed-horizon training and the RWM-U baseline while requiring substantially fewer cumulative rollout steps. Training a world model on ANYmal-D following the presented approach reaches comparable final performance with the baselines with roughly 72% less rollout computation. These results indicate that epistemic uncertainty is useful not only for downstream policy regularization, but also for making world model training itself more compute-efficient.

AI.tldr: 提出基于认知不确定性的自适应 rollout 策略训练离线世界模型，按自课程在不确定性超阈值时截断自回归展开，在保证/提升预测精度的同时大幅减少计算量。
AI.motivation: 多步自回归训练可提升长时程预测能力，但固定 rollout 长度会增加计算开销，且在模型尚不准确时放大早期训练误差；现有方案在整个优化过程中使用固定展开长度，未考虑模型当前预测可靠性。
AI.method: 面向离线世界模型训练，采用自课程（auto-curriculum）自适应展开：当认知不确定性超过由 warm-up 阶段校准的阈值时终止自回归 rollout。比较两类不确定性估计器：共享循环骨干的五头集成、Monte Carlo Dropout；并用两阶段 warm-up 稳定不确定性估计后再启用自适应截断。
AI.result: 在 ANYmal-D 与 ANT 上，基于集成的自适应截断在预测精度上达到或优于固定视界训练与 RWM-U 基线，同时累计 rollout 步数显著减少；ANYmal-D 上以约 72% 更少的 rollout 计算量达到与基线相当的最终性能。
AI.conclusion: 认知不确定性不仅可用于下游策略正则化，也能提升世界模型训练本身的计算效率，使离线世界模型训练更省算力且不牺牲精度。

title: Analysing the Linearity of Linguistic Relations in Language Model Embedding Spaces
comment: 6 pages. Accepted at the Workshop on Scientific Methods for Understanding Deep Learning (Sci4DL) at ICLR 2026
summary: We propose a framework to analyse how strongly different linguistic relations are linearly encoded in language model embedding spaces. We formalise linear encoding via a constrained linear approximation over related and unrelated word pairs and apply this to an extended BATS dataset covering inflectional, derivational, lexicographic, and encyclopedic relations in GloVe, RoBERTa, and ModernBERT. Our experiments show near-perfect linear encodings for inflectional and derivational relations, but substantially higher errors for lexicographic and encyclopedic relations, especially for one-to-many and many-to-many associations. We also find that RoBERTa and ModernBERT generally encode relations more linearly than GloVe. These results indicate that our framework can reveal which relational structures are most linearly accessible in embeddings, offering a compact tool for probing and comparing relational geometry across models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种通过受约束线性近似来量化语言关系在词嵌入空间中线性编码强度的框架，并在扩展BATS数据集上测试GloVe、RoBERTa与ModernBERT。
AI.motivation: 探究不同语言关系（屈折、派生、词典、百科）在语言模型嵌入空间中被线性编码的程度，以揭示哪些关系结构最易于线性访问。
AI.method: 形式化线性编码为在相关与不相关词对上施加约束的线性近似，并应用于覆盖屈折、派生、词典和百科关系的扩展BATS数据集，比较GloVe、RoBERTa和ModernBERT。
AI.result: 屈折和派生关系呈现近乎完美的线性编码，词典和百科关系误差显著更高，尤其是一对多和多对多关联；RoBERTa和ModernBERT总体上比GloVe更线性地编码关系。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能揭示嵌入中哪些关系结构最具线性可访问性，为探测和比较不同模型的关系几何提供紧凑工具。

title: From Pretraining to Proficiency: Real-World Subtask RL for Long-Horizon Manipulation with Minimal Human Intervention
summary: A pretrained robot foundation policy may execute most of a long-horizon task yet repeatedly fail at a few critical subtasks. Collecting additional full-task demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) requires operators to repeat behaviors the policy already performs well. Reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning offers a promising path to bridge this gap, but existing approaches struggle to solve long-horizon tasks using only sparse rewards. We present PARTS (Policy Adaptation with RL on Targeted Subtasks), a real-world subtask RL framework that concentrates practice at these bottlenecks while allowing training rollouts to proceed with minimal human intervention. The frozen pretrained policy supplies nominal actions throughout execution, while agent-generated selectors and success verifiers activate residual corrections and provide local outcome rewards. These rewards support learning from successful subtasks even when complete-task successes are scarce. Training combines online RL with success-reweighted retraining, and each retrained residual policy is redeployed to collect further experience. Humans identify bottlenecks during setup and perform physical resets when needed. On bimanual YAM and single-arm Franka tasks, PARTS improves complete-task success from 32% to 61% and from 50% to 95%, respectively, using tens of minutes of real-world RL rollouts per task on average. Compared with existing real-world RL fine-tuning methods, PARTS raises full-task success by more than 25% under the same robot-rollout budget while requiring less human involvement.

AI.tldr: PARTS是一个真实世界子任务级强化学习微调框架：冻结预训练策略输出名义动作，由智能体生成的选择器/成功验证器激活残差修正并提供局部结果奖励，聚焦少数瓶颈子任务，从而用稀疏奖励解决长程任务。
AI.motivation: 预训练机器人基础策略可完成长程任务的大部分，却常在少数关键子任务上反复失败。补充全任务演示做SFT需重复已掌握行为，成本高；而现有RL微调方法在仅用稀疏奖励时难以解决长程任务。因此需要一种能集中练习瓶颈子任务、且训练rollout对人类干预需求最小的真实世界RL微调方法。
AI.method: PARTS在真实世界中进行子任务级RL：冻结的预训练策略全程提供名义动作；智能体生成的选择器与成功验证器激活残差修正，并提供局部结果奖励，使得即使在整任务成功稀缺时也能从成功子任务中学习。训练结合在线RL与成功重加权再训练（success-reweighted retraining），每次再训练的残差策略重新部署以收集更多经验。人类仅在设置阶段识别瓶颈，并在需要时进行物理重置。
AI.result: 在双臂YAM和单臂Franka任务上，PARTS将完整任务成功率分别从32%提升至61%、从50%提升至95%，平均每任务仅需数十分钟的真实世界RL rollout。与既有真实世界RL微调方法相比，在相同机器人rollout预算下，整任务成功率提升超过25%，且人类参与更少。
AI.conclusion: 通过将RL练习集中于瓶颈子任务、借助选择器—验证器提供稠密的局部结果奖励，PARTS在稀疏奖励与有限人工干预条件下有效微调预训练机器人策略，显著提升长程任务成功率与rollout效率。

title: RheoSampling: Resolving the One-Hot Dilemma in Stochastic Dynamic-Tree Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by drafting multiple tokens in parallel, with tree-based methods further improving efficiency through hierarchical structures. Dynamic-tree methods such as EAGLE-3 perform well under greedy decoding via deterministic top-K expansion and global pruning. However, in stochastic decoding (T>0), this mechanism collapses the draft distribution into one-hot probabilities, causing a severe drop in acceptance rate. This creates a dilemma: dynamic-tree methods sacrifice stochastic sampling to preserve context-aware topology, while static-tree methods preserve stochastic sampling with context-agnostic structures. The issue arises because the same probability distribution is used for two conflicting tasks: constructing the tree and verifying tokens. This coupling makes direct injection of randomness challenging due to the resulting stochastic process. We resolve this by decoupling these roles: RheoSampling assigns a token sampled from the draft distribution a proxy probability for tree expansion and pruning alongside its true sampling probability for verification. Specifically, we inject a sampled token among the deterministic top-K slots and treat it with different probabilities during construction and verification, making RheoSampling the first dynamic-tree method with both context-aware top-K construction and stochastic sampling while maintaining losslessness. We establish the lossless guarantee through an equivalence-class analysis that compresses the stochastic tree space into tractable classes. An OT-based verification strategy and a sparse draft mechanism ensure that theoretical gains translate into practical efficiency. Experiments across LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate improvements in acceptance rate and speedup over state-of-the-art dynamic tree methods. This framework may provide a template for analyzing stochastic tree structures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RheoSampling，通过解耦"树构建"与"验证"两种概率角色，首次实现兼具上下文感知 top-K 构建与随机采样的动态树推测解码，并保持无损性。
AI.motivation: 动态树方法（如 EAGLE-3）在贪心解码下表现优异，但在随机解码（T>0）时，其确定性 top-K 扩展与全局剪枝会把草稿分布坍缩为 one-hot 概率，导致接受率骤降。由此形成两难：动态树牺牲随机采样以保留上下文感知拓扑，静态树保留随机采样却使用上下文无关结构。根源在于同一概率分布被同时用于构建树和验证 token 这两个相互冲突的任务，这种耦合使直接注入随机性变得困难。
AI.method: 核心思路是解耦两种角色：RheoSampling 为从草稿分布采样的 token 分配一个代理概率用于树的扩展与剪枝，同时保留其真实采样概率用于验证。具体地，将采样 token 注入确定性 top-K 槽位中，并在构建和验证阶段使用不同概率处理。为建立无损保证，作者通过等价类分析将随机树空间压缩为可处理的类别；并引入基于最优传输（OT）的验证策略与稀疏草稿机制，以保证理论收益转化为实际效率。
AI.result: 在多个 LLM 与基准测试上，RheoSampling 在贪心解码下实现无损加速。
AI.conclusion: RheoSampling 是首个同时具备上下文感知 top-K 构建与随机采样且保持无损性的动态树方法，其解耦框架可为分析随机树结构提供模板。

title: AeRove: A Compact Bimodal Aerial-Terrestrial Drone with Rapid Bistable Reconfiguration for Close-Range Pipeline Inspection
summary: Close-proximity pipeline inspection is challenging for standard drones due to high hovering power consumption, airflow sensitivity, and propeller wash interference with gas sensing. To address this, we present AeRove, a compact bimodal aerial-terrestrial robot. AeRove uses its propeller guards as wheels to roll along pipes and employs a spring-loaded bistable mechanism to reconfigure between ground and flight modes in 200 ms without continuous actuator power to maintain either state. The converging propeller-guard geometry also improves measured thrust efficiency. By reserving flight for obstacle hopping and using ground rolling for continuous traversal, current draw is reduced 14x compared to continuous flight (0.7 A vs. 10 A), extending estimated travel distance from 144 m to 2057 m. Autonomous trials on a 51 cm diameter steel pipe demonstrated navigation on straight and curved sections, obstacle jumping, and leak detection of simulated inspection markers. Separate CO2 sensing experiments evaluated gas-detection performance under perched and aerial operating conditions. Perched inspection produced a substantially larger concentration response than hovering under the tested conditions. During flight, an underbody propeller-intake configuration produced a faster and stronger gas-detection response than an extended probe by leveraging propeller-induced airflow. Code and designs are released under the CC-BY license.

AI.tldr: 提出双模态空中-地面机器人 AeRove，用螺旋桨护罩作为滚轮沿管道滚动，配合弹簧双稳态机构实现 200 ms 内地面/飞行模式切换且维持状态不需持续供电；滚动巡航使电流降低 14 倍、估算行程从 144 m 提升至 2057 m，并在 51 cm 钢管上完成导航、越障与泄漏检测验证。
AI.motivation: 近距管道巡检对标准无人机困难：悬停功耗高、对气流敏感，且螺旋桨下洗气流会干扰气体传感。
AI.method: AeRove 将螺旋桨护罩用作滚轮在地面滚动，采用弹簧加载双稳态机构在 200 ms 内完成地面/飞行模式重构；飞行仅用于越障，地面滚动用于连续行进。收敛式护罩几何提升推力效率。另设 CO2 传感实验，对比栖息（滚动/停驻）与悬停条件下的气体检测性能，并比较机身底部螺旋桨吸气式与伸出探针式进气方案。
AI.result: 相比持续飞行，电流消耗降低 14 倍（0.7 A vs 10 A），估算行程由 144 m 增至 2057 m。51 cm 直径钢管自主试验完成直道与弯道导航、越障及模拟标记泄漏检测。停驻检测的浓度响应显著大于悬停；飞行中底部螺旋桨吸气式方案比伸出探针响应更快、更强。
AI.conclusion: 双模态空中-地面设计可显著降低巡检能耗并延长航程，同时利用螺旋桨诱导气流增强气体检测，适用于近距管道巡检；代码与设计以 CC-BY 许可开源。

title: Shake to Learn: Dynamic Interrogation of Hidden Object Physics for Robotic Manipulation with Physical Reservoir Computing
summary: Many physical properties relevant to robotic manipulation are hidden from vision. A sealed object, for example, may reveal little about its center of mass (COM) or internal contents until it is lifted, shaken, or otherwise dynamically perturbed. This study shows that such interactions can enable a new modality of robotic perception and learning, in which interaction-induced dynamic responses are used to infer object physics that is inaccessible to conventional sensing. We implement this idea using an origami-inspired soft robotic arm that functions as a physical reservoir computer. After grasping an object, the arm is excited by a fixed shaking input at its base, and the resulting ringdown response is recorded through either camera tracking or embedded sensors. Because the input is held constant across trials, hidden object properties, such as the COM position, are encoded through their effect on the dynamics of the coupled robot-object system. A lightweight linear readout can then decode these dynamics to recover interpretable information about the hidden object physics. Using this framework, the soft robotic arm reservoir completed three tasks of increasing difficulty: inferring the orientation of the object's hidden COM, inferring the COM distance from the grasp point, and using the inferred COM information to guide a subsequent regrasp. We further develop a dynamic summary representation of the ringdown response that improves prediction accuracy. Together, these results establish shake-to-learn mechanical interrogation as a promising strategy for robotic systems to convert brief physical interactions into actionable cues about hidden object properties for downstream manipulation.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出"shake-to-learn"机械询问范式：利用折纸启发软体机械臂作为物理储备池计算机，通过固定晃动激励并读取耦合系统振铃响应的动力学，用轻量线性读出解码隐藏物体属性（如质心），完成质心朝向推断、质心距离估计及指导再抓取三项任务。
AI.motivation: 许多与机器人操作相关的物理属性无法通过视觉获取，例如密封物体的质心位置或内部内容物，只有在提举、摇晃或动态扰动后才可能显现。因此需要一种新的感知模态，将交互诱发的动态响应用作推断隐藏物体物理属性的信息来源。
AI.method: 采用折纸启发的软体机械臂构建物理储备池计算机；抓取物体后在基座施加固定晃动激励，通过摄像机跟踪或嵌入式传感器记录振铃响应；由于输入在多次试验中保持一致，隐藏物体属性通过影响机器人-物体耦合系统动力学而被编码；再用轻量线性读出解码这些动力学；并提出振铃响应的动态摘要表示以提升预测精度。
AI.result: 该软体机械臂储备池完成了三项难度递增的任务：推断物体隐藏质心的朝向、推断质心与抓取点之间的距离、以及利用推断出的质心信息指导后续再抓取；动态摘要表示进一步提高了预测准确率。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果确立了"shake-to-learn"机械询问作为一种有前景的策略，使机器人系统能够将短暂的物理交互转化为关于隐藏物体属性的可操作线索，用于下游操作任务。

title: ForeTac-VLA: A Forecasting-Based Tactile-Vision-Language-Action Model for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on visual perception limits robustness in contact-rich environments, where critical physical interaction states may not be visually observable. Existing tactile-enhanced VLA methods improve physical grounding using observed tactile feedback, but most remain largely reactive rather than explicitly modeling how contact may evolve. Therefore, we propose ForeTac-VLA, a forecasting-based tactile-vision-language fusion model that predicts future tactile states to guide action generation. Specifically, ForeTac-VLA encodes recent tactile observations into temporal representations and integrates them with vision-language features through bidirectional cross-attention. Further, a transformer-based forecasting module predicts multi-step future tactile states, enabling the model to reason jointly over observed and anticipated contact. Finally, the fused multimodal representations and predicted future tactile states are fed into the VLA backbone to condition action generation. To stabilize training, a ground-truth-to-prediction curriculum is employed when early forecasts are unreliable. Across four real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, ForeTac-VLA achieves an average success rate of 95%, outperforming the fine-tuned VLA model by 36.25 percentage points and state-of-the-art tactile-enhanced VLA baselines by over 22 percentage points. ForeTac-VLA also maintains strong performance under low-illumination and visually cluttered conditions. Video demonstrations can be found on https://foretac-vla.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出ForeTac-VLA，一种基于触觉预测的视觉-语言-动作融合模型，通过预测未来触觉状态指导动作生成。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型依赖视觉感知，在接触密集环境中鲁棒性不足，关键物理交互状态难以从视觉观测；已有触觉增强VLA多为被动响应式，未显式建模接触的演化过程。
AI.method: 将近期触觉观测编码为时序表示，通过双向交叉注意力与视觉-语言特征融合；用Transformer预测模块预测多步未来触觉状态；融合多模态表示与预测触觉状态输入VLA主干以条件化动作生成；训练初期采用真值到预测的课程学习稳定训练。
AI.result: 在四项真实接触密集操作任务上平均成功率95%，较微调VLA模型提升36.25个百分点，较最先进触觉增强VLA基线提升超22个百分点；在低光照与视觉杂乱条件下仍保持较强性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式预测未来触觉状态可有效增强接触密集操作中VLA模型的物理接地与鲁棒性。

title: PIVOT: Physically Informed Vision-Language Off-Road Traversability for Field Robot Navigation
summary: Terrain assessment is a critical capability for off-road mobile robots, enabling safe and reliable navigation through unstructured and geometrically complex environments. Conventional geometry-based terrain assessment is fast to compute but often overly conservative in unstructured environments. We present PIVOT: a Physically Informed Vision-Language Off-Road Traversability navigation system that augments conventional geometry-based planning with vision-language-model (VLM)-based semantic reasoning for field robots. To physically ground this assessment, we quantify how strongly the VLM's predicted traversal energy cost, robot vibration, and wheel slip correlate with real-world measurements and introduce a unified traversability score that weights each modality by its prediction-measurement correlation. For efficiency, we design a two-level navigation architecture that retains geometry-based planning as the nominal mode and invokes semantic replanning only when that mode fails to find a path. Across five repeated closed-loop trials on a mixed-terrain route totalling around $6.4$ km, the proposed system increases overall autonomy from $59.6\%$ to $97.0\%$, reduces human interventions from $11$ to $3$, and increases the mean distance between interventions (MDBI) from $69.2$ m to $412.9$ m compared with geometry-only navigation. These results demonstrate that physically grounded VLM-based terrain assessment can substantially extend autonomous navigation beyond the limitations of geometry alone, while preserving efficient geometric planning as the nominal mode.

AI.tldr: PIVOT 是一种物理信息引导的视觉-语言越野可通行性导航系统，在几何规划基础上引入 VLM 语义推理并进行物理标定，通过两级导航架构实现高效重规划，闭环实验中自主率从 59.6% 提升至 97.0%。
AI.motivation: 越野移动机器人需要在非结构化、几何复杂环境中安全可靠导航。传统基于几何的地形评估计算快，但在非结构化环境中往往过于保守，限制了自主导航能力，需要引入语义层面的可通行性推理来弥补几何方法的不足。
AI.method: 提出 PIVOT 系统：用视觉-语言模型（VLM）进行语义可通行性推理，对 VLM 预测的通行能耗代价、机器人振动与车轮打滑三类输出与真实测量值的相关性进行量化，以实现物理落地；并据此构建统一可通行性评分，按各模态的预测-测量相关性加权。导航上采用两级架构，以几何规划为常规模式，仅当几何模式无法找到路径时才触发语义重规划。
AI.result: 在约 6.4 km 混合地形路线上进行五组重复闭环试验：相比纯几何导航，整体自主率由 59.6% 提升至 97.0%，人工干预次数由 11 次降至 3 次，平均干预间隔距离（MDBI）由 69.2 m 提升至 412.9 m。
AI.conclusion: 物理落地的 VLM 地形评估可显著拓展自主导航能力，突破纯几何方法的局限，同时保留高效几何规划作为常规模式。

title: Project SCOUT: Interceptor Drone for Perimeter Defense
summary: The rapid proliferation of unauthorized unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) has created a growing need for robust, jamming-resistant counter-UAV systems for perimeter defense. This paper presents \textbf{SCOUT} (Spatial Computation for Optimized UAV Tracking), a ROS-integrated onboard perception and control framework for real-time aerial defense against incoming UAVs. SCOUT performs visual detection, target association, track filtering, and control command generation directly onboard the defender UAV, without relying on external sensing infrastructure or ground-station computation. To provide stable control inputs, the perception pipeline combines TensorRT-accelerated drone detection with ByteTrack-based association and a lightweight track-retention state machine. The state machine rejects abrupt target jumps and maintains short-term target continuity during temporary detection degradation, reducing unstable control responses caused by false detections or target switching. We evaluate the proposed architecture through an integrated hardware deployment executing a planar ``goalkeeping'' interception strategy. In this setting, the defender UAV tracks the incoming target and adjusts its motion to maintain a blocking configuration near the protected boundary. Real-world flight results show that SCOUT maintains valid target detections for 92.2\% of frames while operating at real-time onboard detection rates, demonstrating the feasibility of visual tracking and closed-loop control for UAV perimeter defense. A video demonstration of the end-to-end perimeter defense operation is available online. https://figshare.com/s/497befc033091fc0b84f

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SCOUT，一个集成于 ROS 的机载感知与控制框架，用于无人机边界防御中的实时目标跟踪与闭环拦截，实测有效检测帧率达 92.2%。
AI.motivation: 未经授权的无人机快速增多，边界防御亟需具备抗干扰能力的反无人机系统；现有方案多依赖外部传感设施或地面站计算，难以满足机载实时自主防御需求。
AI.method: SCOUT 在防御无人机上直接完成视觉检测、目标关联、航迹滤波与控制指令生成。感知流水线采用 TensorRT 加速的无人机检测、基于 ByteTrack 的关联以及轻量级航迹保持状态机，以抑制目标突变跳变、在检测短暂退化时维持目标连续性，减少误检与目标切换导致的不稳定控制响应。硬件部署下执行平面"守门"式拦截策略。
AI.result: 真实飞行实验中，SCOUT 在实时机载检测速率下保持 92.2% 帧的有效目标检测，防御无人机能够跟踪来袭目标并调整运动以维持保护区边界附近的阻挡构型，验证了视觉跟踪与闭环控制用于无人机边界防御的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明基于机载视觉感知与闭环控制的无人机边界防御方案具有工程可行性，为不依赖外部基础设施的自主反无人机系统提供了实践参考。

title: SPARROW: Survival-POMCP for Adaptive Robot Routing, Observation, and Waiting
summary: Temporary obstacles that may block a robot's planned route create a sequential navigation problem: a robot must decide whether to wait for a blockage to clear, reroute, or acquire more information about the obstacle before acting. We formulate graph navigation among temporary obstacles as a partially observable semi-Markov decision process and introduce SPARROW, a belief-space planner built on Partially Observable Monte Carlo Planning (POMCP). SPARROW searches over traversal, observation, and finite-duration waiting actions while maintaining a particle belief over latent obstacle classes and clearance times. Class-conditioned survival models are learned online from both clearance observations and right-censored encounters where the robot reroutes before clearance is observed. A generative model simulates obstacle arrivals and clearances as each action unfolds, so the planner can account for blockages that may occur along alternative routes. We further introduce a value-of-learning criterion that trades the immediate cost of collecting labelled survival data against its expected reduction in future navigation regret. Across two simulation graphs and multiple obstacle-class settings, SPARROW reduces mean time-to-goal by 12-26% relative to OSCAR, a recent survival-based method for the same problem. On a physical mobile robot, SPARROW reduces mean time-to-goal by 20.5% relative to OSCAR while selectively observing, waiting, and rerouting as environment conditions change.

AI.tldr: 将临时障碍下的图导航建模为部分可观测半马尔可夫决策过程，提出基于POMCP的置信空间规划器SPARROW，联合搜索通行、观测与有限等待动作，并在线学习障碍清除生存模型，仿真与真机实验均显著优于OSCAR。
AI.motivation: 机器人在规划路线上可能遇到临时性障碍，此时需要在"等待障碍清除、绕行、先获取更多障碍信息"之间做出序贯决策，传统方法难以权衡观测成本与未来导航收益。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为POSMDP；提出SPARROW，基于POMCP在置信空间上规划，搜索通行、观测和有限时长等待动作；用粒子滤波维护对潜在障碍类别与清除时间的置信；通过清除观测与右删失遭遇在线学习类别条件生存模型；用生成模型模拟障碍到达与清除以考虑替代路径上的阻塞；引入"学习价值"准则，权衡采集带标签生存数据的即时成本与未来导航后悔的期望降低。
AI.result: 在两个仿真图和多种障碍类别设置下，SPARROW将平均到达目标时间较OSCAR降低12-26%；在真实移动机器人上较OSCAR降低20.5%，并能随环境条件变化自适应地观测、等待与绕行。
AI.conclusion: SPARROW表明将临时障碍导航纳入置信空间规划并主动学习生存模型，能在仿真和真实场景中一致地提升导航效率与自适应性。

title: Towards Effective Visual-Inertial SLAM with Passive-Only Sensors for Low-Cost Autonomous Underwater Vehicles
summary: Improvements to Visual-Inertial Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (VI-SLAM) for low-cost autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) are critical for transitioning advanced marine robotics from specialized labs to broader research and hobbyist applications. While high-end AUVs typically rely on expensive sensor suites - such as Doppler Velocity Logs (DVLs) and Ultra-Short Baseline (USBL) systems - this work demonstrates that robust, high-quality navigation is achievable using a sub-$10, 000(USD) platform equipped only with inexpensive consumer-grade sensors. By leveraging a similarly priced, open-source AUV, we evaluate the performance of stereo cameras, Micro-electromechanical System (MEMS)-based IMUs, and depth sensors in a fully unconstrained 6-degree-of-freedom (6-DOF) underwater environment. We analyze the efficacy of off-the-shelf SLAM packages and propose optimizations for sensor fusion to mitigate the visual and physical challenges of untethered underwater operation. Our results prove that a usable SLAM solution can be accessible to the masses, providing a benchmark for expectations in demanding, real-time maritime missions without the financial barrier of industrial-grade hardware.

AI.tldr: 该研究证明，使用总价低于1万美元、仅配备消费级立体相机、MEMS IMU和深度传感器的开源AUV，即可在无缆、无约束6-DOF水下环境中实现可用的VI-SLAM导航，为低成本海洋机器人提供基准。
AI.motivation: 高端AUV依赖DVL、USBL等昂贵传感器套件，成本高昂，限制了先进海洋机器人从专业实验室走向更广泛的研究与爱好者应用。因此，亟需验证低成本平台上能否实现鲁棒、高质量的视觉-惯性SLAM导航。
AI.method: 采用价格相近的开源AUV平台，仅搭载消费级立体相机、MEMS IMU和深度传感器；在完全无约束的6-DOF水下环境中评估其性能；分析现成SLAM软件包的有效性，并针对水下无缆作业的视觉与物理挑战提出传感器融合优化方案。
AI.result: 实验验证了在低成本消费级硬件上可获得可用的SLAM解；现成SLAM包经传感器融合优化后，能缓解非结构化水下环境带来的视觉与动力学难题，实现实时导航。
AI.conclusion: 低成本、消费级硬件可支撑鲁棒的水下VI-SLAM，使SLAM技术可被大众获取，为苛刻实时海洋任务提供无需工业级硬件预算的性能预期基准。

title: Catch Me If You Can: Real-Time Feedback Denoising for Responsive VLAs
comment: 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026), Austin TX, USA
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong generalization in robotic manipulation by combining semantic knowledge from pretrained vision-language models with expressive action-generation policies. Diffusion-based action generators are particularly effective for modeling temporally coherent action chunks, but these chunks are typically executed open-loop after inference. This limits responsiveness when objects move, contacts change, or the scene evolves during execution. We propose VLA-Feedback, a two-timescale architecture that combines low-frequency diffusion planning with high-frequency visual feedback.
