Rather than fully denoising an action chunk before execution, VLA-Feedback retains its final denoising step as a lightweight feedback interface, allowing each action to be corrected using the latest observation before it is executed. This design preserves the expressiveness of the diffusion planner while enabling real-time action correction without rerunning the full vision-language diffusion model. VLA-Feedback matched GR00T on static LIBERO tasks while improving average success on dynamic simulation tasks from 27.5% to 85.0%. On real-robot tasks, it improved average success from 51% to 73%. Additional materials can be found on our project page: https://vla-feedback.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出VLA-Feedback，一种双时间尺度架构，将低频扩散规划与高频视觉反馈结合，把扩散去噪的最后一步作为轻量反馈接口，实现执行前的实时动作校正。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型虽泛化性强，但基于扩散的动作生成器通常对动作块进行开环执行，当物体移动、接触变化或场景演化时缺乏响应能力。
AI.method: 采用双时间尺度架构：低频扩散规划器负责生成动作块，保留其最终去噪步骤作为轻量反馈接口，在每次动作执行前利用最新观测对动作进行校正，无需重跑完整的视觉-语言-扩散模型。
AI.result: 在静态LIBERO任务上与GR00T持平；动态仿真任务平均成功率从27.5%提升至85.0%；真实机器人任务平均成功率从51%提升至73%。
AI.conclusion: 该设计在保留扩散规划器表达能力的同时实现了实时动作校正，显著提升了动态场景与真实环境下的操作成功率。

title: Adapting Rigid-Body Dynamics Derivatives for Constraint Embedding Closed-Chain Models
summary: This paper extends an existing algorithm for the first-order derivatives of rigid-body dynamics to the case of closed-chain kinematic systems modeled using constraint embed- ding. Many standard dynamics algorithms apply to both open- chain and constraint-embedded models, but existing efficient derivative methods assume joint velocity effects are locally config- uration invariant. We remove this assumption and derive adapted algorithms that extend dynamics derivatives to more general joint types, including those arising in constraint-embedded closed- chain models. Our results compare conventional pin-joint robot models with more complete actuation models that capture local closed chains. We show that the additional terms introduced by these generalizations have low computational impact when mod- eling actuation kinematics alone, but can incur higher cost when additional rigid bodies, such as motor rotors, are included in the actuation chain, or when considering non-local loops. Overall, these results enable more accurate dynamics computations for constraint-embedded actuation submechanisms to be adopted in model-predictive control and differentiable simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文将刚体动力学一阶导数的现有算法扩展到基于约束嵌入建模的闭链运动系统，通过移除"关节速度效应局部构型不变"假设，导出适用于更一般关节类型的动力学导数算法。
AI.motivation: 现有高效动力学导数方法假设关节速度效应在局部构型下不变，该假设不适用于约束嵌入闭链模型中的一般关节类型，限制了对更真实驱动子机构的精确动力学计算。
AI.method: 移除关节速度效应局部构型不变的假设，推导适配的动力学导数算法，将导数计算扩展至约束嵌入闭链模型中的一般关节类型；对比传统销轴关节机器人模型与捕捉局部闭链的更完整驱动模型。
AI.result: 泛化引入的附加项在仅对驱动运动学建模时计算开销较低；但当驱动链包含额外刚体（如电机转子）或考虑非局部闭环时，计算成本显著升高。
AI.conclusion: 该工作使约束嵌入驱动子机构的更精确动力学计算可用于模型预测控制与可微仿真。

title: MAPLE-RF: Efficient Probabilistic RF Source Localization in Partially Explored Environments
summary: Localizing a radio-frequency (RF) transmitter from received signals often requires a model of the environment to predict how obstacles block and reflect the signal. In many robotic applications, however, only a partial map is available, particularly when a robot localizes the source while exploring with simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). We study single-snapshot transmitter localization on such partially explored maps and compare two approaches that output a posterior over transmitter locations. The first extends a digital-twin method, which ray-traces every candidate location, to partial maps by treating unexplored space as free and training on mixed map coverage. The second, MAPLE-RF, encodes estimated path angles of arrival and signal-to-noise ratios as grid channels aligned with map knownness, occupancy, and line-of-sight visibility, and a U-Net scores all candidate positions in one pass without simulating propagation at inference. Ray-tracing simulations of indoor environments indicate that training on mixed map coverage is essential for both approaches. The digital-twin approach is more accurate on most single-snapshot metrics, while MAPLE-RF comes close at a query cost that does not depend on the propagation model and is more than two orders of magnitude below a fresh full-grid query with general-purpose ray tracing. Both outperform Gaussian and Gaussian-mixture baselines, and on exploration routes guided by its own estimates, fused MAPLE-RF posteriors place more probability near the source than the compared methods. Code and data will be released.

AI.tldr: 研究部分探索地图下的单快照射频发射源定位，比较数字孪生方法与MAPLE-RF两种输出位置后验的方法，结果表明混合地图覆盖训练对两者都至关重要。
AI.motivation: 许多机器人应用中只有部分地图可用，尤其是机器人边探索边定位射频发射源（结合SLAM）时，传统定位方法依赖完整环境模型来预测障碍物对信号的阻挡与反射，因此需要适配部分已知地图。
AI.method: 对比两种方法：第一种将数字孪生方法扩展至部分地图，把未探索空间视为自由空间并对混合地图覆盖进行训练，对每个候选位置进行射线追踪；第二种为MAPLE-RF，将估计的到达路径角和信噪比编码为与地图已知度、占据状态、视距可见性对齐的网格通道，用U-Net一次前向为所有候选位置打分，推理时不模拟传播。
AI.result: 室内环境的射线追踪仿真表明：混合地图覆盖训练对两种方法都必不可少；数字孪生方法在多数单快照指标上更准确，MAPLE-RF接近其精度，但查询成本不依赖传播模型，比使用通用射线追踪的全网格查询低两个数量级以上；两者均优于高斯和高斯混合基线；在由自身估计引导的探索路径上，融合的MAPLE-RF后验在真实源附近赋予的概率高于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 混合地图覆盖训练是部分地图下发射源定位的关键；数字孪生精度更高，MAPLE-RF以极低且与传播模型无关的查询成本接近其性能，并在探索式定位中表现更优，代码与数据将公开。

title: DEXTERA: From a Single Image to Deployable Dexterous Manipulation via Real-to-Sim-to-Real
summary: Collecting real-world robot data for dexterous manipulation is costly and time-consuming. While high-fidelity physics simulators enable scalable data synthesis and policy learning, constructing deployment-ready digital twins manually remains labor-intensive, and residual visual, geometric, and dynamics gaps hinder reliable sim-to-real transfer. We present DEXTERA, an automated real-to-sim-to-real framework that transforms a single RGB image into deployable policies for dexterous manipulation across four unified stages: (1) single-image scene factorization into a static Gaussian background and interactive rigid or articulated assets with VLM-inferred physical parameters; (2) metric scene global alignment, object canonicalization, and morphology-balanced robot calibration; (3) scalable simulator task primitive construction, VR teleoperation, and object-centric trajectory synthesis; and (4) a shared multimodal policy interface supporting both imitation learning and reinforcement learning. We evaluate DEXTERA across 13 task-embodiment pairs, 2 dexterous robot platforms, and 6 policy architectures. Experimental results demonstrate that DEXTERA achieves superior visual fidelity and 3D geometric reconstruction compared to generative baselines, while cross-domain trajectory replays validate strong physical interaction consistency. Furthermore, simulation-only trained policies enable viable zero-shot real-robot deployment, while simulation-real co-training substantially improves mean physical policy success from 29.2% to 61.9% across diverse policy architectures.

AI.tldr: DEXTERA是一个自动化的real-to-sim-to-real框架，可从单张RGB图像生成可部署的灵巧操作策略，通过仿真数据或仿真-真实联合训练实现零样本或高效的真实机器人迁移。
AI.motivation: 真实世界灵巧操作数据采集成本高、耗时长；虽可用高保真物理仿真器进行可扩展的数据合成与策略学习，但手动构建可部署的数字孪生工作量大，且视觉、几何与动力学残差阻碍了可靠的sim-to-real迁移。
AI.method: DEXTERA包含四个统一阶段：(1) 单图像场景分解为静态高斯背景与可交互的刚体/铰接资产，并用VLM推断物理参数；(2) 度量场景全局对齐、物体规范化与形态均衡的机器人标定；(3) 可扩展的仿真器任务原语构建、VR遥操作与以物体为中心的运动轨迹合成；(4) 支持模仿学习与强化学习的共享多模态策略接口。
AI.result: 在13个任务-具身配对、2个灵巧机器人平台、6种策略架构上评估：DEXTERA在视觉保真度与3D几何重建上优于生成式基线；跨域轨迹回放验证了较强的物理交互一致性；仅仿真训练的策略可实现可行的零样本真实机器人部署，仿真-真实联合训练将平均物理策略成功率从29.2%提升至61.9%。
AI.conclusion: DEXTERA证明了自动化real-to-sim-to-real流程可为灵巧操作提供高保真、可部署的策略学习方案，仿真-真实联合训练能显著提升真实机器人操作成功率。

title: Constraint-Unified MPC for Over-Actuated Surface Vehicles with Post-Detection Fault Reconfiguration
comment: 15 pages, 10 figures. Accepted for the International Symposium of Robotics Research (ISRR) 2026
summary: Choreographed aquatic performances require small autonomous surface vehicles to track precise paths under per-thruster force and rate limits, including after thruster failures. We report a deployed system in which trajectory tracking, thrust allocation, and the per-thruster force and rate limits are resolved in a single quadratic program over the per-thruster commands, with fault reconfiguration entering through one binary flag per thruster from an external detector. The system has driven a fleet in live performances on Lake Zürich and at the Time Space Existence 2025 exhibition in Venice. The field campaign measures 1.6 cm root mean square position error in a 10-minute hold and 4.3 cm over a 10 m square at 0.6 m/s. At 0.5 m/s, losing the front thruster increases the error to 11.6 cm, while losing the starboard-side thruster increases it to 11.5 cm. Losing two thrusters simultaneously leaves the craft tracking a 0.4 m/s square with a root mean square position error of 1.25 m. Compared to our own cascaded baseline, the unified formulation tracks the nominal square to the same few centimeters and holds station more tightly with roughly half the thruster force. The architectures separate after a thruster failure, where the unified controller stays within 24 cm of the reference path while the cascade leaves it.

AI.tldr: 提出将轨迹跟踪、推力分配与执行器力/速率限制统一为单个二次规划（QP）的自主水面艇控制架构，并通过故障标志实现容错重构，已在真实表演中部署验证。
AI.motivation: 编排水上表演要求小型自主水面艇在推力器力与速率限制下精确跟踪路径，且需在推力器故障后仍保持控制性能；传统级联架构在故障后性能退化明显。
AI.method: 将轨迹跟踪、推力分配以及每个推力器的力与速率限制统一在一个关于每推力器指令的二次规划中求解；故障重构由外部检测器提供的每个推力器一个二值标志引入。
AI.result: 在苏黎世湖现场表演中，10分钟定点保持的RMS位置误差为1.6 cm，10 m方形轨迹（0.6 m/s）为4.3 cm；0.5 m/s时失去前推力器误差增至11.6 cm，失去右舷推力器增至11.5 cm；同时失去两个推力器时以0.4 m/s跟踪方形轨迹RMS误差为1.25 m。与自研级联基线相比，统一形式在标称方形轨迹上精度相当，但定点保持更紧且推力约为一半；故障后统一控制器保持在参考路径24 cm内，而级联架构则偏离路径。
AI.conclusion: 单一QP统一形式在正常与故障工况下均优于级联基线，具备实际部署的容错跟踪能力，但双推力器同时失效时性能显著下降。

title: Design of Adaptive PID Controller Based On Asynchronous Advantage Actor Critic Learning Method for QuadCopter Control
summary: Quadcopters offer great utility in many applications, but their nonlinear nature and disturbance sensitivity present great control challenges. Basic PID controllers are generally not sophisticated enough to cope with these complexities. This paper suggests a control system that integrates the Asynchronous Advantage Actor-Critic (A3C) algorithm with a PID controller for quadcopter attitude and trajectory tracking. The A3C controller uses parallel agents to optimize PID parameters dynamically using a neural network. A system identification module for the complementary system makes predictions about system states for optimal control policy. The proposed framework was compared with a standard actor-critic (A2C) model. Simulation results verify that they both track accurately. However, the A3C-based controller converges much more for the loss function, as evidenced by reward figures and loss curves, demonstrating better parameter optimization. This shows that A3C-based approach results in improved performance for the control of quadcopter, effectively integrating reinforcement learning and traditional control to achieve higher adaptability.

AI.tldr: 本文将A3C强化学习算法与PID控制器结合，用于四旋翼姿态与轨迹跟踪，A3C通过并行agent与神经网络动态整定PID参数，并结合系统辨识模块预测状态；与A2C对比，仿真表明两者均能精确跟踪，但A3C损失收敛更好、参数优化更优。
AI.motivation: 四旋翼具有非线性特性和对扰动敏感的问题，传统基础PID控制器应对复杂工况能力不足，因此需要更具自适应性的控制方案。
AI.method: 提出集成A3C算法与PID控制器的控制系统，利用并行agent通过神经网络动态优化PID参数；并设置系统辨识模块为互补系统预测系统状态，以获得最优控制策略；与标准A2C模型进行对比。
AI.result: 仿真结果显示两种控制器都能精确跟踪；但基于A3C的控制器损失函数收敛更好，奖励曲线与损失曲线均验证其参数优化效果更佳。
AI.conclusion: A3C与PID结合的方法提升了四旋翼控制性能，有效融合强化学习与传统控制，实现更高的适应性。

title: Dynamic Modeling and LQR Control of a Single Coaxial Drone with 2DOF Thrust Vectoring Mechanism
summary: Coaxial rotor drones have generated considerable interest because of energy efficiency and small size, but they are afflicted with inherent underactuation for roll and pitch control, although systems like swashplates have circumvented this limitation at the cost of greater mechanical complexity. This work presents a novel coaxial drone supplemented by a two-degreesof-freedom pendulum mechanism for active thrust vectoring that offers a less mechanically complicated alternative. We develop a comprehensive Lagrangian dynamic model that does not ignore the inertial contributions of all the components, including body, servo arms, and motor assembly. A Linear Quadratic Regulator(LQR) is designed based on the linearized dynamics around the hover equilibrium. High-fidelity simulations taking actuator dynamics and sensor noise into account validate the proposed architecture. An Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) blends GPS, barometer, and IMU estimates with high accuracy for state estimation. The findings verify the potential and reliability of this approach for power-saving, rapid coaxial UAVs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种采用二自由度摆式机构的主动推力矢量同轴旋翼无人机，以较低机械复杂度实现滚转与俯仰控制，并通过拉格朗日建模、LQR控制、EKF状态估计及高保真仿真验证其可行性与节能潜力。
AI.motivation: 同轴旋翼无人机具有能效高、体积小的优势，但滚转与俯仰控制存在固有欠驱动问题；现有斜盘机构虽能克服该限制，却显著增加机械复杂度。因此需要一种机械结构更简单、同时能实现主动推力矢量控制的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出由二自由度摆式机构实现主动推力矢量的同轴无人机架构；建立完整拉格朗日动力学模型，涵盖机体、舵机臂和电机组件的惯性贡献；在悬停平衡点线性化后设计LQR控制器；并结合执行器动态与传感器噪声开展高保真仿真；采用EKF融合GPS、气压计与IMU进行状态估计。
AI.result: 高保真仿真（考虑执行器动态与传感器噪声）验证了所提架构的有效性；EKF融合GPS、气压计与IMU实现高精度状态估计；结果表明该方案在节能型快速同轴无人机方面具有潜力与可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 二自由度摆式推力矢量机构可作为一种机械复杂度较低的同轴无人机欠驱动解决方案，配合完整动力学建模、LQR控制与EKF状态估计，能够可靠实现滚转与俯仰主动控制，具备节能与快速飞行的应用前景。

title: Dynamics-Induced Commitment in Learning-Based Robotic Penalty Kicks
summary: Learning in robotic games is constrained not only by strategic information but also by what the body can still execute. We study this coupling in a hierarchical humanoid-quadruped penalty system in which game-level self-play policies command fixed soccer whole-body controllers (S-WBCs). The humanoid shooting skill is initialized from self-collected motion-capture data, whereas the quadruped saving skill is learned by reinforcement learning. We introduce dynamics-induced commitment mapping (DIC-Map), a body-grounded analysis that estimates continuation capability, identifies the first persistent loss of a terminal alternative, and tests whether the remaining interaction admits a reduced zero-sum game. For symmetric terminal alternatives, the reduced game yields a closed-form bound on optimal strategy concentration determined by the responder's value of deferring. We further show that, when the responder acts through an estimator, equal response values eliminate the direct terminal-allocation gradient and leave an estimator-mediated first-order learning channel. Experiments locate commitment about 0.29 s before contact, and changing only ball speed shifts deferral coverage. Across four responder policies, replacing the estimator raises save rate from 0.240 to 0.472, whereas a comparable gain in read accuracy obtained by waiting raises it only to 0.246. Posterior analysis is used for the equilibrium comparison because the available coverage terms are observational proxies. Project website: https://chris-ruizegeng.github.io/penaltykick/

AI.tldr: 该研究提出动力学诱导承诺映射（DIC-Map），在分层人形-四足点球系统中刻画"身体可执行性"对博弈学习的约束，并给出简化零和博弈的闭式界与估计器中介的学习通道分析。
AI.motivation: 机器人博弈学习不仅受策略信息约束，还受身体能否继续执行动作（延续能力）的约束。作者希望定量刻画这种"策略-身体"耦合，尤其是何时承诺（commitment）不可逆地发生、以及承诺后剩余交互能否简化为零和博弈。
AI.method: 构建分层人形-四足点球系统：博弈层自对弈策略指挥固定的足球全身控制器（S-WBC）；人形射门技能基于自采集动作捕捉数据初始化，四足扑救技能用强化学习训练。提出DIC-Map：估计延续能力、定位终端备选首次持续丧失的时刻，并检验剩余交互是否可约减为零和博弈。对对称终端备选推导最优策略集中度的闭式界（由响应者的延迟价值决定）；并分析当响应者经由估计器行动时，相等响应值会消除直接的终端分配梯度，仅保留估计器中介的一阶学习通道。
AI.result: 实验定位承诺发生在触球前约0.29秒；仅改变球速即可改变延迟覆盖范围。在四种响应者策略下，替换估计器使扑救率从0.240提升至0.472；而通过等待获得的相近读球准确率提升仅将扑救率提高到0.246。由于可用的覆盖项是观测代理，故采用后验分析进行均衡比较。
AI.conclusion: 身体动力学造成的承诺会重塑博弈结构：承诺时刻可被定量定位，且其后的交互常可约减为零和博弈；学习效果的关键瓶颈在于响应者的估计器而非单纯读球准确率，改进估计器远比延后决策更有效。

title: Learning Scene-Aware Humanoid Locomotion through 3D Clutter from Immersive Human Demonstrations
summary: While learning from human motions has enabled highly dynamic humanoid skills such as dancing and martial arts in obstacle-free space, traversal through densely cluttered environments remains underexplored. These spaces are three-dimensional and geometrically constrained, requiring scene-aware locomotion that tightly couples whole-body motion with scene geometry for obstacle avoidance. To address these challenges, we present Moving Through Clutter (MTC), a learning-from-demonstration framework for scene-aware humanoid locomotion. To bypass costly physical scene construction, MTC uses procedurally generated Virtual Reality environments for immersive data collection. To transform these human motions into training-ready humanoid motions, we propose a scene-aware motion retargeting algorithm that converts human demonstrations into humanoid trajectories while strictly enforcing robot-scene clearance to guarantee collision-free traversal. These reference trajectories are then used to train a scene-aware locomotion policy that deploys on a Unitree G1 humanoid. Evaluated on our proposed MTC-Challenge for multi-obstacle traversal, the policy demonstrates a 70.2% collision-free rate across diverse scenarios, successfully traversing complex environments through diverse whole-body skills, including crawling through low-clearance passages and squeezing through narrow gaps.

AI.tldr: MTC是一个从示范中学习场景感知人形运动的框架，利用VR生成环境采集人类动作并经场景感知重定向训练运动策略，在Unitree G1上实现密集障碍环境中的全身避障穿越。
AI.motivation: 现有从人类运动学习的方法虽能让仿人机器人在无障碍空间中完成高动态技能（如跳舞、武术），但对密集杂乱三维受限环境中的穿越问题研究不足。此类环境几何约束强，要求全身运动与场景几何紧密耦合以实现避障，而真实场景搭建成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出MTC（Moving Through Clutter）从示范学习框架：使用程序化生成的虚拟现实环境进行沉浸式数据采集，规避昂贵的实体场景搭建；提出场景感知运动重定向算法，将人类示范转换为仿人轨迹，并严格约束机器人—场景间隙以保证无碰撞穿越；以所得参考轨迹训练场景感知运动策略，部署于Unitree G1仿人机器人。
AI.result: 在自提出的MTC-Challenge多障碍穿越基准上评估，策略在多样化场景中实现70.2%的无碰撞率，并通过爬行通过低净空通道、挤过狭窄缝隙等多种全身技能成功穿越复杂环境。
AI.conclusion: MTC验证了从人类示范学习并结合场景感知重定向的可行性，为仿人机器人在密集杂乱三维环境中的全身避障运动提供了有效途径。

title: Demonstration Synthesis from a Single Scan via Gaussian Splatting for Visuomotor Policy Learning
summary: Training a visuomotor policy calls for abundant demonstrations that closely match the target environment, yet collecting them anew remains expensive. Existing demonstration synthesis methods reduce this cost but remain constrained by high manual effort, limited visual fidelity, or heavy reliance on physics simulators. This paper introduces GaussianFactory, a high-fidelity data engine that mass-produces demonstrations with a single video scan as its only human input and no physics engine in the generation loop. Specifically, GaussianFactory reconstructs the scene as an editable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) replica and samples from the object-combination tasks the scene affords. For each task, it plans grasps and trajectories purely kinematically on the geometric reconstruction, rendering photorealistic demonstrations that visually match the target environment. Physical dynamics enter the pipeline only where contact force interactions dictate the outcome---during grasp formation, via a learned contact model pretrained once on an interaction dataset. To evaluate the downstream utility of the synthesized demonstrations, we implement an end-to-end scan-to-deployment workflow in two setups: a simulated scene that stands in for the real world to enable reproducibility, and a real-world workspace with a physical UR10e robot. In each setup, a standard diffusion policy trained solely on the synthesized demonstrations achieves 95.1% and 84.2% success rates, respectively.

AI.tldr: GaussianFactory是一个仅需一次视频扫描作为人类输入、无需物理引擎参与生成循环的高保真数据引擎，通过3D高斯泼溅重建场景并运动学规划抓取与轨迹，合成逼真演示数据，在仿真与真实UR10e机器人上训练的扩散策略分别达到95.1%和84.2%的成功率。
AI.motivation: 训练视觉运动策略需要大量与目标环境高度匹配的演示数据，而重新采集成本高昂。现有演示合成方法虽能降低成本，但仍受限于高人工投入、有限视觉保真度或对物理仿真器的重度依赖。
AI.method: 以单次视频扫描为唯一人类输入，将场景重建为可编辑的3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）副本，并从场景支持的对象组合任务中采样；对每个任务在几何重建上纯运动学地规划抓取与轨迹，渲染照片级逼真演示；仅在接触力决定结果的抓取形成阶段引入物理动力学，通过预先在交互数据集上训练一次的习得接触模型实现。
AI.result: 实现了端到端的扫描到部署工作流，在两种设置下评估：替代真实世界以保证可复现性的仿真场景，以及配备物理UR10e机器人的真实工作空间。仅使用合成演示训练的标准扩散策略在两个设置下分别取得95.1%和84.2%的成功率。
AI.conclusion: GaussianFactory证明仅凭单次视频扫描、无需物理引擎即可大规模生成高保真演示，所合成数据能有效支撑下游视觉运动策略训练，并在仿真与真实机器人部署中均表现出高成功率。

title: Noctif3R: Feed-Forward Monocular Real-Time SLAM for Photon-Limited Scenes on Embedded Hardware
summary: Robots carrying out tasks in dark environments need to localize from a single RGB camera, in light so low that the per-pixel signal approaches the sensor's own noise, on a power-constrained onboard computer, in real time. Each of these constraints has matured pipelines, but the intersection does not. Offline low-light reconstruction now recovers structure below -4 dB but is far too slow to run in real time, while the real-time monocular systems a robot can actually carry (DROID-SLAM, DPV-SLAM, etc.) degrade or fail when SNR gets low. We measured how they fail: across the nine lowest darkness levels of our scenes, DROID-SLAM returns a full-length trajectory carrying no information about the camera's motion on all nine, VGGT-SLAM and CUT3R on eight, pi^3 on seven, and DPV-SLAM on four. We present SYS, a monocular pipeline built on a low-light feed-forward pointmap front end with an explicit match gate, which returns three tracked trajectories and no uninformative ones, at the lowest error of any method where it tracks (24-47% of the no-information ceiling against 56-73% for the strongest baseline), and at the narrowest coverage. On a real robot video take in which 86.5% of delivered frames are entirely black, every configuration of ours stops after the lit beginning, while DROID-SLAM and DPV-SLAM each emit a pose for all 1178 frames. Our method contribution is an embedded execution path for the Jetson AGX Orin: running the map, keyframes and backend at 384 pixels with tracking at 256, together with two fixes to the per-frame pose solve, is a replicated Pareto improvement, 1.28x throughput at 0.964x error on one scene and 1.42x at 0.68x on a second, with 47% less peak GPU memory and 29% less energy per pose. We evaluate on a calibrated, bit-exact regenerable noise ladder, on relabelled real-world dark exposures, and on a new dark-room video ladder recorded from a Boston Dynamics Spot robot.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SYS——一个面向暗环境机器人的单目视觉里程计/建图流水线，基于低光前馈pointmap前端与显式匹配门控，在极低信噪比下给出更可靠轨迹与更高精度，并在Jetson AGX Orin上实现能效与内存更优的嵌入式实时执行路径。
AI.motivation: 机器人在极暗环境中需依靠单目RGB相机、低功耗板载计算机实时定位，而现有实时单目系统（DROID-SLAM、DPV-SLAM等）在低信噪比下退化或失效；离线低光重建精度虽高但无法实时。作者实测了这些系统在暗光下的失效模式，发现它们会输出看似完整却完全不含相机运动信息的"无信息轨迹"，因此需要一种在暗光下既实时又可靠的方法。
AI.method: SYS构建于低光前馈pointmap前端之上，并引入显式匹配门控（match gate）以判断跟踪是否有效，从而避免输出无信息轨迹。同时提出面向Jetson AGX Orin的嵌入式执行路径：地图、关键帧与后端以384像素运行，跟踪以256像素运行，并对逐帧位姿求解进行两处修正。评估使用标定且比特精确可复现的噪声阶梯、重标注的真实暗光曝光数据，以及从Boston Dynamics Spot机器人采集的新暗室视频阶梯。
AI.result: 在场景中最暗的九个暗度等级上，DROID-SLAM在全部九个上返回无信息全长轨迹，VGGT-SLAM与CUT3R在八个、pi^3在七个、DPV-SLAM在四个上如此。SYS返回三条被跟踪轨迹且无无信息轨迹，在其可跟踪范围内误差最低（为无信息上限的24–47%，最强基线为56–73%）。在86.5%帧全黑的实际机器人视频中，所有配置均在明亮开头后停止，而DROID-SLAM与DPV-SLAM对全部1178帧都输出了位姿。嵌入式优化实现可复现的帕累托改进：一个场景吞吐提升1.28倍、误差为0.964倍，另一场景1.42倍、误差0.68倍，峰值GPU内存减少47%，每个位姿能耗降低29%。
AI.conclusion: 在暗光实时单目定位这一交叉约束下，SYS通过匹配门控与前馈pointmap前端避免了现有方法常见的无信息轨迹输出，在可跟踪范围内取得更低误差，并通过嵌入式执行优化在Jetson AGX Orin上实现吞吐、精度、内存与能耗的多目标改进，适用于低功耗机器人暗环境部署。

title: MetaPusher: Meta Learning and Planning for Nonprehensile Manipulation of Unseen Objects with Rapid Online Adaption
summary: Manipulating previously unseen objects remains challenging, as their dynamics depend on latent physical properties, such as friction and mass distribution, that cannot be inferred from perception alone. Prior experience across objects can provide an initial estimate of unseen object dynamics, but this estimate remains uncertain and can degrade further during sim-to-real transfer. Adapting the dynamics through interaction can progressively refine the estimation, however, updating the model may invalidate the planned trajectory. Successful and efficient manipulation therefore requires both rapid dynamics adaptation and a planning strategy that can incorporate this evolution. In this work, we introduce MetaPusher, a meta-learning and adaptive planning framework for nonprehensile manipulation of unseen objects without prior object-specific interactions. A meta-learned dynamics model rapidly adapts from interactions during task execution, while an adaptive kinodynamic planner updates long-horizon plans by reusing and refining its existing search tree. This coupling enables manipulation and adaptation without a separate data collection phase. We evaluate MetaPusher on unseen objects in simulation and in sim-to-real scenarios, comparing against fine-tuning and active learning methods, MPPI-based control, and a reinforcement learning policy. It achieves lower prediction error and improves task success rate by up to 20%.

AI.tldr: MetaPusher：结合元学习动力学模型与自适应kinodynamic规划，实现未知物体非抓取式操作的快速适应与长时程规划，仿真与sim-to-real任务成功率最高提升20%。
AI.motivation: 未知物体操作困难在于其动力学依赖摩擦、质量分布等无法仅从感知推断的隐式物理属性。跨物体经验可提供初始估计，但该估计不确定且在sim-to-real迁移中会退化；通过交互自适应可逐步精化，但更新模型会使已规划轨迹失效。因此需要兼具快速动力学适应与可融合模型演化的规划策略。
AI.method: 提出MetaPusher框架：1）元学习动力学模型，在执行任务过程中从交互快速适应；2）自适应kinodynamic规划器，通过复用并精化已有搜索树来更新长时程规划。二者耦合，使操作与适应无需独立的数据采集阶段。
AI.result: 在仿真及sim-to-real场景中对未知物体进行评估，与微调、主动学习方法、MPPI控制及强化学习策略对比：MetaPusher获得更低的预测误差，任务成功率最高提升20%。
AI.conclusion: 将元学习动力学适应与树复用式自适应规划耦合，可在无物体特定先验交互条件下高效完成未知物体非抓取式操作，并在仿真到现实迁移中保持性能优势。

title: SAGE: Safety-Aligned Gradient Enforcement for Human--Robot Collaboration
summary: Multi-party human-robot collaboration poses a dual challenge: robot decisions should remain interpretable and auditable, while executed actions must satisfy safety constraints during physical interaction. Combining explainable decision-tree policies with control-barrier-function (CBF) filtering provides a promising architecture but creates two learning mismatches in multi-agent reinforcement learning. Safety projection changes the action applied to the environment, while the coupled proposal graph can misalign independently optimized actor updates with a team-level update. We present safety-aligned gradient enforcement (SAGE) to address both mismatches. Its shield-annealed internalization layer (SAIL) uses a differentiable finite-penalty proposal map while retaining the exact CBF quadratic program for execution, preserving constraint-normal sensitivity to internalize repeatedly active safety constraints. Team-averaged Lyapunov policy optimization (TALO) constructs a team-aware update reference and applies a Lyapunov half-space correction to regulate independent actor updates. Physical experiments with two humanoid robots and a human partner demonstrate deployment feasibility. Across nine simulation scenarios, SAGE achieves a 71.0% success rate with 0.5 collision steps per thousand environment steps. Ablations show that direct CBF filtering reduces collision frequency by 98.5% but decreases success from 67.3% to 59.3%. SAIL reduces proposal violation by 48.8% and proposal-execution correction by 85.2%, while TALO reduces the update-consistency gap by 50.8%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAGE方法，通过SAIL层与TALO优化解决可解释决策树策略与CBF滤波结合时在多智能体强化学习中产生的两类学习不匹配问题，实现多人-机器人协作的安全与性能兼顾。
AI.motivation: 多人-机器人协作要求机器人决策既可解释、可审计，又须在物理交互中满足安全约束。将可解释决策树策略与控制屏障函数（CBF）滤波结合是有前景的架构，但在多智能体强化学习中引入两个学习不匹配：(1) 安全投影改变了实际作用于环境的动作；(2) 耦合的提议图使独立优化的actor更新与团队级更新产生错位。
AI.method: 提出安全对齐梯度强化（SAGE）。其一是shield-annealed internalization layer（SAIL），使用可微的有限惩罚提议映射，同时保留精确的CBF二次规划用于执行，从而保持约束-范数敏感性以内化反复激活的安全约束。其二是team-averaged Lyapunov policy optimization（TALO），构建团队感知的更新参考，并施加Lyapunov半空间修正以规范独立的actor更新。
AI.result: 在两个人形机器人与一名人类伙伴的物理实验中验证了部署可行性。在九个仿真场景中，SAGE达到71.0%成功率，每千环境步0.5次碰撞步。消融显示：直接CBF滤波将碰撞频率降低98.5%，但成功率从67.3%降至59.3%；SAIL将提议违反降低48.8%、提议-执行修正降低85.2%；TALO将更新一致性差距降低50.8%。
AI.conclusion: 直接CBF滤波虽显著提升安全性但损害任务成功率，而SAGE通过SAIL将安全约束内化、通过TALO对齐团队更新，在保证安全的同时维持并提升任务性能，兼顾可解释性与安全性，具备实际部署可行性。

title: Same World, Different Knowledge: When Isolated Audits Misjudge World-Model Repairs
summary:
A repair favored under an isolated input fault can be inferior when deployed modules share the faulty information. We introduce an information-interface
  audit for world models, distinguishing fidelity gaps, where exact inputs become estimates, from availability gaps, where inputs are missing. Fixed-weight
  interventions measure prediction error, input dependence, and paired closed-loop benefit, including dependencies introduced by reconstruction. In
  simulated quadrotor model predictive control, coupled, opposite-sign 10% mass/thrust calibration errors reduce a physics-anchored model's success from 69%
  to 8%; uncertainty training restores 65%. Wind reconstruction recovers control benefit but inherits calibration dependence. For a positive calibration
  offset, reconstruction-only corruption favors uncertainty-trained reconstruction, whereas shared corruption favors the baseline. Acceleration diagnostics
  reveal compensation between reconstruction bias and nominal-model error, also observed with a disturbance observer. Repair selection therefore depends on
  the information paths used in deployment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向世界模型的"信息接口审计"，区分保真度缺口（精确输入变为估计）与可用性缺口（输入缺失），用固定权重干预测量预测误差、输入依赖与闭环收益，指出在共享故障信息时优越的修复可能反而更差。
AI.motivation: 在孤立输入故障下表现良好的修复方法，当部署模块共享同一故障信息时可能反而更差；因此需要从部署所使用的信息路径出发评估修复方案，而非仅看单一输入扰动下的表现。
AI.method: 提出信息接口审计，区分保真度缺口（精确输入被估计替代）与可用性缺口（输入缺失）；采用固定权重干预，测量预测误差、输入依赖以及成对的闭环收益，并纳入由重构引入的依赖关系。在仿真四旋翼模型预测控制中验证。
AI.result: 耦合、反号的10%质量/推力标定误差使基于物理锚定模型的成功率从69%降至8%，不确定性训练恢复到65%；风场重构恢复了控制收益但继承了标定依赖。正标定偏移下，仅重构受污染时有利于不确定性训练的重构，而共享污染时有利于基线。加速度诊断揭示重构偏差与标称模型误差之间存在补偿，扰动观测器中亦观察到该现象。
AI.conclusion: 修复方案的选择取决于部署中使用的信息路径；应基于信息接口审计而非孤立输入故障下的表现来评判世界模型修复的有效性。

title: MA-LIPP: Cooperative Multi-Agent Load-Aware Informative Path Planning for Heterogeneous Robot Teams
summary: Field robotics missions often require physical samples to be returned to laboratories for analysis, making path planning inherently load-aware and order-dependent as accumulated samples increase payload and traversal energy costs. In single-robot Load-Aware Informative Path Planning (LIPP), this rigidly couples sensing with hauling: a solitary robot must transport every collected sample, forcing frequent depot returns that severely restrict its spatial coverage. Heterogeneous multi-robot teams can overcome this bottleneck by dividing labor---enabling high-precision samplers to collect while high-capacity carriers handle transport. However, this introduces a complex coordination challenge regarding when, where, what, and to whom handoffs should occur on top of the LIPP problem. To address this tightly coupled problem, we introduce Multi-Agent LIPP (MA-LIPP), which enables teams to cooperate through asynchronous "dead drops," allowing one robot to deposit samples for another to retrieve later without requiring synchronous rendezvous. We formulate MA-LIPP as an exact Mixed-Integer Quadratic Program (MIQP) alongside a scalable Pairwise Large-Neighborhood Search (LNS) heuristic for complex real-world applications. The heuristic matches exact optima in $95.5\%$ of certified cases and reduces weighted posterior variance by $16.1$--$19.8\%$ relative to a sequential baseline on larger instances of up to 12 robots, providing a robust framework for cooperative physical-sampling missions.

AI.tldr: 提出Multi-Agent LIPP（MA-LIPP）问题，通过异步"dead drops"实现异构多机器人采样与运输分工，以MIQP精确建模并用Pairwise LNS启发式求解。
AI.motivation: 单机器人LIPP中采样与搬运强耦合，机器人必须运送所有样本，导致频繁返回基地，严重限制空间覆盖范围。
AI.method: 将MA-LIPP精确建模为混合整数二次规划（MIQP），并针对大规模实际应用提出可扩展的Pairwise大邻域搜索（LNS）启发式。
AI.result: 启发式在95.5%的已验证案例中达到精确最优，在最多12个机器人的较大规模实例上将加权后验方差较顺序基线降低16.1%–19.8%。
AI.conclusion: MA-LIPP通过异构团队与异步dead drops分工，为协作式物理采样任务提供了稳健框架。

title: OpenRoIS: A Community-Driven Open-Source Middleware Implementing the Robotic Interaction Service (RoIS) Framework for Physical Robots and Virtual Agents
comment: Submitted for presentation at the 2027 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration (SII), Kobe, Japan
summary: Service applications for human-robot interaction are commonly written against the hardware-specific interfaces of one platform, so a change of hardware forces a rewrite of the application. The Robotic Interaction Service (RoIS) Framework 2.0, standardized by the Object Management Group (OMG), addresses this fragmentation by defining a platform-independent model in which Service Applications interact with Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) Engines through standardized interfaces and hardware-independent symbolic messages. A specification alone, however, does not provide the maintained implementation, Software Development Kits (SDKs), and adapters needed for practical adoption. This paper presents OpenRoIS, a community-driven open-source middleware providing a concrete implementation of the RoIS Framework 2.0. It takes the position that an openly developed, paradigm-neutral implementation is what carries the standard from specification to practice. OpenRoIS contributes a recursive engine architecture in which a single engine class realizes the main and sub HRI Engine roles, an internal five-method component contract distinct from the five external RoIS interfaces, a mapping of those interfaces onto JSON-RPC 2.0 over WebSocket, a single-source-of-truth type pipeline that generates three consistent language stacks, TypeScript and C# client SDKs that include web and Unity support, and a Python adapter SDK that includes ROS 2 support. Through the common RoIS interfaces, a Service Application can address physical robots and virtual agents over the internet. All source code, interface types, and documentation are released under the Apache-2.0 license and openly developed at https://openrois.org/.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 OpenRoIS——一个社区驱动的开源中间件，作为 OMG 标准化 RoIS Framework 2.0 的具体实现，将平台无关的机器人交互服务标准从规范推向工程实践。
AI.motivation: 人机交互（HRI）服务应用通常针对某一平台的硬件特定接口编写，更换硬件即需重写应用，造成严重的碎片化问题。OMG 的 RoIS Framework 2.0 虽定义了平台无关模型，但仅有规范无法提供实际采用所需的可维护实现、SDK 与适配器。
AI.method: OpenRoIS 提供 RoIS Framework 2.0 的开源实现，其核心包括：递归引擎架构（单一引擎类同时实现主 HRI 引擎与子 HRI 引擎角色）；内部的五方法组件契约（区别于五个外部 RoIS 接口）；将接口映射到基于 WebSocket 的 JSON-RPC 2.0；单一数据源类型流水线生成三套一致的语言栈；TypeScript 与 C# 客户端 SDK（支持 Web 与 Unity）；以及支持 ROS 2 的 Python 适配器 SDK。
AI.result: 通过统一的 RoIS 接口，服务应用可经由互联网同时访问物理机器人与虚拟代理；生成的三套语言栈类型保持一致，客户端与适配器 SDK 覆盖 Web、Unity 与 ROS 2 场景。
AI.conclusion: 一个开放开发、范式中立的实现是将标准从规范转化为实践的关键。全部源代码、接口类型与文档以 Apache-2.0 许可发布，并在 openrois.org 上开放开发。

title: When to Waddle: A Comparative Study of Bipedal Torso-Stabilization on Low-Friction Surfaces
summary: Low-friction surfaces challenge bipedal locomotion by limiting the contact forces available during stepping. Inspired by penguin waddling, we investigate how lateral torso motion and center of mass (COM) placement affect locomotion as surface friction changes. Using a five-actuator biped, we compare an upright-gait strategy with a penguin-inspired torso-over-stance-leg strategy across multiple COM placements in simulation and hardware. In the 3-D simulator MuJoCo, we sweep through sinusoidal leg and hip actuation parameters across four friction coefficients mu = 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7. In simulation, torso-over-stance-leg motion produces more successful controllers and higher forward speeds at low friction, with the highest speed occurring for the high-COM configuration. Hardware experiments show the same low-friction speed trend: at mu=0.12, torso-over-stance-leg motion increases forward speed and reduces cost of transport at both tested COM ratios, and the higher COM also improves both measures. The high-COM penguin configuration is the fastest and most energy efficient while maintaining low sideways foot motion. At mu=0.45, the COM trend reverses: the lower-COM configurations are faster and more energy efficient, while gait strategy has little effect on forward speed but still changes sideways foot motion. These results show that the effects of lateral torso motion and COM placement depend on the available friction, and that forward speed, energy use, and slip-related foot motion can be modulated with a penguin-inspired torso motion on hardware.

AI.tldr: 受企鹅摇摆步态启发，研究在低摩擦表面上通过躯干侧向运动与质心（COM）位置调整来改善双足运动，并在MuJoCo仿真与五自由度硬件上验证其摩擦依赖性效果。
AI.motivation: 低摩擦表面限制了迈步时可用接触力，给双足运动带来挑战，需要探索新的步态策略与质心配置以维持运动性能。
AI.method: 使用五执行器双足机器人，对比直立步态与"躯干位于支撑腿上方"的企鹅式步态；在MuJoCo中扫描正弦腿/髋驱动参数，覆盖μ=0.1、0.3、0.5、0.7四种摩擦系数，并测试多种COM位置，随后在硬件上验证。
AI.result: 仿真中，低摩擦下躯干位于支撑腿上方产生更多成功控制器和更高前进速度，高COM配置速度最高。硬件实验在μ=0.12时呈相同趋势，前进速度提高、运输成本降低，高COM同时改善两项指标并保持低侧向足部运动。在μ=0.45时趋势反转：低COM更快更节能，步态策略对速度影响小但仍改变侧向足部运动。
AI.conclusion: 躯干侧向运动与COM位置的效果取决于可用摩擦：前进速度、能耗与打滑相关的足部运动可通过企鹅式躯干运动在硬件上调制。

title: Stochastic Neural Signed Swept Volume for Real-time Chance-Constrained Trajectory Optimization
summary: Collision-free motion planning requires reliable collision models from sensed environments and validation of states along a continuous trajectory. To make this tractable, most planners check for collision at discrete states along continuous trajectories against a single determinized model of the environment, introducing a trade-off between safety and computational efficiency. While continuous collision checking approaches that approximate the swept volume of the robot exist, they are computationally expensive or overly conservative. Data-driven approaches can learn the swept volume; however, these neural models are susceptible to approximation errors and are therefore often limited to serving as coarse filters for downstream collision checkers. In this work, we propose to learn a signed distance function of the swept volume as a probabilistic field, enabling quantification of epistemic uncertainty, incorporation of perception noise, and eventual integration into a chance-constrained trajectory optimization framework. We demonstrate our approach on challenging high-dimensional manipulation problems with significant sensor noise, both in simulation and on real hardware.

AI.tldr: 提出学习扫掠体积的符号距离函数作为概率场，量化认知不确定性并融入机会约束轨迹优化，实现高维操作的无碰撞运动规划。
AI.motivation: 无碰撞运动规划需可靠碰撞模型与连续轨迹状态验证，但主流规划器仅在离散状态、对单一确定化环境模型做碰撞检测，带来安全性与计算效率的权衡。现有连续碰撞检测方法计算昂贵或过于保守，数据驱动方法虽能学习扫掠体积，但其神经模型存在近似误差，通常只能作下游碰撞检测器的粗过滤器。
AI.method: 将扫掠体积的符号距离函数建模为概率场进行学习，从而量化认知不确定性、纳入感知噪声，并最终集成到机会约束轨迹优化框架中。
AI.result: 在具有显著传感器噪声的高维操作问题上验证了该方法，涵盖仿真与真实硬件实验。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习扫掠体积的概率符号距离场，可将不确定性显式纳入规划，在噪声环境下兼顾安全性与计算可行性，并在高维真实操作任务中有效。

title: Safe Real-Time Policy Steering via Noise-Space Trajectory Optimization for One-Step Generative Policies
summary: Generative robot policies can represent diverse, multimodal behaviors, but adapting pretrained policies to deployment-time constraints such as collision avoidance and orientation maintenance remains challenging. Existing inference-time steering methods typically apply gradient guidance through iterative diffusion or flow processes, which can be computationally expensive for real-time control. We propose INSPO, which formulates inference-time steering of one-step generative policies as trajectory optimization in the policy's input noise space. By optimizing the input noise while evaluating constraints on the induced state trajectory, INSPO searches the policy-induced behavior space without directly modifying generated actions. The optimization includes a regularization term that encourages solutions to remain consistent with the policy's input distribution and is solved online using population-based particle optimization. We evaluate INSPO on state- and image-based task-specific policies and generalist vision-language-action policies across Push-T, Can pick-and-place, and LIBERO-Spatial. INSPO improves task success and constraint satisfaction over best-of-N sampling and action projection, while comparing favorably with gradient-guided generation at lower runtime.

AI.tldr: INSPO将一步生成策略的推理时引导建模为输入噪声空间中的轨迹优化，用种群粒子优化在线求解，实现高效的碰撞避免与姿态维持。
AI.motivation: 生成式机器人策略能表达多样化、多模态行为，但将预训练策略适配到部署时约束（如避碰、姿态维持）仍具挑战。现有推理时引导方法需通过迭代扩散或流过程进行梯度引导，实时控制时计算开销大。
AI.method: INSPO将一步生成策略的推理时引导形式化为策略输入噪声空间中的轨迹优化。它在评估诱导状态轨迹上的约束的同时优化输入噪声，从而在不直接修改生成动作的情况下搜索策略诱导的行为空间。优化包含正则化项以保持解与策略输入分布一致，并通过基于种群的粒子优化在线求解。
AI.result: INSPO在Push-T、Can pick-and-place和LIBERO-Spatial任务上，对基于状态与图像的任务专用策略以及通用视觉-语言-动作策略进行了评估。相比best-of-N采样和动作投影，INSPO提升了任务成功率与约束满足度，并且以更低运行时间优于梯度引导生成方法。
AI.conclusion: INSPO通过在输入噪声空间中做轨迹优化，为一步生成策略提供了一种高效、有效的推理时引导方案，在满足部署约束的同时保持低运行时开销。

title: SafeStage: Evaluating Safety Before, During, and After Vision-Language-Conditioned Robot Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-conditioned robot policies integrate perception, language understanding, and control for general-purpose manipulation. However, existing evaluations often focus on task success, isolated physical constraints, semantic refusal, or realized physical damage, providing limited insight into where safety fails during closed-loop manipulation. We introduce SafeStage, a lifecycle-structured benchmark for evaluating manipulation safety before, during, and after task execution. SafeStage contains 97 purpose-built risk scenarios organized into three stages. Initial-State Hazards captures safety-relevant relations that must be resolved before manipulating the target. Execution-Time Safety evaluates unsafe contacts, trajectories, region entries, and object interactions during execution. Final-State Hazards capture unstable or otherwise unsafe conditions remaining after nominal task completion. The benchmark evaluates realized interactions using event-based and state-based checks and reports native task success independently from stage-specific safety outcomes. We evaluate representative direct-action Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies and policies with world-model-based policies under a common closed-loop protocol. Our results demonstrate that nominal task completion frequently coexists with safety violations and that different policies exhibit distinct failure profiles across the three stages. By separating task success from safety and localizing when violations occur, SafeStage provides a unified diagnostic testbed for evaluating and improving vision-language-conditioned robot manipulation policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SafeStage——一个按任务生命周期（执行前/中/后）划分结构的机器人操作安全基准，包含 97 个风险场景，将任务成功率与分阶段安全结果解耦评估。实验表明任务完成常与安全违规并存，不同 VLA 策略呈现差异化失效模式。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-条件机器人策略评估多聚焦于任务成功率、单一物理约束、语义拒答或已发生的物理损伤，难以揭示闭环操作中安全失效发生的位置（何时、何阶段）。作者希望将任务成功与安全表现分离，并定位违规发生的阶段，从而提供统一诊断工具。
AI.method: 构建 SafeStage 基准：97 个专门设计的风险场景，划分为三阶段——初始状态危害（操作前需解决的安全相关关系）、执行时安全（执行中的不安全接触、轨迹、区域进入、物体交互）、最终状态危害（名义任务完成后残留的不稳定/不安全状态）。采用事件级与状态级检查评估真实交互，并在统一闭环协议下独立报告原生任务成功与各阶段安全结果；对比评测直接动作型 VLA 策略与世界模型型策略。
AI.result: 名义任务完成与安全违规经常同时出现；不同策略在三阶段上呈现各异的失效画像（failure profiles）。
AI.conclusion: 通过将任务成功与安全解耦并定位违规发生阶段，SafeStage 为评估和改进视觉-语言-条件机器人操作策略提供了统一诊断测试平台。

title: AirSplan: Risk-Aware Motion Planning for Quadrotors in Cluttered 3D Gaussian Splats
comment: To appear in the proceedings of IROS 2026
summary: Quadrotors are increasingly deployed in applications such as agriculture, infrastructure inspection, and maintenance. In each of these applications, the robot must navigate complex scene geometry while remaining strictly collision-free. Unlike in ground domains, even minor collisions for aerial vehicles can result in the loss of the robot. This safety requirement induces a pair of technical challenges. First, the environment must be represented with sufficient fidelity to encode complex structure, even when no ground-truth obstacle data is available. Second, a motion planner must leverage this representation to determine a collision-free path to the goal. This paper proposes a system that addresses these complementary challenges. The proposed method, AirSplan, adopts a normalized variant of 3D Gaussian Splatting that encodes high-fidelity scene geometry. It then applies a novel reachability-based motion planner that leverages the differential flatness of quadrotors to compute continuous-time collision constraints that tightly overapproximate the robot's occupancy. Experiments demonstrate that AirSplan successfully finds a path in 81.2% of challenging test cases, a significant improvement over the nearest baseline method's 51.2%.

AI.tldr: AirSplan：用归一化3D高斯溅射建模场景几何，结合基于可达性的运动规划器，为四旋翼生成连续时间无碰撞轨迹，在挑战性测试中成功率81.2%，显著优于基线51.2%。
AI.motivation: 四旋翼在农业、设施巡检与维护等场景中需在复杂几何环境中严格无碰撞飞行，且空中碰撞往往导致机器人损毁。这带来两个挑战：一是无真值障碍数据时仍需高保真表示复杂场景结构；二是规划器需基于该表示求解无碰撞路径。
AI.method: 提出AirSplan系统：采用归一化变体的3D高斯溅射（3D Gaussian Splatting）编码高保真场景几何；并设计新颖的基于可达性的运动规划器，利用四旋翼的微分平坦特性（differential flatness）计算连续时间碰撞约束，紧密过近似机器人占用空间。
AI.result: 在挑战性测试用例中成功找到路径的比例为81.2%，较最接近的基线方法51.2%有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 将高保真辐射场式场景表示与可达性规划相结合，可有效解决无真值障碍数据下的空中无碰撞导航问题，验证了该方法在复杂场景中的有效性。

title: LOInK: Learned Optimal Inverse Kinematics via Structured Neural Surrogate Models
summary: We introduce Learned Optimal Inverse Kinematics (LOInK), a method to generate approximately optimal solutions to an inverse kinematics problem. When trained on data consisting of sampled configurations and associated task variables and a given cost function, LOInK learns a bi-Lipschitz invertible mapping from configuration space to a decoupled task/latent space, and moreover, the latent space is structured so as to place cost-minimizing solutions at the origin. This enables efficient sampling of cost-minimizing solutions via a network-inversion algorithm based on operator splitting. We demonstrate the proposed approach on three problems: an illustrative three degree-of-freedom manipulator problem; a quadrupedal climbing robot for which LOInK can generate near-optimal solutions on average 31 times faster and up to 100 times faster than a constrained optimization approach; and a simulated soft actuator as a purely data-driven example, in which LOInK can explicitly generate high-quality solutions, unlike existing generative approaches that require diverse sampling and evaluation of candidate solutions.

AI.tldr: LOInK通过双Lipschitz可逆映射将构型空间解耦为任务/潜空间，并将代价最小解置于原点，配合基于算子分裂的网络反演算法，实现近似最优逆运动学解的高效采样。
AI.motivation: 逆运动学问题通常需在满足任务约束的同时最小化代价，传统方法依赖约束优化，计算开销大、速度慢；现有生成式方法则需大量采样并评估候选解才能获得高质量结果。因此需要一种能高效、直接生成近似最优解的方法。
AI.method: 在由采样构型、对应任务变量及给定代价函数组成的数据上训练，学习一个从构型空间到解耦的任务/潜空间的双Lipschitz可逆映射；通过构造使代价最小解位于潜空间原点，并采用基于算子分裂的网络反演算法，高效采样代价最小化解。
AI.result: 在三个问题上验证：三自由度机械臂的说明性算例；四足攀爬机器人上，LOInK生成近优解平均比约束优化快31倍，最高快100倍；在仿真软体驱动器这一纯数据驱动任务中，LOInK能直接生成高质量解，而现有生成式方法需依赖多样采样与候选解评估。
AI.conclusion: LOInK通过学习具有良好几何性质的可逆潜空间表示并结合网络反演，为近似最优逆运动学求解提供了高效、直接且适用于纯数据驱动场景的新范式。

title: Stability-aware Residual Reinforcement Learning Framework for Robotic Manipulator Disturbance Compensation
summary: Although conventional controllers and disturbance observers (DOBs) are the standard for precision tracking in manipulators, they suffer from parameter uncertainty, nonlinear friction, and compound disturbances. This study proposes a residual reinforcement learning DOB framework that pairs an analytical observer with an RL policy. The deterministic baseline operates within a reliable region, whereas the RL policy explicitly targets the residuals that the model cannot capture. To make this compensation disturbance-aware, an estimator network aligns the observation history with a privileged disturbance context, organizing the latent space by disturbance regime and enabling rapid adaptation across disturbance transitions. To guarantee stability, we derived and enforced a state-dependent action bound on the RL policy from an input-to-state stability (ISS) analysis such that the closed loop provably confines the tracking error to a certified envelope for arbitrary policy outputs. Experiments on a 6-DOF manipulator demonstrated consistent improvements in disturbance estimation and tracking, including a 27.8% tracking-error reduction on real hardware under zero-shot sim-to-real transfer and a 38.0% reduction under a base-vibration disturbance that was not observed during training.

AI.tldr: 提出残差强化学习干扰观测器(RRL-DOB)框架，用解析观测器与RL策略互补，并引入干扰感知估计器与基于ISS的状态相关动作约束，保证跟踪误差收敛到认证包络，在6-DOF机械臂上实现零样本仿真到现实迁移。
AI.motivation: 传统控制器与干扰观测器在精密跟踪中面临参数不确定性、非线性摩擦与复合干扰，模型无法完全刻画这些残差，因此需要一种能补偿未建模残差同时保证稳定性的方法。
AI.method: 将确定性解析观测器作为基线在可靠区间工作，RL策略专门补偿模型无法捕获的残差；设计估计器网络，将观测历史与特权干扰上下文对齐，按干扰工况组织隐空间以支持干扰切换下的快速适应；基于输入到状态稳定性(ISS)分析推导并施加状态相关动作边界，使任意策略输出下闭环误差被限制在认证包络内。
AI.result: 在6-DOF机械臂实验中，干扰估计与跟踪性能一致提升：真实硬件上零样本仿真到现实迁移使跟踪误差降低27.8%；在训练中未观测到的基座振动干扰下误差降低38.0%。
AI.conclusion: 将解析干扰观测器与残差强化学习结合，并配合干扰感知表征与ISS稳定性约束，可在保证理论稳定性的同时显著提升机械臂在不确定与未见干扰下的跟踪精度。

title: NaViRrator: Robot Navigation from Human-Readable Maps through a Learned Visual Route
summary: Human-readable maps provide an intuitive interface for specifying robot destinations, but connecting their schematic geometry to egocentric observations remains challenging. We present NaViRRator, a framework that translates user-specified start and goal locations on such maps into navigation instructions for a pretrained vision-and-language navigation (VLN) policy. Its core method, RouteScribe, separates route inference from verbalization by first generating an explicit route scaffold in map-image coordinates, which a pretrained vision-language model (VLM) converts into a navigation instruction. We construct the scaffold with start--goal line conditional flow matching (SGL-CFM), which deforms a straight start--goal waypoint sequence into a map-conditioned route. During execution, the VLN policy receives only the instruction and egocentric observations, while the map and scaffold remain upstream, allowing executor replacement without retraining the map-to-language modules. Real-world experiments show higher success rates and success weighted by path length (SPL) than direct map-to-instruction generation, A*-based scaffolding, and Gaussian-source conditional flow matching. Qualitative results further show clearer salient turns and better preservation of the intended maneuver sequence, supporting route-grounded language as a modular interface between human-readable maps and pretrained navigation policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NaViRRator框架，将人类可读地图上的起点与终点转化为导航指令，供预训练的VLN策略使用，实现地图到语言的模块化接口。
AI.motivation: 人类可读地图是直观的机器人目的地指定界面，但其示意几何与机器人自中心观测之间的连接仍是挑战；同时希望地图到语言的模块无需随执行器更换而重新训练。
AI.method: 核心方法RouteScribe将路径推断与语言化分离：先用起点—终点线条件流匹配（SGL-CFM）将直线起点—终点路点序列变形为地图条件下的显式路径骨架（地图图像坐标），再由预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）将骨架转成导航指令；执行时VLN策略仅接收指令与自中心观测，地图与骨架留在上游。
AI.result: 真实世界实验表明，相比直接地图到指令生成、基于A*的骨架生成和高斯源条件流匹配，该方法的成功率与SPL更高；定性结果显示显著转弯更清晰、预期机动序列保持更好。
AI.conclusion: 基于路径接地的语言可作为一种模块化接口，连接人类可读地图与预训练导航策略，并支持执行器替换而无需重训地图到语言模块。

title: LEMCA: LLM-Guided Synthesis of Efficient Mode-Switching Control Architectures
summary: Physical control tasks in the natural world, such as driving or object manipulation, frequently exhibit dramatic variations in sensory and compute complexity over time. Correspondingly, a natural resource-efficient choice for robot control is to dynamically switch between control modes with varying resource allocations. However, such "mode-switching controllers" (MSCs) have historically required laborious, expert-driven design and synthesis for each new task. Driven by these design difficulties, modern robotic control architectures often fall back to a wasteful "monolithic" one-size-fits-all structure, where resource allocation is permanently anchored to the hardest, most resource-intensive task phases. To facilitate the design of performant yet efficient MSCs, we propose LLM-Guided synthesis of Efficient Mode-Switching Control Architectures (LEMCA). LEMCA represents MSC designs as interpretable programs to be iteratively refined in an evolutionary loop. To evaluate design fitness, we propose MSC-compatible extensions of automated controller synthesis approaches, such as reinforcement learning in simulation. LEMCA then leverages the semantic priors, reasoning, and coding capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to iteratively edit controller modes, their corresponding sensory-compute resource allocations, and mode transitions. Our experiments across diverse control benchmarks show that LEMCA consistently discovers strategies that surpass the Pareto frontier of monolithic designs by reclaiming wasted resources during "easy" task phases. LEMCA thus presents an automated, low-effort path to synthesize resource-efficient MSC designs.

AI.tldr: 提出LEMCA框架，利用大语言模型的语义先验、推理与编码能力，在进化循环中自动合成可解释的模式切换控制架构（MSC），从而在简单任务阶段回收浪费的资源，超越单体设计的Pareto前沿。
AI.motivation: 自然界的物理控制任务（如驾驶、物体操作）在感官与计算复杂度上常随时间剧烈变化，因此资源高效的自然选择是动态切换具有不同资源分配的控制模式。但模式切换控制器历史上需要大量专家驱动、针对每项任务重复进行费力设计与合成；受限于此，现代机器人控制架构常退化为浪费的“单体”一刀切结构，将资源分配永久锚定在最困难、最耗资源的任务阶段。
AI.method: 将MSC设计表示为可解释程序，在进化循环中迭代优化。为评估设计适应度，提出MSC兼容的自动化控制器合成扩展（如仿真中的强化学习）。随后利用LLM的语义先验、推理与编码能力，迭代编辑控制器模式、对应的感官-计算资源分配以及模式切换。
AI.result: 在多种控制基准任务上，LEMCA一致地发现超越单体设计Pareto前沿的策略，其方式是在“容易”的任务阶段回收被浪费的资源。
AI.conclusion: LEMCA为合成资源高效的模式切换控制设计提供了一条自动化、低人工投入的路径。

title: The EventCV Library for Event-Based Robotic Vision
summary: Event cameras detect per-pixel brightness changes asynchronously on microsecond timescales, with high dynamic range and low power draw. These are desirable properties for robots that move fast or work in difficult lighting conditions. However, integrating an event camera into a real-world robotic pipeline still requires substantial effort: plug-and-play drivers do not exist, event streams are recorded in a variety of incompatible file formats, and most projects rely on custom research-grade code. Here, we present EventCV, an open-source and extensible Rust library with OpenCV-style Python bindings that lowers the entry barrier to working with event cameras. EventCV provides a wide range of features: denoising filters and geometric transforms, augmentations, corner detection and unsupervised feature learning, contrast-maximization motion estimation, a video-to-events simulator, and Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) inference for deployment in robotic stacks. EventCV integrates the Neuromorphic Drivers package, allowing an event camera stream to be processed directly in real time. No existing toolkit covers this range of operations in one package, and EventCV builds representations and decodes files 1.1x to 3.7x faster than the currently available libraries. We deploy EventCV on a Jetson Orin AGX and present three robotics case studies spanning object detection, on-device model inference, and localization. Project webpage: https://eventcv.net.

AI.tldr: EventCV：面向事件相机的开源可扩展Rust库，配OpenCV风格Python绑定，集成去噪、几何变换、增广、角点检测、无监督特征学习、对比度最大化运动估计、视频-事件仿真及ONNX推理，并接入Neuromorphic Drivers实现实时处理。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具备微秒级异步响应、高动态范围、低功耗，适合高速或困难光照下的机器人，但缺乏即插即用驱动、事件流文件格式互不兼容、多依赖定制研究级代码，导致接入真实机器人流水线门槛高。
AI.method: 以Rust实现开源可扩展库并提供OpenCV风格Python绑定；功能涵盖去噪滤波、几何变换、数据增广、角点检测、无监督特征学习、对比度最大化运动估计、视频到事件仿真、ONNX模型推理；集成Neuromorphic Drivers支持事件流实时处理；在Jetson Orin AGX上部署。
AI.result: 现有工具包均无法在单一包内覆盖如此广泛操作；EventCV构建表示与解码文件的速度比现有库快1.1×至3.7×；在Jetson Orin AGX上完成三个机器人案例研究（目标检测、端侧模型推理、定位）。
AI.conclusion: EventCV通过统一、开源、可扩展的工具链降低事件相机使用门槛，并具备实时处理、部署与效率优势，适用于机器人视觉任务。

title: FAN: Foresight Action Normalization for Continual Adaptation of Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models pre-trained on large-scale, closed datasets have demonstrated remarkable success across diverse robotic manipulation tasks. However, their long-term real-world deployment necessitates continuously acquiring new skills while retaining previously learned capabilities. While pioneering works have explored continual VLA adaptation using techniques such as experience replay and reinforcement fine-tuning, they overlook a foundational mechanism: action normalization, which determines the underlying coordinate system in which policies perceive and execute physical actions. To bridge this gap, we systematically evaluate five normalization strategies across four real-world task streams covering single-arm and bimanual manipulation. Our analysis reveals that existing protocols induce severe failure modes due to inter-task coordinate drift, limited motion coverage, or train-test coordinate mismatches. Motivated by these insights, we formulate three core design principles: consistency, coverage, and causality (3C), and introduce foresight action normalization (FAN). FAN estimates normalization statistics once from a small, task-independent calibration set prior to continual learning and freezes them throughout adaptation. Across all evaluated streams, FAN achieves the highest performance and demonstrates consistent robustness, providing insightful guidance for building stable action representations in achieving effective lifelong VLA adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文聚焦VLA模型持续适配中被忽视的动作归一化机制，系统评估五种归一化策略在四个真实任务流上的表现，提出3C设计原则与前瞻动作归一化（FAN），该方法在持续学习中保持最优且稳健的性能。
AI.motivation: 大规模闭源数据预训练的VLA模型在多种机器人操作任务中表现优异，但长期真实部署要求持续习得新技能并保留旧能力。现有持续VLA适配研究多依赖经验回放、强化微调等技术，却忽视了决定策略感知与执行物理动作坐标系的动作归一化这一基础机制，导致任务间坐标漂移、运动覆盖不足、训练-测试坐标失配等严重失效模式。
AI.method: 作者在涵盖单臂与双臂操作的四个真实世界任务流上，系统评估五种归一化策略，分析其失效机理，进而提出一致性、覆盖性、因果性（3C）三条设计原则，并据此设计前瞻动作归一化（FAN）：在持续学习开始前，仅用一个小规模、与任务无关的校准集估计一次归一化统计量，并在整个适配过程中将其冻结。
AI.result: 分析表明现有归一化协议会因任务间坐标漂移、运动覆盖有限或训练-测试坐标不匹配而诱发严重失败模式。在所有评估任务流中，FAN均取得最高性能，并展现出稳定的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 动作归一化是持续VLA适配的关键基础机制。基于3C原则的FAN通过在持续学习前一次性估计并冻结归一化统计量，为构建稳定的动作表示、实现有效的终身VLA适配提供了具有指导意义的方案。

title: MicroHookACT: Monocular Microscopic Vision Guided Visuomotor Policy for Flexible Microelectrode Hooking
summary: Automated needle-loop hooking is a critical step in flexible microelectrode (FME) implantation. This paper presents MicroHookACT, an imitation learning-based visuomotor policy for automated 3D hooking under monocular microscopic vision. First, a unidirectional hooking strategy exploits defocus cues and optical-axis guidance to enable palpation-free precise alignment and contact-rich threading. Second, an action-supervised object attention module built on a frozen ViT backbone learns to focus on the micro-needle tip and micro-loop directly from human demonstrations, without requiring manual visual annotations for training. Third, attention-centered global coarse and local fine features are dynamically weighted according to predicted action progress, enabling a single ACT policy to adapt to changing defocus blur and visual requirements throughout the operation. In the experiments, visuomotor policies were trained on 60 human demonstrations and evaluated under five setups with varying difficulties. Our MicroHookACT framework achieved the highest overall success rate of 96.7\% with an average execution time of 11.5 s. These results demonstrate the potential of visuomotor policy learning for micron-level control under varying operating conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MicroHookACT——一种基于模仿学习的视觉运动策略，在单目显微视觉下实现微电极植入中针-环自动3D钩挂，总体成功率96.7%，平均耗时11.5 s。
AI.motivation: 柔性微电极（FME）植入中，自动化针-环钩挂是关键步骤，但显微尺度下存在景深模糊、目标细微、对准精度要求高等难题，传统方法难以胜任。
AI.method: 采用三项关键技术：1）单向钩挂策略，利用离焦线索与光轴引导实现无触诊的精确对准与接触丰富的穿线；2）基于冻结ViT骨干的动作监督目标注意力模块，直接从人类示教中学习聚焦微针尖与微环，无需人工视觉标注；3）以注意力为中心的全局粗特征与局部细特征，依据预测动作进度动态加权，使单一ACT策略适应操作中变化的离焦模糊与视觉需求。
AI.result: 基于60组人类示教训练视觉运动策略，在5种不同难度设置下评估，MicroHookACT取得最高96.7%的总体成功率，平均执行时间11.5 s。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了视觉运动策略学习在变化操作条件下实现微米级控制的潜力。

title: AVT-Fabric: Active Visuo-Tactile Perception via Adaptive Evidence Selection for Efficient Robotic Fabric Comparison
summary: Robotic fabric comparison needs to actively combine visual appearance and tactile cues. Here, we present AVT-Fabric, an RGB-first framework that allocates tactile evidence according to the difficulty of each comparison. A dual-scale gate evaluates answer-token confidence and raw logit separation to determine whether another force-tagged GelSight observation is needed. Compact textual memory preserves the executed history, and majority voting consolidates the selected predictions. On 400 held-out comparisons, AVT-Fabric achieves 98.0% accuracy with a compact 7B Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM), surpassing the 94.0% reported by the 90B MLLM-Fabric baseline by 4.0 percentage points while processing only 1.60 of five available stages on average. It improves on matched passive inference by 9.25 percentage points and reduces model-side latency by 61.8%, while also improving on RGB-only accuracy. Four additional MLLM backbones support the generalizability, accuracy, and efficiency of the framework. This framework is also deployed on a real robotic system, achieving 78.1% pairwise ranking accuracy and correct fabric selection in seven of eight application scenarios. AVT-Fabric demonstrates that adaptive evidence selection can improve both the accuracy and efficiency of robotic visuo-tactile reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AVT-Fabric，一种RGB优先的机器人织物比较框架，通过自适应门控按需调用触觉证据，以7B MLLM达到98.0%准确率并大幅降低延迟与计算量。
AI.motivation: 机器人织物比较需同时结合视觉外观与触觉线索，但被动地固定使用全部触觉阶段会造成计算与延迟浪费；因此需要一种根据每个比较任务难度自适应分配触觉证据的方法。
AI.method: AVT-Fabric为RGB优先框架：双尺度门控（dual-scale gate）依据答案token置信度与原始logit间隔，判断是否需要追加带力标记的GelSight触觉观测；紧凑文本记忆保存已执行历史；多数投票整合所选预测。
AI.result: 在400个留出比较任务上，7B MLLM达98.0%准确率，超90B MLLM-Fabric基线的94.0%（+4.0个百分点），平均仅用5个阶段中的1.60个；相比匹配的被动推理提升9.25个百分点，模型侧延迟降低61.8%，并优于纯RGB方案；四种额外MLLM骨干验证了通用性、准确性与效率。真实机器人系统上达78.1%成对排序准确率，8个应用场景中7个正确选布。
AI.conclusion: 自适应证据选择能够同时提升机器人视触觉推理的准确性与效率。

title: MarineCraft: Enabling Rapid Prototyping of Underwater Robots via Modular Construction
summary: Underwater robot development is often hindered by the complexities of waterproofing and wiring, which significantly delay the rapid prototyping process. This paper presents MarineCraft, a modular toolkit designed to accelerate the development cycle through structural reconfiguration. The system features self-contained, waterproof propulsion modules that integrate power, wireless communication, and actuation. By eliminating centralized wiring and the need for repeated sealing, MarineCraft allows diverse robot geometries to be assembled and tested in minutes rather than days. Experimental results demonstrate that this reconfigurable architecture enables fast, iterative design cycles while maintaining reliable operation and leak-free performance at depths of up to 2.5 meters. Our toolkit effectively lowers the barrier to underwater robotics by transforming modularity into a vehicle for rapid physical prototyping.

AI.tldr: MarineCraft 是一种模块化水下机器人工具包，通过自包含防水推进模块消除集中布线与反复密封，实现分钟级重组与快速迭代原型开发，可在 2.5 米水深下无泄漏可靠运行。
AI.motivation: 水下机器人开发受限于防水与布线复杂度，导致快速原型迭代周期被显著拖长；作者希望降低水下机器人研发门槛，将模块化作为快速物理原型设计的手段。
AI.method: 提出 MarineCraft 模块化工具包，采用结构可重构设计；核心是自包含防水推进模块，将电源、无线通信与驱动集成于一体，从而取消集中式布线和重复密封环节，支持多种机器人几何构型在数分钟内完成组装与测试。
AI.result: 实验表明该可重构架构支持快速迭代设计循环，并能在最深 2.5 米水深下保持可靠运行与无泄漏性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工具包通过模块化显著降低水下机器人研发门槛，使组装与测试从数天缩短至数分钟，为水下机器人快速物理原型开发提供有效途径。

title: Stabilizing Trajectory Outputs in End-to-End Autonomous Driving via SC-IMM Based Teacher Signals
summary: End-to-End autonomous driving models commonly predict future waypoints from sensor inputs and convert them into vehicle control commands through a downstream controller. However, conventional waypoint-based imitation learning mainly minimizes coordinate-level errors, making it difficult to capture scene-dependent path-speed changes and temporal instability across waypoint outputs. In this paper, we propose an offline teacher-signal generation and learning method for trajectory-output stabilization based on a Scene-Conditioned Interacting Multiple Model (SC-IMM) to mitigate this issue. The proposed method converts expert trajectories into path-speed states and performs IMM updates conditioned on scene cues to generate path-speed teacher labels and mode posterior probabilities. The generated signals are added to the original trajectory loss as auxiliary supervision during training, while the inference structure and waypoint controller remain unchanged. In closed-loop evaluation on 100 short routes in CARLA Town12, the proposed method improved the driving score by 28.0% and reduced Collision/km by 62.3% compared with the baseline, while also improving jerk and trajectory-variation metrics. These results demonstrate that offline teacher signals embedding scene-conditioned motion-model cues can guide trajectory-output driving models toward more stable closed-loop behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于场景条件交互多模型（SC-IMM）的离线教师信号生成与学习方法，通过将专家轨迹转化为路径-速度状态并生成辅助监督信号，提升端到端自动驾驶模型轨迹输出的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 传统基于路点的模仿学习主要最小化坐标级误差，难以捕捉随场景变化的路径-速度变化以及路点输出间的时间不稳定性，导致闭环行为不稳定。
AI.method: 将专家轨迹转换为路径-速度状态，基于场景线索进行IMM更新，生成路径-速度教师标签和模式后验概率；这些信号作为辅助监督加入原始轨迹损失进行训练，而推理结构与路点控制器保持不变。
AI.result: 在CARLA Town12的100条短路线闭环评估中，相比基线，驾驶得分提升28.0%，每公里碰撞数降低62.3%，同时jerk和轨迹变化指标也有所改善。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入场景条件运动模型线索的离线教师信号能够引导轨迹输出式驾驶模型实现更稳定的闭环行为。

title: A Unified Dynamic Force Guidance Framework for Performance-Optimized Kinesthetic Teaching
summary: Collaborative robots are increasingly deployed in industrial scenarios characterized by frequent product changeovers. As an intuitive programming method, kinesthetic teaching facilitates rapid robot deployment. However, users may overlook the configuration of the robot during kinesthetic teaching, leading to degradation in operational performance. Operational performance refers to the capability of the robot to generate motion and can be quantified by the Minimum Singular Value of the Jacobian matrix. To address this issue, this paper proposes an online dynamic force guidance method that integrates performance constraint and optimization mechanisms. Specifically, variable admittance control maintains the operational performance of the robot above a predefined threshold, while a virtual force actively guides the user to drag the robot towards configurations with improved performance. Experiments are conducted on a 6-DOF collaborative robot, comparing three typical paths in the task space. To evaluate the quality of the taught trajectories, trajectory playback experiments are conducted to analyze the relationship between the operational performance of the robot and the work efficiency. The results demonstrate that the proposed method effectively enhances the operational performance of the robot and consequently improves the work efficiency, holding significant value for reducing production takt time in industrial deployment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种融合性能约束与优化机制的在线动态力引导方法，用于提升协作机器人拖动示教过程中的操作性能与工作效率。
AI.motivation: 协作机器人在频繁换产的工业场景中需求增加，拖动示教可实现快速部署，但用户示教时易忽略机器人构型，导致操作性能下降。操作性能反映机器人生成运动的能力，可由雅可比矩阵最小奇异值量化。
AI.method: 提出在线动态力引导方法，集成性能约束与优化机制：采用可变导纳控制将机器人操作性能维持在预设阈值以上；同时施加虚拟力，主动引导用户将机器人拖向性能更优的构型。
AI.result: 在六自由度协作机器人上开展实验，对比任务空间中的三条典型路径；通过轨迹回放实验分析机器人操作性能与工作效率的关系。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法有效提升了机器人操作性能，进而改善工作效率，对缩短工业生产节拍时间具有重要价值。

title: Robotic Multiphase Interaction: Manipulating Coupled Liquid and Solid Dynamics with a World Model
summary: This work presents \textit{Robotic Multiphase Interaction (RMI)}, a setting in which liquid enters a porous material and interacts mechanically with its deforming solid skeleton. Manipulation can therefore change pore volume, expel or redistribute retained liquid, and alter grasp stability at the same time. Spilled liquid can also create safety risks in domestic and manufacturing settings. This differs from most manipulation of solid objects and from tasks that involve both liquid and solid while keeping the phases spatially separate. We study a sponge filled with water as the first RMI example. We use implicit incompressible porous flow with smoothed particle hydrodynamics as the dynamics engine and enable robotic manipulation by adding Coulomb contact memory, hybrid velocity and force regulation, and a stability gate for lifting. The resulting environment connects robot commands to changes in the coupled liquid and solid state. A world model conditioned on actions predicts how this state evolves under candidate commands, while a temporal UNet generates actions using either Diffusion Policy or rectified flow matching. Our world model reduces retained water prediction error by more than $60\%$ compared with the baseline. The best action sequence selected by the world model from policy proposals further reduces the predicted terminal water error by about half. These improvements show that modelling the coupled liquid and solid state helps the robot predict how its actions affect both the porous object and the liquid held inside.

AI.tldr: 提出"机器人多相交互(RMI)"新设定:液体进入多孔材料并与其变形固体骨架发生机械耦合,以含水海绵为首个案例,构建基于SPH的不可压缩多孔流仿真环境,并结合动作条件世界模型与扩散/整流流策略,显著降低保水预测误差。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人操作研究多针对纯固体对象,或虽同时涉及液体与固体但保持两相空间分离;而液体渗入可变形多孔骨架的耦合场景(如含水海绵)缺乏建模与操作方法,且液体溢出在家庭与制造环境中存在安全隐患,因此需要研究这种操作会同时改变孔隙体积、挤出或重分布液体并影响抓取稳定性的新问题。
AI.method: 1) 定义RMI设定:液体进入多孔材料并与其变形固体骨架机械交互。2) 以充水海绵为实例,采用隐式不可压缩多孔流与光滑粒子流体动力学(SPH)作为动力学引擎。3) 为支持机器人操作,加入库仑接触记忆、混合速度与力调节,以及用于举升的稳定性门控。4) 构建将机器人指令与耦合液固状态关联的环境;使用以动作为条件的世界模型预测候选指令下状态演化;用时间UNet结合扩散策略或整流流匹配生成动作。
AI.result: 世界模型将保水量预测误差较基线降低超过60%;在世界模型从策略提案中选出的最优动作序列进一步将预测的终端水量误差降低约一半。
AI.conclusion: 对耦合液固状态进行建模有助于机器人预测其动作如何同时影响多孔物体及内部液体,验证了RMI设定与所提方法的有效性。

title: Learning Distance-Conditioned Object Transport for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from a Single Motion Clip
summary: Motion tracking can reproduce humanoid loco-manipulation from a single retargeted motion clip, but a policy trained on a fixed reference primarily reproduces its demonstrated transport outcome. Although the source trajectory visits intermediate object displacements, transport termination is demonstrated only at its endpoint. We identify this mismatch as the termination-versus-passage gap: intermediate displacements are observed as passage states rather than termination-complete outcomes. We introduce Distance-Conditioned Reference Recomposition (DCRR), which relocates the demonstrated termination segment to intermediate transport states. A frozen tracking teacher replays the recomposed references under closed-loop dynamics, and the retained trajectories are relabeled by their achieved object placements and distilled into a reference-free policy. This procedure constructs distance-conditioned supervision from the interaction behavior encoded in the source motion. Across Carry, Kick-Push, Crouch-Push, and Drag, DCRR-BC produces command-dependent transport with an overall normalized distance mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.15, compared with 0.28 for source-only behavior cloning. RL fine-tuning further improves the command response and execution robustness in the training simulator and under sim-to-sim transfer. Finally, hardware experiments demonstrate transport-distance modulation across all four interaction modes.

AI.tldr: 提出距离条件参考重组(DCRR)方法,将演示的终止片段重定位至中间搬运状态,通过冻结跟踪教师闭环回放、按到达物体位置重标注并蒸馏出无参考策略,实现距离可控的人形搬运操作。
AI.motivation: 基于单一重定向动作片段的运动跟踪策略只能复现演示中的运输结果。源轨迹虽经过多个中间物体位移,但"终止"仅演示于终点位置,形成"终止-经过"差距(termination-versus-passage gap):中间位移只被观测为经过状态而非终止完成的结果,因而策略缺乏距离条件化的监督信号。
AI.method: DCRR:将演示的终止片段重定位到各中间运输状态,重组出距离条件化的参考动作;用冻结的运动跟踪教师模型在闭环动力学下回放这些重组参考,保留可行轨迹并按其实际达成的物体摆放位置重新标注;最后将标注数据蒸馏为无需参考的策略(BC),并辅以RL微调。
AI.result: 在Carry、Kick-Push、Crouch-Push、Drag四种交互模式下,DCRR-BC实现命令相关的运输,整体归一化距离MAE为0.15,优于仅用源行为的BC(0.28);RL微调进一步提升了命令响应与执行鲁棒性,在训练仿真器及sim-to-sim迁移下均有效;硬件实验验证了四种模式下的运输距离调制能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将演示终止片段重定位到中间状态并闭环回放重标注,DCRR可从源动作蕴含的交互行为中构造距离条件监督,使无参考策略具备可控运输距离,并具备仿真与真机迁移的可行性。

title: FORTE: Task-Adaptive Force Capability Optimization for Mobile Manipulators
summary: Effective physical interaction control in robotic manipulation requires not only kinematically feasible motion but also sufficient force-interaction capability. Existing redundancy resolution methods often ignore task-specific force demands or maximize the force capability indiscriminately, sacrificing dexterity when large force margins are unnecessary. We propose a task-oriented force capability optimization framework for redundant mobile manipulators. A Vision-Language Model (VLM) infers object physical properties from an RGB image and a task description, generating a desired task-force sequence that captures gravitational and inertial demands. We then define a task-oriented force capability metric as the signed distance between a task-force uncertainty ball and the dynamic residual force polytope (RFP), quantifying compatibility between task demands and the robot's remaining actuation capacity. This metric is incorporated, alongside manipulability, joint-limit avoidance, trajectory smoothness, and base-oscillation suppression, into a whole-body multi-objective trajectory-optimization problem. Experiments on a mobile manipulator performing lifting and single-point-holding tasks under varying payload conditions demonstrate that the proposed method provides sufficient force capability for heavy loads while preserving high manipulability for light loads. This yields a task-adaptive balance that fixed capability-maximizing baselines (RFP inscribed radius, RFP cone) and manipulability-only optimization fail to achieve. The core implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/yeying256/FORTE.

AI.tldr: 提出任务导向的力能力优化框架，用VLM推断物体属性生成任务力序列，并以任务力不确定球与动态残余力多面体(RFP)的有符号距离作为力能力度量，融入全身多目标轨迹优化，使移动机械臂在重载时保证力能力、轻载时保持高可操作度。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作中的有效物理交互控制不仅需要运动学可行，还需足够的力交互能力。现有冗余度求解方法要么忽略任务特定的力需求，要么不加区分地最大化力能力，在不需要大力裕度时牺牲了可操作度，因而缺乏任务自适应性。
AI.method: 1) 用视觉语言模型(VLM)从RGB图像和任务描述中推断物体物理属性，生成刻画重力与惯性需求的任务力序列；2) 定义任务导向力能力度量为任务力不确定球与动态残余力多面体(RFP)之间的有符号距离，量化任务需求与机器人剩余驱动能力间的兼容性；3) 将该度量与可操作度、关节限位规避、轨迹平滑性和基座振荡抑制一起纳入全身多目标轨迹优化问题。
AI.result: 在移动机械臂执行举升与单点保持任务、并在不同负载条件下进行实验，所提方法对重载提供足够的力能力，对轻载保持高可操作度，实现了任务自适应的权衡；而固定能力最大化基线（RFP内切半径、RFP锥）与仅可操作度优化方法无法实现这一效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过将任务力需求与动态残余力能力显式耦合于全身轨迹优化，可实现力能力与可操作度的任务自适应平衡，验证了任务导向力能力优化在冗余移动机械臂物理交互中的有效性。核心实现已开源于 https://github.com/yeying256/FORTE。

title: DPed-VLN: A Benchmark for Socially Compliant Vision-and-Language Navigation in Dynamic Pedestrian Environments
summary: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) has advanced rapidly in static indoor environments, but robots operating in human-populated spaces must ground language while responding to moving pedestrians and social-safety constraints. We present DPed-VLN, a Habitat 3.0 benchmark for dynamic-pedestrian VLN that couples 33,093 navigation episodes with paired global and prior-augmented instructions, ORCA-controlled humanoid pedestrians, socially constrained expert paths, and metrics that jointly assess navigation efficiency and social safety. DPed-VLN separates ordinary goal-oriented route guidance from prior-augmented instructions that expose dynamic-pedestrian cues for controlled analysis. To instantiate the benchmark, we introduce DPet (Dynamic Pedestrian-aware Network), a pedestrian-aware policy network trained with reinforcement learning and imitation learning. We further adapt representative state-of-the-art VLM-based navigation models, including NaVILA and StreamVLN, to DPed-VLN through LoRA fine-tuning. Experiments show that LoRA adaptation improves zero-shot VLM baselines in several success and safety metrics, especially reducing StreamVLN's collision rate. Among the evaluated methods, DPet-RL achieves the highest SR, SPL, and STL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DPed-VLN——基于Habitat 3.0的动态行人视觉语言导航基准，包含33,093个导航回合、配对指令、ORCA行人与社会约束专家路径，并配套DPet行人感知策略网络及VLM适配实验。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言导航（VLN）研究多集中于静态室内环境，而真实场景中的机器人需在有人群活动的空间中理解语言，同时应对移动行人并满足社会安全约束，缺乏相应的基准与评估手段。
AI.method: 构建DPed-VLN基准：基于Habitat 3.0，含33,093个导航回合，配备全局指令与增强先验指令的配对设计、ORCA控制的人形行人、社会约束专家路径，以及联合评估导航效率与社会安全的指标；同时提出DPet动态行人感知策略网络，采用强化学习与模仿学习训练；并通过LoRA微调将NaVILA、StreamVLN等代表性VLM导航模型适配至该基准。
AI.result: LoRA适配在多个成功率和安全性指标上提升了零样本VLM基线，尤其降低了StreamVLN的碰撞率；在所有评估方法中，DPet-RL取得最高的SR、SPL与STL。
AI.conclusion: DPed-VLN为动态行人场景下的视觉语言导航提供了可控、可复现的评测平台，验证了行人感知策略学习与VLM适配在该任务中的有效性，DPet-RL在导航效率与社会安全指标上表现最优。

title: Skel-WAM: A Hand-Skeleton-Conditioned World Action Model for Human-to-Robot Manipulation Transfer
summary: Robot demonstrations are expensive to collect and often provide limited distributional coverage of task variations. Human videos offer a low-cost source of complementary manipulation experience, but learning from them requires bridging embodiment gaps in visual appearance and action spaces. We introduce Skel-WAM, a world action model that bridges these differences through a unified hand-skeleton motion interface. The key insight is to align human and robot motion through a common hand topology, combining skeleton overlays that ground motion in the scene with structured 2.5-D keypoints that encode explicit hand kinematics. Video and Keypoint Experts jointly learn visual and skeletal dynamics through a Mixture-of-Transformers, while a separate robot-trained Action Expert maps these predictions to executable controls. This separation enables human and robot demonstrations to directly supervise shared dynamics without requiring robot action labels for human videos. Across four real-world bimanual tasks and seven simulated tasks, Skel-WAM achieves average success rates of 79.86% and 63.29%, surpassing the strongest baseline by 22.22 and 8.28 percentage points, respectively. Human-robot cotraining more than doubles real-world success on task variations absent from robot training data, from 38.89% to 86.11%. These results demonstrate that a shared skeletal interface enables joint learning across human and robot data and expands robot task coverage through complementary human demonstrations.

AI.tldr: Skel-WAM 是一种世界动作模型，通过统一的“手部骨架运动接口”对齐人类视频与机器人演示，将视频/关键点专家与机器人动作专家解耦，实现人类数据无需机器人动作标签即可共同监督共享动力学，显著提升双臂操作成功率与任务泛化。
AI.motivation: 机器人演示采集成本高、任务变体覆盖有限；人类视频虽廉价且具互补操作经验，但存在视觉外观与动作空间的具身鸿沟，直接利用困难。
AI.method: 构建统一手部拓扑作为跨具身接口：用骨架叠加将运动锚定到场景，用结构化2.5-D关键点编码显式手部运动学；采用Mixture-of-Transformers让Video Expert与Keypoint Expert联合学习视觉与骨架动力学；另设由机器人数据训练的动作专家，将预测映射为可执行控制，从而人类视频无需动作标签即可监督共享动力学。
AI.result: 在4个真实双臂任务与7个仿真任务上平均成功率分别达79.86%与63.29%，较最强基线高出22.22与8.28个百分点；人机协同训练将机器人训练数据未覆盖的真实任务变体成功率从38.89%提升至86.11%，翻倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 共享骨架接口可有效实现人类与机器人数据的联合学习，并借由互补的人类演示扩展机器人任务覆盖范围。

title: SABER: Learning Attention-based Semantic Affordance for Legged Locomotion
summary: Perceptive legged locomotion has advanced rapidly by integrating terrain geometry into learned policies, yet the integration of terrain meaning remains sparse: a pipe, a patch of grass, or a fragile box may be geometrically traversable while being inappropriate for contact. In industrial environments, where legged robots increasingly operate, a single misplaced step can damage fragile equipment, destabilize the robot, or endanger the site. To address this, we introduce SABER, a planner-free reinforcement-learning policy that jointly reasons about terrain geometry and semantic contact permission. The policy consumes a unified terrain-affordance map, where each cell encodes local 3D geometry and a semantic contact cost. We augment cross-attention with a learned, signed semantic bias: an additive term on the attention logits, gated by the contact cost, that reweights flagged cells by their distance from the nearest foot. A hazard therefore reshapes attention where it can still affect the next foothold, and its influence fades where it cannot. The resulting policy selects footholds on permitted support and keeps the leg clear of forbidden regions throughout the swing phase. We perform a systematic ablation that isolates the contribution of each architectural component; removing the semantic bias alone increases forbidden contacts by 55% while velocity tracking is unchanged. We validate the policy on a Unitree B2, demonstrating sim-to-real semantic contact selection across indoor and outdoor environments and four semantic obstacle classes.

AI.tldr: 提出 SABER：一种无规划器、端到端的强化学习运动策略，在统一地形可供性图上联合推理几何与语义接触许可，通过带符号语义偏置的交叉注意力实现语义接触选择，并在 Unitree B2 上完成 sim-to-real 验证。
AI.motivation: 现有感知式足式运动虽已将地形几何融入学习策略，但缺乏对“地形语义/含义”的整合：管道、草地、脆弱箱子等在几何上可通行，却不适合踩踏。在工业场景中，一次误踩可能损坏设备、使机器人失稳或危及场地安全。因此需要让策略在决定落足点时同时考虑几何可通行性与语义接触许可。
AI.method: SABER 为无规划器（planner-free）的强化学习策略，输入为统一的地形可供性图（terrain-affordance map），每格编码局部 3D 几何与语义接触代价（semantic contact cost）。核心为在交叉注意力（cross-attention）中引入可学习的带符号语义偏置：作为注意力 logits 上的加性项，并由接触代价门控，按“距最近足端的距离”对被标记单元格重新加权——使危险区域仅在仍能影响下一落足点的位置重塑注意力，距离过远时其影响衰减。最终策略在允许支撑面上选择落足点，并在整个摆动相使腿部避开禁区。作者进行了系统性消融，隔离各架构组件的贡献。
AI.result: 消融实验表明：仅移除语义偏置一项，违规（禁区）接触增加 55%，而速度跟踪性能不变，说明该组件专门负责语义接触选择而非影响运动跟踪。在 Unitree B2 上完成验证，实现了室内外环境、四类语义障碍上的 sim-to-real 语义接触选择。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，将语义接触许可以带符号、距离门控的注意力偏置形式注入学习策略，可在不牺牲速度跟踪的前提下显著提升足式机器人的语义安全落足能力，并具备从仿真到真实（sim-to-real）的迁移可行性，适用于工业等对误踩敏感的接触选择场景。

title: Tilt as a Certified Resource: Preserving Motor Wrench-Rate Authority on Articulated Multirotors
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Fully-actuated multirotor aerial vehicles must not only track nominal wrenches but retain the "readiness" to modulate them rapidly under disturbances. Classical effort-minimizing allocators ignore this dynamic limit, whereas maximizing readiness leads to topologically disconnected optimal sheets demanding physically impossible actuator rates. Enforcing a readiness safety floor on fixed-geometry symmetric platforms further encounters a zero-sum degeneracy: motor-speed redistribution cannot improve authority without conceding wrench tracking. This paper uses active morphology to break the degeneracy, treating servo tilt as a geometric resource supplying authority-recovery directions unavailable to static rotors.
