We construct a configuration-dependent, motor-only readiness certificate - the log-volume of the reachable wrench-rate set - that explicitly excludes servo capacity, preventing a "ghost capacity fallacy" in which the certificate would falsely credit slow mechanical kinematic limits instead of collapsing accurately at motor saturation. The certificate is enforced as a Control Barrier Function (CBF) within a Unified Physical-Command Quadratic Program acting on motor torques and servo setpoints. Closed-loop simulations of an articulated octorotor under severe gust disturbances show classical allocators diverging and uncertified articulated allocators violating the safety floor, while the proposed CBF filter bounds the system state and preserves vehicle authority.

AI.tldr: 本文利用主动形态（伺服倾转）打破定几何对称平台中"就绪性-力旋量跟踪"的零和退化，构造了一个依赖构型、仅由电机决定的就绪性证书（可达力旋量速率集的体积对数），排除了伺服容量以避免"幽灵容量谬误"，并将其作为控制屏障函数嵌入统一物理指令二次规划中。仿真表明，经典分配器会发散，未认证的关节式分配器违反安全下限，而所提出的CBF滤波器能约束系统状态并保持车辆权限。
AI.motivation: 全驱动多旋翼不仅要跟踪标称力旋量，还须在扰动下保持快速调制力旋量的"就绪性"。经典的省力分配器忽略这一动态限制，而最大化就绪性又会产生拓扑上不连通的、需要物理上不可能执行器速率的优化面。在固定几何对称平台上施加就绪性安全下限会遭遇零和退化：电机转速的重分配无法在不牺牲力旋量跟踪的前提下提升权限。
AI.method: 使用主动形态学打破退化，将伺服倾转视为提供静态转子所无法提供的权限恢复方向的几何资源。构造依赖构型、仅含电机的就绪性证书——可达力旋量速率集的体积对数，该证书明确排除伺服容量，从而避免"幽灵容量谬误"（否则证书会错误地将缓慢的机械运动学极限计入，而非在电机饱和时准确崩溃）。该证书作为控制屏障函数（CBF）在作用于电机力矩和伺服设定点的统一物理指令二次规划中强制执行。
AI.result: 在严重阵风扰动下对关节式八旋翼进行闭环仿真显示：经典分配器发散，未认证的关节式分配器违反安全下限，而所提出的CBF滤波器能够约束系统状态并保持车辆权限。
AI.conclusion: 主动形态学（伺服倾转）为全驱动多旋翼的力旋量速率就绪性提供了静态转子无法获得的权限恢复方向，从而打破定几何平台的零和退化；基于电机专属就绪性证书的CBF滤波能在严重扰动下保证安全下限并维持车辆权限。

title: A High-Payload Wall-Climbing Robot Using Passive Bistable Suction Cups
comment: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics & Automation (ICRA)
summary: Wall-climbing robots capable of scaling vertical surfaces could help automate hazardous or labor intensive tasks such as window washing, inspection, maintenance, and construction. Active adhesion methods achieve higher payload capacities, but require power to maintain their grip. Passive adhesion devices such as suction cups are an attractive option for such robots because they do not require power to maintain their grip, but they are limited by their payload capacity. This work presents a novel high-payload wall-climbing robot that utilizes passive bistable suction cups to generate adhesion without needing to be pushed into the wall. The robot features a track-based system that automatically engages and disengages bistable suction cups to achieve locomotion on smooth surfaces. The robot is able to achieve vertical wall climbing on glass, wood, metal, and painted surfaces, sideways and upside-down climbing, and is able to tow a payload of 7.940 kg (with a payload-to-weight ratio of 2.25).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用被动双稳态吸盘实现高负载壁面爬行的机器人，通过轨道系统自动吸合/脱开吸盘，在光滑表面实现爬行，最大拖曳负载7.940 kg，负载自重比2.25。
AI.motivation: 壁面爬行机器人可自动化窗户清洗、检测、维护与施工等危险或高强度任务。主动粘附方式负载能力强但维持吸附需持续供电；被动粘附（如吸盘）无需供电维持吸附，但负载能力受限。因此需要一种兼具高负载能力且无需持续供电的粘附方案。
AI.method: 采用被动双稳态吸盘产生粘附力，且无需将吸盘压向墙面即可吸附；机器人搭载轨道式系统，自动完成双稳态吸盘的吸合与脱开，从而实现光滑表面上的运动。
AI.result: 机器人可在玻璃、木材、金属及涂漆表面实现垂直壁面爬行，并支持侧向与倒挂爬行；可拖曳7.940 kg负载，负载自重比达2.25。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了被动双稳态吸盘在高负载壁面爬行机器人中的可行性，在无需持续供电维持吸附的前提下实现了较高负载能力与多表面、多姿态爬行能力。

title: CounterPlay: Counterfactual Post-Training for Self-Play Driving Policies
summary: Self-play in high-throughput simulators yields driving policies with robust closed-loop performance, but improvement per unit of simulation diminishes as training scales. Policies learn to handle common situations early, while further rollouts repeatedly encounter unresolved failures. Post-training offers an opportunity to target these failures, but existing methods primarily evaluate alternative actions or continuations at visited states, although successful recovery may require changing driving style earlier. We propose CounterPlay, a counterfactual self-play post-training approach that backtracks from failed tasks and retries them under alternate driving styles. CounterPlay rests on three key components. First, failure-driven backtracking uses the policy's value estimates to select an earlier stored state from which to retry the task. Second, reward conditioning enables a single policy to retry the task from this state using candidate styles ranging from cautious to aggressive. Third, CounterPlay retains task-completing retries only if no other vehicle incurs a new or earlier collision or off-road event relative to the factual branch. Retries that pass verification with fresh randomness are then distilled into the policy under its deployment condition. On BehaviorBench, CounterPlay achieves state-of-the-art scores on both the Interactive and Random splits across all eight traffic regimes using 1B post-training transitions, which is just 1% of the anchor's 100B self-play training budget. Improvements over the anchor hold across all three evaluated driving styles. CounterPlay resolves a substantial fraction of the anchor's timeout cases on BehaviorBench and achieves a balance between task completion and safety that neither continued self-play nor adopting a more aggressive driving style attains.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CounterPlay，一种反事实自博弈后训练方法，通过回溯失败任务并在不同驾驶风格下重试，用极少训练量显著提升驾驶策略闭环性能。
AI.motivation: 高吞吐仿真器中的自博弈能产生闭环性能稳健的驾驶策略，但随着训练规模扩大，单位仿真带来的改进逐渐递减。策略早期就学会处理常见情形，而后续大量 rollout 反复遭遇未解决的失败。现有后训练方法主要在已访问状态上评估替代动作或续接，但成功恢复驾驶往往需要更早地改变驾驶风格。
AI.method: CounterPlay包含三个关键组件：1）失败驱动回溯，利用策略的价值估计选择更早的存储状态来重试任务；2）奖励条件化，使单一策略能以从谨慎到激进的不同候选风格从该状态重试；3）验证机制，仅当重试中无其他车辆相对事实分支产生新的或更早的碰撞或越界事件时，才保留完成任务的重试。通过验证的新随机性重试随后在部署条件下蒸馏进策略。
AI.result: 在BehaviorBench上，CounterPlay仅用1B后训练迁移量，就在全部八种交通规则的Interactive和Random划分上取得最优分数，仅为基线100B自博弈训练预算的1%。相对基线的改进在三种评估驾驶风格下均成立。CounterPlay解决了基线在BehaviorBench上一大部分超时情况，并实现了任务完成与安全之间的平衡，这是持续自博弈或采用更激进驾驶风格都无法达到的。
AI.conclusion: CounterPlay通过反事实回溯与风格条件化重试，以极低训练成本有效解决驾驶策略的顽固失败案例，在性能与安全性间取得优于持续自博弈的平衡。

title: Towards Fine-Grained Object Manipulation: SAM3-Guided Visuomotor Policy with Persistent Memory Learning and Focused Visual Conditioning
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027
summary: Fine-grained object (FO) manipulation requires robots to distinguish a specified FO from visually similar objects and execute actions reliably despite scene distractors. However, scene-level visual conditioning lacks explicit object selection, while category-level guidance cannot reliably distinguish FOs within the same category. We present a SAM3-guided visuomotor framework that addresses these challenges through persistent object memory and focused visual conditioning. First, we introduce FO Memory-driven SAM3 (FOM-SAM3), which learns reusable FO memory tokens from limited multi-view registration images while keeping SAM3 fully frozen. Through one-vs-rest learning, these tokens encode persistent memories for localizing target FOs and rejecting similar alternatives, which can be stored in a memory bank. Second, we propose Focused Spatial-Appearance Encoding (FSAE), which combines in-FO local appearance features with explicit bounding-box coordinates to condition action policies including Diffusion Policy (DP) and Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT). The effectiveness of the proposed FOM-SAM3 was validated on the FO-30 dataset comprising 30 physical objects across four coarse categories. Across three real-robot FO manipulation tasks, our FOM-SAM3-guided policies demonstrated robustness against distractors, discrimination ability among similar FOs, and extendibility to new FOs.

AI.tldr: 提出 SAM3 引导的视觉运动框架，通过持久对象记忆与聚焦视觉条件实现细粒度物体操作。
AI.motivation: 细粒度物体操作要求机器人区分视觉相似的指定目标并可靠执行动作，但场景级视觉条件缺乏显式目标选择，类别级引导又难以区分同类细粒度物体。
AI.method: 提出 FOM-SAM3，在 SAM3 冻结条件下从有限多视角配准图像学习可复用记忆 token，通过 one-vs-rest 学习编码持久记忆以定位目标并排除相似干扰，并存入记忆库；另提出 FSAE，将目标内部局部外观特征与显式边界框坐标结合，用于条件化动作策略（DP、ACT）。
AI.result: 在包含四大类 30 个物理物体的 FO-30 数据集上验证 FOM-SAM3；在三个真实机器人细粒度操作任务中，策略对干扰物具有鲁棒性，可区分相似细粒度物体并扩展至新物体。
AI.conclusion: SAM3 引导的持久对象记忆与聚焦视觉条件能有效支持细粒度物体操作，兼顾抗干扰、相似物区分与泛化能力。

title: RAYA: Learning Where and When to Intervene for Robot Recovery
summary: A robot can predict failure and still be unable to prevent it. By the time a safety mechanism reacts, the nominal plan may already have spent the control authority that recovery requires, and fixed task priorities may block whatever response remains. Our key insight is that both aspects are decided inside the controller. Recoverability must inform actions while they are chosen rather than veto them afterward, and task objectives must be adapted as recoverability shrinks. Building on this, we present RAYA, a hybrid learned-analytic framework that places a learned finite-horizon recoverability margin inside an optimal controller with hard constraints and pairs it with a bounded learned scheduler that shifts task weights to facilitate recovery. Across 7,200 simulation episodes per controller spanning quadrotor and autonomous-vehicle benchmarks, RAYA not only improves survival rates, but also transfers the learned components zero-shot to unseen trajectories, disturbances, plant shifts, and friction layouts. We developed an embedded realization of RAYA and deployed it on-board a 35g Crazyflie quadrotor. Across 40 combined hardware flights under wind with either aerodynamic mismatch or an unmodeled 40% motor-command loss, each of three baselines fails in all trials, while RAYA completes 10/10 six-cycle missions. Project Website: https://raya-control.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出混合学习-解析控制框架RAYA，将学习到的有限时域可恢复性裕度嵌入带硬约束的最优控制器，并用有界学习调度器动态调整任务权重；在仿真与35g Crazyflie实机上均显著提升生存率并实现零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 机器人即使能预测失败也可能无法避免失败：安全机制反应时，标称规划已消耗掉恢复所需的控制权限，而固定的任务优先级又会阻碍剩余可用响应。作者认为这两个问题都应在控制器内部解决——可恢复性必须在动作选择时参与决策而非事后否决，任务目标应随可恢复性收缩而自适应调整。
AI.method: RAYA是一个混合学习-解析框架：在带硬约束的最优控制器中嵌入学习的有限时域可恢复性裕度（recoverability margin），使可恢复性在动作选择阶段即影响决策；并配以有界的学习调度器（bounded learned scheduler），动态移动任务权重以促进恢复。学习组件支持零样本迁移。
AI.result: 在四旋翼与自动驾驶车辆基准上，每个控制器进行7,200次仿真回合；RAYA不仅提升生存率，还将学习组件零样本迁移到未见过的轨迹、扰动、被控对象偏移与摩擦布局。嵌入式实现部署于35g Crazyflie四旋翼；在风扰加气动失配或未建模40%电机指令损失的40次硬件飞行中，三个基线全部失败，而RAYA在10/10次六周期任务中完成。
AI.conclusion: 可恢复性应作为动作选择的内在约束而非事后否决，任务优先级应随可恢复性自适应；将学习到的可恢复性裕度与有界任务权重调度嵌入硬约束最优控制，可在仿真和真实微型四旋翼上显著提升任务生存能力并具备强泛化性。项目网站：https://raya-control.github.io/。

title: NeuRIO: A Streaming Neural Estimator for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Multi-Robot Relative Inertial Odometry
summary: We present NeuRIO, a streaming neural estimator for anchor-free 6-DoF relative inertial odometry using only identified inter-robot bearings, ranges, and IMU measurements. NeuRIO canonicalizes measurements into gravity-aligned coordinates, represents robots as nodes and mutual observations as factors, and uses attention for spatial reasoning and GRUs for temporal modeling. As a graph network, NeuRIO applies shared node-wise and factor-wise operators throughout the network, enabling it to handle different team sizes and time-varying observation graphs. NeuRIO is trained on a simulator that couples various motion patterns, device-level sensor characteristics, and diverse, realistic modeled, and temporally persistent sensor corruptions. In this way, NeuRIO achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. Across $24$ real-world sequences, NeuRIO achieves $14.1\,\mathrm{cm}$ position RMSE and $3.9^\circ$ rotation RMSE. More importantly, NeuRIO demonstrates strong computational scalability, maintaining an update cost below $20\,\mathrm{ms}$ with up to $400$ robots in simulation, while optimization-based methods exceed $20\,\mathrm{ms}$ at only $24$ robots. Moreover, even trained on limited team sizes, NeuRIO transfers directly to unseen larger teams without architectural or parameter changes.

AI.tldr: NeuRIO：一种基于图神经网络的无锚点6自由度相对惯性里程计流式神经估计器，仅利用机器人间识别到的方位、距离和IMU测量，实现零样本仿真到现实迁移，并具有极强的计算可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 多机器人系统需要无锚点、仅依赖相对观测（方位、距离、IMU）的6-DoF相对惯性里程计，且要求能适应不同团队规模和时变观测图，现有优化方法在大团队下计算开销过大。
AI.method: 将测量规范化到重力对齐坐标系；以机器人作为节点、相互观测作为因子，构建图网络；使用注意力进行空间推理、GRU进行时间建模；网络中共享节点级和因子级算子以支持不同团队规模与时变观测图；在耦合多种运动模式、设备级传感器特性及建模的时序持续传感器退化的模拟器上训练，从而实现零样本仿真到现实迁移。
AI.result: 在24条真实世界序列上达到14.1 cm位置RMSE与3.9°旋转RMSE；计算可扩展性强，仿真中400个机器人时更新成本仍低于20 ms，而优化方法在仅24个机器人时已超过20 ms；即使仅在有限团队规模上训练，也能无需改变架构或参数直接迁移到未见过的更大团队。
AI.conclusion: NeuRIO以图神经网络与流式估计实现了高精度、强可扩展、可零样本迁移的无锚点6-DoF相对惯性里程计，在精度和计算效率上均优于优化方法，并具备对大团队的泛化能力。

title: AgenticSwarm: Semantic Perception and Adaptive Task Allocation for Heterogeneous Multi-UAV Missions
summary: Multi UAV missions in complex environments require the system to understand both the surrounding scene and the intent of a human operator while maintaining feasible task allocation as mission conditions change. This paper presents AgenticSwarm, an agentic framework for semantic perception and adaptive task allocation in heterogeneous multi UAV missions. An agent interprets aerial imagery and natural language instructions to construct a grounded mission representation that links perceived objects and regions with task requirements, capability constraints, and mission dependencies. This information augments a constrained task allocation process in which obstacle aware path feasibility, energy consumption, and protected return home requirements are incorporated before assignment. During execution, changes such as UAV failure, battery degradation, or task modification trigger residual mission reconstruction from the current system state, while completed work and reconnaissance progress are retained. AgenticSwarm is evaluated across five diverse Gazebo environments and an indoor real test environment, demonstrating its ability to connect semantic reasoning with constrained allocation and adaptive multi UAV mission execution. Compared with a Grounding DINO+SAM~2.1 perception baseline, the SAM3-based pipeline improves class-aware recall by 25.2 percentage points (pp) and semantic label accuracy by 29.5 pp. Ablating residual mission replanning increases mean repeated work from 0% to 61.7% and post-event recovery time by 58.6%, highlighting the contribution of adaptive replanning to mission execution.

AI.tldr: 提出AgenticSwarm智能体框架，实现异构多无人机任务的语义感知与自适应任务分配，在仿真与实测中验证其语义推理与约束分配的有效性。
AI.motivation: 复杂环境下的多无人机任务要求系统同时理解周围场景与人类操作员意图，并在任务条件变化时保持可行的任务分配，现有方法难以将语义理解与约束分配统一起来。
AI.method: 智能体解析航拍图像与自然语言指令，构建将感知对象/区域与任务需求、能力约束、任务依赖关联的接地任务表示；该表示增强带约束的任务分配过程，在分配前纳入障碍感知路径可行性、能耗与受保护返航要求。执行中，当出现无人机故障、电池衰减或任务变更时，基于当前系统状态进行残余任务重构，同时保留已完成工作与侦察进度。基于SAM3的感知流水线用于语义分割与标注。
AI.result: 在五个Gazebo环境和室内真实测试环境评估。与Grounding DINO+SAM 2.1基线相比，SAM3流水线将类别感知召回率提升25.2个百分点，语义标签准确率提升29.5个百分点。消融残余任务重规划后，平均重复工作从0%升至61.7%，事件后恢复时间增加58.6%。
AI.conclusion: AgenticSwarm能够将语义推理与约束分配相连接，实现自适应的多无人机任务执行；自适应重规划对减少重复工作、缩短恢复时间具有关键贡献。

title: A Novel Path-Tracking Algorithm for Automated Tractor-Trailer Forward and Backward Maneuvers
summary: Fully autonomous tractor--trailer systems are increasingly deployed in logistics, agriculture, and industrial environments, where precise and robust path-tracking capabilities are essential. However, the articulation between the tractor and the trailer introduces additional nonlinearities and significantly complicates lateral and longitudinal control, particularly during reversing maneuvers. This paper introduces a novel path-tracking algorithm specifically designed for articulated vehicles with a single trailer. The proposed method combines a lateral control law applied at the trailer level with a short-horizon predictive adjustment of the tractor steering angle, ensuring stable convergence toward the desired path in both forward and backward motion. The approach is geometry-based and requires no per-vehicle calibration or training. Simulation studies in a high-fidelity physics simulator demonstrate the ability of the controller to match or outperform classical and state-of-the-art methods in terms of accuracy, stability, and robustness to disturbances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向单挂车铰接式车辆的新型路径跟踪算法，通过在挂车层面施加横向控制律并结合牵引车转向角的短时域预测调整，实现前进与倒车工况下稳定收敛的路径跟踪；方法基于几何、无需逐车标定或训练，并在高保真物理仿真中匹配或优于经典与前沿方法。
AI.motivation: 全自主牵引车-挂车系统在物流、农业和工业场景中日益普及，对精确鲁棒的路径跟踪需求强烈。但牵引车与挂车之间的铰接引入额外非线性，显著增加横向与纵向控制难度，尤其是倒车机动。
AI.method: 提出面向单挂车铰接式车辆的路径跟踪算法：在挂车层面施加横向控制律，并对牵引车转向角进行短时域预测性调整；方法为纯几何式，无需逐车标定或训练。
AI.result: 在高保真物理仿真器中的仿真研究表明，该控制器在精度、稳定性及抗扰鲁棒性方面可匹配或优于经典方法和当前最优方法。
AI.conclusion: 该几何式控制方案可在前进与倒车中实现稳定收敛，且无需标定/训练，具备较好的通用性与鲁棒性。

title: ZeroTouch: Tactile-Supervised Visual Contact Estimation for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Reliable robotic grasping benefits from estimating the evolving physical interaction and selecting a grasp-dependent compression target. Tactile sensors provide direct interaction measurements but require dedicated hardware at deployment. We introduce ZeroTouch, a tactile-supervised framework that predicts dense contact deformation, the instantaneous six-axis wrench, and a grasp-dependent desired compression target from wrist RGB observations, gripper state, and local gravity direction. Tactile measurements are used only as privileged supervision during training and are not required at deployment. On the full validation set, the complete architecture reduces normal-force MAE from 2.017 N for a state-only baseline to 0.531 N. In physical evaluation with 20 trials per condition, ZeroTouch achieves 95% success on an unseen object, 80% in a seen-object/unseen-grasp condition, and 90% under a content/load shift. Under the same evaluation protocol, OpenVLA achieves 25%, 40%, and 55%, while SmolVLA achieves 10%, 25%, and 35%, respectively.

AI.tldr: ZeroTouch 通过腕部 RGB、夹爪状态与局部重力方向，在训练期用触觉测量作特权监督，预测密集接触形变、瞬时六轴力/力矩及抓取相关的目标压缩量，部署时无需触觉硬件。完整模型将法向力 MAE 从 2.017 N 降至 0.531 N；物理实验中在未见物体、已见物体/未见抓取、内容/负载偏移下成功率分别为 95%、80%、90%，显著优于 OpenVLA 与 SmolVLA。
AI.motivation: 可靠抓取需要估计动态变化的物理交互并选择与抓取相关的压缩目标。触觉传感器能提供直接交互测量，但部署时需额外专用硬件，成本与集成难度高，因此需要一种无需部署触觉硬件、仍能获得触觉级交互估计的方法。
AI.method: 提出 ZeroTouch 触觉监督框架：输入为腕部 RGB 观测、夹爪状态和局部重力方向，输出为密集接触形变、瞬时六轴力/力矩以及抓取相关的期望压缩目标。触觉测量仅在训练阶段作为特权监督信号，部署阶段不使用。
AI.result: 在完整验证集上，完整架构将法向力 MAE 从仅状态基线的 2.017 N 降至 0.531 N。物理评估中每种条件 20 次试验：ZeroTouch 在未见物体上成功率 95%，已见物体/未见抓取为 80%，内容/负载偏移下为 90%；相同协议下 OpenVLA 分别为 25%、40%、55%，SmolVLA 分别为 10%、25%、35%。
AI.conclusion: ZeroTouch 表明，以触觉作为训练期特权监督，可在部署时仅依赖视觉与本体感知实现接近触觉水平的交互估计与压缩目标预测，并在多种泛化条件下显著超越现有 VLA 基线，验证了触觉监督视觉抓取框架的有效性与泛化能力。

title: Visual Proactivity: Enhancing Human-Robot Collaboration Through Intent Communication
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
summary: As robots transition from performing repetitive tasks to collaborating with humans, understanding human intent becomes crucial to effective interaction. Anticipation enables robots to predict human actions, while proactivity allows them to take initiative and guide human behavior toward optimal outcomes. Although research has largely focused on how robots infer and respond to human intentions, less attention has been paid to how robots communicate their own intent. This paper introduces visual proactivity, a novel, simple yet effective approach that enables robots to communicate their intentions through visual feedback, influencing human behavior and enhancing transparency and fluency. We develop and evaluate proactive robotic behaviors in a human-to-robot handover scenario, where a user study validates human perception of reactive, anticipatory, and proactive behaviors. The results demonstrate that effective visual proactivity fosters better alignment and coordination, paving the way for more intuitive human-robot collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"视觉主动性"（visual proactivity）方法，让机器人通过视觉反馈传达自身意图，从而影响人类行为并提升交互的透明性与流畅度。
AI.motivation: 机器人正从执行重复任务转向与人协作，理解人类意图对有效交互至关重要。已有研究多关注机器人如何推断和响应人类意图，而较少关注机器人如何传达自身意图。
AI.method: 提出视觉主动性方法，使机器人通过视觉反馈传达意图；在人到机器人（human-to-robot）物品交接场景中开发并评估反应式、预期式和主动式三类机器人行为，并通过用户研究验证人类对这些行为的感知。
AI.result: 用户研究证实了人类对反应式、预期式和主动式行为的不同感知；有效的视觉主动性促进了更好的人机对齐与协调。
AI.conclusion: 视觉主动性是一种简单而有效的方式，可提升人机协作的透明性与流畅性，为更直观的人机协作奠定基础。

title: When Should Robots Intervene? Balancing Engagement and Intrusiveness in Human-Robot Interaction
comment: Accepted for publication at the 35th IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN 2026)
summary: Designing effective Human-Robot Interaction in task-oriented settings requires carefully balancing user engagement with socially acceptable levels of robot intrusiveness. In this paper, we examine how different robot intervention strategies shape user experience, interaction dynamics, perceived intrusiveness, and sense of support. We compare two approaches: a continuous engagement-seeking robot strategy, and a context-aware strategy that selectively intervenes based on the user's state and task context. Both approaches rely on multimodal behavioral cues, including body orientation and attentional signals, to guide robot actions. We evaluate these strategies in a user study with 32 participants performing a task in a simulated hospital environment. Our findings show that higher interaction frequency does not necessarily lead to better engagement. Instead, we observe a systematic trade-off between perceived support and intrusiveness, influenced by factors such as physical proximity and user effort. These results provide empirical evidence that effective engagement in HRI depends on adaptive, context-sensitive intervention policies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过32人模拟医院任务实验，对比"持续寻求互动"与"情境感知选择性介入"两种机器人干预策略，发现更高互动频率并不带来更好参与度，感知支持与侵入性之间存在系统性权衡，有效参与依赖自适应、情境敏感的干预策略。
AI.motivation: 面向任务的HRI设计需要在用户参与度与可接受的社会性侵入水平之间取得平衡，但不同机器人介入策略如何影响用户体验、互动动态、感知侵入性与支持感尚缺乏实证依据。
AI.method: 提出并对比两种策略：（1）持续寻求参与的机器人策略；（2）基于用户状态与任务情境选择性介入的情境感知策略。两者均依赖多模态行为线索（身体朝向、注意信号）驱动机器人动作。在模拟医院环境中开展32名被试的用户研究进行评估。
AI.result: 更高的互动频率未必带来更好的参与：实验观察到感知支持与侵入性之间存在系统性权衡，并受物理距离、用户投入努力等因素影响。
AI.conclusion: HRI中的有效参与取决于自适应、情境敏感的干预策略，而非单纯提高介入频率。

title: Sandwich-Residuals: Parameter-Efficient Test-time Adaptation of World Models
summary: Latent world models enable planning by predicting the effects of actions in a learned representation space, but their predictions can become unreliable when test-time conditions differ from training. Existing test-time adaptation methods address this by updating parts of the pretrained model, often modifying millions of parameters and requiring a choice of which internal components to adapt. We introduce Sandwich-Residuals, a lightweight alternative that keeps the pretrained world model frozen and learns only small residual corrections around the predictor. The residuals are optimized online using the model's self-supervised prediction error and require no rewards, labels, or source-domain data. Across 21 conditions on the AdaJEPA benchmark, our method achieves $1.3\times$ the success rate of the frozen model while retaining 95% of the performance of the strongest AdaJEPA variant and adapting 97-99% fewer parameters. Under compound shifts, this advantage increases to $1.9\times$ the success rate of the frozen model, while remaining comparable to internal block adaptation. We further demonstrate the same adaptation principle on a DINO-WM model for 3-D manipulation. These results suggest that effective test-time adaptation of world models does not necessarily require modifying their pretrained internal weights.

AI.tldr: 提出Sandwich-Residuals：冻结预训练世界模型，仅在线学习预测器周围的小型残差修正，以极少参数量实现高效测试时自适应。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型虽能通过预测动作效果进行规划，但当测试条件偏离训练分布时预测会失效。现有测试时自适应方法需更新预训练模型的部分参数，涉及数百万参数更新，且需要人为选择适配的内部组件。
AI.method: Sandwich-Residuals 保持预训练世界模型完全冻结，仅在预测器周围学习小型残差修正；残差利用模型的自监督预测误差在线优化，无需奖励、标签或源域数据。
AI.result: 在 AdaJEPA 基准的 21 种条件下，成功率达到冻结模型的 1.3 倍，保留了最强 AdaJEPA 变体 95% 的性能，同时少适配 97–99% 的参数；在复合偏移下提升至冻结模型的 1.9 倍，与内部块适配相当。并在 DINO-WM 三维操作模型上验证了同样的适配原理。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型的有效测试时自适并不必然需要修改预训练内部权重，轻量残差修正即可在极少参数开销下取得有竞争力的性能。

title: Understanding Engagement and Intrusiveness in Assistive Human-Robot Interaction Using Individual Traits
comment: Accepted for publication at the 35th IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN 2026)
summary: Robot assistance is particularly crucial in unfamiliar tasks, where users must understand task requirements while coordinating with the robot. Previous research offers mixed evidence on the role of robot proxemics in user engagement: some studies suggest closer proximity enhances interaction, while others report it can feel intrusive. In this work, we argue that perceptions of intrusiveness depend not only on proxemics but also on the frequency of robot interventions, and are strongly influenced by individual traits such as personality and demographics. We conducted an experiment with 32 participants who interacted with two assistive robots that provided similar task support but differed in their intervention strategies. Results indicate that overall engagement remains stable across conditions, yet affective responses and perceived intrusiveness vary significantly with personality traits. Moreover, personality shapes interaction dynamics differently depending on the robot's behavior. These findings emphasize that effective human-robot interaction should account for individual differences, tailoring robot behavior to maintain engagement while respecting each user's unique affective and behavioral profile.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了机器人接近性与干预频率如何共同影响用户的投入感与侵扰感，并发现人格等个体差异在其中起关键调节作用。通过32名被试与两种不同干预策略辅助机器人的交互实验，结果表明整体投入感在条件间保持稳定，但情感反应与侵扰感知随人格特质显著变化，且人格对交互动态的影响取决于机器人行为。研究强调人机交互应针对个体差异定制机器人行为。
AI.motivation: 在陌生任务中，用户既需理解任务要求又需与机器人协作，因此机器人辅助尤为关键。然而，以往关于机器人空间关系（proxemics）对用户投入感影响的研究结论不一致：部分研究认为更近的接近性可增强交互，另一些则报告其可能令人感到侵扰。作者提出，侵扰感不仅取决于空间接近性，还取决于机器人干预的频率，并受人格与人口统计特征等个体特质的强烈影响，因此需要对此进行系统探究。
AI.method: 开展了一项实验，共32名参与者，与两种辅助机器人进行交互。两种机器人提供相似的任务支持，但在干预策略上存在差异。研究考察了空间接近性、干预频率与个体特质（如人格、人口统计特征）对用户投入感、情感反应与侵扰感知的影响。
AI.result: 总体投入感在各实验条件间保持稳定；但情感反应与感知到的侵扰程度随人格特质呈现显著差异。此外，人格对交互动态的影响因机器人行为的不同而有所差异。
AI.conclusion: 有效的人机交互应考虑个体差异，通过定制机器人行为来维持用户投入感，同时尊重每位用户独特的情感与行为特征。

title: PSR: Predictive Sensorimotor Representation Learning for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Contact-rich manipulation requires policies to generate precise actions by reasoning over contact forces, robot configurations, and interaction histories beyond visual observations. Existing methods passively condition on force feedback rather than actively predicting future contact dynamics, limiting their ability to generate high-precision actions. To address this problem, we introduce Predictive Sensorimotor Representation (PSR) learning, a framework that learns a hierarchy of predictive representations from multimodal sensorimotor signals and integrates them into the action stream of a visuomotor policy. Specifically, during a pretraining stage, a multimodal Transformer is trained to learn a hierarchy of predictive representations by jointly forecasting future interaction dynamics. The learned hierarchy subsequently augments the action stream, enabling the resulting policy to exploit contact-relevant cues at multiple depths. We further instantiate PSR within a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model, resulting in PSR-VLA, and evaluate it on six real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks. Experimental results show that PSR-VLA achieves 91.7% overall success, improving over $π_{0.5}$, ForceVLA-$π_{0.5}$, and ForceVLA2-$π_{0.5}$ by 30.0, 22.5, and 19.2 percentage points, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed PSR for force-aware, contact-rich manipulation. Videos of the tasks and stability tests are available at https://psr-vla.pages.dev/.

AI.tldr: 提出预测性感觉运动表征（PSR）学习框架，通过多模态Transformer预测未来交互动力学，并将预测表征融入VLA策略的动作流，在六个真实接触密集型操作任务上实现91.7%成功率。
AI.motivation: 接触密集型操作需在视觉之外推理接触力、机器人构型与交互历史以生成精确动作。现有方法仅被动地以力反馈为条件，缺乏对未来接触动力学的主动预测，限制了高精度动作的生成能力。
AI.method: 提出PSR学习框架：预训练阶段用多模态Transformer联合预测未来交互动力学，学习分层的预测性表征；随后将学到的层级表征增强至动作流，使策略能在多个深度上利用接触相关线索。并将其实例化于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，得到PSR-VLA。
AI.result: 在六个真实接触密集型操作任务上评估，PSR-VLA总体成功率达91.7%，分别较π0.5、ForceVLA-π0.5、ForceVLA2-π0.5提升30.0、22.5、19.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了PSR在力感知、接触密集型操作中的有效性，表明主动预测未来接触动力学并融入动作流可显著提升策略精度。任务视频与稳定性测试见 https://psr-vla.pages.dev/。

title: CRISP: Contact-Rich Robotic Simulation Platform with Extensive Geometries and Contact Solvers
summary: We present CRISP (Contact-RIch Simulation Platform), a high-fidelity physics engine tailored for complex multi-contact simulations such as tight-tolerance robotic manipulation. Achieving high physical fidelity in robotic simulation requires both expressive modeling of geometry and contact interactions, as well as accurate numerical resolution via robust collision detection and contact solvers. However, existing simulators often either rely on limited support for geometric representations and simplified modeling of contact interactions, or employ numerical resolution methods whose accuracy or robustness is inherently constrained. Accordingly, we develop a new simulator that supports diverse geometric representations with accurate optimization-based collision detection, and combines contact modeling with robust augmented Lagrangian-based contact solvers. This integration enables efficient and consistent detection of contact information across complex geometries while accurately resolving multi-contact constraints without problematic relaxations, which is essential for simulating contact-intensive and sharp interactions. We validate the physical fidelity of our simulator against state-of-the-art platforms and further demonstrate its capabilities through complex robotic manipulation scenarios. CRISP is publicly available at https://github.com/INRoL/crisp.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CRISP，一个面向复杂多接触场景（如紧公差机器人操作）的高保真物理仿真平台，结合多几何表示、基于优化的碰撞检测与增广拉格朗日接触求解器。
AI.motivation: 机器人仿真需要高物理保真度，要求既具备表达力强的几何与接触建模，又具备鲁棒的数值求解。现有仿真器在几何表示支持、接触建模简化程度或数值求解精度与鲁棒性上存在不足，尤其难以处理接触密集和尖锐交互。
AI.method: 开发新仿真器 CRISP：支持多样几何表示，采用基于优化的精确碰撞检测，并将接触建模与鲁棒的增广拉格朗日接触求解器相结合，从而在复杂几何上高效一致地获取接触信息，并在无病态松弛的情况下求解多接触约束。
AI.result: 将仿真器的物理保真度与当前先进平台进行对比验证，并通过复杂机器人操作场景展示其能力。
AI.conclusion: CRISP 通过几何表示、碰撞检测与接触求解的一体化设计，实现了复杂多接触仿真的高保真度，可用于接触密集的机器人操作任务，且已开源。

title: Scaling Vision-Language Reward Learning for Robot Manipulation in Parallel Simulation
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can replace human annotators in preference-based reward learning, but sequential API requests and single-environment data collection make training slow and costly. We present RAPID (Reward learning with Adaptive Parallel Image Diversity), a system that couples GPU-parallel rollout with data-aware policy updates, single-request preference labeling, automatic reward stabilization, and representative image sampling. We evaluate these components on five Franka Panda manipulation tasks in IsaacLab. Parallel rollout and adaptive updates provide the first substantial reduction in training time: under matched two-stage prompting, mean runtime falls from 9.18 to 3.13 hours. With all RAPID components enabled, training completes in 1.15 hours using 896 rather than 19,840 API calls per run, and aggregate final success rises from 86.3\% to 98.7\%. This represents an 8.0$\times$ end-to-end speedup and a 95.5\% reduction in API usage. An offline evaluation with Gemma~3 12B and GPT-4.1 mini demonstrates that single-request prompting reduces labeling latency and cost across both models. Code is available at: https://github.com/rapid-vlm/rapid-vlm-rl.

AI.tldr: RAPID 系统通过 GPU 并行 rollout、数据感知策略更新、单请求偏好标注、自动奖励稳定化和代表性图像采样，将基于视觉语言模型的偏好奖励学习训练时间从 9.18 小时降至 1.15 小时，API 调用从 19,840 次降至 896 次，最终成功率从 86.3% 提升至 98.7%。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型可替代人工标注者进行基于偏好的奖励学习，但顺序 API 请求和单环境数据采集导致训练缓慢且成本高昂。作者旨在解决这一效率与成本瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 RAPID（Reward learning with Adaptive Parallel Image Diversity）系统，耦合四项组件：GPU 并行 rollout 与数据感知策略更新、单请求偏好标注、自动奖励稳定化、代表性图像采样。在 IsaacLab 的五个 Franka Panda 操作任务上进行评估，并利用 Gemma 3 12B 与 GPT-4.1 mini 进行离线评估。
AI.result: 在匹配的两阶段提示下，并行 rollout 与自适应更新将平均运行时间从 9.18 小时降至 3.13 小时；启用全部 RAPID 组件后，训练在 1.15 小时内完成，每次运行的 API 调用从 19,840 次降至 896 次，聚合最终成功率从 86.3% 提升至 98.7%。实现 8.0 倍端到端加速和 95.5% 的 API 使用量削减。离线评估表明单请求提示在两个模型上均降低标注延迟与成本。
AI.conclusion: RAPID 通过并行化、数据感知更新、单请求标注、奖励稳定化与图像采样等协同设计，显著提升基于 VLM 的偏好奖励学习效率并降低成本，同时提高任务成功率。代码已开源。

title: TRACE: Coverage Path Planning for Unknown Environments Using Hierarchical Coverage Tree
summary: This paper presents a novel online coverage path planning (CPP) algorithm, called TRACE, for real-time coverage of unknown environments. TRACE is built upon a hierarchical coverage tree that provides a global representation of the evolving connectivity of the uncovered space. As the environment is incrementally revealed and covered, newly discovered obstacles and covered cells may fragment the remaining uncovered space into disconnected regions. TRACE recursively expands the corresponding tree nodes to explicitly represent these regions and organize them for subsequent coverage planning. Based on the updated tree, an incremental global tour is maintained to guide the coverage process. TRACE locally refines only the affected portions while preserving the visiting order of unchanged regions, thereby reducing the computational burden of global replanning and maintaining a consistent coverage progression. Guided by the global tour, a local planner generates back-and-forth coverage paths and switches to global-tour-aware planning to efficiently complete the target regions. Theoretical analysis establishes the computational complexity and complete coverage property of TRACE, and derives an approximation bound for the incremental global tour refinement. The performance of TRACE is evaluated through extensive high-fidelity simulations and real-robot experiments using a mobile robot. Comparative evaluations against six existing CPP methods demonstrate significant improvements in coverage time, path length, overlap ratio, and number of turns.

AI.tldr: 提出在线覆盖路径规划算法TRACE，基于分层覆盖树实现未知环境实时覆盖，兼顾计算效率与覆盖完整性。
AI.motivation: 未知环境下的实时覆盖路径规划（CPP）需要在环境逐步揭示过程中高效规划路径。环境探索会因新发现的障碍物和被覆盖单元将剩余未覆盖空间分割成多个不连通区域，全局重规划计算负担大且难以保持覆盖进程的连续性。
AI.method: TRACE构建分层覆盖树，作为未覆盖空间连通性的全局表示。当新障碍或已覆盖单元导致未覆盖空间碎片化时，递归扩展相应树节点以显式表示并组织这些区域；基于更新后的树维护增量式全局巡回（global tour）指导覆盖过程，仅局部细化受影响部分并保留未变区域的访问顺序，避免全局重规划；局部规划器在全局巡回引导下生成往复（back-and-forth）覆盖路径，并在需要时切换到全局巡回感知规划以高效完成目标区域。
AI.result: 理论分析给出了TRACE的计算复杂度、完整覆盖性质，并推导出增量全局巡回细化的近似界。通过高保真仿真与移动机器人实机实验，与六种现有CPP方法对比，TRACE在覆盖时间、路径长度、重叠率和转弯次数方面均有显著改善。
AI.conclusion: TRACE通过分层覆盖树与增量全局巡回机制，实现了未知环境下高效、连续的在线覆盖路径规划，在多项性能指标上优于现有方法。

title: Compact but Moving: Intervention-Relevant Geometry in Recurrent World Models
summary: Learned world models may have compact interventions even when their recurrent state is high-dimensional, but it is unclear what happens to such a correction after it enters the model. We study this question in a controlled recurrent world model where prior work identified a checkpoint-specific rank-4 interface for one-shot counterfactual velocity interventions. The correction rapidly leaves this fixed entry subspace during autonomous rollout. Nevertheless, a low-rank image obtained by transporting the entry directions through the factual recurrent Jacobian chain continues to capture most of the nonlinear correction. Restarts using the tangent-predicted correction preserve substantial counterfactual future function. This transport/function pattern recurs across independently trained structured-GRU models and a parameter-matched LSTM initialized with a privileged compact correction. We further characterize a finite-horizon future-response operator over the full recurrent carrier. Patching shifts its leading future-sensitive directions toward the matched native-counterfactual organization, and the local operator accurately ranks finite perturbation effects over the registered direction panels at the patched and native-counterfactual basepoints. A separate full-amplitude assay finds substantial factual-endpoint tangent residuals and supports response reconfiguration in two of three checkpoints. Together, these results show that compact intervention structure can persist as a moving, state-dependent local geometry embedded in high-dimensional recurrent dynamics, without implying a fixed or dynamically closed low-dimensional state.

AI.tldr: 在受控循环世界模型中，反事实速度干预的紧凑结构并非固定子空间，而是随自主推演移动到状态依赖的低维局部几何中，同时保留反事实预测功能。
AI.motivation: 探究学习到的世界模型在循环状态高维时，紧凑干预结构进入模型后会发生什么变化，特别是先验工作发现的检查点特定秩-4一次性反事实速度干预接口在模型内部如何演化。
AI.method: 在受控循环世界模型中进行实验：追踪干预方向在自主推演中离开固定入口子空间的过程；通过事实循环雅可比链传输入口方向获得低秩图像；比较独立训练的结构化GRU与参数匹配的LSTM；刻画有限时域未来响应算子在完整循环载体上的性质，并进行方向面板扰动排名与全幅度检验。
AI.result: 修正迅速离开固定入口子空间，但通过雅可比链传输得到的低秩图像仍能捕获大部分非线性修正；使用切空间预测修正重启可保留显著反事实未来功能；该传输/功能模式在多个模型上重复出现；补丁使未来敏感主方向向匹配的本征反事实组织移动，局部算子能准确排序扰动效应；全幅度检验发现事实端点切残差，并在三个检查点中的两个支持响应重构。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑干预结构可以作为嵌入高维循环动力学中的移动、状态依赖局部几何持续存在，而不意味着存在固定或动力学封闭的低维状态。

title: AcousticDiffusion: Semantically Conditioned Audio-Guided Diffusion Policy for Search-and-Rescue Assistance
summary: Navigating toward human callers is an important capability for rescue robots operating where visual contact is degraded or occluded. We present AcousticDiffusion, a semantically conditioned, audio-guided diffusion policy for human-directed navigation. A frozen pretrained audio recognizer processes 10.24 s windows, with speech gating and distress-aware prioritization converting recognition outputs into source-level navigation roles. Microphone-array direction-of-arrival measurements are recursively integrated into a robot-centric Bayesian bird's-eye-view belief field. Ego-motion compensation aligns successive observations, progressively constraining source position while preserving bearing-induced range uncertainty. The semantic belief, recent acoustic observations, audio features, and robot state condition a diffusion model that generates waypoint trajectories. On a synthetic-navigation validation set using recorded audio, AcousticDiffusion achieves a mean end-point bearing error of 11.20 degrees, with 91.78% of trajectories aligned within 30 degrees of the caller. Distractor rejection ranges from 89.20% to 98.99%, and the policy favors a HELP-designated caller over a competing speaker in 91.07% of windows. Deployed online on a ZSL-1 quadruped without additional retraining, it achieves a mean bearing error of 64.9 degrees, compared with 98.2 degrees for A* and 90.4 degrees for RRT, with a mean planner compute time of 6.07 ms. Despite imperfect acoustic localization, the reported mean final source distance is reduced from 3.96 m for the classical planners using ODAS-derived (Open embedded Audition System) guidance to 2.48 m, a 37.4% improvement. These results demonstrate the framework's ability to translate uncertain acoustic observations into closer approaches to human callers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AcousticDiffusion——一种语义条件化、音频引导的扩散策略，用于面向人类呼叫者的救援机器人导航；它融合声源识别与麦克风阵列方位估计构建贝叶斯鸟瞰信念场，并由扩散模型生成航点轨迹，在仿真与四足机器人在线部署中均优于经典规划器。
AI.motivation: 救援机器人在视觉受阻或遮挡的环境中作业时，朝向人类呼叫者移动是一项重要能力，但视觉方法失效，需依赖声学信息；而声学定位存在不确定性（尤其是距离不确定性），需要将不确定的声学观测转化为可靠的导航决策。
AI.method: 采用冻结的预训练音频识别器处理 10.24 秒窗口，通过语音门控与求救优先机制将识别输出转化为声源级导航角色；将麦克风阵列到达方向（DoA）测量递归整合进以机器人为中心的贝叶斯鸟瞰信念场，并进行自我运动补偿以对齐连续观测，在约束声源位置的同时保留由方位引起的距离不确定性；以语义信念、近期声学观测、音频特征与机器人状态为条件，用扩散模型生成航点轨迹。
AI.result: 在基于录制音频的合成导航验证集上，平均终点方位误差为 11.20°，91.78% 的轨迹在呼叫者 30° 范围内；干扰源抑制率为 89.20%–98.99%，在 91.07% 的窗口中选择 HELP 标记呼叫者而非竞争说话人。无需额外重训练即可在线部署于 ZSL-1 四足机器人，平均方位误差 64.9°，优于 A* 的 98.2° 与 RRT 的 90.4°，平均规划计算时间 6.07 ms；平均最终声源距离由经典规划器（基于 ODAS 引导）的 3.96 m 降至 2.48 m，提升 37.4%。
AI.conclusion: 尽管声学定位并不完美，该框架能够将不确定的声学观测转化为更接近人类呼叫者的接近行为，验证了音频引导扩散策略在视觉退化场景下实现面向人类导航的可行性。

title: Contact-Rich Motion Planning via GPU-Parallel Mode Evaluation
summary: Contact-rich motion planning (CRMP) is essential for robotic manipulation and locomotion, yet remains computationally challenging due to combinatorial contact decisions. Existing methods typically avoid broad evaluation of contact-mode sequences through search heuristics or optimization reformulations. We revisit broad evaluation in light of modern GPU hardware and introduce Contact-Mode Expansion with parallel Trajectory optimization (CoMET), which combines GPU-parallel trajectory evaluation with greedy contact-mode expansion. On planar pushing benchmarks, CoMET is competitive with optimization-based, sampling, and tree-search baselines in solution quality and planning time, matching the full-enumeration reference on nearly all instances with fewer evaluations and shorter planning times. Ablations suggest that much of the performance gain comes from the high-throughput trajectory evaluator. In bimanual nonprehensile manipulation, GPU-friendly local mode expansion achieves higher planning success than the tested adaptive tree search as the mode space grows. These results demonstrate that broad explicit mode evaluation provides a simple yet effective alternative for CRMP.

AI.tldr: 提出 CoMET 方法，利用 GPU 并行轨迹评估配合贪心接触模式扩展，验证了在接触丰富运动规划（CRMP）中广泛显式评估接触模式序列的有效性。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富运动规划（CRMP）因接触决策的组合爆炸而计算困难。现有方法多通过搜索启发式或优化重构来回避对接触模式序列的广泛评估，本文重新审视这一做法，考虑现代 GPU 硬件带来的可能性。
AI.method: 提出 CoMET（Contact-Mode Expansion with parallel Trajectory optimization），将 GPU 并行轨迹评估与贪心接触模式扩展相结合，对接触模式序列进行广泛显式评估。
AI.result: 在平面推动基准上，CoMET 在解质量与规划时间上与基于优化、采样和树搜索的基线方法相当；在几乎所有实例上以更少的评估次数和更短的规划时间达到全枚举参考解的性能。消融实验表明性能提升主要来自高吞吐轨迹评估器。在双臂非抓取操作中，随着模式空间增大，GPU 友好的局部模式扩展成功率高于所测试的自适应树搜索。
AI.conclusion: 广泛的显式模式评估为接触丰富运动规划提供了一种简单而有效的替代方案。

title: A Sim-to-Real Integration Pipeline for Training and Deployment of Chunk-Based VLA Manipulation Policies
comment: Accepted at IROS 2026 Workshop on Sim2Real and Classical Control: From Rigorous Theory to Data-Driven Robotics
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a prominent paradigm for mapping multimodal inputs, including semantic instructions, visual observations of the scene, and proprioceptive observations, to robot actions. Most state-of-the-art models predict actions in the end-effector pose space as sequences of action chunks. Training and evaluating these models requires large-scale collections of real-world demonstrations, pairing robot actions with the corresponding visual and proprioceptive observations. Collecting such data on real hardware typically relies on human teleoperation, making the process costly, time-consuming, and difficult to scale. We present an open-source sim-to-real experimental protocol that addresses this bottleneck: expert trajectories generated in simulation are replayed open-loop on a real Franka FR3 setup, where the corresponding real visual and proprioceptive observations are recorded and converted into a format compatible with VLA training. The same deployment stack is then reused, in closed-loop, to evaluate a trained policy on that setup, so that data collection and evaluation share an identical hardware configuration. Because each real recording is paired with the simulated trajectory that produced it, the protocol also yields a direct measurement of the sim-to-real gap. We release the collected datasets on Hugging Face together with the pipeline source code https://gitlab.isir.upmc.fr/kappel/sim2real_public_chunk_control.

AI.tldr: 提出开源sim-to-real实验协议：在仿真中生成专家轨迹，在真实Franka FR3上开环回放并采集真实视觉与本体感受观测，转换为VLA训练格式；同一部署栈闭环评估策略，同步量化sim-to-real差距，并开源数据与代码。
AI.motivation: VLA模型通常预测末端执行器位姿空间的动作块序列，其训练与评估依赖大规模真实世界示范数据；这类数据多靠人工遥操作采集，成本高、耗时长、难以扩展，构成数据瓶颈。
AI.method: 开源sim-to-real实验协议：仿真生成专家轨迹→在真实Franka FR3上开环回放→记录对应的真实视觉与本体感受观测→转换为兼容VLA训练的格式。数据采集与评估复用同一部署栈，评估时以闭环方式在该硬件配置上运行训练好的策略。
AI.result: 每条真实记录都与生成它的仿真轨迹配对，从而可直接测量sim-to-real差距；在Hugging Face发布采集的数据集，并公开流程源代码。
AI.conclusion: 该协议通过仿真生成、真机回放与同一部署栈复用，缓解VLA数据采集瓶颈，实现数据采集与评估硬件配置一致，并提供sim-to-real差距的直接度量；数据集与代码开源以促进复现与扩展。

title: LunaDrive: A Delay-Compensated High-Voltage GaN FET-Based Motor Driver for Dynamic Robots with Flat BLDC Motors
comment: Accepted at IROS2026, website - https://woodrobo.github.io/lunadrive/ , YouTube - https://youtu.be/iD8vzvis_5w
summary: The performance improvement of high-power flat BLDC motors has accelerated the development of dynamic robots. However, many commercially available servo motors assume operating voltages of 48 V or lower, which limits the maximum rotational speed. Dynamic robots require rapid energy generation, so this voltage constraint restricts motion performance. Therefore, driving motors beyond the rated voltage is desirable to increase the instantaneous maximum speed. On the other hand, semiconductor devices used in motor drivers have a trade-off between voltage rating and current capacity. Conventional drivers using Si MOSFETs have difficulty achieving both high-voltage and high-current operation. Although GaN FETs are promising, compact drivers that can be mounted on the rear side of flat BLDC motors remain limited. In this study, a motor driver for high-power flat BLDC motors using GaN FETs is developed. The effect of delay compensation in the high-speed region beyond the rated operating range is also investigated. In the experiments, under 96 V operation, a continuous current of 30 A was achieved with a heat sink attached. A peak current of 80 A and a maximum electrical frequency of 3110 Hz were confirmed. A high-speed load lifting experiment driven by a LiPo battery 24S (100 V) was also conducted, demonstrating applicability to dynamic robot operation.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一款面向高功率扁平BLDC电机的GaN FET驱动器，支持96 V、30 A连续电流与80 A峰值电流，最高电频率3110 Hz，并验证了超额定转速下的延迟补偿效果及动态机器人应用可行性。
AI.motivation: 动态机器人需要快速能量输出，但商用伺服电机多限于48 V及以下电压，限制了最高转速；同时Si MOSFET驱动器难以兼顾高压与大电流，而可安装于扁平BLDC电机背侧的紧凑型GaN驱动器仍较缺乏。因此需要超额定电压驱动电机以提升瞬时最高转速。
AI.method: 采用GaN FET构建适用于高功率扁平BLDC电机的紧凑型电机驱动器，并研究在超出额定工作范围的高速区域中的延迟补偿方法。
AI.result: 在96 V工作条件下，加装散热器时实现30 A连续电流；确认80 A峰值电流和3110 Hz最高电频率。还进行了由24S LiPo电池（100 V）驱动的高速负载提升实验。
AI.conclusion: 所开发的GaN FET驱动器可在超额定电压与高速条件下稳定运行，延迟补偿有效提升高速区性能，并展示了对动态机器人运行的适用性。

title: PopNavShift: Stress-Testing Social Navigation under Behavioral Population Shift
summary: Social-navigation algorithms are often evaluated under a fixed pedestrian-behavior distribution, despite substantial variation in pedestrian responses to robots across individuals and social contexts. We introduce PopNavShift, a matched simulation framework for stress-testing social-navigation strategies under pedestrian population shifts. PopNavShift constructs population-conditioned pedestrian motion profiles by prompting Gemini 3.7 Flash with 600 synthetic persona records from MatrAIx Persona 1M and deterministically mapping the responses into bounded motion parameters. It then compares three representative navigation strategies, reactive avoidance, early yielding, and reciprocal collision avoidance, across eight population conditions and 7,488 matched robot runs. In a matched intervention on the same 202 personas, changing only time pressure reverses 8.6% of controller rankings based on robot travel time, but 22.4% based on mean pedestrian delay and 23.9% based on worst-decile delay. Across population conditions, this sensitivity is greater for pedestrian burden than for robot travel time and increases in spatially constrained settings; the same qualitative pattern persists under a second pedestrian dynamics model. These findings support evaluating navigation strategies across behavioral populations using both robot performance and pedestrian burden.

AI.tldr: 提出PopNavShift仿真框架，用大模型生成人群条件的行人运动画像，对三种社交导航策略在人群分布偏移下进行压力测试，发现评价指标（尤其行人负担）会导致控制器排名反转。
AI.motivation: 现有社交导航算法通常在固定行人行为分布下评估，忽略了个体与社会情境导致的行人反应差异；这种单一分布假设可能使策略排名不可靠，因此需要在人群分布偏移下系统检验策略稳健性。
AI.method: PopNavShift：用MatrAIx Persona 1M中的600条合成persona记录提示Gemini 3.7 Flash，得到人群条件下的行人运动画像，并将回答确定性映射为有界运动参数；在8种人群条件下对反应式避障、提前让行、互惠避碰三种策略进行7,488次匹配机器人运行对比；另对同一202个persona做仅改变时间压力的匹配干预，并在第二种行人动力学模型下复现。
AI.result: 同一202个persona的匹配干预中，仅改变时间压力就使基于机器人通行时间的控制器排名反转8.6%，基于平均行人延误反转22.4%，基于最差十分位延误反转23.9%；跨人群条件时，这种敏感性对行人负担大于对机器人通行时间，且在空间受限场景中更强；定性模式在第二种行人动力学模型下依然成立。
AI.conclusion: 社交导航策略评估应跨越多种行为人群，并同时采用机器人性能与行人负担两类指标，否则单一人群分布下的排名结论可能不稳健。

title: VIRGA: Virtual-Agent-Intermediated Riemannian Geometry for Active-Sensing Air-Ground Coordination
summary: Air-ground autonomy becomes harder when the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) must remain observable by a gimbal light detection and ranging (LiDAR) mounted on the unmanned ground vehicle (UGV). The platforms must avoid dynamic obstacles while coordinating heterogeneous motion, limited sensing, and changing task initiative within one closed loop. This paper presents VIRGA, a neural geometric coordination framework that turns dual-LiDAR observations into bounded source-specific Riemannian fields and couples them through a virtual agent with reciprocal elastic feedback. Platform-aware execution maps convert the shared coordination reference into feasible UAV, UGV, and gimbal commands while enforcing active-observation safeguards. Evaluation against three complementary baselines reveals distinct limitations. An adapted Ray-RMP controller provides the fastest Riemannian response but produces insufficient clearance in the coupled air-ground task. A dense analytical Riemannian field improves geometric avoidance, yet its high evaluation cost prevents stable field-of-view maintenance. An adapted ColAG controller achieves the lowest latency but still incurs safety and observability violations. VIRGA completes all paired warehouse conditions safely, while a long-range cave stress test without retraining demonstrates sustained coordination in irregular and confined geometry. Ablations confirm contributions from online geometric evaluation, virtual-agent mediation, and reciprocal feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VIRGA框架，将双LiDAR观测转化为有界黎曼场，通过虚拟智能体与互惠弹性反馈实现空地协同，在仓库与洞穴场景中安全完成观测约束下的协同任务。
AI.motivation: 空地自主协同在UAV需持续被UGV搭载的云台LiDAR观测时难度显著上升：平台需在同一闭环内规避动态障碍，同时协调异构运动、有限感知与变化的任务主导权。
AI.method: VIRGA将双LiDAR观测转化为有界、来源特定的黎曼场，并通过一个虚拟智能体以互惠弹性反馈进行耦合；再经平台感知执行映射，将共享协同参考转为可行的UAV、UGV与云台指令，并施加主动观测安全约束。
AI.result: 对比三类基线：Ray-RMP响应最快但间隙不足；稠密解析黎曼场避障更好但计算代价高，难以稳定维持视场；ColAG延迟最低但仍出现安全与可观测性违规。VIRGA在全部成对仓库条件下安全完成，并在未重训练的远距离洞穴压力测试中保持协同。消融验证了在线几何评估、虚拟智能体中介与互惠反馈的贡献。
AI.conclusion: VIRGA通过黎曼场与虚拟智能体中介，在观测约束下实现了安全、可泛化的空地协同，消融证明各关键组件均有实质贡献。

title: CommitFlow: Semantic Commitment Verification and Local Correction for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation VLA Execution
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to the IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2027
summary: Although vision-language-action (VLA) policies have advanced rapidly, long-horizon execution may still progress to the next task stage before the required physical effect has been established. We call this a mismatch between semantic commitments, physical conditions that a stage must establish or maintain, and the actual physical state. Because an action command alone cannot confirm such a condition, local deviations can propagate and cause task failure. To address this problem, we present CommitFlow, a closed-loop execution framework that combines commitment monitoring with local correction while keeping the base policy frozen. CommitFlow integrates three components. A Semantic Commitment Monitor (SCM) compares stage requirements against current state evidence and holds back dependent actions when a required condition is unmet or violated. BoundaryFlow then generates a local correction conditioned on the current state and base action, and Relation and Gain Calibration (RGC) selects the smallest correction strength that satisfies the relevant constraints. Across the ten common RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark tasks, CommitFlow achieves a mean success rate of 75.9 percent, improving on the base policy pi0.5 by 22.7 percent. Cross-policy experiments show consistent gains, pointing toward reliable long-horizon robot execution.

AI.tldr: CommitFlow：一种结合语义承诺监控与局部修正的闭环执行框架，冻结基座策略即可在RoboTwin 2.0十项任务上平均成功率75.9%，较pi0.5提升22.7%。
AI.motivation: VLA策略虽发展迅速，但长时程执行中常出现"语义承诺—物理条件—实际物理状态"三者失配：在所需物理效果尚未建立或维持前，就推进到下一任务阶段。由于单一动作指令无法确认物理条件是否达成，局部偏差会逐步传播并最终导致任务失败。因此需要一种在保持基座策略不变的前提下，对承诺条件进行监控并对局部偏差进行修正的机制。
AI.method: CommitFlow为闭环执行框架，包含三个组件：(1) Semantic Commitment Monitor（SCM）将阶段需求与当前状态证据进行比对，当所需条件未满足或被破坏时，暂缓依赖该条件的动作；(2) BoundaryFlow以当前状态和基座动作为条件，生成局部修正；(3) Relation and Gain Calibration（RGC）在满足相关约束的前提下，选择最小的修正强度。整个框架不更新基座策略参数。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0的十项常见基准任务上，CommitFlow平均成功率达75.9%，相比基座策略pi0.5提升22.7个百分点；跨策略实验也显示出一致的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过将语义承诺监控与可标定的局部修正结合，CommitFlow在不重新训练基座策略的情况下显著缓解了长时程执行中的语义-物理失配问题，为可靠的长时程机器人执行提供了可行路径。

title: MAAP: Multi-Agent Active Perception for Collaborative Manipulation
summary: Multi-agent manipulation naturally produces multiple task-driven viewpoints: every arm carries a wrist camera and moves through the scene while acting. Yet these observations are typically underutilized, and active perception in manipulation is still often treated as requiring a dedicated sensing agent. We introduce MAAP (Multi-Agent Active Perception), in which every arm is dual-purpose: it executes manipulation actions and, through the wrist camera it carries, simultaneously serves as a moving viewpoint for the team. We pair this with RAIL (Role-Aware Imitation Learning), a controller that predicts each arm's current role alongside its action chunk and conditions action generation on it, representing role-dependent actions within one network. Across four simulated tasks, widening the perception regime lifts average success from 56.5% with a fixed camera to 62.5% with one active wrist view and 70.0% with all of them, while MAAP+RAIL reaches 79.2%. RAIL's additional gain is concentrated on the three-arm Microwave task, where success rises from 47% to 82% on identical multi-wrist inputs. On a dual-arm platform, MAAP+RAIL succeeds in 14 of 20 placement trials compared with 0 of 20 for fixed-view ACT. Collaborative manipulation can thus serve as an active perception mechanism in its own right.

AI.tldr: 提出MAAP框架与RAIL控制器，将多臂协作机械臂的腕部相机作为主动感知视角，显著提升操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 多智能体操作中每个机械臂都携带腕部相机并在执行任务时移动，天然产生多个任务驱动的视角，但这些观测通常未被充分利用；主动感知在操作领域仍常被视为需要一个专用感知智能体。作者希望证明协作操作本身即可作为一种主动感知机制。
AI.method: 提出MAAP（Multi-Agent Active Perception），让每个机械臂双重用途：既执行操作动作，又通过其腕部相机作为团队的移动视角；并配以RAIL（Role-Aware Imitation Learning）控制器，预测每个机械臂当前角色及其动作块，并以角色为条件生成动作，从而在单一网络中表示角色相关的动作。
AI.result: 在四个仿真任务中，感知范围扩大使平均成功率从固定相机的56.5%提升至单腕视角的62.5%，全腕视角达70.0%，MAAP+RAIL达79.2%。RAIL的额外增益集中在三臂Microwave任务上，在相同多腕输入下成功率从47%升至82%。在双臂平台上，MAAP+RAIL在20次放置试验中成功14次，而固定视角ACT为0次。
AI.conclusion: 协作操作本身即可作为一种主动感知机制，多臂腕部视角的有效利用与角色感知的动作生成能显著提升操作性能。

title: CARF: Contrastive Attraction-Repulsion of Failure-Guided Flow Matching
summary: Robot demonstration collection often produces imperfect or failed trajectories in addition to successful demonstrations. Existing methods typically exploit failed trajectories by identifying segments that still make progress toward task completion, but largely overlook \textit{failure-critical behaviors} that directly lead to task failure. Here we argue that these two types of segments provide fundamentally asymmetric supervision: progressive segments should be imitated, whereas failure-critical segments should be explicitly avoided. Based on this observation, we propose CARF, a Contrastive Attraction-Repulsion of Failure-guided framework for learning from imperfect robot data. CARF introduces a progress-based importance scorer, trained solely on successful expert demonstrations and its perturbation results, to estimate step-wise contributions toward task completion and identify informative regions in failed trajectories. These scores guide a unified flow-matching objective that attracts the policy toward progressive behaviors and repels it from failure-critical ones, while excluding ambiguous segments. This enables more comprehensive utilization of imperfect data and avoids unreliable supervision from ambiguous failure segments. Extensive experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate consistent improvements over competing baselines across diverse failure scenarios, with ablations further validating the effectiveness of the proposed scoring and attraction-repulsion mechanisms. Our website is https://zhao-sq.github.io/carf/#.

AI.tldr: 提出CARF框架，通过对失败轨迹中"进步片段"与"失败关键片段"施加吸引-排斥的非对称监督，更全面地利用不完美机器人数据。
AI.motivation: 机器人演示采集常混入失败轨迹。现有方法多只提取失败轨迹中仍有进展的片段进行模仿，忽视了直接导致任务失败的"失败关键行为"。作者认为这两类片段提供本质不对称的监督信号：进步片段应被模仿，失败关键片段应被显式规避。
AI.method: CARF引入基于进展的重要性打分器，仅用成功专家演示及其扰动结果训练，估计每步对任务完成的贡献并识别失败轨迹中的信息区域；这些分数指导统一的流匹配目标，使策略被吸引向进步行为、被排斥远离失败关键行为，同时排除模糊片段。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实世界多种失败场景下，CARF持续优于对比基线；消融实验验证了所提打分机制与吸引-排斥机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 对失败轨迹中的进步片段与失败关键片段进行非对称（吸引/排斥）监督，能更全面利用不完美数据，并避免模糊失败片段带来的不可靠监督。

title: SkelWAM: A Skeleton-Guided World-Action Model for Zero-Shot Cross-Embodiment Manipulation
summary: Reusing manipulation experience across robot embodiments is important for scaling robot learning and reducing repeated task-specific data collection. However, changes in embodiment alter visual appearance, action dimensionality and semantics, and the whole-body configurations that can realize the same tool pose. We present SkelWAM, a skeleton-guided world-action model that couples perception and control through one explicit geometric representation for single-source cross-embodiment manipulation. Arm centerline geometry, tool-center-point (TCP) pose, and parallel-jaw commands form a shared 25-D state. The same definition underlies canonical third-person and wrist observations and future whole-body action targets. Trained with predictive visual supervision, a video-action mixture of transformers predicts canonical skeleton action chunks, which embodiment-specific constrained decoders convert into joint or continuum-robot controls. This formulation requires no one-to-one joint correspondence and uses no target-task demonstrations or target policy updates. We introduce LIBERO-Cross10, a source-only cross-embodiment transfer benchmark covering ten tasks and ten target embodiments across four morphological groups. On this benchmark, Franka-trained SkelWAM achieves 43.3% success over 1,000 episodes, exceeding the best-performing evaluated baseline by 36.2 percentage points. We further deploy a JAKA mini2-trained policy on the Feagine A03 continuum robot for three tabletop manipulation tasks, illustrating the approach's potential for real-world cross-embodiment manipulation. Project page: http://www.liukepku.com/skelwam/index.html

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SkelWAM，一种以骨架几何为共享表征的世界-动作模型，实现单源跨形态机器人操作迁移，无需目标域演示或策略微调。
AI.motivation: 跨机器人形态复用操作经验可显著降低重复的任务特定数据采集成本，但形态差异会改变视觉外观、动作维度与语义，以及实现同一工具位姿所需的整体构型。
AI.method: 构建由手臂中心线几何、工具中心点（TCP）位姿与平行夹爪指令组成的共享25维状态，统一用于规范化的第三人称与腕部观测以及未来全身动作目标；采用含视频-动作混合的 Transformer 在预测性视觉监督下预测规范化骨架动作序列，再由形态特定的约束解码器转换为关节或连续体机器人控制指令，无需关节一一对应。
AI.result: 提出 LIBERO-Cross10 单源跨形态迁移基准（含十项任务、四个形态组下的十个目标形态）；Franka 训练的策略在该基准1000个回合中取得43.3%成功率，较最佳评估基线高出36.2个百分点；并将 JAKA mini2 训练的策略部署至 Feagine A03 连续体机器人完成三项桌面操作任务。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何骨架表征可作为感知与控制的耦合接口，在无目标任务演示与目标策略更新的条件下实现有效跨形态迁移，并具备真实世界应用潜力。

title: Gripper-Aware Automatic Dense Packing of Irregular Objects
summary: Automatic dense packing is widely desired in warehouse operations but remains a fundamental challenge in robotic manipulation. Existing work on irregular-object packing largely targets simulation with idealized contact, treating the object as an isolated rigid body. The gripper often enters as a discrete, post-hoc feasibility check, if considered at all, and the perception and contact drift accumulated during execution are not addressed. We present a closed-loop pipeline that integrates perception, gripper-aware placement optimization, and force-guided execution on a real manipulator. The optimizer represents the object together with the gripper as a single composite body of hierarchical sphere trees. It searches over five degrees of freedom on a GPU within a CMA-ES framework, with the vertical coordinate grounded analytically against the current heightmap. During execution, a force-monitored vertical descent stops on first contact. A post-release consolidation push then closes the residual lateral clearance that gripper-aware planning leaves behind. The container is re-perceived between placements so that drift does not accumulate. We validate the system on a Franka Emika Panda robot packing a 3D-printed set of flat, curved, and concave objects, and a YCB object subset. An ablation study isolates the contribution of gripper-aware optimization, the consolidation push, and mesh-derived geometry to end-to-end success, achieved density, and computational cost. We further benchmark against the heightmap-minimization method as a baseline representative of prior irregular-object packing work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套面向真实机械臂的闭环密集堆叠流水线，将感知、考虑夹爪的放置优化与力引导执行集成，在Franka Panda上实现不规则物体的自动密集装箱。
AI.motivation: 仓库作业对自动密集堆叠需求强烈，但现有不规则物体堆叠研究多局限于理想接触的仿真，将物体视为孤立刚体，夹爪仅作事后可行性检查，且未处理执行过程中的感知与接触漂移，导致难以落地于真实机器人。
AI.method: 方法为闭环流水线：优化器将物体与夹爪建模为分层球树构成的单一复合体，在GPU上以CMA-ES搜索五自由度位姿，竖直坐标依据当前高度图解析确定；执行时采用力监测垂直下降，首次接触即停止；释放后通过整理推挤消除夹爪感知规划残留的横向间隙；每次放置后重新感知容器以避免漂移累积。
AI.result: 在Franka Emika Panda上对3D打印的平面、曲面与凹面物体集合及YCB物体子集进行验证；消融实验分离了夹爪感知优化、整理推挤与网格几何对端到端成功率、达到密度和计算代价的贡献；并与高度图最小化方法作为代表性基线进行对比。
AI.conclusion: 该系统证明闭环集成感知、夹爪感知规划与力控执行可有效提升真实场景下不规则物体密集堆叠的成功率与密度，且各组件贡献可量化。

title: Duty Factor Predicts Robust Constrained Quadrupedal Locomotion Across Gait Types
summary: Quadrupedal robots are increasingly deployed in environments where locomotion must remain robust to disturbances and constrained terrain. Gait type, such as walking or trotting, is commonly used to characterize quadrupedal locomotion. However, gait type does not uniquely define locomotion, as parameters such as duty factor, speed, and stance width can vary within a single gait type. In this work, we investigate the relationship between these gait parameters using three distinct quadrupedal locomotion control approaches. First, using whole body trajectory optimization with LQR feedback, we show that duty factor is a stronger predictor of local error convergence than nominal gait type. Second, we investigate duty factor selection with a learned locomotion controller, suggesting how duty factor may serve as a low-dimensional parameter for adapting locomotion robustness in narrow-terrain environments. Finally, we show that these trends persist under a centroidal model predictive control framework and validate them through narrow-terrain experiments on a physical quadruped. These results show that duty factor provides a simple and effective basis for understanding and selecting robust quadrupedal locomotion across gait types and control architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三种不同的四足机器人运动控制方法（全身轨迹优化+LQR反馈、学习型控制器、质心模型预测控制），研究步态参数（特别是占空比）与运动鲁棒性的关系，证明占空比比名义步态类型更能预测局部误差收敛，是理解和选择鲁棒四足运动的简单有效基础。
AI.motivation: 四足机器人越来越多地应用于需要抵抗扰动和适应受限地形的环境。步态类型（如行走或小跑）通常被用来表征四足运动，但步态类型并不能唯一确定运动特性，因为占空比、速度、站立宽度等参数可在同一步态类型内变化。因此需要探究这些步态参数之间的关系，寻找更有效的鲁棒性表征指标。
AI.method: 采用三种不同的四足运动控制方法：(1) 全身轨迹优化结合LQR反馈控制；(2) 学习型运动控制器，研究占空比选择；(3) 质心模型预测控制（centroidal MPC）框架。并在物理四足机器人上进行窄地形实验验证。
AI.result: 在三种控制方法中均发现一致趋势：占空比是比名义步态类型更强的局部误差收敛预测因子；占空比可作为适应窄地形环境中运动鲁棒性的低维参数；质心MPC框架下趋势依然成立，并通过物理四足机器人窄地形实验得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 占空比为理解和选择跨步态类型、跨控制架构的鲁棒四足运动提供了简单而有效的基础。

title: LIMBO: Learning and Internalizing Model-Free Barrier Objectives for Agile and Safe Whole-Body Control
summary: Safe whole-body control requires coordinating collision avoidance and balance under high-dimensional, nonlinear dynamics--making safety certificates difficult to design and reuse across behaviors. We present LIMBO, a framework for synthesizing a state-action control barrier function and distilling its safety structure into a task policy. LIMBO learns the safety certificate from black-box transitions and a state-based failure specification over residual actions around a frozen base controller, making Q-CBF synthesis tractable in the full control dimension while placing the certificate in the task policy's control space. During synthesis, the learned safety value drives risk-guided sampling near the estimated boundary of recoverability; during task learning, it serves as a teacher that provides action-level safety feedback, yielding a robust task policy and alleviating the need for an online safety filter at deployment. We demonstrate LIMBO on a 29-degree-of-freedom humanoid performing dodgeball avoidance and locomotion beneath low obstacles. Beyond scaling learned Q-CBFs to whole-body control, we show that risk-guided boundary sampling provides a theoretically grounded way to explore the edge of recoverability. Under the same safety specification, ceteris paribus, varying the sampling concentration produces strategies ranging from crouching to a novel backward-leaning limbo maneuver. In both settings, the learned policies transfer to hardware without online safety filtering, showing that learned safety synthesis scales to agile whole-body control.

AI.tldr: LIMBO 从黑盒转移与失败规范中学习状态-动作 Q-CBF，并将其蒸馏进任务策略，在29自由度人形机器人上实现无在线安全滤波器的全身敏捷控制。
AI.motivation: 全身控制需在高维非线性动力学下同时协调避障与平衡，安全证书难以设计与跨行为复用；而 Q-CBF 在完整控制维度上合成通常不可行。
AI.method: 在冻结基控制器周围的残差动作空间上，利用黑盒转移和基于状态的失败规范学习状态-动作控制屏障函数（Q-CBF）；合成时用学到的安全价值驱动风险引导采样，聚焦于可恢复性边界附近；任务学习阶段将其作为教师提供动作级安全反馈。
AI.result: 在29自由度人形机器人上完成躲避球规避与低矮障碍下行走；在相同安全规范下改变采样集中度，可产生从下蹲到后仰 limbo 式动作的不同策略；策略无需在线安全滤波即可迁移到硬件。
AI.conclusion: 学习型安全综合可扩展到敏捷全身控制，风险引导边界采样为探索可恢复性边缘提供了有理论依据的方法。

title: SeeQ: Training Generalist Value Functions for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
summary: Despite rapid progress, generalist robot policies remain brittle on complex, long-horizon tasks that comprise multiple stages or require repeated attempts and deliberation on the same underlying stage before success. Q-value functions can improve these policies by ranking candidate actions or guiding policy improvement, but learning from sparse task-level rewards entails long credit-assignment horizons, difficult Bellman backups, and broad data-coverage requirements. We introduce SeeQ (Subtask-elicited Q-functions), which instead learns Q-values for the currently active subtask. This shortens the value-prediction horizon and enables effective learning with temporal-difference (TD) objectives. During training, subtask-level annotations present in offline robot data provide the decomposition and enable learning from broad, potentially suboptimal robot datasets. To eliminate the need for human annotations or modular subtask prediction systems at test time, our Q-function architecture is trained to autoregressively predict the active subtask in natural language before estimating its value. We instantiate SeeQ using a base vision-language backbone, pretrain it on diverse open-source robot manipulation data, and finetune it on downstream tasks. Across four real-world manipulation tasks on two bimanual robot platforms, the SeeQ value function substantially improves best-of-N policy steering.

AI.tldr: SeeQ提出为当前活跃子任务学习Q值函数，将长时程信用分配缩短为子任务级，并通过自回归预测自然语言子任务实现无需人工标注的测试，在真实双臂机器人任务上显著提升策略引导效果。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人策略在复杂长时程任务上表现脆弱：这类任务包含多个阶段，或需在同一子阶段反复尝试与推理。Q值函数可通过排序候选动作或引导策略改进来缓解该问题，但从稀疏任务级奖励学习面临信用分配时程长、Bellman备份困难、数据覆盖要求高等挑战。
AI.method: 提出SeeQ（Subtask-elicited Q-functions），为当前活跃子任务学习Q值，从而缩短价值预测时程并可用时序差分（TD）目标有效学习。训练时利用离线机器人数据中的子任务级标注提供分解，支持从广泛且可能次优的数据中学习。为免除测试时的人工标注或模块化子任务预测系统，Q函数架构被训练为先以自然语言自回归预测活跃子任务，再估计其价值。基于视觉-语言骨干实例化，在多样开源机器人操作数据上预训练，并在下游任务上微调。
AI.result: 在两个双臂机器人平台的四个真实世界操作任务上，SeeQ价值函数显著提升了best-of-N策略引导的效果。
AI.conclusion: 为子任务而非整任务学习Q值可有效缩短信用分配时程，结合自回归子任务语言预测可去除测试时的人工标注依赖，为长时程机器人操作提供有效的价值引导方案。

title: AnyviewMeter: Adapting Robotic Reward Models with Camera Geometry and Multi-View Attention
summary: Robotic reward models evaluate task execution from visual observations, but their predictions can change with camera viewpoint and occlusion even when the underlying task state is unchanged. Adapting a pretrained reward model to a local task therefore requires accounting for how that task is observed. We introduce AnyviewMeter, a geometry-conditioned adaptation framework for robotic reward models that represent task progress as a scalar reward signal. It combines low-rank fine-tuning with token-aligned Plucker rays and synchronous block attention: ray conditioning incorporates camera geometry into visual features and attention queries and keys, while block attention fuses synchronized views inside the pretrained decoder. The framework supports both single-view reward prediction and joint multi-view evaluation through parameter-efficient adaptation of a pretrained Robometer model. On PickCube, single-view adaptation improves progress prediction in every camera group and reduces mean absolute error under a changed field of view by approximately 21% relative to RGB fine-tuning. Across simulated manipulation tasks, joint multi-view prediction reduces progress error by 41-69% compared with averaging single-view RGB predictions and improves temporal ordering in approximately 88% of task-camera groups. On real tasks with fixed and wrist-mounted cameras, mean absolute error decreases by approximately 21% relative to averaged RGB fine-tuning. These results support camera geometry and joint visual evidence as useful components of task-specific robotic reward adaptation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出AnyviewMeter，一个几何条件化的机器人奖励模型适配框架，通过将相机几何（Plücker射线）与同步块注意力结合低秩微调，实现单视图与多视图奖励预测，在仿真与真实任务中显著降低进度预测误差。
AI.motivation: 机器人奖励模型从视觉观测评估任务执行，但其预测会随相机视角和遮挡变化而改变，即便任务状态本身未变。因此，将预训练奖励模型适配到特定任务时，必须考虑该任务的观测方式（相机几何）。
AI.method: 提出AnyviewMeter，将任务进度表示为标量奖励信号；结合低秩微调（LoRA）与令牌对齐的Plücker射线及同步块注意力：射线条件将相机几何注入视觉特征以及注意力的查询与键，块注意力则在预训练解码器内融合同步视图。框架支持单视图奖励预测与联合多视图评估，通过参数高效方式适配预训练的Robometer模型。
AI.result: 在PickCube上，单视图适配在每个相机组均提升进度预测，视场变化下MAE相比RGB微调降低约21%。在仿真操作任务中，联合多视图预测相比平均单视图RGB预测降低进度误差41-69%，并在约88%的任务-相机组中改善时间排序。在固定相机与腕部相机的真实任务中，MAE相比平均RGB微调降低约21%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，相机几何与联合视觉证据是任务特定机器人奖励适配的有效组成部分。

title: Do small language models know what they don't know?
summary: We explore whether entropy-based confidence signals can be leveraged to improve the accuracy of Small Language Models (SLMs) with fewer than 3 billion parameters, running entirely on consumer hardware. We evaluate seven distinct approaches, including token-level entropy early stopping, semantic entropy estimation, and uncertainty-aware routing to larger expert models, across 7 model pairs and 5 standard NLU benchmarks. Our key finding is that token-level entropy is effectively blind in SLMs: in 91% of dataset-model combinations, mean token entropy is near zero regardless of answer correctness, rendering token-based confidence signals unusable at this scale. We demonstrate that semantic entropy, computed by generating multiple samples, clustering answers by meaning, and measuring distributional uncertainty, recovers a viable confidence signal. Using semantic entropy to selectively route uncertain queries to a larger expert model yields accuracy improvements of up to +50 percentage points. Notably, cross-family routing (e.g., SmolLM 360M to Phi-3.5-mini) averages +22.0% improvement compared to +6.8% for same-family routing, revealing that expert model quality matters more than architectural compatibility. Our results suggest that the value proposition for entropy-based methods in SLMs is not computational savings but intelligent compute allocation: spending more tokens where they matter most.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究基于熵的置信信号能否提升3B以下参数的小语言模型（SLM）准确率。结论是词元级熵在SLM中近乎失效（91%的组合均值近零），而语义熵可恢复有效置信信号，并用于不确定性感知路由，跨家族路由平均提升+22.0%，最高可达+50个百分点。
AI.motivation: SLM可在消费级硬件本地运行，但准确率有限；现有基于熵的置信估计多针对大模型，其在SLM规模下的有效性未知。作者希望明确熵类置信信号在SLM中的可用性，并探索以更低成本提升SLM准确率的途径（如按需调用更大专家模型）。
AI.method: 在7组模型对（含SmolLM 360M、Phi-3.5-mini等）与5个标准NLU基准上系统评估7种方法：词元级熵早停、语义熵估计、不确定性感知路由至更大专家模型等。语义熵通过多次采样生成、按语义聚类答案、度量分布不确定性计算；据此将高不确定查询路由给更大专家模型。
AI.result: 词元级熵在SLM中近乎失效：91%的数据集-模型组合中平均词元熵接近零且与答案正确性无关。语义熵可恢复可行置信信号。基于语义熵的选择性路由最高带来+50个百分点准确率提升；跨家族路由平均提升+22.0%，显著优于同家族路由的+6.8%。
AI.conclusion: 在SLM中，熵类方法的核心价值不是计算节省，而是智能算力分配：把更多词元预算花在最需要的地方。专家模型质量比架构兼容性更重要；语义熵比词元级熵更适合作为SLM的不确定性度量与路由依据。

title: From Discharge Notes to Patient Understanding: Persona-Grounded, Open-Ended Simulation of LLMs as Discharge Educators
summary: Hospital discharge education is an interactive teaching task: a clinician adapts a discharge plan to a patient's literacy, recall, and personality. Existing LLM evaluations target static or artifact-generation tasks and do not measure patient understanding under open-ended dialogue. We introduce DischargeBench, a persona-grounded simulation in which a candidate LLM educator conducts a multi-turn session with a Virtual Patient, while an Education Monitor Agent regulates patient realism without modifying the educator, protecting the evaluation signal. We curate MIMIC-IV-Ext-DischargeBench, 477 cases over 24 ICD chapters with persona axes (personality, education level, health literacy, past-medical-history recall) for stratified analysis. Each simulation is scored on four axes -- Conversation Quality, Topic Checklist, Comprehension, and Factual Consistency -- by an LLM-as-a-Judge aligned against physician annotations. Across closed- and open-source LLMs, aggregate scores conceal clinically relevant variation across ICD chapters and patient personas; difficult personas expose coverage failures, comprehension gaps, and reduced source-answer agreement. LLM evaluation for discharge education should center patient understanding, not text quality or answer accuracy alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DischargeBench，一个基于人格设定的多轮对话仿真基准，用于评估 LLM 在医院出院教育中提升患者理解的能力，并构建了包含 477 个病例的数据集 MIMIC-IV-Ext-DischargeBench。
AI.motivation: 出院教育是互动式教学任务，医生需根据患者的识字水平、记忆能力与人格特征调整出院计划；但现有 LLM 评测多针对静态任务或文本生成任务，无法在开放式对话中衡量患者理解程度，导致评测与实际临床教学目标脱节。
AI.method: 提出 DischargeBench：候选 LLM 教育者与虚拟患者进行多轮会话，教育监测智能体（Education Monitor Agent）在修改教育者的前提下调节患者真实感以保护评估信号；整理 MIMIC-IV-Ext-DischargeBench，含 24 个 ICD 章节的 477 个病例，并设置人格、教育水平、健康素养、病史回忆等人格轴用于分层分析；每次模拟由经医生标注对齐的 LLM-as-a-Judge 从对话质量、主题清单、理解度、事实一致性四个维度打分。
AI.result: 在闭源与开源 LLM 上，总体分数掩盖了跨 ICD 章节与患者人格的临床相关差异；困难人格暴露出覆盖失败、理解缺口以及源答案一致性下降的问题。
AI.conclusion: 面向出院教育的 LLM 评测应以患者理解为核心，而不能仅关注文本质量或答案准确性；总体聚合指标会掩盖重要差异，需按章节与人格分层评估。

title: SAGE: Schema-Guided LLMs for Grant Review
summary: Grant reviewers must apply detailed criteria to application forms, budgets, and supporting documents while producing assessments that colleagues can inspect. We present SAGE, Schema-Guided Aspect-Based Grant Evaluation, a system that translates a grant rubric into structured checks and links its judgements to evidence from the application package. We evaluate SAGE in two stages on 35 nonprofit grant applications. A post-factum comparison with 105 reviews from the original competition shows fair ordinal agreement (kappa = 0.29). The foundation then conducted a criterion-level re-review after inspecting SAGE, producing 202 assessments. In this assisted round, SAGE reached kappa = 0.58 and outperformed a one-prompt-per-criterion baseline (kappa = 0.33 on the common subset), with higher rank correlation and lower error. A claim-level audit further identifies confirmed, disputed, and unaddressed parts of the structured draft. SAGE operationalizes the review methodology by producing a detailed, evidence-linked, and auditable draft for expert correction.

AI.tldr: SAGE 将资助评审标准转化为结构化检查项，并把评审判断链接到申请材料中的证据，在35份非营利资助申请上进行两阶段评估，辅助评审时与专家评分一致性显著提升（kappa 0.58），并提供可审计的证据溯源。
AI.motivation: 资助评审人需依据细化标准审阅申请书、预算及支撑材料，并产出可供同行核查的评估意见。此过程工作量大、标准执行不一，现有自动化方法难以将 rubric 落地为可核查的判断。作者希望构建一个能操作化评审方法、产出证据链接且可审计草稿的系统，供专家修正。
AI.method: 提出 SAGE（Schema-Guided Aspect-Based Grant Evaluation）：将资助 rubric 翻译为结构化检查项（schema-guided checks），并基于 aspect-based 方式，把每项判断链接到申请包中的证据。评估分两阶段，共35份非营利资助申请。阶段一：与原始竞赛的105份评审进行事后比较。阶段二：基金会在查看 SAGE 后开展 criterion-level 复审，产生202份评估，并与 one-prompt-per-criterion 基线对比。另做 claim-level 审计，区分结构化草稿中被确认、有争议和未涉及的部分。
AI.result: 阶段一事后比较达到 fair ordinal agreement（kappa = 0.29）。阶段二辅助评审中，SAGE 达到 kappa = 0.58，优于 one-prompt-per-criterion 基线（共同子集 kappa = 0.33），且排序相关性更高、误差更低。claim-level 审计可识别结构化草稿中被确认、有争议和未涉及的论断部分。
AI.conclusion: SAGE 通过生成详细、证据链接且可审计的评审草稿，将评审方法论操作化，服务于专家修正流程；在专家辅助场景下显著提升与人类评审的一致性，并具备可追溯的证据审计能力。

title: Reviser: Revision-Capable Text Generation via Autoregressive Cursor Actions
summary: Revision-capable generation is appealing because it can insert or revise earlier content, but many non-autoregressive and edit-based approaches obtain this flexibility through repeated sequence-level computation. We propose Reviser, a decoder-only Transformer that generates a response as a sequence of cursor-relative actions on a mutable canvas. At each step, Reviser predicts exactly one action token: INSERT(token), MOVE($Δ$), or STOP, and is autoregressive over edit-history actions rather than final text order. This design enables genuinely non-monotonic generation while preserving a simple next-action interface. On a continuation benchmark, Reviser is strongly preferred to SEDD and MDLM in our arena evaluations, and trajectory statistics confirm that the model performs frequent backward moves and mid-canvas insertions rather than merely emulating end-append decoding. Against size-matched autoregressive baselines, Reviser is competitive at both the 100M and 300M scales. Under our shared FLOPs convention, Reviser also requires substantially less inference compute than representative multi-pass refinement and diffusion-style baselines.

AI.tldr: Reviser 是一种仅解码器 Transformer，将文本生成建模为在可变画布上的光标相对动作序列（INSERT/MOVE/STOP），实现对编辑历史的下一动作自回归，从而在不进行重复序列级计算的情况下实现真正的非单调生成。
AI.motivation: 具备修订能力的生成很有吸引力，因为可以插入或修改先前内容，但许多非自回归与基于编辑的方法需要通过反复的序列级计算才能获得这种灵活性。因此作者希望在保留简单下一动作接口的同时实现真正的非单调生成，并降低推理计算量。
AI.method: 提出 Reviser：一个仅解码器 Transformer，将响应生成为可变画布上的一系列光标相对动作。每一步只预测一个动作 token：INSERT(token)、MOVE(Δ) 或 STOP；模型自回归的对象是编辑历史动作而非最终文本顺序。
AI.result: 在续写基准上，Reviser 在竞技场评估中显著优于 SEDD 和 MDLM；轨迹统计确认模型频繁进行向后移动与画布中部插入，而非仅模拟末尾追加式解码。与规模匹配的自回归基线相比，Reviser 在 100M 与 300M 规模上均具竞争力；在统一 FLOPs 约定下，其推理计算量显著低于代表性的多轮精修与扩散式基线。
AI.conclusion: Reviser 通过光标相对动作序列建模实现了真正的非单调生成与修订能力，同时保持简单的下一动作接口，并在质量与推理效率上展现出优势。

title: TatBLiMP: A Benchmark of Linguistic Minimal Pairs for Tatar
summary: We introduce TatBLiMP, the first benchmark of linguistic minimal pairs for Tatar (tt, ISO 639-3 tat), a Qypchaq Turkic language written in Cyrillic. To our knowledge it is the first grammaticality evaluation for Tatar language models of any kind, since even the 101-language MultiBLiMP does not include Tatar. TatBLiMP covers 16 morphosyntactic phenomena in 1248 sentence pairs. Each pair differs by a single morpheme, one grammatical and one ungrammatical. A model passes a pair when it assigns higher probability to the grammatical member. Scoring compares probabilities the model already assigns, so the benchmark needs no text generation and no parser, and it runs on base models and on mid-training checkpoints. TatBLiMP adapts the phenomenon inventory and single-morpheme breaking operations of TurBLiMP to Tatar and adds one phenomenon specific to Tatar, bare-noun number after numerals and quantifiers. The grammatical member of every pair is an attested sentence from Tatar literary prose. The ungrammatical member is produced by a deterministic single-morpheme perturbation with the apertium-tat transducer. Every pair is ratified by a native speaker. A plausibility principle governs construction, so the ungrammatical member is a plausible real-world error rather than an arbitrary corruption. Across from-scratch Tatar models, cross-lingual adaptations, and frontier multilingual LLMs, the benchmark tracks focused Tatar training rather than parameter scale. A 478M from-scratch model and a 125M monolingual model lead near 0.97, a 7B adaptation trails, frontier LLMs of 30-120B parameters fall to 0.80-0.92, and a lightly tuned multilingual model is weakest. We close with the benchmark's main limitation. Its inherited taxonomy omits the morphophonology, vowel harmony and consonant assimilation, that is most salient to native speakers, and we sketch a native second layer that would add it.

AI.tldr: TatBLiMP 是首个针对鞑靼语（Qypchaq 突厥语族，西里尔文）的语言学最小对立对基准，含 16 类形态句法现象、1248 对句子，仅通过模型已有概率评分（无需生成、无需句法分析器）。实验表明基准性能主要反映针对鞑靼语的定向训练程度，而非参数规模。
AI.motivation: 鞑靼语此前缺乏任何语法性评测资源，甚至 101 语种的 MultiBLiMP 也未涵盖该语言，因此需要构建专门的最小对立对基准以评估语言模型的鞑靼语语法知识。
AI.method: 将 TurBLiMP 的现象清单与单语素破坏操作迁移至鞑靼语，并新增一条鞑靼语特有现象（数词/量词后光杆名词的数）。每对仅差一个语素，语法句取自鞑靼语文学散文真实语料，非语法句由 apertium-tat 转换器确定性单语素扰动生成；每对均经母语者审核，并遵循合理性原则使非语法句为可信的真实错误。
AI.result: 在从头训练的鞑靼语模型、跨语言适配模型与前沿多语种大模型上，基准反映的是鞑靼语定向训练而非参数规模：478M 从头训练模型与 125M 单语模型接近 0.97，7B 适配模型落后，30–120B 前沿大模型仅 0.80–0.92，轻度微调的多语模型最弱。模型通过一对的标准是对语法成员赋予更高概率。
AI.conclusion: TatBLiMP 提供了首个鞑靼语语法性评测，证明小规模定向训练可优于大规模通用模型。主要局限在于沿用的分类体系遗漏了母语者最敏感的形态音系现象（元音和谐与辅音同化），作者据此提出构建本土化第二层评测的设想。

title: Transsion's Speaker-Attributed Multilingual ASR System for the MLC-SLM 2026 Challenge
summary: This paper presents the Transsion Speech Team submission to Task 1 of the MLC-SLM 2026 Challenge, which focuses on speaker-attributed transcription for multilingual conversational speech. We propose a cascaded framework consisting of three components: a speaker diarization module, a long-form multilingual ASR module, and a speaker-transcription fusion module.
