The diarization module is built upon DiariZen and produces speaker-homogeneous segments through local speaker activity estimation and global speaker clustering. The ASR module is based on Qwen3-Omni and generates multilingual transcriptions, while an external CTC-based alignment model provides precise word- and character-level timestamps. Finally, the fusion module combines diarization outputs with timestamped transcriptions to generate speaker-attributed STM outputs. Experimental results on the official evaluation set demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. The submitted system achieves a tcpMER of 15.41% and ranks second among all participating teams.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 Transsion 语音团队参加 MLC-SLM 2026 挑战赛 Task 1 的方案，提出由说话人日志、长音频多语种 ASR 和说话人-转写融合三模块构成的级联框架，在官方评测集上取得 tcpMER 15.41%、排名第二的成绩。
AI.motivation: 任务目标为多语种对话语音的"说话人属性转写"（speaker-attributed transcription），即在多语种、长时对话场景下同时完成说话人分离与内容转写，并将二者对齐输出结构化结果。该任务需要解决长音频建模、多语种识别以及时间戳精度等问题，因此需要设计一个能够协同日志与识别能力的系统框架。
AI.method: 采用三级级联框架：（1）说话人日志模块基于 DiariZen，通过局部说话人活动估计与全局说话人聚类生成说话人同质片段；（2）长音频多语种 ASR 模块基于 Qwen3-Omni 生成多语种转写，并借助外部 CTC 对齐模型提供精确的词级/字符级时间戳；（3）融合模块将日志输出与带时间戳的转写结果结合，生成带说话人属性的 STM 格式输出。
AI.result: 在官方评测集上的实验验证了所提框架的有效性，提交系统取得 tcpMER 15.41%，在全部参赛队伍中排名第二。
AI.conclusion: 级联式"日志-ASR-融合"方案可有效应对多语种对话语音的说话人属性转写任务，并在官方评测中达到具有竞争力的性能水平。

title: Towards Secure Cloud-Native Computing: Unveiling Kubernetes Misconfigurations with Large Language Models
summary: In the rapidly evolving landscape of cloud-native computing, Organizations are increasingly adopting infrastructure models that emphasize scalability, flexibility, and efficiency. Kubernetes has become the de facto standard for orchestrating containerized applications in these environments. However, the inherent complexity of cloud-native ecosystems introduces significant challenges, particularly in the form of misconfigurations that can compromise both security and performance. This study explores the potential of Large Language Models (LLMs) in identifying Kubernetes misconfigurations. We introduce a comprehensive taxonomy of common misconfiguration types, offering a structured framework to better understand and categorize these issues. Additionally, we conduct an empirical evaluation of state-of-the-art detection tools to benchmark their effectiveness. Furthermore, we analyze the Kubernetes objects most prone to misconfiguration and evaluate the severity of the identified issues. By leveraging advanced machine learning techniques, including LLMs, we provide novel insights into enhancing misconfiguration detection methodologies.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨利用大语言模型（LLM）识别 Kubernetes 配置错误，构建了常见错误配置分类体系，并对现有检测工具进行实证评估，同时分析了易出错对象及问题严重性。
AI.motivation: 云原生生态日益普及，Kubernetes 成为容器编排事实标准，但其复杂性导致配置错误频发，威胁安全与性能。现有检测手段存在不足，亟需探索 LLM 等先进方法提升检测能力。
AI.method: 引入常见错误配置类型分类体系；对当前最先进的检测工具进行实证评估与基准测试；分析最易发生配置错误的 Kubernetes 对象并评估问题严重程度；借助包括 LLM 在内的先进机器学习技术开展研究。
AI.result: 建立了结构化的配置错误分类框架；对主流检测工具的有效性完成基准对比；识别出高风险的 Kubernetes 对象类型并量化了所发现问题的严重性。
AI.conclusion: 利用 LLM 等先进机器学习技术可为改进 Kubernetes 配置错误检测方法提供新思路，有助于提升云原生环境的安全性与性能。

title: A Generative Grammar Underlying the Voynich Manuscript, the Pastiche Hypothesis: Evidence from Large Language Models
summary:
Background: The Voynich Manuscript is a fifteenth-century codex written in an unknown script whose content remains undeciphered. Previous studies suggest that its statistical properties resemble those of natural languages, while its illustrations - primarily plants - recall medieval herbals.
  Methods: We present a multidisciplinary analysis combining probabilistic modeling, phonetic decomposition, rare-event detection, and multimodal image analysis, based on a newly transliterated corpus. Word- and letter-level distributions are modeled using position-dependent probabilistic grammars, while phonetic patterns are compared across Indo-European, Semitic, and Asian languages. Image-text alignment methods based on large language models are applied to identify potential botanical correspondences.
  Results: The results indicate that Voynich symbols behave as letters rather than syllabic units, while word-length distributions resemble syllabic structures. Phonetic analyses show closer alignment with consonant-heavy languages such as Hebrew or Arabic than with Indo-European languages. Probabilistic modeling reproduces Zipf-like distributions and reveals extremely low probabilities for repeated initial-letter sequences, indicating a structured imitation of natural language. Image analysis suggests strong correspondences between Voynich plant illustrations and those found in Pseudo-Apuleius herbals from the Mediterranean tradition, consistent with an imitation of medieval medicinal books.
  Perspectives: These findings support the hypothesis that the Voynich Manuscript follows a structured generative system combining linguistic regularities and herbal knowledge, and demonstrate the value of integrating probabilistic and AI-assisted approaches in the analysis of historical manuscripts.

AI.tldr: 该论文对15世纪伏尼契手稿进行多学科综合分析，结合概率建模、语音分解、稀有事件检测与多模态图像分析，认为其符号为字母级单元、语音特征近闪语系，植物插图与地中海Pseudo-Apuleius草药书高度对应，支持"结构化生成系统"假说。
AI.motivation: 伏尼契手稿书写系统未被破译，既有研究仅指出其统计性质类似自然语言、插图类似中世纪草药书，缺乏系统性、跨学科的定量验证。作者希望检验其究竟为自然语言、编码语言还是结构化仿造，并探索概率方法与AI辅助方法在历史手稿分析中的价值。
AI.method: 基于新转写语料库：(1)用位置依赖的概率文法建模词级与字母级分布；(2)进行语音分解，将语音模式与印欧语、闪语及亚洲语言比较；(3)采用稀有事件检测分析重复首字母序列的概率；(4)应用基于大语言模型的图文对齐方法识别植物学对应关系。整体为概率建模、语音分析与多模态图像分析的结合。
AI.result: 伏尼契符号表现为字母而非音节单元，但词长分布类似音节结构；语音上与希伯来语、阿拉伯语等辅音密集语言更接近，而非印欧语；概率模型可复现类Zipf分布，并显示重复首字母序列概率极低，说明是对自然语言的结构化模仿；图像分析显示其植物插图与地中海传统的Pseudo-Apuleius草药书插图高度对应，符合对中世纪医书的模仿。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持伏尼契手稿遵循一种结合语言规律与草药知识的结构化生成系统这一假说，并证明将概率建模与AI辅助方法整合用于历史手稿分析具有重要价值。

title: From Generation to Detection: Exploration of Discourse Driven Scenario based LLM Generated Fake News
summary: In this study, we examine how modern LLMs generate and detect fake news under controlled settings across four manipulation scenarios. These are open-ended generation, rewriting, manipulation prompts and attribute based prompts grounded in the journalistic discourse framework. Firstly, using seven widely adapted models, we created a synthetic fake news corpus with 14000 generated articles across these four scenarios. Then we analyzed its linguistic properties to assess how closely model-generated news resembles real news structurally and semantically. Finally, to evaluate detection performance, we conducted experiments where each model judges generated fake news, starting with a basic detection prompt and improved prompts developed through an iterative refinement process that extracts misleading patterns from real-fake pairs. Our results revealed substantial variation across models in both generating and detecting misinformation, demonstrated that the generation strategy strongly influences detectability, and show that the refined prompt does not improve and often harms detection performance. Therefore, the study provides a systematic assessment of LLMs detection capability of LLMs generated fake news across typical generation scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了主流大语言模型在四种操纵场景下生成与检测假新闻的能力：构建14000篇合成假新闻语料，分析其语言特征，并测试检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对LLM生成假新闻与检测能力在多种典型生成场景下的系统性对比评估，尤其缺少生成策略对可检测性影响的量化分析。
AI.method: 采用七个广泛使用的LLM，围绕开放式生成、改写、操纵提示和基于新闻话语框架的属性提示四种场景，生成14000篇假新闻构成语料；分析其结构与语义层面的语言属性；再以基础检测提示和通过真实-虚假配对迭代提炼误导模式得到的改进提示进行检测实验。
AI.result: 不同模型在生成与检测虚假信息方面差异显著；生成策略强烈影响可检测性；迭代改进提示并未提升检测性能，反而常导致性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了跨典型生成场景的LLM生成假新闻检测能力系统评估，揭示了模型间差异及生成策略对检测难度的关键作用。

title: COAL-SQL: Coverage-Guided Augmentation and Failure-Driven Learning for Text-to-SQL Post-Training
summary: Text-to-SQL translates natural-language questions into executable SQL queries, but open-source large language models still require task-specific post-training for complex, real-world SQL generation. Effective post-training requires both training data that cover the capabilities demanded by the target task and a learning strategy that enables the model to acquire them. Existing datasets provide valuable supervision but incompletely cover SQL structures, while augmentation methods typically expand data without identifying structural gaps. Moreover, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or reinforcement learning (RL) alone cannot dynamically address weaknesses exposed during training. We propose COAL-SQL, a unified framework combining Coverage-Guided Augmentation (CGA) and Failure-Driven Learning (FDL). CGA uses greedy selection to identify SQL structures missing from the original dataset and constructs complementary examples, improving structural coverage. FDL retains GRPO as the main optimization objective while supplying targeted supervision for unsolved examples. At the step level, it applies SFT to verified reasoning traces generated by a strong LLM for accumulated failures. At the epoch level, it retrieves structurally related examples based on accumulated failures to create targeted practice, helping the model acquire the corresponding SQL capabilities. With only 12,600 distinct post-training examples, COAL-SQL achieves 64.9% execution accuracy on the BIRD development set and outperforms baselines trained at comparable scale. The code is available at https://github.com/TechNomad-ds/COAL-SQL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COAL-SQL框架，通过覆盖引导增强（CGA）与失败驱动学习（FDL）相结合，用较少数据提升开源大模型复杂Text-to-SQL生成能力。
AI.motivation: 开源大模型在复杂真实场景Text-to-SQL生成中仍需任务特定的后训练。有效后训练需要两要素：覆盖目标任务所需能力的训练数据，以及能使模型习得这些能力的学习策略。现有数据集虽提供监督，但对SQL结构的覆盖不完整；增强方法通常只扩充数据而不识别结构缺口；且单纯SFT或RL无法动态应对训练中暴露的弱点。
AI.method: 提出统一框架COAL-SQL，包含两部分：(1) Coverage-Guided Augmentation (CGA)，用贪心选择识别原始数据集中缺失的SQL结构并构造互补样本，提升结构覆盖；(2) Failure-Driven Learning (FDL)，以GRPO为主要优化目标，同时为未解决样本提供定向监督——步级层面，对累积失败样本由强LLM生成并验证推理轨迹后施加SFT；轮级层面，基于累积失败检索结构相关样本构造针对性练习，帮助模型习得相应SQL能力。
AI.result: 仅用12,600条不同的后训练样本，COAL-SQL在BIRD开发集上达到64.9%的执行准确率，并优于同等规模训练的基线方法。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: COAL-SQL通过将结构覆盖增强与失败驱动学习统一，在数据规模较小的条件下有效提升开源大模型的复杂Text-to-SQL生成性能，验证了覆盖与动态学习策略结合的有效性。

title: Boosting Deepresearch and LongContext Ability with Self-Generated Deepresearch Rollouts Traces
summary: Deepresearch (DR) agents interact with real-world web environments through multi-turn search and visit, causing their contexts to grow rapidly over time. We observe that, even after DR Agentic Reinforcement Learning (DR-RL), 61.6% of the model's remaining prediction errors can still be attributed to insufficient long-context understanding, including longcontext hallucination and failures in cross-document evidence integration. It motivates us to further break the bottleneck of DR-RL by strengthening the model's long-context ability. However, effective LongContext training requires more than simply increasing context length. To bridge the data gap, we propose `DR Rollouts to LongContext-QA (DR-to-Long)'. The method repurposes DR-RL trajectories, which naturally contain search histories, visited webpages, evidence snippets, and final-answer supervision. It then replaces the compact snippets and webpage summaries in each trajectory with the full contents of their corresponding URLs, producing substantially longer multi-document contexts while preserving the original evidence relationships. Building on DR-to-Long, we introduce DLD (DR -> LongQA -> DR)-RL. DLD-RL first performs a short DR-RL stage to collect rollout trajectories, which are then converted into LongQA instances at zero annotation cost. The model is subsequently optimized with LongQA-RL to strengthen LongContext ability, followed by full DR-RL to continue improving its DR capability. Experiments show that DLD-RL outperforms standard DR-RL by 7.3% on three Deepresearch benchmarks and improves performance by 13.5% on three long-context benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文针对DeepResearch智能体因长上下文理解不足导致的预测错误，提出DR-to-Long数据构造方法及DLD-RL三阶段训练框架，以零标注成本提升长上下文与DR能力。
AI.motivation: DR智能体通过多轮搜索与网页访问与真实网络环境交互，上下文随时间快速膨胀。作者观察发现，即便经过DR-RL训练，仍有61.6%的剩余预测错误可归因于长上下文理解不足，具体表现为长上下文幻觉与跨文档证据整合失败。因此需要突破DR-RL瓶颈，强化模型的长上下文能力。而有效的长上下文训练并非简单增加上下文长度即可，还面临数据缺口问题。
AI.method: 提出DR-to-Long数据构造方法：复用DR-RL轨迹（天然包含搜索历史、访问网页、证据片段与最终答案监督），将轨迹中紧凑的证据片段与网页摘要替换为对应URL的完整正文，从而在保留原始证据关系的前提下生成显著更长的多文档上下文，且零标注成本。基于此构建DLD-RL三阶段流程：先进行短程DR-RL收集rollout轨迹并转换为LongQA样本；再用LongQA-RL优化模型以增强长上下文能力；最后进行完整DR-RL继续提升DR能力。
AI.result: 在三个Deepresearch基准上，DLD-RL相较标准DR-RL提升7.3%；在三个长上下文基准上性能提升13.5%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将DR-RL轨迹重利用为长上下文QA数据并进行分阶段强化学习，可有效缓解长上下文理解瓶颈，同时提升DR任务与长上下文任务表现，且无需额外标注成本。

title: Reading Anxiety or Reading the Label? Comparing Fine-Tuned and Frontier Models for Anxiety Detection on Social Media
summary: Anxiety is among the most common mental health conditions, and people often write about it online well before seeking clinical help. Practitioners building detection tools face a concrete choice: call a frontier commercial model, fine-tune a smaller model in-house, or deploy a conventional classifier. We compare six conditions spanning all three on a held-out Reddit test set under a single controlled protocol. We also identify a confound in how this task is evaluated. In the corpus used here, 69.3% of anxiety-labelled posts contain the word "anxiety" or a variant, roughly twice the rate of comparable conditions, so a classifier can score well by keyword matching rather than by modelling the language of the condition. We therefore evaluate every model twice, on original text and with those terms deleted, and report the difference as lexical dependence. A frontier model leads on anxiety F1 (0.846), but a 110M-parameter domain-adapted encoder reaches 0.831 with no external API dependency, and mental-health domain pretraining accounts for only 0.7 of those points. Lexical dependence spans 8.6 to 25.4 points and does not track model capability: the LoRA fine-tuned 3B model is the most keyword-dependent condition tested, above even a TF-IDF classifier, while the frontier zero-shot model is the least. Published figures on this corpus are therefore upper bounds, and the inflation is largest for the fine-tuned models such figures typically report.

AI.tldr: 该研究在统一的Reddit留出测试集上比较了六种焦虑检测方案（前沿商用模型、自建微调模型与常规分类器），并揭示评估中的词汇混淆：69.3%的焦虑标签帖子含有"anxiety"或其变体，约为对照类别两倍。作者通过删除关键词前后各评测一次来衡量"词汇依赖度"。结果表明前沿模型F1最高（0.846），但110M参数领域适配编码器达0.831且无需外部API，领域预训练仅贡献0.7分；词汇依赖度在8.6–25.4分之间且与模型能力无关，微调3B模型依赖度最高，甚至高于TF-IDF。
AI.motivation: 焦虑是最常见心理健康问题之一，用户常在求助临床前就在网上书写相关内容。构建检测工具的从业者面临具体选择：调用前沿商用模型、在本地微调较小模型，还是部署常规分类器，但缺乏在统一协议下对三类方案的系统比较。此外，该任务的评估方式可能存在混淆，需要识别并量化。
AI.method: 在留出的Reddit测试集上，于同一受控协议下比较覆盖三类方案的六种条件。识别评估混淆：语料中69.3%的焦虑标签帖子含"anxiety"或其变体，约为可比条件的两倍，分类器可凭关键词匹配而非建模病症语言获得高分。因此对每个模型进行两次评测——原始文本与删除这些词后的文本——并以两者差值作为词汇依赖度。
AI.result: 前沿模型在焦虑F1上领先（0.846），但一个110M参数的领域适配编码器达到0.831且无外部API依赖，其中心理健康领域预训练仅贡献0.7分。词汇依赖度跨度为8.6至25.4分，且不与模型能力相关：经LoRA微调的3B模型是所测条件中关键词依赖最强的，甚至高于TF-IDF分类器，而前沿零样本模型依赖度最低。
AI.conclusion: 该语料上已发表的指标应被视为上界，且这种虚高对微调模型（此类文献通常报告的对象）最为严重。选择检测方案时须注意，模型能力并不等同于对关键词捷径的鲁棒性。

title: Generative Artificial Intelligence Chatbots for Motivational Interviewing: A Scoping Review From System Design to Intervention Outcomes
summary: Motivational interviewing (MI) is a collaborative approach to elicit autonomous motivation for health behavior change. Generative AI (GenAI) offers new ways to deliver MI via conversational systems, but evidence on their design, assessment, and translation into interventions remains fragmented. This scoping review characterized evidence on GenAI-MI chatbots across system design, safety, MI quality, user perceptions, and intervention outcomes. We conducted a PRISMA-ScR scoping review. Nine datasets were searched for studies published or publicly available from January 1, 2015 to June 2, 2026 that used GenAI to generate MI chatbot responses or counselor utterances. Data were extracted using a predefined framework and synthesized descriptively. Forty-seven reports (48 studies) were included. Twenty (41.7%) focused on system design without direct participant use; 28 (58.3%) involved direct interaction. Most systems were text based and disembodied; 23 (47.9%) incorporated dynamic adaptation. Safety measures were unevenly reported. Among studies with direct use, 21/28 (75.0%) reported informed consent or user education. Thirty (62.5%) assessed MI quality, generally suggesting MI-consistent interactions. User perceptions were favorable, especially empathy, usability, helpfulness, and intention to use, though measures were heterogeneous. Eighteen (37.5%) reported intervention outcomes, mostly after a single session. Positive findings were more consistent for short-term motivation than sustained behavioral or functional change. GenAI-MI chatbots can deliver MI-consistent interactions perceived favorably, but evidence for sustained behavioral or functional change is limited. Future research should strengthen runtime safety monitoring, standardize MI quality assessment, and use longer-term comparative designs with behavioral and functional outcomes.

AI.tldr: 该范围综述（PRISMA-ScR）纳入47篇报告（48项研究），系统梳理了生成式AI驱动的动机性访谈（MI）聊天机器人在系统设计、安全性、MI质量、用户感知及干预结局方面的证据：多数系统为纯文本、无实体化设计，互动总体符合MI原则且用户评价积极，但干预结局多限于单次会话，对持续性行为与功能改变的证据有限。
AI.motivation: MI是一种通过协作方式激发健康行为改变自主动机的方法，生成式AI为以对话系统形式提供MI带来新可能，但相关系统设计、评估与干预转化的证据较为零散，缺乏系统整合，因此有必要开展范围综述以描绘研究全貌并识别证据缺口。
AI.method: 遵循PRISMA-ScR开展范围综述；检索9个数据库，纳入2015年1月1日至2026年6月2日期间发表或公开的、使用生成式AI生成MI聊天机器人回应或咨询师话语的研究；采用预定义框架提取数据并进行描述性综合。
AI.result: 共纳入47篇报告（48项研究）。20项（41.7%）聚焦系统设计而未直接让参与者使用，28项（58.3%）涉及直接交互；多数系统为纯文本、无实体化，23项（47.9%）具备动态适应能力。安全措施报告不均衡；直接使用类研究中21/28（75.0%）报告了知情同意或用户教育。30项（62.5%）评估了MI质量，总体上互动与MI原则一致。用户感知积极，尤其在共情、可用性、有帮助性和使用意愿方面，但测量工具异质性大。18项（37.5%）报告了干预结局，多为单次会话后；短期动机方面的阳性结果较一致，而持续性行为或功能改变的证据有限。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI-MI聊天机器人能够提供符合MI原则且被用户积极感知的互动，但支持持续性行为或功能改变的证据仍有限。未来研究应加强运行时安全监测、标准化MI质量评估，并采用更长期、含行为与功能结局的对照设计。

title: $μ^2$-Bench: A Multilingual Machine Unlearning Benchmark
summary: Undesired information such as harmful content and private data propagates through Multilingual Large Language Models (LLMs) via direct training and indirect cross-linguistic spread. Multilingual Machine Unlearning (MMU) aims to remove such information, yet its evaluation remains underexplored, leaving unclear whether unlearning truly eliminates target knowledge across all languages. To bridge this gap, we introduce $μ^2$-Bench, an MMU benchmark that simulates the full pipeline of memorization, unlearning, and evaluation across diverse languages. It 1) spans a broad set of languages, 2) evaluates on both training and hold-out languages, and 3) assesses knowledge as dispersed across multiple languages. We show that successful MMU requires methods that reflect multilingual characteristics, and conduct analysis to provide deeper insights into MMU.

AI.tldr: 提出 $\\mu^2$-Bench 多语言机器遗忘基准，覆盖多语言记忆—遗忘—评估全流程，揭示现有 MMU 评估不足。
AI.motivation: 多语言大模型会通过直接训练与跨语言传播扩散有害内容与隐私数据；现有多语言机器遗忘（MMU）评估不充分，无法确认目标知识是否在所有语言中被真正消除。
AI.method: 构建 $\\mu^2$-Bench 基准，模拟多语言场景下的完整流程（记忆、遗忘、评估）；其特点为：1) 覆盖广泛语言；2) 同时在训练语言与留出语言上评估；3) 将知识视为分散于多语言中加以评估；并据此开展分析。
AI.result: 实验表明，成功的 MMU 需要能够反映多语言特性的方法；分析进一步提供了对 MMU 的深入见解。
AI.conclusion: 多语言机器遗忘评估需纳入多语言特性与跨语言泛化视角，$\\mu^2$-Bench 为系统评估与后续方法设计提供基准与分析依据。

title: Scaling Forced Alignment to End-User Devices
summary: The Viterbi algorithm has been previously used to perform forced alignment of audio to text to mine training data from online resources. However, many existing implementations have quadratic time and space complexity, scaling poorly to long input sequences. We propose two optimizations to address this issue. First, we apply the Hirschberg algorithm to perform the alignment in place using linear memory. Second, we model the alignment between speech and text as a constrained random walk, allowing us to prune the search space with arbitrary confidence while accounting for transcription errors. The Hirschberg optimization reduces memory usage from 140 GB to 5 MB for three-hour inputs while producing identical alignments in one-third the time of torchaudio when both run on a CPU. We achieve an additional 2x speedup with pruning on inputs longer than 20 minutes while preserving alignment accuracy in more than 98% of tested cases.

AI.tldr: 提出两种优化将Viterbi强制对齐的复杂度从二次降为线性内存，并剪枝加速，兼顾内存、速度与准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有Viterbi强制对齐实现具有二次时间与空间复杂度，难以扩展到长输入序列，用于从在线资源挖掘训练数据时效率低下。
AI.method: 1) 将Hirschberg算法应用于对齐，实现线性内存的原地对齐；2) 将语音与文本的对齐建模为受限随机游走，从而可以任意置信度剪枝搜索空间，并兼顾转写错误。
AI.result: Hirschberg优化在三小时输入上将内存从140 GB降至5 MB，CPU上与torchaudio产生相同对齐结果且耗时为其三分之一；对超过20分钟的输入，剪枝再带来2倍加速，并在超过98%的测试用例中保持对齐准确率。
AI.conclusion: 所提优化显著降低内存占用并提升速度，同时保持对齐准确性，使长序列的强制对齐更具可行性。

title: CoLearn: An Agentic Tutor that Learns its Learner in a Human--AI Co-Learning Loop
summary: Good tutoring adapts to the individual: it tracks what a learner knows, notices why they go wrong, and asks the next question that will help most. Most deployed tutoring tools instead serve fixed item banks and treat a wrong answer as a single bit of signal. We present CoLearn, an interactive, agentic tutor that supports an iterative tutoring loop: the learner practises, and the system builds an evidence-grounded memory of the learner's mastery and misconceptions. This memory is updated as evidence accumulates and is used to generate the next personalised question. CoLearn has three components: (i) a persistent learner-state memory that updates per-topic mastery with a soft-evidence variant of Bayesian Knowledge Tracing, where a large language model acts as a continuous observation function; (ii) adaptive question generation that targets the learner's weakest topic and recurring misconceptions; and (iii) an evidence view that makes personalisation visible and testable through live progress visualisation and blind A/B comparison. In blind A/B evaluation, questions conditioned on this memory are preferred over non-personalised ones 68-69% of the time, and in persona simulations with hidden ground-truth mastery the agent's belief converges toward the learner's true mastery.

AI.tldr: CoLearn是一个交互式智能体辅导系统，通过持续更新的学习者状态记忆实现个性化出题，盲测中被偏好率68-69%。
AI.motivation: 现有辅导工具多采用固定题库，且仅将错误答案视为单一二值信号，无法追踪学习者掌握的知识并诊断错误原因，缺乏真正的个性化。
AI.method: CoLearn包含三部分：(i) 持久化学习者状态记忆，采用软证据版贝叶斯知识追踪（BKT），由大语言模型充当连续观测函数，按主题更新掌握度；(ii) 自适应题目生成，针对最弱主题与反复出现的错误概念；(iii) 证据视图，通过实时进度可视化与盲A/B对比使个性化过程可见、可验证。
AI.result: 在盲A/B评估中，基于该记忆条件化生成的题目被偏好比例达68-69%，优于非个性化题目；在隐藏真实掌握度的人设模拟中，智能体的信念收敛于学习者真实掌握水平。
AI.conclusion: 基于证据的持久学习者记忆与LLM观测函数可有效支撑迭代式个性化辅导，显著提升题目相关性与掌握度估计准确性。

title: Not All Irregularity Is Equal: Causally Isolating a Rare Failure Mode in Japanese Morphological Inflection
summary: Neural morphological generation systems often achieve high aggregate accuracy on benchmark datasets, yet such performance can conceal systematic errors clustered in rare morphological subclasses. We present an orthography-aware diagnosis of Japanese past-tense verb inflection, treating hiragana not merely as a transcriptional medium but as a representational system that encodes morphophonological structure. Using two character-level Transformer architectures evaluated across five random seeds, we show that although both systems exceed 97% aggregate accuracy, a single structurally specific irregular subtype, verbs whose stems end in /e/ and require gemination before the past-tense suffix and make up fewer than 1% of the data, accounts for a disproportionate 30-43% share of residual errors and contributes roughly 34-48x its prevalence to total errors. We then move from diagnosis to causal isolation: controlled ablation experiments show that removing this subtype alone produces larger accuracy gains than removing all irregular verbs combined. These findings indicate that error concentration in neural morphological learning is not driven by irregularity per se, but by the interaction between extreme low-frequency morphological patterns and specific orthographic processes. We argue that morphological evaluation should incorporate fine-grained subclass analysis, and discuss implications for data-efficient, developmentally plausible language model pretraining.

AI.tldr: 该论文对日语过去时动词活用进行正字法感知诊断，发现两个字符级Transformer模型虽总体准确率超97%，但占比不足1%的特定不规则子类（词干以/e/结尾且需促音化）贡献了30-43%的残余错误，其错误贡献约为其流行度的34-48倍。
AI.motivation: 神经形态生成系统在基准数据集上常取得高总体准确率，但这种表现会掩盖集中在罕见形态子类中的系统性错误，因此需要更细粒度的子类诊断来揭示被聚合指标遮蔽的失败模式。
AI.method: 作者将平假名视为编码形态音系结构的表征系统，而非单纯转写媒介，对日语过去时动词活用进行正字法感知诊断；使用两种字符级Transformer架构，在五个随机种子下评估，并进行受控消融实验以隔离该特定不规则子类的因果影响。
AI.result: 两个系统总体准确率均超过97%，但词干以/e/结尾且过去时后缀前需促音化的不规则子类仅占数据不足1%，却占残余错误的30-43%，对总错误的贡献约为其流行度的34-48倍；仅移除该子类带来的准确率提升大于移除所有不规则动词之和。
AI.conclusion: 神经形态学习中的错误集中并非由不规则性本身驱动，而是由极低频形态模式与特定正字法过程之间的交互所致；形态学评估应纳入细粒度子类分析，并对数据高效、符合发展规律的语言模型预训练具有启示意义。

title: When Better Turns Do Not Make Better Agents: Diagnosing the Gap Between Next-Turn Metrics and Workflow Success
comment: Accepted to the REALM Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Agent models are frequently evaluated one decision at a time, where the model predicts the next action based on the gold interaction history, which is scored against a reference. We investigate whether improvement under this protocol is predictive of improved autonomous workflow execution. We study pre-SFT and supervised fine-tuned (SFT) Qwen3 models at 4B and 14B parameters and Gemma 3 models at 4B and 12B parameters on multi-turn customer-support workflows. We find that SFT consistently improves text-turn success, and that overall next-turn success increases for every model under gold-history evaluation. However, these improvements do not transfer to autonomous workflow execution. Tool-specific gains also vary across metrics and models. None of the four SFT models succeeds under holistic workflow evaluation, with strict trajectory completion reaching at most 10.4% workflow success. Our results show that next-turn evaluation is not a reliable proxy for workflow success, motivating separate reporting of text quality, local action correctness, tool execution, and end-to-end task completion.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现，逐决策的"下一轮成功"评测并不能可靠预测智能体的自主工作流执行能力，因此主张分别报告文本质量、局部动作正确性、工具执行与端到端任务完成度。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体模型常采用"一次一决策"方式评测：在黄金交互历史下预测下一动作并与参考答案比对。作者质疑这种逐轮评测的改进是否能预测真实的自主工作流执行能力，即其作为评测代理的可靠性。
AI.method: 在多轮客户支持工作流上，研究 pre-SFT 与 SFT 的 Qwen3（4B、14B）和 Gemma 3（4B、12B）模型，对比黄金历史评测下的下一轮成功与自主工作流执行的严格轨迹完成评测。
AI.result: SFT 一致提升文本轮成功，且所有模型在黄金历史评测下下一轮整体成功率都上升；但这些提升并未迁移到自主工作流执行。工具相关的增益因指标和模型而异。四个 SFT 模型在整体工作流评测下均未成功，严格轨迹完成的工作流成功率最高仅 10.4%。
AI.conclusion: 下一轮评测不是工作流成功的可靠代理，应分别报告文本质量、局部动作正确性、工具执行和端到端任务完成情况。

title: Beyond Reference-Based Evaluation: Reward Models for Meta-Evaluation of Grammatical Error Correction
summary: Reference-based metrics for Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) such as M$^2$ and ERRANT assume that the reference set enumerates all valid edits, and therefore often penalize corrections that are grammatical and meaning-preserving but phrased differently. We introduce RM-EVAL, a reward model trained on human preference data from SEEDA, as a reference-free meta-evaluator that predicts human-like quality judgments at both full-sequence and partial-sequence levels. Beyond evaluation, we show that the same reward model can be used as a learning signal to improve GEC generation via Reward-Guided Text Generation (RGTG), which keeps a base GEC model frozen and performs online, reward-driven decoding. Across SEEDA, RM-EVAL achieves strong agreement with human rankings, and RGTG yields consistent gains in reward and external validation, demonstrating a unified framework for both assessing and enhancing GEC systems without relying on gold references.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RM-EVAL，一种基于人类偏好数据训练的无参考奖励模型元评估器，可进行整句和部分序列质量判断，并可用作RGTG的奖励信号改进GEC生成。
AI.motivation: 传统GEC评估指标（如M²、ERRANT）依赖参考集枚举所有有效编辑，因而会惩罚语法正确、语义保持但表达不同的修改。作者希望摆脱对金标准参考的依赖，实现更贴近人类判断的评估，并进一步将评估信号用于提升GEC系统。
AI.method: 构建RM-EVAL：在SEEDA人类偏好数据上训练奖励模型，作为无参考元评估器，预测整句与部分序列层面的人类化质量判断。同时提出Reward-Guided Text Generation（RGTG）：保持基础GEC模型冻结，进行在线、奖励驱动的解码以改进生成。
AI.result: 在SEEDA上，RM-EVAL与人类排名高度一致；RGTG在奖励和外部验证上均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: RM-EVAL与RGTG构成统一框架，可在不依赖金标准参考的情况下同时评估与增强GEC系统。

title: When Does Reasoning Help in Machine Translation? A Hierarchical Analysis of LRM Reasoning Traces
summary: Large Reasoning Models increasingly use intermediate traces for machine translation, but it remains unclear when such reasoning helps or hurts. We analyze reasoning traces across models, languages, domains, and datasets, focusing on reasoning language, length, and structure. We find that the best reasoning language is model-specific, reasoning length has a non-monotonic relationship with quality, and traces exhibit recurring functional patterns. To uncover these patterns, we introduce Hierarchical Meta-Summarization (HMS), a scalable framework that induces coarse- and fine-grained reasoning structures without predefined taxonomies. HMS reveals a shared organization--understanding/planning, translating/drafting, and refining/verifying--alongside domain-specific variation. Our results suggest that MT reasoning should be controlled in a model-aware, length-aware, and pattern-aware manner rather than uniformly encouraged.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统分析了大推理模型在机器翻译中中间推理轨迹的作用，提出层级元摘要（HMS）框架揭示推理的结构与模式，主张对翻译推理进行模型感知、长度感知与模式感知的调控。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型在机器翻译中日益使用中间推理轨迹，但何时这种推理有益、何时有害尚不明确，亟需系统分析推理语言、长度与结构等因素的影响。
AI.method: 跨模型、语言、领域与数据集分析推理轨迹，关注推理语言、长度与结构；提出可扩展的层级元摘要（HMS）框架，在无预定义分类体系下归纳粗粒度与细粒度的推理结构。
AI.result: 最优推理语言因模型而异；推理长度与质量呈非单调关系；推理轨迹呈现反复出现的功能模式。HMS揭示了共享组织（理解/规划、翻译/起草、精炼/验证）及领域特定的变异。
AI.conclusion: 机器翻译中的推理应以模型感知、长度感知和模式感知的方式进行控制，而非一律鼓励使用推理。

title: Beyond Atomic Tokens: Factorizing Syllables for Language Model Pretraining
summary: Conventional tokenizers represent text as characters or statistically derived subwords, overlooking the internal phonological structure of syllables and often requiring large vocabularies. We introduce \textbf{Phonemic Tokenizer}, a linguistically motivated tokenizer for Vietnamese and Chinese that converts each syllable into IPA and factorizes it into three phonological components: onset, rime, and tone. The three components jointly occupy one contextual position, preserving syllable-level sequence length while enabling representation sharing across phonologically related syllables. Non-phonological and unsupported units are handled through character-level fallback. This deterministic design requires no corpus-dependent vocabulary learning and yields vocabularies of only 112 entries for Chinese and 256 for Vietnamese. Intrinsic evaluation shows that the tokenizer achieves substantially higher Rényi efficiency in both languages, represents every entry in a standard Vietnamese syllable dictionary with a Fertility of exactly one, and generally produces shorter Vietnamese sequences than existing pretrained tokenizers. We further instantiate the tokenizer in \textbf{PhonemicBERT}, which combines factorized component embeddings and reconstructs complete masked syllables using three prediction heads. Under a controlled Chinese pretraining setup, PhonemicBERT-Zh is competitive with or outperforms character, subword, and SubChar alternatives across diverse language-understanding tasks. PhonemicBERT-Vi also achieves competitive or superior results to established Vietnamese and multilingual pretrained models. These results establish phonemic factorization as a compact, efficient, and interpretable alternative to atomic and statistically segmented text representations.

AI.tldr: 提出音素分词器 Phonemic Tokenizer，将越南语和汉语音节转为 IPA 并分解为声母、韵母、声调三个音系成分，共享一个上下文位置，词表仅 112（中文）和 256（越南语），并实例化为 PhonemicBERT 在多项理解任务上达到或超过字符/子词基线。
AI.motivation: 传统分词器以字符或统计子词表示文本，忽略音节内部音系结构，且往往需要大词表。作者希望引入语言学先验，用音系分解实现紧凑、高效且可解释的表示。
AI.method: 将每个音节转换为 IPA 并因子化为 onset（声母）、rime（韵母）、tone（声调）三部分；三者共同占用一个上下文位置，保持音节级序列长度，同时允许音系相关音节共享表示；非音系及不支持单元采用字符级回退；设计为确定性、无需语料相关词表学习。进一步构建 PhonemicBERT，融合因子化成分嵌入，并用三个预测头重建完整被掩码音节。
AI.result: 在两种语言上取得显著更高的 Rényi 效率；对标准越南语音节词典的每个条目 Fertility 恰为 1；越南语序列通常比现有预训练分词器更短。受控中文预训练下，PhonemicBERT-Zh 在多种语言理解任务上与字符、子词及 SubChar 方案相当或更优；PhonemicBERT-Vi 与既有越南语及多语言预训练模型相比也具竞争力或更优。
AI.conclusion: 音系因子化是一种紧凑、高效且可解释的文本表示方案，可替代原子化与统计式分词表示。

title: ArenaFlow: From Trajectory Ranking to Hierarchical Credit Propagation for Open-Ended Agent RL
summary: Reinforcement learning has substantially improved large language model (LLM) agents in verifiable domains, but remains difficult to apply to open-ended agent tasks, where solutions are diverse and reliable scalar rewards are hard to obtain. Recent pairwise evaluation methods alleviate reward discrimination collapse by replacing pointwise scoring with relative preferences. However, they still compress rich comparative feedback into a single trajectory-level reward, obscuring decisive intermediate steps and preventing successful behaviors from being consolidated into reusable skills. We propose ArenaFlow, a hierarchical credit propagation framework for open-ended agent reinforcement learning. ArenaFlow leverages tournament-based relative ranking to derive trajectory-level reward signals. Each comparison is further equipped with structured reflective evaluation, which reveals three types of supervision: pivotal success steps, reusable strategy skills, and usage attribution of retrieved skills. At the step level, ArenaFlow propagates trajectory-level advantages to high-confidence pivotal steps according to tournament survival depth, enabling more targeted optimization of local reasoning behaviors. At the skill level, ArenaFlow estimates skill utility from group-level usage attribution and maintains a global skill memory through utility-aware updating, pruning, and retrieval. The resulting high-utility skills further serve as policy priors for future exploration. Extensive experiments validate ArenaFlow's effectiveness on open-ended agent tasks.

AI.tldr: ArenaFlow：面向开放式智能体强化学习的分层信用传播框架，通过锦标赛相对排名获得轨迹级奖励并结合结构化反思评估，将优势传播至关键步骤并构建技能记忆。
AI.motivation: 强化学习已在可验证领域的LLM智能体中取得显著进展，但在开放式任务中难以应用：解具有多样性且难以获得可靠的标量奖励。现有成对评估方法虽通过相对偏好缓解奖励判别崩塌，但仍将丰富的比较反馈压缩为单一轨迹级奖励，掩盖了决定性中间步骤，也无法将成功行为固化为可复用技能。
AI.method: 提出ArenaFlow分层信用传播框架：1）利用基于锦标赛的相对排名导出轨迹级奖励信号；2）每次比较配备结构化反思评估，揭示三类监督信号——关键成功步骤、可复用策略技能、检索技能的使用归因；3）步骤级：依据锦标赛存活深度将轨迹级优势传播至高置信关键步骤，实现局部推理行为的针对性优化；4）技能级：从组级使用归因估计技能效用，通过效用感知的更新、剪枝与检索维护全局技能记忆，高效用技能作为未来探索的策略先验。
AI.result: 大量实验验证了ArenaFlow在开放式智能体任务上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ArenaFlow通过分层信用传播，将轨迹级相对奖励细化为步骤级与技能级监督，有效解决了开放式智能体强化学习中奖励稀疏、信用分配粗粒度及技能难以复用的问题。

title: Benchmarking Gender Bias in Machine Translation Evaluation Metrics across Occupations
comment: Accepted for publication at the 11th Conference of Machine Translation (WMT26), co-located with EMNLP 2026
summary: Gender bias remains a persistent concern in machine translation (MT), affecting both generated translations and their automatic evaluation. When a source text leaves a person's gender unspecified, translations may realize that person using masculine or feminine forms, and both MT systems and evaluation metrics may exhibit systematic preferences between these alternatives despite the source providing no basis for such a distinction. We study this behavior in the WMT 2026 Automated Translation Quality Evaluation Systems Shared Task using an occupation-balanced subset of GAMBIT+. We consider seven English-source language pairs, six from the original dataset, targeting Arabic, Czech, Greek, Icelandic, Russian, and Ukrainian, and extend the original resource with German. The subset contains 1,308 masculine/feminine translation pairs per target language, with three examples for each of the 436 ISCO-08 occupational groups. We evaluate shared-task submissions and baselines for score prediction and error annotation, examining the direction, magnitude, and frequency of gender-related differences. We find an overall tendency for masculine translations to receive higher scores, as well as differences per occupation following stereotypical gender representations, although the strength and consistency of this preference vary considerably across evaluators and languages. Our results show that gender bias remains present in MT evaluation, but that capturing its extent requires looking beyond a single aggregate measure to complementary dimensions of evaluator behavior.

AI.tldr: 论文研究WMT 2026自动翻译质量评估任务中的性别偏见，使用GAMBIT+职业平衡子集（7个英语源语言对，每语言1308对男/女性别翻译对），发现男性化译文整体得分更高，且差异随职业呈刻板印象分布，但评估器与语言间强度不一致。
AI.motivation: 机器翻译在源文本性别未指明时，译文可能采用阳性或阴性形式，而MT系统与自动评估指标可能对二者存在系统性偏好，尽管源文本并未提供区分依据。性别偏见既影响生成译文也影响其自动评估，但现有评估对偏见的方向、幅度、频率缺乏多维度刻画，尤其在共享任务语境下缺少细粒度分析。
AI.method: 基于GAMBIT+构建职业平衡子集：7个英语源语言对（阿拉伯语、捷克语、希腊语、冰岛语、俄语、乌克兰语，外加德语扩展），每种目标语言1308个男/女译文对，覆盖436个ISCO-08职业组、每组3例。对共享任务提交系统及基线进行评分预测与错误标注评估，考察性别相关差异的方向、幅度与频率。
AI.result: 译文整体呈现阳性形式得分更高的倾向；不同职业间的差异符合性别刻板印象；该偏好的强度与一致性在评估器之间和目标语言之间存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 性别偏见仍存在于MT评估中；仅靠单一聚合指标无法充分捕捉其程度，需结合评估器行为的多个互补维度进行衡量。

title: MIRAGE: Multi-Perspective Creative Language Model Reasoning with Reinforcement Learning Guidance
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the ICML 2025 Workshop on Multi-Agent Systems in the Era of Foundation Models: Opportunities, Challenges and Futures (MAS-2025)
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized artificial intelligence and how human interact with AIs. Despite impressive advancements, LLMs struggle with complex mathematical, scientific, and logical tasks. Inspired by human cognitive flexibility - our ability to dynamically switch mental perspectives - we propose MIRAGE (Multi-perspective Inference-time Reasoning via Agent-Guided Exploration), a novel inference-time creative thinking framework. MIRAGE includes a Selector that prioritizes effective conceptual perspectives (e.g., algebraic, probabilistic) and a Reasoner that sequentially solves tasks until a confident solution emerges, otherwise aggregating multiple perspectives. Tested on GSM8K, MATH500, MMLU-Pro, and Game-of-24 benchmarks, MIRAGE consistently outperforms methods like Chain-of-Thought and diverse prompting ensembles, significantly boosting accuracy with minimal inference overhead, providing a scalable solution for practical applications.

AI.tldr: MIRAGE 是一个推理时创造性思维框架，通过动态切换多种概念视角（如代数、概率）来提升大语言模型在数学、科学和逻辑任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽取得显著进展，但在复杂数学、科学和逻辑任务上仍表现不足。受人类认知灵活性（即动态切换心理视角的能力）启发，作者希望赋予模型多视角推理能力以弥补这一短板。
AI.method: 提出 MIRAGE（多视角推理时推理，通过智能体引导探索）。框架包含两个核心组件：Selector（选择器）负责优先挑选有效的概念视角（如代数、概率视角）；Reasoner（推理器）顺序求解任务，直至产生高置信度的解，否则将多个视角的结果进行聚合。
AI.result: 在 GSM8K、MATH500、MMLU-Pro 和 Game-of-24 四个基准上测试，MIRAGE 持续优于 Chain-of-Thought 及多种提示集成方法，在极小的推理开销下显著提升准确率。
AI.conclusion: MIRAGE 提供了一种可扩展的实用解决方案，通过多视角智能体引导探索有效增强大语言模型的复杂推理能力，兼顾性能与效率。

title: Rethinking Human-Aligned Evaluation: An Analysis of Semantic Metrics Beyond WER
summary: Word Error Rate (WER), the most commonly used metric for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), treats every lexical deviation from the reference as equally costly, regardless of whether it changes meaning. This raises the question: does WER actually track how humans judge ASR transcript quality? We introduce HATS-en, an English dataset for human-centered ASR evaluation. Using this dataset, we benchmark lexical metrics against several configurations of BERTScore and SemDist, varying the language model, layer, and pooling strategy. We find that WER agrees least with human judgment among all metrics tested, that the best-performing SemDist configurations achieve the highest overall agreement, ahead of CER and BERTScore, and that no single model is best across settings. CER, despite its simplicity and low cost, remains remarkably close to these best configurations. In line with prior recommendations, our results support shifting ASR evaluation toward CER both for English and for morphosyllabic writing systems as it is a more interpretable and low-cost metric for what evaluation should actually capture, and using SemDist as a complementary evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HATS-en英文人类评价数据集，系统比较WER、CER、BERTScore与SemDist与人类判断的一致性，发现WER一致性最低，最佳SemDist配置最高，CER性价比突出。
AI.motivation: WER作为ASR最常用指标，将任何词级偏差等同视之，忽略是否改变语义，因此需要检验WER是否真正反映人类对转写质量的判断，并寻找更贴合人类感知的评价指标。
AI.method: 构建HATS-en英文人类评价数据集；以人类评分为基准，对比词级指标（WER、CER）与多种BERTScore、SemDist配置（改变语言模型、层选择与池化策略）的一致性。
AI.result: 在所有测试指标中WER与人类判断一致性最低；最佳SemDist配置整体一致性最高，优于CER与BERTScore；不存在跨设置普遍最优的单一模型；CER虽简单低成本，但表现接近最佳配置。
AI.conclusion: 支持将ASR评价转向CER（对英文及音节文字系统均适用），因其更可解释、低成本且更贴近评价应捕捉的目标，并将SemDist作为补充评价手段。

title: PRISM-BN: A Controlled Corpus and Benchmark for Text-to-Parameterized Bayesian Network Extraction
summary: Probabilistic Graphical Models (PGMs), especially Bayesian Networks (BNs), expose directed structure and probabilistic parameters, making them natural symbolic targets for neurosymbolic AI. Yet training text-to-parameterized-BN systems requires paired text-to-BN resources unavailable at scale. We introduce PRISM-BN, a controlled corpus of 5054 BN-grounded descriptions paired with discrete reference BNs containing variables, states, directed edges, root priors, and full multi-parent CPDs across five domains. The instances are derived from 50 Wikipedia-seeded backbones, and their probabilities are internally constructed benchmark targets rather than externally validated causal estimates. PRISM-BN is built with PRISM, a marginal-first pipeline that elicits marginal and local joint distributions, analytically recovers normalized CPDs, and constructs locally reparameterized subgraphs. We define a benchmark with semantic node and state alignment, conditional structural scoring, and strict full-CPD evaluation. Across six LLM extractors, Node F1 ranges from 0.56 to 0.83, conditional Edge F1 from 0.90 to 0.97, and CPD-KL from 1.11 to 3.14. Conditional state and edge recovery remain consistently strong, whereas strict full-CPD agreement remains challenging. These trends persist with independently generated GPT-5.5 references, and a human pilot corroborates structural recoverability and similar probabilistic interpretations. PRISM-BN supports separate evaluation of structural recovery and probabilistic parameter estimation.

AI.tldr: PRISM-BN：5054条文本-贝叶斯网络配对语料，用PRISM边际优先流程构建，支持结构恢复与概率参数估计的分离评测。
AI.motivation: 概率图模型（尤其贝叶斯网络）具有有向结构与概率参数，是神经符号AI的天然符号化目标；但训练"文本到参数化贝叶斯网络"系统需要大规模配对的文本-BN资源，此类数据在规模上不可得。
AI.method: 构建受控语料PRISM-BN：5054条BN grounding描述配对离散参考BN，含变量、状态、有向边、根先验及完整多父节点CPD，覆盖五个领域；实例源自50个Wikipedia种子骨架，概率为内部构造的基准目标而非外部验证的因果估计。采用PRISM边际优先流水线：先诱导边际与局部联合分布，解析恢复归一化CPD，并构建局部重参数化子图。基准定义含语义节点/状态对齐、条件结构评分与严格全CPD评测。
AI.result: 在六个LLM抽取器上，Node F1为0.56–0.83，条件Edge F1为0.90–0.97，CPD-KL为1.11–3.14。条件状态与边恢复持续较强，严格全CPD一致性仍具挑战；该趋势在独立生成的GPT-5.5参考上保持一致，人类试点亦支持结构可恢复性与相似的概率解释。
AI.conclusion: PRISM-BN支持对结构恢复与概率参数估计进行分离评测，为神经符号文本到贝叶斯网络的建模与评估提供受控基准。

title: Reusing Latent Speech Representations for Query-Conditioned Topic Localization in Transcripts
summary: Long transcripts are costly inputs for downstream NLP systems and often contain irrelevant context. We study query-conditioned topic localization: predicting the sentence span in a transcript that best addresses a topic-title query. To improve span localization, we reuse ASR encoder states as sentence-level representations and fuse them with textual embeddings. This lets lightweight span locators exploit speech information without running a separate audio encoder. Experiments on two public datasets show consistent gains over text-only baselines, especially under strict boundary-matching criteria. Cross-dataset experiments further indicate that the benefits are strongest for structured or semi-structured speech, while gains on spontaneous speech are limited and mixed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"查询条件化主题定位"任务：在长转录文本中预测最能回应主题标题查询的句子片段。方法复用ASR编码器状态作为句级表示，并与文本嵌入融合，使轻量片段定位器无需单独音频编码器即可利用语音信息。两个公开数据集上均优于纯文本基线，尤其在严格边界匹配标准下；跨数据集实验显示结构化/半结构化语音收益最大，自发语音增益有限且不稳定。
AI.motivation: 长转录文本作为下游NLP系统输入成本高昂，且包含大量无关上下文。需要定位转录中与给定主题查询最相关的句子片段，以降低成本并提升下游效率；同时希望在不额外训练音频编码器的前提下利用语音信息改进定位。
AI.method: 提出查询条件化物主题定位任务。复用ASR编码器状态作为句级表示，将其与文本嵌入融合，为轻量级片段定位器提供语音线索，避免引入独立音频编码器。
AI.result: 在两个公开数据集上相较纯文本基线取得一致提升，在严格边界匹配准则下提升尤为明显。跨数据集实验表明，收益在结构化或半结构化语音上最强，而在自发语音上增益有限且表现参差。
AI.conclusion: 融合ASR编码器状态是一种无需额外音频编码器的有效增强方式，可提升转录中查询条件化的片段定位性能；但其有效性依赖语音类型，对自发语音的迁移增益有限。

title: TrialAtlas: Multi-Agent Research Organization for Clinical Trial Design and Optimization
summary: Nearly 90% of drugs entering clinical development ultimately fail, despite billions of dollars in investment. Pharmaceutical companies therefore rely on clinical development planning (CDP) and probability of technical and regulatory success assessment to anticipate development risks, yet these decisions remain labor-intensive and subjective, requiring experts across clinical science, statistics, regulatory affairs, and competitive intelligence to jointly acquire, synthesize, and reason over heterogeneous evidence. Here, we introduce TrialAtlas, a memory-augmented multi-agent research organization for CDP that mirrors this collaborative process by coordinating specialized agents for literature synthesis, competitive trial intelligence, regulatory precedent analysis, and integrated reasoning over trial design and development risk. TrialAtlas further learns from historical clinical trials and regulatory outcomes, including prior New Drug Applications (NDAs), to ground its decisions in accumulated development experience. To evaluate these capabilities in an authentic regulatory setting, we introduce TrialAtlasBench, constructed from 291 FDA Complete Response Letters and spanning three practical tasks: detecting trial design deficiencies, recommending actionable design improvements, and predicting technical and regulatory success. TrialAtlas achieves an F1 score of 50.0% for deficiency detection, outperforming the strongest baseline by 6.1 points, and reaches 85.3% balanced accuracy and 84.7% F1 for prediction of technical and regulatory success, improving over the best baselines by 6.7 points in balanced accuracy and 12.0 points in Cohen's kappa. In expert evaluation, 86.4% of TrialAtlas-generated concerns were judged valid, compared with 83.1% for OpenAI DeepResearch and 59.3% for Gemini DeepResearch.

AI.tldr: TrialAtlas：记忆增强的多智能体研究组织，用于临床开发规划（CDP）；配套TrialAtlasBench基准，在缺陷检测、设计改进建议与技术/监管成功预测三项任务上均超越基线。
AI.motivation: 约90%进入临床开发的药物最终失败，药企依赖CDP与技术/监管成功概率评估来预判风险，但现有决策高度依赖人力、主观性强，需跨临床科学、统计、监管事务与竞争情报专家共同获取、整合并推理异构证据，缺乏自动化、可积累经验的支持系统。
AI.method: 提出TrialAtlas，一种记忆增强的多智能体研究组织，通过协调文献综合、竞争性试验情报、监管先例分析及试验设计与开发风险集成推理等专用智能体，模拟专家协作流程；并从历史临床试验与监管结果（含既往NDA）中学习，将决策建立在积累的开发经验之上。同时构建TrialAtlasBench，基于291份FDA完整回复函（CRL），涵盖试验设计缺陷检测、可执行设计改进建议、技术与监管成功预测三项任务。
AI.result: 缺陷检测F1达50.0%，超最强基线6.1个百分点；技术/监管成功预测达85.3%平衡准确率与84.7% F1，较最佳基线在平衡准确率上提升6.7个百分点、Cohen's kappa提升12.0个百分点；专家评估中TrialAtlas生成关注的86.4%被判为有效，高于OpenAI DeepResearch的83.1%与Gemini DeepResearch的59.3%。
AI.conclusion: TrialAtlas以多智能体协作与记忆机制将CDP与监管成功预测从主观、劳动密集的过程转化为可积累经验、可量化评估的自动化流程，并在真实监管场景基准上验证了其有效性与专家认可度。

title: RecreationWorld: Scalable and Verifiable Environments for Hybrid Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) have advanced along two separate lines: graphical interaction and software development through code and the command line. Real digital work requires both, interleaved rather than stacked end to end. We study hybrid CUAs that autonomously decide when to explore an interface, implement software, and run and visually verify their artifacts. We introduce RecreationWorld, a five-platform framework built around recreation: given a running reference, an agent must discover its behavior and build a faithful implementation with no prescribed workflow. RecreationWorld provides reproducible environments on Ubuntu, macOS, Windows, Android, and Web, plus a unified harness with native GUI control and coding tools. The running reference serves as an oracle for hidden behavioral tests, providing execution-grounded rewards. We scale trajectory generation with high-quality open-source applications. Models trained on these trajectories improve across five out-of-distribution coding and hybrid computer-use benchmarks and more frequently verify their rendered outputs, providing evidence of transfer beyond recreation. For held-out evaluation, we introduce RecreationBench, comprising 250 diverse tasks across domains and platforms. Reference-grounded programmatic and visual assertions cover action-conditioned outcomes at multiple interaction depths; each is validated on the reference and by human reviewers before the suite is frozen for automatic scoring. GPT-6 Astra leads at 58.1% overall, but passes all programmatic tests on just 2.8% of tasks. Agents reproduce static interface structure more reliably than interactions and computed outputs, while generated applications remain smaller and more monolithic than their references. We release the benchmark, environments, and test suites.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出混合计算机使用智能体（hybrid CUA）设定，并构建 RecreationWorld 五平台框架与 RecreationBench 基准，用以评估智能体在无既定流程下"复刻"运行中参考软件的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机使用智能体分两条独立路线发展：图形界面交互与通过代码/命令行进行软件开发。而真实数字工作需要在两者之间交替进行，而非端到端串行堆叠，因此需要研究能自主决定何时探索界面、何时实现软件并运行和视觉验证产物的混合型智能体，同时缺乏相应的可复现环境与评测基准。
AI.method: 提出 RecreationWorld：围绕"复刻"（recreation）设计的五平台框架（Ubuntu、macOS、Windows、Android、Web），提供可复现环境与统一测试台，集成原生 GUI 控制与编码工具。任务设定为：给定一个运行中的参考程序，智能体须自行发现其行为并构建忠实实现，不预设工作流。以运行中的参考作为隐藏行为测试的 oracle，提供基于执行的奖励。利用高质量开源应用扩展轨迹生成规模，并据此训练模型。
AI.result: 基于所生成轨迹训练的模型在五个分布外编码与混合计算机使用基准上均取得提升，并更频繁地对渲染输出进行验证，显示跨复刻场景的迁移证据。在冻结的 RecreationBench（250 个跨领域、跨平台任务，含基于参考的程序化与视觉断言，经参考程序与人工审阅双重验证）上，GPT-6 Astra 以 58.1% 总体得分领先，但仅 2.8% 的任务通过全部程序化测试。智能体复现静态界面结构比复现交互与计算输出更可靠；生成的应用程序相比参考仍更小、更单体化。
AI.conclusion: 混合计算机使用（交替进行界面探索、软件开发与视觉验证）是可训练且可评测的方向；当前最强模型在完整通过全部程序化测试的任务上比例极低（2.8%），交互与计算输出仍是主要瓶颈，生成应用在规模与模块化程度上与真实参考存在差距。作者开源基准、环境与测试套件。

title: QuranicMMLU: A Cognitively-Aware Benchmark for Evaluating Generative AI Solutions on Quranic Linguistic Knowledge
summary: We introduce QuranicMMLU, a benchmark for evaluating generative AI on Quranic Arabic across multiple dimensions of linguistic complexity. Existing Quranic benchmarks center on general question answering and semantic retrieval, without probing specific linguistic competencies or stratifying by cognitive demand and verse difficulty. We construct a five-pillar Quranic taxonomy spanning Phonology, Morphology, Syntax, Semantics, and Pragmatics, with 31 leaves covering phenomena from tajwīd and root-and-pattern morphology to occasions of revelation and inter-surah coherence. For each leaf we generate questions stratified by Bloom's cognitive level and verse perplexity, then have LLM as a judge to independently answer and score every item and route the annotations to manual review. The resulting dataset comprises 980 human-reviewed questions, each issued in both open-ended and multiple-choice form. We benchmark 12 systems on these items and find that the Islamic-specialized model leads, yet every system scores higher on multiple-choice accuracy (average 84%) than open-ended answer quality (average 60%): the two rankings agree closely (Kendall's τ=0.73), but multiple-choice scoring hides failures that surface only once answer choices are removed. QuranicMMLU thus offers a rigorous, linguistically grounded framework for evaluating Arabic NLP in the Quranic domain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 QuranicMMLU 基准，从语言学五大层级对生成式 AI 的古兰经阿拉伯语能力进行评估，构建 980 道经人工审核的题目，并以开放式与多项选择两种形式测试 12 个系统。
AI.motivation: 现有古兰经基准主要关注通用问答与语义检索，未针对具体语言学能力进行探测，也未按认知需求与经文难度进行分层，因而难以细致刻画模型在古兰经阿拉伯语上的真实能力。
AI.method: 构建涵盖音系学、形态学、句法学、语义学、语用学五大支柱、31 个叶节点的古兰经分类体系；为每个叶节点按 Bloom 认知层级与经文困惑度分层生成题目；采用 LLM-as-a-judge 独立作答与打分并转交人工复核；最终形成 980 道经人工审核的题目，每题同时以开放式与多项选择两种形式呈现；在该数据集上对 12 个系统进行评测。
AI.result: 伊斯兰专门化模型表现最佳；但所有系统在多项选择准确率上（平均 84%）均高于开放式作答质量（平均 60%）；两种形式的系统排名高度一致（Kendall's τ=0.73）；多项选择评分掩盖了去除选项后才暴露的失败。
AI.conclusion: QuranicMMLU 为古兰经领域的阿拉伯语 NLP 评估提供了严谨且语言学基础扎实的框架，并揭示多项选择评测的低区分度问题。

title: An Interpretable Memory Decision Controller for LLM Agents Based on Three-Signal Complementarity: Decoupling Confidence and Consistency
summary: Memory systems for large language models have focused predominantly on efficient retrieval, whereas the decision of whether retrieved memories should be trusted has received comparatively little attention. When the memory store contains conflicting positions, standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) blindly injects memories and amplifies hallucinations: in models susceptible to memory injection, the RAG hallucination rate under conflicting memories is markedly higher than that of a memory-free baseline. Inspired by memory signaling mechanisms in the prefrontal cortex, we propose the Memory Decision Layer (MDL), a zero-parameter memory decision controller situated between the retrieval and generation stages. Its core is a three-signal complementary encoder that fuses relevance, reliability, and task risk through QR-based orthogonal subspace projection and a meta-working-memory signal into an interpretable decision representation that quantifies the trustworthiness of retrieved memories. Building on this encoder, MDL explicitly decouples confidence from consistency and introduces risk inversion and explicit abstention. Evaluations on mainstream large language models and multiple open-source datasets show that MDL reduces the hallucination rate under conflicting memories by about 56.04% in general scenarios and approaches zero hallucination in high-risk scenarios. The controller is fully white-box: it relies purely on geometric operations, requires no trained parameters, and adds only about 0.14 ms per decision -- roughly 50x faster than the embedding-retrieval step that precedes it and four to five orders of magnitude faster than an LLM self-evaluation call.

AI.tldr: 提出零参数记忆决策控制器MDL，通过三信号互补编码对检索记忆的可信度进行显式判定，在冲突记忆下将幻觉率降低约56.04%，高危场景接近零幻觉，单次决策仅约0.14 ms。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型记忆系统主要聚焦高效检索，却忽视"检索到的记忆是否应当被信任"这一决策问题。当记忆库中存在冲突立场时，标准RAG会盲目注入记忆并放大幻觉：在易受记忆注入影响的模型上，冲突记忆下的RAG幻觉率显著高于无记忆基线。作者受前额叶皮层记忆信号机制启发，希望补上"检索—生成"之间缺失的可信度判定环节。
AI.method: 提出Memory Decision Layer（MDL），一个位于检索与生成阶段之间的零参数记忆决策控制器。核心是三信号互补编码器：融合相关性、可靠性与任务风险，通过基于QR的正交子空间投影，并结合元工作记忆信号，形成可解释的决策表示，量化检索记忆的可信程度。在此编码器基础上，MDL显式解耦置信度与一致性，并引入风险反转与显式弃答（abstention）机制。控制器完全白盒，仅依赖几何运算，无需训练参数。
AI.result: 在主流大语言模型与多个开源数据集上评测：一般场景下冲突记忆导致的幻觉率降低约56.04%，高危场景下接近零幻觉；单次决策仅增加约0.14 ms，比前置的嵌入检索步骤快约50倍，比LLM自评估调用快四到五个数量级。
AI.conclusion: MDL将记忆系统的研究重点从"检索效率"扩展到"检索可信度决策"，以零参数、白盒、低开销的方式有效抑制冲突记忆引发的幻觉，并提供风险反转与弃答能力，为RAG中的记忆信任问题提供了轻量且可解释的解决方案。

title: Cross-sector generalization of accident-process role classification in occupational accident narratives
summary: Occupational accident narratives contain valuable information about work situations, unfavourable conditions, accident events, and their consequences. Automatically structuring these narratives can facilitate large-scale accident analysis and support occupational risk prevention. However, the terminology and writing styles used to describe accidents vary considerably across sectors and organisations, raising questions about the ability of automated coding systems to generalize beyond their training domain. In this paper, we evaluate the cross-sector generalization of accident-process role classification in French occupational accident narratives. We construct an expert-annotated corpus in which factual units are classified into four roles: work situation (A0), explicitly reported unfavourable condition (A1), accident event or deviation (B), and reported consequence (C). The role classifiers are developed and selected exclusively on 42,244 factual units extracted from 6,040 construction-sector narratives and are then evaluated on unseen corpora from the metallurgy and chemistry--plastics sectors, as well as on an independently collected company corpus, without retraining or target-domain tuning of the role classifier. We compare frozen pretrained representations with task-specific fine-tuning and supervised representation-learning strategies. The results show that task-specific adaptation consistently improves cross-domain transfer over frozen representations. Across repeated training runs, the three leading task-adapted strategies achieved average balanced accuracies between 85.6% and 85.8% across the three target corpora. These findings support the development of transferable assisted-coding systems capable of consistently structuring heterogeneous occupational accident narratives for expert review and cross-sector prevention analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文评估法语职业事故叙述中“事故过程角色分类”的跨行业泛化能力，发现任务特定微调显著优于冻结预训练表示，前三种方法在三个目标语料上平均平衡准确率约85.6%–85.8%。
AI.motivation: 职业事故叙述蕴含工作情境、不利条件、事故事件及后果等信息，自动结构化可支持大规模事故分析与风险预防；但事故描述术语与写作风格因行业和组织而异，自动编码系统能否泛化到训练域之外尚不明确，因此需检验跨行业泛化性。
AI.method: 构建专家标注语料，将事实单元分为四类角色：工作情境（A0）、明确报告的不利条件（A1）、事故事件或偏差（B）、报告后果（C）。角色分类器仅在来自6,040条建筑行业叙述的42,244个事实单元上开发与选择，随后在未见的冶金、化学—塑料行业语料及独立收集的企业语料上评估，不进行重训练或目标域调优。比较冻结预训练表示、任务特定微调与监督表示学习策略。
AI.result: 任务特定适配在跨域迁移上始终优于冻结表示；重复训练中，三种领先的任务适配策略在三个目标语料上的平均平衡准确率为85.6%–85.8%。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持开发可迁移的辅助编码系统，以一致地结构化异构职业事故叙述，服务于专家复核与跨行业预防分析。
